Love love love this theater.  Went on a weekday. So theater was near empty. Seats were comfy, popcorn was fresh and yummy, staff was friendly.

I accidently stumbled on this place during a makeup trial with Vinny Hoang (an amazing makeup artist) and I AM SO THANKFUL FOR THIS PLACE!!!!!!! Michelle, the co-owner of this One-Stop-Shop wedding boutique is wonderful!!  This boutique covers EVERYTHING for your wedding.  They have tux rentals, limos, photography, wedding gowns, evening gowns, makeup services, accessories, DJs, invitations, etc, etc.  I bought an evening gown for my wedding and rented a chinese wedding dress from them and the prices are GREAT!  My fiance and his groomsmen all rented their tuxes here and the fits are great and the prices are the best around.  Their limo services and DJs are also the cheapest I have found so far.

Brides, please stop by and check this place out before you go anywhere else!  Michelle and her partners will help plan all the details of your wedding. They have absolutely taken out the stress in my wedding planning and I am so thankful that I found them.

The coffee is... alright; it is mild in strength.  They have a limited variety of flavor syrups. A positive is that the barista understands espresso terminology and is friendly. The muffins are good. The atmosphere is friendly to all, including homeless people, which is cool. Some people may call it an alternative style atmosphere. The Wifi is a decent speed for being free.

The bowls are good and lots of options. However, we got the Avocado Toast for the first time tonight and it was horrible. We had to throw it away. The "everything" seasoning was so salty it ruined any chance of eating it.  I'm sure no one working there has tasted it because it's truly inedible.  It's $6.99 for one slice of toast which is a little expensive as well.

I've lived in this city for over 2 decades so believe me when I say I have tried many, many sandwiches during that time-- but Cafe Cuong's chicken banh mi is my favorite sandwich in Philadelphia!!! The bread is crispy, the blend of flavors is absolutely perfect, and the chicken is delicious. The bbq pork is also very good. 
Also the staff here are so nice and the service is quick. It's just the best.
Amazing chicken banh mi.  The restaurant interior isn't great and that's the only reason for the 4 stars

[ summary ]
A vegan restaurant with the dignity of a regular restaurant. You should come here not because the food is good "for a vegan place", but because the food is good, period. You know your vegan friend - the one that you keep forgetting is vegan because they don't feel the need to clutter your Facebook feed with PETA ads and pictures of cute rabbits, and actually lives and talks like a normal person who has interests outside of being vegan? Yeah, this restaurant is like that friend.

[ vibe and decor ]
A chic modern feel with clean, angular tables. Nice bar when you walk in. Black, grey, and beige, minimalist art on the walls, strings of yellow-tinted light bulbs, clean-looking menus. The building has a neat round part in the middle that they made excellent geometric use of. 10/10 on this front.

[ service ]
Impeccably dressed and warm, friendly waiters! Quite impressive.

[ food ]
Balanced, mild but well-calibrated flavours. Everything we ordered was fantastic:

-piri piri tofu: gently grilled, well-seasoned

-jerk trumpet mushrooms: delicious and umami-y

-korean fried tempeh tacos: not quite sure why this was called Korean as the gochujang flavour is actually quite mild, but the crispy breaded tempeh is perfectly cooked. Dipping sauce is on point.

-mushroom dan dan noodles: spicy and not as peanut-y as you'd get in a real Chinese restaurant, but still well-flavoured. Cucumber slices and deliciously sautéed shiitake mushrooms really round this off.

We split these among three people and came out quite satisfied at about $15 a person after tax and tip. Excellent value for food of this quality.

[ conclusion ]
If you are vegetarian or vegan you definitely need to add this to your to-try list. And for your carnivore friends who think that all vegetarians / vegans are hipster, beanie-wearing PETA-flag waving idiots who eat salad all day, let this place change their mind. Dignified people (and restaurants) can be vegan too. :)

Similar to the Ritz 5 but with better stadium seating. A nice spot to see the most popular independent films. The theaters and bathrooms are kept clean. The concession stand is a bit limited. But the best thing is that the people that come here love movies. So you don't get the idiots talking and texting during the movie.
They have the most amazing vegan fish with rice! It tastes so close to actual fish. The watermelon juice and espresso are also amazing!

I've been coming here since I was a child and I do not like the classic banh mi from anywhere else! To explain how much I love this place, let me just say that when I visited Vietnam and came back home, I still liked Cafe Cuong's the most!

This is a small, little hole in the wall with two tables. However, most people just order takeout. The family is really nice and friendly, and makes everything themselves. Just keep in mind that this place is cash only! One banh mi will not set you back any more than $5, but prices over the last 15 years have nearly doubled like everything else LOL

This is a "banh mi" however anyone who has ever had a REAL banh mi would know you don't put American mayo on the sandwhich!!! AND there's no cold cut Vietnamese ham!! Not impressed to say the least...

This place is insane the flavors of vietnam intermingle
With delight here as you savor the sweet beer pho and the soft piano play in the background! The a ala carte Menu offers any coMbination you can think of ! Do you aren't limited to just the broken rIce platters or the soup I like that a lot ! The staff are pleasant and very attentive to anyone who comes in. They fed a homeless man first time I was here I thought that was a rare qualtity  to see nOw a days but great to see in an establishment so close to home! I give them 5 stars if you are shopping in Germantown stop by this place ! It won't disappoint !

Love the service here! We ordered omelettes 1 with bacon, tomatoes, mushrooms and avocado it was perfectly cooked no browning of the egg and light and fluffy. The vegetables were all in tact and fresh. The skillet potatoes were tasty and seasoned nicely. The 2nd omelette was ham, mushroom and avocado and it was also light fluffy and delicious. Both were served with the skillet potatoes and a wedge of fresh bread. 
What made this a perfect review, is we ordered delivery and they forgot our lemon bread. The women answering the phones was sweet and accommodating. She delivered our bread at her cost and even offered us fresh coffees for our inconvenience. I love that kind of service. Our next trip here will be in person! Great food and amazing service. Check this place out and eat well, live well.

Great place for coffee and dessert.

;-)

Giving 3 stars because we enjoyed the deluxe beef pho, but the other two items we ordered were incredibly disappointing. The fried chicken wings tasted exactly like wing dings - not what we were hoping for. We also ordered the chicken pho, which had a terrible broth. It tasted like nothing but star anise and I usually drink all the broth from my pho, but this was so unpleasant that I completely avoided eating it and just went for the noodles. Those were a good texture at least. 

Hope this place can get better quality food and succeed, but at this point I don't think I'd come back just based on that chicken broth!

Best banh mi spot in philly. It has a gourmet and authentic taste. The bread is soft yet crispy, not too much inside dough either. I usually get the banh mi Ga(chicken) or Pate cha lua. You can also request for more butter on your banh mi . Give this place a try, you won't be disappointed!
Go here almost every morning. Solid breakfast sammies, wonderful ladies staffing the counter.

Walked here after dinner for a late night latte. mmmm pumpkin spice was delicious.  Yum!

They have a gluten free option in the case, sometimes its a muffin, I was told.  Tonight it was bread pudding.  I had that, but I was too full and I almost exploded.  That's definitely not Epic's fault.

Something is a bit off with the decor, even if they are shooting for hippy/artist space... but I can't place what.  I wasn't too bothered by it, and I enjoyed my time there.  As did the diverse crowd of people who took up every available seat :)

Hands down, my favorite cafe in Tucson. It's got a very relaxed vibe, a great variety of patrons, and I love that people of all stripes are welcome and treated the same. The local art on the walls is regularly changed and interesting, and the outlets are plentiful. It's an excellent place to hide from the world, people watch, and get work done.  

I love the coffee and tea, the snacks, and most of the food. My lactose-intolerant kid and my gluten-free friend are both happy that they have choices here for food, cookies and other baked goods. The *only* dish I have issue with is the grilled cheese.  I've had it twice, and both times the bread was barely toasted and the cheese barely melted. It's disappointing, because otherwise I'd happily give this place 5 stars.

2nd time around was ok. Everyone waits outside until they open the doors. People who walked up last minute were inside before some of us who had been outside waiting, so I do not recommend arriving before hand.

The price is $4 (cash only) for an hour and a half on the ice. There's nothing fancy about the place, but it gets the job done.

Very disappointing.  Impossible burger tasted terrible.  Ordered lettuce bun because I'm a vegan and I was charged 1.10 extra for iceberg lettuce.  And fries were cold.  I'll find something else at the airport.  Never again.

Beware of bone chips. Tried this place while on a layover. I search far and wide for the best burger and after googling I decided to give this a chance. I always go with the original so I can taste the meat and flavors. The burger was average in both bun and meat taste. For a place that says they choose the best tomatoes and lettuce, my tomato was razor thin and disintegrated before I reached the bone chip- yes bone chip in my burger. The burger was overly salty and a disappointment. The patty was somewhat juicy but had no texture. After getting to the bone chip, I decided to end my experience. Staff was friendly but my attendant was  new and had trouble figuring out the register.  I would have given this a 3, but bone chips in the meat are inexcusable.

As someone who rarely floats around near the city, I was craving some good bahn mi's so hit up another Elite(Hi Nick!) for recommendations. He told me about Cafe Cuong and told me to meet him in the city. For someone from the burbs, street parking gives me anxiety but after I found a spot, it was all good from that point forward. Walking in, it is a small family owned establishment that were extremely friendly. Beware this is a cash only establishment, so bring some green with you. We got one of each bahn mi, combination, pork and shredded chicken to share between 3 people. As we were trying to awkwardly maneuver for our yelp photos, the owner came over with gloves and helped us stage the food. I really enjoyed the pork and combination bahn mi. Chicken was a little dry and would probably skip next time. You can tell everything is made from scratch and with love. Easy to see why it is one of the top places for bahn mi.

Overall: B

Price: D
Flavor: B
Portion: C 

Clean, easy, good flavor and over priced even for the airport expectations. 

Payed 18.50
True Price 14.50
Annie is accomodating and so great. Decorations were beautiful and prices beyond reasonable. Awesome!

This restaurant seems like such a great concept with a really interesting menu. Unfortunately, the execution of the team behind the counter completely destroyed what should have been an excellent meal. Why bother to ask me how I'd like my burger cooked if when I tell you medium-rare you turn it into a super well done hockey puck? Why is it when I ask for my French fries well-done I get cold soggy and Limp fries? When i order a burger with no lettuce and no tomatoes,  and wait ten minutes to get it with... lettuce and tomatoes...  then send it back,  and you return with a burger with no bottom bun?

Execution Fail.

I've been on this banh mi kick lately, having tried 3 different kinds in the span of a few hours.

Their banh mi dac biet is decent. Decent meat, veggies, and pate. The pate did become overwheming after a few bites though. The bread was tasty and fresh.

Legit hole-in-the-wall, no frills, banh mi-only place. There are only 2 tables here, and it's cash only. They did have the football game on, though. No BBQ-anything banh mi for those that only eat that.

The burgers are very good here! I ordered the #11 which is the skinny burger which comes as a turkey patty between two pieces of iceberg lettuce with condiments and my fiancé ordered the #2 (bacon cheeseburger) and enjoyed it as well!

However, the frys are the saltiest things I have ever eaten. Save your money and just order the sandwich opposed to the meal.

I've seen Jessica Krakowski twice now and I love her! The work she does is tasteful and natural. During my first appointment she thoroughly explained the process and went over the different types of Botox they provide (who knew there were so many). I can't wait to explore the other beauty services they have to offer.

So we had a long layover and decided to eat here. It took 10 mins for the burgers and they were ok. This was around 530pm. At 711pm went back to get 2 milkshakes and only 2 people were ahead of me. I didn't get my milkshakes until 735!!! I was very upset, and had to remind them. The staff is overwhelmed and had no idea what was going on. 
The shakes were good but the wait was ridiculous. The manager did give me a refund after I reminded them about the order.
Good food, love the portions and the eggs are delicious! Wish they stayed open later.

My favorite place for Vietnamese hoagies! And the owners here are super nice.

There are a few different types of haogies you can get or you can get the spread and meat individually and make them yourself at home!

And if you buy 10 you get 1 free.

Oh, there is also a cat walking around some times.

Although the movie theater is dated it's clear time and money spent has kept it maintained and clean. There is ample seating for any type of movie or festival which one is usually  hosted by the Philadelphia Film Society in October. Often this is where you will find independent movies and other documentaries not otherwise seen on the big screen. I enjoy coming to Ritz East because it's so close to Penns Landing and a lot of restaurants. 

When you purchase a large drink or popcorn they offer free same day refills. The popcorn is fresh and tasty but don't look for popping kernels in a machine, it's not made in house. Almost every time I come to this theater I make a point to take in happy hour at a local pub or restaurant because the don't have 'food'. After the movie I may take a walk along Delaware Avenue to soak in the scenery.

We had the six-course tasting menu at Laurel on Saturday night.  Everything was perfectly executed and delicious, and the staff was kind and accommodating.  We even had the chance to meet Chef Nick Elmi, which was a unique privilege.  The only blemish in an otherwise perfect meal was the duck...while we loved the flavor, it was pretty tough to chew, despite being perfectly cooked.  Not sure what happened, but it won't keep us from visiting again in the near future.

The location is great, right near 2 of my favorite theatre groups. The vibe is casual and blues with interesting art. The coffee is quite decent and some of the sweets really make the grade. Definitely a feel easy place.
Little cafe with great cakes and tasty beverages. Friendly staff. Cozy and will-lit study or work spot. Had upbeat music. Try peanut butter anything here, you won't regret it!
Best banh mi in Philly! I've been coming here since I was little, almost 15 years. Chicken is my favorite but I also like the Bi and Thit Nguoi

Thank you Yelp for the Elite invite. The Ritz was such a cool movie theater. Parking was convenient. Local eateries within walking distance. We went to the Yelp Elite pre-screening of Knives Out. The movie was awesome and it was fun to be able to see a movie prior to its release date. The theater was old school and was tucked away. Location was great and atmosphere was fun!!!
Solid Vietnamese restaurant, and really affordable too. I was definitely surprised to find this place right by the hospital.

Yum yum!! Searching for something hearty and Yelp brought me here. The pho ga was everything I needed and more. So delicious and hot. The shrimp roll was nice and light. I loved the fact that when I was done eating I was full but not overly stuffed. Would've totally gotten some Thai iced tea if I had the space to gulp it down.

In the Southwest terminal at TIA with a very friendly staff.
I had the applewood smoked bacon, egg & cheese bowl. Very solid breakfast. 3.5 stars but yelp doesn't have that as an option.

Anything 3 or better is good in my ratings;)

I've had burgers and fries there as well several times in the past and always good, so if you're hanging out and want a bite to eat it's tasty.

This place reminds me of Portland. It's a cute lil coffee place that is quaint and quirky. It definitely is your "neighborhood coffee place" if that is such a thing. It's warm and comfortable inside. A little worn and weathered but they've got lots of goods there. I'd recommend it!

Excellent chicken shawarma, best i've had in Tampa!  Bread is on point! if hungry, get two :-). They use bread very similar to the best shawarma spots in the middle east that are famous for their chicken.  Highly recommend!

This is an old school movie theater and not in the iconic way.  
First, it's hard to find the entrance at night.  If you get off at the wrong street, you may not find the front door very easily. the theater itself is old and slightly dirty.  It was not stadium seating, and I was in the back and the sound was not great, in fact, I missed some part of the movie.  
This would not be my go to movie theater, or even my 2nd or 3rd.
Good lunch option close to Temple Hospital. Very friendly and quick service. Food is on par with the Vietnamese restaurants off Washington ave.  They have many vegan options as well.
The night pics up slow but after 1am there is a good crowd. I have a good time going to a judgement free club

I'm an angry mom! I went into epic the other day with my daughter. But we left immediately because my daughter was afraid of Alexis. S, I found out your employee Is harassing my daughter Via Facebook. That is pathetic. Why would you hire a person like that? To hell with that.
Patricia rocks! She was the only one at the front and she had a great system. She took orders, expedited, and delivered food in a very timely manner. It was impressive. Thanks for the great service!!

I went here with friends to check out this new spot. Despite it looks as same as other restaurants but I was surprised by the quality and service. I'm a coffee addition and I have to say their coffee is a must try. In addition, their smoothies are made from real fresh fruits which is a big plus compared to other artificial flavor coffee or boba tea shops in town. Definitely come back here.

My family and I love coming here for Vietnamese hoagies! 

It's a great shop around my area and they're always open early enough that I can grab a hoagie and make it to work on time. The employees and owners are really nice.

The hoagies are always great and filled with a lot of everything. They never disappoint and if you buy ten, then you get one free! Stock up ;) !

Sabrina's food is delicious, lots of options, great vegetarian options, they even have fake sausage which are great additions to your omelettes. This place gets crowded, service is quick but no frills.

I would definitely recommend this place for breakfast or lunch. I have never checked it out for dinner, but would be willing to go for a chill dinner there.

I really like this place to study or do some work. Inexpensive prices and they have food and pastries if you want a snack while working. They offer plenty of comfortable seating which I look for in a cafe! It's a nice chill vibe with some strange people coming in once in awhile but that's because of its location off of 4th ave. Overall I'd recommend this price for value and atmosphere !

This is a small local Vietnamese shop serving a few bahn mi options. I ordered the chicken bahn mi. I thought it was very good. The bread was crunchy on the outside and soft inside. The chicken was juicy and tender. And the condiments were well balanced with an intelligent amount of mayo to add savor without dominating the sandwich.

Banh Mi Dac Biet.

That's all you really need to know. 
Oh, and maybe Cafe Sua Da.

;) 

(Been coming to Cafe Cuong for years. Years as in since I was a wee little girl. Definitely one of the best banh mi's I've ever had.)

Glad I chose this place within the food court. I had the tutu burger which came on a lettuce wrap. I really liked it and also had the fries. They have so many sauces on the side- it was really fun and the lady who helped me at the counter was very kind.

We took our daughter for a late light lunch. The grilled cheese and tomato with a side of greens was prepared perfectly, and the coconut milk latte was deliciously creamy. 

Classic coffee shop atmosphere with couches, unique decor, and board games. Cozy booths with checkerboard table tops (my kid loved playing checkers while we waited for our food) and bright windows filled with plants. 

There appeared to be only one person working there at the random time that we went (around 2pm on a Monday) and she did a great job balancing out duties of managing the register as well as prepping the food and drinks. To top it off she did so with a smile and a kind disposition. 

Fast, friendly service, and yummy food! Perfect.

This indoor playground is amazing! So many things to do and so clean. Our 2 and 3 year olds had a blast and wanted to go back the next day again. The staff was constantly cleaning and disinfecting the surfaces and everyone is wearing a mask. We were just traveling thru Tucson and decided to try it instead of an outdoor activity since its very hot outside.

3.5.

Being the pig that I am, I originally had a craving for Vietnamese sandwiches and decided to go to Nhu Y since there were more reviews. While walking there, I saw Cafe Cuong and couldn't help myself but to grab one here also. I thought I might as well do a comparison since they are across the street from each other :) Again, this place disappointed me but not as much as Nhu Y. The bread was fresher though still not like home. The pickled daikon and carrots were much bigger, giving the sandwich more texture and crunch. However, it again wasn't pickled! I liked the pate and meat here better also since it wasn't as salty. The Thit Nguoi sandwich is $3.25, while you can get the Thit Nguoi Dac Biet (includes Cha Lua), for $3.75. So in comparison to Nhu Y, it is definitely pricier. Overall, I think I'd have to choose Cafe Cuong over Nhu Y. I will probably make my way a little further towards Washington Ave to get my Vietnamese Sandwich fix. Report back later!

Burger 21 is fire, always fire and will always be fire. I have loved this place since college and will continue to stop in when I can! 

I had their bacon burger sliders, it was on Hawaiian sweet rolls and freshly crisped bacon. As always they were magical and wonderful. Fries were crispy and fresh. 

Now the most important parts always stop by the sauce bar. I love their Cajun sauce and literally coat everything with it. I have tried almost all of their sauces and have yet to be disappointed. Check it out and you will overjoyed!
Nice small little shop.  I always come here for Vietnamese hoagies.  Best tasting.  Worth my 30 miles drive.

I first took my daughter here when she was just beginning to skate and did not expect much. I was pleasantly surprised !! It is very well maintained, rarely too crowded and the price can not be beat!! We now love this place for bi-weekly skating sessions. She gets to practice her figure skating lessons and I get excercise. Whoever is overseeing the rink management is doing a great job. Only wish the season was longer. We have to drive out to the burbs to find a year round rink boo ..

The sweet potato fries are thin and crispy and delicious, and definitely shareable! The Tex Mex and mushroom burgers were both tasty, although a little on the extra oily side. My go-to food place at the Tampa airport!

Ordered the Bagel and Lox here today. For 10 dollars a plate, I was expecting a nice freshly toasted bagel, a good amount of lox, and a nice assortment of onions, tomatoes, capers, etc. Instead what comes out is a cold, limp bagel with three tiny pieces of fish. No onions or veggies of any kind, absolutely NOT worth 10 bucks plus tax. They also didn't have the bagels we asked for in stock and came to our table after we ordered to tell us. No problem! However, when we ordered from the selection they did have in stock, they brought us the wrong ones. Additionally, their website advertises the bagel with cream cheese and Lox as being 5.75. What we got today was absolutely worth no more than 5.75 and yet we got charged 10.....this place has some work to do!
My favorite steakhouse in the city. The ambience is excellent and the food is delicious. Top 10 steakhouse that I have visited in the United States.

Went to Jackson's for the first time on Valentine's day and the place was great. The inside was packed since it was in the 50s, but there were a good amount of people sitting outside by the torches. People were dressed in a variety of ways; there were families dressed very causally, couples dressed business casual, and colleagues dressed as if they came straight from work. 

We were served by Nick U, who was fantastic. He gave us a few recommendations on what to order, was consistently around and made sure we were well taken care of throughout the night. We got our dinner rolls within 5 minutes of ordering dinner and received our dinner within 15 minutes as well. I can't remember the last time the food came out so fast from any restaurant. 

Before the meal, we were served with 3 dinner roles that were nicely covered with olive oil and parsley. They tasted and looked great. 

My date had the Crab ravioli, which she really enjoyed. I ordered the the Chef's Valentine's day special Blackened Swordfish and it was incredible. It came with tomatoes and green beans, and the dish had a nice butter-garlic sauce to it. My date and I both thought the swordfish was cooked perfect and all the tastes complemented each other.  I highly recommend the swordfish if it's available. We were also very happy with our tirimasu, which we took to go. They also have a gelato bar for anyone interested. 

I highly recommend this place and will definitely go back.

Me and my fiancée hired Annie and Only You Wedding after seeing nothing but good reviews on their Yelp.  Turns out Yelp hid the bad reviews and seems like Annie and others at Only You wrote there own reviews. 

WORST MISTAKE WE EVER MADE!  We hired the team to host our wedding and ordered flowers as well.  THEY DIDNT EVEN SHOW UP ON THE WEDDING DAY!!  The venue had to play an iPod for us.  Annie is by far the most unprofessional person I have ever worked with.  Do not make the same mistake we did.  Go to the wedding stores in NYC!!

Things that are awesome about Ritz:

1. Student discount! 6.75 for an evening movie? So baller.
2. Really great concessions: SnoCaps! Pretzel M&Ms! Caramel Popcorn! 
3. Movies you can't find almost anywhere else in the city. 

Parking can be difficult but there's always the huge garage, and there are a lot of pre- or post-movie restaurant and bar options nearby. This Ritz in particular usually only shows one or two movies at a time, but the screens are more the size you've come to be accustomed to. If you don't want to drag your ass out to AMC or pay a premium for the Bridge ("Rave") or get shot at Riverview, this is the place to be.

Not very friendly staff at Tampa airport. Had to ask for pepper 4 times. Since she only would give 2 packets per request and each  it has 3 granules in each one. She was wearing a black shirt. Different from everyone else appearing like the manager.  Holding onto them Like they were gold. In every interaction they seemed put off and bothered. 

Food was good. Service Makes me not want to deal with them.

Great coffee and food, but sometimes limited space. I always stop by here whenever possible and get a large coffee to go along with a nice rugelah (think it comes out to around $3.50). Definitely my favorite coffee in town, but there are some others that come close.

Tons of vegan options, and an impeccable staff. The art on the walls changes frequently and will always give you something to look at. Watch out for wifi campers and people who take up more room than they should. The outside seating along with lots of bike parking is a big plus.

Had the best birthday experience there today! Lauren was on top of everything she greeted us before we came in. Took all the gifts so we weren't standing there holding them in line. She was so communicative and seemed like she was running the whole place but still helped us out with whatever we needed. We felt like she was our personal employee! She will go far. Cherish a employee like this for as long as you have them because she will be running some company some day.

$5 for a fantastic banh mi is such a steal. I just came to this place for the first time last weekend and will for sure be returning. Usually I exclusively go to QT in Chinatown for banh mi but this place is officially in my rotation. 

I believe the sandwiches here top out at $6. I got the banh mi thit nguoi ($5): the bread here is perfectly crusty and the patê smear is sooo good. I bought one and took it with me to lunch on Monday and forgot to take a picture so you'll have to take my word for it. Next time I plan on getting the dac biet because I believe it comes with pork and more meat in general. The family that runs this place is super friendly and can answer any questions you have about the menu. Be sure to stop by if you're in the mood for a great viet sandwich!

They are putting out some great food, burgers  and fowl, veggies available, but the food is scrumptious, and Joella is one of the most pleasant and personable counter people I have met!!!  I went to the  Cigar place next door to drink.

Straightforward ethical clinic.  I appreciate they ask for your level of financial commitment and level of medical/scientific knowledge you wish to have on the new patient information sheet.   My dogs have received thorough compassionate care consistently over the past 4 years I have been using this clinic.   They are committed to providing the best care within your comfort zone and financial commitment.    Great intuitive healers with obvious experience treating a variety of common and rare conditions.

What a great  experience! I needed breakfast for a  work event STAT and I called Epic Cafe for a Hail Mary. The manager graciously gave me a platter and a coffee carafe to borrow for my event and stocked me up with all the  goods I needed to go with it. The bagels and coffee  were great and I had a  great cappuccino. 
I'm excited to go back and see what else they have to offer.

If I could give this place zero starts I would. I walked into this establishment and the first thing I see are newspapers over the table with bones of chicken, soup puddles and bowls everywhere. Flies were all over the place. Behind the counter there was the "chef" standing there. He was staring at me. I asked if they were open and he said yes. I asked for 2 Bahn mi sandwiches. After he rubbed his watery nose he dug his hands into a pile of cooked chicken. Dumbfounded I just stared at him.
He then grabbed 2 rolls of bread and (bare hands) put it in the oven. He rubbed his nose again. After a few minutes he took the bread out the oven and rubbed his nose again and began stuffing with vegetables.
I walked out. Will never order from there. I'm glad I walked in and saw this rather than order delivery.
Tasty food, service is fast and friendly. restaurant is clean. Definitely a go to for Vietnamese food.

The place is quaint, but over priced for what you get. An espresso and a sandwich which didn't have a lot to it ran about $15. The pies looked amazing and I hope that does well for them. It's a counter service restaurant and I needed to remind the server about my drink. My sandwich had very little bacon, small slices of brie, and less than a teaspoon of caramelized onions.

I haven't been to this theater since ET was shown there in the 80's! I remember because my friends and I got lost trying to figure out how to get to it because this was back in the days when Chestnut Street was lined with movie theaters. The Ritz was then and still is off the beaten path but has endured through times when all those old school movie houses fell out of fashion. 

I scored some free tickets by way of Elites Go Free to an advanced screening of Knives Out. I knew this Agatha Christie inspired flick was going to be popular so my date and I arrived extra early. By 7:15 the place was pretty full. The theater is well maintained but definitely still old school. No stretching out on recliners here. We sat shoulder to shoulder but seats do have cup holders and no bad veiws. I also loved the bags the popcorn came in. Very sturdy. No butter stains on my pants. And the movie was a riot!!!!
epic cafe is such a good place for when you need to get work done! it has a quiet environment and not to mention they play good music:) and from what i've tried they also have very good food!
It was delicious! They were very accommodating. Very clean and tasted fresh. Enjoyed the  toasted marshmallow and sweet potato fries and their seasonal bayou burger with the turkey patty instead.

Epic is...well average...not really all that Epic.  The atmosphere, for some, is what they like. A mish mash of differet types of seeing, a huge old deli case full of food and an inside bathroom that requires a key. The bathroom has stuff customers have written on teh wall. The furniture is kinda torn up.  They are also open later than all of the other coffee shops on 4th which changes the atmosphere depending on the time of day and whatnot. 

The pros of this place are as follows:
-Their sugary sweet coffee drinks are really good. So is their whipped cream. So for shakes and blended coffee drinks, they are pretty good.
-They have gluten free and vegan options which for some folks is important. I'm gluten intollerant and some of what they have is pretty tasty. 
-They also have some really tasty cakes.
-Ample seating and wifi that never seems to go out. Big windows and plenty of space to advertise.

The cons of this place are:
-The coffee is really just so-so and their teas are just meh...I'd hit passe before I would hit epic during the day. The quality just can't compete.
-The food is REALLY OVERPRICED FOR THE QUANTITY. I mean seriously. The sandwitches here are filled with less than the ones you get at starbucks (which also make me very grumpy) and often at a higher price. Their salads are a little bit better but not by much. Delectables, passe, hell even magpies would get you a better bang for your buck. You could go down speedway and hit bentleys too and get much better food. 
-Their savory foods like lasgne and quiche are alright but often seem like they have been sitting there for too long. Their cakes are usually fresh but their cookies are often stale. Same comment as the above point. There are way better places to go to eat. 

Overall I think this place could use a trip from chef ramsay to kick their butts into improving the place and turning it into a rockstar. It has potential but needs a serious overhaul. I will step foot in Epic again because it's open later than the rest and is a place to hang out on 4th ave. Since I work off 4th ave that is convienent. IF I have another choice, Epic will not be it.

Cafe Cuong has the best Vietnamese hoagies in Philly! I personally love the chicken banh mi here. The marinated, shredded chicken goes so well with the Vietnamese mayo, toasted baguette and pickled veggies. I've also had their regular and deluxe hoagies and both are great as well. I try to avoid buying Vietnamese hoagies anywhere else because whenever I go somewhere else it just does not compare to this place!

I arrived to an ice attendant posting a sign on the outside of the entrance doors. 

"Public Skate Cancelled...". 

What a bummer. She informed me of some complication to their ice. She continued with they may reopen for their later session at 5:30pm but chances are they will not. They post updates to their Facebook Page, so check there for the most recent news regarding the rink. Funny thing is, on the walk back to my car, and later on that evening, I checked for updates to said page. For one the page exists. Secondly, there hasn't been an update since Feb. 14, 2017. Boy was I heated. Then I head to their website to see if there was any news on the reopening of the ice and nada. 

She seemed empathetic to my sad demeanor considering I was truly looking forward to skating but the entire operation is ass backwards. Considering how many mediums their are for informing people these days, the business could at least manage to use one of them.
The best Bahn Mi! The bread is crusty, ingredients pop with flavor and the price is great. I absolutely recommend the deluxe hoagie!
Banh mi here is very traditional and tastes great.  The place itself can feel weird because you think you're barging into someone's house.

The food here is always excellent and fresh. The cafe sua da is rich, sweet, strong and perks me right up from that midday crash. The Rice and Grilled Pork Chop is delicious and Pho is hot, aromatic, rich and gingery(personally I like this). I always enjoy my meals here. The service is quick and friendly.

Update 7/26/19

Ownership has changed, and they've quietly been updating the cafe, the menu, and prices. I liked the old setup, but I never realized how cluttered it was (or how loud the music was) until they cleared it out. It's now more spacious, calm, and welcoming. It's a hidey hole from the world. There are more booths, but they've been spaced so that people of all sizes fit in them. The new owners are polite, personable, and remembered me from my last visit.

Yes, some prices have gone up...just like almost every other restaurant/coffee shop in town. In this "inbetween" time when the Epic is updating, there are orange signs hanging at the bottom of each menu board, stating that changes are afoot and prices may differ.  But, as I know from grocery shopping, the price of food and other ingredients has increased, so I certainly don't begrudge the Epic for doing what they need to in order to keep things afloat. And let's not forget that they're on Fourth Avenue, where it's well known that rents have increased do to gentrification.  I'm not sure why another reviewer was so surprised and disgruntled--there are clear alerts about price changes, and it seems entitled for him to expect the old price just because he didn't like the new one.  (If only the world worked that way.)

As for me, I wholeheartedly support the changes, and will continue to visit.

OK, first of all, I ordered on GrubHub, and exactly 21 minutes later, the delivery man was calling to tell me he was outside.

Second, I babysit in the Kensington/N.Libs area every Thursday, Friday and Saturday, and order from Sahara at least one of these days, sometimes more.

Third, this is by and far the best Chicken Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan I have ever, ever, ever had. I crave it constantly, try it everywhere I go, and even try to emulate it at home, but nothing even comes close.

My tongue is raw from burning it on the hot sauce, but I can't stop eating it.

Great airport location serving very good, fresh burgers and sandwiches 

We had a buffalo chicken sandwich. The chicken was fresh and piping hot with very good flavor. Lettuce was fresh and crispy, and the flavors were good. Total price for sandwich only $8.35 and was worth it for an airport. 

Service: Not friendly but not unfriendly- basically neutral counter staff. It's a self-service place. 

Seating: common area seating

We used to stop in Epic Café about a year ago and decided to stop in yesterday for an ice cream with some friends. Bad decision. 

Even though Borden's ice cream was advertised, also I guess they serve Thrifty (one of the cheapest brands of ice cream). We asked for strawberry and we should have left when they didn't have strawberry, but accepted what was supposed to be vanilla, which did not taste like vanilla at all. 

As a matter of fact, I felt queasy after eating it. And without a doubt, I'm sure we got the Thrifty. 

The ice cream server was a mean-spirited Afro-American woman, which didn't add to the experience. She needs fired. 

So obviously the quality of the Epic ice cream for sure has gone downhill.

Since Chic-Fil-A is closed on Sunday had to find an alternative for a quick breakfast bite. My husband had the breakfast wrap - minuscule w a sprinkling of egg, bacon and 'tater tots' - $6.89 - I had the breakfast bowl - again 'greasy tater tots' with a sprinkling of egg and bacon - $7.39 - no beverage, and maybe 1 egg and maybe 1 slice of bacon between 2 people - someone is making $$$ off of airport customers, who have limited options -

There aren't too many movie theaters in the Center City area, which is something I'll never understand but the Ritz East is one of the few and mighty. They only show two movies at a time and the selections seem to be films that cater to the indie crowd. More mainstream films (your average summer blockbuster) probably won't be shown here but that quirky Wes Anderson film probably will be!

It's small inside, but the concessions stand is well stocked with the basics, the amenities are clean, and the screen quality is clear. The audience was also the most courteous group of people I have ever had the pleasure of watching a movie with - everyone just seems to be there to enjoy the movie.

Awesome adventures for kids and adults to play, climb, swing, jump and exhaust some energy indoors when it's too hot outside. Also super grateful for their lax rules about wearing a mask! It's not safe for anyone to wear a mask while exercising and I'll definitely be coming back here all summer to enjoy this place!

Got free tickets to the advance screening of Knives Out last night through Elites Go Free. Thanks Yelp! This was a murder mystery movie, but was funny and had a stellar cast. My husband and I really enjoyed it, and definitely recommend it. As for reviewing the theater, this was our first time at Ritz East, and we had a hard time finding the entrance. The signs around weren't very helpful but with the help of some other people who have been there before, we finally arrived. This theater is small, the seats aren't very comfortable (I found myself wiggling a lot trying to get comfortable) and the movie screen isn't very large either. If you're looking for an IMAX or 3D experience, this is probably not the place to come to. I gotta to say though, location wise, this place is very convenient. There is a parking garage right above the theater, or street parking within walking distance. Wouldn't mind just coming here once in a while to catch a movie.

I have seen two films here. One Oscar contender and the second a limited release film. Theater had a good crowd, with perfect theater etiquette for a Friday night film. 

Great location in Old City. Has an old fashioned vibe and after can take a stroll through history. 

Movie theater is dated compared to other theaters in the area, but they keep everything clean.

Dr. Callahan and staff are the most knowledgeable, caring pros I've ever encountered in 35 years of pet care (mostly cats). After a thorough, careful evaluation, they give you the facts and choices to make decisions about care. They respect your financial considerations as well as the level of care you decide to pursue. Besides that, they make you feel like a welcome friend regardless of how busy they are.
This food city is kinda dirty and an eyesore in the neighborhood. They do however have the cheapest quality produce in town! everything else is more expensive than other stores.

I assume there is hardly any rotation of ingredients due to the current pandemic. However, I was unable to eat any noodle soups I ordered. The soups had very distinct odor and the meat was very dry to the point where I thought I was chewing a rubber. Hopefully it's better next time.

I like it a good value and the staff is not all Jaded and sad. I would definitely like a membership option here. But I am willing to pay so maybe they shouldn't do it. It is clean kept clean well-maintained and fun.

I've had some of their banh mi sandwiches a few times now, and I think this is now my go to spot for Banh Mi sandwiches. I normally get Banh Mi Dac Biet (Specialty), but they happened to have the last BBQ Pork this time around so I had to try it. I was impressed with the BBQ Pork. The baguette for the sandwich is amazing with a nice crunch texture. The meat they use is very juicy but not fattening. I also got their Ca Fe Sua Da (Vietnamese Iced Coffee with Milk), and it was smooth yet strong. This is probably the best place yet so far in Philly for their Vietnamese iced coffee that I have tried. 

If you guys want to try this place, definitely call in ahead first and make sure they still have baguette because there has been times where I came later in the afternoon, and they were all sold out (which only shows how great their baguette and sandwiches are!)

10/10 for their Impossible Burger that they have. I even forgot to order cheese. I almost was beginning to think that i wasn't going to be able to have anything to eat while i had a layover at the Tampa airport because the other restaurants they had seemed different than what i was used to  but this was so good. The fries were good as well and it was something that was worth it for the price(as airport food is a little pricey). If i return to Tampa airport i hope that this is still there!

Fantastic Indian food and I am so fortunate that it's right around the corner from where I live. Take out or delivery, the food arrives steaming hot and fresh. They spice it to the level you ask. The Tandoori Paneer is incredible along with any of the naans I've ever tried. Samosa Chat and regular samosas are brilliant. Very reasonable on their prices too. I don't even think to go to Tiffin anymore when I get the craving for curry!
Went to play with kids last Friday, awesome & clean place, nice service. Kids love it. Will come back to play here again soon for sure.

Okay I'm coming here more often. 
I came in around 8:30. There were already people there sipping their coffees. The owners were already busy roasting bread and making their bahn mis. 

I got an iced coffee with milk and a chicken bahn mi. Wow. What a breakfast of champions. The coffee is smooth with a spoonful of the condensed milk at the bottom giving it an overall caramel taste. The chicken bahn mi has tasty chicken that's not dry at all and filled to the brim with the regular veggies. 

Definitely a go to place that I'm going to go to more often.

This is the perfect place in Tucson to take the kiddos during hot days. Plenty of play equipment to enjoy, and even older kids can have fun on the rock wall. Sanitizing basically every hour, which is awesome. Very friendly staff. Highly recommend if you're looking to hang out while the kids run their energy out.

In Tampa airport needing a meal.  The ladies were polite at the counter.  Ordered the buffalo chicken burger and requested it to be cut in half.  No problem.  The chicken burger was served on a brioche bun.  The bun was perfectly soft.  The chicken patty was piping hot and the combination of hot sauce with the blue cheese made an interesting combination and plain delicious.  Fast service was well.  A pleasant surprise at the airport.

I couldn't wait to try this place after all the positive reviews on Yelp. Unfortunately, I was disappointed. I ordered on GrubHub and waited over an hour and 20 minutes for my food to arrive. When it finally came, the driver called up to me to say he was outside. I asked him to bring the food up and he said, "There's no parking, m'am." I go downstairs and the 30 minute parking spot in front of my building is open...RIGHT IN FRONT OF MY BUILDING. He wasn't even in front of my building...I had to call him and he pulled around and gave me my food. The food itself was OK...the chana masala had very little flavor. We got an eggplant dish that I really liked, and my boyfriend enjoyed the chicken tikka. But the service was so terrible that I was already pissed off before I took my first bite. And to think I pre-paid a $5 tip. UGH!

This store got fixed up a few years ago and has a really good vibe to it now. The staff is friendlier and helpful and it's one of the best places to get some of the difficult cuts of meat. I recommend it to anyone looking for fresh low cost veggies and fruits. I've never changed a review from 2 stars to 5 before but I really feel like this Food City is trying hard to be a great business that serves the local community.
Such a fun place for my kid to run around :) he absolutely loves it there and it gives mama a break!

I was debating between PDQ and Burger 21, I went with Burger 21, it looked more modern and more food choices, so I decided to give it a shot, the lady at the cash register was friendly she took my order and gave me my drink, my order was burger sliders and fries combo, after I placed my order I went to the little side bar they had with all kinds of sauces which was really cool, I grabbed sauces and was just waiting, my ticket number was 19 and they were at ticket 14 so I didn't think it would take long... yeah... after 25 mins of waiting, they kept telling me they were waiting on fries, which made no sense because at one point they skipped ticket 19,20,and 21, went to 22 and was all the way up to 25 when I finally had to say something, again they said that they were getting our stuff fresh at that point I requested to get a redound, they were not happy about it but my ticket was about 15 dollars I don't think I deserved that kind of service for "fast and expensive food", after receiving my refund, I went to PDQ next door ordered there got my food super fast, came back around and those people behind me were still waiting.. terrible service, if you're in a hurry do not recommend this place, I wish I would of gotten to taste the food so I could leave a better review but meh I'll be ok.
Really nice theater with large viewing rooms. Popcorn is tasty and fresh. They mostly have independent and foreign films.

You may think this is a quick option. Currently, it is not. The employees are hustling but it appears there aren't enough early evening during snowbird and tourist season. 

I didn't think 40 minutes was enough time to get a drink and salmon at Rumfish so figured I'd try one of the fast(er) options. 

I waited 13 minutes for my order to be called. It was right. It was hot. And it was better than I had expected. I'd try it again, but I'd make sure I had enough time. 

There were a lot of people.  When I ordered they were just called about ten numbers behind me. So as I said the employees are hustling, but just not enough people 

Also, the soda was FLAT.  Serves me right for falling off the wagon, back to that devil Coca-Cola.

I purchased a watch from this store about a year ago.  The band broke and the watch sat on my dresser for a couple weeks.  I missed wearing it so I drove across town and swung by the store to either have them fix it or purchase a new one.  When I asked for their help they asked me if I fell or something ripped the watch off me and I told them the truth, no.  They proceeded to tell me there was no way I didn't fall on it or have it ripped off which was really uncomfortable because I'm not a fan of being accused of lying.  They tried to send me to a different company to get it fixed and when I asked if they could fix it or help find me a good deal on a new watch they said no and no lol.  They let me turn around and walk out of the store with my broken watch and a pocket full of money. Your watches don't last, your customer service is poor, and your reps don't know how to sell.  There are too many other options nearby, don't waste your time and money here!

One of most caring veterinarion ive ever met!! She not only cares about your animal but the owner aswell. She helped our family take care of what needed to be done for my aunts cat, of 16 yrs, while she was in ICU for over month. Again, Dr Callahan is such loving and caring Dr that id never take my animal anywhere else. Id recommend her to anyone who has a furr baby that they love with all their heart, Dr Callahan is one for your animal

Small family owned cafe. Traditional and delicious banh mi. The pate on the banh mi is delicious. The bread is fresh and crispy.

Don't be alarmed if you see a cat walking around inside the store.

Great place for all ages. Had a blast with my 5 year old son. This place has tons of activities for kids to do and is all new. There is a small snack bar but no real food just yet. Can't wait to take the little one back for some fun. Great way to get the kids off their butts and running around.

I'm visiting family near by and This place was a fun experience for me and my two toddlers. Had a great time and the price is so low it's almost free! Well worth it if you have your hands full with children.

My son loves this place! Reminds me of Discovery Zone when I was a kid- I've been trying to find something like this for him but have had no luck until I found Wild Katz! They have many different playgrounds to keep the kids busy as well as climbing and dodgeball. I was also happy that the tickets and food were affordable- much more than similar indoor playgrounds. We are big fans!
This is a wonderful pet clinic, administered by dedicated individuals. I wish that I still lived in the area. When I did, this was where I took my cat, and I trusted the individuals who work there.

Jerk chicken wings were delicious. Got it with peach BBQ sauce on the side and it really paired well together. Very welcoming feel with the smoker right out front of the restaurant. Will definitely give it another go when I'm back in the area!

What a great place and staff, so professional, such reasonable pricing for so much fun. Sara at the check in is particularly great, as I spoke to her on the phone prior to coming in and she remembered, but everyone we encountered was amazing and the iced coffee, fantastic. Thanks, my Granddaughter had a great time, and so did I!

The chicken banh mi is great. The price is cheap too. If you wanna try vietnamese authentic banh mi, this place is a must try. It's hard to find a parking and it's a take out restaurant. They also have Vietnamese coffee. Which is great.

This is by far the best banh mi I've had in Philly. I always get the deluxe cold cut & my partner gets the bbq pork. All of the ingredients are super fresh, and you can also purchase the ingredients if you want!

The Vietnamese iced coffee is also top notch. I've went to a lot of Vietnamese cafes, and this place does it best. Not too sweet, not too bitter. 

Make sure to have cash on hand!
Epic Cafe is reopened! Under new ownership, Geroge has taken this place to a new level. We had The Hoagie sandwich, prickly pear tea and a dirty Horchata all absolutely amazing.

I've been taking my children to Wild Katz ever since it opened in 2020 and have supported this business also by having my children's birthday parties there in 2021.  I took my children to play on New Years Eve 2021 and not even thinking to check to see if the hours were different (NYE is not a holiday) and when we arrived at 3:15pm, the "Manager" informed me that they closed at 4:00pm and they do not pro-rate playtime and we would have to pay for a full hour, even though my children couldn't play for only 45-minutes. Now, I understand that this is their policy to not pro-rate anything under an hour, but this was not a "normal business" day and there was no way I could have known that they change their hours at random. It costs $12 per person to play, then times that by 4, and it would have cost $48 for only 45-minutes. I feel inclined to write this review because, as a business owner myself of a successful private music studio, I couldn't sleep well at night knowing that I gave a 45 minute lesson to someone who paid for 1 hour. It's just poor business practice. I know the pro-rated amount would have saved me about $12, which is such a small amount in the grand scheme of things, but it was the principal of the matter, considering we've supported this business so much.
My absolute favorite banh mi. The bread is on another level, and everything else is made with such attention and care. Don't let the exterior fool you.

I love this place. I have no problem with the staff and find them very accomodating. I bought my granddaughter a pair of the Wild Katz sox and we just wash them and take them back to use again. My very energetic granddaughter usually spends about 2 hours in play (so many choices) and then we have about a 1/2 hour cool down with a snack and a drink from their fountain. 
I really works to mellow her out for quieter activities later.
I tell everyone how wonderful this place is...

My husband and I did a pre-wedding photoshoot outdoors with them and the entire package was a good price that covers the gown, tux, make-up, and hair. They have many style and option of dresses for you to choose and I must say that my wedding dress is absolutely stunning. Got a lot of compliments from strangers, family, and friends. The photographer Johnny and his assistant Ming is very funny and professional. They know how to break the ice and make us comfortable and relax. Well, I wasn't relax because too many people were watching lol. Johnny, ming and annie are a good team to work with. They know the best angle to get the shot and they help you with posing, where to look, and fixing my hair and dress in a way to make me look stunning! 

After I receive my photos, they were beautiful! I honestly thought that I would look so awkward in them but It didn't. Will definitely recommend to my family and friends.

Pork Vermicelli with egg roll was the best thing I've eaten in a very long time! It was a huge portion that I had to force myself to stop eating because it was so good! I had their Deluxe Beef Pho a few times before and it was delicious as well. Never disappointed here!
I called them to asked some questions but they didn't answer and hung up on me. Unprofessional. Never come back here.

It doesn't get better than the Ritz for great films! Independent films in good theaters and even an affordable, good snack bar! From fresh popcorn to coffee and teas to organic chocolates and snacks, it's priced way more affordably than your average multi-plex.

A don't miss tip: discount night on Wednesdays!

If you park in the Ritz East garage on 2nd Street, you can get discounted parking from the theater. Just show your parking card to the folks at the box office.

This place is insane the flavors of vietnam intermingle
With delight here as you savor the sweet beer pho and the soft piano play in the background! The a ala carte Menu offers any coMbination you can think of ! Do you aren't limited to just the broken rIce platters or the soup I like that a lot ! The staff are pleasant and very attentive to anyone who comes in. They fed a homeless man first time I was here I thought that was a rare qualtity  to see nOw a days but great to see in an establishment so close to home! I give them 5 stars if you are shopping in Germantown stop by this place ! It won't disappoint
Love this place, great atmosphere with great food. Everything you want in a Vietnamese restaurant. Definitely a must try for those who haven't.

Paul was super responsive and came out same day.  His trip charge was more than reasonable and fixed my plumbing issue.  I had a problem with my water softener and he resolved in a matter of minutes.  Highly recommend Rahn Plumbing.  I live in Lutz so if you are looking for a plumber near lutz, he's your guy.  I also got an estimate for new water heater , he gave me a fair quote and was due per knowledgeable about what I needed.

I stopped in here yesterday to do some work, and I haven't been in for several years. The furniture and atmosphere could use some updating, but it was a great place for me to sit and have a cup of hot tea and a good croissant breakfast sandwich. The desserts they had in the case looked SUPER delish, so I'll have to go back and try something. I know they have a back patio, but it was too cold to check it out. Overall, I would stop back in if I was down on this end of 4th again and try their coffee!

The fried chicken sandwich is ground chicken and not the most tasty.  It's essentially a huge chicken nugget dipped in hot sauce for the buffalo sandwich. The fries and sauce selection were the only two positives about this place, based on the meal I had.

I'm the airport there are better sandwiches at the same price. I would go elsewhere.

This kosher butcher has a ton of variety. All kinds of meat, chicken and a bunch of different Israeli products. The woman who is always there is very helpful if you need help choosing the right meat for your meal or figuring out the best way to cook the meat you are picking up. If you're looking or kosher meat, you'll find anything you want here.
I've had Vietnamese in every major city in America. This is in the top 3. They're als affordable and so nice!
Great place!  Very affordable for what they offer.  I look forward to be able to bring the granddaughter to the toddler time in the am .

I was in the mood for a Banh Mi and since this was closer to where I was than QT's, I decided to give this place a try. I am glad I did because they make a GOOD banh mi!! It is cheaper than QT's and easier to find parking in this area. Unfortunately it isn't centrally located in Chinatown, but it was well worth the trip! It also tasted great even later for leftovers! The man who helped me was also super nice! They have a few tables to sit and eat, and it's not fancy, but you can sit there and enjoy your sandwich if you like.

Authentic Vietnamese foods with friendly service. I came here with a friend to check out this newly open restaurant since it's the only place to sit down in the area. The foods remind me of home and each portion is big enough to serve 2 people. We got pork chop on rice and beef pho for main courses and flan for dessert. Needless to say, we left the restaurant with a full and satisfied stomach. Saw chicken wings and shrimp on rice on the menu too so I'll make sure to come back and try those.

I thought it would be good, but my expectations were well exceeded. I had an excellent fish and shrimp dish that was perfectly seasoned in a spicy red sauce. The garlic naan was really good, the ideal companion to the fish and shrimp dish. 

Service was quick and beyond accommodating. I recently learned that there was a change in management, which has probably resolved most of the issues expressed in earlier reviews. My sense is that the new management is committed to providing excellent food and good service.  They certainly succeeded with my order tonight, and I will definitely become a regular.

Very cool place with very poor customer service. My friend and I were both overcharged and not given a receipt. When we asked the manager on duty she got defensive and claimed that the huge mistake was tax which it was not. She finally agreed to give a refund after making a big scene. Pretty sure something shady is going on so make sure you get a receipt.

This is my favorite theater in Philly. Upon walking through the doors yesterday afternoon, the ticketing agent welcomed my boyfriend and me with a giant hello. I almost turned around, thinking she was talking to someone she knew. Nope, she was talking to us! Nice.

We grabbed our medium popcorn, small soda and medium soda (totaling twelve hard-earned dollars), and walked into the theater a solid fifteen minutes early, claiming two primo-positioned seats. The popcorn was fresh and buttery, the seats were comfy and the other patrons were respectful: not a single cell phone rang during the movie. Even the bathroom was spotless. What a great place to escape the craziness of the city for a couple hours!

Mr. Dave H. Gave me a mini trip to Philly before I went to work.

Little tiny cafe place with an old couple cutting veggies attended us.
We ordered 2 Regular Vietnamese sandwich (EXPECT ABOUT 10 MINUTES TO GET READY).

I watched the entire process of how they do it:

1) Warm up the Baguette
2) Spread their special Cream inside the Baguette
3) Puts layers and LAYERS of Meat in it (Not just one or two layers, MANY LAYERS!)
4) Puts Jalapenos, Cucumbers and Cilantro at the end.

Wraps around with a layer of Paper and hands in to us.

For $ 3.25 you can get a pretty filling sandwich!.

Flew out of Tampa over the weekend and was pleasantly surprised by the delicious impossible burger I had at Burger 21. I've heard and read so many positive reviews about the impossible burger, so it was great to finally come across one -- at the airport no less! The fries were spot on as well. 

Overall, the service and experience was positive. Staff was friendly and worked quickly.

Great indoor space for kids to run and play to make quick friends and have a blast while doing it. They have 5 separate areas for activities so as not to get bored. The price is good, socks are sold separately. As a special needs parent I was allowed a parent assistant wrist band so that I could follow my son anywhere in case he needed help but had to pay for my own socks separately. The food court area is a hit with parents. Also they have a lot of seating options which was wonderful! All around we had a great experience!

If you're in Terminal C at the Tampa airport and aren't in a hurry, well, Burger 21 is certainly a place you can spend some money. It's not a *good* place to spend money, or to eat, or even to visit and wait, but heck, they sure do *exist* there pretty hard. To make a long story short, the staff is slow, unprofessional, uncoordinated and disorganized, and the food is overpriced and unremarkable. Check out Cigar City Brewing next door, you can thank me later.
To make a long story slightly less long than eating here would take, we had the dreadful misfortune of feeling peckish while waiting for an outgoing flight and deciding to try out one of the two fast-food-looking burger joints in the terminal (the other one is on the far side behind a bar). "Burger 21" seemed like a cool place to grab a bite, and they had several more gourmet-sounding options like a black and bleu burger or sweet potato fries, but what we failed to realize is the "21" in the name is apparently the estimated minimum wait time. For a fast-food burger and fries. Not a great optic.
First, I ordered off their menu; the menu options started at 2 for the "Cheesy," had the "Bacon Cheesy" immediately afterward at number 3, and the Black and Bleu was number 7 although it was third on the menu. This might seem confusing for a reader, and it certainly confused the young lady behind the counter when I asked for a "number two Cheesy" which is even how the name is presented BY A PROMOTIONAL PICTURE elsewhere on the menu board. She rang in two meals. I'm glad I caught that or I'd probably still be there waiting. It also wasn't until after I ordered that I was told they could not accept cash "at this time." No signs, no warning, no reason provided. No cash, no care for customers to forewarn them.
My brother, who was in line behind me, ordered the Bacon Cheesy (sans the digit from the front) and we got in line to wait for our food to come out. Maybe a bit over five minutes later, our burgers appeared in the hot window beneath the watchful eye of the heat lamp. I figured we'd have time to sit down, try the food (the Cheesy boasted their signature "21 Sauce") and see what we thought. They were obviously cooking them up fresh. That's a good thing. What followed, however, was a travesty against every single definition of the words "fast food" you could probably come up with.
One order went out ahead of ours when their fries finally came up. Mind you, the sandwich came up at the same time ours did, one cup of fries went up on the fries side of the hot window, it all got sloppily dropped into a paper bag and handed out to the person who bought it. Then we waited, and we waited, and we waited. We waited while one employee who couldn't be bothered to hitch her mask up over her lower lip walked out from the kitchen and past their access door. We waited while another customer came up, ordered a salad and some sweet potato fries, and got her food despite the fact all we were waiting on were fries anyway (that's what the another clerk who couldn't wear her mask right said - see picture) and her sweet potato fries were cooked, finished, and out the window before ours had apparently been started.
I finally got my fries sloppily dropped on top of the styrofoam burger container in my bag, exactly 21 minutes after the receipt said my order had been rung in. Then we waited some more. One woman who looked like a manager walked back and forth from the kitchen to the counter taking orders and telling them to cook fries. The clerk who still hadn't put her mask on right was now helping the first one who wasn't wearing her mask right to restock the grab-and-go cooler where customers could grab drinks if they didn't want something off the fountain. Neither seemed in any hurry and despite the fact the manager was calling for fries to be cooked, none were appearing in the window, and the clerk wasn't concerned at all for the sandwiches baking in the heat of the lamps in full view of everyone there. Finally another customer (who turned out to be on the same plane we were) demanded his sandwich, which he could see in the window, despite the fact they were "still waiting on fries" more than twenty minutes after the burgers had hit the window. The clerk finally called for fries and miraculously they appeared as if they might have been cooked already and just waiting for some air-headed dough-eyed register jockey to tell the cook to put them in cups. I called out for my brother's, they were dispensed as well, and we got out of there because our flight was already boarding by this point. We managed a couple handfuls of fries before getting into line, and had to eat the sandwiches on the plane after takeoff. They were already well cold by that point so there's no true judgement on how they might have tasted if hot and fresh, but just from the flavor profile I can guarantee that there's absolutely nothing remarkable about their food. Sauce was basically undetectable, burger was bland.

Might be a little biased because the only films I've seen here are all knockout emotional rollercoasters... that also happen to be Taika Waititi movies but whatever.

This is a charming little theater tucked away near Headhouse square with all the things you need to enjoy a great indie/limited distribution/arthouse/absurdist Hitlerjugendfilme film, like refrigerated junior mints, giant pop corns and sodas, and a bathroom that is actually clean.

Kick back, relax, watch a couple of flicks, and drink in the area. Everyone should be so fortunate to be able to partake in simple pleasures like the Ritz East.

Our first visit was wonderful..The staff are caring and loving and Dr.Callahan is wonderful. She took time to explain everything.
I'm an overprotective dog parent and I feel totally feel comfortable there.
Will make this my permanent vet.
Their costs are very reasonable as well,and they offer senior citizens a discount!!
Thank you Mission Pet Hospital.
                                                      Roger G

I'm so disappointed by my last visit when I made an appointment and after sitting for 45 minutes and never seeing doc I got pissed and left. I can hear other people who came in after me getting helped and rang out but I could t even get puppy vaccines. Thanks for wasting my time I will never be back
Not recommended as a place for a first date .The music was loud and it is was difficult to carry on a conversation.

This theater is great and the management and staff are outstanding!

I was looking for a different and creative way to propose to my GF and eventually decided it would be fun to create a slide show and show it on a movie screen before a movie.  I didn't want to do it at just any movie theater, so I chose the Ritz cuz of the adult atmosphere and superior quality.  I was not disappointed with my choice.

I called the theater about a week and a half before the proposal and told one of the Managers what I was thinking about doing.  She answered all of my technical questions regarding their equipment and assured me that it was something we could do.  I spent the next week creating the slide show and called the theater back.  They let me test the slide show on the screen the day before the proposal, it looked great.

I arrived with my GF the following evening and the staff really made things special.  I could sorta tell that most of the people working that night knew what was going on.  My GF had no clue.  When we arrived at our seats everything was ready to go.  The viewer was already projected onto the screen.  I called the Manager and told him I was ready.  They dimmed the lights and played the slide show.  It was fantastic!  The staff at the theater really wanted to make sure everything was perfect.  

As we prepared to leave the theater all of the staff congratulated us.  I thanked the manager personally and asked if I could do anything for his staff.  He said that wouldn't be necessary because they had such a good time doing it.

My future wife and I will enjoy many movies here in the years to come!  This is a great movie theater!  Highly recommended!

First off I'll start by saying as far as price goes and my kids having fun and it being clean and safe 5 stars wouldn't do it any justice. But I guess she was a manager or shift leader or just that know it all every place has, she was straight rude from the get go. She had a big attitude about us using socks from other places, when myself and my wife were helping the lil ones through the obstacles course she found us and literally yelled at us like we were children saying "The Parent bands" are only to help the kids NOT for playing on the equipment. You talk about embarrassing. I doubt We will ever go back and it's a shame because the kids really enjoyed themselves and the rest of the staff were nice.

I've had delivery from here.
The veggie samosas are kinda weak.
The navrattan korma is kinda weak.
The chicken tikka masala is very, very good.
The garlic naan is good.

Indian food novices will find this review to be very useful.
The food here wows me every time! I love the bahn mi grilled pork sandwich and vermicelli bowls! Cucumber lemonade is also a must try.

I must say I'm a pretty big fan of all the Ritz theaters. Perhaps it's because of the select indie films they show or maybe it's the small town, non commercial/mainstream vibes they give off. 

This particular location is much larger than the others,  so finding a seat will never be an issue. 

I think it's a perfect theater for a date as there's so many wonderful restaurants just down the street here in Olde City! 

The concessions are fairly typical with the addition of tea, which I find to be my new favorite thing to enjoy while watching a film, especially on a winter's or rainy day. 

Ticket prices are fairly standard, perhaps a tad less expensive. They do offer student and matinee discounts ($8) and senior fare ($7.25) as well. On Wednesdays, all day and all night, pay just $7.25. 

The theater is clean, as are the restrooms. 

Kiosk parking is available on both sides of 2nd street and was super easy during the day midweek! 

*Text RITZEAST to 3FILM to sign up for their film club, which includes info on new release, director appearances, giveaways, contests, free and advice screenings.
I love this place. The people who work here are so nice and knowledgeable. Never any issues. I trust them 100% with my dog. Affordable too!

Cafe Cuong turns out a mean Vietnamese sandwich.

I discovered Cafe Cuong through Viviane T. and other friends. They're off the beaten path, and quite possibly the smallest sandwichery ever. Come here for take out, not to sit.

My friend and I shared a regular Vietnamese sandwich (banh mi thit nguoi) for a reasonable $3.25 (cash only, last I checked). In addition, we had a deluxe (banh mi dac biet), for $3.75. The banh mi's bread was nicely toasted, crisp and yielding. Biting into it, I found the mayo a bit of a surprise. The cook wasn't stingy with meat, and we had a healthy amount of pickled carrots, cucumber, and cilantro (my favorite) packed in - if only there were more peppers in my sandwich!

It's easy to take down two or three sandwiches in a sitting, so take advantage of Cafe Cuong's "buy 10, get 1 free" deal.

I left full and happy, with phantom banh mi dancing above my head for hours.

Stopped by here after getting my nails done a few doors down.  I heard them talking about pho, & even though it's almost 90 degrees, I had to get my fave, shrimp pho takeout.  It's SO good.  Broth is tasty and shrimp were nicely cooked. Really like how they packaged the takeout.  The noodles, fresh onions and herbs are in a nice big bowl to add the broth to, and the accents (lime, fresh basil, bean sprouts & hot & hoisin sauces) are all in a separate baggie.  Most other places I've gotten pho takeout from expect you to use that tall container that's super awkward to eat from.  I saw they have vegan options too.  This was my first visit, but I'll surely be back.  Highly recommend.
Great coffee, great sandwiches, awesome vibes, chill people here, favorite coffee shop downtown
The Epic is closed and out of business.  A new restaurant has replaced it.  Maggie's.

Café Cuong is so underrated. It's been around for years and years. I prefer Café Cuong to Ba Le because the owners are friendly and their banh mis are incredibly cheap and delicious. I love that there is never a line. Not that it matters because we always call ahead and they are super quick. They're a cash only establishment, so be sure to have cash on hand!

I literally am reviewing Epic for one reason and one reason only. Styrofoam. I wish people would read before they jump to conclusions, the "styrofoam" cups y'all are complaining about are NOT NORMAL STYROFOAM. They have a thing on the counter explaining everything about there green-ware "styrofoam." Com'mon people, read.
