The manager was really disrespectful and unprofessional. We waited for 2-1/2 hours for a table and the guy comes with a attitude because we had brought a cup with a bit of wine from the outside.  He said they could not serve us even though we offered to throw it out and get new drinks from the restaurant.  He was unreasonable and would not hear us.  I believe it had more to do with the fact that we were speaking Spanish than the actual "issue" they were calling out.  Is unfortunate that the staff is not prepared to deal with diversity in an city like Philadelphia.  Poorly handled, feel like we were discriminated and will absolutely never return and never recommend this place to anyone.  Very rude and unprofessional.  This place is in serious need of some diversity and inclusion training. Do not go there!

Why 5 stars?

Where have you been? Where have I been? Why didn't I find this sooner?

I never used to be sad that I didn't go to Downtown Tampa. After being here I am now sad that I don't get to Downtown Tampa more often. 

Great staff, great food, parking sticks (always does downtown).

Price is decent, food is good and you should definitely give this spot a try!

The food was delicious!!  Some of the best grits I have ever had. I had an omelet and it was just right, not too grease and the veggies were not mushy. This is a must breakfast stop while in Tampa Bay Area!!!
A great spot with great food! A Downtown Tampa a staple for years. Dylan will hook you up with a great breakfast item or coffee for an affordable price!

I visit here at times when I'm in town for work. I stay in a hotel near by so Iron Hill is convenient. Overall I'm happy with Iron Hill but some small issues always seem to arise. On my last two occasions I have been missing a items I ordered in the take away bag. Iron Hill has rectified the situation but they need to tie up the details a bit. 

I suggest for the customers to verify all items ordered and foe the hostess interacting with the customers to also verify what is in each take away bag before presenting it to the customer. A little QA will go a long way.

Friend treated me to a birthday massage here and I was pretty impressed. Although Massage Envy does not tout all the "bells and whistles" of a traditional spa, the place was clean, and my guy really knew what he was doing. I would say these two elements are probably key to a great experience.  I forgot who my masseur was but he was male, and he made me feel very very comfortable. No complaints!

Good food but horrible service. 

I sat at the bar for lunch, which wasn't busy-there were more than half of the seats open. The bartender made me feel like I was doing him a favor by having lunch there. 

It was difficult to get his attention as he was either texting or chatting with the wait staff at the end of the bar. I don't care as long as service doesn't suffer. My meal came out, and it took quite a long time to get his attention to get a napkin and a fork and knife. Not so much as a sorry when he finally brought the setup. 

It could have been an off day, but I don't think I'll be back.

The only reason I'm rating this with 4 stars is because the bartenders (Jarred and Madeline) were so accommodating regardless of other errors out of their control. 
We were greeted promptly upon arrival at the bar , had a beer before the eagles game but stayed for longer because of the great service. I wanted to order the philly special but they had previously ran out unfortunately. We stayed a little longer for food and ordered wings well done with a basket of fries and cheese sauce. None of it came out right. The cheese sauce was freezer cold and the wings were soggy and chewy. Again the bartenders were super accommodating but at that point I was not hungry any more. The bartender informed me she had ordered me a new order of wings and an hour later they came out. The manager brought them out rolled her eyes after I said I did not want them anymore after waiting an hour. Needless to say I will be coming back for the beers and the bartenders service but nothing else.
Get the egg rolls, they are out of this world. Drinks were also very good. Great spot in the heart of Philly.

I have to actually say the name Tasty Shop is a fitting name for this establishment.  Since the start of Covid I've been trying to utilize more smaller establishments considering usually it's even harder for them to stay afloat.  Just imagine if big name places are struggling to remain open usually mom and pop businesses will likely have it worse. They opened May 12, so just imagine opening a new business during these uncertain times, I was glad I was told about them.

My friend mention that they have awesome combo deals, I logged into DoorDash and browsed the menu.  I was trying to remember what flavor of wings to get because my friend told me all of the flavors were actually great but her favorite was the honey sriracha flavor.  I decided on honey sriracha wings and shrimp fried rice. The price was a steal $8.99 for a good portion of food.

About 20 minutes later the food arrived really piping hot, which I appreciated that.  I tasted the wings and they were messy and tasted great! Hey I'm eating inside my house so who really cares if I had to keep the paper towels near by! Also the fried rice was just how I prefer fried rice with egg and onions, the shrimp tasted very fresh not frozen.

They advertise their style of wings as Atlanta Style Wings, besides wings they have subs, burgers, seafood, tenders salads and of course fried rice.  You can order through DoorDash or Grubhub and also call in for pickup.  I hope you all check them out!

Here's the deal... after a long day of site-seeing, we had hungry bellies, a squirmy-wormy toddler, and no dinner plan. WHOOPS. Huge parenting fail. We crossed our fingers and hoped the place we saw (Iron Hill) across from our hotel would be kid-friendly at 7:00 on a Saturday night and we wouldn't end up eating 7-11 hot dogs in our hotel. We were handsomely rewarded for our bad planning with a great experience. 

Definitely feel okay taking your children for the following reasons: 1) kids menu & crayons (always a sign kids are okay); 2) staff was incredibly friendly to a toddler; 3) it's loud but not too loud in the restaurant so its okay to talk at kid-volume and if you end up with quick cry you'll be covered (PSA: don't stay in a restaurant with a crying child but if you're reading this to find out if kids are cool here, you're probably not that obnoxious parent anyway).

We checked in and were quoted a 20 minute wait. I love that they have a high-tech system with your cell-phone being the pager for when your table is ready. The wait ended up being considerably shorter. I appreciate the underpromise-overdeliver strategy. 

When we got to our seats, our server Sam was a total pleasure. I told him that I actually don't really like beer so if he could just bring me the least-beery beer on tap, that would be great. He laughed and brought me and my husband a couple of samples so we could place orders that we actually liked. I totally appreciated that because I probably would have ordered something I hated and it would have been a bummer. Instead I got a really great well-balanced pumpkin ale. He was also great with our kid who was hanging on like a champ. It really helped having an engaged server who talked to him and took his order like an adult. 

There was a slight hiccup with our food (missing an item) but Sam and the management team were so quick to deal with it and fixed it in a way that totally surpassed our expectations. I never get mad when things like this happen if the staff addresses it well, and this was A+ customer service. 

Our food was good, but I think we made an ordering mistake because I saw some more delicious looking items go by. Next time we return to Philly, I am putting this place on my itinerary to come back. 

Overall, I cannot believe this place only just opened. They have service down to a science already. Congrats Iron Hill and looking forward to visiting again soon.
Great food.  Great beer. Staff efficient and busy. Waiting for a table should be expected.

I don't find this restaurant to be anything special. Their food is adequate, the service is great and the beer is good. Once Pennsylvania lifts the food ordinance with alcohol purchases I believe that I would visit this place more often

I ordered on the phone and they told me 10 minutes. I showed up in 10 minutes and nobody seem to be there. It looked dead. There was a white SUV parked in the back but that was it. I had to leave. I've been to the actual restaurant over by USF which is really good but I'm not sure what's going on at this location. Oh well.

Came across this little food stand on a beautiful morning. Dylan, the owner was very personable and conversational! I love supporting local small business. I had the Cajun Frittata and it was the best I've ever had. I'd rather eat here for a good breakfast than other chain restaurants. It was quick and homemade. Im usually not a fan of grits because they aren't flavorful but these grits were awesome. Will definitely recommend coming here and then taking a stroll on the river walk!

Jerk Hut has like 3 or 4 locations.   Personally, I like the drive thru location in South Tampa but I was in the Seminole Heights area.   Seminole Heights location where you park & go to the walk up window.  

The order taker was very pleasant.  It took less than 10 minutes to get my order.  My oxtails dinner was very and tasty.  You will get a lot of food for the money.  Cabbage was good. As well as the mac n cheese.  

In the future, when I think about it, I will revisit this location.

Food was good, service ok...very busy...
Beer selection good and sample really helps you make a wise choice!  Like my ribs and my friend's  chicken and asparagus were great.
Mashed potatoes were chunky and just alright

Went here for a couple beers and apps with a friend. Cool vibe, bar tender was great, tap selection was legit. We got the Philly cheesesteak egg rolls, very good! I got the southwest salad, it was as good as it should be. Definitely recommend as the prices are right for solid beers and food!
All the food at our table was great and came out fairly quickly. Butternut squash soup was incredible and the fried Brussels sprouts were great.

(to the tune of the Spice Girls classic, "Stop")

You just walk in, it's been a while
But, hey, you know Iron Hill Brew'ry.
Whether you traveled an inch, or many miles,
Consistency right here is the key.
And, you know that you could go and find some other
Place to eat, but why would you even bother?
No gimmicks here, so grab a beer,
They'll greet you like you were their brother.

Don't you know - service is way fast.
Those cheesesteak egg rolls, they won't last.
Don't you know, what can't you see?
Just stop by, stay a while,
Get cozy at Iron Hill Brew'ry.

Stop right here, sip or snack or munch,
You could get dinner, or you could get lunch
Hey you, always on the run
You know just what you're gonna get, you're gonna have some fun.

If you've been to an Iron Hill before, you know what to expect. High quality food, large portions, consistently good service. Is anything here going to blow your mind? Probably not. It's not terribly creative, and there's not much finesse needed for pretzels with cheese dip. But the beers are good without trying too hard, the space is large and bright, and it's definitely a crowd pleaser when you're working with a group that doesn't want to get too "wild" with their orders.

I think this location is a great fit, right in the heart of tourist lodging, convention center, and RTM-area.
Food was amazing, beer was better, service was outstanding. Will definitely return next time in Philly.

This place is soooo good. Great beer selection, easy and friendly service, great prices, just all around- great. Casual dining experience + menu compete with other overpriced restaurants in the area with similar decor and ambience. Every time we cant decide on where to go, we come HERE

Iron Hill Brewery & Restaurant is an exceptional, and I strongly recommend it. This place is unbelievable. Every single thing was incredibly flavorful and delicious. I became very good friends with the staff, who are all fantastic and super helpful. We will definitely come back to Iron Hill Brewery & Restaurant again.

Almost impossible to find anywhere to eat in this god forsaken city but I stumbled on this spot and it was great. Good beer, food packed plenty of punch it was fresh as hell too. Hopefully the mayor of this dump pulls his head out of his ass and let's them open back up to full capacity because not only is there no reason to still be locked down like this but it's criminal to deny people this food. Everyone should try this place.

I can't believe this place has good reviews. The pizza had zero flavor (how do you mess up pizza???) just like the rice pilaf that came with the scallops. The nachos, spring rolls etc all were bleh and absolutely forgettable. Did they run out of salt? WTH?

I've wanted to try this for 3 years now. Never had a weekday off to try. Boy am I happy I finally got to try it. Perfect excuse to take a stroll and enjoy a delicious breakfast sandwich. AmaZing. The bacon, egg and cheese with spinach and eggs were  perfectly cooked and I can't wait to try it again. I might go back again tomorrow.

Timely, hot, fresh food, and great customer service. I have been avoiding this place for the last 6 months because my last experience was rough. (Waited 45) for food. This time was great. Customer service is back! Try it out... prove me wrong!

Wow wow wow. So good! We had such a great time celebrating even with Covid. My friend enjoyed and so did we! The burger I got was amazing, and the peach ice cream after was phenomenal to end the night.

Definitely will come again!!

Decent beer and good food. Ive been in a few times and it's usually packed. Not the case now but they have limited seating and staff so you may have to wait. Attentive staff and the prices are good.  Quinoa salad is excellent and the chicken chowder soup was even better. They have a beer for everyone however I've found most are average.

This food cart has the best breakfast in Tampa! The Dylan and Cajun Fritattas are the best, made with care and high quality cheeses and vegetables. I recommend either the cuban bread or grits for the side. You can call ahead and your order will be ready in about 15 minutes. (think they are cash only, fyi)  Wish I had known about this place when I worked downtown, they are only open during weekdays and usually close at 11am.

Great location 
Server was Justin and he was awesome 

Very covid focused and all the booths had partitions in between in a system that makes sense post covid 

Our food was amazing from the burgers to chicken salad and loved the in house beverage selection

Get the root beer ....AMAZING

terrible place, motel 6 has gone downhill fast! big hole in the wall, no working frig, no pool! i had to call the front office to report the condition of the room. the dude was like ok, come down, we have no other room! i got two big suitcases there. Now he is talking about giving me my money back, but certainly that isn't what i expected from motel 6. stain on the bed cover looked like blood! tv was rather small. the little room where you had to stand in the morning, was like a sauna! no early morning coffee! room 252, the maintenance guy even knew the hole was there! crazy. I have stayed in many different places, motel 6 , days inn others too, this place shouldn't have been opened up. Of course my cell has the conversation recorded and i do think i have a picture of the hole! what is the saying motel 6 has, "we'll leave the light on for you!" In this place , leave the light on while you sleep, you never know what can happen in a place like this! These people running this place have no business sense! and oh yeah, on the motel 6 website, when you click on the contact link , you get kicked out of the website, nice touch there motel 6! masters inn 6626 E Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Tampa, FL 33619*(813) 623-6667 use to be "masters inn", they should call it "disaster inn"

Paradiso reminds me of the movie Major League (1989). Hear me out. Paradiso is like Jake Taylor (Tom Berrenger), the seasoned veteran who has lost a step or two, and is being overshadowed by the rising young stars around him. The rookie stars have charisma, flash, and are breathing new life into a beleaguered team. Jake knows baseball. He has grit and determination. He is tenacity personified. And while he may not be the star anymore, his skills are still relevant and even essential to the game. 

Paradiso was the place that kickstarted the Passyunk Ave Restaurant Revival. The food is modern Italian with the occasional twist. Service is pretty good, and the ambiance is more demure than some of the other more ostentatious places nearby. There's no loud music or TVs on the walls. There no fusion food. There's no hipster hostess. There's just baseball- err, umm, I mean food! Just  food. 

It's easy to forget this place as things in this neighborhood are shaping up very quickly. A look through the window will typically show a less than half full restaurant, and patrons may all be 50+ years old, blocking the sidewalk while struggling to figure out their Uber app. 

Regardless, it deserves some respect and patronage. Just like Jake Taylor deserved those two pennants.

Came by after work one day. We didn't have a reservation so the wait was about 30-40 minutes for a table for table for 4. Fine, we'll wait at the bar. The bar was overwhelmingly packed, as in you had to reach through a couple of people sitting at the bar to order and receive your drink. Suggestion, make a small space for standing orders so we don't have to keep disturbing the people sitting at the bar, I felt horribly when I went to order a second drink. There are a fair amount of bar tables, but you have to be quick in arriving or it's not going to happen until a least 6. Food was ok, service was ok. I'm not really complaining. It's jam packed which gives it a social feel, but it's difficult to maneuver so that takes away from it a bit.

3 stars because it's very close to work and the food is decently good. I'll probably be back just because of that, but I wouldn't go out of my way for it. Especially because I'm not a beer drinker, which I understand it is a beer place, but I just got other things. I will give it another try when the outside patio opens.

We had an enjoyable meal at this restaurant. I enjoyed both their beer and food. I had a flight flight of 4 4-ounce glasses of their signature beers. For appetizers we had the mushroom soup and mini-croissants. Our entrees were the grilled brewben sandwich and Baja-style fish tacos. All were good. Our server, Taylor, took good care of us and was very helpful considering this was our first visit there. i would definitely return.
They far exceeded our expectations. The food was excellent the the service was top notch!

I came here Sunday with 2 friends after the beauty convention nearby. 1 friend was visiting from Houston and I wanted to treat her to a good dinner. Yelp lead the way, we were exhausted and wanted to find something close that we could walk to. This place popped up with only 12 reviews but all 5 Star. I decided to take a chance and I'm glad I did. It's a new restaurant so everything looks nice & sleek. The staff was excellent in attitude, service, and attentiveness. The food was delicious and fresh. I had Brussel sprouts and fish and chip which were excellent. One friend had seafood pasta and broccolini the other mussels and fish & chips. We were all highly satisfied, our waiter was awesome and gave great suggestions. I also had a beer flight, I mean it is a brewery lol, the waiter helped me choose and I was happy with what I got. I will absolutely be back and I'd easily bring another out of town guest here. I had a nice amount of food left which I packed to go but I left the container on the table. 15 mins later I returned praying they hadn't thrown it away and guess what, it was waiting for me at the hostess stand. I could've cried tears of joy, my lunch the next day was just as good everything reheated well even the fries  I hope they continue to run this restaurant the way they do, it'll be a hot spot for sure.

This place is meh. It's cheap food which is why it's good, other than that not that special. Plus one time I made the reservation on open table before showing up and they said I can't do that. Doesn't make sense. Rude employees prob won't go back unless I'm just going for beer

I'm staying at a nearby hotel and used their online ordering website for carry-out, which was great, and quick. The hostess was super friendly, and the food was good (burger), the only problem was when I got back to my hotel room and discovered that they left out my side of asparagus, which was on my receipt and paid for. Also, they did not include or offer any ketchup for my fries and burger in the to-go order, which I also realized back at the room. I've Learned my lesson to always check before leaving, but I didn't bother walking back in the dark again to get my asparagus. I'd order again if I was here again, just would check first. They also have four packs of beer if you want to take some for carry-out too, which was nice. Would have given four stars if they had remembered my asparagus!

Stopped in for a beer before dinner since it was right across the street from the hotel we were staying at. We were trying to find a local owned gastropub for dinner vs Iron Hill as it is a small regional chain, but ultimately decided to eat here. We were pleasantly surprised with the quality of the beers and the food.  We just had appetizers for dinner - fried cauliflower, spicy chicken sliders, and the bbq chicken flatbread. All quite good. We tried all the IPAs on tap, some better than others. Our favorites were the Brut IPA (forger the name) and their take in a NE IPA "Philadelphia IPA".   The only miss was the imperial vanilla bourbon porter that the GF ordered. It had a number of weird, during and aftertastes. Oh well, it was hers to drink so not my problem. All in all, I would go back to any of their locations.

Very pleasant experience here during the lunch time rush. My wait in the drive thru was short. My order was made fresh & accurate. The staff were helpful, friendly & professional. The food was delish  I can definitely recommend this Wendy's location to all. I also earned points from using the APP!

Came here around 6PM with a group of 14 on a Wednesday. They are spacious enough for multiple groups. They take reservations, but won't take more than 3 credit cards. So I recommend to bring cash or electronically pay each other. 
For the food, it was great. I had the burger and it was one of the greatest burgers. Maybe it was the bun combination? The beers are fairly priced. Feel free to drink more.

I went to their 40th anniversary weekend offering breakfast burritos because I had a 20% off coupon.  The ad stated that they would be open serving the Breakfast Burritos from 9:00 am - 11:00 am.  I arrived at 9:00 am, but they didn't open until 9:06 & that was only because I said thru the glass door that their ad indicated a 9 am opening time.  They gave the explanation that they were sorry, but they were busy.
I gave the cashier the 20% off coupon, paid $7.16, & sat down to wait for my to-go order. Looking at the receipt, I realized I wasn't given the 20% discount.  When I questioned the gentleman that gave me my order, he said the coupon was not good for the burrito.  I informed him the coupon didn't state any exclusions so he then refunded the 20%.
I got the burrito home and it was the worst breakfast burrito I've ever tasted.  It was mostly filled with mushy hash brown potatoes & very little egg & green chilis plus the tortilla was wrapped sloppily.
I've been to this restaurant before & got satisfactory food at a decent price, but won't be back due to today's experience!

So I'm a Delaware bitch. Iron Hill was a notable presence on UD campus' main street. I actually thought I heard rumors that it was closing but that might be me getting confused with the closure of another gem (Kildare's, R.I.P.). My GF's sister works here on main street so it comes up in conversation. I didn't pay much mind to Iron Hill's presence in Philadelphia until our accrual of a very generously provided gift card. 

We meant to come for a while but one thing or another would lead us astray. On one of our last nights prior to leaving Philly for another job, we knew it was our last chance. 

We spent all day packing up our things prior to the move and left around 9pm to catch them before the kitchen closes. At that hour, most of the tables were empty and we were able to enjoy a lot of attention from the server. 

We were seated by the window with good seats to observe the homeless man nodding into the street's garbage can. 

There's a lot of good stuff on the menu, just the appetizers alone offer buffalo cauliflower, margherita flatbread, hummus, pretzel sticks, lettuce wraps, guac and much more for my meat-eating friends. We settled on the nachos, brussels sprouts, and my carnivorous GF ordered the philly cheesesteak rolls (bc how could you not?).

The nachos just on presentation alone were scrumptious. The chips were crisp and covered with not just melted cheddar but also that delicious white mexican cheese that resembles crumbled feta (whatever that shit is). There were ACTUAL BEANS and ACTUAL JALAPENOS instead of that pickled shit. There was also a spritz of a delicious, creamy, white sauce. Who doesn't like white, creamy sauce? To top it all off, there were two massive dollops, one of sour cream (creme fraiche if you want to be a fancy bitch) and one of GUAC. Did I mention the diced tomatoes? (that no one really cares about tbh). These were surprisingly good nachos from Iron Hill. 

The brussels sprouts were tasty but nothing special. I did appreciate the pecorino romano dusting on top. The philly cheesesteak rolls, and don't take my word for it because I am an onion-despising vegetarian were meh. My flesh-eating companion, however, enjoyed them tremendously (confirmed verbatim that this comment is not an embellishment). 

I also got a cocktail which I do not recall but it was something with tequila and beer and it was delicious. Their tap menu is also impressive.

OMG I almost forgot that we also ordered the cauliflower tacos which on this particular evening were $1 (taco tuesday). I actually no longer see it on the menu however I do see "thai vegetable lettuce wraps" which appears to be similar, our tacos had an asian flare. 

This is a good place to stop by for a drank (if you're picky or like unusual beers) and a meal!

Dylan is AWESOME. He hooked me up with a special sandwich without dairy due to my lactose intolerance. I was here for a conference and had no idea what to expect. So Dylan was super helpful and friendly. The egg sandwich with bacon and avocado on an english muffin + coffee = amazeballs.

He's cash only, but seriously for $5.50 for the whole thing -- I'm okay with that. :)

We held our son's rehearsal dinner at Paradiso in their upstairs private dining room.  It was lovely.  Lynn, the proprietor, was so very helpful in picking the right choices for the occasion and the food was amazing  Our guests went wild for her homemade gnocchi, which are the very best Philadelphia restaurants offer.  We would highly recommend Paradiso for a private party, special occasion, or just spur of the moment dinner.

I went today thru the drive thru because I was really craving Wendy's I have not had it in a long time and I did not even get to taste the food!! I spend 15 minutes in the drive thru there was probably 9 cars there waiting too I finally decided to leave.
Delicious! Dylan knows how to make a breakfast sandwich.
Had the Cajun Frittata w/Dylan Grits, I'm from Atlanta so I know good grits...wonderful!

They are stupid!

I woke up in agony this morning and called them and they said I could come in at 9:30.
I came in and my Mom decided to drive me because I'm hurting so badly, I'm sitting there and they tell me that the therapist decided not to come and my mom left and I have to stand outside because I'm not allowed in there and I'm disabled!

It's not often I give a review as critical as this one; but it's warranted.  When I first walked in, I felt as though I'd just should turn around and go somewhere else.  It looked as though everything behind the counter was in disarray and confusion.  The young man who took my order appeared to be new -- at least I hope that would explain it.  While waiting for my medium Frostys, to accompany my warm (at best), fries and my warm (at best) burgers, a young man came up, asking for an employee.  The young girl who was working behind the counter and trying to multi-task tried to explain to him, whoever he was asking for was in the back talking with someone.  Rather than have the intelligence (and courtesy to those customers waiting to order, behind him), to say, "Please tell him I'll be sitting over here.", he continued to stand at the counter.  He pressed the young lady, who again told him whoever he was asking for was currently busy.  Didn't phase him.  One waiting customer asked, "Have you guys ordered, yet?"  He was justifiably becoming annoyed and impatient.  It was 2:30 PM, MST when I left Wendy's.  When I got home, the Frostys were as thin as the sodas.  I put them in the freezer to try to make them thicker.  I just checked on them.  It is now almost 2 hours later and they still aren't thick.  They are just beginning to get thicker on the very top.  The kid was still standing at the counter, holding up everyone when I left.  With the exception of the young lady, it appeared it was everyone's first day on the job.  I'd recommend new management to come in and try to straighten the place out.  But that's just me.

Most definitely the worst customer service I've experienced EVER. I'd recommend going anywhere else in the neighborhood, and with so many different dry cleaners around, there is no need to have to ever put up with such ridiculousness. The quality of the dry cleaning is just OK, and the turn around time is a lot longer than other places in the area. The woman who works there enjoys doing her hair and yelling at customers, as oppose to providing customer service. This place is just the worst.

I went here on a recommendation from s friend.  He was right; this place is great.  I sat at the bar and started with a melon,  prosciutto salad that had this great spicy oil drizzle that complimented the dish perfectly.  I then was torn between the spaghetti and shellfish in a tomato based sauce and another crab and pasta (wider and thicker than your average pappardelle)  dish with a white sauce.  The bartender said that I could split my dinner with two 1/2 portions of each.  Best recommendation

The staff was excellent and the food was exceptional.  What a treat!! I will definitely be back and I highly recommend this establishment.

Finally we have an Iron Hill Brewery in Center City, and with such a gorgeous location here at the sprawling new East Market project!

This is a big restaurant, as it should be for such a high-profile, bustling, Center City location. The wall of windows that surround Iron Hill's perimeter are breath-taking, and showcase great views of the Reading Terminal Market and the vibrant sidewalk crowds. There is an outdoor dining area just along the side of this new building, for those nicer weather times. There is music in the air, but at no point was it overwhelming to drown out great conversation with others.

Came here with a friend for lunch, and we both pretty much ordered the same entree - buffalo wings. Iron Hill gives you 10 for $13; they are juicy, and they are a pretty decent size too. You can order them crispy, which both of us did, or not. I've already been to other Iron Hills to have experience with other menu options, such as the delicious char-grilled burgers and sweet potato fries; but I'll wait to update this review on those once I come back to have them here.

And the on-site brewed beers are always a highlight when you hit an Iron Hill. Today I went for the White Iron Wit - because I'm a Belgian/wheat beer kinda guy. This particular beer will satisfy those of us in the Blue Moon crowd, with a perfect amount of orange to compliment this light-styled brew. If there ever was a better Blue Moon beer than Blue Moon itself, then this is would be it!

Our waitress just couldn't have been nicer or more attentive, and I couldn't help but be happy to reward her with a generous tip for being so fantastic.

I don't make a frequent habit of coming to these kind of pricey establishments when I fly solo, but Iron Hill proves its value when you are on a date or meeting up with friends. Iron Hill has always been a great experience for me, and I couldn't be more thrilled to now have it here in Center City!

The wait was long on Saturday afternoon (10/23). The food was prepared as requested. It was worth the wait. I wish there was one close to my home. My friend had the cauliflower pizza with chicken. I had the pub burger, but forget to take a photo. It was perfect!

Great little spot for breakfast. Just a small cart by Riverfront Park. Menu options look great. I had the sandwich with egg, goat cheese, bacon spread and arugula. It was great. Guy there is super nice too.

First off, the hospitality is awesome. From the beginning that my fiancé and I walked through the door we were greeted and seated where we were most comfortable, so we went to the bar. We saw everyone with Brewer's Flights, and decided to inquire. Jared is SUCH an amazing bartender. My fiancé and I are traveling from New York and we definitely don't have something like this back home. Jared told us of the restaurant's history, and he made sure both our flights were personally crafted to our liking. My fiancé even saw him taking down our preferences and matching them with beers. The blueberry yum yum & Brambleberry are our favorites! The manager even saw us with our egg roll sampler tray and explained each and every sauce and roll to us. Btw, the Buffalo sauce is homemade! Chefs kiss. Whenever you're in Philly just ask for Jared at the bar: you will not be disappointed!
Food was tasty.... Customer revive was excellent. The Brussels were delicious as were the fries.
Only reason I am giving 5 stars is because the food was great. Rachel was awful and would deserve 1 star at best. She seemed like she did not want to be there whatsoever!!

This place has the best cheese grits I've ever had. We always get the Cajun Frittata with a side of the grits and it is the best breakfast in Tampa. It is always made to order and comes out piping hot. 

The owner Dylan is a really nice guy and even cooked a piece of bacon for our dog. This is a great, small business to support!

We split the seafood bisque which was delish. The waiter was awesome he split our soup because he knew we were sharing. The brews were great. Something for everyone. I ordered the burger salad med rare and it was a little more done than I'd like but it was good. He also noticed we liked IPAs so he brought us an extra sample. He was awesome.

Good beer. Good food. Friendly staff. What more could you want. We got the Korean bbq wings and the meat trio pizza. Great wings the pizza wasn't the best I ever had but it was a solid slice. Would recommend.
Had a very nice meal here until we realized there was a dead mouse under the table next to us.

I've always had a good experience at this location. From my first visit they were very welcoming and professional. Scarlet today however was the best at targeting the muscles that needed work. With my rather vague explanation and my previous file. Amazing
 Highly recommend.

This location was amazing the food was delicious, I had a burger and requested that some things be changed they did it with no issues. My 7yr old is a burger fiend but what took me out is he ate some of my coleslaw and then ate it all he said it was delicious this from a kid who hates all vegetables on this earth. The waiter was amazing with him what I didnt know was they make their own root beer his root beer float was amazing. Definitely will go back.

My husband and I entered and walked past a couple of the employees several times. None of which acknowledged my husband or I or greeted us. Not even a glance our way. It was like we were invisible to them. Very poor customer service. The store wasn't even busy.
Not much to say since we came here for a quick bite to eat and drinks but we left pleased! Would recommend the nachos *tongue out emoji* and service was great!

YUM!!

we had a group here for a rowing race in Philly and we found this place on Open Table- 

We each had great meals and appetizers- super yummy homemade gnocci!  THere were some very interesting menu items- so a good variety could be found by anyone-  Pork Belly was delish, I even tried my first chicken livers- and I have to admit, they were tasty!

Nice for a quiet dinner, but they were very accommodating to our group of 7.

Great meal with friendly service!

I don't often write reviews, but we ordered takeout and this was so bad I felt compelled to leave a review.  We ordered the fried chicken sandwich, firecracker mac n' cheese, chicken corn chowder, and brownie dessert.  I can't say that in the past Iron Hill had the best food, but at least it used to be serviceable.  Tonight I felt like I received fast food at brewpub prices.  Think Wawa's mac n cheese and Wendy's chicken sandwich. Everything was super cheap and bland. The soup was seasoned like ham and bean (which was sort of weird) and seemed like it was out of a can.  Even the brownie and ice cream were bad.  I've had fantastic takeout at a similar price point from several other restaurants in the area so I know it can be done well.  This was just so bad, would not recommend.

Had a very pleasant experience dining at the Center City location of Iron Hill Brewery. We were in town for a short visit and our friends recommended this location as family friendly. It's very difficult dining with an infant but the service was outstanding and they helped us get situated quickly. Our server brought a flight of beers for tasting and was very attentive throughout our meal. I'd love to dine here again next time I visit Philly!
Good burgers & fries .  Friendly service.  Staff brought water & treats out for our dog.

Love that they brew beer here and the food is delicious. Was a great date night. I had the chicken and linguini while my husband had a burger special. Had the molten cake for dessert which was served with vanilla ice cream. Had the pumpkin beer which was one of my favorite pumpkin beers I've had.

Fun atmosphere, great drink selections and super friendly and educated staff. There is a wide variety of beers to choose from and the menu also had a lot of options. I had the buffalo cauliflower pizza and it was very good!

Our family visited Iron Hill after attending an exhibit at the Convention Center. I appreciated that, not only did they ask for our vaccine cards before the city's mandate went into effect, the also checked our IDs to make sure the names on the cards matched. 

Our waiter was friendly and attentive. Our food was delicious, and the final tab for lunch for three, including three beers was under $100 with tip. We will certainly be back!

Started the day with 3 hours of sleep and a dead car battery. The car fiasco meant no time for my planned big cup o' jo and a breakfast sammy so I walked into my meeting across the street longingly staring at Egg, White, & Associates and wishing I had time to visit. I said a little prayer that our meeting would end before closing time at 11am. Walked out of our meeting at 11:03 and my heart sunk. We saw Dylan packing up and asked if he was done for the day or if he'd consider two more customers. He kindly agreed to sweat it out for 2 more breakfast sammies. They were both eggcellent (corny pun intended), though I would've preferred my fried egg on the English to have a runny yolk. Dylan was super nice and friendly and eager to learn about his customers. The wait was a bit long, though I'm not sure if that's because he had already packed up some of his stuff. If I worked nearby, I'd definitely be here at least a couple times a week! Egg white and whole wheat English muffins help make for a healthier option!

I ordered this online via Yelp (which, in turn, operates through Grubhub). The process was quite straightforward for pickup, particularly because the food truck is conspicuously located at the northeast corner of MacDill Park.

I appreciated that the vendor was honest. The prices for the Du Jour Omelette were incorrect online (too high), so I overpaid. I didn't know this, and he readily handed me the difference in cash when I went to pick up the food.

We also had the Dylan frittata. Everything was quite hearty and maybe a tad too oily/buttery...but nonetheless delicious. You can also customize the meal based on your preferences.

We stumbled upon this brewery after a long day of exploring the city and it did not disappoint. We were lucky enough to snag a table in the bar area before it got packed on a Friday night! Our server was awesome as she was very attentive to us the entire time. 

We split the nachos which were delicious and had a few beers before digging into trying their flat breads which were also very delicious. 

They had a lot of TVs as well which was nice for watching games. It was clearly a happening place as it was filled with youNg entrepreneurs along with many people clearly in town to run the marathon over the weekend looking to carboload before the big race! 

Overall I would definitely recommend everyone check this place out. They also had a really cool growler filling machine which I had never seen before!
Best Jamaican food spot in Tampa hands down!! Only recommendation is get there early before they sell out of the Jamaican beef patties. I try to grab a few each time I'm in Tampa.

This is a wonderful little breakfast food cart located in Macdill Park. GPS will get you close but just know it is located in the park. I had the English with a side of grits and both were amazing and cheap. I will be back to this little gem food cart!
All these reviews are absolutely correct! Great food at a great price. The coffee is awesome too! Five stars isnt enough for him - 6 or 7 is more fair.

Stopped by here after a very long day at work and travel. It appears this is a new location and as I walked in it was very full. Luckily there was a spot open at the bar. I sat down and ordered what was a delicious in house brew called the Belgian Tripel. Their menu has a lot of enticing offerings, and I ordered the Jaegerschnitzel. Its pan-fried pork cutlets, herbed spaetzle, haricots verts, roasted mushroom With a Wee Heavy Ale sauce.  Unfortunately that's when things went sideways. As I waited for my meal another patron at the bar had ordered at about the same time as I, and his food arrived and next thing I know he's almost done eating and my food is nowhere to be found. As I was bringing this delay to the staffs attention, a manager by the name of Matthew came to me and apologized for the delay in getting my order out. He assured me that it would be out as quick as possible. At that point the wait staff offered me a delicious complimentary cauliflower soup to tide me over and when the meal arrived it was fresh and delicious. I really appreciate him reaching out to me before I had time to complained . Overall The delay hurt my experience, but hopefully this is not the norm as the place and food is very good.

I wish I could give more than five stars! The food was excellent and the porter I had was fabulous. They have so many choices on their menu my husband and are going back until we sample them all.

When you arrive ask for Eden's section. She is THE BEST server we have ever had. No lie. She was attentive but did not hover, her knowledge of the menu was impressive and her beer recommendations were spot on. You can't do any better, I guarantee. We will definitely recommend this restaurant to our friends.

This was truly the worst burger and fries I've had.  Burger was smashed, including the bun.  The other burger was burnt.  Fries were cold and didnt seemed fully cooked.  My dogs didnt even want the fries.  I'm guessing they dont have a manager or they really dont care.

Gross, why are you designing clothes that already look dirty?  That's a bad business model.
On the other hand your clothes fall apart at the seams very quickly causing people to return to buy more clothes sooner.  That's a good business model.
Too bad the location (the Gallery) brings your image down.  That place is a dump.  I have to give the store credit though, it is clean and has friendly employees.

Make better clothes for a reasonable price and people will stop hating.

Went to this place last week with my girlfriend during our visit to Philly and it was awesome coming here. The Korean style chicken wings were totally delicious and the beers were great too. I don't remember much of the names of the beers but so many of them were good. The server who's name was Cozette gave some of the best service I have ever had. She let us sample all of the beers and almost converted me into an IPA drinker. If I ever find myself in Philly again I'd totally come back here.

I've been meaning to stop by here for a while now after reading the reviews, but I am rarely in downtown Tampa in the morning. Well, the reviews are accurate and this was worth the wait!

The coffee was excellent (and much appreciated as the thermometer is reading 48° right  now) and the food was even better. I had the Cajun with grits and both were excellent - perfectly seasoned and fresh ingredients. The owner was friendly and if I worked downtown I would be here every morning! 

If you haven't checked it out yet, don't wait as long as I did!
I specifically come into the heart of the city just for this place. I love the beer, the atmosphere is great!! We are from upstate New York, so coming here for worK it is a great place to unwind!!
Has the potential but fell short.  Double Titos and grapefruit had no alcohol. Steak and mashed potatoes were flavorful but cold.

A huge letdown. We were very confident in ordering the Philly egg rolls, we were wrong. The outside was gummy, very chewy. The filling was very lacking. 
Tomato soup was really very bad. It was not served warm. It had a thick film on the top. A salad, costing $14, containing no protein... had better be good. It was not. Like simple lettuce, a piece of tomato, and very bad ranch dressing.

Came here while visiting Philly for the first time and it was amazing! Our server Cozette was exceptional. She was patient and explained all the beers and helped make deciding easy. More than just take our order and bring our food, she made our experience here truly memorable. Shes passionate about what she does and goes above and beyond for her guests! Highly recommend this place!

Service sucks.  When we're seated there was no silverware. We asked for a different seat because the pub table was too high. Although some extra open seats the hostess response was, "that's for larger party".  It was 745pm and the place closes at 8pm on Sunday. No waitress or waiter came until we asked staff passing by.  He said he was in the back and would be right with us.  We left after 15 minutes with no one who came to check on us. Bad experience for 1st day in Philly
Good beer. Absolutely more a restaurant than a brewery. But they have a good beer list with a mix of types. The couple we had were very good.

I've had a rough time finding a great stylist to color my hair correctly. I have curly hair and it's not the easiest to work with. Adrienne worked her magic on my hair and I can finally stop looking!! She is absolutely amazing and her skills are top notch.
Great location and our waiter, Ryan, was extremely accommodating and friendly.  He offered samples of beer and helped us make a selection among their many offerings.  Pub burger was delicious.

Totally mediocre in every way. Basically a tourist trap for people who are in downtown Philly and are willing to overpay for mediocre food.

I had a $15 pub burger that was more or less Burger King quality at best. I also had the $9 "Triple Chocolate Hill" dessert which took forever to come out (as did everything, on a weekday afternoon when there were very few customers) and I got the impression it had sat in the window for awhile because the brownie was mushy and the ice cream was half melted.

The sides of roasted potatoes and broccoli were average, not bad but definitely not great - worth the $3 each they cost. Throw in the $3 iced tea, tax and tip and I spent $40 on a $15 meal.
I loved Iron Hill Brewery! What great food and everyone there was so nice!  Thanks for a great experience!  I will be back :-)
I don't like strong beer so I loved the raspberry beer -best tasting beer I've ever had

OMGGGG I'm hooked! Every time I'm at my office I have to Uber Eats some Tasty's! I've had them 2 times last week and I'm hooked. I've ordered the Fried Chicken Wings and Shrimp Fried Rice -- SO GOOD! 

I can't wait to go back to work  so I can fast forward to lunch time. Try them out!

Ambience was pretty good. Great lighting, a bunch of televisions with games on, and decent music in the background. The wait was next to nothing (this was a Thursday night around 6:45). We were greeted right away and taken to a table, where our waitress came soon after and offered samples of beer. The appetizer came out in a timely fashion, however, it took a very long time for our waitress to come back and finally take our orders for entrees. Seeing as to how it wasn't packed this night, it was surprising that it took so long. We watched as other tables that came in after us got their meals before we had even ordered. In any instance, the food was good, and the beer was phenomenal (they make their food from scratch and brew their beer in house). Had the service been better, this would've been 5-stars easily.
Very relaxing very mellow very good time great food and great service. Would definitely frequent this place again
Great spot to get all you need! Beer is great and food was for also. Variety of beers on tap. Do it!

I was really excited about this place before we got to Philly because of the reviews. The wait was 30-45 minutes on a Friday night, it was my boyfriends birthday and we had just arrived in town. The server was okay, the two-three times he actually even showed up, if that many times at all. It took so long to get any sort of food in front of us, and then the cherry on top... nowhere on the menu did it say the Korean BBQ Wings were spicy, nowhere. We were also not warned. It was so inedible, 

I had two wings (in tears) and left the rest. Burger was sub bar, nothing special but cooked great and the sauce for the calamari was good. Mushroom soup also good. Just awful service. Awful.

I was here a few weeks ago and enjoyed a delicious burger and a beer! It has become my new go-to place in the city and the food and service are always great! 

I enjoyed the Sante Fe Turkey burger which was cooked to perfection and the Witberry signature beer on tap.

I went here for my birthday and I got a back facial believe it or not I was not impressed for the fact that they can't do certain things based off the company such as extracting pimples. Overall I did end up getting a massage as well and the lady at the front desk really sold but I got a deep pressure one however it was way too deep and my back ended up hurting at the end of the session I am really not impressed with this place nor the Massage Envy franchise. But they don't tell you that even though you get a 60 Minute massage that ends up being more like a 50 minute because they take 10 minutes away I just don't like all the scams.

Was downtown Tampa looking for breakfast. When I arrived at Yolk, Whites and Associates it was not what I expected. I read the reviews so decided to give it a try. And was I pleasantly surprised. I order the Cajun Frieda and Grits. It was excellent!!  Fresh and tasty!  Don't let the little cart fool you. Dylan knows what he is doing.  Not to mention my meal was only $6.

Went here for a drink with a friend tonight because I'm staying at the Marriott downtown. The hightop tables on the bar side are seat yourself so we went there. The waitress came over to us almost immediately. I ordered the white wit. It was good and light. I had already eaten dinner so I didn't order any food. My friend ordered the chicken sliders and she said they were really good. 
Very convenient location with tons of seats inside. I will definitely come back.

Jerk Hut is a Tampa institution, and this newish location is perfect for COVID. There's only a take out window, so no waiting inside. The food is every bit as good as the original. The patties are always amazing as is everything else on the menu. Service is efficient.

Look no further during the week- this is your weekday morning breakfast spot once you try it once. The owner is exceptionally personable and can customise each entree if needed. 
The frittata are well seasoned and veggies well cooked. The omelette was also well seasoned. Didn't try the coffee but maybe on  one of my many return trips!!

Came here for some apps and drinks and we were not disappointed! I got the fish tacos which were delicious with some sweet potato fries which were also very good. The margaritas are so tasty and the service was great! Our server was so pleasant and he was so helpful. We sat outside and the atmosphere was great. I would definitely return when I come back into philly

Had a great meal here, even if you're not a beer person, you should go. Lots of choices, try the Philly cheese steak appetizers. This restaurant was  recommended by the waitress at another place as it is her favorite. I can see why!
Food excellent, margarita pizza perfect! Bacon Gouda burger awesome, French fries perfection. Ordered lemonade vodka drink-horrible!! Can't taste vodka, sooo sweet. Otherwise food superb.

This is my first time trying this iron hill location, but have been to one in New Jersey a few times and have always enjoyed the food. Everything here was great! The Rhode Island calamari is really good and I'd highly recommend trying it if you like calamari. The sauce that comes with it is so delicious that we asked for more to put on the burger. Burger and sweet potato fries were good too. There is also a decent beer menu here that usually has something for everyone.

I came in here after have 3 drinks (old fashion, Tom Colin's, and martini) the manager said I could not have beer.  I asked for GM information and she did not give it to me.  I spent 21 years in USMC and came to visit the city of our constitution.  Another manager just brought me the bill and said will not serve me.  This place not for me.  Said did not wanna serve me because said swear word when asking about refusing drinks.

Tried Iron Hill for the first time last weekend. My in-laws gave us a gift card for Valentine's Day so we gave it a try! We did the Yelp Waitlist check-in, but were very disappointed to learn when we got there that they did not use it. If you aren't going to use it, disable it. Simple fix. It was annoying to start the evening off this way. We had to wait for about 15 minutes for a table for 2, there was about 5 couples ahead of us waiting. I'm not sure what was going on, but a server came up on two occasions to tell the hostess that he had 4 open tables. The hostess brushed off the server the first time and only took 1 couple to a table. Then the server came back a few minutes later and reminded her that they had 3 more open tables and she said something (couldn't hear it) and then finally sat couples at the open tables. 

So we got to our table and our waitress came over quickly and brought us waters and took our drink order. I had the Little Red Wagon sour beer and my husband had the Pennycracker Pils. She also brought us a complimentary flight of some of their popular beers, which was awesome! 

I was going back and forth between ordering the fish and chips or the Mac and cheese. I ultimately went with the Mac and cheese and had chicken added. My husband ordered the meat trio pizza. Our food came out pretty quickly! Upon initial inspection, I was a nervous. I thought my husband's pizza kind of looked like a red Barron frozen pizza. And I was a little unsure about my Mac and cheese because I could tell by the very specific red/orange color that they had put crushed up flaming hot Cheetos. Keep in mind, this is a sit down restaurant not a food hall or outdoor carnival, where that would be totally normal. But we were pleasantly surprised! My Mac and cheese was really good! It was creamy, but not heavy! They used a good balance of cheeses, none that were over powering so it was really balanced! The flaming hot Cheeto crust didn't do a whole lot for me, I could barely taste it.  
My husband's pizza was also really good! It had a lot of toppings and was crispy! It was the perfect size as well! Not too big, but enough to fill you up. 

Our waitress was super attentive, and nice! She made sure to check on us and was informative regarding the menu! We had a great experience minus the check in and seating issue. This probably won't be a regular dinner spot for us, but we will definitely be back!

Went here for the first time on a work lunch as a large party. The restaurant was very accommodating and helpful and the food was delicious. I would absolutely come here again and it seems like a great place for any occasion.

The service was absolutely fantastic.  We had a big party that was split between a few tables and they accommodated us really well.  
I was really surprised by the inconsistency of the food.  Some dishes were over salted while others were under seasoned. The presentation was great, but the flavor left something to be desired.  
The bar was a little slow to get drinks out but they may have been understaffed. The cocktails and beer pours were on point.

Love this place, best breakfast ever.

I could eat it every morning.

Have to try the Cajun frittata.

The grits amazing. Even if you don't like them, you'll love these.
Love this place!! Zeck was the sweetest! Thank you so much! We will definitely come back just because he is so awesome!!!

That women in there is the rudest, most obnoxious person you'll ever encounter. I've been going there for years. A couple of shirts a month. A year or so ago, one shirt came back with the print removed in most places. I went back to complain, they said it was my fault - that the shirt was old - "this just happen". OK - fair enough - the shirt was a few years old - I let it go. Today, I returned with a shirt that they'd cleaned - was nice about it, explained that it came back with a small stain on it and wanted a re-do - woman YELLED at me, said that another store had done it (I never go anywhere else) - that it was there before - that I didn't know what I was talking about, they do hundreds of shirts a week and now I come in here blaming them - all the time YELLING - at a CUSTOMER!! 

In the end, I just grabbed the shirt and said forget it - I'll be going elsewhere in the future. 

Even when you're not complaining, these people are nasty to customers. I advise EVERYONE to go somewhere else.

My husband and I booked Paradiso for our small wedding last month. It would be an understatement for us to say they did a great job. Lynn and her team exceeded our expectations.  They were wonderful from the start to the very finish of the evening. Lynn gave us five different menu options varying by price, which is excellent for those who are on a budget to those looking to over indulge. 

For the group of 30 guests we had two servers, Frank and Tony. They both deserve a round of applause. They did a fantastic job at the bar and the tables. They were professional, attentive, friendly and responsive to every guest.  They helped move the evening along in a smooth manner.
 
We started with a cocktail hour, which we selected four passed hors d'oeuvres. These were all outstanding! (Scallops wrapped in speck, arancini balls, pulled pork sliders and spinach & ricotta crostini) Our group moved to the tables after the first dance for bruschetta served for the table.  The first course was a baby spinach and pear salad topped with pancetta and shaved parmesan. The dressing was an apple cider vinaigrette... it was light, fresh and the perfect portion.  For our second course we selected farfalle with jumbo lump in a light tomato sauce.  The pasta was cooked to perfection along with the crab and sauce. Our first generation Italian family members commented on the quality as well! For the entrees we selected three and let our guests choose. We had a choice of beef, chicken and fish all served with mashed potatoes and spinach. Every entrée was outstanding and the portion size was massive! The rib-eye was massive and cooked exactly to the guest's instruction, chicken was juicy and the fish was tender. We opted out of the dessert as we were also serving wedding cake. Lynn was very accommodating and deducted this from our bill. 

To get this kind of a meal for a dinner, let alone a wedding dinner was outstanding! Every guest was blown away by the fantastic quality of the food and service! This is an exceptional restaurant and I would highly recommend making a reservation here. 

Good details to know: Paradiso has a large private dining area upstairs. This space would definitely hold around 100 people plus it is equipped with a bar and bathrooms.  Parking was available through valet service next door and we were able to add onto our bill. Did I mention it was only $8 a car!

My first visit in Philidelphia and visiting this place is a must! This business has been around for close to a 100 years, family-owned. I have to take a taste of Philidelphia history!

I ordered a reuben with marbled bread. Delicious! Generous helpings of meat and sauerkraut with just the right amount of mustard. I don't frequent delis very much in California but this place gives me some sort of meter to go by.

During a recent excursion to Chinatown, we found this place on yelp. As vegetarians, it looked pretty promising. And, my partner remembered going here over 10 yrs. ago when living in Philly. The concept of this place is really great. And we love how they serve brown rice. But, we think it could be done better. The lunch menu was reasonably priced, with interesting looking options. But, must say that it is weird that everything is referred to in meat terms, but none of it is meat. There just isn't a reason to call menu items at a VEGETARIAN restaurant "chicken," "beef" etc. And, a lot of it is just fried bean curd/tofu, which isn't very creative, and honestly isn't much better for you than meat (but I guess it depends on why one is a vegetarian). So, it sufficed for a cheap, non-meat meal. But, I can't say we'd hurry to go back.

The food is decent and fairly priced, but honestly, I prefer New Harmony. I once came here for an event and ended up getting really awful service. Our party was basically rushed out by the owner, who got into an intense verbal altercation with members of our party. I realize this was just one negative experience, but it prevented me from even going back.

This unassuming Chinese restaurant in the Foothills is definitely worth a stop if you're up in the area. I especially recommend the Two Flavor Shrimp and the Sweet and Sour Chicken. Friendly service rounds out the visit. The big negative is its atmosphere... it's drab and a bit gloomy. The cooking makes all the difference, though.

Just found my Tucson hairdresser -- Andrea at 4th Avenue Hair.  We live on the road for 6 months of the year which makes getting my monthly  cut and color very challenging -  sometimes I feel its a dice roll. This time I rolled a 6!  If they let me give this a 6 star rating I would. 
1)  She matched the color beautifully
2)  She does the best shampoo job ever - I felt like I had booked a massage 
3)  She was meticulous  with every strand of hair - wether it was foil or scissors. 
4) She strategically did the highlights or low lights in a way that could let me go longer in between visits (which is great when you live on the road) 
5) She has  amazing honest down to earth values.  I learned about her many other talents besides hair.  Ask her about her art!  Ask her what she does when she's not doing hair!  You'll be impressed. 
6) TRUST!  A hair dresser is a special relationship of trust -  (I've had two hairdressers in my life and each has lasted more than 10 years).  That's not a luxury you get when you live on the road and  drop into a city -  but after ONE visit,  Andrea gained my trust.  

 Next time I'm in Tucson- I know where I'm getting my hair done! 

Note:  Don't squeeze in an appointment with Andrea -  Give yourself time without booking something immediately after.   She takes her time and it was the longest hair appointment I've had-   -- enjoy the time to yourself and the feel of someone playing with your hair.   LUXURY!

Just came in this afternoon with my thirsty kids in the 90 degree weather to buy a bottled ice tea for myself and get three cups of ice for the kids and I. I went through the relatively short line at the cashier, paid for my bottled ice tea and had to wait more than 10 minutes just to get some ice. The manager/employee, who is the only person making the drinks at the store at the time, was super rude to me and deliberately made me to stand there and wait for my three cups of ice for a while. He won't simply give me the ice. I felt I was treated badly after having already been in line and paid for my drink. I did not expect to wait in line just for some ice. This operation is poorly run and I will not return to pay to get harassed again.

The Korean BBQ is mediocre and tasteless. The marinated beef dishes do not taste like Korean Beef at all so I don't know why they call it Korean BBQ. Fraud alert! The service is alright, nothing fancy. The server at the end confronted us about the tips we left ($15 for $100 bill). So rude. Never come back to this place.

Singapore is my top pick for good, basic, affordable Chinese vegetarian.  They have a wide selection of mock meat and all-veggie dishes, with a variety of sauces and flavors.  More importantly, they don't fall victim to the "fry-everything-in-a-puff" mentality of too many other Chinese vegetarian restauarants.  Though if you're into that, you'll find plenty of fried dishes there, too.  I've been going here for years and will probably be back again soon.

T.A.L.E.N.T.E.D. Andrea is a miracle worker, and as nice as can be! She took me in (and saved me from the ravages of grey roots!) at the last minute on a Saturday evening as a new client. What an angel! Kismet! Destiny! Serendipity! I picked from the Yelp app, and so happy I did make that call! I have a hairdresser now! 
She understands the best part of getting your hair done is the shampooing. I could have gone to sleep, happy until morning. 
I left (by my choice) with wet hair, and with her magical mouse and touch, my hair looked more styled than all the blow drying and straight ironing have ever done I will gladly make the 150 mile round trip to see her! 
Such a fun person to talk with too! Thank you, Andrea, if you read this! Thank you!

It's pretty good. Their dumpling game is on point! The only issue is that they get my order wrong sometimes which kinda sucks especially when placing a big order. If your going for lunch then you have the right idea. It's also a little pricy for your lack luster brand of Lo Mien. The lunch deals are where it's at. I'll definitely order if in the mood but wouldn't drive across town for it. I'd say 4/5 is a fair rating.

we've been members of shs for 7 years.  the rabbi is smart, compassionate, and available to members for support and guidance.  i have found the playschool and religious school communities to be very active and full of interesting families.  i recommend you check it out!
If i could get thousand island dressing on my burger I would come here even more often.

This is one of those places that are SO good and so comfortable and SO HEALTHY that I almost don't want to let anyone else know about it so I never lose my seemingly always available friday/saturday night table. Extremely sweet and generous staff serving vegan/vegetarian fare that's made the right way (no processed garbage). Awesome!

I've been here three times now, and the food is both consistent and delicious. They have a pretty good deal for lunch, two courses for $15. The portions are on the smaller side, and the prices are slightly more expensive a la carte, but well worth it.

Enjoyed both the camarones ceviche (Shrimp, avocado, tomato) and the carnitas tacos (pulled pork, black bean, pineapple). Nice place for lunch or dinner in University City.

Do yourself a favor and download the app and place a mobile order! It seems like they will make everything that's ordered online before those who order in the store. This will save you 15+ min of waiting at all times throughout the day.

A 30 minute wait for a cold brew drink. I even ordered online!! I complained to the barista and he didn't apologize, just said, "Even the best have bad days." That's not an appropriate customer service response. There were 5-6 people working behind the counter, so it's not clear why things were moving so slowly.

I was visiting Philadelphia for a conference at the end of March and I ordered take out from here. I ordered General Tso's Chicken and stuffed tofu pockets that were supposed to be fried. I don't think that's what I received. I don't even know what I got but they looked like friend dough balls stuffed with chicken (that chicken was so convincing that I went back to the website to make sure the place was totally vegetarian). All the food was very, very greasy, beyond what I find acceptable for fast take-out type food. In each bite the taste of grease was overwhelming. I felt pretty awful after eating this food and I ate it because I was STARVING from walking all over the city Gallery hopping.

Very disappointing!  Ordered take out cashew chicken and egg rolls (basic staple items on a Chinese food menu right?) and the food was not only NOT good but we ended up throwing it away (first time ever done that!) 

Egg rolls were mushy and tasted fishy and cashew chicken was bland, tasteless and also had a squashy texture to it. 

Although employees were friendly, it's best to skip this place!

I am absolutely in love with the dim sum platter for two or more. For just ten dollars per person you can feast on a huge plate of several amazingly delicious items (typically two of each per person with the ubiquitous pile of peanut noodles). I can't wait to go back just thinking about it! If you are ever taking out both Vegan AND Kosher friends/relatives (and I have a few of both) this is just the right place!
Consistently good. Favorite is the General Tso's Chicken. Hot, fresh, very tasty. Hot and sour soup is the best I've had, and I'm very particular. Overall an excellent choice.

I checked this out after looking for a Chinese veg place on here.  I agree about the whole fake meat thing, but since having some amazing veggie sausage in the U.K.  I've been trying some things here and there.

I had to do a double take to the menu because it looks like a carnivorous one.  It was as another review noted, off putting.  But I found myself debating between two lunch specials, General Tso's chicken and Lions - something or other. 

If you get there before 3, for $7.50 (as of 5/10/08) you get a choice of soup to start and a small lunch mains plus extras.  I chose the miso soup which was thick with seaweed, tofu, and string cut veggies.  It was really good.

I ordered the  Lions - something with brown rice and was not dissapointed.  It came with fresh veggies, spring roll, curry dumpling and Lions - something that was a mushroom in tofu skin and spicy bean curd.  The dish was well portioned, veggies really were fresh, the spring roll was tasty, and they rice seemed to have been cooked that day.  Everything on the plate was tasty, except the sauce drizzled on the dumpling. 

I will be back to try some of their other dishes.

My favorite Chinese place in the city. Their dinner special is awesome and well-priced: new years soup, 3 appetizers, and general tsao's- all for $12 it's perfect! The service is great. My only caveat is it's much better to eat in the restaurant than order in, but I guess that's true of any Chinese place. Enjoy!

I came here for a group birthday party.  It was a great set up for shareable food.  A lazy suzan was in the middle of the table to rotate the foods.  The place is also BYOB which worked out well for the occasion.  

I felt bad because we had a large table of people, and they sat 3 different couples on dates around us, which must have been awful for them, as I know it was loud.  

Most of the people present were not vegetarians, so they had some issues with all of the fake meats.  The General Tsao Chicken tasted and was textured like sweet meatballs.  Which is fine, if that's what you want, but I would advise meat eaters not to get anything they have a pre-determined notion of taste for.  I got the Pineapple chicken, and it was delicious.

The best deal is the $12.50 3 course dinner.  You get a soup, an appetizer plate of a dumpling, fried wonton, and spring roll, and an entree.  It was a lot of food for the price as well.

I would definitely go back to this place, and I would recommend it to vegetarians and meat eaters alike.  The food was decent and I had a good time.  I wasn't knocked off my feet or amazed, but it was satisfying.

Steven (with the English accent) gave my family and I the BEST customer service I've ever had at Sonic. Multiple times we asked him for certain things and he ran back and forth, never made us feel like we we bothering him. Steven is a great example of how customer service should be. I felt bad not having more cash to tip him and he replied "it's ok I'm just glad I could help you"
Sonic is so lucky to have you Steven, I hope you will be there in our next visit!

Considering how close I live to this restaurant, this was really disappointing. While the lunch specials are reasonably priced they are very mediocre for what you get. The Chicken Teriyaki was not bad but the Almond and Cashew Chicken was not good at all. As I only had take-out here I can't really comment on the service however it seems that the staff are quite indifferent and seem to do everything in a rush.

I would much rather drive 5+ miles to eat at a much better Chinese restaurant.

The staff are all friendly and you can tell they all sincerely care for animals. I enjoy saying hello to the cats ( and wishing I could take one home!) Every time I go. The have the grain free brand of dog food I get at the best price. PLUS If you're a member your 10th bag is free. Just make sure that if you usually buy large bags, to always buy large bags and never a small one or else the company can only offer a free small one. Just a heads up, everything else is great!

C'mon people, it's a truck that drives around, ringing a bell, that sells fresh pizza and water ice!!  What could be better??

Yes, it's "carnival" style pizza, it is anything but gourmet, and that's how it should be!

IT'S CASH ONLY and Im sure that upsets some of the DOUCHEBAG posters on Fishtown.us and nothing could make me happier!
Good vegetarian Chinese food where the focus is on faux meat.  They make an amazing realistic duck.  Only 3 stars because a vegetarian joint should have more crisp vegetables.

Yay!!! I absoultly love my new hair cut!! Andrea has been cutting my hair for many many years!! Always does an outstanding job. She's the only one I trust to actually do my hair! I'd recommend her 100%

This is one of my favorite restaurants in the city, I ride my bike across town about once per week to get lunch here. I swear that the shark fin soup is medicinal. If I eat it when I feel the start of being sick, I wake up the next day feeling great. I recommend going during their lunch special M,W,R,F (I think they are closed Tuesdays and don't offer the special on weekends) because you get ALOT of great food for ~$8. I have liked everything that I have tried so far, but the Golden Lion's head and the shark fin soup are my favorites. 

Although the inside of the restaurant is dated and might be hard for some people to get past, the food and the family-owned and operated feel makes one easilty forget the embience. The owner is a friendly man who is always coming in and out of the restaurant, and happy to talk about vegeterianism or advise you on what to order; and his sister is the waitress.
Awesome food and can't wait to go back to try out the dim sum sampler!

A little light on the vegan options, but I still got a custom-made veggie sandwich on wheat AND a large La Colombe coffee for $5 -- a bit less than Subway charges for a footlong and a Diet Coke. Also, it's definitely worth noting that ALL of the ingredients here are visibly fresh; none of that wilted lettuce crap you get at a number of other places. I'll definitely be back when I'm in need of cheap eats and good coffee!
Good burgers, creative small plates, and a healthy variety of local beers. Definitely worth the trip up!

The food here is really good!  The yam "whole fish" is unique and delicious.  I had a birthday party here with my family (8 people total) and we came for an early dinner on a Saturday (around 6pm).  There was only one other party of 4 there, and the service was very good.  All the food we had was very delicious.  Vegans just watch out for some menu items that seem to have honey.  I didn't verify if they truly use honey, but to be safe, I would just avoid those few menu items.

I am a meat eater but sometimes I enjoy the pleasures of tofu and veggies.  We've eaten our way around Chinatown and there have been a few places I've gotten some questionable meat... after that happens I always want to come here and eat something yummy like the fake chicken generals tso's and not worry about chewing into something I don't like.  Good prices and service and great food.
Awesome.  Friendly service and delicious food.  Try the Malaysian Chicken with noodles. Awesome.

This Starbucks location is just okay. I prefer the one on walnut and 34th much more. This Starbucks location definitely is one of the busiest in the area but I feel that they're always a bit under staffed. Baristas are always struggling to fulfill the online orders.

I always get a tall americano but I know that they almost always just pour dripped coffee which is not what I ordered. 

Though, I am impressed with their selection other than coffee which include variety of dessert items, sandwiches, mugs etc. Cake pops cures all.

I'll probably come back to this location just because it's convenient for me but doesn't mean that I'm happy about it. Meh
When the closest fast food type restaurants to you are McDonalds, Burger King, Pizza Hut, and Subway, you're grateful for being able to split an order of sesame chicken for 10 bucks, to-go.
