I had a grilled chicken sandwich from Bain's for the second time today and I think it's safe to declare this place one of my favorite spots to get a sandwich. I love grilled chicken sandwiches and the biggest selling point of this place is the fact that they use real chicken breast and not the processed chicken that you get at places like Subway. 

I had a grilled chicken sandwich on marble bread. They are very generous with the portions of chicken, which I think it great. They have a variety of deli meats to choose from, as well as various soups. One of these days, I'll probably try a different sandwich, but for right now, when I'm in the mood for a grilled chicken sandwich, I'm going to Bain's.
I love Bain's on Broad St. It's very clean, the staff is friendly and pleasant, and the sandwiches are fresh. I pick up lunch here at least once a week.

Somewhere between a local petshop and and the big box stores.  The prices are about the same as Petco and Petsmart, I shop here mostly for convenience as it close to work and an easy in/out.  Employee assistance is 50/50, have had good and "meh" experiences here...

I'm not a vegetarian but I eat loads of vegetarian food because that's just how I roll.  

I got some takeout general tso chicken and it was really yummy.  It's not super greasy tasting like other fake meat vegetarian Chinese places around.  My favorite such place in Chinatown.  

I agree with another reviewer that why eat fake meat if you are vegetarian, but some people seem to like it.

Anyone who knows me  (or can read my profile) is well aware I am all about the dessert. So Sonic, prepare to be reviewed.
   I happen to love your shakes! There us nothing like a chocolate cream pie shake with extra, extra, extra, extra, you get the point, extra gram cracker crumbs! The reason your shakes are aboive the bar is there are so many different combinations. While McDonalds and Dairy Queen have better soft serve, you take the cake ( or the shake) when it comes to choices! I love the styrofrome cups so my hands dont get to cold, and i love that I can put practically anything into my ice cream. Plus, nothing better than msome onion rings, chili cheese tots, and motz sticks to inhale while enjoying my dessert. I would give 5 stars, but the service....SLOW. I will keep coming to you when i need a late night craving fix.

Every single time I come here, I'm blown away.  Last visit was a light dinner - just the bacon wrapped dates and a cocktail at the bar.  Un-frickin-believable.  Can't even put into coherent words how good the dates were.  If you even Remotely like dates, do yourself a favor and come here.  Plus, the decor and atmosphere feel like an escape.   *****

Best pizza in the neighborhood. 

I've only ordered their pizza, and every time it's awesome. Great thin crust with just the right amount of sauce and cheese. 
I always get the big 24" pie for like $15, you can't beat it.

Three stars is reasonable. Their food is at best okay. Why? It's not, in my opinion, anything close to what I consider Chinese. The owner/some employees seem (but I'm no expert) to be Vietnamese. No problem with that but it kind of shows in the taste of the food. Also, I that may explain why there is Vietnamese spring rolls and Pad That (a Thai dish) --- in a Chinese place?? I have enjoyed dishes in Shanghai and Beijing as well as in Hong Kong so I may be quite critical - sorry.

I guess one can enjoy the food but it's just not fitting the flavor profile I am used to eating.
Very tasty! I wish I had a better memory for names on menus. But I concur with most previous reviewers on the best dishes. They're very nice there and recognized me on my second visit.

The Route 44 lemon berry slush always has chunks in it that get caught in the straw. I constantly get shorted on M&M and Reese's in my Blasts. Dairy Queen may be a bit more expensive but they know how to make a Blizzard! I tried one last time after a few months of disappointment and when they were out of Reese's they promised to give me extra M&Ms at no extra cost...what they gave me was a chopped up handful of M&Ms in my large shake! That's it, the only reason they didn't get a one star rating is because the workers were always very nice and friendly.

We ordered delivery it was gonna take like 45 mins it was really fast we ordered hot n sour soup yum broth was spicy n fresh yes had the eggroll good veggies not crisp but good flavor mongolian beef was very tasty enjoyed our meal sweet n sour chicken good too I will go here again

To go order was correct, piping hot, quality was excellent. Very consistent, good quality every time we order. Today we had Chicken/Broccoli, Kung Pao Chicken, Pork Fried Rice with extra egg and several appetizers. They have handled any past minor problems quickly and professionally.

I have been there several times and cannot recommend the food. Most recently we ordered Singapore noodles which were dried out, flavorless and lacking essential ingredients that define the dish. On a Monday night when the restaurant was empty, we waited 50 minutes for a small order. Please see "tips" for my comments on their summer rolls! The vegetables in our order of Beef Chop suey were scant and very overcooked. Overall the food was pretty poor even if their fish tank is nice!

I was SO happy when they opened this Starbucks! It's practically right downstairs from where I get monthly treatments! They are usually pretty busy since its surround by hospitals so all day long you'll see doctors and nurses standing in line, but I order through the mobile app and by the time I walk down to the Starbucks they almost always have my order ready and waiting! The staff is great; friendly, quick, efficient! This is by far my favorite Starbucks location!!!

Andrea is AMAZING!!! I have been going to her to get my hair done for the past 8 years. She is the only person i will ever let color or style my hair. I have lived in Phx, az for the past 7 years and i wil drive down there just to have her do my hair.

I don't know what people expect when they hear the words VEGETARIAN. It's quite obvious its Faux and its no matter how well its seasoned its not going to taste IDENTICAL to real meat. once you're prepared for that you'll be OK. 

I like Singapore. I am one of the few people who enjoy the taste of wheat gluten, so for me this place rocks! I usually order the General Tso's Chicken, or the Chicken LoMein, but am interested in trying some of the other items. 

I went there the other day and bought the General's Chicken Lunch Special, and my only complaint was the portion size. They do give you a dumpling, soup, a spring roll and a fried dumpling though. The fried dumpling thing was filled with some sort of curry concoction that was delicious! 

It also came with soup that smelled like Tea so I didnt eat it. I gave it to a co-worker who said it was quite salty (yet he polished it off).

I hear people compare this to the Kingdom of vegetarians which i have yet to experience, but will be going there shortly. 

Singapore even has an upper floor with a Karaoke machine if you have a large group!

This mock-meat vegetarian chinese (is kosher, too) has take-out, delivery ($20 minimum) and friendly services.  That's a the good part.
Also the pineapple"chicken" is one of my little girl's faves.

The appetizers are a grease-fest.  The stuffed eggplant with inedible.
The spring-rolls were only fair (might be better to have these dine-in.) BUT the leek dumplings were delectable.

Hot & Sour soup was nice and spicy - but had a strange "ketchup-y" sweet note to it that I did not care for.

We will come here when our daughter demands it, but for now we shall stick to Square on Square for the BEST hot & sour around.

As a meat-eater, I really enjoyed this place with my vegetarian and kosher friends. Definitely order at least two plates of General Tso's "chicken" if you go with a group of four or more because they went like hotcakes for us!  The food was really good and I highly suggest people getting different plates and sharing it family style.  Also, the manager is reaaally funny and nice so you will have good service!

EDIT: Visit #3 - I think I got food poisoning or food poisoning from eating so much :(
EDIT #2:  definitely food poisoning :( one star for fast service, another for having a couple good times there, minus this one.

I used to be a fan of Donut Wheel.  A HUGE fan of their "Buttermilk" and "Old Fashioned" donuts.  I just got back from my fifth trip to this location over the past few months to buy a Buttermilk or Old Fashioned donut for breakfast, and for the fifth time in a row they were out of both!  Even the cashiers admit the guy who makes the donuts here is lazy, and even though the Buttermilk donut is on the menu, he only makes them a few times a month?!?  This place has great donuts but a lazy baker.  If you're going for a particular favorite, don't get your hopes up or call ahead to make sure you're not wasting gas (although calling ahead isn't even reliable here!).  The last time I called ahead, they claimed they had Buttermilk or would have a new batch by 10am, but when I drove a couple miles and showed up at 10:15, they said they never made them!!  This Donut Wheel location is losing my business, and I'll be giving more business to Le Caves Bakery instead.  At least they ALWAYS have their two favorite donuts in stock (The Bismark and the Vegetable Glazed).

the insides of this place are just sad looking. it's like those restaurants that gordan ramsey or the likes would go into and revamp because it used to be good but then somehow got stuck in the 80s and never invested any of their profit into the decor. i am no snob  either. i like a good hole in the wall place, as long as the food is incredible...which this place just isn't.

 we came here for lunch and their lunch menu was disappointing. what was especially weird was the ravioli-like dumpling? with what tasted like the filling for a samosa. it was just not good. i ordered the Golden Lion's Head which i didn't know exactly what that was. so somewhere else on the menu they described it as this: "made from golden mushrooms, tofu, five spice bean curd and tofu skin, water chestnuts with fresh veggies, and served with peking ginger sauce, spicy". sounds good right?? well, when i got the plate this "golden lion's head" was two small hockey-puck fried things hard as anything (i had to pick them up in my hands and bite into them) and only tasted like the frier. there was nothing mushroomy, spicy or otherwise tasty in this thing. i still don't understand what i actually had. and our server was unhelpful. it was like she'd just woken up. 

i'm sorry to say, as this place used to be good back in the day, but it is a sorry sad run-down place now and i would never recommend anyone go there.

Aside from being more expensive, this is a great Chinese takeout place. Taste wise, it's a lot better than a lot of other Chinese take-out. This goes for customer service as well. they do take special requests. As protocol, I always avoid beef and broccoli. Their lo mein dishes are pretty decent; not bad but not exceptional. Their rice is often hard so at this point I just tell them every time to hold it. And the soy sauce isn't all too great. Their takeout soups consist of way too much broth.  The foods that are delicious here: egg foo yong, most of the tofu and vegetable dishes, spring rolls, sweet and sour chicken, and the sliced chicken breasts.

I'll continue to eat here because of the good customer service and the foods that are great for takeout.

An affordable treasure in the heart of Philadelphia.  I ate here with six or seven colleagues; the large group was treated like family and speedily, at that.  The food was amazing for the price: lunch specials included the main dish, egg roll, dumplings, and choice of soup.  I'll definitely be back!  Only complaint is that the menus were a bit grimy and frayed...

The best pizza in Fishtown due to the thin crust and proper understanding of the cheese to sauce ratio. I tracked it down after hearing the loud bell that blares from the top of the truck.. Finally caught it on Berks. I felt like I hunted a pizza. 

Chase the truck. It's fun and worth it.

The place is a bit of a let down considering the people that own it also own the awesome Grey Lodge. I like their beer selection, but that's about all. The inside is very outdated, and the food really is mediocre. It's a nice place to stop in for a quick beer, late at night, but not much more.
Walked in, walked around, walked out. The employees seemed great but the prices were higher than Petco and the selection not as good for what I need.

I LOVE ANDREA @ 4th AVENUE HAIR!!! I honestly can't say enough good things about her. I've been getting my hair done by her on and off for about 4 years but over the past year I have been going to her every 7 to 8 weeks consistently. I get full highlights and a cut and I don't think anyone in Tucson can do highlights as good as Andrea, especially at such a great price. And it is a refreshing bonus to sit and chat for a couple hours with someone who is so down to earth and just 'real'. Their location has moved and is actually right off of 4th Avenue on 2nd Street I think? It's basically still 4th Ave though, across the street from that pink church. Honestly if you want quality color and cut service Andrea is who you need to see. I've been to a lot of different hair dressers in my life time and she is by far the best. Call her cell to make appointments: (520)444-6317

Geez Louise can we eat in peace?! 

Stars for our fave dish is the sizzling rice soup...but they need to make up their minds whether they want beef chicken or all...some days we get one or the other or all 3. C'mon now, we don't like surprises.

We can't stand dining in!!! Always feeling rushed to finish our food. Tonight was probably the worst...getting interrupted every 5 min to try to take our half eaten plates and bowls away. In fact, I was still eating my soup and she literally put her hand under the bowl ready to take it. I had to tell her TWICE "I'm still eating." WTF!!! I think we ate the fastest in record time 12 minutes because she wouldn't stop coming to our table and asking us if we want this or that to-go!! Ugh we might as well have packed it up the minute we received it. 

Customer service: Super rude, they don't smile, sometimes can't understand them!

Tip: Just do take out to avoid them ruining your appetite or just drive 5 more miles down for better Chinese food. 

Damnit Foothills and the lack of good food up here!

I'm a big fan of vegetarian Chinese restaurants.  As a vegetarian, having a full menu to choose from can be simultaneously liberating and overwhelming.  The fried, fake meat offerings feel like a guilty pleasure.

It seems like Philly's Chinatown has a number of vegetarian Chinese offerings that are indistinguishable for each other.  Singapore Chinese Vegetarian Restaurant is one of these.

What, if anything, sets it apart?

As other reviewers have noted, the "New Year" soup is pretty darn good.  The crunchy, fried "noodles" served at the beginning of the meal are a plus.  Also, the dinner specials are a great deal and a good way to make ordering less overwhelming for vegetarians unaccustomed to having a full menu of choices.

In my opinion, it is not the best veggie Chinese restaurant in the area but you certainly won't go wrong with the place.

I like this place a lot and try to visit whenever I'm in Philly.  If you are a vegetarian, be prepared to spend some time going through the menu--it is quite expansive, and a totally different experience than looking for the small vegetarian section at a typical Chinese restaurant.  If you eat meat, don't worry:  the meat eaters I've eaten with here have been consistently satisfied.  The owner is gracious and the staff attentive.  The prices aren't bad, either.  The only thing I don't like about this place is the decor, which is a little too, uh....pastel.  But that won't stop me from coming back.

Golden Dragon is a reliable option for my son and I when I don't feel like cooking. I've never done delivery since it's so close to my house, but I've never been disappointed.  Don't get me wrong - Golden Dragon is not going to knock your socks off if you're expecting some kind of nouveau Chinese cuisine.  This is your standard, Americanized Chinese food - you get white rice with every dish and a fortune cookie.  My son and I prefer their House Fried Rice, which seems to last for days in our refrigerator even though we have it for breakfast and lunch the following day.  We also like the Mongolian Beef.  

The Sunrise location seems to always stay busy but they work their tails off to deliver good customer service.  Pro-tip: their website always has coupons that will give you some kind of discount.  In the past, I've printed those coupons out, but they've even accepted the coupon if I just have it up on my phone.

Another addition to the list of top-notch Spanish tapas places!

[ decor and vibe ]
Upstairs is nice and buzz-y, downstairs has adorable romantic couches and candles. Great place for a date or a real conversation with friends. Very classy.

[ food ]
Oh dear lawd everything was so good. We ordered:

- manchego - served with honey, quince paste, apple slices, and bread.
- red and white sangrias - well done
- pulpo - phenomenal! Perfectly cooked with an amazing spicy tomato sauce. My friend, who doesn't even like octopus, said this was delicious.
- sea bass and cockles - perrrrrfectly done
- duck - I am vegetarian so I didn't try this but my friend seemed to enjoy it
- rice with mushrooms and raw quail egg - perfectly seasoned

You know that point where everyone at the table is silent because you're both enjoying the food too much? Yes.

[ service ]
Scott, our server, was the perfectly calibrated combination of warm, friendly, professional, and attentive without hovering. Also incredibly cute. Always a bonus :)

Each dish is brought over by a different server who gives a tantalizing description of the ingredients. Much fun.

[ overall ]
A perfect experience. Not cheap, but worth every dollar. Another fantastic tapas place!

This spot is conveniently located adjacent to the hospital and Perlman center, offering your standard Starbucks staples. Their cue is often short and if you're lucky, food may be disseminated minutes before closing time. The seating area is quaint, though not cozy like other neighboring Starbucks locations. Overall solid spot!

This is probably one of the worst Starbucks I've been to but it's conveniently located across the street from my work so I always find myself back here. Can't tell you how many times I've ordered through the app and the drink has been made wrong like ordering a hot drink and they made it iced and takes forever if you want to get it remade. Seems like a lot of the staff here are rude and always dragging their feet I definitely would not recommend waiting in line here, order before you come in. I agree with one of the previous reviews that says they water down drinks.. I always order my iced tea without water and every single time at this Starbucks they add water, they just don't care. Given this Starbucks so many chances but today I couldn't believe it they were supposed to open at 530am and were still closed on my way in to work at 645... and they did not open til 9am!! Just a lot of lazy work here honestly definitely won't be coming back here I'll make the extra effort to walk to another Starbucks. I feel bad even writing this review because I'm not the type of person to bash a business on yelp but something really just needs to change at this location I've had so many terrible experiences here and I don't think I'm the only one. I also would just like to remind the employees here you are working across the street from two major hospitals, so most of your customers are either workers at the hospital or family of patients. We often work long, difficult shifts and I know it seems silly but sometimes that coffee really is the only thing getting us through the day, and these families that come in to get a break from being in the hospital rooms 24.7 are likely having one of the most stressful times of their lives so would it kill you to show them a little kindness?? Please, Maybe just think about this before the next time you are rude to a customer and remember where you are working.

I simply love this place. I eat meat, yet I enjoy their General Tso's mock chicken dish more than any other real meat General Tso's i have every tried. Definitely a must whenever I find my self in chinatown

I've eaten here twice, both times amazing! The first time I ordered Singapore noodles for pick up. They said to pick up in 20 min and it was ready waiting for me. It traveled well and tasted delicious! The second time I dined in and got the lunch special with lo mein. Everything was very delicious. The staff was nice and the restaurant has a great look and ambience. So excited I found this place!

I always order my Chinese food from this restaurant and have done so for many years. They're quality and freshness is excellent. Their family run business is a delight to interact with and they make the effort to get to know you. One of my favorite things to do is plan a night in consisting of Chinese food and movies. I couldn't imagine enjoying those evenings without them. Great menu, reasonable prices and a recently renovated dining room. Love these guys!

Wonderful food. Very well designed menu. We were four each tried different type of dish. I tasted all the four. I usually find all the Thai dishes taste the same in other restaurants. But here it is different, each dish has its unique flavor. One of my colleague ordered duck curry. I never tried duck but loved it here. With lunch special we were given chicken and mushroom soup with veg spring roll which are pretty good. Very friendly staff and neat place. This will be one of my lunch stops from now.

Their food is tasty, the prices on par or a little lower than competitors, and the service is outstanding.

Taste is subjective, but I'll just say that so far I tried two Thai dishes, one Japanese dinner, three of their more basic sushi rolls, and one of their higher end hot seafood dishes(a tuna maduro dish). I thought the Thai dishes (pad see ewe and Thai fried rice) were great; my wife thought this was her second favorite, and my son thought it was his third. My wife and I agreed that the seafood dish I got was outstanding, And the Japanese dinner was also really good.

The portion sizes and prices on their hot foods were similar to what we find elsewhere, but if you like brown rice you'll save a dollar or two because they charge less to upgrade. It seems to me that their sushi roll prices are on the low side, so I'll look forward to taking advantage of that in the future.

Service is fantastic. They've been busy the three times I've been there, but their waiters work as a good attentive team, and the owner (or one of the owners) goes from table to table to see if you need drink refills, extra plates, or just to generally fill in whatever gaps there might be. And even the sushi chefs, when they're not busy creating their masterpieces, are nice and interactive. Overall, they make it seem like you're being invited into someone's home and do all they can to make you comfortable. We look forward to going back many times.
We have done take out from this restaurant on Sunrise and Swain. Food has always been great. Egg Foo Young is really amazing. Service has been great.

Have eaten at Zaccone's many a time, and we always have a nice meal!
I recommend the veal with crabmeat, and their desserts are all homemade and excellent!
The restaurant was recently renovated and expanded, and it is a BYOB-so remember to bring a bottle. It's cash only as well.
Service was good too.
I definitely recommend this place, a nice place to eat in the NE.

Roger (owner) and his staff take great care in their food and patrons. The food is amazing and super yummy!  Roger's wife makes great green curry!The sushi is great, the chefs are fun to talk with and the lunch specials are a great deal.

This was not good... I appreciate the delivery to our hotel, however this was bad.  The chicken with broccoli was watery and not in brown sauce.  The lo mien had very thick noodles that tasted weird.  They didn't even give us soy sauce with the delivery.  I get we are in Tucson and this is later night, however Phoenix has much better Chinese food.
Love the food here. Always coming for the amazing Thai food and sushi is always fresh. Such a friendly environment.

This is one of the best Asia restaurant on E Sunrise drive.
They service and the food is exceptional. Jenne the manager is exceptional at remembering her regular customers and their choices.

Their lunch hours are best to go try. I love their General T'sou Chicken and House Special Lo Mein.

Great service. Great environment. Great staff. Perfect to have a good food good mood experience.

Oh my goodness!!!! Rudest guy running the drive-thru.... Here's a tip LEVI (I only know his name because I asked) ... If you can't handle the customer service bizz (which BTW entails being nice to people who are paying customers and just looking for a nice, quick meal) THEN FIND A NEW CAREER PATH!!! A NEW JOB!!!! You seemed miserable and you treated me like I was an idiot! Also, the food was awful! Yuck we will never ever be back. See ya Sonic!

Convenient location but my order is always not made right. Espresso frappe looks just like milk blended with ice and looks so white. Chai latte that I ordered is not the same as other Starbucks. Taste like hot milk. They need to train their baristas coz their drinks are not pretty standard.

Great new addition to Carrolwood! Fresh vegetable rolls were delicious as was the duck noodle soup. Great surf and turf roll with crab and carpaccio. The Thai beef salad was had many  dimensions of flavor. My son said the wonton soup had delicious flavor as well.

I messed up and ordered 2 fresh spring rolls when we really wanted the fresh vegetable rolls (my fault). Our waiter was very kind and made everything right. 5-star service all the way.

The staff here waters down ALL drinks, even if you ask for no water (waters down coffee, hot drinks if they don't make enough to fill the cup, ALL teas so they don't have to keep making more, lemonade, etc.) If you catch them watering it down they give you so much attitude and end up wasting more product in the end since they're so often asked to remake the orders. Moreover, it's very rare that they're fully staffed or even friendly. This is honestly the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and would not continue to waste my time or money if I didn't work across the street.

Ah, the elusive pizza truck. Long have I heard about this legendary Fishtown truck.

Lo and behold, one evening, returning from the gym...like a bad joke...the Pizza Truck was open for business and stopped in front of my house.

Burning close to 400 calories on the ellipitcal must have been meant for this moment of pure joy and cheap pizza.

I will agree with previous reviewers...pizza truck may not have pizza that is any better than a frozen pizza, but still wonderful and good and a novelty nonetheless.

Good sushi and good service. 
 We got the Pan Fried Port Potstickers, Panang curry with beef, Lama Roll, Tornado Roll and Crunchy Salmon Roll
We got the 3 signature rolls for $30 and were very pleased by the selection and quality.  
The Tornado Roll was the best tasting, second best was the Crunchy Salmon, a distant third place was the Lama Roll (simply because it seems to have too much cream cheese that took away from taste of the  tuna and salmon) 
We also tried a thai dish, the Panany curry.  This was my least favorite this everning.  I thought the sauce seemed too thick, too much peanut butter taste, not enough sweet tasting.  I have a sweet tooth so my opinion here might not be shared by anyone else. 
Restaurant overall has a very nice quiet atmosphere, everything is new, seats are comfortable. The service is nice and prompt.
The "boss" if that's what you want to call her, was extremely rude and disgusting. I couldn't even enjoy my food when i saw her and spoke to her due to her lack of respect and her bad attitude.
I could not have said this better than David C's review.  Very disappointed.  I got two slices and only took three bites and had to throw the rest away.  My girlfriend felt the same.
Holy crap!! Everything that touched my mouth in this restaurant tastes like heaven. I'm usually a meat guy, but this place is AMAZING! I will definetly come back here again.

If you are a meat-eater like me, and you go into Singapore Chinese Restaurant, you may be slightly confused when you look at the menu.  To help you, here are a few points to remember:

1. Pork, chicken, duck, etc. are not actually made of meat here.  They are some sort of proteinacious substance made to look and (somewhat) taste like meat.

2. Fish (ie. salmon) is also NOT not vegetarian, so it isn't actually served here either.  When you see salmon on the menu, see above.  

3. Shrimp is also not vegetarian, so when the menu says shrimp, see above.  

Once you learn these rules, you'll do just fine.  Truly, the menu is ridiculously extensive.  One more rule of thumb for those of you that are avid meat-eaters..

4. Don't order anything that sounds like something you would order at a non-vegetarian restaurant.  The "meat", while remarkably good for not being actual meat, does not taste the same, and you might be disappointed.

Now that you've learned the rules, prepare to be amazed and impressed.  I kind of felt like I was at a magic show the whole time I was here.  Nothing is as it seems.  Sometimes you expect chicken and you get soy.  Other times you expect pork and you get tofu.  Sometimes you expect veggies and you get something that looks like meat (but isn't!).  All the rules you thought you had memorized about chinese food have been thrown out the window!  Seriously though, I didn't know that it was possible to make "meat" look, smell, feel, and taste this much like meat.  In all honesty, I don't really see the point in taking the trouble to do so, but  if for any reason you do, this is the place to try it.  

I came here with a vegetarian friend and proceeded to be amused and entertained by the menu and the food for the entire visit.  Because I got no further than the first page on the very extensive menu before being so perplexed that I had no idea what to order, we opted for the $10 a person dim sum menu.  For our money, we got a bowl of soup plus two plates full of other treats.  My favorite from a purely sociological standpoint was the chicken legs, made of not-chicken and a wooden skewer.  As for flavor, I was a big fan of the egg roll, the satay (with fried tofu), the dumplings, and the scallion pancake.  It even comes with a little plate of dessert (sesame ball, fortune cookie, and orange slice).  It was a TON of reasonably good food, and we had plenty to bring home.

So if you are a vegetarian that misses eating meat, or a meat-eater that is just intrigued by the idea of fake-meat, Singapore is definitely the place to go for cheap food and good service in a nice quiet restaurant.

This Starbucks is super slow, especially in the afternoon. I just waited 20 minutes to get a single frappachino, and several other times I've waited over 10 minutes. They often only have one barista working, which is not enough considering the number of customers they get. Their drinks are also expensive, like most Starbucks. Overall, I find that walking to Au Bon Pain and getting coffee there is quicker, despite the walk, and much cheaper than going to this Starbucks.

Something different and great! I ordered the turkey/gouda panini ; it was delicious.  Loved the fact the did it on cuban bread. Looks like a good sports bar with great food.  WILL be back if i'm in the area!

OhhhhMy!   This is my first time registering for Yelp, and I felt that I had to, just because I had such an amazing dining experience at Singapore Kosher....

I was back in town to hang out with my cousin and his friend (i live in Chicago now)... and I wanted to eat someplace in Chinatown.  I'm vegetarian (my cousin/friend are not)...  but I dragged them to this place and we all LOVED the food.

The $10 dim sum is spectacular.... I almost feel like going back tomorrow night for another round.... That is if I ever burn off all the food that I ate tonight, I am so stuffed.
Slowest Starbuck's I've ever been to. It takes 20 mins to get an iced coffee. I've taken to just getting a hot house coffee because I know they'll just grab it for me while I'm at the register. Ugh.

my co-worker suggested we order from golden dragon last night when our lunch options at work weren't the greatest.

it was a hard call between pizza and chinese.

i haven't had chinese food in a while, so i figured, what the heck.

i think delivery time took around 45 minutes. 

i ordered the lemon chicken. sauce came on the side as well as a container of white rice. the lemon chicken i'm used to is crispy. the batter they used for this chicken was kind of soggy, but that may have been because the container got moist while being delivered.

the taste of the food was pretty good.

i really liked their crab puffs, although there was a lot more cream cheese than there was crab. 

will probably order from here again, just not soon.
Ever since new management took over, this sonic sucks. The drinks are always inconsistent. They have more water and soda than flavor.

Back today, 2nd visit, for lunch with my wife. Consistency is on-point. Great conversation with the staff and my new friend, Roger. Thankful for the restaurant being close to home and quality food with affordable prices.

Slowest Starbuck's I've ever been to. It took 20 mins to get an iced coffee. Also might be the only Starbucks you can watch one person man the register while 3 people clean/stock and let the orders pile up.. 18 mins later you get your Americano. I've taken to just getting a hot house coffee because I know they'll just grab it for me while I'm at the register.

My wife and I moved back to Philadelphia two years ago after 16 years in Washington, DC.  There we had a favorite local pizza place that we frequented for 16 years.  Our family developed a tradition of ordering pizza on Friday nights.  Since moving to Philadelphia, we have been searching for a really good pizza.

We still have not found a pie to match our local place in Bethesda, MD, but Lorenzo's is the best so far.  The pizza is flavorful and the crust thick.  If one adds extra cheese, the cheese is awesome.  Delivery times have varied, but we are in Old City and the fact that Lorenzo's will drive from the Italian Market to our house is impressive, so we have no complaint.

The pizza seemed just a  tiny bit salty, something we have noticed in every pizza we have eaten in Philadelphia, but this was much less salty than other brands. For the moment, Lorenzo's has become our go to pizza shop.

I have visited this location once a week for the past 4 weeks and it is terrible. Fries and onion rings have not been fresh , and the strange thing is that they have been busy when I'm there. The trash cans are overflowing with trash around the entire place, and the attire of the employees (I know it's Sonic) is unacceptable. This place needs a new manager to straighten things up!

I hate saying this but this place has gone downhill significantly since they downsized. It's sad since my family has come here for about 12-15 years but we have it a few trys after the restaurant downsizing and it was just plain bad. I got a stomach ache after my chicken for a second time. Service was solid but that's about it. Disappointed

This is one of the best Asian Bistro I have recently visited. Ambiance was really good and the food was delicious. The owner was really attentive and service was great. Will be going back for more sushi.

The customer service is pretty terrible. I walk in and there are four associates at the counter and not one acknowledged me today. I come here all the time for crickets and you'll stand there for minutes and no one will come to ask if you need help. So, you have to go up to the registers all the time. I guess it depends on who's there too. There are some good associates on occasions. I try to avoid this location.

This is my office's favorite place to order from at the Bellevue food court. 

Bain's Deli is always friendly, fast, and the sandwiches are great.

We have ordered from them almost every day or other day for like 8 months now and they're never out of anything and the whole process is always easy. We have large orders so it makes a big difference. Their soups are also kickass. 

note to Bain's crew - Don't change anything and we'll keep coming back

*EDIT - 2011 Feb - *Used to be favorite*, there service has gone down since the staff was changed out, there just isn't love in the food anymore... you can taste the difference. The only guy that stayed makes a lot of mistakes with each order then has an attitude when we come back for anything he left out of the order.

The service was good, Sushi Chef was very nice and good food. I did not care for the way the back desk looked when you walked to the restroom it was very unorganized with vacuum cleaner cleaning supplies all over and during our meal the server cleaned a table next to us with something that smelled like Lysol. Ruined my taste buds. The meal was very expensive $80.00 for lunch on Sunday, no lunch menu. So, just my thoughts.
MSH

Ordered from here a few times, pizza , steak Stromboli, always great, it's becoming the best in the neighborhood really. Shitty location with great food I hope the location doesn't affect it I know it was there before for years but the neighborhood was a little better then.
Love the food here. Always coming for the amazing Thai food and sushi is always fresh. Such a friendly environment.

Their food is tasty, the prices on par or a little lower than competitors, and the service is outstanding.

Taste is subjective, but I'll just say that so far I tried two Thai dishes, one Japanese dinner, a bunck of their more sushi rolls, and one of their higher end hot seafood dishes(a tuna maduro dish). I thought the Thai dishes (pad see ewe and Thai fried rice) were great; my wife and son also thought it was among their favorites. My wife and I agreed that the seafood dish I got was outstanding, And the Japanese dinner was also really good.

The portion sizes and prices on their hot foods were similar to what we find elsewhere, but if you like brown rice you'll save a dollar or two because they charge less to upgrade. It seems to me that their sushi roll prices are on the low side, so I'll look forward to taking advantage of that in the future.

Service is fantastic. They've been busy the three times I've been there, but their waiters work as a good attentive team, and the owner (or one of the owners) goes from table to table to see if you need drink refills, extra plates, or just to generally fill in whatever gaps there might be. And even the sushi chefs, when they're not busy creating their masterpieces, or nice and interactive. Overall, they make it seem like you're being invited into someone's home and do all they can to make you comfortable. We look forward to going back here many times.

This was a very good experience for our first time RV purchase. Our salesman Mitch was very accommodating and we really liked the fact that they gave you space to look things over and no high pressures sales tactics were employed.

Ordering pizza from Dominos is nothing new. However, I felt compelled to write a review letting people know how wonderful and helpful this staff was. I needed a special pizza ordered as a surprise to make someones Monday a little better. Juanita even included a special message with the pizza for them. :) And she even took the additional step to follow up with a phone call to confirm my "gift" went out along with the message. Seriously impressed with Juanita's level of customer service and how she went above and beyond for my special order. Thanks Juanita--they were surprised and loved it! :)

I swear the take-out tastes better than the food when you're dining in. And that's fine with me since the dining space is nothing to write home about really. Golden Dragon offers your basic American-style Chinese. The orange chicken is delicious. Good eggrolls. It is definitely the best option in the Swan-Sunrise area. It's either Golden Dragon or Pizza Hut (yikes). 

I miss this place since recently having moved away from the Foothills area.

This place is always there for me when I'm at the hospital for my son. 

I used to work for Starbucks and in the morning that I would have to leave the hospital to work, I would stop here. They would always give me my coffee for free. 

Friendly staff, nice place to sit and bring a bite of food.
Had craving for sonic burger! Tried their double burger there was no lettuce or tomato! Tea was spoiled! Was disappointed because this location is usually pretty good!

These people are just plain incompetent. The girl taking the order could not grasp the idea of the mango lemonade listed on their menu. "You want a lemonade with Nerds?" Mango sounds just like Nerds. Insert the card into the reader and everything disappears. Another person comes on to take the order. We tell him we just gave the order. He tells us they have to take the order again because some how the order got deleted. We place the order again, and pay again. They claimed the entire transaction disappeared. 

Girl comes out with two large drinks and one medium. We ordered one large and two mediums. The girl tells us the total. We tell her we have already paid. She tells us the card reader isn't working. We ask why no one mentioned that. "Sometimes it works, and sometimes it doesn't. We don't know when it works. It decides when to work. We have no control over that."  We hand her $20. She has to go get change. Our total was $3.68 and she brings back $15 even  obviously math skills are a problem. 

Husband gets out of car to go find the manager. Manager explains that they are all learning a new system and that it does go out from time to time and they have no control over it. Husband says that the total was $3.68 and that he gave the server $20.00 and she returned with $15.00. The manager stated "So she short changed you?" This should not have been a question! Husband makes a suggestion that people be trained in groups, to which the manager responds; "I have no control over that, we are learning a new system." He then says; "You need to understand sir, it is part of humanity." 

These people want $15 an hour?
Perfect lunch sushi and teriyaki box.The service was very good and food was delicious.

This is most definitely my favorite sushi  place. The owner is very welcoming and he also prepares sushi especially for your liking. He made a special  for my son and named it after him. It's called the Alexander. It is amazingly awesome. You should try it! It's not on the menu you have to request it.  Both the restaurant and the Alexander. You will not be disappointed.

There should be an option for zero starts! I went to get a plain cheese burger, some fries, and some onion rings. It wasn't busy at all! The guy over the speaker talked so fast I could barely understand him, they didn't say thank you or have a good day. Then when I got home my budget was smothered in mayo, shit white lettuce, and nasty tomatoes! What part of plain don't they understand?  I called the store to complain and they treated me with more than no repect, didnt solve the problem, and when I asked for the manager or their number they refused to give it to me! They told me I could call back tomorrow at 2...because that solves the problem!!! Screw this sonic! And to the manager Jody Catrell, you are incompetent and need to be fired from you job! Get your shit together Sonic!!!

A hidden gem in the Michaels strip mall. I'm so glad we stopped in. I saw their reviews were good so we stopped in. My husband and son both got the sushi lunch special. Yellow tail, salmon roll, eel roll and a citros roll. The lunches came with soup and egg roll. I ordered tofu pad Thai Thai hot. It was delicious. So many places here in Florida are over Americanized and lose their authenticity. I'm happy to say this was exactly what I look for. I order pad Thai as a base to see if they can cook Thai or not. I'm excited to have a place nearby that's not over priced and delicious. The owner was very pleasant and even shared his cool music channel with my husband. It's also nice to have relaxing music to eat to, that isn't overly distracting like some places. Everything was fresh and tasty. Excellent service. Stop in!
Eric is beyond rude and doesn't need to be in customer service at all. The car hop was very polite and apologized for how he spoke to us. He is ruining the face of your establishment!

Excellent service, delicious food and friendly staff. I felt super welcomed when I arrive. The atmosphere was very nice. The food was on point.  Best hole in the wall restaurant I've been to in a long time. I would definitely recommend everyone to go check out this place.

This is the second experience we have had at Golden Dragon. First was OK. We had dinner there last night and the way I'm feeling this morning prompted this review. The food is rather flavorless and soupy, and lacked the proteins in the dishes we ordered. Very salty and probably full of MSG. The fried egg rolls tasted like the stale oil they were fried in. This morning I awoke to horrible gut rot and I have to assume the cause was this food. My wife also has GI symptoms and she has a cast iron gut. I will NEVER return to this restaurant.

I have always enjoyed the food at Golden Dragon. 
I ordered a takeout and was very disappointed. 
Won Ton soup had no flavor, almost like water. Won ton's were soggy to the point the were falling apart. Other ingredients were minimal at best. house special Cow Main was also tasteless. Had to search for the chicken and pork pieces they also had no flavor and rubbery in texture. The shrimp tasted great though. 
Don't think I'll come back. Very disappointing.

Can't speak highly enough about this locally run repair shop.  I decided to save myself $$$ and replace my evaporator and compressor with a friend.  I simply came here for an evac and recharge based on a recommendation when I was done.  However, a hose immediately blew after the recharge.  Rather than charge me twice, they allowed me to replace my hoses, return, and gave me another recharge at no additional cost.  They didn't just make my day but made my WEEK.

My family has been coming here for years. It's always solid. It's not outstanding Chinese food but it is worth the price and the food is actually pretty good. Service is ok, not great. They make everything from scratch which is also nice. I would recommend this place for families too.

Food is great especially for the price!!  I ordered from them all month while I was working in the area and they've messed up my order once but I called and it was easily fixed.  However, if you're ordering online and ask for anything extra on a sandwich (which needs to be typed in additional comments) you won't get it on your sandwich. It happened to me 3 times but, to me, it's petty. 

Edit.  I edited my review down two stars because I called tonight and the lady put me on hold, but I could still hear the lady say to someone else "Yeah it's a call from that address but it's a white guy". Now idk what that means but in this day and age when everyone else is allowed to be offended over having their race pointed out, I find that this was very very rude.
I love this place  we work across the street at El cisne we always go here for lunch everything is delicious

Had a great dinner this evening at Ahi Asian Bistro! Alex, our server was so great and positive, he really made it hard to decide what was better, the food or the service! We got the appetizer sampler, the Delta Force roll, the green curry and red curry which all came out fresh and full of flavor! To be honest, the whole staff was so friendly and welcoming! We will definitely be returning very soon to try more of the menu options!
We ate lunch here a few times on our recent trip to Florida.  The food was quite good considering it is a fast food Mexican place.  Would definitely recommend.

This is a once in a lifetime store operated by a Once in forever owner! Simply said Jodi  is incredible. She knows her customers, she knows her merchandise, this lady knows her business and bends over backwards to make every experience for her customers a delightful and memorable one. I have known Jodi and Troy for over a year now and I have nothing but praise on their business and I have over 100 items from the Resale Ranch to speak louder than anything I could write here. Jodi has found a unique balance between being the consummate professional and providing a "at home " atmosphere. I drive several miles twice a week just to see whats new! 
TonyD

This is only to advice customers to stay clear of the margarita reaper. It is not edible nor enjoyable.  It is simply too hot (spicy) to enjoy. I'm giving 4 stars because the establishment in itself serves other treats my kids and I enjoy. However save your money and enjoy other items on the menu.

The food is Okay... They have a bad habit of messing up my order 3 out of 10 trips... Chicken Wings are subpar, and the steak meat is missing that "flavor", but the sandwich is meaty... Don't try any of the seafood products.
The specials are good, I love there chicken fingers and fries with a can soda!!! The pizza is really good too... I normally get pepperoni or cheesesteak pizza.
Surprisingly, the spaghetti and ravioli dishes are good too, just tell them lite on the shredded mozzarella on top.

This is the best Thai I have ever had. We started with an order of spring rolls and a house salad. Both were good and I appreciated the chilled salad bowl. 
I ordered the salmon with panang curry. It was absolutely delicious!! The salmon was crispy on the outside but still moist and flaky on the inside.  My husband had the Prig Pao wIth chicken, beef and pork.  He really enjoyed it.
We had warm sweet sticky rice with mango for dessert. It was also delicious. 
Alex our service was very good and pleasant. The owner/chef came out and chatted with us. He told us he was getting fish shipped fresh from Japan the next day for their sushi.  We'll have to try that. 
The place is nicely decorated and they also have a nice selection of wine and some beer. 
Prices were very reasonable. 
We definitely will be going back.

A nice little antique shop. It's not a huge place but there are lots of items to see and the front porch area is utilized well! 

Some items I took notice of: there are various tables of different sizes - I particularly like those that fold down and there are at least two if not more. There was also a pretty cool vintage TV the kind in the wooden stand - super unique! 

Some antique stores are all dishes - not this one. There are vintage purses, a tool section, shoes, ty stuffed animals, jewelry, and much more! 

The prices are fair, they are not yard sale, but they are pretty good! For example, a vintage Simba cookie jar for $20.00. But, there were 2 antique milk  glass vases - one was unique and funky for $6.00, meanwhile the other was not as unique and not as large and priced at $5.00. (Just an example not necessarily a criticism). 

I would revisit especially if I was on the hunt for a unique item.
They have awesome food with quality ingredients. Pricing is great. They got this huge ass slice of pizza for only 2 bucks. Can't beat that. The runs are also great.
Just ok, They need to learn how to make a crispy crust, It was like thick soft bread. It isn't that hard to do it right

I ordered a chicken Parm sandwich, no cheese. The sauce smelled off and the chicken on the outside was dark like it was rotting. 

I will never eat here again. This was my first and last.

Disappointing. We live near by..never ate here..read reviews, decided to try.  Ordered beef lo mein..very soggy noodles, very little sauce..tasteless.  also ordered war won ton soup..it also was equally tasteless, and won tons which were soggy and disentegrated...   The delivery was super fast..but food very sub par.  We ordered right at 4:30pm..when they opened.., so the food should have been fresh..but it taste like 2 days old, and very soggy.  Cannot recommend based on our first and last experience. We do not plan to ever return.
Great place to eat , great food and excellent service , always very attentive and efficient.

OK, first: make sure Alex is still the waiter when you visit this place. That's just where the awesome experience begins. I love everything about this place! My boyfriend and I have tried many sushi places and this one, by far, stands apart. From the chef to the waiter, these guys go above and beyond to make sure your experience is unforgettable. The sushi, of course, is delicious and gets an easy 5 Star rating. As for the customer service, well, you'll have to visit this place and experience it for yourself. When you do, feel free to order the Hawaiian roll, Mexican roll, California roll, avocado roll, sweet potato roll and/or the Rainbow roll. You won't be disappointed. This was our third visit and can't wait to come back!

My husband and I had lunch here on Wednesday and it was great. They have awesome lunch specials, we had the sushi and it was fresh and also he had thai curry, really tasty and when you get "Thai-hot" they actually do make it spicy! I had the teriyaki chicken lunch box and it was also really good and plenty of food . I can't wait to bring my son for happy hour $4.00 sushi rolls and see how many he can eat at that price. Keep up the great food cause you are less then a mile from my home & my new favorite place.

Had a great experience buying our 2015 Thor Citation. No complaints. Everyone worked to get it done. Coach was delivered as described. No pressure sales. Tim was easy to work with...we are in NM so it was hard doing things sight unseen....would work with them again..

This is our favorite sushi restaurant, we can't keep away! Everything is so fresh and delicious. Love the salmon tataki, citros roll, and the fresh rolls. Tried the Thai food this time, it was also amazing. Staff and owner are so nice and friendly and go out of their way for you. Their recommendations are spot on. Far and above the best place in Tampa.

Food consistency has become a problem for me. When we first started eating here in December 2018 the food was unmatched and consistently was never an issue. Over the course of the past few months the dishes we love to order have experienced inconsistencies. Our absolute favorite dish was inconsistent at our last visit where it was remade three times (during the same visit) and we left the restaurant HUNGRY (despite the refund).

When friends I introduced to eat here start complaining to me at the grocery store... that becomes a personal item for me, as I carried the flag for this company touting how amazing and consistent it "was". That just adds salt to the wound.

I love the staff but when it comes down to principal, consistency is the main metric.

When consistency becomes a problem... (fill in your own conclusions).

Mornings are always insane at this location. I work in the area so this store is my go-to. This particular morning was chaos. I placed a mobile order thru the app and it said the 1 drink I ordered would be ready in 5-8mins. Incorrect. It should have been updated to reflect the circus show going on in the store and said your drink will be ready in approx 50mins-never!!!!!
That's how long I had to wait until I realized I was never going to get my drink. Everyone was looking at each other and stating how crazy this was! Others had been waiting just as long and the frustration in everyone's faces was brewing. The staff was calm and really tried to maintain some sense of order. There was a girl going thru the older mobile orders stacked up on what appeared to be a book shelf. She tried her best to pull orders for ppl waiting but at some point I wised up and asked for a credit because I couldn't wait any longer. They issued a refund on my mobile app and a credit towards my next order. The 2 stars   goes to the recovery effort.

my husband and I ordered from here on Doordash, and we were blow away with the quality and taste of the food. we ordered pork dumplings, chicken with veggies in brown sauce, chicken fried rice, and the Korean beef dish. the two meat dishes also came with a side of jasmine rice. delicious !

A couple weeks ago, I went in here to order some sushi to go for lunch. Even though I want dining in, the staff (all the way from the host to the charming sushi chefs) were incredibly hospitable and friendly. They provided me with water and a sample of their soup while I was waiting for my order. On to the food: The sushi rolls I ordered tasted super fresh and delicious. You get a great portion for a lunch special. I also love that they serve Thai dishes. Would definitely recommend this place!
We were the only ones here but they were very friendly and the sushi was very good! We will definately be back! Very quick with our food came very fast and the sake pineapple was really good
This is our first visit here. We're definitely coming back. We ordered too much but everything was sooo delicious! The toro was amazing. The amazing eggplant was yummy as well.

Hidden gem!  Great lunch and happy hour prices.  Very clean inside, beautiful decor, super friendly service and most importantly.....DELICIOUS FOOD!  Everything we tried was great but my personal favorite was the Massaman Curry.  Can't wait to come back!

Love this place! Owner is so nice and food is just fantastic, I was just in Jerusalem last month and this place is definitely authentic! If you're in the mood for good Mediterranean food or a home cooked meal this place is it!

We made an impromptu trip to Tucson for a business trip; his business, my pleasure! I had the day to myself and was in need of a facial. Luckily, this gem of a day spa was walking distance and they accommodated me on short notice!
I had the Red Wine facial from Megan and it was exactly what my poor face needed. Aside from the scrumptious products being applied, Megan was gentle when needed and more assertive when required. Very relaxing and I do have a bit of a glow now. My skin feels great. Thank you!
Good Pad Thai and they were really quick when I ordered to-go at a busy time! However, not ideal to eat inside as there is limited seating. Great place to order to-go Thai food though!

The Basics: Ahi Asian Bistro is a Japanese and Thai restaurant located in a strip mall off of Dale Mabry in North Tampa. The restaurant has booths, tables, and a sushi bar. The menu is large and diverse and has options for both sushi and Thai food. I only ordered sushi when I came here and the quality of the sushi was amazing! Definitely a must try!

Things I like: All of the food I had here was of perfect quality and was prepared to perfection. We started with the Crispy Pork Wontons, which were absolutely delicious. The sushi I had included Toro, the Hot Night Roll, White Dragon Roll, and Citros Roll. I thoroughly enjoyed all of these rolls and would highly suggest them. You can tell they use great quality fish and the dishes were all plated beautifully. Additionally, it is important to note, the service here is amazing. Roger, the owner, is so personable and really makes an effort to connect with his customers. The entire staff here is extremely attentive and are all great at what they do. 

Things I didn't like: Nothing! I loved my experience here! 

Overall, Ahi Asian Bistro is a must for sushi in Tampa. Definitely worth a try for those wanting some great quality sushi. I am looking forward to becoming a regular here for my sushi fixes!

Very nicely designed with small bistro feel. Clean and comfortable. Good service. 
Excellent egg rolls and steamed dumplings. 
Really good white rice.  
Liked General Tso's Chicken and Szechuan Beef. 
We will be back.

Returned a second time and shared steamed dumplings, orange chicken and a pot of tea. Plenty for two to share. 

Place serves consistently good old school Chinese menu in a pleasantly redesigned environment. Like the place. 

Really good neighborhood choice for a night that is too hot to cook.

Went here because I saw they had Japanese and Thai which was perfect for my boyfriend and I. They were rated #2 in the area and I was surprised I'd never heard of the place before.  We went there a bit late so we got some very personalized service as they were winding down for the day. The food was INCREDIBLE. I got panang curry and my boyfriend got some specialty rolls. My curry was to die for (super fresh veggies! Not over cooked) and they even offered me Thai spices! The server was just so attentive and kind. They even gave us some mochi because it was our first time there! We had a lovely time and will definitely be back!

This a fun place with great selection of items made to order magnificently prepared. even  request not on the menu are happily made. Their spicy tataki sauce is a house special that should not be missed. True recommend for any outing.

Staff is helpful and very friendly. 
They made sure my water was never empty!!!

Sushi is really really good. I got the Fried Dynamite roll and it was perfect all around! Honestly haven't had this good of sushi in a while. Great prices with better quality, staff is super sweet. Great restaurant  10/10 would recommend.

We have been to Ahi twice now and each time the food and service was excellent, we love Thai food and always looking for new restaurants to try and we must say when we found Ahi we found a good one we have tried a good few options and all have been great, and what is nice which is rare for a Thai restaurant is they have happy hr two for one wines and sushi for $4 it is a great deal, on our first visit we met Roger the owner who was very friendly and helpful he also game out to talk with us on our second visit as well which was very nice, our server was very attentive, we will be visiting again soon, we'll done Roger we wish you well with your new restaurant see you again soon.

1) ordered food around 11am still waiting for the delivery, and it's 2pm. Was told 30 min ago that it will be there in 5-10 min.
2) Not going to review the food since I have not tried it

My first time trying this new Japanese/Thai restaurant, it left me stunned at this amazing food. As many of you may know, this specific lot of the complex used to be the place of an amazing Sushi restaurant named Kaisen Sushi. This new restaurant has more than taken the place of this legend, with great food and people. The people in mind was this amazing waiter, Alex, who even recognized my children from coming here with their dad. The food that we ordered, Pad Thai and duck noodle soup, (shown below) were particularly delicious. From tasting both of them, I would suggest the duck noodle soup more than anything I have tried so far. All in all, this restaurant has a lot to offer and will be sure to provide a great spot for a quick and delicious dinner if you're nearby

This is my new favorite place to order from. Me and my main jawn ordered a plain cheese pizza and broccoli bites last night and I was blown away by how bangin the food was. They hook the crust up with a little extra garlicky spices that were a real treat to my buds. The food came fast and hot just how I like it. I was so pleased with the food I dumped a thick load inside my chick after we got done eating.

I had the Panang duck and a sushi roll combo. The duck was good and crispy with tasty curry sauce and vegetables; would eat it again. The sushi however was not to my expectations. To be fair, I had 'Kaisen' (the former establishment) in mind; it was hard not to think about Ryo's spirit in the food, of you were lucky enough to know. Despite the sushi being average, my overall dining experience could have gone either way, but what has since kept me from going back was that I did not feel entirely comfortable in the restaurant setting. When I arrived, there was nobody else there, so I could sit anywhere I wanted. I chose a table away from the sushi bar, but the sushi chef still conversed with me throughout my time of trying to dine (that was a little too invasive), even uncomfortably narrating that I didn't like the sushi when he saw that I didn't finish it. Nice duck dish. Service could be more professional to every customer.
This was our first visit and we will be back! Really good food, great service, excellent value for lunch.

Stopped in this Chinese restaurant last night as I hadn't been there in a long time but remembered the food was always good. First thing I noticed was they remodeled and downsized the restaurant. The atmosphere is gone. It doesn't even look like a Chinese restaurant. I ordered Chow Mein as I've had many times in the past. What I received was very different from what I remembered. The noodles tasted old and there was barely any meat in the dish. The meat was tough and of poor quality. They must have new ownership and a new cook. Not friendly and inviting as it once was. The food was awful. I will not return.

My girlfriend and I went to the soft opening and was delighted by the large variety of sushi and authentic Thai foods that it was hard to decide what to eat.  We enjoyed the appetizers, sushi and dessert.  We left full and very satisfied with the experience, including how personable the staff are.  We will definitely be back again, so many options...

We have been to Ahi Asian Bistro at least 4 times.  We love it!  The sushi is buttery and wonderful. The staff is super friendly.  We also loved that they had a number of good Thai dishes.  The prices were very reasonable.   The Tuna Tar Tar appetizer was so good that I asked them to make me a platter for a party. When I picked it up it was beautiful and was a big hit at the party! Also, they have great lunch and happy hour specials.

Cannot compliment this place enough! My wife and I have been coming weekly since they opened about a year ago. The owner and staff treat us as if we are family and the food is always delicious. Highly recommend

Every time i go here the employees are always nice. But they have never gotten my order right. Every time I have specifically asked for real cherries in my drink, and they always overload it with cherry flavored syrup.

Caught a glimpse of their South Philly pie on social media and decided 
since it's close by to give it a try. 

First up was the steak. Not bad. A typical pizza place steak, decently filled with good amount of meat. Good flavor. 

The pizza was a nice surprise. A boardwalk style pie. Perfect cheese coverage and flavor. The excellent sauce was nicely spiraled on top and had a nice tang to it. They even use a garlic seasoning on the crust which was a nice touch. I just wish their crust was a bit more airy bread like, it was flat and a little dense. 
Still overall it was good and solid choice I would try it again for sure.
(This is for their Bustleton location)

Jodi and Troy were just amazing in helping clean out my moms apartment after her passing away.  I live out of the area and contacted Resale Ranch for help.  They came out and looked at the apartment then a couple days later came and took everything away.  What a relief for me in such a difficult time.  They were professional, caring and shared my values in giving back to the community.  I highly recommend their service.

Wonderful food, owner, and staff! Waitress was quick and bubbly, and the Dynamite Roll was to die for! Potstickers were amazing, as well as the White Dragon Roll! I suggest the Crab Rangoons 100%

10/10 would eat again!!!

I got the jumbo slice for $2.00. It is a big slice. Would have been better if the sauce didn't taste like tomato paste. It had no taste, very flat. Looks like they have a turn over with cooks. They advertise often for a cook. Maybe that's some of the problem.

3 years later, and they're still understaffed. I've also found that their drinks are less consistent than other locations. Today I ordered a vanilla sweet cream cold brew (for which I had to wait at least 10 minutes), and it was both overly sweet and watery tasting. I've never had this problem at other locations. Overall, Kitchen Gia right next door or ABP is quicker and better.
I lived in Thailand and I am also looking for food Thai restaurants.  We have found our new place to come.  I would highly recommend.  Friendly staff and food food and a great price.

Ordered here twice so far, and i gotta say, either hit or miss on the taste.  They do however make it real fast every time we do carry out.  The place is a little easy to miss because its on a small strip but able to find no less.  The people are friendly and can get you in and out real fast.  Overall good experience I've had here and will be ordering again.

Haven't been to a Sonic in years. So decided to stop in on my way home. Ordering was a pain as I had to repeat myself several times. When the order came out it was wrong and they also forgot half of it. I told the runner what I had ordered he said he'd fix it. He did come back with the order correct this time. I ordered a foot long coney meal. I looked at the hot dog and it barely had any chili on it at all and only a few slivers of shredded cheese. The tarot-tots were cold and stale. Not a very pleasant visit. Avoid this place unless you have time to deal with wrong orders and cold/stale food.

Excellent sushi and Thai food in Carrollwood at the same location that Kaisen had been.  I highly recommend giving it a try. Very fresh high quality fish. Owners are very nice and accomodating. A wide variety and all of it is excellent. A welcome new spot in Carrollwood that is family owned.

Ordered delivery from this restaurant to my hotel. Ordered via online app, which was very convenient and even let me know status of order each step along the way. Delivery was prompt, pizza was still hot and everything requested was provided.  I ordered the medium handtossed pepperoni with extra cheese. Dominos has really done alot in respect to their recipe, it tasted excellent and i loved the crust! I could really tell the extra cheese was added as sometimes you order extra cheese and it is not really added on.
I also ordered the cheesy cheese bread, only suggestion is to make the bread more cheesy in the middle..
Delivery man came up to my room, i didnt even have to go down to lobby.  I thought that was awesome!  Very impressed with how far Dominos has come. I may become a regular customer when i return home!
Great service, great food. Nice touches everywhere. Only had lunch (Thai curry) but will definitely come back for sushi. Nice, clean place.

Amazing starters! Amazing and fresh sushi! Friendly and courteous staff and owner! Definitely recommend! 

We got crab rangoon, spring rolls, and crispy pot stickers. Then we got the white dragon roll, dragon roll and dynamite roll. Everything was amazing! 

Last time we got the tempura cheesecake and that was the absolute best cheesecake and idea I've had in a long time!

Very very very good!!! I usually don't have high expectations for Asian bistros that try to do it all (Japanese, Thai, Korean), but everything we tried was fantastic! The massaman curry and tom kha soup were better than most full on Thai restaurants in the area. The sushi was top notch. There are soooo many things to choose from. We will definitely be back again and again.

We enjoy the freshness of the sushi, the flavor of the Thai food and the owner making sure everything is great. We have been coming here since shortly after opening and have been eating here almost once a week. 

One of my favorites rolls is named after the owner, the Roger Roll. You have to try it at least once and I am sure you will order it over and over. The strings of fried Krab on top not only gives it a great taste and texture. 

We have also tried many Thai dishes and was not disappointed.  Roger and his wife makes everything from scratch including the salad dressing and sauces. 

Lastly Roger also will special order certain fish only from Japan to create a special meal for you. 

Great place and great food
I heard good things about their pizza. I ordered 2 small pizzas. It was here within 25minutes. The crust was pillowy soft but held it's shape. I liked the seasoning on the pizza and crust.

This place is new and has a lot of promise. I really hope it does well. Food was great, reasonable prices, and service was fantastic. The owner, waiter, and staff were all personable and eager to please and make the restaurant succeed. Would recommend checking this place out!

What a pleasant surprise to find in a strip mall off of Dale Mabry in North Tampa.  Since I work during the week the lunch specials were not available.  But, all the same,​ I ordered the shrimp tempura roll, whitefish roll.  I also ordered octopus​ roll and a clam roll.  Each in there varying degree of taste.  The most interesting order was the octopus and clam roll as seen in the pictures below.  The octopus was sort of chewy when I bit into it and really did not have a distinctive taste.  The clam roll was slightly salty with a mild flavor.  They are both cooked but, initially​ when I saw them I had my doubts ​.(Was being a bit adventurous​--although I have had smoke octopus before .)
To take home with me I ordered crispy chicken with cashew.
Wait staff explained everything and were attentive.
I will go back and try other dishes and flavors.

All I can say is wow this was a really great experience. I would definitely go back here again. I had the tornado rolls and they are amazing! This is a very nice experience the servers were wonderful and welcoming!

This is my favorite Thai and Sushi restaurant yet. Had lunch today and I can't say enough about the food, service and atmosphere. I would actually give six stars today if possible. Roger, the owner, greeted us and we were promptly seated. Carolyn got our hot tea order and gave us plenty of time to study the menu. We ordered from the lunch menu and it was delicious. I ordered tofu panang coconut curry and it truly was the best I've ever had. They make their own tofu and it was so creamy inside, cubes, and the zucchini and carrots were cooked perfectly. My friend had the Pad Thai and she said also, the best she has had. The lunch came with a spring roll and cup of soup. The soup came hot and steamy with chicken and rice. Carolyn was on top of everything. I also happen to observe a lady come in for some sushi. She was in a hurry but Roger jumped on it and had her order in 10 minutes. They are very accommodating and will tweak your order to your specifications. The booth was comfortable and no loud music. This is my number one go to for Thai from now on.

I come here at least twice a week when I visit my parents. I grew up in Tampa and wish we had a place this amazing and reasonably priced back then. I live in NYC now, and I can assure you that I've yet to find a place here that's comparable to Ahi when it comes to quantity, quality, and freshness. It's an added plus that Roger and his staff are so friendly and will prepare anything you want (within reason of course!) I usually get the Alexander roll, Ceviche roll (my dad's favorite - he won't stop talking about it), and the salmon tataki. The two rolls were specials, but Roger still makes them for me when it's not on the menu that day. I've tried the panang curries as well, and that's also delicious. Ahi gives me hope for suburban Tampa's culinary scene, and I'm glad I finally have a go-to place for either a sit-down or takeout dinner when I'm in town. Spectacular service and phenomenal food! If I move back to Tampa, it'll most likely be for Ahi :)

Well, Like most clubs of this nature you get some up's and downs. This place is usually very cold inside and there is always a cover, but they seem to have a little something for everyone if you know what I mean. Like any adult club you need to come planning on spending money. It's very rare that I would even go in there, but it usually happens after a very long night of hitting up the town. I'm not a fan of bathroom attendants to begin with, but when they are stuffing one inside a very small bathroom it makes it even worse. But all in all you never feel any shame when you go in there. I mean for being located in a back alley off of 15th st. it's a lot better then what you would expect.

I am in the process of purchasing my 'senior' RV from Pedata. I worked with Don L. and Taylor while shopping. They were patient and willing to listen to what I liked/needed. Finally something popped up on their website in my price range but it was already 'pending'. When the deal fell thru they called me and I got a 2nd chance at it. Today I met the sales manager, Don, and JR the service tech. JR was just as patient going thru the vehicle with me to tell me what he has done and will be doing to insure it is road worthy (a service they provide w/o an additional cost). Next it will be detailed before I take it out as mine. I anticipate a happy ending to this story. Stay tuned.

Fortuneless: Portion size keeps getting smaller. Seeming like they are skimping on many things. My husband's terriyaki chicken was tough enough to need a knife. My regular order of Mongolian beef, was edible (had to share with husband the chicken was so tough and old) The place is getting worse. No wonder it wasn't full at lunch. Won't make it a habit to stop by anymore. It's cheap, but now it feels like it. Too bad, excellent location. It's ironic that the last two times we got the perfunctory fortune cookie - my husband's didn't even have a fortune in it! Not sure what's going on with this place, but it's not good. My fortune says "find new Chinese joint".
Awesome food.  Quick delivery.  They missed a part of my order but called immediately and delivered separately!  Awesome food and very attentive service!

Clean restaurant, good food, and we especially enjoyed Roger. Great service. The quality of the sushi was pleasing, though I wish the krab rangoons were a little larger.  Overall Ahi Asian Bistro is worth the visit!

Just ordered here today for the first time, and right after put in my order I started to regret a little bit because the reviews were pretty bad on here. So I went ahead to pick up my order. 

Located in The Bellevue Philadelphia, on the lower floor I didn't have much trouble finding this place. I think a few people might have trouble finding about this place because it's not a store front but just a stall in the food court. 

Anyway, so there's some truth to the reviews. Looks like the two guys in the picture are no longer working there. Either they've went on to do other things and hired new workers or there's new owners. Who knows. 

Down to the experience and food. My order was quickly done, and I waited less than a minute upon my arrival. My corn beef sub was heavily packed with meat and a good amount of coleslaw.
