My order was correct,  and they also included a pickle for me of no additional charge. Not sure if they hooked me up or this is common. For under 8 dollars, this was not bad at all. But the sub itself was pretty good and I do not feel sick or anything afterwards. Maybe the new people have leveled up and got things right. But they absolutely did not deserve the really bad ratings I saw on here.

I would give it a 4.5/5 stars if I could. Nothing too special get the perfect rating, but a pretty decent spot for lunch if you want a sandwich in this area.
The most amazing fresh tasting sushi ever !! Ask for a Roger , he's the man!!! Roger is the most Kindness man goes way and beyond to make sure to take care of you !!!

If you have ever eaten great Chinese food, you should never eat what they call food at this place. The items we ordered ranged from barely edible to terrible. It was a total waste of time and money.
As my son used to say "Yechhhhh!" when having something very unpleasant in his mouth - like foul tasting medicine.

I found them to be honest and professional.  If they do not have the R.V. you are looking for on the lot they will find it. The have a large amount of inventory and very fair prices.  Jerry would keep us updated all the time on what came in. I think this is the best RV Center in town. I would highly recommend them.

We love sushi and have tried a lot of places in Tampa but this is by far our favorite sushi place! We try to go at least once a week and if we are lucky enough to fit it in a second time because it really is that good!

Saw reviews from other diners...and boy were they spot on!!! The food is delicious, full of flavor, and portions are generous!!! Fantastic Thai reasonably priced...friendly staff!!! Definitely my new go to spot!!!!
We ordered $50 worth of sushi and it wasn't made as requested, it was so fishy it wasn't even edible, and it took over an hour to deliver it. Very disappointed.

We just purchased our first RV with Pedata RV Center. Mitch was wonderful coming in on a Sunday ( his day off ) to help. We purchased a used Motorhome, the guys could not have been more helpful. Taking the time to explain how it all works. We had one issue after we left the lot and they said bring it back, we did they dropped everything to resolve the problem and we were back on our way. I would highly recommend Pedata, nothing like the big guys, down to earth and a pleasure to work with.

This is probably not a fair review because my expectations were way to high for place like this. Had I known this place was such low quality I wouldn't have such a harsh review. The main floor and bar is about 200 square feet with about 30 dirty chair and tables and a small "stage" with 2 poles. It's got a very frat house basement vibe. Now of that matters what you typically care about is the talent. I hate to be so superficial but it is a topless bar so that's kinda the point right. The few (4) girls I did see were... let's just say an acquired taste. I never call people ugly because there is someone out there for everybody but I can only imagine the list is compact. It's like buying groceries at the dollar store, it's still food and if it's all you can afford you have to make due however,if you have the means I would encourage you to exercise other options. I feel terrible being so harsh so I will say at least the music was decent and the customer service wasn't bad. I will blame it on COVID but wow this place was significantly below average. ‍

I had my dog in the car and was actually going to the drive thru liquor store next to the Pet Supermarket, but I decided my little buddy could use a treat too! So we went in, and immediately my dog started shaking and had an accident. He has only done this 1 time before, and it was at a kennel where he got a bad infection and we suspected something fishy going on, so I was immediately wary (animals can sense things). We picked out a bone and a plush toy, and went to pay. The girl at the register didn't greet me in any way except "what type of dog food do you use?" When I answered, she snickered and told me "yea, that's like...really bad...you should buy  our food." And preceded to tell me how bad my choice of food is. Well guess what lady? I've been feeding it to my amazing, healthy, adorable dog for 6 years and never had a problem (and each of the 3 vets he has been to approve as well). Also, the day I take advice from an 19 year old wearing a scrunchie in 2014 is the day pigs fly.

Store had OK selection and prices, but was dirty (other pet's messes on the floor...at least I had the decency to clean my pet's mess up) and the service was 0/5 stars. I had to keep my mind focused on the wine I was about to purchase to distract me from telling the checker off. Never going back! 

ROYAL PET RESORT & MARKET (I have no affiliation with them, just a satisfied customer!)  is 5-10 min further north and my pup and I have ALWAYS had great experiences in both grooming and the store. I hope this place closes soon and they expand the liquor store or Cuban place!

I was in the club not to
Long ago. Normally wouldn't write a review. The staff was excellent except one girl. She offered "favors" with her dance if I got one. Normally most would not complain about this offer, but she is going to get a lot of people in trouble along with herself. She had orange or red hair and was terrible when I declined. I'm not looking for a hooker hun.  Guess that's what you get when you got to a strip club in a dirty alley.

So disappointed I drove several miles to the store and they had a paper taped to the door saying they were closed today.  Unless it was a medical emergency that is totally unprofessional and I won't drive out there again.  
Update: Owner confirmed it was a family emergency.  I don't know how to delete review but I will try them again.

I hurt my finger so cooking was out tonight.  We went out here because I was craving Thai and sushi.  Both were EXCELLENT and fresh.  You see the chef making the sushi.  They come and personally make sure everything is up to par, very attentive and excellent service.  Great safe area, 5 stars

We were here for the dinner happy hour before 6:30. The place do not have a good access if you come from the east of Bearss Ave. we eventually got to the place with a lot of turn. The plaza have plenty of parking space if you need to get to the restaurant. 

I would they about 4.5 stars restaurant. For the happy hour dinner, definitely 5 stars. We got one of the top seller Lama rolls. It is flame torch over the salmon and wrap with spicy tuna. It is good. Their happy hour roll are the best. We got seven rolls. We spicy tuna, bagel, Mexican, yellow tail, eel, tuna, and crispy salmon. I like all of them, especially the eel, spicy tuna, crispy salmon and yellow tail are the best. 

The service is great. The waiter is realizing we don't like cream cheese and it was not add into it. The sushi rice is the best. Great sushi rice in Carrollwood. I would said they are the best happy hour sushi I like.

I recently purchased a 2015 Thor motorhome, my salesman was Chris B. I told Chris that I found a similar RV for much cheaper in RV trader, he assured me they would meet the price found on the other RV, well I flew to Tucson, with a cashiers check with me and all hell broke loose when Chris told his boss about the other RV's price! Apparently he never mentioned that to the boss, the boss then assured me that the other coach was not equal, so no matching price would be honored! I told Chris that my offer was for $95000 out the door, when it was all said and done, they hit me for $96500, after I complained to Mgr he cut $1500, now I'm stuck with this RV that does not have a warranty! The generator on it acted up all the way home, and miscellaneous lights don't work, front door is not working properly! I called Chris B back and he told me the warranty expired when I drove it off the lot, and it was only for the chassis anyway! Needless to say I would never recommend anybody go through this, as I'm in Denver, CO with an Thor motor coach that needs work!! And no warranty to pay for repairs! Think twice before trusting this Pedata RV!

This place is Starbucks Hades!  It gets slammed by the hospitals in the area and it is too small to handle the volume.  Not sure why anyone would want to work there because it is crazy.  Worse the staff is unhappy and passive aggressive to boot.  Took me 20 minutes to get my order and after asking three times for my muffin, they told me they were out.  Really disappointing spot.  They need to close it and rethink how they function.
A hidden gem! Amazing maki rolls and excellent prices. Employees are super friendly too. Highly recommend this place.

I tried the volcano roll, citrus roll, California roll, Elle roll, and something else. Nothing was outstanding. However they did have very good crab Rangoon. I'll be back to try their Thai since it seems to be really popular and update the rating

The barista who worked on July 4 was slightly rule. I was Starbuck customer for years. I was very shocked about  Starbuck staff who was bad behavior on that day. I ordered the double espresso and cup of ice. After paid and picked my order, I went to condiment table to pur some skim milk on my espresso. I was told  to pay extra if I used condiment milk. I told him that it was ok to charge extra. I willing to pay extra. I was so shock about the way how he talked to the customers. He was loud in the front of every others and he seemed  to let everyone could hear his. The principle was not paying extra for using condiment milk, but it showed how the Starbuck staffs to talk to the customers. I was very embrassing in the front of others. I was told he was a manager. As a manager, I think he should learn how communicate  and respect the customers. Communication is best way to keep the business to grow.  Especially, this Starbuck located in best area. He should realize he deals with differences levels of different professional  around Penn and Chop.

Highly recommended.  The service is very good and the staff is friendly.  I know Jay and Roger from Sushi Tsu.  The food and presentation is very appealing.  I had the crispy chicken and cashews.  The chicken was crispy and came with cashews, pepper and pineapple withsweet sauce.

My new favorite roll at Ahi Asian Bistro.  The Ceviche roll...try it you'll like it!
This place has a lot of hot dancers with incredible bodies. The bartender was also hot and fun. The problem is that the lap dances are $40. They are insane.

Dirty club. Cheap girls except one pale girl was nice. Cocktail waitress Asian was extremely rude. After every song they wanted a dollar and came around. Didn't like that. There has to be better in philly. Place is a dump

The biggest untold scandal is that the bartenders literally steal your cash off the bar.  It has happened many times.  And when you confront them, they of course act like they know nothing.

And the pressure to buy the dancers drinks gets old, especially when they inevitably order some odd $15 drink.  Here's an idea, Ms. Stripper: Your bartenders rob my cash from the bar and I have tipped you ten times in an hour.  You buy me a drink.

Good place otherwise. Good times and glad they are now open Sunday nights.  Good DJ music, dancers are generally friendly and nice.

Try the Brooklyn style tomato pie with spinach, red roasted peppers and opinions and you won't be disappointed. Do it carry out mon to thurs for 7.99. The place looks clean and the guys working appear to be happy. They tell u 15 minutes and their true to their word. The pie is piping hot. They cut the large in 6 slices. I recommend slice in 8. They don't mind . Haven't had a bad experience yet. The price is right.

Great deal on a good pie
Try to find a better pizza in the Northeast.... I'll wait. Don't forget to check out their water ice joint down the street too!

This place was highly recommended by a friend of their great sushi and great sushi specials/prices. We ordered 4 rolls from the sushi special. Let me tell you, they were not only delicious but the price was very reasonable.  The grill squid was a little fishy for my husband but I liked it. We would highly recommend if you are looking for a good and reasonably priced sushi place.
Good food. Nice location and atmosphere.  Service isnt bad.  I eat here several times

It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye! No, not the best; but definitely not the worst strip club in the City. I haven't been back there in years; surprised to learn its still alive. Difficult location (I actually kind of liked this spooky, back-alley spot underneath a huge parking garage). Right next to City Hall, can you stand it? Bwahaha aha ahaha!

First off (to the other reviewers) I suggest that you can't really 'judge' this strip bar or consider it the standard for all establishments of its type--unless you are an experienced strip-bar customer. No one who frequents such joints really takes this place very seriously; the things-they-do-wrong-here are goofy but they're an element of hilarity singular to just this one place. 

Its a ghetto strip bar; you sabby? That's the fun of it. Predominantly black staff (both dancers and clientele). North Philly baby-mama-ghetto-fabulous drama queens,  (visible bullet holes on their bodies) prancing around, somehow under the impression that they're big -time entertainers. Its a hoot!

As a white guy to stroll in here and do the do-re-mi; its like a scene from a bad Bill Cosby movie. Hard to keep the chuckles down as menacing, glowering mandingos in mauve three-piece suits and felt fedoras and silk handkerchiefs (CONSPICUOUS bulges in their upper right-breast pocket) keep an eye on you from the corner of the room, 'in case you're here to cause any trouble'. Yeah, okay sir. Whatever. Like there's no drug dealing going on in THIS place, eh? lol. 'What it is, my brutha'. 'Outtasight'. 'Heavy'. 'Get down'.

Anyway. All in all, you can have a good old fun time in here as long as you pay attention to everything going on around you. Always go with a good pal and watch each other's backs. This is a 1970s time machine. Value it while its still around.

This shul has managed to maintain its original historic dignity. The majority of members are not politicians or snobs. Decency. Honor. Respect. Balance. Community.  I didnt think we made shuls like this anymore. Bravo! Principles and morals over money and influence. The Rabbi Avi Winokur still managed to win an award for being one of the top ten, most inspiring and influential Rabbis in America.  He has the grey hairs to prove it. Ironically, thus conservative shul has also become a sanctuary for Orthodox Jews fed up with denominational politics.  Strength to strength! 
The executive director, Betty, even caters the meals more often than not. One of the top 5 kiddushes in Philadelphia! 
What a privilege to review such a synagogue!

Horrible customer service. Could not complete simple job in a timely manner. Scheduled multiple appointments to have this company come out and multiple times office staff did not put in the appointment or mistakes where made with making it for wrong day/time. Also when invoice was made had multiple issues regarding the balance due and took over two weeks and multiple calls to get them to fix the issue.

Had a great experience my friend is buying her 1st  2013 Trailer..   No pressure sales. Joe was easy to work with...we are in Sierra Vista, would work with them again..they going to train us to do everything

This Starbucks I frequently understaffed and very slow. There have been times where I witnessed one person trying to keep up with drink orders during some of the busiest times of the day because there is no one else to help them. I've waited 40 minutes for a mobile order and had to leave to catch a train. My drink orders are also frequently wrong. I stopped going to this spot altogether after a bad experience with a particularly rude barista. Honestly I would look for another spot to get your coffee.
The pizza tasted fine but even after requesting for the center to be well done, it was still undercooked. The toppings slid off the tip of every slice.
ETHAN IS THE BEST!!!! The best service, the best food, the best prices. This place just gained 3 loyal customers. Thank you guys for the great food and atmosphere.
Amazing food and even better service! Fresh ingredients and SUPER reasonable prices! I go here at least once a week. My favorite appetizer is the crab rangoon.

This restaurant is located in a small strip mall, but it delivers big taste.  It's a comfortable place with a relaxed environment.  We started with the baby octopus salad with had a wonderful smoked flavor and was the perfect consistency.  The restaurant features Japanese, Thai, and sushi. 
We tried all three.
We had the pad Thai, a beautiful blend of flavors in a sauce that was sweet and had just the right amount of heat.
The avocado tamarind  shrimp had nice sized shrimp, big chunks of avocado in a mild spicy red sauce. With a hint of peanut. Amazing
We finished with sushi rolls.  The Roger and the volcano were our favorite. The spicy tuna could of been a little spicier, but the tuna was so fresh. None of that old fatty stuff you get served in other restaurants. 

The chef came over twice to check on us.  Definitely someplace I'll be back to.
Had the duck curry, was great. Just enough spice, loads of duck & vegetables, coconut curry sauce was amazing!

Roger and his team are the BEST! Not only the best sushi we have found, but genuinely great people! The food is fresh, delicious and the service is awesome! My wife and I are very frequent customers because it is the BEST OF THE BEST! 

Highly recommend !!!!

I bought a 2005 fleetwood bounder from here. The sales team were satisfactory but were not up to date on the Rv. We were 2000 miles away from home and told if our temporary tag expired they would give us one to get us home 34 dollars.  When we called back the girl that does the tag and title work says absolutely not. The service man I worked with was very knowledgeable an very nice to work with. The service manager was a  nasty man, not one of my favorite people.  5 trips back to the dealership for things wrong with the RV. Finally gave up with dealing with them becauseofthestress. It started with the turn signals . Which wouldn't work from the start. They agreed to fix. #2. Hot water heater had a problem which was because of something they did and they fixed that. Both grey water and black water seals were bad . #3. The refrigerator burner would not keep up on LP setting. Was told by service manager I was my not understanding how it works. Had a mobile RV repairman look at it. Bad burner. Called and talked to the service manager and he said it was my fault. How can a bad burner be my fault since it was like that from the day we got it.  I can't get the water hook up to work so I can flush my tanks. Compressor for dash air went bad the first time we used it.  Had to be towed. The dash air conditioner froze causing it to throw  a belt and overheated the engine. $2000 bill. Both roof air conditioners need replaced. The motors or compressors squeal  and hard to get running. That is going to cost us $2800. Again diagnosed by an RV mobile repairman. Door latch to the entry door was bad and evidentlythey knew it and tried to fiddle with it we were told the new doorr latch system would be $800. Can't lock or latch the door because you cant open it from the outside. Oven won't light. Slide leaks. There is a leak in the roof around the antenna that needs to be sealed. The service manager, Mark,  just told us to call a mobile repairman, when I asked him if he was going to pay for it he said of course not. I will never buy from them again.

Excellent place for a date! Highly recommend their apatizer and sharing a pizza.  Their calamari is incredible and even gluten free ( that's right gluten free calamari!)! Excellent ambiance and very romantic to take a date!

Well I'm from out of town so I heard this place was amazing. Yes pretty girls. Very talented. But the bartender Megan was incredibly rude to a female friend of mine. She asked to audition and Megan accused me of being her pimp and called me friend fat and ugly and suggested she try the Ballpark. Even a bottle of Xanax could not improve Megan's mood. All that time you're spending fixing your making won't work on your inner ugliness. As for the person who says Megan has a nice ass, well hey there has to be something good about her. Her attitude sucks but if her ass is the only thing good about her that's pretty bad . And what's this about her serving pregnant women? That's dirty.

Really impressed with this restaurant. I've been to most of the Thai restaurants in town and this one is now at the top of my list. My family had 3 different Sushi rolls and loved them all. 
I was also really impressed at how the restaurant tries really hard to maintain social distancing and proper etiquette during these crazy COVID times. All workers wore masks and required all patrons to wear masks aswell. 5 stars!
You all use way too much cream cheese  didn't know it was the main ingredient of sushi! So sad that Kaisen Sushi restaurant had to closed

I went there on a Wednesday around 2pm. The girls were ok the place was dark, there was cold pizza and the bartender Megan was plain awful. She was putting her makeup on and was irritated when I asked for a drink but had no problem serving a pregnant women who asked for a gnt. I had 500$ on me that I was going to spend. But not to a club who lets it's bartender serve a pregnant woman. She should have been fired. When I asked to speak to her manager about it she cursed me out .  Wow.

Went here on a Saturday at about 6:30p.m.  Have enjoyed Ahi Asian Bistro for lunch a number of times and have always found it excellent for food and over the top for service. 

Great atmosphere and always greeted like you are the best customer.  Not only does the waiter greet you but usually the owner Rodger, as well as the sushi chefs, also reach out to say "nice to see you again".  How refreshing.  In some of my other favorite restaurants I am never recognized in this way and most of the time not recognized.

Tonight I learned that there were two sushi chefs behind the counter and that they at one time worked for another of my favorite sushi restaurants. No wonder the sushi and sashimi taste so good here.  Be sure to try one of their specialty rolls. Their sashimi is always perfectly prepared. Delish.  

The other cool thing here is the diversity of the menu.  Great Thai, Japanese and even Korean can be enjoyed here.  

I believe it is only a matter of time when you'll have to make reservations to eat here.  Thank you, Rodger and staff, for another great dining experience.

Singapore rules! My partner and I had our commitment ceremony reception here and didn't have to worry about a thing- Peter the owner took care of it all for us! We had a keg of birch beer and Peter didn't mind at all!

I've been a loyal Singapore lover since 1999 when they were located across the street. The service (although the staff is always changing) is awesome, the owner and his family are super friendly, and they are always willing to modify any dish.

My menu favorites:
1) New Years Soup
2) Bean Curd Skin Knots with Ham
3) Chicken Legs
4) Crab Claws
5) Curry Hot Pot

Correction ; ,sundays are open I was there like 2 sundays ago and this was the place to be ! Great variety of girls , dances are only 30$ which is ok seeing as though this isnt one of those places where people pour money on stage drinks are ok but this place is veryyyy hard to find in an alley behind the bellevue besides that yes great time for the money

It broke down during delivery to California and they refused to refund my money when they couldn't deliver on time. I now have to buy a small travel trailer and wait for the remodel to be completed because Pedata RV delayed everything.  I wish I had never heard of Pedata and never purchased from them.  Please.....DO NOT BUY FROM Pedata RV.  They will lie, cheat and steal your money...leaving you with a mess to clean up.

This is my all time favorite sushi and Thai restaurant!!! The sushi is very yummy, the music selection in there is tasteful, and the staff is very pleasant. I especially enjoy the aura of Zen. She is very kind and hardworking. She always serves me with a smile and tells me the best jokes.
We always stop by here when in town visiting family! Quick eats and cheap but good!

I love this place it's one of my favorite Thai restaurant. The customer service is exceptional and the food is always made to perfection. From the sushi combos to the Thai tea this place is the place to dine! Thank you Ahi Asian Bistro for the great experiences! I will be back definitely.

This was the first time I have had ahi Asian bistro, and I was very curious about it because we live close and haven't been since they opened. We got takeout and they brought our order out to the car which was super easy. 
For appetizers, we got the appetizer platter with crab rangoon and spring rolls. These were all really tasty, but I especially liked the crab Rangoon which I get wherever I can. 
We got a number of main courses and shared them. I think the best were the duck with pineapple and the soft shell crab green curry. These had the most flavor and were pretty big dishes and were unique compared to other Thai restaurants I've been to. The beef massaman curry had very good flavor, I really liked the potatoes that were in it especially. I also enjoyed the pad see ew noodles! The only thing I didn't care for was the salt and pepper pork, it wasn't that flavorful and the meat was not tender. 

Overall, I would go back and I want to try their sushi and other dishes.

Hunan beef is excellent. Sauce is slightly spicy yet slightly sweet. 

The Star is the stir fried rice with beef, chicken and shrimp. Great flavor 

Mongolian beef. Beef was tender, garlic sauce not spicy. Not bad just meh. 

The Orange chicken and beef is just okay. The flavor of the sauce is good. Very sticky and sweet with good orange flavor. The batter on the meat is light and crispy but the meat itself is dry and chewy. I've tried both the beef and the chicken and both meats end up tough to chew like jerky. Hunan beef has the same battered meat but doesn't seem to have the same tough jerky problem and I'd recommend it over the orange chicken dish. 

Wonton soup had good flavor. 

The man who takes the orders is very nice and the staff is quick to have the meal ready. Portion are good sized and not skimpy. We usually order three dishes for 3 adults and two kids.
The guys at podeta made buying my first rv an easy and comfortable, they also listened to what i needed and could afford

So I returned to what used to be one of my favorite Philly gentlemen's clubs and was very disappointed.  The new girls are awful and just stand on stage and shake their ass.  After a lackluster performance I was continuously badgered for tips while I was trying to finish a conversation with one of the girls.  It was way to hectic and the talent has gone seriously downhill.
Flavorful food and fast service. And the fact that they serve multiple Asian cuisines under one roof is great.
Egg foo yong mostly bread dough, very few bean sprouts. This dish is usually made with all bean sprouts and just enough egg and batter to hold it together. Big disappointment.

Great sushi. The $5.00 sushi rolls were quality rolls not 90% rice like some other bargain sushi places. Chirashi was fresh and bountiful. Teriyaki dinner was also great. High quality, great value.
Great sake and beer specials. 
Attentive service, fun environment.

The Massaman Curry is one of the most amazing things I have ever eaten. I get the beef, and the flavor of the whole dish is out of this world. If I could eat it every day, I seriously would - it's that delicious. 

All of their other food is pretty fantastic as well. I've tried a few different sushi rolls, their Pad Thai and a few appetizers. I have never been disappointed. 

5/5 would reccomend to anyone looking for a delicious, autherntic Thai meal.

Love heading to Sonic to get that sweet treat!  Always great staff, with a friendly smile and quick service.  However, they should have considered laying out their parking lot better as the drive thru window traffic, can start blocking in parked cars.  We always manage to get out, but others get stuck.
We have ordered from here several times. Good food for a great value is hard to beat. Service is top notch as well. Carry out has always been fast and timely too. Highly recommend

While I was in my way to Michael's, I found this place and had few cars lined up to pick up food so I looked and saw they have $5 sushi so I figured that's probably why. I gave them a call and placed an order. It's been a while but I think their sushi was just okay nothing impressive. Will probably give them another chance and try them
Great service, and the food was great. Ordered the Hawaiian roll, tempura bagel and the shrimp tempura as well as papaya and krab ragoons for appetizer. She was great would come back again

Sales guy Mitch is great and easy to work with, no pressure and willing to work with you.  Also came in on his day off to show my wife.  Best of all they didn't try to charge me a ridiculous $1500 "set up" fee like the other guys.  Service was great walking me thru everything too!
Food is always good, especially the green and red curry. I am never disappointed and am a loyal customer.

We recently took a day off and discovered this spot for lunch. The appetizers came our fresh and quickly. I also order a fancy $13 volcano roll and $5 mexican roll. Both rolls were fresh and delicious. Awesome spot! I also heard that everyday they offer happy hour specials all day.
Best Sushi in Tampa. hands down. always fresh, staff is always so nice. will always come here every week for as long as i live. keep up the great work guys!

This club is great. With great girls. It's the management that needs to be dealt with. 
First off IF IF the ATM is working that night u can get money with an overpriced surcharge. However a Saturday night in center city and they don't have any money in the ATM machine and then it's broken half the week?!?! I mean seriously people. Get your business together. This club would be great if any of the bouncers or managers gave a damn about anything but money...but wait...to get more money, you need ATM machines , and without one is just going to reduce your business 10 fold. Put a damn ATM that works inside the place and maybe id give it another star. But the incompetence of the management is so bad I'm writing a review of the damn place haha...but seriously if they can't keep a working and full ATM in the building by 2016...It's pathetic!!!

This place definitely deserves the five stars many have given. The service as well as the amazing food make this quaint place a hidden gem that always consistently surprises me each time I've been here. They were able to accommodate my large group as well as date nights with my wife. We've been to all the other sushi places in this area and this is our new go to spot from now on and as long as we live in Florida.
I love the burrito breakfast egg cheese and bacon with tots and drink for $6.49. Delicious and better than mcds bacon egg and cheese biscuit-and cheaper meal!!

Nice Starbucks , right in the heart of downtown, right opposite CHOP. The inside was spotless clean, with plenty of seating . There was one person taking orders and another preparing the drinks - a good system as we got the drinks very quickly. The person taking orders was very patient with us as we took our time to decide. The drinks were very well made and tasted fresh!
Friendly staff, good lunch specials. Great value for the money. Nice relaxing atmosphere, sushi lunch deal includes soup and spring roll. 2 rolls for 9, 3!for 11$.

Yum!!!!! This place was fantastic! My family ordered several Thai dishes and we were not disappointed. We got the duck basil, the panang curry with pork, the panang curry with seafood, and the prig pao with seafood. The service was great and the waiter was very friendly. My only complaint was that the crab Rangoon was too small (but tasty).

I usually love this place but tonight we went in and no one spoke. So I looked around 2 kids on their cell phones oblivious. Come on guys. Makes me want to order online. Much less the case of dog food went up 4.00. Not a happy camper tonight.

This is the worse Starbucks ever!! Take forever even when not that busy. So disorganized. Like cmon I've been to Starbucks that was faster with like 20 times more customers. 

Need to fire the people and start over. Brutal wait here every time!!!

Grabbed some take out from here as a last minute change of plans. We ordered chicken and green beans and chicken and vegetables. We also had the crab wontons. 
The food was pretty average. Nothing stood out, but everything was good. I'd def go back and try some other things!

This was our first visit to Ahi Asian Bistro and we were very pleased. We were looking for a sushi for my birthday and decided to try this spot that we've being meaning to stop at for awhile. They did not disappoint. The pictures below were just some of the items we ordered, I forgot to take pics of the others but everything was delicious. The server was Ethan, he was fantastic and made awesome recommendations. They gave the kids machi ice cream and I got fried cheesecake, which was amazing. The green tea ice cream was also divine. We have another sushi spot that was our go to spot but I think we may have found a new one.

Philly take on a chain of clubs. Girls - 8/10;  remember that they are there to make money!!!  Boobies  - nice with few "bolt ons"; Drinks were ok - no complaints, though a bit pricey. All in all a 7, but only because it is such a small place. Just no room to move around.

We ordered by phone, which took 30-45 min. on the weekend, def. give them extra time due to surge of delivery requests, even though it's close to us, the convenience of delivery is nice & hellooo, we're living in a pandemic. 

The pizza was freakin' delish w/pepperoncini, sausage & chicken.

We were missing two sides, ranch & garlic sauce that we paid for it. I didn't know until he told me, but my hubs went online, entered receipt code & it gave him an option for a refund, a 20% coupon or a free pizza.

I'm surprised he did this because he rarely complains about anything.

The 20% is a better deal only if you are getting a big order, so we went with a free pizza for next time.

Come for the staff. They are knowledgeable about the items they sell and are very friendly and willing to help. I like it for the fact that it is smaller than the other box stores. Able to get in and get out quickly!

Recently bought an RV from Pedeta and the size, style and amenities I was looking for.  The sales staff was very nice and easy to work with.  The service department took the time and showed me the ins and outs of the RV.  These two parts of Pedeta deserve 5 stars.

I downgraded the review because of difficulties I had with the coach after the sale.  On the 1st major climb on the way home (same day as sale), the motor started overheating.  I informed the Pedeta staff.  The coach was still drivable but struggled during climbs because of a faulty temp sensor, late thermostat opening, and a few other problems.  I was told to take it to my local Cummins dealership by Pedeta.  The repair bill totaled $4200+.  After negotiations, Pedeta paid for $2300 of the repairs.  I'm reasonably happy since I'm not sure Pedeta had to pay fir any repairs (I'm not a lawyer), but not as happy as I would be if Pedeta paid for the full cost of repairs.  Hence the 3 star rating.

This business posts fake ads showing sold vehicles just to lure you in to get the hard sell. Unethical practices like this will keep honest buyers from coming here. I encourage all to not go here for an RV or trailer.

Maaaaaan I've been following them on IG for a few months dreaming of their crispy wings and tonight I finally had the pleasure of trying . Ordered the wings, cauliflower and potato salad . All were amazing. Normally potato salad is potato salad and somewhat basic but this was different - spicy and creamy and amazing . Will def be ordering again !
Great food, service, and atmosphere! Recommend trying this hidden gem out. It's been my go to for years.

Today I purchased a vehicle from Pedata RV.  Again, I had nothing but an amazing experience with this company. Honest, professional and really go above and beyond helping you find exactly what you are looking for. .  I am just sorry I wasted my time looking around.  I HIGHLY recommend them.

I went to a Friday night service at the beginning of May and we barely reached a minyan.  According to a few of the members I spoke with before the service, this place is in the process of overhauling its identity.  They are officially affiliated with the USCJ and use the Conservative prayer book, but the rabbi and cantor are Reconstructionist and they have photocopies of prayers from the Reconstructionist prayer book as alternate readings, and a lot of the tunes they used were Reform.  It felt a little bit hippy-ish to me.

I received my food from Mr. Giggles who was snickering and didn't even look at me, and when I received it his manager girlfriend started laughing as well. WTF? If this doesn't make you wonder about what he did to my food I don't know what would. Can you say spit on the burger? Very unprofessional! How about a thank you come again or do you want or need anything else? 01-29-13
Best duck curry I've had in at least 5 years. I almost cried it was so good. $5 eel roll just wow fantastic value! Coming back again tomorrow or ASAP.
One of favorite places to order great food items and my personal dish here are the sushi rolls. We love to order food to go or dine-in. Your truly family at Rogers Place. Thank you Ahi Asian Bistro!

Been coming every month for about 10 years.  Food is always great.  Locally owned and friendly family.  Lunch special is a crazy good deal - soup, entree, crab puff, fried rice for $6-7.  Ppl complaining about portion size are obviously American fat-asses, cause I'm 6'1 and 250 lbs and it's still a great lunch.  The dinner portion is always enough to have left overs.  Favorites: Kung Pao Chicken, Cashew Chicken, Mongolian Beef, Spicy Tofu, Chow Main.

We had a fantastic experience. Went in to see a certain motorhome and found an even better one. Not pushy at all. Very helpful and accommodating. They did all that they promised and we absolutely love our new motorhome
Thank you

My husband and I were looking for a new sushi restaurant to try, and our friend suggested trying Ahi Asian Bistro. It's located off of Dale Mabry, in the Michaels shopping plaza. 

The inside of the restaurant is clean and cozy. Our visit was pre-COVID, and it is a romantic place for a date. Their sushi menu will wow the most seasoned sushi eater. My husband and I were blown away by the freshness of their fish and the variety of rolls available to order.

The owner and staff are very courteous and attentive. When we asked questions, our server helped us or went to the chef for clarification. 

We started our meal with a Seaweed Salad, since that is my husband's favorite side dish to go with sushi. 

We also ordered the Sea Scallop Delight Nigiri, which is sea scallop prepared in a creamy mayo sauce, topped with roe and served without rice on cucumber. I love the decadence of creamy scallop, and the serving is more than generous for the price.

Their traditional rolls can be made into handrolls, so we ordered the following:
- Salmon Skin Handroll: crispy fried salmon skin, carrots and cucmber. This is my husband's favorite handroll and he loved the crunch on it. This handroll is best eaten right away for maximum crunch.
- Philly: krab, cream cheese and avocado. 
- Spicy Tuna: marinated spicy tuna with cucumber.

We also ordered full sized rolls from the 3 for $30 Special - You can choose 3 special rolls for $30 all day, every day! 

The three we chose were:
- Volcano Roll: an avocado, cream cheese, and cucumber roll topped with baked krab and roe on top. Many places make volcano rolls, but Ahi Asian Bistro perfected the baked krab on top. It's not too creamy and it doesn't overload the roll underneath. Love this roll! 
- Crunchy Salmon Roll: no rice, salmon, avocado, asparagus, and snow crab mix, then panko fried and topped with sweet chili sauce. This is a good cooked sushi roll for those who don't prefer to eat raw fish. The panko adds a light crunch to the outside and the inside is not dried out. 
- Rainbow Roll: a krab and cucumber roll topped with tuna, salmon, yellowtail, escolar, and avocado. This roll has clean flavor throughout. This is a great introductory roll for new sushi eaters and has a nice variety of fish on it.

We also received free veggie rolls when you check-in on Yelp. 

Overall, my husband and I had an excellent dinner at Ahi Asian Bistro. From the service to the quality of food, you'll have an excellent dining experience here. We'll definitely be back to try more sushi!

This Domino's is consistently EXCELLENT!  Each time I walk in I feel as if I am walking into a friend's home.  The staff is normally very, very nice and very welcoming.  I all starts with the owner or manager who is always there.  I do not know his name, but he is around late 30's or early 40's and just super happy doing what he is doing.  He talks to his staff with respect and has fun at the same time.  The pizzas are always ready when I walk in, I get them handed to me with a smile, they thank me with a sincere voice for coming in, AND the pizzas are GREAT.

I like this pet store because they give out coupons on a regular basis. My cats can only eat Natural Balance so I get their wet and dry food here. Plus the kitty litter I use is on sale a lot so I stock up during those sales. The same goes for the cat treats. I bought squirrel food and wild bird seed on this last trip and found the prices to be a bit more than where I usually get them (Lowes) but I didn't have to time to hit up both stores that day so bought as a convenience. I will stick to the other store for those 2 items. There are also birds and bunnies to buy and fish. There is also a cat rescue organization who always have cats and/or kittens to adopt there. I am tempted every time but already have my hands full with 2 kitties that don't always get along.

It's just okay. I wasn't throughly impressed with any of the rolls I ordered. The beer was nice and cold and the complimentary spring roll was hot and delicious. I was one of 2 tables in the place when I first arrived and then became the only table. I was a little annoyed at the young, sushi chef listening to his phone at a high volume, while I was eating. I didn't say anything, but won't be back.

My family went to Ahi Asian Bistro on 8/16/20 for the first time.    The food was excellent and the service was awesome.   We ordered so much food and were surprised we ate it all.   We ordered about 4 rolls that came on a boat, beef pad Thai, sampler platter, chicken satay, and the ahi tuna plate.   Everything was awesome.  Then we decided to stuff our faces even more by sharing the tempura cheesecake and Thai donuts.   They were both great!!  But the Thai donuts were not your normal Thai donuts.   They were flakey and light.   So good.   I look forward to going back again.

Everytime we are in the area we usually grab lunch at this clean little Chinese restaurant. Lunch is a bargain, starting at $6.50. and though I've tried a bunch of entrees, I just love their Mongolian beef. Tender velveted beef (a must IMO), simple fried rice, okay egg flower soup (though a bit on the to much gel side, and a bit bland - upgrade to the wonton or hot and sour if you want something tastier). We've had a variety of appetizers at night (salt & pepper calamari stands out), and dinner off the bigger menu is, as expected, a bit more luxurious. Fresh tasting food, fast and super friendly service, clean and always busy! Again, service is great. If you have a big appetite, the serving sizes are on the small side. Other than that, it's a nice reliable stop for some traditional Chinese food. If I could give it 3.5 (only because of portion size), I would think that's more accurate. Again, service is great and lots of regular customers.

The girls are nice, I knew some girls who worked there so I went there to visit them.  That probably made it more fun, but once you're drinking, you actually stop worrying about how everyone looks.  

Though I remember a girl asking me if she could give me a dance and that she was pregnant.  I felt bad and didn't know what to say.  

Some of the girls are alright, but their personalities rocked.  After a bit, most of them learned my name, and people were generally nice.  

It is small, and the ceiling is low so don't expect entirely too much.

Made an order through Door Dash, which said food would be ready in 30-45 minutes. Went to the restaurant 30 minutes later and they said food was not even started, he didn't see a door dash order. This is not the first time the amount of time quoted by them or on their behalf for food being ready was completely underestimated (also has happened when we called orders directly to the restaurant). Then the gentleman working the counter said it would be another 45 minutes before the food would be ready and showed no amount of remorse that he missed seeing the order entirely. He seemed completely disorganized.

Who has 1.5 hours to wait for mediocre chinese food? No thanks: we won't be ordering from here again.

First thing first, difficult to find if you are using Google maps. Takes you to a hotel, lucky for us, the valet knew exactly what we were looking for.
So yeah, this place is small, some chairs, small stage and some cute dancers. We were there on a Saturday around 8, had some beers gave some dollars. 
I gotta say, there were three dancers there that were awesome. Lennon was one, super cute, don't remember the second but she liked to talk (even got in trouble) but the third. OMG, knock your socks right off. She was half Asian (maybe Japanese) and something else. This girl made you want to give her your money, trust me when I tell you put your dollars in your mouth tilt your head back. definitely one of the best dancers I've seen.

Decided to stop here on a whim on Sunday (never eat at Sonic) and if I could give it negative stars I would.  Food was below sub par and made both my husband and I sick over the next 24 hours.  I reached out to customer service to tell them of our experience and they offered me two free cheeseburgers WITH purchase.  Really?  I just told you that your burgers made us sick so the solution is to offer more crumby food only if I purchase something else?  Wow!  Stick with Wendy's, In and Out, heck, even McDonalds burgers are better than this.

Wow, am I glad this location delivers to my new place. I had no idea Dominos could be so delish! 

My gluten free pie was delivered fast, hot and looked exactly the way it was ordered. Chicken, mushrooms, spinach, roasted red peppers on creamy garlic sauce. Everything seemed so fresh. It was love at first bite. 

Much better gluten-free options, prices and service than the local competition. Otherwise, the best gluten free pies are at pricier restaurants out of delivery range. Sometimes all I need is a cheese pizza at my front doorstep.

Downloading the app and using it to order earned me a free pizza. Worth it if you plan on ordering more than once!
Was looking for a new sushi restaurant so we decided to try this place. The menu sounded good. The sushi was cheap sushi..all the rolls we ordered tasted the same. Never again

I tried the volcano roll, citrus roll, California roll, Elle roll, and something else. Nothing was outstanding. However they did have very good crab Rangoon. I'll be back to try their Thai since it seems to be really popular and update the rating.

Went here after drinking up a storm with a very drunk friend of mine...total disaster as my friend was uncontrollably drunk and the dancers were totally below average. They were really hustlin' on giving lap dances, though. Gotta give'em credits for that...

Even with my beer goggles on, I couldn't help but to cringe at the dancers. BUT if the occasion calls for it, I'll probably be back at this joint.. with a bottle of anti-bacterial sanitizer.

Amazing food and incredible staff. The best Asian food I've had in Tampa! Everytime I come the food is so consistent. After a few times the owner, Roger, started to suggest and even create dishes for me surprising me every time. Some of the flavors are so strong but so clean. We have introduced many friends to Ahi and each and everyone has loved it and started to spread the knowledge of this wonderful little gem.

Ahi Asian Bistro is serving up some tasty dishes across the Thai and Japanese cuisine spectrum.  This chef owned business, by Chef/Owner Roger Lama, brings with it, the chef's lengthy repertoire of working of many other Thai and Japanese restaurants where he seems to have honed his skills as well as formed his unique touch of preparing some top-notch specialty dishes.  The staff here are all very caring of their patrons, and the chef personally takes an interest in getting to know each of his customers (when not dealing with a full-house) and always offers to customize and tweak your order if you so wish.  During both my visits, I requested for the special of the day, and both times I was blown away by the unique flavors of dish.  Pictured with this review is a special dish - "Curry Beef Udon Soup", bursting with a combination of Thai flavors with a slight touch of South East Asian flare.  In conversations, I discovered that Roger has cultural roots in Nepal, and nepalese flavors influence his unique touch in the kitchen.

Ahi Asian Bistro is surely a gem and if the full-house during weekends isn't a proof of that, go there in the afternoon or early evenings, get to know the owner/chef and try one of his recommended dish.  If by then you are still not a fan,  message me, and I'll cover your following bill at this place. :-)
Used to be good. Not this time. What happened? Not one of the four of us wanted their leftovers.

Amazing Everytime. Love  the fact they still have Dine in. Miss my Bar though. Warm sake to Start  5 Dollar  Rolls Got Smashed! 2 for 5$ drinks  sister had pad Thai. Nice and  
 spicy

We love Golden Dragon and it's been our go-to take out for years. The portion sizes are generous and I haven't had something that I didn't like. I love their low-main and lettuce wraps. Sometimes they also offer coupons for free crab puffs.

Mozzarella sticks are so so (as I crinkle my nose), the dipping sauce helps to kick them up a notch.  The hubby would give the burger 4 stars.  He stated it is actually pretty tasty for a quick drive thru burger.  We normally receive great customer service, with smiling clerks.  Unfortunately, not sure if our clerk this night wanted to be at work.  Of course Sonic is our go to for shakes.  Can't beat the selection.

We purchased  a used 2017 RV that is in great shape and exactly what we were looking for, right down to the color.  Taylor made sure that the coach was what we needed and put together a great deal for us.  We are very happy with how everyone at Pedata RV treated us and how quickly the paperwork was signed with no hard pressure upsetting.  The walk through on the coach was very through and all of our questions were answered correctly.  Over all Pedata was a great company to purchase our newest rv from.

Stopped in for a quick lunch. Service was friendly and fast. They have a big menu with plenty of pictures. I went for the sashimi lunch special. Came with soup and a spring roll. The sashimi was very fresh, the salmon (my favorite) was exceptional. The cucumber and seaweed salads as well as the crab rangoon were great. The box also came with rice, but I couldn't finish it all! I did enjoy the fresh melon for dessert though. Well worth the $12. Will definitely be back!
This is one of the neatest coffee shops I've been to. They have great coffee and it's really fun looking around. The only con is they don't have a lot of seating.

Tessa was our delivery driver and definitely a keeper!!  We put in the notes we needed paper plates and Tessa stopped on her way to get us plates.  Love it when associates go above and beyond for their customers!!!

Ordered chicken parm and vodka penne for take out. It was ready in 20 minutes , friendly service and was DELICIOUS. Huge piece of chicken and large serving of vodka penne. Can't wait to try more item menus.

I purchased a Safari Trek motorhome from Pedata RV Center in Tucson, Arizona.
Pedata thoroughly went over my motorhome, made repairs, replaced parts and didn't deliver the coach to me until I was completely satisfied.
My sales rep, Chris Burden is the best.  So knowledgeable in all aspects of the Motorhome Industry.  He guided me through the whole process and is a very honest person.
If you are looking to purchase a motorhome at Pedata RV Center make sure you ask for Chris Burden/salesman.

First I thought; over eleven dollars for take out lunch was a bit much, for curry beef and white rice, definitely was  not impressed by the small T.V. Lunch Tray, I did not take noticed until I got home.  Very little beef in Curry Panang.  I asked for Thai hot; did not taste hot, had an o.k. taste but I have had much better o.k. Thai food, not sure what the 5 stars are all about.  Restaurant smelled like old cooking oil, so I waited outside, waiter was nice to offer me ice water.

Some dishes are better than others. Some are just frozen fried chicken chunks with bottled sauce and others are completely homemade and really good. Oddly the Moo Shu lunch special is tiny considering it is just cabbage but it is one of the from scratch dishes and is wokked correctly and is great.

Here we are in End September and still don't have our title and registration stuff. If I could give No Stars !! I certainly would!! BUYERS BEWARE!! This was purchased in May!! No one at Pedata wants to help. They keep referring me back to the Bank!!!  STAY AWAY!!

This place is a good bet for some old school "adult" entertainment, but don't expect to fall in love with the dancers. As Alexandra T says, they're generally very nice but all I can remember about my last visit there is the woman who wouldn't stop talking about her five kids while trying to get my dude to give her a dollar. Buzzkill.

It's super tiny and the bathrooms are gross, but if you like a little laughter with your T&A, the Gold Club is your place.

This is one of the best sushi places in the area. Every time we go in the staff is VERY friendly and welcoming. The food is always amazing, Thai tea is perfect. We try something new every time we go in and have not been disappointed. Their prices are very reasonable for the quality and quantity you receive. They have great specials on their sushi. Friendly and welcoming staff has made us regulars at this location. Definitely a hidden gem in the Carrollwood area. A must try if you are in the area!

First time ordering take away from this Thai restaurant. We tried the red curry, Penang curry, Pad See Ew and chicken satay. Both curries were rich and tasteful, loved the consistency of the curry but I didn't care for the meat cut. We had all 3 dishes with pork and it was cut thick, chunky and dry, not thin sliced like we prefer. Same issue with the chicken satay, it was super dry but the flavor was great! The peanut dipping sauce was thinner than I like, but that's just a preference. The flavor of all 4 dishes was great

I want to give this 2 1/2 stars but since I can not give 1/2 stars (thanks YELP!) I will give it 3.

My friend is going to be hosted a bachelor party for a mutual friend of ours and he asked me my input on possible locations, I do not visit strip clubs too often so my knowledge is limited. My friend decides that we should probably do some research then, who am I to oblige.

Went there on a Friday night.


All the reviews are correct this place the place is difficult to find and very small. There is 1 stage that is probably about 8 feet long and 4 feet wide. The bar can only allow for 4 or 5 patrons to sit at. Drinks were priced moderately high to high for this type of establishment. There is 3 rows of chairs and each row probably had 8 chairs in it. They are very confided so not too much leg room and the girls who come around for the dollar parade have to navigate through it. The talent was average at best, one or two moderately attractive young girls and the rest were past prime.

The good was that because it is a small place you are close to the stage and the action. Another positive was the lap dance area was very private.
Disaster purchasing from them.  Do not buy anything. From Pedata RV.  They deserve a zero star.

Great local Chinese food. Consistently good. Cashew Chicken, Mongolian Beef, Khan's Beef & Shrimp, Hot & Sour Soup, Spicy Tofu, Fried Rice, they make all the basics so well.  This isn't gourmet pushing boundaries cuisine (which can be good at times too), it is straight forward wonderfully cooked Chinese with rich sauces that puts places like PF Changs to shame.

I was at this joint running a tab recently & purchased 3 drinks, left without closing tab & get a call the next day from bank notifying me of  2 separate $150 charges. These low life's charged my card extra $ for drinks I never purchased & an extra $150 for a 10th anniversary guest list charge that I never agreed to. Stay away from this place, they are scam artists. I was so furious I tipped off bbb & IRS.

This place was interesting to say the least.

The drinks are watered down & overpriced, and many of the stage dancers are lackluster. I think it's a little odd/guilt-trippy when the dancers come off stage and ask if you'd like to tip them. I mean, if I wanted to, I'd go up to the stage and do so! One of the (drunk) dancers had a convo w me in the bathroom about finding out she was pregnant, that culminated  in me holding her hair while she puked in the sink.
Honestly, I wouldn't recommend this place at all, except for entertainment value and Nina. 
Nina is one of maybe 4 very beautiful women who make going to this place worthwhile (besides pure comedy). She gives a crazy lap dance - bought my friend his first one from her. I don't know what the "official" rules are, but she told us "You can touch anything that's not covered", which was everything but about 6cm covered by the hint of a g-string.
After the dance, she came and hung out at our table and we talked about piercings and some other randomness. Some of the dancers seem a bit bored, and seem to like talking to people, without freaking them out or badgering for tips. 
Gold Club is good place to spice up a potentially dull night with boobs and comedy.

Dont' diss on fake meat before you try it. I happen to have a lot of vegetarian friends so we came here for lunch one day and I'd have to say that a lot of the food here is pretty decent and tasty. The consistency of the "meat" is a little different, more rubbery, but most of it is fried anyway to give it a little crisp too.

The sizzling black bean beef and pepper beef are amongst my favorites, but lots of dishes deserve at least a try. Just come here with an open mind and palate and enjoy yourself.
Golden dragon special ... the basket was chewy.. food is bland.  Much better places to go

My first time here... Absolutely excellent! For appetizers, we had spring rolls, baby octopus salad, and the the amazing "dragon ball" which is sushi inside a ball of avocado slices. Duck teriyaki special was fantastic; the duck was cooked perfectly. I loved the rainbow roll with its thick slices of sashimi on top, and the area 51 roll is unique and delicious. I could go on, but I gotta talk about the service which was fast and friendly... Perfect really. The sushi chef even entertained my doc year old for about 15 minutes describing how he makes the sushi. She was thoroughly entertained. Lovely experience.

Really nice, comfortable restaurant with Japanese and Thai favorites. This place has the BEST PAD THAI I'VE HAD IN DECADES! Also highly recommend Salt and Pepper stir fry with tofu, but really, you can't go wrong. We are regulars for life.

Good grief. How much change can a few months make. Just did a carry out. Everything was really bad. 
Cold. Gluey. Weird taste. Stale oil on egg rolls. Old food. 
No rice included with food.
Just awful. Threw it away. 
What happened to this nice little local place?

What a lovely surprise to find our favorite Habachi chef is now the new owner of Ahi Asian Bistro. We were warmly greeted and sat at the sushi bar.  We all decided the lunch specials were the best choice. Not only are they reasonably priced, but the quality of the sashimi was impressive. They don't skimp on serving sizes either. Being a family oriented business, the chefs make you feel a part of their Ahi Asian Bistro family.
Love this place!!  One of those hole in the wall gems with great food and friendly staff. Highly recommend, um, everything!  Haven't been disappointed yet and never will.

Rude customer service over the phone. Preferred model came up under their website (http://www.pedatarvcenter.com) and yet salesperson insisted it did not.  His manner was condescending and disrespectful. Then he proceeded to hang up on me!!

Avoid at all costs. This business would get negative stars if I could give it that!!

Love this place!  The food is excellent!  Lots of creative options and super tasty rolls. The owner is amazing and willing to do custom ideas. He is very hands on and makes you feel special.   It's not the closest sushi place to me that for sure but it's worth driving 30 minutes to!   Try it you won't be disappointed.

I am giving such a low review not because of the food but the service. The food was great, flavorful and rich. The dining experience was horrible. They have some fob lady cleaning plates from the tables. First I barely can understand her because her accent is so damn thick, and second she kept on grabbing our plates when clearly there was food on it, and we weren't even finished. My god can you just freaking wait like ten minutes! Forget this place, if you eat slow because your plate is gonna be yanked!!!!! Eat fast or your screwed. I'll i felt was rushed!!!
I really enjoyed their coffee and the decor is really neat. Lots of seating so it's great for students. Staff is very friendly.

We were in the area looking for some place new to have dinner. This place had good yelp reviews so we thought we'd give it a try. Glad we did. 

When I first walked in it was empty. (We later found out they had only been open a week) Looking around it was clean and very tasteful decorated. The sushi bar looked really good and the menu had lots of Thai entrees to choose from. 

We started off with the area 51 roll as well as the spicy tuna roll. Since it was our first time there, I went with the classic chicken pad Thai. My husband ordered the sweet and sour pork which came with rice. The portions were a nice size. Food was really good. They do offer happy hour on certain sushi rolls. 

The service was fantastic. We met the owner who was friendly and made us laugh. He tells us they've been very busy during lunchtime. Looking at the lunch menu, I can see why.

This was the sushi restaurant of my dreams from New York. The service was outstanding the gentleman who helped us look through the menu explained everything. We enjoyed the most delightful Toro ,the most delicious monkfish liver yes Boon- that's for you. Prices was right service was on please stop by give these guys your business because they deserve it. Plenty of parking in the shopping plaza.
We tried the Area 51 roll - delicious .Also the fried red snapper in coconut curry.
Could not resist the fried ice cream at the end of the meal don't miss it it's well worth it.

Well...  I got a little awkward story about the first time I ever went to The Gold Club.  

So this place used to be a dumpy strip club called The Office (perfect material for so many puns).  It was dark, dirty, seedy, used to have pool tables, and quite questionable dancers until one day it closed.

Sometime later The Gold Club emerged.  As much as I try to avoid strip clubs because they make me feel really uncomfortable, I ended up here for a friend's birthday.  I pretty much just sat in the back trying to avoid any contact with everyone until the dreaded moment I had to pee. 

Looking around, I see a hallway with a door and think that must be it.  Boy was I wrong!   I walk over, open the door, walk straight in, ...oh geez!  Turned out to be the dancers' dressing/undressing room.  My jaw dropped.  I was stunned at how bad I just straight up fucked up.  I seriously thought I was about to get the shit beat out of me by all the bouncers.  Thankfully this one nice woman walks up to me completely buck ass naked, picks my jaw up off the floor and says "Honey, you lost?"  I completely digress into a little boy and answer "Yes, ma'am."   She says it's ok, takes my hand, and (still completely naked) walks me out, through the club, past all my friends, and to the bathroom.  She drops me off, pats me on the butt and says "Here you go, honey".  I've never felt so bashful before in my life.  I then noticed the bathroom attendant laughing at me out loud.  All I could really do was just laugh with him.  

I left soon after that, but not before telling all my friends what happened so they could also have a good laugh at my expense.  

It was one of those nights I was thankful I don't really get embarrassed and also that I thrive on awkward situations.  

My Synopsis of the Gold Club: 
-Quite the Dive for a strip club
-Girls aren't busted
-Not a place for a big party or anything, but alright if you like seeing naked people and have a few laughs.

PS-I'm trying to never go back.
Absolutely the best asian food in Tampa. Clean bathrooms, phenomenal cooks and I have even counted my coins to be able to go there!

Ordered take out, everything came as it should have. Was very clean and easy pickup from an online order. Always pleased with the quality here and pricing. Solid places, been going for a few years now.

My sister had purchased a trailer from them 5 years ago and was very happy with their service and sales. Last week I needed a brake controller installed on a truck and went to them for assistance.

Mark in service was excellent and bent over backwards to help and the charges were lower than the estimate was, so was very happy. Could not recommend them highly enough!

i try so hard to give this location multiple chances but every single time they disappoint. why the frick am i asking for extra candy and PAYING for extra candy to be  added to my blast and then they try to play me by only putting the candy on the top ???? it really sucks because i look forward to it and then i just have a whole cup full of plain ice cream??

Had my birthday party there in January, what a great experience! It was the third stop that night for our group, so the manager was expecting us and everything went smoothly. The bottle service we ordered was waiting for us and the entire staff was friendly to our group. Dancers on staff vary in body types, so there is a dancer there for everyone's preference. I highly recommend stopping by the club, have a drink & take a look, and book in advance if your taking your group out for the night.

Really good sushi ! Super friendly staff! I will highly recommend this place to friends and family. The staff was great with my 17m son. Very patient with him.
Thank you !

Food what good I wish there would have been balance of veggies in my my pnanag curry . Overall it was considering I ordered the wrong curry forgot to select chicken pnanag so needed up tofu it was still good

Found this restaurant on Yelp looking for a Sushi restaurant for my sister in law's birthday.  Not only was the sushi fresh and amazing but the Thai Food and Hibachi were delicious as well!  So many great options to choose from.  Will be back to try more!
Ethan our waiter was very informative and helpful and provided top notch customer service.
5 star for this fantastic restaurant find!!  
Support local businesses.

Bought a 35ft Itasca motor home from these folks.  The first thing to understand is that this is a 'no frills' dealership.  They specialize in re-sell and 'consignment '. The good news is that this means you will get your coach at a better price than a large dealership.  While they are a very small dealership, they do go the extra mile to make sure that buyers are satisfied.  I highly recommend them and only took off 1 star because I do think they should upgrade their facilities a little.... they operate out of small, old manufactured trailers and I would recommend that they build a little better facilities for the comfort of their customers. Mitch was our salesman...

This place is AMAZING! We really enjoyed it! The sushi was delicious! If your looking for the best sushi in the area of brush gardens be sure to go check this place out!!! We will be back here again on our next visit!

OK, 4-stars because (and only because) the rabbi is one of the most intelligent rabbis I've ever heard speak. Rare is it that you find a religious leader of any faith who can deliver smart and unbiased speaches/sermons that even academics can find truth in. Seriously, he's good. I think he went to Georgetown Law before becoming a rabbi, so he knows how to present an argument. I remember listening to one of HIS sermons in the midst of an Israel/Arab conflict (intelligent, balanced, realistic) versus listening to other rabbis who give you nothing but pro-Israel propaghanda.

The down side about SHS is the community. Nobody goes on Friday nights, at all. Literally, half the time it seems like they barely get a minyan. It's a shame. And, frankly, the only reason I go to synagogue is to socialize w/ the tribe.

Of course, like all synagogues, the place fills up on the High Holy Days, when you'll get banished to the upper balcony with the bums if you don't have tickets.

This spot needed a current review.!

Take out only , 30 minutes. 
We did the sweet n sour Chicken and kung pau shrimp. 
The chicken pieces are large pieces you have to cut. So large a lot of the flavor Is missing.   So maybe orange chicken next time. Smaller bites. 
The shrimp was better, spicy and vegetables n nuts. I would get it again   
The spring rolls are really good. 
I had seconds.  And the containers are very Large. So we have one more meal for two.

BEWARE! BEWARE! BEWARE!  These guys are horrible to deal with and you would be well advised to steer clear of Pedata RV Cener and the horrific staff that works here.  I first tried working with the infamous Bob Sutherland who can best be characterized as a  pushy and worthless jerk.  Then I had the unsavory experience to try to deal with another sales associate named Bill Harris who proved to be twice as bad. The manager "Donnie" is the leader of this band of crooks who are there to take advantage of you in every way possible!

You may think that you are getting a "bargain" by flying to Tucson to pick up your rig, but wait until you find how bad these guys truly are to deal with.

I sent them a $500 deposit on a $58,000 coach and they turned around and sold it to somebody else the next day before my check even arrived.  I would not provide them with my personal bank numbers over the phone for privacy reasons and chose to mail it to them. Like I said, they sold it to somebody else after my deal was made with Bill Harris. They did not like that I requested a new set of tires  for the rig because the originals were simply worn out. So, you have to fight them "tooth and nail" all the way for everything you request and it is "their way or the highway" at Pedata RV Center in Tucson, AZ.

I got a better deal on line for my 2005 Dolphin LX that had  fewer miles, was in like new condition (unlike the rock-chipped unit that Pedata tried to sell me)  at NORM''S RV IN POWAY, CA.  I also had all new tires installed as part of the deal(Michelins XL's) and the owner  delivered it to me out of state at N/C.
