But this could have been a disaster.) drivers are discourteous, and in the past, they simply didn't show up when my car broke down. And I called them 3x. Choose any other company, or walk. You'll be better off.

We came here with a group of 7 and I'm blown away with the service and how fast the food came out. Our server was amazingly patient and explained all the dishes to us that we had questions on. The food was delicious! The portions are huge! Being that we're out-of-towners and have had Vietnamese food in NYC, I wasn't expecting much but oh man they really knocked my socks off. Tampa, appreciate the fact that you have an amazing Vietnamese spot to indulge at. Definitely a great spot to stop and enjoy some good Pho.

Delicious meal with authentic taste of Indonesia! I was pleasantly surprised with the food and service. I ordered bakso (meatball soup) and ayam goreng (fried chicken), and they both taste like the food made in Jakarta (I lived there for 10 years). Definitely will come back again to try the grilled chicken!
Great food. Really enjoyed the Banh Xeo, egg rolls, Pho, and banh mi. Not many places make banh xeo so I always make it a habit to try it.

Had my first visit with the staff and Dr. Yanez today after recently moving to Philadelphia, and I have nothing but good things to say. If you are unsatisfied with your dentist, look no further!

They've only been around for two years, so the office is very clean and the equipment is all modern (not that stale yellow of machines from the 1960s). Still, I was more impressed with the service and professionalism the entire staff demonstrated. That is what sealed it for me. I was interested in teeth whitening options, and I actually had to bring it up myself, so no hard-selling here.

Last, I'm not sure if they do this for everybody, but the dentist himself actually cleaned my teeth during my first visit. That was a nice touch.

Get on their patient list before it fills up!

I love coming to Thinh An for their pastries!  Their croissants are absolutely the best in town...perfectly flaky and buttery!  The menu is very extensive compared to the rest of the Vietnamese restaurants in town.  With so much to choose from, you'll want to keep coming back to try different things.

Pizza is great (2nd to Nona's on Germantown Ave and Schoolhouse Lane, but not as expensive). If you order toppings on your pizza, beware.......the are SUPER SKIMPY with the toppings. You'd have to order double pepperoni just to get the amount of pepperoni any other pizza place (including cheap ol' Lil Ceasers) would put on their pies. 
Their cheesesteaks, Stromboli and wings are also very good 
The staff has always been friendly to me. I would recommend this restaurant to anybody in the area. 

I just wish they weren't so cheap with applying pizza toppings.

Had fish and chips and it was much more than I could eat. Very nice pieces of white dish. My wife had the Eddie's burger and it was outstanding. We also had the fried pickles and a side of tater tots, both were very good. One other member of the party had French Dip and stated that it was very good. Definitely going back. Well done and we liked the inside remodel.
Love this place! We probably come here twice a week! Never leave disappointed only full! Lychee milk tea is a must try and the pho is always consistent.
This place is OK. It's a little cleaner than the old Super Fresh it replaced and the prices are lower.

There's something really comforting about a great bowl of Pho. This was my first visit here and certainly will not be my last. Our server, Wendy, was very sweet. She offered some great suggestions and we were happily slurping up Pho within minutes.

The people at the table beside us were new to vietnamese cuisine and their server was just as sweet. She patiently explained  the menu to them and answered all of their questions.

Overall, great service and great food.

Preface: 
1.)I've never had Vietnamese cuisine 
2)I went with my Vietnamese friend.
3.)I'm vegan. 

Experience
1.) Friendly & prompt service on a Sunday afternoon at 4:30PM. Yes it was busy, but they were prompt. 
2.) Food was delicious!!! I asked my non-vegan Vietnamese friend to rate it on a scale of 1-5 and she gave it a 4 & said "definitely authentic viet food".  I can't make the "authentic" comparison but in terms of vegan friendly & delicious, yes... 4/5 all day long! Yuumm!!! 
3.) They have a to-go buffet area / bakery which resulted in me spending another $20 in taking home various sticky rice dishes & rolls options. This bar/to-go area was equally busy with people filling up baskets of pre-made foods. 

Soooooo glad we dined here. I will absolutely be adding it to my faves rotation of restaurants!

Long overdue review. 
I've shopped at this Jewel Osco, now Acme, for years. Same good people. Same reliable store.
From the manager, who's been there for years, and exudes pride for running a smooth check out - with the support of her check out and customer service team, to the young man who answered the phone and made sure the store carried cheese cloth when I called to check and the lady in customer service that took me to the exact spot when I looked and couldn't find it - (I was convinced the guy had "misreported" having cheese cloth - love being proven wrong.) **Note: The fact that they had cheese cloth - 6 stars! Packing tape too. And batteries. All when needed at the last minute. It's a super handy, well planned store.
Then there's the lady in the deli department that graciously sliced me 4 slices of American cheese, yes, 4, annoying? One would think but she played it well. The meat dept. guy that helped me out with giving me 3 good, perfectly sized boxes for shipping Christmas presents. These are just a few examples. This is a great, community, neighborhood, corner grocery.
Después de mucho volví a order allá y llego a recoger mi comida y el mesero dice... se me olvido... :o really? Que decepción

The service at this location is almost always poor. The employees hardly ever smile or say hello. The drinks are also bad quality unlike any other Starbucks location I go to. The iced caramel mochiatto always looks like it's been sitting out for a while and the caramel is just sprinkled on top of the drink

This CrossFit gym has it all: camaraderie, challenge, fun, and awesomeness. With Purg, you not only get a body-busting workout, but happy hour fun, group charity events, and a plethora of new friends. I haven't regretted my first step into CrossFit or into this particular gym. 

I used to work out here when I lived in Tucson, and Marcy first introduced me and a bunch of co-workers to CrossFit. I latched on instantly, transferred to Purgatory, and am still into it more than two years later out in San Diego. The owners, Tony and Marcy, and the trainers are top-notch, gregarious, friendly people; they are very competent and committed to helping people get stronger, faster, and better with minimal injury. There's lots of room to play with their new facility, and a kids area. I believe CrossFit Kids is coming to Purg soon, as well. Let's get it!

Stopped by this vietnamese spot for a quick bite to eat. They actually sell various packaged foods, fried foods, meats, and other items on the side. The environment seemed to resemble a fast-casual type of eatery. 

As for the food, the beef pho and banh mi are pretty comparable to Saigon Deli which is located not too far away. I'd say the pho is still better at Saigon, and the banh mi is a bit different as well but still excellent. The beef for the pho isn't as tender or tasty as I would have liked, but still good. They seem to cook their grilled pork and shrimp well. 

I'd give the place a solid 4.5 stars. Prices are good, and they even serve boba tea, though to be honest it's not as good as that of other places. I did not try the deserts or appetizers. Overall, the restaurant has a wide variety of selections, and anyone who comes here will likely find something to enjoy. I'd come back.

Definitely one of the best Viet cuisine restaurants that I have come across in the last 20yrs.

110% recommend it!
This is the best pho ive had in tampa and the only pho i can eat without adding anything to it. Quick. Fresh. Friendly. Clean. Filling. The bakery and boba drinks are great too!

Absolute best shrimp and pork egg rolls!!!!The fish sauce has a special flavor component that sets it apart from other pho establishments, but pairs perfectly with the pork and shrimp egg rolls. This place has a few quirks that sets them apart  that include a bakery, catering and interesting ice cream and cone options. My favorite is the puff cone that looks something like edible bubble wrap:-))))

The food here is absolutely amazing, and being from Brooklyn, we never get Vietnamese food this good. Had the Bun Mang Vit and the duck was so soft and moist, and the udon noodles are phenomenal here as well. Don't leave without having the in-house made tofu, it'll change your world.

I love that this place is opened until 8pm since the other great vietnamese restaurant on waters closes at 5pm. I wish they opened up one in South Tampa so I can get my bbq sandwich fix. 
The bbq sandwich is my favorite.

Also, Frankie Muniz is a regular here and I saw him on my 2nd visit.

Hot fresh flavorful broth.  This is definitely the place to go if your looking for authentic Pho in Philadelphia.  I wish they had a few more menu items and took advantage of the Vietnamese market they is located next to them.  However for only really having 15 menu items 10 of them bien Pho soup they are excellent.  Not what i expected when i first when here.  After sitting down and indulging in the soup, I am not fully recommending this place for anyone look for hot fresh fragrant, flavorful soup.  They are also inexpensive was another upside when, under $15 for two people.

I have been to this Acme on multiple occasions, mostly at night after I get out of work. I have walked in 15 minutes before closing time and was told very rudely that I had to leave and would not be able to purchase anything. I have been told that I couldn't  purchase alcohol after 10pm, even though their signs say nothing about that. I have also had multiple price changes in items that were clearly marked as discounted and would not be sold to me as such. The communication to Acmes customers is not proficient.
Best Phō and spot in this area. The Phō and the pork egg rolls are always great. It's always busy, but servers are always quick to get you a table and service is never more than10 minutes!
Love the atmosphere , food, and their take-out section of prepackaged food!  The food and drinks are amazing and I haven't had an anything I didn't like!

After virtually spending all my money plus my soul over Memorial Day Weekend, I decided I needed to start cooking in.  Everyone that lives in the city understands how much of a pain it is to find a decent grocery store, especially one that's within walking distance, but ACME did the job for me.  

Today I strolled in with the mindset of buying whatever was on sale and just tossing as much seasoning on it to make it edible.  I lucked out.  In one of the meat sections was a buy one get 1 free of pre-packaged and pre-seasoned meat assortments.   I snagged some chicken breasts with panko seasoning and some pork chops with a nice bbq dry rub.  This, along with some veggies, was enough to feed me for about 4 days.  No longer did I have to go complete caveman.  

The rest of the store actually had a lot of reasonable deals going on as well.  I purchased a 4 pack of Dannon Greek yogurt for $3.33 and a 2 pound bag of frozen shrimp was only $12.   Not sure what a normal persons grocery bill would look like, but ACME made it possible to spend all my money at Seacrets (Jamaica USA) and still not have to eat Ramen.  Thank you, ACME.

Since my last review I have ordered from Takka quite a few times and the place has gotten MUCH better.

Their cheesesteaks are among the best I've had along with their fries and their honey mustard dip is divine!  I wish I could bottle it!

And McDonald's has NOTHING on their chicken nuggets platter!  

So bravo to the MUCH improved Takka's!

This is my new favorite Vietnamese spot in all of Tampa! The fried egg rolls and spring rolls are a great starter to what's about to transpire with the amazing Pho options at this place! I went with the combination Pho with seafood and pork and had them spice it up! I ended the meal with an avocado, banana and coconut smoothie! Amazing!

There's a new Banh mi sheriff in town.  For the Viet people, if you are familiar with Ba Le in San Jose and Dallas, it's the same recipe here by the same "chef" so it is a very legitimate taste you know and come to recognize.  They make the same baguette too on site so it's a complete fresh made one stop operation.  You can even buy the special mayo, pate, cold cut, and baguette to take home and assemble your own banh mi thit at home.  Very happy that it's here now in Tampa.  Same goes with the fresh or fried tofu and soy milk. 
I'm docking a star because of the disappointing bun bo hue and hu tieu that I tried.  The broth was a bit lacking.  Pho is pretty decent.  Also the only size they have is large and x-tra large which is too large when I like to get a coffee, maybe appetizer, and sweet dessert with the meal.
Overall big thumbs up for the to go area.  We'll be regular customers for sure now.

I love Pho and have tried about every restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. Came here yesterday and had a good experience.ordered Pho Tai and the large was big enough to fill me up. As others say the broth seemed cleaner and less fattening than some other pho places around here. Broth was satisfying but still not my favorite in the area. Noodles cooked right and meet was good.

One thing that stood out is that the service was as good as it gets for Asian restaurants. Moreover the restaurant is very clean, the veggies that came with the pho were fresh which is not always the case at other viet restaurants.

Half the staff was no. Asian. I think management has made it a point to emphasize good service. While this is not my favorite pho in Tampa bay it is very good and I will add to my rotation

An awesome addition to Girard Estates! Understanding that they just opened and there will be some hiccups here and there, overall we were all happy with our meals. As none of our party were familiar with the items on the menu, our sever happily explained each dish. Once the meals arrived, we had some additional questions, as some of the dishes have 2 separate components, so I asked "how do you recommend eating this" and they were happy to explain! The space is bright and clean. Prices are extremely reasonable !

Delicious food and a very friendly staff! I had nasi ayam goreng. So good. I could have just eaten a plate full of the fried tofu, but the chicken is also very tasty. I tried the "happy soda," and while I'm not 100% sure what was going on with it, but it was yummy and the jelly was fun.

Love this place.  Went there for the first time last night and had the scallop appetizer, eggplant appetizer, and shrimp entree.  Everything was seasoned perfectly and came out in a timely manner.  The waitstaff was friendly and accommodating and at no time did we feel rushed, despite the fact that it was a busy Saturday night.  The apple dessert was amazing as well.  Highly recommend.

If you're looking for the vegetarian items on the menu just keep scrolling. I ordered the veggie meal w/ tofu and veggies. I was surprised that the tofu was fried however is was cooked very well. The rice was tasty however the veggies were odd. By odd I mean you don't get traditional veggies you get a salad. The salad had carrots and also in the box were a few tomatoes and cucumbers. It was strange! The sauce that accompanied the meal was very tasty. Overall I would order this again. They give you a very large portion for a reasonable price.
The service is very good. The atmosphere is very nice and clean too. I recommend bun bo hue and duck with noodles.

I CAN'T BELIEVE I HAVEN'T VISITED SOONER
It seemed every table was taken up for a weeknight dinner yet we were seated fairly quickly. Families, old and young, Asian and non-Asian (always a good sign if there's many Asians at an Asian establishment) were present. It's was bustling and lively in there. Even our server was very lively and animated.

OH GOSH THE FOOD YUMMM
Because of their Pho and Bun Bo Hue, I've moved Thinh An into my top 3 Vietnamese restaurants in Tampa Bay. Delicious! Great balance of flavor, spices, and Noodles to fillings. Their Banh Mi was also good- it didn't blow our minds but very solid. Same thing with their Boba drinks and Vietnamese Coffee. 

DON'T FORGET THE LITTLE MARKET
The little grab-and-go market is in one side of the restaurant and is filled with many house made items. We didn't purchase anything from here, but the collection of Kimchi, many forms of Tofu, and other Fried snacks (I don't recognize them) looked very tasty.

This place is fantastic!  I've eaten here once, and it's already my new favorite Vietnamese place.  I had the Bun Bo Hue - spicy beef and rice noodle soup.  My husband had the Pho Tai - noodle soup with rare beef.  My dad had a tofu and citrus soup, and my mom had a tofu broken rice dish.  We also ordered the pork and shrimp fresh rolls and the grilled pork fresh rolls.  Everything was awesome!  So flavorful and fresh.  

The restaurant was clean, and they have this awesome market area.  We also tried the puffy egg waffle, and it was great.  I'm seriously so thrilled that this place is close to my house!

Absolutely the best gym out there for people who are really serious about fitness and looking for a community to help them get where they want to be. I came for the Groupon and stayed for the simply amazing group of people I came to know and love. I had been doing stuff on my own for a long time but there's a real sense of accountability and encouragement from the folks at Purgatory. They make an effort to learn your name right away, figure out your strengths and weaknesses, and help you try new things and work on any problems you have.

If you like to be harassed by the kind people holding the door for you as you enter and exit the store then this wawa is for you..
If you like waiting in line to pay for you stuff as the same kind folks who ask for your change just come and go with anything they please then thi wawa is for you..

This is the first restaurant to ever convince me that Vietnamese food is worth the calories. I don't understand how they can make so many things so well. My go-tos: curry, meatball bahn mi, waffles, pastries, and the Vietnamese desserts. Seriously, the best bahn mi I've had in Florida. The only reason noodles aren't on this list is because the portion size is too big for me to have dessert! Being able to get a life-altering sandwich and dessert for less than $10 in a clean, attractive place (with AC that is actually cold enough for Florida weather) raises Thinh An to unicorn status in my eyes. 

Psst... there is extra parking on the side and in the back. If you come at a peak time there will probably be a wait. They give you a buzzer so it's not awkward like most casual places. If you're paying by card the waiter comes by at the end of your meal with a portable thing you can pay on. It feels so safe and efficient.

Check out the ready-made food too. There's tons of sweet and savory snacks, all ridiculously cheap. You must try the tarts. I probably spend more on snacks here than I do on dining in, but if I come here for lunch I'll be craving it again by dinner...

I really wanted to like it here, but I've decided to move my daughter to a different studio.  I don't even care that I just signed her up for the next season and I'm sure I'll lose all of the fees, I just can't bring myself to go back.  The waiting area is really awful!  I think they have too many classes going on and not a big enough waiting room.  The more I thought about it the more I realized that I don't need to settle for having to sit **ON THE FLOOR**.  Several times it was even hard to walk through the front door because so many parents had to stand in the waiting area.  And as much as they say it's for security, you can't watch the kids through the studio windows because the blinds are closed, and you can't see the them on the TV's unless you're lucky enough to grab a seat right in front of them.  I think they call it Studio A (right before the doors parents aren't allowed to go through), but at the end of class they just let these little 3 year olds walk out without making sure their parents are right there. 

My daughter took Fairy Tale Theater there and a ballet class.  I will say that the teachers were incredibly nice and my daughter was always excited to go...  

One last thing, you have to register online and pay online, but they make it a lot more difficult to cancel online.  Actually it's impossible to cancel online.  You have to print a form and physically bring it down to the office.  I'm going to try scanning and e-mailing it - we'll see if they'll accept that or make me drive in.

If you want my suggestion, remove the little play area outside of that studio, open the blinds, and line up a couple rows of extra seats for the parents.

Third time in a row I have to go back to Acme Flourtown to get refund for items that rang up wrong. Since Manager is too cheap to hire baggers on a Sunday, I can't watch what rings up because I'm busy bagging. They are thieves so check your receipt carefully. Last time was owed over $13.00, no small change,! Guess I'm paying for upkeep of his tan! I'm disgusted with this place.

Five spring breaks ago my wife and I spent a few days in Asheville. The owner of the hostel we were staying in showed us the kitchen and said "Some local commune gave us a bunch of homemade tofu. Feel free to take as much as you want while you are here. You can even take some with you when you go." A solitary tear rolled down my face as I thought about homemade tofu and why Tampa can't seem to get nice things.

Hey, it may have taken until 2016 but thanks to Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu, Tampa finally has gotten nice things (at least in the world of artisanal tofu making). Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu is a unique place. When you walk in half of the business is a restaurant that serves boba tea, Vietnamese desserts, Pho and other traditional Vietnamese dishes. The other half of the building is a grab and go with coolers of homemade tofu, soy milk and various meats that might be necessary for cooking Vietnamese at home. There are also a number of metal trays that hold freshly made items. It was here, in these metal trays, that I found the artisanal tofu I was looking to take home. 

Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu churns out seven different flavors of tofu. When I visited they had only four. These four were original, lemongrass and chili, onion and mushroom. The mushroom and onion were sliced into large rectangles. They were priced at four for a dollar. I filled a miniature plastic baggie with eight of each. The lemongrass and chili came in two forms, large rectangles (like the onion and mushroom) and a block similar to how traditional tofu in a grocery store is sold. I grabbed four of the rectangles and a big block. I was absolutely astounded when they lady rang me up for the block of tofu and it only came out to two dollars. The only place that I have found tofu that cheap in this city is Whole Foods (organic, $1.99) and MD Market (full of GMO's, $1.29).

I would love to say that I waited until I got home and ate that tofu properly but I didn't. I ripped into the rectangles as soon as I got to the car. Each tofu flavoring was subtle, it wasn't going to overwhelm you with whatever it was covered with. I liked that because it gave you the option of eating it with a dipping sauce as is or using it in a recipe. The different tofus had a nice chewy shell on the outside of them. Inside they were soft and creamy, almost like a custard. It was absolutely and without a doubt the best tofu I've ever eaten. J-Fur wasn't as instantaneously taken in as I was. She would not go on record as saying that it was the best tofu she has ever eaten. But when I pressed her to name a place that had better tofu, she couldn't. I took that as a motion seconded.

Best Vietnamese food.  So many versions of pho.  The menu is huge! The food is delicious.  The restaurant has a kind friendly staff.  Prices are reasonable. They make their own soy milk.   The restaurant had a store inside where they sell pastries, fried chicken, soy milk and many other foods.  The main restaurant also sells boba tea (bubble tea) in every type. Slush, regular and several types of flavored boba is offered.  So many choices.  Great food and atmosphere.   Visit often. They are closed Tuesday

I've been to this burger joint many times in the past 2 years, and have always had the best burgers. But the recent change you made to your patties is very disappointing. Adding pork (which the server confirmed) and breadcrumbs was not a good idea. The burger had a pasty and dry consistency and just not the same. In addition I'd highly recommend that you list the burger patty ingredients (beef and pork). The other items on the menu are good and pretty much as expected for a food truck. Good luck with your new recipe!!! If it weren't for the burger I'd give this place 4 stars.

I don't know how I can say enough about my experience here. I was coming from Gentle Dental where I was told I needed different procedures by different doctors. I also later found that the work that was done caused later dental work to be needed. I switched for these reasons, and I came to Dr. Yanez office with a strong dislike for dentistry all together. I arrived a little early while the office was closed but the receptionist Leslie let me in with a huge smile. The office was clean and bright (like perfect teeth!) I filled out paper work and explained that I was on a budget so I would like to know what things would cost me before anything was done and they were more than happy to help. They took X-rays for free because I was a new patient! The lady who took the X-rays talked me through what she needed from me instead of just pushing my head around. When I was seated in my room it was also very clean and private so I didn't have to hear other work being done. While sitting there I found myself thinking that my papers I filled out wouldn't be looked at and I would have to re-answer all the same questions when the doctor came in. But literally JUST as I was thinking that, Leslie came in and said she was reviewing the paper work I wrote and asked me additional questions about SPECIFIC things I wrote! Very impressed! When the doctor came in he was extremely personable and kind. Talkative and definitely made me not think about the terror that I was feeling in my back tooth. He took a look and said I needed a root canal on the same tooth that Gentle Dental worked on not even a year ago! I asked if I extracted the tooth would it change my smile or my face and he said not at all. Then when he told me the price difference I was all for taking that sucker out (keep the tooth if you can though!) He immediately began working, numbed everything painlessly and while he extracted he told me what to expect which is wonderful when you are nervous and feel clueless. Once finished it was a quick transaction to pay and get my prescription slips. Then Leslie read my mind again. I miss when you are a kid and get free toothbrushes, and without saying anything she gave me a new toothbrush, toothpaste and floss! If my amazing experience hasn't convinced you to switch dentists yet, it didn't hurt that they had great Latin music playing quietly throughout the office!! Switch and be glad you did!! Thank you Dr. Yanez for the work you did. My whole family will be switching over shortly (4 more people!). Also got a few coworkers over there!!

They've done a great job with the interior. They've done a great job on the bakery and food Takeaway. My first time visit I think I need to work on more flavor with the PHO soup. It was okay but definitely needs some work. I'm sure this will be done in the months to come as they work out the cakes of eight new restaurant. The summer rolls work priced below what I would think for their size. The shrimp had some smell, maybe because it was sitting out too long. The above said, this will not deter me from making another visit four take home pastries and tofu. I will wait for a a while before going back for the food giving them a chance to adjust.

Best Vietnamese in town. We're here every weekend like clockwork. Superb service too!

Be sure to check out the market as well for seriously good snacks!

Pretty friendly gym. I dropped in for a workout when I was in Tucson for work. The gym is in a massive strip mall and takes a little walking around to find it. I wonder how they do their marketing. Must be word of mouth cuz there are no signs visible from the main road.

I liked the class structure - a strength portion first and then a metcon, similar to what I'm use to back home. The strength that day was back squats, and the metcon was wall balls and toes to bars. The coaching was fine for the most part, but perhaps it was because my group was on a mobile squat rack in a different room from all others that I felt the other two girls in my group didn't get as much coaching as they could've used.

Love this place even little bit far from where I live. Have big dessert bar and assortment of vietnamese  street food. The Pho is not to bad. I just love the dessert drink and little snack. Overall good place to try

Food is 5 stars. No doubt. 

The restaurant just have the soft open. I would said give them a few week to familiar with the serving routine. It is still a chaos now. Beautiful interior design as a desirable to sit down and enjoy. Service is still need to improve. 

You know if a restaurant will make it or not by just tasting the food. This is the restaurant I will repeat in the future. Food is very reasonable price and easy to select - may be not - it has huge selection. I love it. It make me to come back for more. They have good food presentation. Nicely decorated. Fast food chain of America, watch out, I can eat better food here. 

We start with our entrees with Thinh An Special Noodle Soup and the Hue Style Beef Noodle Soup. I like the Thinh An Noodle. It has the clear noodle soup with seafood in it. Very good soup. My wife have spicy hue style beef noodle. Good but I like the special better. Then we move to the grille pork summer roll -  the appetizer. It is good. 

Our desert is what I search for some time. Hong Kong Waffle. They call it egg puff waffle. The waffle is puffy and crispy. Right baking. It come with two scoop of ice cream and two topping. I have the mango and coconut ice cream with assorted mochi and the blue berry mochi. Delicious. 

Advice for the new comer. Come early at dinner before they are busy, get all the order in earlier. For the owner, I think open late and closing late is better. Breakfast usually don't get much sale. Usually people get one item and leave. Dinner people tendency to order more and get more sale. I will update on next visit.

A very warm welcome by the staff and owners.

Great workout, this gym really pushes for max effort!

Very friendly and serious atmosphere the really made me want to push myself.

I was a drop in and you can get two workouts for free if you buy a shirt! good deal

One of my favorite BYOB restaurants in Philly. It's crazy cheap, food is amazing, service is awesome, girard estates neighborhood is the safest in the city. Most authentic Indonesian food in philly as well. Def have the grilled Pompano. It has this smokey flavor that is amazing. The sauces for the apps are amazing too. I just cant believe how inexpensive it is, they should possibly raise their prices a little. Not sure how they make any money with everything so cheap.

Very nice new Vietnamese restaurant that replaces a long standing Korean restaurant and they did an amazing job renovating and rejuvenating a tired space. The outside of the restaurant looks so inviting and I just had to pull on. It seemed pretty busy and fast pace when I came in around the end of lunch time. I don't know if it was the fast techno/house music playing or the fact that servers are rushing full speed around me but I felt like I had to eat quick haha. I got the Vietnamese steamed rice roll which I haven't really found at other Bay Area Vietnamese restaurants and also ordered a fresh shrimp and pork roll as well as a Thai tea. The tea was great but the other two dishes just seemed lacking. The sauces seemed a little watered down, peanut sauce just didn't taste peanutty enough and the fish sauce wasn't pungent or tangy like I've usually had. But food was ok. I also ordered a spring roll, special banh mi, and a egg puff waffle. The waffle seemed super lacking, like I didn't understand if it was supposed to be sweet, fluffy, or crunchy but it wasn't really either. The waffle just seemed dense and flavorless. Was kinda upset to pull open my spring rolls at home and there was no fish sauce inside for my dipping pleasure ! I don't know if this was good or bad cause at least now I can use a more flavorful sauce at home. I think I'll come back to try some more drinks and other dishes and some tofu too, but I won't get my hopes too too high.

Best Vietnamese food.  So many versions of pho.  The menu is huge! The food is delicious.  The restaurant has a kind friendly staff.  Prices are reasonable. They make their own soy milk.   The restaurant had a store inside where they sell pastries, fried chicken, soy milk and many other foods.  The main restaurant also sells boba tea (bubble tea) in every type. Slush, regular and several types of flavored boba is offered.  So many choices.  Great food and atmosphere.   Visit often. They are closed Tuesday

This place is the epitome of authentic Vietnamese cuisine made to serve the mainstream public. A major problem with Vietnamese cuisine is that if the food is good, the service is shitty, the restaurant is rundown, and no one speaks English. If the restaurant is clean, modern, and caters to everyone else as well, the food usually sucks.

They have milk teas, drinks, coffee and dessert here. They also sell to-go food items and have small baked goods (plus fresh french bread). This is a great one-stop shop. We to-go'ed banh mi for the road and that was delicious as well.

This restaurant blew my mind. Food was great, restaurant was nice, clean , and modern. Service was great. Servers spoke English AND Vietnamese AND they even checked up on you. WHAT???!! On top of all that, the prices. We need this in California. They are doing everything right. Props to management.

I love seeing people that aren't Vietnamese, enjoying the cuisine. I'm glad Ramsay and Bourdain helped nudge this cuisine to mainstream.

I just walked out of the Acme at 10th and South empty handed.  I will be buying my beer elsewhere.  I waited in line at the one register available for beer purchases and then the cashier advised me that she would not sell me beer without scanning my license. I am a senior citizen! I did't have my license with me so it was a no go. I can see asking for proof of age if it's in doubt, but come on, I'm and old man.  I also do not believe they are entitled to collect peoples information when making legal purchases. They can asked to see it but should not collect the data.

We ordered several dishes and they were all excellent! The Greek salad is literally covered in chunks of feta and it is huge! I also got the chef salad, the chicken over rice, a roast beef wrap and a hoagie--all were delicious!
This restaurant exceeded our expectations. The spring rolls and the pho is excellent. Great service and clean restaurant.

Great place, delicious smoothies and food.  Brown rice, vermicelli and Pho are so tasteful. Busy for sure so you can take out and get the entire experience. Service was great as well, friendly and attentive.

Great pho. So many choices. It even has a legit kids menu that the picky eaters will enjoy. I brought back a to go Banh Mi pork sandwich for grandpa and even though it was different than his typical "Jersey Mike's" Italian it was completely gone in short order. I highly recommend.
Love the food and the price is right. The Bahn Mi is my favorite, but I have liked everything I eat there.

I agree with with Steve S and Xiao Z here... It's a disaster at this ACME. The cashiers are all clearly miserable. I feel bad for them. It could have something to do with the fact that the other managers/supervisory staff are poorly trained and/or just inherently unprofessional people. I went there the other day to get a book of stamps. The customer service desk was FILTHY, covered in random crap; pretty much emblematic of this location's approach to serving customers. I waited at the desk patiently while staff members behind the desk loudly blamed one and other for losing an over-ride key, complaining amongst themselves as to why there was only one in the store; "Why can't we get another one?!"  "The answer to that is over my pay grade."... I stood there for several minutes but they continued to bicker and complain among themselves as if I wasn't even standing there. It was bazaar. Depressing stuff. I will do my best to go to a different location from now on...

This place used to be Sky Cafe. But after the fire incident, they moved to Washington street and now it opens a new restaurant. The place is clean and renovated, staff were friendly. Ordered ayam bakar meal and Jakarta Noodle and they are pretty good. The menu is still limited and prices are decent. Will definitely go back to try other items.
I called for a pick up the night before, driver came early which was great because I was ready! Very friendly service to tampa airport

This casual Vietnamese restaurant has become ne of my favorite places to go when I visit Tampa.  Everything on the menu us delicious and it is priced extremely reasonably.   If you plan to have desert,  order with your meal.  I will definitely be back!
i love this place! great trainers...great music...great energy...great team mates...great WODs!

Adding another star . In my previous rating from opening I did rate 3  but I'd like to update my rating and say this restaurant is definitely 4quality. There's always room for improvement and I may say their not perfect "yet ". If you're in a hurry I suggest you swing by and grab food that they have on hand. My brother enjoys coming here often but I believe I've been by only ah hand full of times. The staff are friendly and food is ok! 4  because I'm definitely impressed with the vegetarian options available. Fried tofu is always hot and ready and soy bean drink is enjoyable as well. I recommend Hieu Tieu Seafood.

This place is worth the drive from Clearwater. I'm not an expert on Latino food, but it was terrific. The piccata was overwhelming with a wide variety of meats and sausage--- but it really needs two people to dig into it. I come down for spring training every year from Jersey and this place is going to be a regular meal from now on. No pretension and it's great for kids.

This is an excellent new Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa. If you have a taste for this food, or would like to try it for the first time, come here. Everyone is so nice and helpful!

The modern look of this restaurant is great. They have endless options on their menu. 

I tried the Thinh An Special with broken rice. It was a great combination of what they have to offer. It was very tasty, and the offering was huge.

I look forward to trying their beef pho. My favorite is with egg noodles.

The only place I've ever written a review for because I feel so strongly about it . The rolls are HUGE. Dancing eel is the bomb. Charming little spot for dates or nights out with friends. It's also BYOB

It seems silly to review a grocery store but this location just makes me so upset! We were hoping for a lot when they took over Superfresh- which didn't try, had rats, etc. Acme opened all shiny and new, and good for them trying to compete with Whole Foods across the way by putting in the cafe, an organic section right by the main entrance, and an impressive beer selection. 

However, the staff continue to be so cranky! They never make eye contact or say hello when I check out, and if I dare say "hi" or "good morning," it's not received well. 

I do love me some Whole Foods but Acme is a good option for things that you don't want to pay through the nose for, like regular dish soap, paper goods, etc. But interactions with their staff *almost* make paying a premium worth it to not have to come here!

We have gotten delivery from here and it was difficult to tell the difference between several of the dishes. It might all have been chicken or pork. I'm sure none of it was the tofu ordered. The food was okay; nothing to write home about. There are much better Vietnamese restaurants on Waters.

Yesterday was only my second time going there. I was there about a year ago and ordered a little bit of everything but it was so good we ate our food so fast i forgot to take pctures and write a review. My daughter and I arrived at about 2pm and there was a nice little crowd of people young older middle aged and all ethnicities. The restaurant is kept clean from top to bottom as soon as you walk in your greeted by a friendly host ..they have a small buffett of bakery items and also other food items for purchase. KYLE our friendly server was on point the whole time. Our food was brought out no longer than 8 mins after we put our order in..it was the fastest service ive ever had in a restaurant. We ordered the thai green tea 2 of them ,a pound of crawfish a large beef Pho soup  an order of shrimp spring rolls grilled chicken w/ broken rice plate for $25 we were thinking the bill was going to be higher so we were pleasantly surprised when it wasnt. This will be a place my family and I will frequent..if you get a chance to go Ask for Kyle his customer service and serving skills are just amazing...he was warm patient and very friendly.

My sister brought me here on my last visit to Tampa. We just got to town and were starving. This food was delicious. Ordered the spring rolls to start and then ordered #97 which was from the vegetarian menu. Rice with sautéed lemongrass and chili tofu. this tofu is amazing and so good. you can barely tell its tofu. I thought that I was going to be hungry afterwards but the portion size is perfect. I also ordered some seafood toast from the take out area of the store. I liked the fact that I would add it to my meal and eat it there while I waited for my food, although it was colder than I would have liked (but that could just be because it was for take home). I would come here again while visiting Tampa.

We called asking if they could accommodate a large group of twenty and not only were they accommodating, but they were excited! It was great to see enthusiasm even in a small corner pizza place in Philly. Definitely recommend

I have been a patient at I.dentical for almost five years and their level of care is unmatched in my experience. They offer convenient appointments, are always running on or ahead of schedule (no waiting), and their staff are friendly and professional. The hygienists are incredibly knowledgable and the exams are gentle (no one likes going to the dentist but they make it bearable here!!)  I've had dentists before who have tried to sell me on unnecessary cosmetic procedures; this hasn't happened once here. I highly recommend this office.

Great pho! Great customer service! One of the best Vietnamese concepts in town. 

Please visit. Food is tasty and good environment. 
Durian smoothie is also available and isn't bad at all. 

I will go again. Enjoy!

We never dine in at any Indonesian Resto for some reasons. After got bored with Chinese and Vietnamese Resto, we started to try to dine in. The food taste different when you eat it in the place. It was tastier.
Salty fish fried rice was awesome, we asked it spicy. Soto betawi was great. Tempe and hekeng are a bit overpriced, taste so so

Sadly success has gone to their heads. On our first visit we were wowed. Good food good service. Second visit we bring guests (table of 4) and they were busy and couldn't get rid of us fast enough. Our friends hadn't been there and needed  a  few minutes to look over the menu.  4 different servers tried to take our order in the first five minutes after we sat down.

Didn't get the order right, brought out spring roll appetizers  for the table and one entree and our beers all at the same time. The entree was mine. I sent it back and said we wanted to enjoy our appetizers and beers.  It went downhill from there.  My husband ordered beef, he got pork. By the time his food came out everyone else was done so we took it to go. I got no garnish plate with my pho.  
And, last but not least it took 4 tries for the server to get a correct bill.  My advice,  Stick with Pho Quen on Hillsboro.

As my cousin and I entered the restaurant, I realized how beautiful it is. The woman at the front seated us in a prompt manner and I figured this is going to be a great experience. The restaurant was a bit busy but I figured someone would stop to ask us for our drink order. The waiters helped everyone around us and even addressed a man who came in after us. I was irritated by the lack of response and my cousin asked a waiter to take our order. After one waiter took our order, another one came back and asked us again what we ordered. I was annoyed they didn't remember. Also, both of us ordered an appetizer each, a main course and a drink. They ran out of Boba and forgot about bringing my appetizer. We had to ask for it. Although the food was fantastic, the lack of service makes me not likely to return.

This place is definitely one of the better Vietnamese places I've been too ( I'm Vietnamese, so I'm a bit pickier haha). The restaurant in itself is pretty simple, nothing that makes it stand out too much. It's divided into 3 sections: the seating, a dessert area and a small section for foods that are made to go. 

In the area with the to go foods, you'll find an array of different prepackaged foods. They seem to switch out some items depending on the day, but you can find things like spring rolls, pork buns, and different sticky rices. There's a little section for fried foods such as different types of egg rolls, fried foods, and what they are known for, their tofu. There's a very wide selection of tofu that is 4 pieces for $1.00. They also have fresh baked breads and croissants that go great with the Vietnamese iced coffees.

As for the food, there are a lot, and I mean a lot, of choices. For those who are not familiar with Vietnamese food, it can get a little overwhelming. They have the staples: pho ( beef soup), fried rice and broken rice with grilled meats and banh mi. They have other foods that restaurants typically do not have either like udon soup or rice porridge. I had gotten the pho and two orders of spring rolls. The pho is priced around $8-10. I do like that you can choose a size for an extra charge (m-xl).  the broth is a bit on the light side. The springs rolls were average. Nothing extraordinary. It could have used some more herbs for a more refreshing taste. Overall, it was good.

The dessert side also had an abundance of options. There were boba teas, slushes,waffles, ice cream, and Vietnamese desserts. I didn't try any because I was so stuffed from the pho alone. However, I did like that they had some native flavored like dragon fruit and durian slushes (yes, that is considered one of the stinkiest fruits). Overall, I'd give this place another try when I'm in the mood for Vietnamese food.

Delicious and fresh! I've only been in a couple times but look forward to getting here more when I'm in Tampa. Obsessed with the chili and lemongrass tofu. All of the ready to go food on display looks so tempting and delectable.

The banh mi is really tasty. Bread is fresh and so is the meat and veggies. I like the nem nuong. Menu offers a wide variety of different things. The vermicelli bowls are a good ratio of noodles to meat to veggies. So fresh! I think I've said that three times now lol but seriously, I love it! 

Service is okay, they are usually so busy that it's hard to flag down someone for anything but it is what it is. Parking is tight too. And there was like a 15 min wait when we came in on a Saturday. But it was worth the wait and we kept ourselves entertained by looking at all of the bakery and hot bar items.

Definitely a must visit for Tampa area. And don't forget to get some tofu to go! It's so delicious!

Tampa has a variety of really good Vietnamese Restaurants. Definitely hot on the heels of Saigon Deli is this place. If you want variety, this is the place. Out of all the Vietnamese places I've been in the Tampa area, this place might have the most variety. Everything ranging from your standard Pho noodle soups all the way to a delectable variety of rice, rice noodle, and chef special dishes. All the portion sizes are very generous. Even for a normal bowl of pho, you are going to be leaving very satisfied. To put a Cherry on top of this place, they have their own bakery! I mean, how often do you get to go to an authentic Vietnamese bakery?! Their bakery has a wide selection of sweets, savory breads and baked goods, as well as a variety of other Vietnamese classics. Although price-wise I may still find myself drifting over to Saigon Deli more often, fear not, this is probably the best alternative option out there :)

I've been to many vietnamese restaurants in the area and this was a nice change of pace. Watch some of the Olympics on the big projector and enjoyed some good food.

I had the special sandwich which was surprisingly cheap for 3.50. It could have used some more meat but it was enough to fill me and admire the taste.

All in all I'm glad there is another restaurant close by with a interesting bakery and menu. Will be back to try the special waffles!






















 *

I've eaten at many of the traditional Vietnamese restaurants in the Bay Area. There are some very good pho places here but this is by far the best! Thinh An came highly recommended by a friend. We had dinner there last night and I was extremely satisfied with the quality of the pho. Even the banh mi sandwich was far better than those i've had before. Great quality and great price! I will be back!
I called for a ride and they were right on time. The driver was friendly. I'd use them again.
Food was delicious. I recommend beef soto and fried pompano fish. Great service and very friendly waiters!

Yes this restaurant so much better food I'm from Chicago I'm looking for restaurants near by Tampa finally I find it so happy the service and very quick to order and the food so so good food they're friendly family and cheap prices I recommend some one travel to Tampa need to try it you will loved just me this place the best in Tampa

VERY generous 4-stars, leaning more towards 3-stars but only visited once so giving benefit of doubt. 

Came in for lunch with a friend on a Saturday around 1 and it was packed, was told there would be a 20min wait so we just strolled around and took a look at their bakery section, nbd. I also tried an almond croissant, it was very light and delicious.

Once we were seated, we were able to place our orders quickly; and our food arrived unbelievably fast shortly after.  I ordered Bun Bo Hue, and also an order of the Pork&Shrimp Spring Roll. I typically start with Pho when trying a new restaurant but I was afraid I wouldn't like it and be steered away from coming back. Yelp had more promising reviews for the Bun so I figured that'd give em a better chance.  Bun Bo Hue was lackluster, it wasn't bad but nothing I'd rave about nor would want to order here again. .. just seemed to be missing something(s) flavor wise, not sure what. . And the meats seemed dry to me, too overcooked. Spring rolls were disappointing as well, I was surprised there was no cucumber or carrot, but instead they had old browned bean sprouts. .. not a good taste. I didn't care for their peanut dipping sauce (too much peanut butter) but once I added in a generous amount of hoisin sauce, it was better but could use a little lime or vinegar as well. 

They seem to bring each item as they're done because we had to wait at least 5 minutes after my food for my friend's dishes to come out. My soup had came out so quick, it actually arrived before my spring roll appetizers. .. We were lucky to have probably the best server out of everyone, very friendly and attentive. Unfortunately, we didn't catch his name, but excluding him. . The rest of service staff seem to be less aware of customs and their only concern is getting from point A to point B. I understand when it's packed, it's inevitable you'll bump into people, but it's more forgiving if they're actually careful not to knock into people or actually apologize if they do. At least 3x I had been knocked into by service staff during my visit, first incident was within the first 5 min of arriving, the server rushed through an obviously too small a space and side swiped me from behind with no 'excuse me' or apologies whatsoever. I was a little shocked and at first thought it was a disgruntled customer before I turned around and was like. .who tf...and then several times more during the meal, servers would rush through the tiny space between me and the table behind me. Seriously, there are better routes to take, 15s more max, isn't going to hurt nobody. RUDE.

In conclusion, Bun Bo Hue is meh and my homemade Pork&Shrimp Spring Rolls are 5x better, so never ordering that here again.  Next visit, I plan to try either a Com (rice) or a non-soup Bun dish, and their waffle dessert everyone's talking about. If there are no winners, not likely to return.

2nd Visit: Arrived during less busy time, had the Bun dish (not bad) and Banh Mi (awesome!), Waffle dessert (OK - didn't seem like waffle had much flavor, it was like eating ice cream off a bland ego)..& now I'll have to try Pho on 3rd visit :)
Great atmosphere. Amazing fried infused flavor tofu and food is delicious. Service was fast! Gets really busy there so go early!

Thinh An is a great, inexpensive Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa. With a diverse menu that has pho, banh mi, rice dishes, boba, and even a bakery, there is definitely an option for everyone. Despite being very busy quite often, the staff is very efficient and the shop is very clean. The waiters truly take care of their tables; my waiter saw that I stopped eating and gave me a to-go box before I even had the chance to ask!

I've tried the bun bo hue and grilled pork banh mi, and both items were great. The banh mi costed around $3, and the bun bo hue around $7, which is extremely cheap. Even with the low prices, they give generous portion sizes. The food comes out about ten minutes after ordering, which is relieving if you're super hungry! I definitely recommend Thinh An and will stop by when I'm craving pho in Tampa.
This place is so cute. Good food and specialty drinks like Boba Tea and smoothies. Retro look inside with bakery. This dishes are huge and be prepared to take home leftovers.

Best veterinary service I've had in Tucson out of 3 clinics. Compassionate and go out of their way to work with pets (JRT dog), payment situations, and owners. Try to be flexible. Maintained follow up. Limited products. Has always had appointments available without long waits. Pleasant staff. Front desk greeter/clerk can be missing some times from double duty? Very helpful with a life end situation and also setting up  care for new patient never registered before that needed dental work. Plan to keep my vet care here.

Though it's a drive for me; this is my new go to for Vietnamese. Pho, rolls, Vermicelli dishes.  And they have a takeaway market!   Visiting on a Wednesday night and It was pleasantly busy.  10 minutes I was told at 610.  It was 2 minutes.  Wait staff positive and friendly if not a bit harried due to crowd.  Can't wait to visit again and try the pho and take some home.  My vermicelli was enough for 2 me

This place is awesome. Ordered two chicken banh mi sandwiches to go while I perused the additional to-go offerings.  I ended up leaving with a lot! The lemongrass chili fried tofu was amazing, as was the banana tapioca pudding. I also picked up a ham/cheese croissant for my son's lunch and he loved it. I can't believe it took me so long to find this place! I will definitely be back for more!

Not impressed at all. The service was absolutely terrible. We were waiting for a friend to join us and until then we couldn't order an appetizer or get any service. Once we ordered our food, it took a very long time to arrive. Then , only  3 of us received our entree, while waiting 15 min for the 4th entree to be served. I ordered the sole and it was very oily.  Once we got our check and asked for change, we were given $10 short of the change. It was very loud inside and overall not a pleasant experience.

This popped up in my feed on a nice Sunday morning and we couldn't have found a better way to start the day. The extra long drive down I(rritating)4 was worth it! 

Immediately upon walking in the door, we felt like we were back in a California Vietnamese restaurant except there was an added bonus - it was cleaner! 

The place was packed but there were plenty of tables and we were seated nearly immediately. 

If you're looking for a place that has a vast variety of meal options at VERY affordable prices, then look no further. Bonus, everything was fantastic! There's way too much to list but I can't think of anything that I didn't see. They pretty much have it all! 

So go! Oh, the service is super friendly and they are on top of their game despite having a full house!

This brand new restaurant offers extensive selection of Vietnamese  dishes, fresh baked pastry, and a lot of homemade ready to eat food. I  tried Bun Bo Hue- a spicy beef noodle soup. I liked the broth, the beef slices (plenty) and sausage plus the fresh veget and herb.  The summer roll was not bad at all.  I had their almond croissants and the fruit croissants- fresh, fluffy and so delicious.  They serve the tea water which was so refreshing. I had the puff waffle ice cream dessert- so  delicious!  I am glad they serve this because I can't find it anywhere in Tampa Bay area .There are many other dishes I would like to try next time.
 At the market area , so many different food and desserts and ready to eat and fresh made . They all look yummy. 
The restaurant is beautifully decorated. It looked clean inside and out. The pricing is very reasonable. Food was fresh and good tasted. They are working on the services department. I beloved it will get more organized and better in the future. Warning! Their dish  portion was really big, come with very empty stomach or be ready to take left over home.

AMBIANCE: This restaurant was great! It's very unique in that the Vietnamese food tastes authentic, but had a modern and super clean environment. The menus are in both Vietnamese and English.

SERVICE: The servers were so friendly and very quick to refill any beverages and help with additional orders. They have a very kind staff. 

MAIN DISHES: The portions are huge! Definitely awesome that it's a modern restaurant without the premium prices. The bun bo hue (Vietnamese beef noodle soup), pho, and the com dac biet (rice platter with everything) were very good. One concern is that the thit nuong (grilled pork) didn't have the crispy grilled texture, so it seems to be stir fried without compromising taste. I would still get it again, especially since it comes with a tiny bowl of broth... I love when they do! 

DESSERTS/OTHERS: There is a huge selection of desserts and there's even a separate bakery/tofu/che section to the left. There are over 6 different types of banh mi you can order and tons of tea/boba tea options! We got the vanilla waffle with green tea snow (shaved ice), strawberries, and Mochi. The waffle smelled so good as they made it FRESH. It was delicious and crunchy. I was also impressed with the green tea snow. 

OVERALL: I definitely recommend this restaurant! I'll have to come back to try their other dishes, waffles, and teas!

First time at this place. I was so excited for another Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa! The service was excellent; our waitress was very friendly. The vegetarian egg roll was fantastic! I wonder what was all inside the egg roll...it was so yummy! I also got the "mi thap cam" which had great noodle paired with a delicious broth!

I've heard reviews on this place and always wanted to stop in but never had the time. I finally got a chance today and reviews I've heard were exactly right. I ordered the chicken and rice with peppermint Boba tea and everything was amazing. The chicken had a sauce on it that had me searching for little bits of chicken to eat on my plate when I was done. The Boba was also very tasty and it was the first time that I tried peppermint flavored. They also have great pastries at very reasonable prices for sale. Definitely will be returning in the near future.

This restaurant is outstanding! Ingredients are fresh, dishes are well-prepared and very tasty, atmosphere is bright and stylish, service is friendly and helpful, and prices are very reasonable. We had generously sized summer rolls, a bun mi (on delicious, freshly made bread), and a very large noodle bowl. Make sure you check out all the food to go, especially the tofu and croissants.

I've had quality Vietnamese food but never in Tampa. This place is extraordinary. Their broth is excellent, the grilled pork spring rolls divine. They bake their own bread and croissants. I grew up less than a mile from here and I would have put up $100 against the notion that a Vietnamese place as good as the places in Seattle, San Francisco and St. Paul I have been to would ever open here. I would have lost that bet and I would still be glad. Strongly recommend!

Service is excellent.  Food  had a learning curve but have been there twice and good each time. Soup bowl was plentiful. Sandwich was good with grilled chicken. Egg rolls small but tasty.Noodles and shrimp dish also good.will be back to try a few other meals

Rita's Water Ice is a good place to get a quick, cold custard or ice.

The staff was really friendly and the service was quick. I got the mango Italian ice with vanilla frozen custard gelati and it was delicious!
Great ride to Amtrak from Westshore On time and sent texts re progress #cabTampa @United Cab

Honestly, this place is the worst. Service sucked. The food comes out an hour after you ordered your food. Youre going to come in, sit down and not even get a menu for 10 minutes. Im not going to lie the food is okay. But the service are 2 thumbs down. I went in with a group and some of the people in my group left hungry WITHOUT EATING and all they said was "sorry" not even a reimbursement or anything. If thats not enough bad news, all these 5 stars you see here without any commentary, just stars. They're fake. The owner of this cafe CALLED ALL OF HER FRIENDS to make sure that they put 5 stars on this page. Its pretty sad to know this. The reason i know this is because a friend of mine that left 5 stars in this page told me what happened. If you ask some of these people who left 5 stars here, theyll tell you that they never even visited this restaurant in the first place. I'm sorry to say this but please don't support this cafe. If you'd like indonesian food. I'd recommend you guys to sky cafe or indonesian restaurant. 
Update: after giving a bad review from my experience i was attacked by the owner's friend. Harrassed and attacked as you can see from their facebook page. I literally made an account for yelp just so all of you guys wont waste your time by coming to this cafe.
Best Vietnamese food in Tampa. I definitely will recommend this restaurant to anyone. Staff is very nice and friendly. Plus, it is great for vegans.

I would really love to give this place a higher rating, but I've ordered from this place quite a few times and feel the 2 stars are more than justified.

First off, their pizza is one of the better ones I've ordered out, although they put entirely too much cheese on it.  If you're not crazy about cheese, specify less cheese on the pizza.  

Their cheesesteaks are hit and miss, mostly miss.  The last cheesesteak I ordered it was more fat than actual meat.  I was tempted to return it, but figured it was better if I just never ordered from then again.  Time and aggravation saved that way.

The best thing they offer is their platters.  Their salmon and shrimp platter is out of this world.  The only thing that would make that perfect is they could cook the veggies a little longer because they're too tough.

Finally, another minus is the fact they actually charge people money to use their debit or credit card.  It's only a buck, but that quickly adds ... for them and the banks.  

I have experienced better.

I had this place booked marked for a while and finally stopped in. 

So this is definitely a newer restaurant and the curb appeal is great at first glance. Inside you notice an open cafeteria type area ,then a bar, and open seating in the middle. We came here around 4:45 pm on a Friday. It was pretty busy for that time especially since they don't have happy hour specials. I over heard the staff saying they were expecting 30 people around 6pm. My experience here was great with the service. We were immediately greeted by a server asking us if we were ready.

We started off ordering the boa boa tea. I got the matcha milk tea which I have had before at other places. Once difference is this one wasn't overly sweet which I like. The price is very good for the tea and the small is only 3.00 vs a large for 4.00 and toppings are extra. Even when you add toppings it's still less compared to others which can range between $4-6. 

While we waited for our food, we glanced over at the self served packaged food/ buffet to go area. They have a lot of different and interesting items. They have several kinds of tofu. I couldn't really tell you what the other things are but they were interesting. Like dried chicken. 

For my entree I ordered the vermicelli noodles with tofu. It was a nice sized portion with three different types of tofu. It comes with crumbled peanuts on the side. I really liked the dish and they have several
other vegetarian dishes. 

I glanced at the other things and they have a lot of fun desserts made of waffles and shaved ice. I would come back here.

Came in for dinner on a friday night. For a brand new place, the decor is chic, the service was great, the food came out quick, and the atmosphere was enjoyable. As an Indonesian who misses authentic meals, so happy that Djakarta Cafe is another great option in Philly.

Our group got Soto Betawi (tasty with a little kick of heat), Bakmi Djakarta kecil (delish and just like what you'd get from the street vendors), and Nasi ayam bakar (came with various sides and very fulfilling). The food certainly didn't disappoint!

Don't forget to cap the meal by taking a picture by the great mural!

My XL pho was the bomb. Beautiful big place with ample parking in front, on the side and bonus parking in the back back. Friendly employees and owners.

Like any new place they have a few kinks to work out.. The snow ice machine should be operational soon.. The waitstaff is getting their footing. But it's a fun place with an extensive menu, homemade french bread and pastries, Viet specialties to grab n go. Honemade soy milk and tofu dessert. Delicious boba milk teas. Hong Kong style egg waffle desserts (ice cream or snow ice). 

A lot to take in and try. I look forward to returning soon!

Thinh An has a wide variety of Vietnamese food and  in my opinion, is the best restaurant offering Vietnamese food in the Tampa Bay Area. Our group of three went on a Sunday night for dinner and ordered a veggie pho, grilled shrimp with vermicelli and the grilled chicken with broken rice. All three dishes were fantastic with the pho being my personal favorite. The only let down was the sugarcane juice we ordered which wasn't as flavorful as expected. Overall, a great dinner experience and we will definitely be back.

Pretty good and the price is right. However, they have a little market which scares the hell out of me as the prepared food is not temperature controlled - both cold and hot. I'm surprised this is not a health violation.

An absolutely great place to get in shape! we have been going since Mar. of 2012 and this gym is our family. It is much more than a gym. There is a great social aspect that goes with it. From happy hour workouts that are themed and you dress up to member appreciation parties. If that isn't your bag, you can come and get a phenomenal workout  with amazing coaches.
This place is mazaing is both cheap and fast I would recommend this to all of my friends and family!

We love this place honesty you can't beat the prices or the food quality. The service is pretty good too but did I mention the food!!! The sandwiches are packed with meat and flavor also you have to try the shakin beef and duck soup both awesome. We get Togo from this place all the time and the food is always hot and fresh. I wouldn't go anywhere else in town for this style of food

Several old time employees with hugely negative attitudes. Observed to avoid work by failing to man cash registers while avoiding eye contact with customers and sometimes engaging in conversation with other cashiers but not helping.  I heard one cashier complaining to another wondering when she might be provided with a list of produce prices (if ever).   The other said she didn't know.  When I suggested the cashier should ask the manager, the cashier told me "the manager won't do anything". There is a lot of dead weight at this store which is why I avoid shopping at this Acme.
Standard Rita's stand with long lines and great water ice. The employees are generally really nice here and they don't get upset when you ask for a sample! Woo!

It is no surprise that this is one of my favorite and go-to restaurants. I've been here multiple times and regardless of the day or time, it's always packed. The place is clean and the staff is always smiling. There's nothing more that I look forward to after a night of drinking than a big bowl of pho from Thinh An. I also love their mi sate, hu tiu bo kho, and com tam ga nng. My mouth is watering just thinking about it! Their pastries and banh mi are out of this world! It's a must try!
The Pho is awesome, the service is excellent and the prices are great! My goto restaurant, when I want a good meal.
Love this place! Delivery is always on time! They have fast service you think that it's going to take a long time but they come pretty fast.

what a pleasant experience.  and who says that about going to the dentist?!?.  well i do when it comes to my first experience at i.dentical.  the office is clean, modern, and has up to date technology.  the staff, from the dental hygienists to the secretaries were friendly and wore some great smiles.  dr. yanez himself did most of the dental work himself and i must say that he was very efficient and gentle.  my routine cleaning was done in no time, and i can't remember the last time a dentist made me feel so comfortable (and pain free).  he was also very professional and didn't sit there trying to lie to me about the thousands of non-existent and asymptomatic cavities that i need filled and how my wisdom teeth need to be pulled.  he seems like a straight shooter.  i highly recommend dr. yanez and the i.dentical staff for your dental needs.
Great food. I ordered the gourmet buffalo chicken pizza and it was surprisingly really good.

Excellent place for Vietnamese style noodle soups of various varieties.  I've tried a couple with everything from super thin to extra wide noodles and with beef, pork, seafood, or a some combination of the preceding.  All have been excellent, but my favorite is the number 47. Also, you should try the Bahn Mi sandwiches. The Op La with the over easy egg is delicious.  And the little fresh baked French baguettes really set them apart.  They have an extensive selection of Boba teas and other made to order drinks which I've sampled a few an all have been delightful, so you can't go wrong with any choice. For dessert be adventurous and give the Durrian yogurt a try.  It is definitely an acquired taste but you might be pleasantly surprised.  Also before you leave take a walk through the bakery and deli section and grab something to take home for later!

It's Tuesday and we came for lunch.  For future reference do not go on Tuesday.
Tuesdays are closed. As posted on store door schedule.
we really enjoyed having lunch in this establishment

Thinh An is my go-to restaurant for Vietnamese food. Located on Waters, Thinh An has both a to-go side and a sit down side. What does that mean? Well, if you want something quick and easy -- there are options already wrapped up and ready to buy on the left. If you want to sit down and have a meal, there are tables for that too! 

There are soooo many options. You think I'm kidding but take a look at the menu. If you want anything from Pho to Crawfish to Waffles, they have it ALLLLL. And I've had pretty much it all haha. I keep coming back and there's a reason why. Their portions are large and prices small. What's better than that?! My favorite meal is the summer rolls with shrimp/pork and a hot bowl of pho. I usually end the meal with a Hong Kong style waffle.
Excellent!  Everything is very fresh and flavorful. The staff is very nice and accommodating.

I went here because of the reviews by other people... I sure was fooled. The food looks like nothing like the pictures. Although majority of these photos were posted by the owner. I ordered Bakmi Goreng Djakarta or their Stir Fried Egg Noodle, the noodles were broken up, greasy, and tasted like frozen food. I ordered Es Cendol, which is that light green drink... it basically tasted like caramel, so sickeningly sweet. Asians do not like things too sweet. Trust Asian reviews, do not trust others!

I really enjoyed the food and service here. We ordered the number 14 beef pho, it was delicious! The eggrolls were on point. We also tried a banh mi roasted pork sandwich with a taro smoothie and honey dew slushie. Everything was great! Will definitely be back to try an entree next time.

Wonderful experience - restaurant is very open and clean with a small market inside for pre-made foods and pastries.  The menu is extensive with many choices in each category from rice to vermicelli, soup (20 different choices), and sandwiches and 6 different fresh (not fried) rolls. A group of chef specialties as well. Our group enjoyed beef pho and grilled shrimp vermicelli - the fried egg roll that came with the bun was delightful as were the fresh rolls we ordered!  There were a dozen vegetarian options if that's what you are looking for.  There is an entire menu of drinks including dozens of teas and smoothies.  Something for every taste.  The prices were very reasonable and the food fresh.

First time trying Thinh An Kitchen and their summer rolls were a knock out. The peanut sauce was thick and flavorful topped with a hearty handful of crushed roasted peanuts, giving the sauce an amazing aroma. Had tons of variety on their menu with a big bakery and cafe. The food was also decently priced for their humongous portions.

Quick, efficient, friendly service.... extensive menu, ...and 10 or 12 items like egg rolls, croissants, fried tofu,sesame balls in a side-bar for immediate takeout... cheap and good.
Been there a couple of times, and is likely to be one of my regular stops

Food is good.  I enjoy the concept of made on site tofu and bread.   The bread was light and airy, similar to the areas with large ethnic Vietnamese population like Houston and Orange county, CA. Food was seasoned well.  Service was a little off due to the size of the party.  One dish wasn't brought out without several reminding and they forgot a drink.  They get quick up remedy the problem. Place is very clean and everyone was pleasant.  Will come back.
Omg the soups and the homemade mushroom tofu is awesome!!! You can even get a pork bun in their To go area for like $2!!

Received a note suggesting I try the food. I have and it is mediocre. That said, my mother ate here for years and, I believe, loved their hoagies.  I last had food from here 2 years ago, proviso, so can't say what they are putting out now.

For anyone who has not heard of CrossFit, it is an exercise program whose general motto is, "your workout is our warm-up." Briefly, CrossFit utilizes a high-intensity interval training method of bouts of harder, resistance training...eh, Google it.  It is not for the light-hearted. Many Big-Box gym buff, meatheads would more than likely get their a$$ kicked by this workout -seriously, (which for me is motivation enough to do it.)

As someone who has been in and out of Big Box gyms for twenty years and recently completed P90-X, I can tell you this is an amazing work-out. The best part about CrossFit Purgatory is the no-attitude, friendly instructors. Being a CrossFit beginner is no easy task. I have been taking the 9am class with Logan. It has generally been a small group which is great for someone just getting started. These workouts can be intimidating and Logan has been great at demonstrating the moves and pushing me to my limits. 

Everyone's daily results are posted on a whiteboard so it is motivating to come back the next day and see how my score held up during the remaining classes. Everyone does the same workout at each class. In CrossFit terms it is their WOD, (Workout of the Day) some are harder than others, but you are guaranteed a great work-out that will leave you wanting more. 

Tucson has many CrossFit locations, all indepantly-owned. Purgatory is a great, friendly, non-intimidating environment to get started on your CrossFit adventure. It is tucked away in the Midway Plaza on Speedway (I had to circle the plaza a few times to find it) it is on the right of the restaurant in a strip facing east. It's clean too!

The best example of authentic Vietnamese in Tampa Bay. They have a little market on the side where they sell many of the products they make that they use in the restaurant including fresh tofu of multiple varieties, eggrolls, meats and pates, and veggies. They also fresh bake French Vietnamese puff pastries every day both sweet and savory kinds as well as various soy coagulation's, made fresh but I just don't understand that stuff. They have all sorts of beverage options with Boba and jellies, cheap sandwiches for 3 1/2 bucs, and their biggest plated $10 is enough to feed three

This store stands out from other boutiques of its kind because of how well curated its stock is. Yes, I said curated. 

As though outfitting a small gem of a museum, the buyers have crafted a selection of meticulously selected jewelry and home decor pieces that make the store feel like a spread from Elle Decor - the gold standard in decorating magazines.
