I noticed neoprene lunch totes by BuiltNY, double-walled glassware by Bodum, and a variety of candles I wanted to buy just to keep the pretty botanical screen-printed glasses they came in. 

On a previous trip to Philly I had picked up beautiful earrings here that were spun from a golden wheat. My last trip had me admiring a silver jewelry tree set with small sparrows perched on its boughs. I wish I knew an infant so I could've bought the toddler's onesie that said 'Nobody Puts Baby in a Corner'. 

The store loses a star because it is pricey and I didn't see much on sale, but otherwise I commend the owners for putting together a shop with a veritable cornucopia of gift possibilities.

Thinh An has improved quickly since their grand opening, maybe more than 6 mo. now.  Well done!
Being from CA and knowing good Vietnamese food, I find there are some average flavors with some dishes here.  Overall, a good effort!
This place has become my VN go-to with the sandwiches.  Unbelievable, the prices are the same as Little Saigon CA!  Sometimes the bread is a little too hard, and I find the raw green onion slivers strange, but tasty abd satisfying for the price!
The coffee and smoothies are good, too.  The durian smoothie has the "stink" that makes it A+!
The family who owns and work here are very nice and aim to please.  The place fills up on Fri. and the weekend, mostly with VN peeps.  They're even quite busy on weekdays during lunch.  They are on their way to being a top restaurant in Tampa!  My heart goes out to this business in wishing them continued success!
They have the best pho!!!! Great service and authentic food. The food is super cheap and delicious! Once I found them, that's the only place I went for pho.
Love this place!!! The best salchipapa I've ever had. Great customer service and very lay back environment.

Will not go anywhere else for Vietnamese. This is it.. The soup, pastries, ice cream and dishes are by far the best in the surrounding area. Let me start of by saying how clean the place feels. Next, the food. Everything here is priced so well and you get so much wonderful tasting food. Lastly, I love that this is a one stop shop. They have boba, smoothies and oh so delicious ice cream. I find the other places nearby lack good dessert choices.   I come here at least once a week and look forward to trying some of their pastries or home made soy milk.
This place is one of the best Pho placed I've ever 3aten at.  Great bubble tea.  Cane sugar juice is amazing.. lemongrass need vermicelli is awesome.  Nice service staff.  My neighborhood go to

My new favorite restaurant in Tampa bay! Incredibly authentic, extensive menu. I should have taken a pic of my vegetarian pho, but I began inhaling it as soon as it arrived. The number of options for vegetarians was a blessing. My mom took a photo of her order from the specials board, which she was also very happy with and I have included it. Also included is a photo of the to-go area. We ate at a table and had great service, but definitely a cool option if you only have a moment to pick something up! Five stars, all around.

This is an OK grocery store. It is in my neighborhood so I shop here. Typical city grocery store. Mostly clean and somewhat limited on selections. But overall ok.  Went in Sunday night and they had almost no produce. That must  be their change over day.
You know what I hate the worse?   Cabs that ask for cash and then be a dick about it when you want to use a credit car -- looking at you cab 398 taking me to the airport at 5:30am on May 15, 2014.

Great authentic Vietnamese food. The place was very clean and looks like it was remodeled. They made all their tofu and soy milk by hand. The menu is vast and has variety. I been here 3 times and every time it was a good experience with great tasting food. The service is great. There's lots of parking. The sitting is a little crowded though. Every time someone behind be stood up their seat would hit mine and made me spill my soup.
Best Vietnamese food in central Florida. Tried 10 different dishes , all taste amazing

Went early on a Saturday evening with my wife.  Place was almost empty (though it still felt cramped because they had so many tables and staff).  Service was friendly but not very experienced.  Kind of like a puppy -- very eager, but a bit clumsy.
Our appetizers we disappointing -- we had the thai chicken skewers and the duck "tea bags". The chicken was flavorless and my duck appetizer had several pieces of grizzle and bone in it.  Underwhelming for $8 each.  Our main courses were a beef stir fry and shrimp pad thai.  Flavors and level of heat were very good and just as we requested.  But were they worth $15-$19 each?  Not so sure. So, in the end it was "ok,"  but there are better alternatives not far away. Sorry to say that  I doubt we'll go back.
This place is magnificent! The food is wonderful, the service is great and they are so pleasant, and the interior is so lovely.

Besides the convenience and occasional sales on vegan frozen items, ACME markets are not my first choice when grocery shopping. Their selection of certain products, especially ethnic foods, could be better. I'm particularly upset they stopped carrying Valentina Mexican hot sauce.

I was looking for a dentist for a dental cleaning but currently don't have dental insurance. After looking through the Yelp reviews, I decided to make an appointment with I.Dentical. Not only are their reviews good but they also offer a Yelp discount special, which they gladly honored.  I am thrilled with the dental cleaning I received from Carly and will surely return. I can tell Carly is extremely experienced, as well as very friendly and pleasant. The office is immaculate and has state of the art equipment. Thanks Carly, my teeth feel fabulous!!

Ridiculous. I order the 44 specifically for the pork blood, I requested it to be extra spicy. The waiter asks if I'm sure about the pig blood, I enthusiastically say yes! My food comes out, not only did they totally ignore my request for the extra spice (first pointed out by the waiter himself), I dig into the bowl and notice the lack of pork blood, we inquire to the waiter who finds out they're out. So I ask if I could substitute it for some tripe or tendon, he comes back to inform me that they wouldn't do that. So irritated with the whole ordeal I tell them I don't even want it any more. Only then do they bend and give me 2 of the smallest pieces of tendon I've ever seen. Absolutely the cheapest attitude I've ever had the misfortune of encountering. What a waste of decent food. I feel bad for the poor waiters that have to be the face of such cheapness.

Though it's a drive for me; this is my new go to for Vietnamese. Pho, rolls, Vermicelli dishes.  And they have a takeaway market!   Visiting on a Wednesday night and It was pleasantly busy.  10 minutes I was told at 610.  It was 2 minutes.  Wait staff positive and friendly if not a bit harried due to crowd.  Can't wait to visit again and try the pho and take some home.  My vermicelli was enough for 2 meals!

If you haven't been yet, it's time to go!  Thinh An does so many things right, and has so many options, all I can really do is provide an overview of what I have tried.

Drinks - they offer a wide variety, sodas, tea, etc., but I always end up with the honeydew slush with boba. Sweet, tart, perfect.

Pho - it is crazy good. I've had the pho with chicken and the vegetable pho, and I am slightly addicted to both. Now when I crave pho, I only want to come here.

Pastries - oh geez - they are amazing, and I've eaten enough to be an expert on the matter. My favorites are the ones with fruit in them, but I had a meat-filled one, too, which was awesome.

Bread - I'm sure you've heard they bake it fresh - have a bahn mi and see for yourself how fluffy and fresh it is.  Or - order the curry and it comes with a loaf to dip in the tasty sauce. I bet your bread will be gone long before the curry is.

Tofu - multiple flavors, multiple preparations. It's the star of my veggie pho. It is also served as a weird, but oddly delicious dessert, where fresh tofu is mixed with a ginger sugar sauce.  This is a must try!  You can also bring some home with you as they sell it in the to-go section.

To-go Section - everything your little heart desires, and more.  You could feed your family on different things every night of the week from the quantity of items they have pre-wrapped and ready for take out.  Rolls, curry, tofu, pastries, sausage, milk, etc.

Dessert - while there are many offerings, the thing to have is waffle cone with ice cream. It is a puffy, freshly made waffle cone, and if you combine it with the green tea ice cream, it is a delicious cold contrast.

Every time I've been the place is hopping, but service is friendly, management plays an active role, and check-out is quick due to servers using an iPad at your table.
Great find just Northwest of Tampa. Super fast service, grocery store and specialty drinks. Fun family spot.  We will be back.

I live fairly close to this ACME and am here a few times a week. It's a pretty standard grocery store. Sometimes they have good deals. They're often stocking shelves at the busiest times of the day and run out of things frequently. There are a few people who work here who make for a really pleasant experience, but 70% of the staff is young and they make it known that they don't enjoy their jobs. I actually had one person confront me about how "comfortable" I looked one day because I walked into the store in moccasins. I thought that was incredibly rude.
This place is great. I loved the pho soup and waffle. I have come a few times and definitely will be back. I love the food! Service was okay kinda slow, but the food was worth it.

Occasionally, like this evening, I get a craving for some really cold sugar, water and flavoring.  I am a fan of this particular Rita's as they almost always have Wild Black Cherry water ice, so much better than the artificial tasting regular cherry.  The staff is always very nice and helpful.  The custard at this store has also been very good.
First time at Djakarta cafee. Ordered indonesian grilled chicken it was really...really tasty...service very friendly...

This is a GREAT new addition to Vietnamese food in Tampa Bay. The selection is huge. The food is fresh and varied. And the taste - amazing!

I love the look of the place. Very openly laid out with a huge section for pick your own stuff. I'd totally recommend the Lemongrass Tofu from here. Just delicious. 

All of the stuff here is made fresh daily- and I think the freshness is really felt in the place. We stopped on our way to go to another Vietnamese restaurant in town and just the decor and friendliness of the staff made us immediately want to stay here. 

I had the Udon which was great - my kid had the rice with chicken and the wife had the Shrimp Bun. All very delicious. We are actually very excited to go through the menu - think I'll do the spicy  bun next week!

Definitely give them a go!!

Always good. Carry out as well as done in. Thanks for opening it Tom and An. The owners are right on top of things and make sure the place tuns like a top.  Especially like the crab soup.  Highly recommend.

I am never ever going back here again...  Not only the food has lost its quality but now the soy milk, which is supposed to be their specialty, has given me great disappointment.  I bought a half gallon on Thursday afternoon and when I pulled it out of the fridge on Saturday morning for the first time it already turned lumpy.  As I poured it out, It was also slimy which makes me think that surely additives have been added.  My other friends also have stopped coming here.  The thing is most Vietnamese restaurants started out pretty good but after having built their customers, all seems to go down hill from then on.  Think An like Pho Tasty in St Pete where we went the last time their Pho tasted so sweet indicating cutting down on broth made from real meat and bones and adding in more sugar and/or MSG just to be even more profitable.  All these leave such a bad taste in my mouth.
AMAZING!!!! Just got home from eating here and i can already tell you that i will be back for more. The prices are great for anyone and the food is to die for. The service is also amazing.

They mess up every order I have given up to date. Horrible customer service and I'm sure many costumers can agree with this. The chicken is always dry and packed on to the Salchi papa. I don't understand whats so "number one" about it.

While I am not generally the type of person to "Go Ham" over a grocery chain, I am totes in love with this newly renovated Acme (used to be Super Fresh).  While part of my reasoning may be in part biased slash based by default on exceptionally negative experiences (i.e. the stupid amount of money I've been forced to spend over the years and become accustomed to as the "norm" at Rittenhouse Market), I have to say that this place is a total 180 from the former Super Fresh.  For city living, this has got to be the closest I've ever come to suburban grocery prices.  Produce is fresh and they have a beautiful flower selection that can go toe-to-toe with Whole Foods 95% of the time.  Great weekly specials and deals and, as a nerdy HR professional, I have to wonder what kind of staff training they put their people through, because the level of customer service and simply "smiling" cashiers is a pleasant shock in comparison to the disgruntled staff from Super Fresh days.  

Living only a few blocks away, I frequent this location almost daily.  Also, a lesser known tip for people in the area:  if you have guests coming from out of town and struggle on advising them where to park, the Acme garage is only $10 for the day (and I think $18 overnight) if you buy $10 worth of groceries in the store.  Not too shabby!

Always crowded, the first sign it's going to be good. Lots of selections of very tasty food. Served hot without much of a wait. Generous portions and the prices are great. Been here twice and will return.

This restaurant is wonderful! I have only been twice and I've fallen in love with it! The people here are so friendly and helpful for someone who hasn't tasted a lot of Vietnamese cuisine. I highly recommend you to go if you are visiting or live in the Tampa region! Wonderful service, wonderful people, and wonderful food!!

I love the community that Purgatory has created.  There are gym events, happy hour workouts and a generally caring environment.  It was a bit intimidating to come in as the clumsy/nerdy newbie whose last competition involved crossword puzzles, but every body is really welcoming and helpful.

 Since I'm not one of the stronger crossfitters around, I appreciate the coaches dedication to using good form with scaled weights and modifications over completing the workout as prescribed.  Of course they also encourage athletes to push their limits.  As someone who can easily get into ruts when planning my own workouts, I love the variety of the workouts here.


I feel stronger and less injury prone since doing CrossFit. I  had a minor tear in my shoulder from climbing.  Focusing on strengthening surrounding muscles led me to more lifting and eventually to CrossFit.   It has helped immensely and I give a large piece of the credit to the coaches at Purgatory who were able to both modify my workouts as I regained strength and give me additional exercises to focus on weak areas.

This place is awesome, I usually go between here and Saigon Deli depending which is closer. Sagion used to be my number one go to spot but this place is the beez kneez! Fresh bread which is great with their Banh Mi, their vermicelli is good too and fresh rolls. That's about all I've had besides the great teas and such so I can't comment on the rest. I did order a Banh Mi to-go once and the meat was cold-not heated (Grilled Pork), reason for four stars, sorry! I didn't notice until home and this is the only time its happened in the dozens of times I've been there.

I would definitely give it a try, they have a huge screen (projector) there to play football or whatever's going on.
This was our frist time here. Great atmosphere, great food, great portion you can't go wrong.
I passed this place a few time and finally Stopped in order some alcapurrias they were great definitely will be going back............................

I needed a receipt.  The driver put the charge through electronically, but his receipt printer was broken - and I had to fix it for him, but the charge had already been sent, so I got no receipt.  Then, to get me a receipt he ran my card.... and bingo, now I have two charges.  OK AMEX will sort it out, but this was unpleasant and a time waster for me.

Update: AMEX convinced United Cab to withdraw the duplicate charge.  It worked out ok after several months.

Food was good, however service was terrible! I went there with my roommate to get dinner and there were 2 girls waiting on customers. One of the girls acted as if she did not want to be at work that day and the other girl gave all of her attention to my roomie because he could converse in Spanish, however she acted as if taking my order in English was upsetting to her. I felt both of them were rude and not fit to be in a customer service job! I will definitely not darken this Taco stand again!!

I was excited when I found out an Indonesian restaurant was a quick walk from work.  I stepped out for lunch to try this place.  It's tucked within the neighborhood, maybe 9-10 tables, the walls decorated with sticker murals, framed pictures, and trinkets, which add a nice touch.

The restaurant is family-owned and the cook is apparently the owner's mother.  I loved the beef rendang dish, which was just $7.50.  (EDIT- I came back about 3 weeks later and they'd upped all the prices, so this exact dish is now $9.50! That's quite a big increase) Apart from the beef rendang, it came with a whole egg that seemed lightly deep-fried; two pieces of shrimp; and what tasted like sweet potatoes with an interesting sauce; and some kale/collard greens, also in an interesting (but different) sauce.  The flavors were wonderful.   This place is cash only, so be aware of that.  The only drawback is it took ~30 minutes for my food to come out, which is great in the sense that I'm sure it was made to order and not pre-made.  There were maybe 3 other small groups there but it seemed like they were already eating when I ordered.  That's something to keep in mind if you're on a time crunch but apart from that, the food here is lovely, the atmosphere is simple and nice, and you're supporting a local business.  What's not to like?  I'll definitely be back on another lunch break.
Loved mint tea... added lychee boba. Ordered vegetarian pho with fresh tofu but substituted beef broth as I'm not vegetarian. Delish!  Too much...
Thinh An is my favorite spot in tampa.... and  their crawfish and bun mang vit are the best in town , so I gotta give them a big 5 star

I am not convinced of a 4-star rating just yet, but I will upgrade to 3-stars for the following reasons: 1) I finally met Mary Jo and she was very receptive to opening another Adult Ballet class at our request and arranged it the following week, and 2) After the first couple of weeks of the start of the new year, management has improved a lot in responding to emails quickly.
Clean and fast. Good food in various types. Get you a nice hot bowl of Pho and grab a bubble tea on the way out. Need I say more?!

Update: This time we got the vegetarian pho...it was to DIE FOR! So much falvor in one little bowl of veggies, noodles, and broth! Their tofu is something special. I love that they make it in-house, as it tastes like none other. Truly, this place is a gem! Yum yum!

Had just dropped off my boyfriend at the airport and was departing the airport when a cab from this company ran me off the road merging into my lane. I was the only one in my lane and even though I was aware of his, he made no attempt to see that I was in the lane he was merging into and when I noticed him merging into mine, I honked at him. He apparently did not care about my honk and continued to merge into my lane, running me into the far right lane. 
Thanks, cab #430, for ensuring that I will never use this company for services again!

Great menu, excellent food, friendly service, great prices! Winner all around. I had chicken rice noodle soup and loved it. The other members of my party (6 total) had different dinner menu items and all their selections!

I went there today for severe discomfort in my teeth and not only did they admit me on the same day I called (truly appreciated) but they also did an amazing job. As some of you mentioned, I get really nervous when I go to the dentist, but they were great. Dr. Yañez and his staff were really nice and professional. I had two teeth removed and I barely felt a thing. I truly recommend their office whether you live nearby or not. We all know how long it takes to find a good dentist, and they sure are the next best thing! :)

Visited this great restaurant twice so far and will be having dinner there again tonight. The service was outstanding and staff was very attentive. They were eager to assist and explain everything on the menu. I had the Chicken Pho and the grilled pork sandwich. Everything was fresh and crisp. We also ordered the chicken and shrimp rolls that were crispy and light. There was several different drink options we had the watermelon slush, thai tea and the grapefruit tea with lychee. For dessert we had the apple crossiant and a vanilla waffle with vanilla ice cream and green tea ice cream. I would visit again and again as there is so much to choose from on the menu.

I've been here twice in a week. Everything I've had is good. I liked the shredded pork banh mi, spring rolls, pho tai, and fried rice but I really loved the Thinh An Special Vermicelli. The price was excellent for a ton of food and the meat was great, especially the pork. The boba drinks are also really nice. My only complaint is that the desserts were not sweet enough for my taste but that's just my taste.

My favorite place to grab a Bahn Mi in the Tampa Bay Area! I love dining in we always have excellent service. The house made fish sauce is delicious! I'm also a big fan of their drink menu, they have an excellent Thai Tea Boba.

Well, I'm impressed. Husband and I visited today for a sit-down meal. There were some "issues" but I think they're working out the kinks as best they can.

1. FOOD WAS EXCELLENT. We ate from the vegetarian portion of the rather large menu. It was surpisingly full-flavored and not just salt and fat layered on salt and fat like most vegetarian food is. The vermicelli bowls had great mix of heat and Vietnamese flavor. The tofu sandwiches are making me dream of our next visit. The tea was tasty, altbough I think it was boiling still when they brought it to the table! I couldn't drink it for like 15 minutes. I really enjoyed the food.

2. The service needs work, but I think the intent to be excellent was there! They seemed short staffed for SERVERS, but there was a host-type person that came a few times and chatted with us. He refilled oir tea cups at each visit, as is the custom, he explained. There wasn't much to really ask from him, except perhaps in the very beginning I should have been more forthright and asked for service sooner. It took a while to get a server, someone took our drink order, but it took a long time to come to our table. Otherwise, our server visited once while we ate and I had to catch her eye to get the check

3. The bakery area has a nice selection of sweet and savory. We brought home a couple croissants. Pretty delish. They had a nice selection of tofu, ready for take-home. You CAN add it to the check, but I didn't go over there until after we paid for the meal.

4. Seating was a little tight, once the tables were full. And I did NOT like how low the booth seats were compared to the height of the tables. I mean, the table was inches from my face! But, most of the seating is chairs...so I swtiched to a chair.

Since they are barely a month running, at this point I don't expect perfection. But I have to say that this place will be visited often. I mean it's little things that I can ignore or just expect as part of the experience.  This is what you do with restaurants that aren't American-themed.

Today my family from Georgia came to Thinh An restaurant has dinner,our family has combination rice place,Mì Qung and H tiu bò kho( beef stew noodles),all of food tasted so good and the server very nice,thanks for a good dinner.We 'll be back

Subpar food with ridiculous $1.00 fee to use credit or debit card. 

I've had other establishments require a set amount you need to spend to use a card but to charge a $1.00 is going to cost you customers like me. I won't be coming here again.  By the way I ordered $14 worth of this horrible food.

Amazing prices and amazing pho. Was just what I needed with the cold weather. Will definitely be coming back. I ordered the x-large pho dac biet which was very flavorful and had a variety of meat. I will definitely order the large bowl next time because the x-large was huge and I couldn't finish it.

We came during a very busy time period because of Black Friday but luckily we were given a wait time pager and seated within 10 minutes.  I did not see any other parties waiting more than a few minutes as well because the staff was very quick on turning tables.   We ordered an appetizer of BBQ pork rice paper rolls and main dishes of the combination pho (Pho Dac Biet), a Vietnamese pancake (Banh Xeo), and a BBQ pork broken rice platter. They serve their food as it is completed so your company may receive food at different times so that is something to keep in mind.The appetizer came out quickly and was great!  Appetizers range $2 to $3 per and  main dishes or chef specials range from $8 to $10.  If you want something expensive you can try their duck salad which is $30+. The pho arrived first for the main dishes and was the standard combination of meats, tendons, and meatballs typically found in pho.  The broth was very tasty and had a great depth of flavor and of course a combination of add-ins were provided like bean sprouts, basil, cilantro, jalapenos etc.  The broken rice platter was also tasty and had a variety of items like egg, lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber slices included.  The pancake has a lot of bean sprouts inside so I wouldn't recommend it if you aren't okay with that but I enjoyed it.  The meat is mixed into the pancake batter and fried.  We also ordered a Thai tea with boba.  The boba was chewy which I prefer and had just the right amount of sweetness.

Definitely would recommend this!

Sidenote!  There is also a bakery area and drink bar area if you just want to pop in and grab something quick.  Some of their rice options come prepped so you only need to unwrap and eat!

Hello darkness my old friend.

This "supermarket" is anything but. The inside is dark or very dim and creates a dingy ambience. The deli workers were wiping their noses both with and without gloves. Lovely. 1 Rhinovirus with my cheese. No thank you. 

The cheese selection at the deli is particularly paltry. No standard Landolakes or even more special cheeses. Awful customer service by a new girl who just started today. They also don't carry Amoroso's bread! The best bread in the area made locally- and this place doesn't carry it. 

The price of food here is also pretty high considering what you get. The meat section occasionally has specials, but no angus beef? The manager tells us, they won't carry it, and they never give manager specials on steaks. Literally five minutes later someone puts the stickers that read "manager's special" on the steaks. Wat. 

This place just gives off a whole dirty vibe. It seemed to have more of a selection and friendlier staff when it was a SuperFresh. Ironically I think SuperFresh was owned by Acme. It will be the last time I come here.

The hu tieu sa te is not as good as i thought . And the servers took the wrong order of our goi cuon . We ordered goi cuon nem nuong but they gave us goi cuon tom thit . I can only give this place 3 stars !

First stop in Tampa is always here. Everything here is so good! One side is a restaurant and the other side you can buy food to take home. Like spring rolls,egg rolls, shrimp toast, fresh bread, lots of different Asian pastries. The banh mi's are also very good. Packed with meat and flavor. Lee's sandwiches used to be my favorite. But now it's from here! I'm from Jacksonville and we always stop by here and get food to go and bring it siesta key beach. Everything is very affordable. Banh bao's are $2 and are big and tasty. Try a little bit of everything from the store side. I'm almost sure you will love it all.

Really disappointing. Pizza dough was sweet and doughy. Chicken wings were waaay too salty. Turkey hoagie was also sweet (we didn't order honey smoked turkey). Flounder over rice tasted fake and like cardboard. Old bay fries were soggy. The onion rings were the only redeeming item and they were just normal; But at least they were edible. Really disappointed; tried it for the first time and spent a lot of money to try multiple items...there was nothing we ordered (besides the onion rings) that we could even eat. Waste of money.

I went for lunch with a few friends that are vegetarians. It was nice to have a mixed menu so we could all find some we wanted. I had the bbq pork sandwich with an avocado smoothie, both were great! I will definitely be coming back.
We visited and picked up a tri-tip today. Fed all 5 of us with leftovers for tomorrow. Great deal and delicious food!

There has been less than the number of fingers on my right hand of the number of places whose service was as bad as this one. First the waiter was nowhere to be found for the first 10 minutes. Then, when the waiter arrived, he seated two other people before us. HIGHLY LIKELY a racist establishment. Terrible service. I would not recommend this place.

I heard so much about this place, and we live sooo close I thought I would just drop in and grab a takeout menu. I ended up ordering the most delicious Pho (soup w/ rice noodles and lots of fresh vegs) for both myself and my neighbor, and it was just wonderful. The veggies were so fresh and crispy they serve them in a seperate container so you can add them later and they remain crispy. Then I spent 15 minutes looking at all the goodies they have in a self serve area near the cash register: yummy baked goods, I recommend the flaky croissants, especially the almond and the apricot ones. If you are vegetarian they have lots of tofu and veggie goodies. If you are a coffee lover, you MUST try the Vietnamese Coffee: iced espresso and condensed milk over ice- OMG YUMMY! I drank one in 5 minutes and went in to get another to go. This place is closed on Tuesdays but every other day they are packed at lunch - even the patio was full. So call ahead for takeout or go in at a time when the lunch crowd is gone. I havent tried anything else food wise but neighbors who are Vietnamese Foodies say its Awesome! Happy Dining!!
Such amazing food! Wendy was our waitress both times we've been here and she was sooo sweet. We loved talking to her. We can't wait to go back!

I love Thinh An. Their soups and vermicelli bowls are so delicious. I always end up getting the chicken vermicelli bowl , and orders of spring rolls and fresh rolls. Finish with a waffle for dessert. And don't forget to take a look they their pastry and to go section with great selections.

I've only been here once, but I'm already HOOKED! The place is meticulously clean and feels so inviting when you walk in. You're greeted with friendly and smiling faces right off the bat. The modern design and decor is a very refreshing view. The service is prompt and attentive. On the first visit, we tried a little bit of everything, lol. The bun bo hue was very tasty so it's a must try. My boyfriend had the Thinh An Special with broken rice and he loved it. The portions is nothing like other places. Plate and bowl sizes will leave you full and satisfied.The drink/dessert menu is to die for. There's so many flavors and options, it's going to tempt you to keep returning so you can try them all. For anyone who's on the run and short on time they have a nice to go selection as well. Obviously we had to get some to try later. Definitely recommend the chocolate and almond croissants, so delicious!  Overall, everything is yummy and will leave your taste buds wanting more. Going back again, VERY SOON.
Best and friendliest practice in the city. Dr Yanez and his staff are great, he does great painless work.

Can't Believe this place only has four reviews, this is the only place in Tampa to come to for laser hair removal! Their prices are more than fair and they use the latest and best technology.  I highly recommend Arviv for laser hair removal!
Super tasty! Second time I've been here. I always get a chicken broth based pho. The shakes are great. Looking forward to getting some tofu to go.
If I lived closer to this place, I would be here almost everyday. The food is delicious and very cheap! They have a grocery as well. I am able to buy some snacks for the week.

Waited 1.5 hour and my food never came out! And apparently the appetizer comes out after we eat the main entree. They also Lack organizational skills, because they keep asking us if the food we ordered already came out or not. Im very disappointed. They were definitely not ready to open this business
This is a great place with reasonable prices and huge portions. The wings in fish sauce are amazing. I recommend any of the pho.

I'm so happy this place opened! Finally an authentic Vietnamese restaurant with very reasonable prices. They have a large variety of teas, milk teas, slushies, smoothies, etc. with every flavor you can imagine. I've gotten pho and vermicelli bowls, both were outstanding. This is definitely my #1 place in Tampa to get shrimp pho and they even have an on-premise "store" that sells fresh baked goods, Vietnamese snacks, and hot foods just in case you want to grab something quickly. The staff is also extremely friendly and punctual, meaning you're never sitting at your table wondering where your food or waiter/waitress is. That itself is a huge plus.

Stopped in for lunch on a Saturday afternoon and was welcomed by the modern, but relaxed setting. We tried both of the satay (skewer) appetizers: chicken and lamb. The lamb was great, but the chicken with the peanut sauce was absolutely incredible. My main dish was the soto betawi (beef soup), and it was quite an impressive bowl of soup. 

Both the appetizers and the main course were presented nicely, with sides of lime and hot pepper paste, extra peanut sauce (yes please, haha), and soy sauce brought to the table. 

Unfortunately I couldn't do dessert that day, but will definitely stop back in sometime to try the happy mango (looks fantastic), and the fried banana.

High quality, inexpensive, great neighborhood spot. I'll definitely stop by again!

We came with a party of 6 and they started sporadically bringing about half of our orders but after about an hour of waiting we still didn't get the rest of our orders so we just cancelled it. The few things that came out were good but it was not worth the headache and hassle. They have a terrible system for bringing food out. Not only do they not know who the food goes to at the table, but they don't even know which table it goes to. I'm pretty sure they gave our food to other tables that got their after us. To make it worse, the manager had an attitude with us and made it seem like it was our fault. Not even an apology, attempt to make amends, or offering to compensate. Never coming back again.

The worst. Will be boycotting wawa until they make this store safe. The one on aramingo has security. My family got a death threat today when they came here. Not just that, my husband and child were followed all around the store and the staff and nonexistent security did NOTHING. They allow intoxicated 'customers' to roam the store inside and harass customers. Never again. Won't be visiting ANY of your locations any more.

Have been here several times, the experience has always been positive and consistent. Do go earlier in the day, it gets packed early and stays packed!

I have always gotten the beef pho bowl with all the goodies, the tendon melts like butter. Service has always been friendly and prompt, the little market and drink bar inside also helps tide you over when waiting for take out.

The bowls and rice dishes have always been fresh and flavorful, this is my go to rainy day or long day comfort delight.
Delicious food, excellent service and beautiful decor. Our favorite spot when we visit Tampa!

After my first visit, all I can think about is when I will be back. The food here is incredibly tasty and delicious. To say that this is the best food that I've ever had out of the food truck does not do this place justice. This is some of the best latin food in Tampa. I don't think I've ever had Colombian fast food before. I am extremely impressed by my first experience here.  I had the Paisa hot dog and the sausage and Fries mix. I can't wait to come back and try something different. This place is definitely worth you stopping through.

This place is amazing!  Clean, bright - comfy...with delicious food.  The staff is wonderful with suggestions from their large menu.  #34 Hue Style Beef Noodle Soup (spicy) is my absolute favorite, although everything we have had here has been beyond awesome with flavor!   The take home pastries and pork sausages (all items are hand made in house)- yummy!  Also try something from the beverage menu- it will not disappoint, most recently had the iced mocha milk slush - WOW!!!  yummy!   Price's are so reasonable for food that is amazing.  Try it  and be a bit adventurous.

First we tried 3 out of the 4 appetizers- shrimp rollade, lumpia, and fried wontons. I always love Indonesian wontons, and didn't mind have two more come along with the egg noodle dish. This bowl covers all the major food groups, plus a side of weird meatball soup. If I'm on my own at an Indonesian restaurant without any eating buddies to share with and I have to pick one thing to order, it will usually be this because of all the flavors and textures. 
 
 
And while mysterious, bouncy, grey meatball soup is not for me, I would have a whole bowl of the tangy cabbage side soup that comes with the fried chicken ($7). It outshined the small portion of fried chicken. 
 

Beef rendang, on special, came with just a little bit of tender beef, but also some unexpected fried shrimp and a tiny dish of kale stew. 

The portion size of the protein in the rendang and fried chicken dishes were  better suited for and individual to enjoy and not for sharing, but the fried fish (on special) was more generous. It was a great plate to share, we all enjoyed digging in to the crispy skin.
Completely agree this studio does not care about their customers unless your a favorite.

All I can say is 3 words! 
MINT CHOCOLATE CHIP!!!!
Yum!!!!!!
Wait, is that four???!!
It's not available all the time but when it is, don't miss it!!!!!
Great atsmosphere, good food, friendly staff, will be back for more food! Recommended to anyone to try the restaurant
Great value and really good food! The fresh cilantro and basil made the pho dishes really stand out.

Honestly I don't want to encourage more people to go, but this is a Tampa gem not to be ignored! If you are not familiar with Vietnamese food, this place will make you wish you were raised on it. The bowls of soup, the Banh mi sandwiches, spring and summer rolls, try them all, we are working our way through the menu, but can't resist ordering our favorites again and again. The prices are ridiculously low, and don't miss out on the crawfish, a flavor like you've never had, of crawfish is not your thing, they make shrimp in the same sauce. Pure heaven!

This is more of a 3.5 rating than a 3. Very nice restaurant, great service. I didn't get anything from the bakery and have heard that it's delicious. I had the vermicelli with grilled pork and egg roll which was very tasty and had good flavors. Their viet iced coffee was very good - a little sweet for my liking but tasty. 

My two viet friends each got pho - the true test of any viet restaurant. They were nice sized portions and came with  all the right fixings however I was not impressed with I tried the pho broth. They agreed that it wasn't the best pho broth they've had in the tampa Bay Area either.

I had a slice of pizza. It was the sort that I associate with Chuck E. Cheese's. That rubs both ways. Nostalgia is better than presence often. The ambiance was somewhat European and definitely fast-foodish. I've heard rumors of some culinary excellence; will have to figure on trying out their hoagies.

Food here is incredible, and its menu is VERY robust! Almost all of the popular Vietnamese dishes
are represented here along with some not so popular but equally delicious dishes. 

Service was prompt, professional, and a notch above most "Vietnamese" joints. Except the only bad is that they may be too busy to be consistent. We received our drinks/orders after a couple tables despite the fact that we were there first and ordered first. No biggie, as the overall experience was very positive. 

They also have a section of the restaurant partitioned out for to-go items (ready to eat, grab and go items). 

Crazy selection of teas, bobas, smoothies...... well let's just say drinks. They have a mind boggling selection and can be seen making them behind the counter.

OMG, WOW. I came to get a bahn mi before heading to the movies. Yeah right! The Pho offerings, Milk Teas, Boba Teas, Slushes, Ice Cream, Waffles and the take out area of tofu, croissants, desserts and bao. I couldn't take it. Yummy overload. I got a Bahn Mi (Special) and a bowl of Pho (I asked for a medium, but she said they only had the regular size.) I had to leave behind a pile of noodles but devoured the broth, veggies and proteins. I wanted to take a little of everything from the take out side but I convinced myself, that I will have to come back for that waffle and ice cream and a tea and sweets to take for the trip back home. Tampa is making it so hard to resist moving here.

The best tofu I've had in Tampa 
Self-serve area offers enticing selection
I found the sever Kara to be efficient and personable
Large menu very reasonably priced
Clean and inviting

This is my 4th visit to Mahla and every time she does a wonderful job. She really has an eye for what looks good on your figure. I can shop confidently knowing that she would be able to bring in and change anything I want! Turnaround time is also very fast!

The worst. The service is rude. They have inattentive teenagers working there that do not even come by your table. Then makes faces when you asked for anything. On several occasions I would ask for a coffee and 90% was just ice! When asked why she said " you have to pay for another one if u want it filled all the way to the top" Look out for that! Food is nothing special. Don't waste your time this place will piss you off more than actually make u want to come back. Unless it is to complain about the service

It is very crowded but not without good reason. The waiter was very fast once we were seated and we had the Chicken noodle Pho, egg rolls, and Thai chicken curry. I waited a while for the chicken curry but it was well worth it. Never has chicken and potatoes tasted so delicious than in that curry sauce. Accompanied by bread for dipping which is so soft and fluffy. My bf's Pho was really flavorful and delicious as well. We ended with taro boba smoothies. Talk about a foodgasm. We only wish we had learned about it sooner because it was just a 5 minute drive.

I do crossfit in California, and was in Tucson for a week (for work).  I decided to do a drop in class at CrossFit Purgatory and I'm so glad that I did!  The coach (Aly) was enthusiastic and knowledgable.  The gym was clean and they had great equipment.  I highly recommend this place!!

Sooooo good. So very good. I stopped here and had phó tai and chicken egg rolls to go. My pick up order (which I ordered online through their website) was ready when I got there. The staff was friendly and accommodating. I ate my food ate home and I cannot overstate how delicious it was. I tried another popular place in town last week that offered smaller portions and wasn't nearly as good. I just moved here from the East Bay Area of California, where there is an abundance of pretty much any kind of Asian food you could ask for.....except good phó. I am really excited to have amazing phó again!! The only complaint I have is that I ordered extra beef (+$2) and I think they only gave me the standard amount. Overall, I'm looking forward to coming back.

It's Tuesday and we came for lunch.  For future reference do not go on Tuesday.
Tuesdays are closed. As posted on store door schedule.

favorite Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa Bay
I took classes there many years ago.  I feel favorites were played and I would recommend another studio.

It was worth the 45mins drive from Clearwater! Service was great! Waiter was very helpful and honest. Food portion and price are reasonable (they def. Make sure you get more for your buck for sure). The most organize Vietnamese restaurant I've been to. Authentic Vietnamese food right here! We'll definitely come back here when we are back on this coast.  

Opportunity more improvement: the che 4 mau was not impressive. Nothing memorable and it was too sweet.

Been here twice, and everything is awesome. I fancy the interior as well as the food, thank you for answering my prayer by providing my favourite kinda meal in Philadelphia (grilled chicken, sambal, and tamarind soup). Gave them some encouraging inputs on my first visit and they fixed it on my second visit. I only spent 35mins on my first visit from waiting for the food until devouring them which was surprising because they were packed. There are some improvements that they are able to accomplish in the future I believe. And please do consider to change your music playlist in order to meeting the longing of Batavia's ambience. Well done.

This is by far the best Vietnamese food I've ever had. Between 4 adults and 3 toddlers, we had the curry chicken, fried rice, summer rolls, BBQ sandwich, beef noodle soup, chicken noodle soup and fresh bread rolls. The food was phenomenal! The curry sauce was so good I poured it over the fried rice. I also enjoyed a Mango Boba slushie after all that.

I'd probably give the restaurant a four star rating, but the bakery is my favorite new stop. Croissants filled with assorted fillings, egg rolls (delicious), seafood toast!, buns, tofu, banh mi rolls... I've loved every baked good I've gotten here. 

The restaurant isn't too bad but the service (probably because they're so new) has been a bit scatterbrained. Also, each time I've dined in, they didn't have what I wanted on the menu.

I would give a ZERO if this was an option.

I'll summarize my preceding review as it appears to be missing. This location has no signs OR reasonable convenient access to restrooms. To find THE ONE CUSTOMER RESTROOM, please be prepared for Acme's version of Siberia. To get there you have to navigate the storage area in the rear that is linked to multiple prep rooms. You are exposed to large containers, equipment and foot traffic by busy workers. It is a potentially dangerous obstacle course that tells you all you need to know about how this company views customer comfort, safety AND RESPECT and the priority it gives these: ZERO x3.

So don't fall for phony catch phrases, fake apologies and plastic smiles.

Fellow customers: take your hard earned money to a place that respects you and ALL your needs.

This was my first time trying Pho and I loved it! Huge portions and a very nice atmosphere! We also had the fresh rolls with sliced pork and shrimp which were also very good but just a little bit too much basil for me. I loved the peanut dipping sauce that came with them.  We will definitely be back!

delicious and fresh food. I'm very sensitive to new foods and Things I'm not used to. Never made me feel bad eating here and you can tell it's good quality. Sometimes the chicken is a little tough/overdone in the pho but that is my only complaint so far and I have been several times. Staff is always super nice.
This is like the 3rd time here I like it a lot it's right down the street from my house they have a wide variety of food and beverages I'm working my way to all of it! Lol

This place is exceptional. Everytime always busy. O matter what time and day, except Tuesday since they closed. Variety noodle soup and vietnamese
Sandwich, also drinks. What I like is the concept
They bring is combine street food on the other side of dining so you just grab and pay when you ready. Is good place and you will surprised what they have that you not going to find in orher Vietnamese restaurant in the area.

There are many Crossfit gyms in Tucson and I can honestly say that Purgatory is about as good as it gets. Marcy and Tony know how to foster a community people want to be a part of, and have made this space in-between a little slice of heaven. Be ready to be pushed to your limits and work hard on a daily basis but the sacrifice is well worth the rewards.

I am dedicating my 2000th review to this Vietamese cafe I found thanks to yelpers.  I  am competely in love!    

The price is unbeatable ...huge bowl of vermicelli $10, boba tea $3, summer rolls $3, banh mi $5....are you kidding me!   It is not just cheap, but also the quality is amazing.  Everything was so fresh and wonderful.  

Not only that, they have great customer service.  Everyone is so hard working, efficient, attentive and nice.  This place is always busy but somehow they manage very well.  

They have very clean environmen including the bathroom, which is a very good sign.  Oh I wish this place is in Hawaii I would be their regular customer!  I really hope they keep up the good work.

Bio: Vegetarian, who loves different cuisines and want to have a good gastronomical experience.

Pure bliss. A Minneapolis person giving high recommendation of a Vietnamese food in Tampa doesn't happen a lot(reason: Minneapolis has one of the highest Vietnamese settlement in the States and known for its great Vietnamese food scene).

Tried their spicy hue pho. Top notch. This soup is something in between a clear Pho and thick curry pho. Very hard to find this consistency in pho as you generally get only extremes.

Also tasted their Banh mi and stir fry noodle. Both super great. 

Biggest up: Affordable and not too expensive. Great taste.
An Awesome place to eat authentic Vietnamese food, love their variety in food and beverage

I just came out from my cleaning and had a filling done as well. My teeth feel amazingly clean and polished.
Very professional and efficient treatment. Doctor Yanez was  friendly and explained everything very clearly. No pain at all.
The office is clean and very well located!

I will admit I haven driven past this place a bunch of times and never thought twice about going there. I met my husband for lunch there on a Friday afternoon. Lots of people on lunch there from work. The place is decorated nicely and service was good. The floors and the menu were a little sticky/tacky feeling, which put me off a little. I ordered a "smaller" bowl of won ton noodle soup with pork and that was a meal in itself! The portion is humongous - I couldn't even finish half of it. Very large portions and the value for what you get is pretty good. I don't see any issues gong there again. Just not sure I would go out for dinner or anything. A quick lunch is fine for me.

Fantastic experience - food was excellent, service and ambience were even better. Unique mix of Spanish, Cuban, and Italian fare made for a fun and delicious dinner party with the extended family. A tourist beacon for sure - but one that hasn't forgotten its homey roots after 100+ years of business.

I love Vietnamese food and this place is great! We arrived on a Monday around 2:00 and the place was packed! I was happy to see this because that just means one thing...that the food must be good! Well...it was better than good it was as I said in my first sentence, it was GREAT! We had a Bun, a Combination Pho, a Banh Mi, Spring Rolls & Summer Rolls! Everything was yummy and we can't wait to come back and order other things off the menu! The service was wonderful the place was cute and clean! Thank you Thinh An Kitchen! We will be back!
First time experience was very enjoyable. The staff was very friendly and informative and didn't make a language barrier a problem :)((()

This is the best restaurant for authentic Vietnamese cuisine in Tampa. The menu is quite extensive and also provides customers with a variety of customizations for any dish or beverage (diet friendly). The menu pricing is affordable even on a budget, portions are more than generous, the food is phenomenal and staff are very attentive and friendly. The restaurant is super popular and can be quite busy, but  usually in such a circumstance the wait times are short for dining in. There is also a small deli inside of the restaurant that anyone can access which is my favorite feature, especially if you want something small like a snack. Tl;Dr, this place has massive clout, it's ALWAYS lit, you absolutely want to dine here if you're visiting Tampa and you better have eaten eaten here if you live in Tampa lol.

New Indonesian cuisine ,.... I went there today and ordered bakmi ayam jamur ,......and I like it ,the foods are good , the pangsit is reeaaally goood (I recommend) , the indoor lay out is nice, the service are good ,IS ONLY TAKE THEM 15-20 MINUTES TO BRING MY ORDERS ,so it quite normal (no worries). I definitely back for more .....!
Totally ghetto store. Smells like rotting garbage, the checkout girls are rude and don't belong in this neighborhood. An awful store.

Don't expect a cab. I understand it's a busy evening (Buc's Game), but after being assured twice, I expect you to show up. Disgraceful to say the least. I guess it is no wonder Tampa Cabs Plus was unavailable, they're reliable.

Service was great. Very friendly and food came out fast. We had chicken satay for appetizer with peanut sauce. The chicken is tender and moist with very tasty sauce. Wonton soup is ok and tends to fall apart. I had the veggie noodle soup with chicken and mushrooms. It's on the salty side and the flavoring is similar to instant-ramown seasoning and I could taste white pepper. The flat noodle (kwetiaw siram) had again dominated by white pepper also the stir fry version of it (kwetiaw goreng). We had ropang for dessert which was amazing. It's a toasted bread with chocolate, cheese, and ham filling topped with shredded cheese and sprinkles. This place is cash only.

Thanks to TJ for putting this event together! Sadly, even with arriving at 2 pm on Sunday, the restaurant was still packed.  Finally we were sat, and our waitress was right on top of things, taking our order super quickly.

Most food came out surprisingly fast, I thought, even if at all different times. That's fine with me-I like my food to be really hot.  My veggie & tofu pho was fabulous. I'll definitely be ordering that again.

Unfortunately, the durian for the durian challenge was brought out midway through the meal, and I had to suffer smelling it's rotten odor the rest of my meal. The repulsive smell even came through the styrofoam container we stored it in! Nasty!

RJ actually liked it-it was very anti-climatic.  I would have to say Chris W and I were the biggest "hell no-ers!" Make sure you check out TJ's video of Chris smelling-correction-tasting it-truly hilarious.

First of by saying that the decor of the place is very nice. BUT the food was just mediocre. I got the grilled chicken platter and my SO got some noodle dish. Both of us agreed that sky cafe does it better. We will not be returning.

Food: 8/10 (Huge portions)
Service: 7/10
Value: 9/10
Ambience: 7/10

TL;DR - Great food, price, service, and portion. Really nothing bad to say except Pho broth was not the best I've had. Bubble tea was good as well.

I expected it to be more spacious based of pictures i've seen on Yelp. It was packed, though doesn't feel cramped, at lunch time.

I was surprised by how big the bowls and portions were with our orders. (#13 Pho and # 32 Vermicelli)

They were all yummy of course, but I've had better Pho elsewhere.

I had to finish my girlfriend's Pho as always, which was not a problem.

Bubble Tea was above average according to my BBT expert GF.

I would recommend this place and come back here again when I'm in Tampa again.

Cheers.

This is a wonderful gym. Every workout is challeging mentally and physically but the support of the coaches and fellow members will get you through. There is no time like the present to change your life.

BBQ4U is outstanding!  The owners, Bill & Susan are fabulous!  We have used them to cater two large birthday parties(80+ guests) and we were so thrilled with the food and service each time.  You cannot go wrong using BBQ4U!!  The tri- tip is excellent.  They bring everything to you and are very accomodating with all of your requests.  They have the ability to set up just about anywhere.  Once we had the party at our home.  The other time we had it a a local museum. Our guests just raved about how great the food tasted. We make sure to visit them each time they are at the 4th Avenue Street Fair.  We cannot get enough of their tri-tip.  When you try it, be sure to also put in your order for a tri-tip or two to go.  Just follow the heavenly smell in the air- you won't be disappointed!!!!
Nice and clean restaurant. Very friendly service. Good food. I love this place. It would be great if they can open one like this in the other coast (Bonita Springs or Estero)

I love this place. So delicious. Best pho I've had in tampa by far. The customer service was great the other night as part of our meal didn't come out and they gave it to us for free because it took a while. Great place with good food and service!
Very good for the price.  Great Vietnamese food for a low cost.  Gotta try it!

While they are very generous with their food. It is poorly cooked. They probably need a new chef. No salt. No flavor. Onions are not caramelized. Steak is cheap. I can find better refried beans in a can.

Drop in for a couple of days from Denver. These people run a great place. I'm still kind of new to this and the coach was both supportive and extremely helpful, providing insight on proper form. This is a keeper.

I saw the creative loafing article recently and then checked Yelp...so it looked like a place I needed to try. The place is where Ginza use to be. But the inside was redecorated. We went on Saturday and the place was packed. But we were seated promptly. Ordered petty fast. I ordered a sandwich because of the fresh baked bread, pork summer rolls, kids beef pho, tofu dessert, waffle ice cream, and combo fried rice (to go). Shares the food with my husband and still had leftovers. Everything seems pretty basic but loved the tofu. Nothing like having fresh tofu. The waffle ice cream I was disappointed cause the waffle wasn't freshly made...we sat right in front of the waffle maker and it wasn't being used when our waffle ice cream was being made. I like my waffle warm and crispy. This was cold and chewy. We ate half of it. The ice cream I got was more like icicles. So snow ice that I've had in Hawaii ...they flavor the ice before it comes out like snow. And that is what this ice cream was like then the traditional creamy ice cream. 

On our way out we had to buy some 50 cent loaf of fresh bread, sesame balls, and pork bun. Still need to try them. 

The price of everything was really reasonable...I would definitely frequent the place if I lived closer. But I'll be back for fresh tofu and want to try the fresh soy milk. 

I can't think of anyone being disappointed with this place. So much to offer.

This place is great. Really new, clean environment and great food. The waffels are an awesome desert! If you love Vietnamese food but are turned off from saigons deli's uncleanness than this is the place for you.
Takka has an excellent menu and their staff is always warm and friendly, I've tried almost their entire menu and I have loved everything I've tasted, yes I'm slowly eating my way through the menu.

First visit for me, but Lay has been a couple if times. I had a ham and egg sandwich which was quiet good with a light crusty roll. Lay had their Pho for the first time, and decided it is about the best he has found. They also have all the spices and sauces he likes with his Pho.

The service was good, and the restaurant is very clean and comfortable. They also have a pretty substantial bakery.

I have been going here for the last couple of years. Because of the shortage of decent places to eat around my office, we had no choice but to order from here.  They have really good salads but everything else is sub-par.  Their customer service is horrible.  They are often rude on the phone.  We ordered a plain stromboli a few weeks ago and they delivered us a steak stromboli.  We called to complain but the lady told us it was our fault and was convinced that we ordered the steak.  She was rude and just plain nasty to us.  Since that experience we researched other places and finally found a better quality/price lunch shop.  I have not ordered since.

Great restaurant quality food out of a truck. Really good for late night drunk food. Only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was it was a little pricey and portions were kind of small. But overall great food!

Good service and lots of options. I enjoy the "to-go" snacks and the boba tea is pretty decent. This is a similar restaurant you'd see all over California which is heavily populated with Vietnamese people, so we were happy to see one open up in town and it is definitely comparable. I have not tried many dishes so I cannot give it five stars yet!

This place is awesome, we eat here at least once a week. My husband gets the beef pho soup, I always get the chicken vermicelli (bun) and the fresh rolls with the chicken or shrimp, my son always gets the fried rice. Its all really good and fresh, the fried rice has cilantro in it and tastes so good. Also the place is super clean and they have a bakery with all kinds of good foods that you can just grab and go.

Boba tasted odd.. couldn't finish it cause I thought I would get sick.. I also got the egg puff waffle with ice cream. It was also disappointing. Not work the long wait.. Don't get me wrong, the food looked amazing. Just personally not my cup of tea

Thinh An has been a consistent go-to restaurant for my family and friends, but the service and timing of when the foods comes out has declined. Before giving this review, I wanted to give them a second chance. The first incident the food never came out after checking in 3 times. This second incident I decided to order something simple - fried rice. I'm not sure if the cooks changed but the rice came out after 30 minutes (3 tables that came after us had their food) and it was soggy. I didn't know fried rice could be soggy. I was polite and told the waitress no big deal; however the owner was not happy that I sent it back and asked how much did I eat. Seriously, I had 1/2 spoon if that and shouldn't a good restaurant owner be more concerned about the quality or reason why I sent it back? Not here.
Very fresh! Beautiful fixtures and clean. Great manager. Ask questions when trying something new and don't solely rely on pictures.
Please don't call the place The one fast food when you don't know how long gonna take to make a pre cooked hot dog......

They just started selling beer and wine and have much cheaper prices than corner stores in the area. The renovations have also made the interior much brighter and more navigable. It's a big improvement from the dimly-lit Super Fresh that previously occupied this space.
Best vegetarian pho I've ever had in Tampa. No other place does it quite like Thinh An Kitchen. Their portions are pretty good too and the prices are fair.
Terrible service. Don't use United. Use any service instead

This might be our new favorite Vietnamese spot in Tampa Bay! It's spotlessly clean and tastefully decorated, while still keeping prices in the very reasonable range. Now... about that Tofu... It's freaking delicious!

They had four flavors of fried tofu... original, scallion, mushroom, and chili lemongrass. All were spectacular as an appetizer! The chili lemongrass was my favorite.

We also scarfed down some pork spring rolls that were equally delicious. On to more pork and rice and a massive bowl of Pho. Yum!

Finally, we had no room for dessert but got numerous flaky croissants to go since they were like $1.50 each and they had mango, pineapple, blueberry, and almond beyond the normal plan and chocolate. When's the last time you had a mango croissant? For me, it was a first!

We can't wait to return!

I waited for this place to open for a while and LAWD when I tried it, it was everything and more.  Lots of choices on the menu for all taste pallets, everything moderately priced, and huge portions.

The resturant is brightly lit with modern decor and a huge video projector on the side wall. If you went there to actually watch a game, which im sure wouldn't be the case, its placed behind where the waitors and waitress are working. So it's not a clear view. But you can see majority of whats going on on the screen.

The best part is the ala carte thats located on one side of the resturant. Small groceries, packaged up entrees, eggrolls, pastries etc. Good for if you're in a rush.
LEGIT!!!!! The restaurant is clean, the staff is nice and very quick! Best of all the pho is amazing! My new favorite place!!

Okay so I feel like I was the least upset about my most recent experience here. I think a lot of that has to do with the fact that I wasn't in a rush or hangry. 
We first showed up and found out there was a 30 minute wait. That was a good sign I thought as I've never experienced a wait at a Vietnamese restaurant. However we were all hungry and not looking to stand around. We asked if we could eat outside as they had all the tables open outside and we were told that they didn't serve food outside. So waiting is what we did.
After a 20-30 minute wait we were seated at our table. We looked at the vast menu and ordered some drinks. We then all ordered food, admittedly we all ordered multiple things as wanting to really see how this new restaurant was.
After a bit one of our meals came. Within 10/12 minutes we all got at least one of our items.
However that's where it seemed to take a turn. We  all got our pho, stew, and vermicelli but the fresh rolls, spare ribs, and banh mi were no where to be found. We assumed they would come when made as not all of our other food came at once. Once we had finished those dishes we decided that was enough waiting and asked. Not to mention the table next to us that ordered those exact same things were already almost done with theirs and they were seated after we were. Luckily I wasn't that upset since I had my Pho already, but if that wasn't the case I would have been very mad. We then told the waitress who did not know why they missed 4 of our items from our order, but to her defense I could see where she had put it in.
We cancelled a few of the items and got the others to go. Overall no complaints about the food, but the mistakes kind of overpowered the food. 
Then we decided to order the egg cup waffle and shaved ice. This took another good 20 minutes to get. We were warned about the wait for this so I don't know how much you can fault them for that.
To top things off as we were leaving we noticed other people dining outside in the same seats we were told they did not serve food at. After the mess ups with our dinner that was the cherry to the top of the frustrating dinner experience.

Pho was fresh and tasty.  Too much oil in broth for me but my wife loved it.    Veggies super fresh. 

Bang Mi sandwich (BBQ pork) was great.  Next time I'm getting extra pork. 

Summer roles hit the spot too.  

A ton of tea, and dessert drinks. 

Small restaurant, service was okay but they were very busy that day

We ate here for dinner last night and it was fine. Came back today to get some prepared foods in the market area and the honeycomb cake was stale and the coconut milk was chunky and very sour! Becareful buying the prepared foods.  It's not hot even under heating lamp as we got the eggroll and nem nuong on a stick.

1st time and we got good, if not excellent!  We'll come back for more and try the other menus.

Tip. Keep a good lookout for their "specials" board.

The lines are long and the food portions are small.   The family owners give horrible customer service.  They are rude and don't care about their customers, they only care about making money.  There is plenty of other good vendors who care about their customers; don't even bother.
If you are looking for an authentic Vietnamese restaurant look no further this place is it. Best food I have had in a long time. Definitely will be a repeat customer.

Thanks to Hilary E, I for the past 10 Wednesdays I woke up at 6am to go do more more in 40 minutes than I usually do in an entire day. That's not to say I'm a lazy sloth, when it comes to sweating, I'm down for just about any and all physical activity, but something about the way CrossFit packs explosive movements into a 20 minute workout, it shakes ya up. Santa could stand to do a WOD with elves (workout of the day).

I know there are a lot of CrossFit gyms in Tucson and this one is pretty tight. It's not much to look at on the inside, mildly run down, but I imagine most of that falls to the landlord that owns the storefront. I'm excited that I tried these guys out in 2011. Not certain if I'll keep at it yet in 2012, but it's worth looking into if you can be safe about it, and don't get too caught up in the hype. Be smart and know what you're body can do and you won't risk injury.

This is one of my favorites stop whenever I land in Tampa International Airport.  I like banh mi, banh boa, sesame balls, Vietnamese doughnuts that i can get from the deli.  The dishes in the dining area are usually spot on.  However, for this visit, the broth for pho tai and bun bo hue was not as good.  It had a sweet taste like MSG was used .  I hope that it was just a one time occurrence.
This is old-school, loaded with flavor extra-smokey tri tip.  Give it a try.
yum so good!! Great Food at a GREAT price!!! I order the economy grilled chicken breast..it comes over a bed of Yellow rice...(sometimes it could be cooked a little longer) but its delicious!

Went here because we want to try something new. We have no relation with the owner and never meet before (saying this due to other reviewers comment).

We treat this restaurant as a new restaurant, meaning we would not compare this place to another place since that would be subjective and defeat the purpose.

Service: other reviewers might come during their first time opening this place so you should expect them to be very busy, maybe panic, or confuse.

We went here during dinner time Sunday and service were fast, we actually count the time due to the reviews about the slow service. It was not slow at all. 3 minutes for appetizer, we ordered 2 of them. Maybe 5-7 minutes for both of our main dishes.

Food: 

For the appetizer, we order Rujak Buah and Friend wonton.

Rujak Buah basically a fruit salad with peanut dressing.

The peanut dressing is sweet, sticky (due to the palm sugar), not spicy at all. Contain cucumber, jicama, raw red sweet potato, pineapple.

Fried wonton, have shrimp in it (might be wrong), it's a decent fried wonton.

For the main dish, my wife ordered Ayam Bakar, it came with Sayur Asam, Fried Tempeh, and Tofu. She likes it and that all that matter.

I ordered Nasi Campur Rendang, it came with a lot of other stuff other than the Rendang.

It has Sayur Daun Singkong (boiled cassava leaves in coconut milk), Spicy Egg, Spicy Potatoes, and Shrimps.

They provide you with Acar (pickles) on the table which is a plus for me.

Before we left we ordered the Soda Gembira (soda with milk and some jelly). 

As a new restaurant, it seems they learn to be better which they do and we appreciate that.

Other reviewers that have not to decent experience should give this place a second chance.

We surely going to be back here. And also, a good decoration inside this place.

This place is straight fire. The food is amazing and so incredibly cheap. Portions are big and the taste is on point. Noodles come out so fast. Every time I order pho it comes out in 5 min or less. Hands down the best Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa and officially my go-to restaurant. 

You can tell the owners care about this place. They didn't cheap out on decorations, appearance, and quality of servers. In fact, we were served by the owner himself today. The little market on the side is awesome as well. I would come here every day if I could.

This place is so great that the food is tasty and very cheap. Black milk tea is perfect sweet and the pho is very enough for a good meal. There are also several deli to grape to go. In sum, great food with low price!

Ordered a Buff Chicken Cheesesteak for delivery, and the quality was horrible. In addition to the buffalo sauce tasting more sweet than spicy, every bite of "chicken" I took had fat and gristle, and my fried onions were tough and seemed like the outer layer of onion that should have been thrown away. Called to tell them how disappointed I was, they argued that the sandwich was fine but offered to send me a new one. I instead asked for a small pizza because I didn't think I was going to like any sandwich that they could make me. Rude Manager got on the phone and demanded that they use quality meat, refused to even send me anymore food, asked for the cheesesteak back and said she would send delivery man back with my money.  After already waiting an hour for my first delivery (even thought my address is less than 1/2 mile from them) I was hungry and I can't believe this establishment refused to sell me food. Even the delivery man was rude. 
I am a student at one of the Temple Health schools nearby to this restaurant and will be telling everyone I know, students and staff, not to give any business to this horrific place. 

P.S everything else I've tried from them has been mediocre as well (pizza, Stromboli, soggy fries and chicken fingers, cheap deli meat)

I had to use Sansom Cleaners a couple times and I was very satisfied with the service. They are pretty expensive so I try to dry clean as rarely as I can. Usually I trust them with my silk clothe which cost even more. I paid $13 for silk dress and $9 for silk blouse. They charged me regular $5.25 for dress pants. But its all worse it cause I got my stuff back like new. You always get what you pay for!

Here's how pathetically phobic I am (or rather was) about dental visits: after 7 years of avoiding any trips to the dentist I broke a tooth, and was finally forced to confront my fears. Despite the inevitability of actually going to see a dentist - with half of a molar missing, I wasn't getting out of it, it still took me five sweaty-palmed attempts over the course of a half hour to complete the phone call for my first (emergency) appointment because I kept hanging up as soon as it would start to dial.

From that first phone call on, the experience of dealing with everybody has been 100% positive. The receptionist/manager, Leslie, listened patiently as I babbled on the phone about being extremely nervous, and assured me that we would 'start to build good memories to replace the bad ones'. At the time I didn't remotely believe that that was possible.... but I'm getting there.

The office is really nice - open, airy, super clean, very high tech. The staff, as I mentioned are extremely nice. Everybody was patient and reassuring, in a warm, genuine, and natural way which didn't make me feel patronized. The dental assistant who took the X-rays, took a second to say 'don't worry - it'll be super-easy!'... and it was. And that little comment made a huge difference (thanks!).

Dr Yanez is gentle, efficient, and very knowledgeable. He is focused and unhurried, in the best possible way. He managed to make me feel both informed, and empowered throughout, neither of which are words I associate with any of my prior dental experiences. That comment applies not only to the emergency visit, when I was extremely stressed out, but also to the routine follow-up visits. 

Over the course of three visits, I've had the broken tooth crowned, two cleanings, and two cavities/filling replacements (the penalty for my 7 year hiatus)... and no pain. At all. Ever. They did such a great job of calming me down on the first visit, that I didn't end up asking about sedation, so I don't know whether or not it's offered. Either way - you won't need it! 

They take my dental insurance - yay! (Aetna DMO... I couldn't believe my luck finding such a nice practice, in an emergency, as a new patient). Leslie is a wiz at navigating the benefits end of things. 

TL:DR version - if you're nervous about dentists... this is the place for you. This is also the place for you if you just need a new dentist.
Excellent authentic Vietnamese food with excellent veggie dishes for vegetarians looking for some flavor.

Cute, wholesome, homestyle high-quality baked goods. Not alot of seating, but a lovely spot if you can nab a table. There's one small bar and table inside, and a table that seats three outside with a lovely planter arranged with all kinds of neat tropical things.

We tried the pear chocolate chip scone, which was fantastic. I also had a sample of the apple cinnamon bread pudding cake which was also very good. I like that their baked goods are well-flavoured instead of just being too sweet.

Coffee is fine and they provide soy and almond mik. Corsica is their dark roast.

The server was so friendly!

Drop by. :)

Fresh tasting food and drinks, great portion, fast service, and very helpful staff members. Love their desserts!!!banh mi sandwiches and pho #10 are two of my favorites. We are frequent customers and still loving this place!

This place was packed.  Lots of locals and some big groups as well.  Super fresh food and unsweetened green tea hit the spot.  

No complaints about the food but the service was a wee bit inconsistent.  I don't go to Pho restaurants for the ambiance, I go for the food.  However, took some 15 minutes to flag the waiter down and for him to bring the check.  

First world problems....right?

Small parking lot with a few more spaces in the back, plan ahead!

I was there couple weeks ago bought few things in bakery. Guess WHAT! I bought only few things but my receipt was high. In the receipt 21 items. But I got home and count only 17 items:-( I called the this place immediately then a girl answered only said I'm sorry :-( not even honest to return my money or anything. So I hope anyone if have to go here. Please watching carefully. If not they will take your money under your nose and you don't even realize.
