How do you not LOVE this place??!! It is a one stop shop. Everything is made fresh and in house. The place is beautiful and clean. The service is friendly and attentive. They are over staff. But who cares?? More people to tend to customers. I love all of their bake goods. Baked fresh daily!!!  The soy milk is light and refreshing. And the duck and bamboo soup is to die for. And don't even get me started on the curry chicken- OMG!!! It makes me wanna dance every time i eat it.

It is pretty busy on the weekends but the wait isn't too bad. If you have to wait for a table, just grab a croissant or an egg roll from the to-go section to snack on while you wait. Or grab a boba tea. Teas are awesome too.
The restaurant is small, but it is nice and clean. This is my first time having Indonesian food and I love it. The food is wonderful and I can see their kitchen is very clean.

Highly recommended! I can't count now how many times I've recommended this kitchen to a co workers and friends! Excellent food! Friendly servers and owner! Quite a bit of a drive for us but it's all worth it!
I love CF Purgatory! This is my second home! The coaches, the other members, everything about this place made me feel comfortable and welcomed from day one. This community is my family.
Everything I have tried here is amazing! Very quick service and every person we have encountered here is extremely friendly!

Overall, the food was disappointing. The Caesar salad was very good. The calamari app we ordered was not, very chewy and little flavor. I ordered spaghetti and clams expecting little necks, rather the pasta was served with canned clams. The food is on the cheap side, and it's BYOB - but I wouldn't return.

It is no surprise that this is one of my favorite and go-to restaurants. I've been here multiple times and regardless of the day or time, it's always packed. The place is clean and the staff is always smiling. There's nothing more that I look forward to after a night of drinking than a big bowl of pho from Thinh An. I also love their mi sate, hu tieu bo kho, and com tam ga nuong. My mouth is watering just thinking about it! Their pastries and banh mi are out of this world! It's a must try!

Wow! What an amazing place! I'm so glad that we found it!! Between us we tried the vegetarian fresh rolls, vegetarian bun, and the curry chicken. While I didn't try the chicken, it smelled delicious and my husband said it was great, and both of the vegetarian dishes were extremely flavorful and filling. We can't wait to come back!!

This is hands down my favorite Vietnamese restaurant! It takes me about 45 minutes to get there, but it is worth the drive. It's always packed, but you never wait long for a table. Service is usually pretty good for being extremely busy. Their pho is the bomb!! Their banh mi is bomb! Their desserts are also the bomb!! I can't get enough of this place! Best part is that they're very reasonably priced!

A wonderful little Italian BYOB. Food was excellent and worth the money. Call ahead for reservations as it is a small restaurant.
Highly recommend

I had better elsewhere. I'm giving them 3 stars until they really shape up! Order were taking wrong.  Thai tea is not good so don't order it.  They sure have a BIG selection of snacks & little foodies TOGO. This is my 1st time at their first opening so honestly I'm sure within time their staff can have better accuracy / speed & service.  Overall I will definitely try them again but NOT anytime soon. I highly suggest staying away on weekends unless your available to wait 1hr + for a table. Right now I can only suggest BUN BO HUE. Please don't get Thai Tea.. (you been warn) "good luck". Until next time
Best Vietnamese food in Tampa Bay! I've tried so many places and this is the best. The food is always fresh and abundant. The place is very clean and always crowded.

Excellent Vietnamese food. Extensive menu, deli, chè. The pho is rich and flavorful. I had some soup with ribs and shrimp with a giant sesame cracker. It was great.
The prices are great too. Something for everyone.

This place is amazing!! Just moved from Hawaii where they had awesome Pho and this place is just as good!!! We had bbq pork spring rolls , shrimp spring rolls, pork egg rolls, and beef pho! The place was super clean and the service was amazing. It's really well priced too! We will be back soon!

Visited philly with my love, he took me here. i had a slice of cheese pizza-which was delicious! I didn't even miss the pepperoni. Also had a cheese steak sandwich..the meat was tender, plenty of cheese with lettuce an tomato and a side of peppers!! It was super tasty. It was definitely better than the other place we visited. Service was cool. Needless to say I went back again before I left for Cali!!
Amazing food, just like my mother's cooking. I take my clients and friends here. It's a hidden away so not many people know about it.Truly authentic Vietnamese cuisine

Update here:
I came again the very next day(Saturday around noon)with a girl friend who had yet to try this place. My experience today was a lot better. All the food I ordered came out as expected I was even approached by the manger who explained why they were not able to serve us outside the day prior. 

I am updating to 3 stars because my 2 experiences have been so inconsistent-- it's either a hit or miss. Furthermore, I was able to try more menu items today and felt that some of the food are also either a hit or miss. Wasn't a fan of the Vietnamese frappe and (very fatty)short ribs but enjoyed the shrimp and pork chop that came with the broken rice meal.

All in all I love the interior and modern feel of this place. And, their price point and portion size is more than reasonable! But in terms of flavor,  this is not my favorite Vietnamese place in town.

Initial review:
It was my first time here with a few friends and we were so disappointed with our experience. First and foremost when we arrived, they told us there was a wait and I had asked if we can sit outside so we wouldn't have to wait and the lady up front told us they didn't serve outside. Come to find out later after we had gotten a table inside that they started serving customers outside....  I hate it when I'm lied to and had to wait for a table when others didn't have to wait and could be served outside. So we finally sit down and so many of the items on the menu are crossed out but it seems they did  not do a thorough job crossing even more out because the first beverage my boyfriend tried to order was not available(and not crossed out) and the medium pho option was no longer offered(again, not crossed out on my menu). What is the point of having such an extensive menu if so many items are going to be unavailable? Anyways, so the most horrible thing about our experience was the wait for the food items we ordered. Not only did our foods(the ones we actually got)come out at different times spread minutes apart each, It's like they forgot about half the stuff we ordered-- we got the majority of our entrees but were missing all the appetizers and one entree . When we inquired about those dishes, our waitress said that it's coming and will come out once the kitchen has made it. But, we waited and waited and they never appeared... All a the while, the tables next to us who arrived after us got theirs. Eventually, our waitress went on to the kitchen and moved our order along--this is long after we've already finished our main entrees(minus the one we never got). You'd think they would serve the appetizers before main course but they just completely forgot our appetizers.  It's so annoying and it's not our waitress' fault because she put in our order but it wasn't her responsibility to bring out the food for us.... Anyways, I canceled that entree I never got and my friends eventually got their appetizers around 30mins after I finished my noodles. Then, I decided to order the egg waffle and shaved ice desert. Our waitress put in the order, comes back and tells me it'll be 15 mins until it's ready.... But at least 25 mins went by until the desert arrived. 

Reason why I gave two stars is because although the wait was tragic and they completely forgot about some of the stuff we ordered, the food was decent. The phos and spring rolls were good but the bahnmis are not as good as other places in town--we don't like that they add yellow mayo in their bahnmis and the grilled meat inside is not as good.  Also, I don't think anyone purposely forgot our food but this restaurant needs to have some sort of a system to make sure all food items are made/cooked and delivered because even when some of the staff presented us with the food we ordered, they looked confused and unsure if it was to be delivered to us.

Honestly wanted to love this place but I didn't . The concept is nice and I love their menu design but that's about it . The milk teas were not good , and the meat in both the entree and appetizer tasted off . The only thing I liked was the rice and dressing it was delicious . The prices are pretty cheap. Lastly, customer service wasn't the best , just a very odd ambiance overall .

The food was very authentic and exactly what one could expect to eat in Vietnam. Not the most delicious Vietnamese food in Tampa but it is in the top five. They also have a little food market with pre-prepared food items.

Terrible facility and even worse staff and customer service. Took my car in for repairs through my fleet company and they refused the business because they had 18 cars on the lot, which is apparently too busy for a collision center that is nationwide. There wasn't a single smile from the staff from the moment i walked in. They refused to look at the damage to even know what's  wrong, but immediately knew they didn't have the parts. Needless to say I left there and took my business to Jim click, who were more than happy to take my business because that's what they're in the business for, to repair vehicles.  Will never take my car to gerber collision again or recommend to anyone.

While I cannot vouch for their kids' classes, I'm pretty sure MJPAA does not value their adult students. 

In the past year, their adult ballet class has had three different ballet instructors. Management was slow in updating class changes to their website and is slow in providing requested information to their students. As a previous reviewer stated, I doubt they are internally organized because one of their instructors couldn't tell us whether she would be teaching the following term when the following term was only 2 weeks away.

I only kept attending out of convenience; the studio is within walking distance of where I live. I am still debating whether I will return in the fall.

The food was inexpensive. Bun Rieu was really good! The subs and boba were good. One complaint was as we just finished, and there were people coming in and waiting; we were rushed to pay and leave. The food was great but the service was quite not!

Been here more times than I can count. Great lunch spot from work. They just released new menus, so find your old favorite number on the new format. 

I like the new menus because they show a picture of what you are about to order.

Visiting from Seattle and we eat a lot of Vietnamese food. This place is so, so good!  The tofu is delicious.   Everything is fresh and flavorful.  And the take out buffet was great.  We bought food for breakfast and snacks while we are visiting family here.

This place is absolutely awesome! Cheap price, great taste! Normally, if I go to a pho place, I would be order a few extra dishes to keep me full after couple hours. But this place, oh man! After a bowl of beef stew noodle soup, I don't think I need anymore stuff to fill my stomach! And the big bowl is only $8.50. What can you ask more from that? Also, they have an mini deli bar in the restaurant. All things there look legit and delicious! Great place! Must go!

This was a very unfortunate experience that my entire party of 4 had been looking forward to attending.  Being that it is a new restaurant that serves many tradition items, along with looking at all of the Yelp photos, my friends and myself we're all looking forward to restaurant.

We arrived around 7:15 on a Friday, were told it would be 30 minutes before we would be seated and they handed us a pager.  My girlfriend inquired about the front patio seating, roughly there was 8-10 tables for four that were all available and not being used.  We were told that the patio is closed, so we waited for our indoor table.

Once seated the waitress was very nice and took our drink orders.  On the back of the menu they have pictures of the popular dishes, I noticed a peach smoothie with boba.  After I ordered the drink, the waitress came back and told me that item is unavailable.  I then switched to mango.....I found the smoothie to be average, but the boba was very hard chewy and not as sweet as traditional boba.  I was unhappy with the drink.  

For our main entree's I ordered the #11, rare steak pho.  I found the broth to be over salty and I wanted the medium size that it showed on the menu but was forced to order a large, since medium sizes are no longer available....?  With my party of 4, only one of the four menus had the "Medium Size" option crossed out with a black marker.  It was also very upsetting to find that roughly 35-40% of the menu entire's are only available on Saturday and Sunday.

My friends had ordered pho as well, but all of our pho bowls came out at different times.  Not to mention that my friends had ordered two appetizers, that never came to the table.  Making things even worse, two others in our party had order a second entree for the table, as we were dinning here at this new restaurant and wanted to taste multiple items.  Those two entree's, ban me and sport ribs with sticky rice never came.  After all four of us at the table were finished with our pho bowls, nothing had come out, not even the appetizer's, let alone the 2 missing entree's.  My girlfriend and I requested they remove the spare rib entree from our bill, which they did.  The ban me sandwich, our friend just took it home since the timing was horrible.  

We did proceed to order 1 dessert, which was just average but again not as good as expected (defiantly not as good as it appeared in pictures on Yelp).

As we were walking out of the restaurant, the outdoor/front patio was full with people that had been seated outside.....when were told the patio was closed and forced to wait 15/20 minutes for a table. The restaurant is also attached to pawn shop, which gave me an uneasy feeling as we had to park in front of the pawn shop due to the restaurant's lot being full.  

In closing, the restaurant was very clean, everything being brand new and remodeled, the food I had wasn't anything special just average pho.  The wait and timing of our meals combined with not even getting the appetizer's or other entrees was very upsetting & unprofessional.  The wait staff was nice and the restaurant seems to have the potential to be such a better place, but in my opinion they're desperately in need of leadership/management to help them become more efficient and accurate with orders.

Best Vietnamese restaurant I've been to! Every time we go to Tampa, we come here for lunch. They give generous portions of food at a reasonable price. Love their vermicelli dishes. The number 32 vermicelli has everything in it and tastes so delicious! Will keep coming back for more of their tasty dishes! :)

We went today after caving into a perpetual craving I had for TA's pho mid-afternoon. In addition, I was excited to finally try some pastries as well. #proudfatkid 

The restaurant itself was pretty busy/active (but in a productive way as people were leaving and coming in) but the nicely shaded patio only had one occupied table. Being as we had our dog, we sat outside comfortably at a shaded table by the door. Perfect for our September evening prior to hitting the park so we could all get some exercise in ;) 

Service was efficient and cordial and our dog was treated to a styrofoam water bowl. I appreciated that they accommodated our pooch. 

We both had bowls of pho with rare meat on the side. The bowls came with a nice amount of garnish and a good presentation of meat, had a nice clean broth and were a hearty size--almost too much to eat in one sitting if you haven't eaten all day (like myself). I managed to do just fine. At $8, I feel this is a great value. I utilized some chili sauce and sriacha that were provided to me upon request. Yum! 

I attempted to order the special of the day that I saw on Instagram (if you're a user FOLLOW THEM to see daily specials and some serious food porn), but, wouldn't you know, and like it was suggested, they were sold out. I cried a little inside; IG rep wasn't kidding when we were encouraged to get it while it lasts. The crabmeat and shrimp toast looked divine and I'm sad that I missed it. Because I was in the mood for tofu, I got four pieces of their flavored house made tofu ($1 total) from the food bar to sample at the table. I really enjoyed the mushroom tofu and the lemongrass tofu very much; it was unlike anything I ever had and the tofu was inflected with vegetables and seasonings. 

Of course we had to get our favorite avocado boba to split. That was the icing on the cake.  A few pastries and treats from the food bar later and waddling away with a full belly it was a wrap. I wish I could say that I ate their dessert tofu with a delightful ginger sugar syrup but I was sooo full. I will dream about the next time I can visit. Thanks, Thinh An crew for an enjoyable experience!

Stopped here for lunch randomly... Boyfriend got a quesadilla mixta, I got the arepa mixta-- let me tell you.. AMAZING!! Owner was so nice and friendly, explained a lot of the platters to us and helped us pick out food and drinks... We also got the mango and mora drinks and those were phenomenal also!! Can't wait to return here soon!!
Great Vietnamese food, great value, excellent friendly service in a convenient bright clean modern location.  Best in Tampa!

This place is awesome!!!The cook greets us with open arms every time we visit from the DMV!!! I love this place and can't wait to visit again!!' The cheesesteaks are awesome the drinks at the bar are the best yessssss a must visit !!!

My overall review of this place would be a 3.5, so I decided to round up.  I stopped in on a Friday night after a majority of the dinner rush had subsided.  I was seated quickly, but the side booth areas felt like I was literally eating with some random people at the table next to me.  Our waitress was less than attentive and took a couple of trips back and forth to the table to get our drink orders and deliver our drinks.  Once we ordered the food came out fairly quickly.  I ended up trying the Chicken Vermicelli bowl and it was a generous portion and satisfied my craving for something semi-healthy during this meal.  I'll be back to try the pho, but I hope the service gets a bit better based on my experience.

I can't believe I am the first to review! Bill and Sue have done their BBQ for years at the 4th Avenue Street Fair, SAHBA Home Show, and catered all over the city. Their tri-tip is the best meat I  have ever had! And I know I am not alone in that thought. they also do catering with chicken, beans, salads, and more, Bill has the coolest BBQ set up and only uses mesquite which smells and makes the meat awesome!
The food is delicious and they have so many options to choose from. Our table had the fried rice, vermicelli, an egg puff, and drinks from the coffee bar. Everything was great. Highly recommended.

Finally a breakfast sandwich next to my office! ok enough about my needs lol Loved this place it offers breakfast and lunch.  I ordered an egg and cheese breakfast sandwich on cuban bread with a double expresso, it's was $6 and well worth it.  Sandwhich was a great size, the cuban bread was fresh and eggs cracked on the spot. I will be a regular here for breakfast and lunch.  they have salads , sandwiches and for bread they offer white, wheat, rye, cuban bread and croissant.  I'm posting pics of menu.  Must try!

There are 20 one-star reviews for this cab company that yelp filters out. What's up with that???

I ordered a cab, they said it will be about 20 mins. 25 mins later I called, they said it will be about another 15 mins. I called again after 15 mins, they said it will be about another 10 minutes. It took them almost an hour to pick me up. On a Sunday afternoon. 

Now I understand that sometimes things get busy. Maybe they need an hour to pick me up. But tell me, don't lie to me and make me call back 3 times because you are  not doing what you say you are doing.

There are no words to impeccably illustrate the wonderful experience CrossFit Purgatory, their coaches and their members offer! The atmosphere is gracious, exhilarating, energetic and positive! The gym genuinely cares about community and their members...(so much; we do burpees if we don't remember each other's names!!) I LOVE IT! Anyway, I have to say; my favorite thing about CrossFit Purgatory is they recognize that I pay for a service, one with the purpose of helping me reach the fullest of my potential. I expect this gym to give me the coaching and tools necessary to make me faster and stronger than then me yesterday and let me tell you, I'm never disappointed. Something that hasn't gone unnoticed is that they know my potential and because they do, they will and have never let me sell myself short. Sure, I'll extremely dislike them during those brutal heavy breathing minutes during the WOD, but in the long run I'm grateful for that drive. Lastly but most certainly not least, they never push me too hard as they truly believe in community, optimal health, functionality and helping others realize just how much they can achieve. Try it...it's an experience worth having!

Came here for lunch on a Friday afternoon with my sister. The menu is not very big, but each of the dishes we decided on were packed with flavor! We shared lamb sate and each got nasi with beef rendang. The beef was tender and filled with spice. The accompaniments were tasty and added nice relief to the spice from the sambal. The service was quick and the atmosphere made me feel as if I were in a shop in Jakarta. I loved the little touches of Indonesian culture. Will definitely eat here again!

This ACME seems to have a better selection than the other grocery stores that are around my apartment. It's about a mile away but I still make the hike with some others who live in my apartment because they don't disappoint!

I see that others are disappointed in the store for various reasons, but none of those have affected me personally so I don't really feel qualified to comment on them! What I can say though is that the sales people here are really nice and helpful. The store is set up a little oddly so it takes a minute to find things but that's a small point. The lines are generally a little longer than I would like (sometimes it's a little ridiculous -- I'll be honest) but that doesn't mean it's not worth! Finally, the wine/cider prices were like a buck more than I wanted to pay but meh. I still think it's a worthy choice!!
I can see this place from my apartment as soon as I walk out. Had to drop a five star to my "go to Vietnamese food".
Great food! Their cheese steaks are amazing. They're really quick with delivery too. Highly recommended :)

I went here yesterday at a friend's suggestion. I was slightly put off by the family style seating but that's only because I'm slightly anti social and neurotic. Once my fears of having conversation with strangers was put to rest by seating us by a couple who could care less about us, I felt much better. 

I ordered the seafood rice noodle soup, and shrimp egg rolls and a tofu banh mi sandwich to go, for my husband. The pho was pretty good. A little on the sweet side but once I added lime and hot chili paste to it, it was perfect. The fish cakes in the soup were shaped like little fried pieces of tofu. I was unfamiliar with this type but they were delicious. 

The shrimp egg rolls were good but they had pork in them which wasn't specified, so if you don't eat pork make sure you ask before you order. The dipping sauce could have had a bit more fish sauce in it. 

The tofu banh mi was super good. The best tofu banh mi we've had, actually. So I definitely recommend that. The tofu was perfectly seasoned and had so much flavor. Even if you're not a vegetarian it was just a damn good sandwich. 

What I absolutely LOVED was that they had a bakery/deli section in the back with so many delicious savory and sweet and options. Even homemade condiments and pickles. Everything from homemade Vietnamese mayo and sausages to dumplings and pre made meals to steamed cakes and homemade candies. 

That is extremely exciting for me. 

Obviously pork is a main ingredient in a lot of this food, so again, if pork is not in your diet you may want to just ask before you order or buy anything. 

Still, lots of great pescitatrian and vegetarian options. And the food is cheap! 

I ended up getting an EMBARRASSINGLY large amount of food while I was there and it cost me less that when I go out to eat on a date with my hudband:

Seafood pho 
Shrimp egg roll appetizer (both eaten there) 
then the to-go items:
Tofu banh mi
Savory steamed dumpling in banana leaf
Banana cake
Coconut cake
Shrimp rice cake and dipping sauce 
Glutinous rice dumpling with savory mung bean filling and dipping sauce (this ended up having pork in it btw) 

This all cost me $32 and change..... Holy shit. That is 8....I repeat, 8 delicious food items for $32. Amazing.

This place is so fantastic!  The BBQ pork banh mi is phenomenal. They also make their own tofu and so the vegetarian items are also delicious!  And the even have a little grab and go section full of awesome goodies to take home. Really this is a gem in our city!
I love how this cafe includes a ready to go selection of foods. The only negative is the staff isn't very friendly/approachable and the boba is really bad.
Outstanding experience. Everything I have ordered has been amazing. It gets a little crazy in here, but they got it under control....it's great
This place is unique, a breath of fresh air. If you like Asian food, this place is a must try. The food is good and fresh. They sell all types of bubble tea/smoothie drinks. I love it here!!

This is by far the best Vietnamese restaurant ever. All their portions are a generous amount of heaven. You can't go wrong with any dish that you order! The Pho, rolls, shrimp, crawfish, noodles are so delicious. They have so many different drinks to choose from as well-although my fav is the Thai tea. The have a small hot buffet on the side,as well as a freezer and cooler, for a quick take out. Don't get me started on their pastries...the almond croissants make my eyes roll to the back of my head cause they are so good. You need to try this place today...trust me, your eyes will roll too!

I used them 3 times in the last two weeks.   Cab ride 1.    Redefined the meaning of distracted driving.  1030pm, his lights go out and he continues driving at speeds of 60 mph, while jiggling the wires under the front seat and more than half of his body under the dash.    OMG !      Cab ride 2   (Cab 470) - this guy was worried I wouldn't be paying the full 15.00 (for in zone airport) because I asked him to drop me at the corner of my complex, vice in the middle of the complex (3 blocks of shlepping my luggage).  His body odor was so bad, I literally had a gag reflex the whole trip.  He also drove with all the windows down, not only pushing the toxic smell back to me, but also wind blowing me the whole trip home.  OMG !!    And finally Cab ride 3.  Call for 5 am pick up and gave address.   The driver decided that my address was at another location and waited there.  At 515 I called company and they said they had sent someone...but clearly the guy was at wrong address.   I waited and he finally showed up at 530 and he yelled at me that my address wasn't #####  it was #####   Are you kidding me ?  Dude I know my own address, just because you can't read the difference between numbers - not my fault.   Then I handed him a 20 for my 15.00 fare and he pocketed it and started toward the door ....   Change  ?   Oh, I usually get 20.00 for this trip... NO you don't, it is a flat rate, 15.00     Then he gave me the "i don' t have change".   Well go find some, I'll wait.     He took so long, I almost missed my flight.     HORRIBLE COMPANY AVOID at ALL COSTS.

Courteous And knowledgable staff.  Great wine and beer lists.  Well balanced cocktails.  Went in late on a Friday night with a group of 8.  Food was executed flawlessly.   Chicken Liver Toast and the Steak Tartare are standouts.  The gnudi are light and delicious.  A welcomed addition to the area.   The decor is hip and chic.  Music is perfect for the room.  The manager checked in with us to make sure we were having a great time.  Overall, an awesome experience.

Not the best, not the worst. I've been here a number of times over the last year, but leave each time less and less impressed. On the plus side, they have good happy hour drink specials and half-priced apps. The restaurant is designed nicely and the waitresses are attractive. Food and service are just OK. I'll go there if my friends suggest it, but I would not choose it myself.

Wow... this may be my new favorite restaurant in the country. I visit Tampa once a month or so, & I think I will be coming here every visit. Amazingly inexpensive for OUTSTANDING food. The service was excellent. The dessert/coffee/slush (think smoothie) bar would be worth the visit by itself.  Vietnamese cuisine was one of the very few foods I have limited experience with, but I was anxious to come here because I had recently watched an Anthony Bourdain episode from Vietnam. It was every bit as good as it looked to be on the show.  I highly recommend trying this place.

Just moved to Tucson and looking for a new box to workout in, first stop was here and I was not disappointed. Friendly and welcoming coach, who was super encouraging throughout the workout, pushing the members for their best effort! 
The other members where exactly what makes crossfit amazing, welcoming and cheering each other on. First class down but far from my last visit to this gym! Must try if in Tucson and looking for a great workout:)

Went there and service is terribly slow. Also got the ban xeo which was terrible. Everything else was okay so I just wanted this item removed. I told my server that the ban xeo wasn't good and his response was you ordered it. So I asked to speak to the manager and his reaction was even worse. He stated that we don't give refunds if it doesn't taste good. Then he goes on to ramble about how he had it last week. Then goes and takes one of the forks off the table and pokes it saying it's not burnt so he wont refund. Just don't appreciate the service here and the food is not great either. I was not being a rude customer either so definitely didn't deserve the rude attitude either.

Recommend not going here unless you want bad service and food that is subpar

First off this place has a more westernize feel in atmosphere and food.  The service was chaotic but was the best service I've had at any Vietnamese restaurant.  More attentive and will help with odd requests like a pair of scissors to cut the rice noodles for the kids.

The Pho broth was lighter and did not have the gelatinous consistency I normally expect.  If you just order this then it's fine but it will get over powered by anything else you eat along side.  Good news is that the amount of msg is not high.  Did not need a lot of water afterwards.  
If I want Pho I'll still go to Saigon deli but everything else I like this place more

The bahn mi dac biet (special) was good.  It had all the normal ingredients, most of which is made in house.  The only difference is that their veggies were not pickled enough.  But I like how their head cheese did not have too much tendon/cartridge 

Their chicken curry was hearty.  Full of flavor and chicken was tender.  

Very disappointed that they did not have their puff waffle.  Waiting on it to be delivered.  Had not found a place outside of Vancouver or New York.

Overall I think that there is another restaurant I would go to other than Saigon Deli in Tampa.

Authentic Vietnamese food! Good service. Big selection of entrees. Large portions too. Their Deli and Bakery looked good and fresh. We ordered a few Pho entrees. All were good with generous meat  but a little too sweet for our taste. Spring rolls had great taste but a little too greasy.

While not the worst choice, I wouldn't recommend it. I've had no problems with the dry cleaning I've dropped off and their hours are great, but do note it's going to be more expensive than some other places in the city and a longer turn-around time. The customer service isn't great, and they don't take cash under $10. There's also a dog that freely roams the store. While I haven't found dog hair on my clothes, I wouldn't recommend it if you're allergic. I also dropped off some clothes for tailoring, and it was pretty poorly done so if anything I'd stick to dry cleaning and avoid the tailoring.

I've recently become a fan of Rita's, this one in particular. They seem to have more flavors and options than other locations. I notice they have the light vanilla custard which they don't have everywhere and they usually have two flavors of sugar free water ice, not just one.

The best part is that now they are open until 11. I don't know how long that will last though. There are also a lot of restaurants in this plaza, so you can grab a water ice after dinner.

I really like the blendinis which is a topping, water ice, and custard all blended together. I had one the other day with vanilla, juicy pear, and nilla wafers and it was fantastic. The gelatis are also good which is just the custard and ice in layers, which is also good. I'm way beyond simple custard or water ice only!

Would be great if they had some tables and chairs to sit at while enjoying these desserts.

Not everyone can afford whole foods. sure the organic stuff is cheaper there but why would you go to acme to buy organic stuff? it's a normal acme. (shaws/star market if you are from new england....nicer than boston's star though.)

The place looked incredible! Service was prompt and courteous. I had the Thinh An Combo w/ broken rice and it was very delicious and the portion was beyond generous. FIVE-STARS simply for this dish. The to-go/pastries section had numerous tempting items, which made it difficult to chose, so we decided on a little bit of everything and all were amazing. The tofu and almond croissant are a must! We will be returning weekly!

The communication at the dance studio is lacking.  Their customer service is awful.  I took my daughter there for about 6 months.  I took her about because I got tired of the miscommunication and poor customer service.  My daughter does not miss going to dance class at all.  I plan on enrolling her in another studio that actually cares about their customers and is more organized.

Ingredients used to make food where poor quality. Meat tasted old and right from the freezer. Horrible food, we didnt even touch half of it and the staff pretendd not to notice. All we could really stomach were the shakes we ordered. Very disappointing experience the price. Never again. Brought the food home to better inspect the food and found hair in the ground beef, and the hotdogs used for the fries and hotdog ordered looked refried. Yuck this place should be shut down.

This place is fantastic! 

The good:
Food portions are great!
Everything we have had tastes amazing!
The prices of their bakery and menu items are reasonable and worth every penny!
Friendly staff!
Bakery items are very fresh!

The bad:
It gets really packed on the weekends. The parking lot does not accommodate for the amount of business they bring. I have bought the boboa tea probably 10-11 times and one time the boboa was terrible. The texture was as if it was cooked the previous day. Only happened once though.

All in all, 5 stars!

Sushi and sashimi can get more complex but the basics here don't get much better anywhere. Arrived for great prices at Happy Hour and then had second go when friend arrived who had a bento box. I shared my soup and the bento box ... all were delicious ... fresh. Became crowded and noisy as Friday night wore on and then VERY noisy with a line out the door. More quiet and privacy at old location. Service was fantastic. Miso lacks flavor and everything else.

Amazing food, attentive staff. My husband usually takes me to siagon deli near dale Mabry, however I hate that place because the choices are limited. This place is so much better becauseof such a wide selection. Definitely will be coming back.
Very organize, very flavorful , first time eating Vietnamese  Food , love it , need to go back and taste more things

Fantastic Meal!!! Loved it! Great service too!
Had the fried whole fish, fried fish rice, sweet and sour whole (peel yourself) shrimp and don't miss the sweet coconut milk!

This Rita's has been here forever. The workers are always nice and have a smile on their face. The product is consistent and it's a Philly favorite. Sucks they close down for the dead of winter. I'd eat Rita's in the cold!
This place is great.  It has very transformed from when it opened.  Love the grocery section and pho.
Its just ok nothing to run home and tell anybody about... Its near my house so its quick but I rather travel and eat somewhere better.

Great place for authentic pho ! Clean and welcoming. 
Customer service is great. My favorite dishes are the crab paste pho , bbq pork sandwich, curry w/bread . 
Fried egg rolls and a Thai tea . Servings are huge ! You won't be disappointed.

Would not recommend. Always late and this time cab 323 driver named Sanford had come to pick me up from Regency  square which is upscale Brandon. 
He was late and then at time of payment his credit card machine was not working. It was very inconvenient. Thumbs down

Really great Bun! Great portion sizes! I am so full lol! This is a great authentic Vietnamese restaurant with all the favorite dishes along with bakery treats both sweet and savory. Bon Mi sandwiches look good as well!
Very fresh food! Never a disappointment from the pho, vermicelli noodles to their to go area! Great bubble tea too!
Driving through town and found this place. Everything  was good and fast . Will be back when visiting Tampa.

Horrible customer service....dispatchers are rude and the cabs take forever and are sometimes a no show. I would not reccomend this place to my worst enemy.  I called at 12 o clock and ended up calling back at 12:40 and they couldnt get intouch with the cab driver. Called back twice and got hung up on each time. Cab driver never showed up

Reallyyyyyyyy unhappy with this place. This is our second season - only because it is close to the house. 

Cons:
1. No where to sit (or even stand)
2. Hot crowded dusty waiting room, can't even see the kids on these old tv's over 15 feet in the air. 
3. The students sit for 10 minutes out  of 45 minutes getting stickers (eye roll). 
4. We are doing Creative Dance for the second time and the SAME routine is done over and over. It looks like an obstacle course. 
5. Studio is in need of a Major Upgrade. Seating, T.V.'s, etc. 
6. I sat in the waiting room for over an hour listening to 3 other parents complain about the studio {great vibe}. 
7. I arrived yesterday for dance and the studio was closed. (another eye roll) There were 3 other parents there very upset. No one was notified that classes were canceled. 

Pros:
They offer a lot of classes. 

There are so many better studios in the Tampa Bay Area!
We tried the Pho and summer rolls. They are very good. The vegetable and tofu noodle soup is now one of my favorites.

Sad that United has gotten bad reviews from other sources.  I had three experiences with them while I was in Tampa this past weekend for the Outback Bowl.

1) La Quinta Airport to Whiskey Joe's.  I called for a reservation, the dispatcher told me 10 - 15 minutes.  I walked towards the lobby at the 10 minute mark, and the driver was waiting and calling me just as I arrived.  Very friendly driver, though I wasn't exactly sure what his affiliation was.  His card suggested that he had his own service, but maybe he contracts out or something to United.  Whatever.  Very friendly driver, courteous, couldn't ask for more.

2) Whiskey Joe's back to La Quinta.  Dispatcher told me 5 - 20 minutes, and the driver came at the 20 minute mark.  Didn't make as much small talk, but got us home safely and on time.  To and from trips were both 9.65 each on the taxi meter.

3) La Quinta to Tampa Airport at 3:45 in the morning.  See, I asked for 3:45 because sometimes cabs are late, and I really just needed to leave by 4:00.  HOWEVER, at 3:35, I get a call from the front desk saying, "Your cab is here."  Great on punctuality.  The only gripe I would have is that it's a flat fee of 15 bucks, but at 3:45 in the morning, I'm not really going to put up a fuss like that.

I would use them again if I was in Tampa.

Upon visiting , we are greeted by very friendly staff . The customer service is great! Very knowledgeable for their menu as well. The price for the amount of food you're given is amazing, I can barely finish their regular sized pho. I liked the food very much, not salty at all, not heavy and everything leaves you refreshed! While waiting for the order, we browsed the little tofu shop on the side, amazing selections, including many delicacies. We bought some fried tofu with mushroom /fried onion/lemongrass. Each of them are wonderful and unique. We had their banh mi special/banh mi BBQ pork - the bread is so crunchy and flaky, the BBQ pork was tender. Then the special itself, had amazing headcheese. The great thing I must emphasize again, is that the salt level is just balanced, not heavy at all. Once you take a bite, you can't stop! I inhaled my food, then onto my pho beef combination. The broth is light, there were more than enough meat to go with every bite of noodles. I am full and satisfied with more than enough noodle to take home. This place is great, I will visit again.

Decent: The pho

I thought the pho is quite respectable,  especially if you care for a more cleaner version of it.  Seemed to have less salt, probably no msg(don't quote me), extremely fresh greens.  However it didnt steal me away from my one true love.  I already have a pho go to.  Their beef wasn't as tasty and the broth while good, wasnt magic.

Worthwhile:  The bakery selection

They had high quality croissants/pate sio.  These were very well done and extremely affordable.  If anything of my experience deserved a revisit it would be the To go section.  Baking and artisan tofu seems to be their strong suit.  It is a must if you live close by.

Not so good:  Thai tea.

Very early on they already crossed off items from their menu.  It seems congested for an opening as if they were over ambitious and tried to juggle too many things.  It shows when you offer some items that are just poor quality.  They had many drink options and I chose wrong apparently.  The thai tea was either prepared incorrectly or is straight up bad.  It tasted watered down and it was difficult to taste the tea.  Might be powdered weak stuff.
This place is consistantly great. There is something here for everyone from those familiar with the food to first time foodies. Pluse they have great sweets and carry out.

Great dentist, great office and great staff! Since the moment you walk in you feel relaxed and forget you're at the dentist. Everybody is very friendly and attentive. Doctor Yanez is very professional, proficient, fast and very gentle. He is fluent in English and Spanish. You can make an appointment on Saturdays or late in the evening on weekdays, which is very useful if you work normal hours and can't take a day off of work only for a cleaning. He also does the patient's cleaning himself, something that you can't find anywhere these days. Neat office, state of the art equipment. Great experience overall, I would recommend it to everybody!

Tucson has a lot of CrossFit gyms, but Purgatory is a stand-out thanks to its friendly, supportive community. Community is a major part of CrossFit in general, but it's obvious from when you step in the door that it just comes with  the  membership at Purgatory. The gym has a foundation of knowledgeable trainers and great workouts. But at any given city-wide CF event, we're usually the one cheering loudest and having fun. And fun makes those grueling WODs more bearable!

For those who don't know what CrossFit is and are alarmed by the workouts and the pricing, rest assured that whatever you pay in effort and money is leaps and bounds ahead in value than what you pay for when you go to a globogym. You may pay $25 a month there, but you don't get the personal attention of a trainer who ensures you're doing exercises correctly and safely. In addition, you won't realize your athletic potential by doing bicep curls in front of a mirror, but CrossFit will get you closer to doing workouts that NFL players are training with! And nobody calls your or writes on your Facebook wall to find out "where ya been?" if you don't show up for a week or two. Finally, it's worth mentioning again: when you try CrossFit, you have fun. You constantly have goals to achieve, and you always have people there to cheer you on and coach you towards those goals. So is it worth the price and pain? You bet!

BEWARE OF CAB 315 w/United Cab!!! Just finished the ride from hell, just airport to our hotel... The driver did not want to take us. So he popped the trunk and we loaded our own bags. Then he continued to demand payment the entire trip since our hotel was paying for the cab he did not want to wait for the hotel to pay him, he wanted his money and he wanted it the moment we got to the hotel. We were not even out of the airport until he started RAVING about getting paid! He then continued to drive recklessly, speeding and running stop signs. We pulled up to the hotel and the trunk was popped before we even pulled into the parking lot. We unloaded our own bags and he proceed to harass us as we unloaded... It was truly the worst taxi ride I have EVER had. Beware of the taxis at the airport that incurred only the minimum fare amount. It's just not "worth" it to the drivers and they make it known.

Our daughter has been taking classes for the last seven years at MJPAA. We absolutely love Mary Jo's and the teachers are so talented and knowledgeable in their field!
Here's to many more years of dance at MJPAA!

I love Rita's and almost always get a chocolate gelati with vanilla custard. It's my absolute fav! Although, I do like to try their signature flavor they are offering, this time it was Peeps! It was really delicious but I think for me it would have been too sweet in a gelati. This location usually offers two or more sugar free options. They always have fresh pretzels to accompany your water ice. 

A lot of the workers are in high school and at times they are a bit on the slower side, so don't let the long line scare you. 

They always happy to accept coupons & there are benches you can sit down on if you want to eat it there & not in your car.

This is a GREAT new addition to Vietnamese food in Tampa Bay. The selection is huge. The food is fresh and varied. And the taste - amazing!

I love the look of the place. Very openly laid out with a huge section for pick your own stuff. I'd totally recommend the Lemongrass Tofu from here. Just delicious. 

All of the stuff here is made fresh daily- and I think the freshness is really felt in the place. We stopped on our way to go to another Vietnamese restaurant in town and just the decor and friendliness of the staff made us immediately want to stay here. 

I had the Udon which was great - my kid had the rice with chicken and the wife had the Shrimp Bun. All very delicious. We are actually very excited to go through the menu - think I'll do the spicy  bun next week!

Definitely give them a go!!
Stopped in on a whim and was not disappointed! Great food with a friendly staff and nice dining area. I would highly recommend coming here.

What can I say, I came here because I was craving Pho! It was like 100 degree in Tampa but I didn't care lol. When I came in the place was very neat. The staff had headsets which seem very high tech to me. The ordering process was very streamline. I got my order very quick and everything was fresh! My waiter was very kind! He was attentive my needs as well. Their wasn't a lot of seating. In fact the table I sat at, I felt very crammed. I purchase the wonton noodle soup that had roast pork in it. It was delicious spicy and everything I could imagine. I would go back again because the place was clean, the staff nice, and the prices were very good!!!!! I ordered shrimp spring rolls and the soup.

Surf and turf or lobster special on Tuesday a must have. 

Bar drinks specials are delicious. Have not checked it out yet, it's a must.  Lots of parking and plenty of table service!

Very professional wait staff!

Very disappointing!  I went there for lunch today and got the bam bam steak bowl. The whole thing tasted BURNT!  They need to teach their cooks how to actually cook. I had such high hopes for this place.... :-(
Horrible! Horrible horrible!! Waited an hr to be told they don't have a car to assign me. Smh BS!!

Finally I got to try this Indonesian watering hole deep in South Philly (at the old location of Sky Cafe), and it did not disappoint! After passing the critical test of finding a street parking spot, you will be rewarded with delicious Indonesian food (and true to the name, focusing on Jakarta-style dishes).

Tried the Nasi Ayam Bakar, which comes with a cup of rice, tofu, salad, tempeh, some chicken liver/heart pieces, chili/soy sauce, a cup of sayur asem (sour veggie soup), and the sweet-tasting crispy chicken (you can choose breast/thigh portion). The noodle with chicken and mushroom is also well cooked and better tasting than average. We also tried the soto betawi (ok tasting but no surprises there), and the delicious Bakso Djakarta (meatball soup). The dishes are delicious, well-cooked, and accurate. For me, the winner is still the ayam bakar dish -- don't miss it!
The prices are reasonable at $6.5 to $7 for most of the main dishes. I also like the modern cafe-style decor with photos, mural and collection of toys and trinkets on the wall.

Service is fast and very friendly. The only o-oh! is that they only take cash. But, pad your wallet and try the dishes, you won't regret it.

This studio is by far one of the top studios in the state of Florida. The facility is spacious with their dance rooms, lobby for parents, dance boutique to purchase dance needs, and even a place for dancers to do homework between classes!  All of the faculty are friendly and have been there for a long time! (Must be a great place to work!) Both of my girls have danced there for several years and now my son is dancing! I'm thrilled that they offer so many classes not just in dance but music and acting too!
Simply fantastic! Great value. Looking forward to our next meal from BBQ4U
Take a Uber clean and safe. Taxi is an outdated technology that rips off their drivers charging them over 2000 dollars a month just for a cab.

I've been coming to Thinh An for almost two years now when it opened, and I can easily call it my safe haven to satisfy my Viet food Cravings. Compared to every and all Vietnamese restaurants in Tampa, I safely call this one the best, for its wide selection fo authentic dishes, attention to quality of ingredients, and best flavors. Dishes I regularly order are: Banh Cuon, Pho Dac Biet Thinh An, Com Tam Thinh An, and Bun Bo Hue with Egg noodles instead of udon. The Pho has a pleasant and soothing aroma (perfect for the morning after a wild night). Com Tam is extensive! With so many different types of meats, soup, and the broken rice, I always leave full after this dish. You must order it with a sunny side up egg, that's the traditional way of enjoying it. I am not the biggest fan of Bun Bo Hue, but this place made me fall in love with it all over again. Typically, I find the broth much too heavy and greasy, and I do not care for sloppy udon (banh canh) noodles. But the past weekend, I ordered it on a whim, but substituted the udon noodles with Mi (egg noodles). It was excellent, because these chewy and thin egg noodles soaked up the soup very pleasantly. This place offers a widespread selection of Street foods, dessert, and side dishes in the bakery: Ban Da Lon, Che Trung, and the Dau Hu Chien are the three I tend to return to. I tend to come during the busy hours of the week, but even when the crowd (a combination of Vietnamese locals and people who are interested in Viet cuisine) is large, the team is quick with upturning tables and seating in the most efficient way possible. To me, Thinh An is one of the jewels of our Tampa Bay, and I always bring my visiting friends here when I can.

So I just graduated from UCF and was heartbroken that I'd be leaving so many amazing food places. Thinh An Kitchen and Tofu marks the beginning of my new food adventures after moving back home to Tampa. I went with my mom and boyfriend and it was actually really good. I got a sliced rare steak and flank pho and I got a special combination banh mi sandwich. I liked the sandwich a lot even though the bread was a bit too crunchy for my liking but still better than it not being toasted I suppose. The pho had an awesome broth flavor which means a lot to me because the only place I had gotten pho in Tampa grow me up was Pho Quyen and it's getting old for me. So this place was a nice change and I like how trending it feels. There's even a little section like a mini market with lots of food goods. Haven't tried them or ordered a boba so I'll just have to come back and try next time. The service was really fast and the lady who took care of us was very sweet but also down to earth and not Asian which is also a big thing to me because it shows diversity compared to other places that I've been to. I definitely recommend it and will definitely need to invite my Orlando foodie friends if they ever come to this side of FL lol

Kudos to Acme for stepping up their game.  I used to go to the Whole Foods next door, then hit the Acme for buy-one-get-one-free chicken ir ground beef for the dogs but now I often eschew WF and shop here for everything but produce, for which I pay about 1/3 the price at the Asian supermarket on Washington.

This place is too legit to quit. Honestly, this place hits all the check marks and blows service out of the water. 

I came here the other day to pick up food and was so impressed by their menu and set up. Parking out front is pretty small even though they have their own lot to the front and side of the restaurant. Every time I've driven by here, it's been packed no matter what time of day or day of the week, which is promising.

The moment I walked in, I was greeted. The staff is incredibly friendly and kind. There is ample seating inside and outside as well. When you walk in, you see a bakery to the left with ready to go food, soups, sweets, desserts, dinners, you name it, it's there. To the back is the bar for their bubble teas, waffle desserts, snow cones and more. Lastly, the seating area inside is brightly light, with great decor and constant photos of their food, menu and ads running through. 

Their pho is awesome and comes in two sizes, large and extra large. Fresh, delicious and full of flavor. I also got some other dishes as wel which were all wonderfully prepared. Their bubble tea was on point and great for the price of $4. All of their food is priced wonderfully for their size, portion amount and quality. This place is a legit gem in this area. 

I was upset that I wasn't dining in because I wanted to try everything on the menu from their dishes to their desserts. I will absolutely be coming back here repeatedly and I'm sure this place will soon become a normal dining spot for me. I highly recommend this place for anyone who appreciates vietnamese food, soups and sandwiches.

I can really only comment on the Veggie grinder, it is great. In an area where there aren't many options for vegetarian options, Two Brothers does well. The service is pretty quick and the order doesn't take too long. I enjoy visiting when I am in the area and want a meal.

I had a really good experience here! Everyone is really nice and professional. And the office is really clean, organized and well run. You would think you're walking into a spa because there is something really relaxing about it!

They also do Saturday appointments which is really convenient if you work during the week!

I'm definitely going back and recommending to my friends!

Just witnessed the scariest and worst driving. Which is saying a lot in Tampa! Hey can 451. Get off the phone and watch where you're going!! Terrifying. This man should not have a license let alone be responsible for other people.

Love! Love! Love this place!
Typically, I am not the biggest fan of pho. I find it really bland, so I stay away from the pho selection that they have. However, the spicy sate beef egg noodle soup is delicious!! It has just the write amount of spice. Jalapenos, scallions, onions, and cilantro are all included. The spicy broth gives the beef a great flavor and overall, the combination of flavors makes a great soup!
I have come back three times in the past week to eat this soup.
They have thai tea here too. Sometimes, its made just right, but sometimes it can be a bit bitter, so it depends on your luck.
I would come back here again and again.

I stumbled upon this gem! Food is delicious and the staff is friendly and attentive. The facility is very clean and welcoming. I eat here every time I make my way to Tampa. My favorite dish so far is Pate Vietnamese Ham Sandwich with some iced viet coffee. Whenever I order anything other than my favorite sandwich I am never disappointed. Don't forget to check out the bakery , lots of fresh yummy goodies there too!
Waited for over an hour, dispatcher annoyed when I called after waiting 45 minutes. Cancelled cab, don't use!

Love the house made Tofu especially the lemongrass! Delicious Bun, Pho, Bah Mi. Fast service, and delicious food. There is to go market on the side that sells crossants, house made Tofu and a variety of Vietnamese dishes to include rolls, congee and deserts. Only downfall is not enough parking for the many people who come to this delicious restaurant.

Just Outstanding!

A friend recommended this place who recently relocated to Tampa. I have been to a lot of Vietnamese places and this is the best I have had hands down. Prices are reasonable, plenty selections to choose from. Quality of food, customer service and portions are excellent. My daughter and I went several times while we were visiting Tampa. I can't say enough about this place! This will be one of my go to places when I am in the area.

Love this place! I would certainly recommend a dish but I forget the names of them. Our son loves the Happy Mango drink and I like the spicy beef. Service is great and the spot is really cozy and sweet. Great place for the kiddos.

Their bbq for is one of my favorite dishes. Pretty well rounded in Vietnamese cuisine and have tried all Vietnamese restaurants in the Tampa area, this is one of my go to for summer rolls and any bbq pork dish. I love the simplicity and cafeteria style menu, it can't be overwhelming to try and pick from 150 different Vietnamese dishes if you don't know the cuisine, and Thin Ann makes is easy for anyone I introduce to the food for the first time. 
My husband loves their pick blood soup and tofu bar (make sure to only pick up tofu when its brand new and hot from the kitchen. This place reminds me of Pho 24
Worst cab company. Got my address wrong. Didn't ever contact me back. I never got picked up ever from them. Waited an hr.

Awesome 


Always solid 
Great 
Authentic 
All Asian 
Great prices 
Support local 
Fantastic

Worst cab company ever!!!! I called for a cab and was told 15 to 20 minutes. After 45 minutes no cab so I called the dispatch. No one picked up my order so they sent out another call to the drivers. Another 30 min goes by. Still no driver pick up. Supposedly they had available drivers but dispatch wasn't sure why no one picked it up. After 2hrs a cab finally arrived but by that time I arranged a can pickup with YELLOW CAB an was siting in a cab. The yellow cab  arrived after 30 minutes after my call. Which is what one would expect! And is very reasonable! The yellow cab driver was stuck in bad traffic but still made it within a reasonable time and was the nicest guy. Needless to say I missed my flight since I was heading to the airport.

Use Yellow Cab!!!!!! Unless you want your can to arrive after 2 hours and 3 calls to dispatch, then maybe just maybe United cab is for you.

The restaurant has been serving the best and most authentic Vietnamese cuisine by far in Tampa. Even though the price is not as low as other Vietnamese restaurants, the quality of the food is irresistible. I would recommend Pho, the broth is quite authentic, and Banh Mi sandwich.
Seriously the best Vietnamese restaurant in Florida. The vermicelli is the best and for something refreshing go with the kumquat juice

Simply loved this place for both Pho and egg rolls both chicken and prawn. Rice paper wrapped shrimp and Tofu where good too. Very generous serving portions too. 
Bakery was good too with a lot of variety of buns and rolls. Must Visit value for money place for good Vietnamese food.
I got the banh canh dac biet and it was delicious. Also the Vietnamese coffee and it was tasty. Def recommend and will def be coming back when in Tampa.

This is a terrible comoany.  I got into the taxi and sat on a sopping wet car seat.  The driver had no idea where he was going and relied upon GPS.  He drive very fast in heavy rain.  Upon arrival his credit card machine was broken and his solution was to take me to an ATM.
The Bubur Ayam tasted authentic. Everything was good including the service. We ordered the salted fish fried rice and cumi mentega. We will definitely come back.
Authentic Vietnamese food and desserts! All the noodles were great. The desserts were the best. The restaurant has a cute bakery and deli place inside.
Really enjoy dining here. Always fresh food and fast service. Great place to bring someone special eat by yourself.
One of my favorite restaurants in Tampa! Real fresh food with tons of flavor. Awesome menu with a wide selection. Also has a really good deli with ready to go delicious items. Highly recommended!!

really disappointed with this place. The food was so bland, and came all came out way too quickly. Clearly, they forgot to season their dishes and were more focused on pushing out food. After seeing so many great reviews, I truly expected a very different experience. We ordered the crab wontons, Kobe beef satay, Korean BBQ satay, shrimp(way over cooked) lettuce cups and veggie pad Thai. Horribly disappointed in all these dishes.
Amazing! Worth the drive every time! Best pho in Tampa. Good service. Fresh vegetables. Always busy always good.

Horrible experience! I never write reviews but I had too this time! The driver picked me up on time and got me to my destination on time no problem, but when it came time to pay he scammed me. I paid the cab driver 20.00 which was the cab fair and then I asked him if he had any change, because I had another twenty that I wanted to break so I could give him a tip..so he took my first 20.00 which was the cab fair put it in his pocket gets out change and then tells me that I never gave him the 20.00 for the cab fair and that the other 20 dollars in my hand was the cab fair and we argued back and forth and I told him no I just gave you the other 20.00 I had for the cab fair, this 20.00 dollars is what I wanted to break so I could give you a tip, and he told me that I never paid him!!! I didn't have time to argue with him any longer, as I had to catch a flight and it was embarrassing and making a scene in front of the airport. After he left I called the cab company and they said that he called them right after he left (go figure he wanted to cover his butt!) and told them I was trying to get out of paying..not the truth at all! Overall they said that there was nothing they could do and it was supposed to be setteled right then and there..yea I am a 100 pound girl and a 200 pound guy is arguing with me that I didn't pay him, how was I supposed to settle that! Overall horrible experience...the man robbed me and his company stood behind him and I am sure he will do it again to someone because its his word against the customers and he knows that and he knows just what to do, call his company and complain that the customer didn't want to pay and the company can't do anything about it, because again its his word against the customers and I guess they don't really care how there customers are being treated! Beware and be careful if you use this company...they don't care about there customers.

This is very authentic. Lots of selections for all kinds of Vietnamese dishes. I had summer shrimp rolls and beef stew soup, they were divine. They give too much meat per soup, but it's so tasty. Best Vietnamese food I've ever had. They also have a section for ready-made food. Overall the best Vietnamese place I've been to

Decent sized store with an okay selection of produce. It's nice that you don't need a loyalty card to get the sales at ACME and they will have some great prices at times. Though I definitely prefer the acme on Girard (in northern liberties area) to this one since it has a much fresher selection of fruits/vegetables. 

Otherwise this is an average grocery store that is good for any basics that you might be missing at home though not a store that I would regularly shop at.

This is the worst cab ride I have ever had. The car was dirty, the driver wore no seatbelt! It was 6:00 on Friday needed a ride home from airport. He huffed & puffed about the traffic, drove like a maniac, and then complained to me. I called & no supervisor available. No wonder Uber is doing so well. If you see Cab 399 run as fast as you can!

If you're tired of Sabrinas, Greek Lady, Tap House, or any of the usual brunch spots near campus, Day by Day is your new go-to. A short and lovely walk from University City, perfectly done food, a lovely setting, and very reasonable prices.

[ vibe ]
Spacious with plenty of seating and sunlight. Lovely wood tables with lots of room. Framed artwork with no particular theme, but pretty nice anyway.

[ service ]
We had a lovely waitress with an unplaceable but sophisticated accent and a great attitude who ran us through her favourite items on the menu. Attentive without being annoying - no complaints here!

[ food ]
Everything was well-balanced, freshly prepared, and very generous in portion size. I ordered the tuna melt, which came with generous portions of fresh, well-seasoned tuna salad, tomato slices, melted havarti, all on a toasted croissant.

My friend got the stir-fry, which was also impressively flavoured without being overly greasy or heavy like you might get at a real Chinese place.

Portion sizes are huge - you'll definitely walk out full.

[ overall ]
Another reliable addition to your brunch repertoire!
Love the TOFU. They have a lot of convenience ready to go breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  A lot of food to choose from the menu. Everything is fresh and the taste is awesome.

This place was great , had delicious lunch ,pho , thanks to my friend , Alexa, 
Next time i will buys some food to go ,

Best Vietnamese in Tampa!!!! I ordered the veggie and tofu fresh rolls and they were amazing. The veggie and tofu pho was great and the tofu was very fresh. The service is extremely quick; within a minute of ordering the pho was brought to the table steaming hot and within five minutes of ordering the fresh rolls were brought to the table. The chocolate croissant was amazing and tasted like it was made with love. The chocolate in the croissant was rich and the croissant was buttery but not too greasy. Overall, best Vietnamese in Tampa!

I see there are many posts talking about the TERRIBLE customer service for this company. My mother in law goes to silver sneakers through Humana and they use the worst company in the world, UnitedCab company. He showed and she waved to let him know that she saw him. Well he took off before she could get her purse. She called and was told the next cab would get her in 20 minutes. Same BS each time we called until she completely missed her appointment.

I called and got the lease compassionate person ever. No customer skills what so ever. She could have cared less about what was going on. She was a complete failure to do anything. The drivers all complain they don't make any money doing this. Hey, GET ANOTHER JOB! There cans are filthy, drivers and filthy as well.  Just another bad experience from United Cab.

Okay so after being here 6 times, sampling various things each time, I am finally ready to review after trying a lot of their menu items.  There are some great things to this place and some really bad things.  Food wise some standout and clear disappointments so 3 stars seems appropriate.  I however will be back for specific items.

1) Pho: definitely was lackluster and a 3 at best. Extremely oily and lacked flavor.  Maybe it's bc I spent a lot of time out west in CA with large Vietnamese populations, but this pho was no where near the best I have had.  In Tampa, I have had better pho too. My favorite in Green Mint in Clearwater.  

2) Boba tea: Also pretty bad in the 2-3 range depending on what you order.  The boba balls are very small and the texture is very gooey.  Their smoothies are way too liquidy in the couple of times I have tried to give it a chance.  There is also a strong powdery aftertaste.  Also wait times for boba are ridiculous.  I have been there and had people in front of me wait 20 minutes and I have waited in the 15-20 minute range to get my order too, which is way too long.  If you are looking for great boba, please just make the drive to Kalesia Tea House, Naga Tea, or Kung Fu Tea. Trust me you will be much happier.  This place does have a bunch of toppings like many unique flavors of popping boba so that's one positive thing I can say.

3) Hong Kong Egg crate waffle ice cream: 2 in terms of service and 4 in terms of taste.  The day I went there was no one in front of me in line and they couldn't figure out how to enter my order into their system.  Mind you this wasn't the first week but several weeks after opening. After the exorbitant 15 mins it took to enter the order, I realize they were about to double charge me! So they had to redo it again! Then it took another 10 to actually get my order and upon receipt they still missed one of the toppings.  Who wants to wait this long to get anything.  The only reason I did is bc the last 3 times I was here tried to order the waffle ice cream they told me they didn't have any more left.  So my last time they had it and I wanted to try it.  The waffle itself was good but parts had gotten cold by the time I had gotten it.  The ice cream was decent but nothing special.  I tried the green tea and coconut ice cream.  If you are looking for a similar concept go to Boba cup and get a ice cream with a Hong Kong crepe.  Very similar and their they will even decorate your ice cream into a super cute animal.

4) Egg Rolls: 3. I have tried the shrimp and the chicken and I wasn't impressed with the flavor.  They were very cold and I wouldn't order this again after the one time I tried it.

5) Spring Rolls: 4 I had the chicken and I thought it was nice they had that option.  Flavor wise it was good and I was happy I had tried this.  I would order it again.

6) Tofu: 3-4, depending on the flavor.  I have tried the lemon grass, mushroom, onion, and original.  I liked the lemon grass as you could definitely approach the background flavor.  The other ones really were not as pronounced and I couldn't tell a difference between the mushroom and the onion flavor wise.  They both tasted fine.

7) Pastries: 4.  This is where this place shines.  The almond croissant were quite good though the filling in it was quite minimal. One time one of them didn't even have any inside.  So they need to improve this.  The almond croissant was flaky and delicious.  At $1.50 the price is also great. This is one of the few things I have gotten multiple times.  I also enjoy the cream cheese turn overs and the strawberry pastry  The plain croissant wasn't anything special and given the choice I would go with the almond or cream cheese here.  

8) Warm Tofu Pudding with Ginger Sauce: 4.  I enjoyed this very much and have ordered it to go several times.  You can order it at the same place you order boba.  Microwave it 90 seconds to 2 mins in a bowl at home and pour some ginger sauce on top.  This is a very light and refreshing dessert and other than the pastries the only thing I have ordered multiple times and have been pleased with consistently!

9) The wrapped meat in green banana leave  in the to go section: 1.  I tried the chicken and the beef and after opening it and slicing one piece off I couldn't bear to eat anymore. It kind of looks like a sausage shape and texture is like a congealed mass.  The flavor was not very appetizing for me.  Maybe an acquired taste, but I will never try this again and it wasn't the meat I was expecting when I asked what it was.  

Overall this place has some hits and quite a few misses.  Based on other reviews I was expecting better.  I took someone else with me and neither of us were impressed with this place.  Stick to the spring rolls, pastries, flavored tofu, and the warm tofu with ginger.  Consider trying the Hong Kong waffle if you don't mind exorbitant wait times.  Skip the powdery boba and pho.  You'll find better else where.

First time here and the place was great. We didn't have a ton of time and it was pretty crowded but we were in and out in under 40mins. The servers were very friendly and attentive. I was surprised at the variety of both hot and cold options. The place was very clean and well organized. The Pho #13and egg rolls #1 were on point. I would definitely visit again very soon. The ice condensed milk coffee was great too!

My bf ordered a stromboli. It was big enough to feed him twice and he said it was good. 

I ordered a cheeseburger platter. I was disappointed to say the least. The lettuce and tomatoes were from a salad huge chunks of tomato to put on my burger...... I asked for no onions they were there anyways I asked for a side of mayo it wasn't there 
The bread was bigger than the burger. My fries were cold. 
I also ordered the scallops side order. All I could taste was the fried breading. The cocktail sauce was so little it was practically worthless.  

Delivery took some time as well.  
Not a fan

The best vietnamese food in Tampa! My wife is vegan, and has plenty of delicious options for her to choose. The food here is honestly the best vietnamese food we have ever tasted and always keep going back for more. The prices are very affordable, the portions are large, and you will have enough to take home. Overall you have to visit Thinh An and experience traditional Vietnamese food they have.

Food came out quickly and service came by from time to time to check despite how busy the place was. Water refills weren't an issue. I liked that there were a lot of vegetarian options as well. They also had chili flake in oil which is always a plus for me. 

I had gotten the spicy vegetarian hue style rice noodle soup with veggies added for there, and a tofu banh mi and congee with chicken to go. The soup had a good rich flavor to it. I wish that the broth came out hotter but I feel like that's pretty typical it doesn't come out really hot. The spiciness of the broth was good but I still added some more after. The ingredients were balanced well in the dish. The congee was good and flavorful. I'd say the only issue on that end was that it was kind of oily later on that night. The tofu banh mi was the only misstep. It just tasted kind of bland like the tofu should've been marinated in something or there wasn't enough mayo put in. It needed something. 

All in all it was pretty good. I'd stop by again if in the area. I wish I had tried out the desserts since there was a lot to choose from.

Best Vietnamese restaurant and grocery store in the Tampa Bay area. You won't regret going to this place. It must be great because a lot of Vietnamese shop and eat there. Was recommended by Vietnamese to me.

A steamy bowl loaded with rice noodles, vegetables and tasty meat pieces. A clear flavorful peach sauce to pour over noodles made it even more yummy. I had enough food left over from lunch to heat up later at home for dinner.  I also tried the mushroom tofu and onion tofu. Lastly, I tried a fresh brewed cup of hot coffee with cream. The best cup of coffee I have had since moving to this area.

Having trouble finding a cleaners around Rittenhouse that can actually get stains out of clothes.  This one was unsuccessful several times.  My last visit I took a dress without any stains, but low and behold it had a stain when I went to pick it up.  They keep insisting they can get it out, so they keep trying but to no avail.  I'll have to take the dress to another cleaners to actually get clean.  Don't expect this place to do anything but clean men's shirts.
Huge fan of this place.  Delicious pho and banhmi sandwiches, very reasonably priced.  Tofu is delicious and made there.

Nice atmosphere, attentive staff, and the food was great.  Ordered the Mi Bo Kho and was pleasantly surprised by the presentation and quality of ingredients.  Not to mention very generous portions - definitely warrants a return visit.

I took a cab from the airport last night. The cab driver insisted I pay 20% fee to use my credit card. He stated it was the company and not his rule.  After a few minutes of arguing with him I paid cash. Never will I use this company again. Scammers!  Beware!
Keep us waiting over 30 minutes  Driver told dispatcher that he couldn't find us, even though we were at hotel entrance.

Yum! This place makes some good food!! I do wish they were open later and open on Tuesdays. There have been multiple times when I go to order and they're closed. Their food is amazing though- grilled chicken fried rice and the pho
Leaving the Lightning game, in the pouring rain, driver asked where we were going. Refused to take us because we were less than 5 miles away.
Some of the best Pho in Tampa. Service was fast and excellent. I will be going again.

I came here today for groceries, I've heard that they have a good selection and good prices, which they do!  I'm used to shopping at smaller grocery stores like the little Everything Fresh, so this is a welcome change because of the nice variety, good deals and a good selection of all sorts of groceries and household items. 

Some items have more of an assortment than others, and some have better prices than others.
