For example, they have a great selection of Siggi's yogurts and awesome price, but a limited selection of Kind granola bars and the price could be a little lower, I think.  There are other similar price inconsistencies like great deal on peanut butter and bread but too much money for Sabra hummus.  

All in all though, I will come back.  I got some pork cutlets for a great deal and maybe I'll check out the bakery, deli or butcher at my next visit.  They have a nice selection of alcohol- great to know in case I want to get a bottle of wine!  

The staff were very helpful, friendly and informative on the phone, just wish it wasn't a 7-8 block walk from home, but I'll be back.  It was nice that the cashier said "thank you" and people working there helped me find things, did so in a very friendly way.  They should have more registers open for checkout though...I paid about $40 for two bags of food, but I got a good amount of food!

Tried their "Picada", was just ok nothing to brag about. Portion is ok but the price is a bit much compared to other restaurants that offer that same dish. Don't think I would go back. Not much of a variety on the menu.

This is the best doctor's visit you will ever have! Everyone is so patient and nice and helpful, especially to those of us apprehensive about getting things done to our faces! I will NEVER go to another doctor again! Dr Arviv is amazing and she is a perfectionist! She will tell you the truth about what you don't need just as much as she'll tell you what you do need. 

The prices are excellent also and better than all the other Aesthetic places I've been to.

[ summary ]
I think they were going for a cross between hipster café and kindergarten classroom, which works in an odd kind of way. Board games, picture books, decent coffee, and yummy home-style desserts.

[ food ]
Coffee is fine. Desserts are probably the kind of stuff you were baking with your parents when you were eight. I've tried the Jewish apple cake and the brownie with Franklin Fountain ice cream. Hit the spot. Portions are huge!

[ vibe ]
Green plaster finish on the wall. Handwritten signs everywhere. There's neat fairy-tale themed art on the walls (quotes from Jack and the Beanstalk). Tables remind me of a kindergarten classroom. I would find it hard to concentrate and actually take myself seriously in doing work here, but maybe I'm too far removed from hipster-land to get it. In any case, it's kind of cute, in a messy, 5 year old kid kind of way.

[ conclusion ]
Definitely not Starbucks. If that's a good thing in your book, give it a go.

Today I experienced  a very unpleasant and degrading situation by United Cab #417.  Humana Logisticare arranged for my pickup from Youfit Carrollwood Sikver Sneakers  at 12:15.. I was outside on time but the cab was not out front.. As I was dailing Logisticare at 12:20 I noticed cab #417 parked in a parking space half way down where I was to be picked up.. It had started to rain and  using my cane I walked over to the cab.. I walked to the front of the cab, back to the side screaming for help saying I am the Humana fare.. The driver then backed out while I am standing near the drivers side pleading for his attention .. he just drove off leaving me standing there.. It is disgraceful if this is how United Cab treats eiderly and disabled people.  I was quite shaken by this incident.  This cab driver of #417 should not be paid for this trip.. I have made a complaint to Humana and Logisticare. 0 star rating for United Cab and driver #417

Gross. The lady working behind the counter talked to her friend the entire time. My sandwich was GROSS because she didn't pay attention. Buff chicken cheese steak with no cheese and the buffalo sauce only on the end. Theres also homeless people EVERYWHERE. Avoid.
Had a nice dinner and drink. The Italian Meatballs, were tasty, side of Mac and cheese was perfect and the greens (Swiss chard) were just bitter enough! Great atmosphere here!

These people are con artists.  I had to take a cab less than a mile to the airport.  The guy didn't put on his meter, which is a sure sign your about to be taken advantage of.  Then, charged me 15 dollars for a two minute trip.

Call a reputable cab company like Yellow Cab.

This place really has a good shot at being 5 stars if not for the discombobulated service. Spring rolls arrived after our meals. I ordered the special bowl and the bahn mi seeing as it as super cheap. The noodle bowl was good but not great. Same goes for the bahn mi. I probably won't return seeing as there are many options in that area to try while in town

I always go to Thinh An for authentic Vietnamese food, and I've never had a bad experience. The staff are friendly and efficient, and the I've waited at most 30 minutes to get my meal. Even when ordering take out, they're great at making sure your order is correct and going through the and telling you which food item is in which bag. They also have a great selection of pre-prepared hot foods, like crabmeat toast, etc. This is easily one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in the Tampa Bay Area!

The place was in the middle of the block on Frankford Ave, and a little hard to find. Very small inside and an odd decor. I had the Caesar salad to start with, which was very good. A friend of mine had the mussels, were nice but the sauce was an odd choice and too heavy with lemon flavor. For dinner, I had the linguini with mussels and shrimp. The pasta, shrimp and mussels were very fresh and flavorful, but again the sauce was a bit off-putting. My friend had the veal and seemed to enjoy it.

Nice spot for the area, and food not bad at all. I would come back, but it would not be my first choice. If you are looking for a good Italian BYOB in the area, check out Zaccone's. It's BYOB which is always a plus.
Service is good and food is even better OMG a must try restaurant here ... they homemade their Tofu !!!Lunch time it's too busy I will do a little later for a faster service ;)

one of the worst experiences ever, so bad that I actually had to call 911 to get help as the driver was holding my bag hostage, this after going to wrong way to get to my house, and yelling at me because I said his car was filthy.  it was, the floor had actually peeled up and I was afraid to even put my foot down. the driver should never be allowed to drive any vehicle of any sort and needs a lot of remedial help in basic communication skills

I was so excited about the Acme taking over Superfresh that I can be quoted as saying "this is the best thing that has happened to me all week!" Between the Italian Market and Whole Foods, I realize how spoiled my neighborhood is. Enter the Acme. Honestly, I was seriously impressed with this supermarket. The produce was FRESH! Not at all what you would have seen at the old Superfresh. Prices on practically everything were slashed, and you do not need to get a store card to reap the benefits. For example, this week they are having a BOGO sale on many different types of meats. While the produce prices aren't as astonishingly low as what you'll find at the Italian Market, they are still comparable. I recently bought a cookie cake here from their bakery for a party and everyone really liked it. The lady behind the counter will write a message for you on any cake you purchase! Food shopping has been oddly satisfying since the Acme has opened up!

I heard this place had opened recently and had to try it. As a huge lover of pho, I couldn't wait! Ive been to every pho restaurant in the area. This was by far the best!! Truly remarkable!! The restaurant is nice and clean and the service was very attentive. This is sure to be a local favorite.
So delicious!! And great prices. Even the take out is wonderful. My hubby and i's new favorite place to get a meal!! The staff is all very friendly. You get your food quickly!

All I can say is, the chicken wing platter was a waste of $10.75 + tip. Although, I was not pleased with a previous order, some time ago. I thought to give it another chance. Everybody can have a bad day. But on a good note, the delivery was fast and the person who took my order, was very pleasant.
This place is amazing! Love their vegetarian menu especially their vegetarian Bun bo hue chay! They get very busy on the weekends so plan ahead.

What a great experience I just had with United Cab!!! Called at 10:05pm asking for a cab. Was told they are busy so it should be no more than 20 minutes. We waited 30 minutes then called back to check on the status. Dispatcher told us it should be another 10-15 minutes because no one responded to the call yet but they would rush it. After another 20 minutes we called back and was told it was on the way. At this point we called Yellow Cab and was told it would be 15-20 minutes. 20 more minutes went by and Yellow Cab pulled up on time. Shortly after my friends left in the Yellow Cab, i heard a car horn all the way down the road. A United Cab drove all the way down my street laying on the horn. At 11:15pm. I went out to inform him they had left because it had been over an hour and the driver started to yell and swear at me.

I would suggest calling Yellow Cab for all your United Cab needs!!!

I got takeout from here when I was sick and I was extremely satisfied with my pho. The menu was extensive, my pho was amazing, the prices were very fair, and the serving size was huge! I will definitely be back! 

Update: we have now gone twice since my initial review and still love Thinh An! Fresh food! Great price! Huge portions! Highly recommend!

This company is a great example of poor communication and lack of customer service. I called for a pickup which and was told 15-20 mins. When I called at the 25 min mark the dispatcher said 3-5 mins. At 45 mins and after a third call I was told I need to go to a different location where they had a pickup spot....decided to hang up and walk down the road and try to hail a cab off the street....got someone in 5 mins.  Lesson learned is don't call on them.

First and last! First of all, 20 mins waiting for a waiter it's not acceptable! And I see some girls walking around doing nothing. Finally, the waiter arrived. He was nice, but it seem like he was the only working while three-four girls doing... what?! I just saw them chatting between them. We ordered the good. It came quick, server by a girl who we asked why the soup didn't have chicken and she said ask your waiter... and he came and explained yes it did have the chicken. Ok the flavor was yucky! The chicken was hard, we said no tofu and there was tofu. I ordered broken rice and that's the only thing I liked in my plate... the rice, cause the meats weren't tasty and the quiche wasn't good at all (tasted very old) and some pork that I wonder what was it?! Was dry and yucky! The salad was fresh at least :) I only enjoyed the milk tea and the coffee. But this was my first and last experience at this place. 

I rather go to brandon for a good Pho and Vietnamese food

We drove up to Philly to try this new restaurant. The interior of the restaurant was new and contemporary. The staff was friendly and helpful with recommendations, though the menu was quite limited (short list). The prices were great! We ordered a few appetizers the shrimp roulade fried wonton and spring rolls with peanut sauce were really good. The chicken and mushroom noodles, soto betawi and the grilled chicken rice too were all tasty, chicken was on the smaller side, loved the tamarind soup that came with the dish. The soto betawi had a sublime flavor, it was delicious! We also tried the chendol - really fresh taste and sweet. I was craving certain Indonesian food but they didnt have them, they seemed to specialize in certain Indonesian food only. It's understandable! Loved the sambals though!!

Just as an update...I started using lyft since this incident. Average wait time for a ride is 5 mins. Longest wait time has been 9 minutes. I was on hold with these guys longer than it took to get a lyft ride...and as an added benefit it cost less.
Another delish meal here! This time I had a lotus shrimp salad.  Yummy.  It is great for keto if you are like me - but I had them do it without the pork.
The interior is nice and relaxed vibes. Food was kinda mediocre. Maybe just try Stirring the soup so it doesn't taste like booger's

Love their croissants, chicken curry soup, made on site tofu and soy milk. Food is consistently good and reasonably priced for the quality and freshness of items available. I do not recommend going during lunch time and dining in if you are crunched for time. They have a nice selected of prepared to eat foods and a bakery with sweet but not overly sugary desserts.
Great Food! Nice Staff! I always have a nice experience when dining weather I'm dining in or taking out.

So me and two other of my friends were out and flagged on of these cabs for a ride home, upon entering we gave him the address and he said "Since tonight is a busy night we are charging a $70 dollar flat rate fee." When he said that the meter was not turned on and he was asking the money upfront before even pulling out, we argued we will pay 35 now and the 35 when we get there as long as the meter is turned on, I've never been a taxi that charged before reaching the destination called the company and they said there is only one flat rate fee and thats to go to the aiport, I asked for a refund he tried to charge me another $35. Best part is from where we were picked up to our address the meter read $28. Cherry ontop is when he drove away decided to say " F**k you n**ger," and drove off. The cherry ontop I left my wallet in his car its been two days and " No wallet has been turned in." I hope nobody gets the same experience as we did.
scrumptious! not looking for it but so happy we found it!!! food, service, price spot on! will be back for sure!

Went here to try this place out. Seems like they're still training and working out some kinks-there were too many workers running around like unorganized colony of ants-just plain chaos! I ordered the pho special, I'm pretty critical when it comes to my pho since I'm a PHOnatic-sad to say it didn't exceed my expectations. The noodles were soggy and the broth were super oily! Their summer rolls were very good tho. Avocado smoothie was okay-might need to add more condense milk or some sweetener to it. Their customer service (waiters) was up to par, refilling my water when I drank just a quarter of it-so kudos for that. 

Went back here the next day since some friends wanted to try it out. Got there at 7:31p and a bunch of hostess-managers who were sitting down (unprofessional) told us that we just missed the cut off time by 1 minute. 
So we can't get a table only to go orders. I'm like really?! Mind you they close at 8p not 7:30p. ALL the restaurants that I've been to they take people up to the time they close. That was pretty disappointing-you don't turn away customers like that especially when you just opened. But whatever, we were so hungry that we just decided to order some bahn mi, didn't eat it tho since I was frustrated so I don't know how it taste. Oh yeah if you're going to order milk teas (which I did, it was pretty good) or any ice drinks make sure to tell them half ice or they'll fill your small cup with ice and barely any milk teas. So I basically paid $3 for a small cup of ice. 

I think this place will do well tho if they just work on a lot of kinks- be more organize, professional (no sitting around behind counters while there are customers around) and better communication with everyone who's working. Most of their food seem yummy.

Man, I love a good deal and all, but I honestly think that the majority of the workers (at least the cashiers) really hate working here. In contrast to the markedly more posh Whole Foods neighbor, ACME is a much more affordable (depending on what you want) market with a decent array of fresh fruits, vegetables and dairy products. Sometimes I will find an amazing deal, like $2 tubs of cottage cheese, or affordable seltzer water, and it makes the journey worthwhile. However, I consistently have to take all of my produce to the line, where I am greeted by..well, let's just say less than enthusiastic staff that makes me feel just...awful. I don't know if they are not being paid for their work, or the working environment is challenging, but they really need to work on their people skills, cause I really don't look forward to checking out everytime.

My go to Indonesian spot! I come here before work or after the gym. I usually get the Shrimp Rollade, Soto Betwai and the Bakmi Goreng. If you're into sweet drinks, get the cendol. Fell in love with this place.

Out of all the Asian restaurants that I went to in Tampa.. this one had to be one of my favorites. They really "pho ness" their competition. If you want the whole Vietnamese experience I would definitely recommend this place. Having ALOT of high rated positive reviews is already a sign that this place is a must try!
Their variety is endless @ an very inexpensive price. They have pho, bun, hu tieu, banh canh, vermicelli, egg rolls, spring rolls, banh mi, vegetarian options, Vietnamese deserts, bobas, cake, bakery items, Vietnamese pancake and TOFU. Basically EVERYTHING to fulfill the needs of actually being in Vietnam. Also, the vibe here is great. Feels like the best time of the year "Christmas" all the time. Even their sign is red, green and white. This place has a flashy and energetic vibe. It's definitely different from the Vietnamese restaurants I've been to. 
P.S. the XL bowls are actually XL... i could barely finish. But that's fine, serve me up like a King. The broth was a little sweet and the fish sauce for the egg roll was too. But that's nothing that sriracha can't fix. Food comes out fast. Hard to beat if you're an Asian restaurant competing against this one... good luck!

The workers here are usually friendly and fast. They have a good selection of flavors, including at least 1 sugar-free, more often 2. 
 
Parking around here is a bit tight at times, especially with lots of people sitting in their cars eating waterice.
Some of the best Pho in Tampa! They also have a cute market inside if you want to buy and Vietnamese food items to take home!!

My cousins took me here for a family dinner on a Friday night.  The restaurant was packed, which is a great sign.  The lot in the front is quite small, but there is extra parking behind the building.  We had to wait a little bit before we were eventually seated.  The restaurant has adequate amounts of seating, but it really fills up!  Tables are close together and the noise level gets loud.

The service is fast and very friendly.  Thanks Brian for great service!  They carry around a mobile device that sends your order directly to the kitchen for quick service.  However, one downside to this technology is you might not be able to change your order once it gets sent back.  

I ordered a plate of Beef Short Rib with Broken Rice.  The ribs were tender and easy to chew.  It came with a side of assorted veggies and a mountain of rice.

I also ordered my boyfriend an order of stir fried egg noodle with tofu and vegetables to go.  The seasoning on this dish was OUTSTANDING!  We are a big fan of the tofu they serve here, but the huge helpings of noodles and veggies in this dish really impressed me.  The dishes are all worth what you pay for.

I had a Shaken fruit tea - raspberry with boba with my meal.  The tea was on the sweeter side to me, but that comes down to preference.  

For dessert, I also ordered a coconut waffle.  I really wanted a Pandan waffle (the green coconut waffle) but this was just as good.  They pour fresh batter for each order and put coconut shreds in the middle for added texture.  

I had a wonderful meal at Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu!  They have a small take away area filled with pre-packaged food to take home.  Whether you're sitting down or grabbing food on the go, you will get a hearty meal here.

It's no surprise that customers want to move to services like Uber and Lyft. I took a taxi from TIA to my home in West Tampa in probably the filthiest taxi I have ridden in anywhere...and I've taken taxis in some pretty  basic places overseas. Driver did not attempt to retrieve my small bag from the trunk, just popped it open which is not a huge deal - I'm not helpless - but just another lapse in good service. And when I opened the trunk it was filthy with a pair of women's old boots inside and miscellaneous other who knows what. The floor between the driver's seat and passenger seat was littered with trash and that short one way ride cost me  $20.50 compared to a 3 stop ride on Lyft in a very clean car with a friendly, engaging driver from West Tampa to Moffitt to TIA for a total of $53 and that included about 20 minutes wait time. Sorry, United, it was really sub-standard all the way around.

My go to restaurant for everything VIETNAMESE. From vermicelli to pho, Bahn mi to Boba, everything is delicious. Never had anything bad here. And they are very nice. Great and fast service. The hot bar is awesome for take out. The egg rolls, spring rolls, and crawfish are great too! Loveeee this place!
What the Pho?  Drop the mic   Mouth watering fresh. Best Pho in town in my opinion. Please comment if you think somewhere else is better? Love me some Pho :) Love trying new places.

I just had lunch here and I thought it was good, but not great. I used to come here when it was Sky Cafe, until it had a fire and closed. The decor is nice and the service was very good. The woman who served me was always smiling. I had the E6, which is the traditional fried chicken with rice and soup. I liked the main part of the dish, but I really didn't enjoy the tamarind soup that came with it. I think it would be nice if the soup was an option, with other items to choose from. Since I didn't eat the soup, I was not full when I left. My friend had The E2, big egg noodle with The meat and fish balls. He said it was ok. Presentations on both dishes were nice and prices are cheap. The menu is very limited, only 7 entrees to choose from and 3 of them have fish balls. I think I'll wait a few months and try again. Hopefully they'll have a few more menu items and more options. I do wish them all the best, this area needs this type of restaurant to round it out.

Super busy. Friendly and efficient staff. This is one of the original Wawa's. Seeing as there is a Sunoco on the left and the Septa Station to the right, the likelihood of it being torn down and rebut is slim. There's a larger number of homeless people who congregate here.
No real complaints- tried them as it was closer then where I normally go but will continue ordering from my regular spot - pho queyn

Service is suck, long waiting for food, left without eating! First, when we came, I brought my baby with me. They only have 2 high chairs that all been used, ok....I put my baby on my lap . Waited for a while for the menu that no one seems about to give them to us until I asked about it. Ordered shrimp rollade (appetizer), 2 grilled chickens and rice, and 2 big mushroom chicken noodle and one soto betawi. Waited for 30 minutes, soto betawi came out. Another 15 minutes 2 noodles came out dry without the soup And then the appetizer came out and then the soup for the noodles came out........what is this?? and another 20 minutes, one grilled chicken came out. My husband, my sons, they both ate and finished their food while I ate nothing! When my husband asked where is my food, they said it was already on the table and i said, or better yet, yelled " FORGET IT!!!!!! I AM NOT EATING!!!" That will be a really bad reviews!!!Did they offer me anything??? No!!! Did they say sorry? Yes!! Well...i left hungry. My family weekend ruined because of this!!! The girl behind me complained also...waited for 45 minutes for the grilled chicken! She was mad too. Not gonna come back!!!!! I will go to Sky Cafe rather than this suckist place!!!!!
UPDATE : After my bad experienced and I wrote a negatives review on this account and facebook account, I have got attack right and left from the owner friends. So be prepared, if you have a negatives review over this place, you will get attack, hard!!!

Huh, I never thought a gas station would produce an edible sandwich. 
It was kinda good actually. The touch screen thing was weird, but rather nice. Some days, you just don't even want to look anyone in the eyes, and with the snazzy touch screen computer, you don't have to. Brilliance.

Not only will this place brings you back to the authentic Vietnamese cuisine that you are in need of trying, but there is almost nothing you can think of that isn't available at this place.

I go here quite often, mainly because they have a large variety of Vietnamese food on the menu and all of the to-go items they have available for purchase on the side of the restaurant. Whenever my family comes to visit or are in the mood to actually go out to eat, they tend to choose Thinh An to get our Vietnamese food fixes. The last few times I have gone I have opted to get the Bun Bo Hue and for the most part it is good with a big portion. Their pho can be a hit or miss but their rice platters are very filling and great for kids.

Overall, a very satisfying and affordable Viet place in Tampa :)

Why has it taken me almost a year to find out about this place??? This place has a great feel. The staff were quick and polite and the pho comes out almost instantly. The price of pho  is great. Regular ("large") is $8 which is about $1 or $2 cheaper than the average. 

The pho taste very well seasoned and was accompanied by fresh bean sprouts, lime, jalapeños, and greens.

We came Friday at 230p and was packed - so just make sure if you're going at a popular time, to call ahead.

I did get a taro milk slush but honestly was not that impressed. Good! But probably would not order it again here.

This place has something for everyone. The entrees we had here were hit and miss, but their flavored tofu, fresh spring rolls, and waffles are all delicious. When you get here, trying their side market is a must. Pho and spicy beef soup (bun bo hue) are pretty good and cheap. Will be coming back to try more from their menu.
WOW WOW WOW! IF YOU WANT GREAT Pho look no further. We will definitely be regulars from here on yum
Good service food was always delicious up until I saw a big ass fly in my pho which was buried under the noodles I had already ate ! Never coming back.

I was thrilled with the whole experience. Very clean, very friendly and the different food favors were magnificant. The owner stopped at our table, to greet us as well. He takes great pride in this place and it shows. A+++

I had a great experience at Thinh An. When I first came, I instantly noticed the cafe. Here, you can pick out various Vietnamese snacks that you can take to go, or you can eat at your table. Be sure to pick out your selections and pay for them before you sit back down at your table! As for the menu items, I have never felt so much comfort from a bowl of bun bo hue, or a plate of com tam ever before. Any soups that they made, is absolute perfection. Any dishes that they serve is out of this world. I usually get the broken rice (com tam) dish, either with pork or braised ribs. However, when I get a noodle dish, it's usually either the bun bo hue, or the pho. I would also definitely recommend the goi if you enjoy pickled carrots and daikon. This is normally an appetizer you share with a group of people. It is a lotus root salad with pickled carrots and daikon, and slices of pork and shrimp. It comes with some shrimp chips that you eat with the salad, and it's a great sharing appetizer, or a great meal to have by itself. I always come here for my Vietnamese food cravings, and I will most likely keep coming here.

Whenever I make a trip to Tampa, I always try to stop by my favorite Vietnamese restaurant, Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu.

They have great portions and great prices! Not only is this a sit down restaurant, they also have a boba counter, bakery, and fried food assortments all located in one building. I always get their spicy satay beef egg noodle soup and it never fails me. I love their fried shrimp egg rolls and combination banh mi. My sister had pho and she said it was the best one she has had so far. Everything tastes fresh and the service is quick. Don't forget to stop by their fried food selection and pick up some fried tofu to go! My favorite fried tofu is the chili lemongrass tofu. They have a large variety of authentic Vietnamese cuisine so there is something for everyone.

This place does get packed during peak dining times and parking can be limited in the front. They have dining area inside and "outside". The outside dining area is still connected to the building and it is a covered area. 

I love this place and wish there was something like this in Miami or Orlando. But for now, I guess I just have to make more trips to Tampa.
This is a great unknown spot!!!!! Amazing Colombian food completely authentic. I'm in love
Simply one of the best restaurants I've ever been to. From the entrees to the deserts, the homemade tofu to the service, this place is absolutely fantastic.

The pho is just okay. It could be served hotter. The banh mi bread around night time isn't fresh, and the bbq pork is scarce. The food is quite cheap, so I guess you cant expect a lot of meat. My friend said that there was more meat on one side of the sandwich, since it was cut in half. 

However, come here for the kalbi rice dish. This was actually pretty good. I would rate it a 9 out of 10. This is the only dish I'd recommend if you come here that makes it worth it. It's only $9, and they actually give you a lot of meat for this dish.

Pho was about $8 for the smaller size, and the banh mi was $3.50.
literally has everything u want... pho... boba.... authentic viet food..... bakery... all in one place... and everyone is always so nice and the food comes out asap!!!!!:)
Seriously the best Vietnamese restaurant in Florida. The vermicelli is really cheap for what you get and for something refreshing go with the kumquat shaking tea
Best Pho place in town! Clean and friendly environment. Quick service and never disappoints. Food is fresh and delicious.

I live going for lunch. Pick up is easy. They have great vegetarian selections. I go to pick up pastries while I wait for my order to go. The bowls of pho and veggies are so large that you have enough to last the day. 
The ready packaged food to go is fresh. The tofu squares at 4 for $1 is a good addition for dinner or mid day snack.
Been coming here for the past 3 years while we're in Tampa area, love love everything this place is so good never disappointed
Great atmosphere and delicious food! Service is so quick and staff very friendly ! Definitely will be back!....Did I mention I loved this place ??!!

Not really understand the hype about Thinh An.
I was in town on business and craving pho.
I found Thinh An on Yelp, and it seemed to be good, so I decided to give it a try.

I came in before 6pm and it was not busy. I came in and noticed the bright menu boards ahead and a little dark inside which I wasn't a big fan of. 
I sat down and ordered pho with rare beef and flank. 
While I was waiting on my food, I noticed the staff was preparing on the to go plastic bags which was not a problem, but they were talking and laughing pretty loud. It was whole time I was here. 

The pho broth was a little salty and the half portion of flank was fat. It wasn't the best pho for sure.
I felt a little uncomfortable in this atmosphere. I don't think I want to come back here. It seems like there are some other pho restaurants in town, so I will just go different ones in the future.
Nice & cosy. Food is super delicious, staff is very friendly. I had satay kambing & soto betawi. OMG.. it's so good.
Great service, even though it was pouring the waitresses went above and beyond to keep us happy. The maizitos were delicious and the paisa hot dog was great too! Super recomendado

Really great food, really great prices! The only thing I haven't liked (only upon the second time trying it) was the broken rice plate with everything. The meat was all severely overcooked and a bit hard to eat. Otherwise, everything is always great and easy to share since the portions are huge.

After flying in past midnight, I walked out of the terminal only to see a United Cab sitting there. I verified with the driver first that he took credit card (as he loaded my suitcase into his trunk) to which he replied "YES". I then told him where I was going and he quickly reponded "no - cash only". I told him that I wasn't going to an ATM at this point so he can just take my stuff out and let me take another cab. He responded "Just get in the car".
 
After 10-15 minutes of lecturing me on how I should have taken money out of the ATM and paid him instead of using my credit card while driving me to the hotel, he pulled up at the hotel check-in and asked me again "So what will it be?" I thought I made it perfectly clear - but I responded again "Credit Card". He rudely sighed and threw a tantrum while getting a credit card slip out and made me wait in the car while he got authorization for the transaction. After he handed me back my card - he popped open the trunk and told me "Go get your stuff". 
 
I have never in my life been treated in this way in a cab - and also at midnight - the last thing you would want to do (as a woman travelling) is to go and get money out of the ATM. I called their customer service to file a complaint and they told me someone would call me back the next day. Still waiting......
 
Apparently they don't care - given all the horrible reviews already posted. My hotel also doesn't recommend them because they've had horrible experiences as well. The driver's car was 544 - do not endorse this company and give them your business - take alternative taxis.

Not really sure what the hype is about Thinh An. I've been here about 3 times and yes, their menu is extensive and they have boba/Vietnamese desserts but that does not make up for their lack of flavor in their food.

One time I bought items from their hot bar area and found a wad of paper inside of my cha lua (Vietnamese fish cake). Another time they pressured me to buy items from their hot bar with discounted prices (assuming they were gonna throw them out anyways) and everything was dry.

Today I went for a pho and boba fix. The food was fast and the bowl was filled with toppings (beef, tendon, meatballs). However .. the broth lacks any flavor!  The boba did not taste like black milk tea at all, mainly just sugar milk. 

Look I gave this place three tries. All three times were a disappointment. Do yourself a favor and go to Saigon deli

By far my favorite restaurant out here in Florida. I came from California and searched and search for a good pho place. 

After 3 years, I found it. This golden gem.
Where the service is great, the food is excellent, and wait time is non existent.

I eat here about 3 times a week, why not it's so affordable. The portion are perfect. 

I recommend the 11, the giant bowl of pho with everything in it. And the Banh Mi with grilled pork.

The waiters will remember you.

It's a great place to take the family.

I miss this place every damn Tuesday. (When they are closed)

I would rate them lower but it is not possible. We got in late because our plane was delayed so the shuttle from the hotel was done for the night.  they took us less than 2 miles. We had 9 in our group which we took 3 taxis they charged $20 dollars we taxi an for 30 dollars for the larger taxi. We're from Chicago and it doesn't cost that much in Chicago!!! Horrible!!!

Beef broth pho w/ tripe, meatballs & beef: the broth is flavorful without relying on seasoning so there's no salty taste just a clean, developed broth. 

Fried rice w/ sausage, chicken, shrimp & pork: the rice is not greasy and they are generous with the amount of protein throughout. The sausage gives the rice a slightly sweet taste, but it could be that I never had Vietnamese sausage before. 

Egg Puff: if you never had one, the best comparison would be a lighter version of a waffle. It's a unique fried treat with some crispiness and a soft inside. Most of the puffs did not have much coconut taste. I think if they added a lot more coconut to the batter or if they provided a coconut sauce it would satisfy the flavor aspect but it is still good even as a plain egg puff.

They're still brutal here. The management doesn't know how to get 80% of the cashiers to smile, be polite, or say thank you. Quilah was miserable and rude (hands the receipt to you saying "here you go" - she just didn't have it in her to say thank you.) Oh and apparently she was trained to toss fruit and vegetables into your shopping bag. Hate checking out at this ACME.  

Now the South Philly, 10th st location is the real deal - they treat you like they'd like to be treated - with respect, professionalism and kindness. It's worth the drive. This management at South Street store is clueless and doesn't seem to have control of their employees. Types of issues like this have been going on for a long time now.
This is a favorite lunch spot for lunch with coworkers. They're fast, easy in and out, the Pho great. They have a bakery inside where you can purchase items to take with you. Definitely recommend it.

This restaurant is not very authentic in my opinion. The size of the plate is twice bigger than the food. And it take a very long time for the food to come out. But still the food is tasty but it is still a bit plain to me.
Good food, good service and good price, a  new Indonesian Authentic Restaurant in South Philadelphia

Unfortunately I can't say the food at this restaurant was great. It wasn't bad but it was mostly bland. We tried the grilled pork fresh rolls, the grilled pork and egg roll vermicelli (bun), the steamed ground pork rice roll with Vietnamese ham and a traditional special banh mi. The bun and the banh mi were the two items that we enjoyed the most, the rest was blah. We also had the warm tofu with ginger for dessert which was an acquired taste but it grew on me. The restaurant is busy, but big enough with inside and outside covered seating. They also have an area with items to go, a hot bar, cold items such as meats, and bakery items. There's also a 'juice' bar where you can get teas, coffee, Vietnamese jelly desserts, etc. The prices are reasonable and the food comes out pretty quickly. 

My dilemma is that every time I decide to try a new Vietnamese restaurant I get so excited and psyched up about it, there's so much anticipation in reminiscing about the amazing flavors I tasted in Vietnam and then the inevitable disappointment and equally as depressing anticlimactic feeling follows the meal. The flavors are just not the same, not even close. Something is always missing. I know, the ingredients are just not the same here and that's the problem to no fault of the restaurants themselves. I think I need to give up my quest for the Vietnamese flavors I so long for.
This place is so good! The amount of food you get for the price is great also.. I used to goto this restaurant down the street but the my recently closed so I found this place right in time!

A very nice neighborhood supermarket!  This is a HUGE improvement over the previous Super-Fresh (NOT) that had been in this space.  

The produce section is quite nice.  Its not the Reading Market or Italian Market, and the prices are fairly high - but the quality is very good, and when they have sales there can be items for good value.  Living in the city, you pay for convenience!  

Another very nice thing is that the fresh fish is quite good.  I used to NEVER buy fish at the supermarket - except for Whole Foods at exorbitant prices - and always went to the fish market in South Philly (good, but not as convenient) - however the fish here is excellent.  I've only gotten a few types - salmon, tuna, shrimp - and it is always fresh and good quality, and this is actually very reasonably priced.  Now I buy fish here every week and I'm always happy with it.

Another positive is the fresh bread & bagels.  However, they did away with the olive bar and salad bar, which is too bad.  I have to go next door to Whole Foods for that.

In general, the prices are OK at best with only a few exceptions - it definitely pays to look for sales and specials.  

The store is small compared to suburban supermarkets, but really has pretty much what I want.  The selection is not huge, and sometimes there is no "store brand" of something that I know would be less expensive than a name brand, and very occasionally there is a very specific item that isn't carried.  But by and large, an acceptable selection.  And I prefer a quick in-and-out in a moderately sized store, than spending so much time going up and down aisles in those huge football-field-sized suburban supermarkets.  They are rarely out of stock of items so it seems well run.

I find that the workers are usually pleasant and helpful.  This is another thing that has improved markedly since it became and Acme.  They are more stable, seem to know the place well, and generally nice.  OK, not everyone all the time, but most of the time.  And I have always found it clean, unlike the prior store.

Overall, its a really nice, convenient neighborhood supermarket.

I had one of the best bowls of phó ever. I tried 13, the classic one with the brisket, rare beef, tendon, meatballs and tripe. Also had half a banh mi and it was just as delicious. This place is cheap, 8 dollars for a big bowl and 10 for a bowl of a size that makes Texas self conscious, and  like 3, 4 bucks for the banh mi. 
 Just fan-f***ng-tastic

The food here is to die for. The question is why are you so far away from me? Then again, maybe thank God you are because I would be scarfing this delicious food up on a daily basis!

From fried spring rolls, fresh spring, bun vermicelli noodles, croissants, egg waffle cones, pork Banh mi sandwich. Those are what I have tried so far. They are so good!  I can't wait to try more.

The restaurant is delightful looking inside and out! They have a vast array of take home items such as different tofu, egg rolls, fresh rolls, croissants, desserts, as well as other items in their fridge.

The drink bar is expansive with many smoothies, milk teas, desserts, and waffle ice cream options and toppings. 

This is a one stop shop for delicious food for now and later. It's also a nice family atmosphere! 

Congrats and best wishes to Thinh An! I wish them the best, and they will make Tampa Bay happy with their delicious food!

THIS PLACE IS AMAZINGGG!!! I used to go to Saigon Deli, which is down the street, but I will no longer be going there after coming to this restaurant. The interior is SOOOOO much nicer, the selection of food is greater, as well as portion size, and the taste can not be beat! Plus the customer service was MUCH better than Saigon Deli.

Best Vietnamese food in town! From the pho to the sandwiches. The employees here are so accommodating and just all around so friendly. We find ourselves here easily twice a week. You should check it out!!

Decided to try this place due to the good reviews and because it had a market which turned out to have many interesting authentic looking items. When we arrived dinner time, there was a line, but it moved quickly. The pho and rolls here come very fast. Everything else was strangely slow. The broth on the pho is very flavorful. We ordered the one with brisket, tendon, tripe and meatball. We also ordered the shrimp and pork summer rolls. All the vegetables and herbs in the roll and that come with the dishes look fresh and clean. The BBQ pork with vermicelli was also good. The spring roll was crisp with a tasty meat filling. At first we didn't like the crispy pancake because it was kind of hard with massive amounts of bean sprouts inside, but it tasted good wrapped in lettuce with herbs. The whole meal my family was lamenting how there are no good Vietnamese restaurants in NY like this place. This place also has a wide assortment of desserts and drinks including sugar cane juice, boba milk tea, smoothies...

This place is really good fro Colombian Fast Food, I've been to a few and this is by far the best in the Bay Area! Is a nice food truck with a nice area to seat with lots of tables and nice decoration to the place. The hot dog and burger are awesome and they have all the special Colombian sauces for fast food. Fast and friendly service, I would recommend this place if you want to eat some good Colombian fast food!

We used United Cab from airport to LaSalle St. This is .7 mile - YES - less than a mile!  Car #493 at 12:20am. Driver did not help with luggage, no meter, did not have a clue where we were going so we had to give him directions!!!

He charged us $19.00 and said, "plus a tip".  Goodbye United Taxi!  We will be calling Uber from now on.

If you enjoy Vietnamese cuisine, this restaurant is a must try! They have a lot more dishes than your typical Vietnamese restaurant. Their food is delicious, which explains why so many people eat here. I recommend their beef stew (bo kho).

This review is solely for their boba tea and coffee with condense milk. I didnt try the food and it looks like they're good but I cant comment on that so anyway 

Got a black milk tea and jasmine milk tea. Both are on the list of my Worst boba ever. I had bad boba tea before, some are from restaurants like this but not this bad. My friend told me he saw them use tea but when i drank it, i cant taste anything. Both drinks taste off, powdery, no taste of tea or milk (be that in powder form or liquid, i can tell since i drink boba like i eat rice but here, no taste detected whatsoever) i and a friend took a sip and the drinks went to the trash. I esp craved for boba tea at that time being on vacation so i was extra disappointed 

Got 2 coffee with condense milk. Usually i have a prob with the coffee being too strong and i got this for my parents but here it taste like powder coffee mix with water with water being 70% of that and the result is watery coffee with no condense milk and no apparent taste for both

Maybe i should have tried the food but i had no time so i opted for the drink. Btw you order at the counter near the door and pick up the drink, dont order it where they make it
Dont get the boba or coffee with milk
Go get the food

Went last night and I will not be back. It was so busy but we were seated pretty quickly for a party of 4. My bf and I placed our order and so did our 2 other friends. Our food came out but our other 2 friends foods took more than 30 minutes. We finally were able to flag down our waiter who never came back to refill our waters and asked why their food hadn't come out and they finally told us their ordering system had crashed, but I guess they failed to mention it to us, so we were just sitting there with no clue to what was happening. I asked to speak with the manager and he came out and gave a bs excuse of that they were understaffed and so busy for our shitty service and experience but did not take any further action. If you're a manager of a restaurant you should probably keep a better number of staff so you dont run into these issues. Needless to say I am very disappointed with my experience last night. Food is good, but service is also of MAJOR importance to me. Will not be back.

This weekend, I ordered take out from D'jakarta Cafe. It was delicious! The food came in the designated time frame (we ordered from Postmates), and everything was the temperature it should be. For food, I ordered the Stir Fried Egg Noodle, and it was delicious. It came with some spicy sauce on the side and some pickled cucumbers. The cucumbers added a nice crunch. The spicy sauce was WAY too spicy for me when I tried it, and the dish was very flavorful without it, so it worked out. 

For a drink, I ordered the Es Cendol. It had an almost savory taste to it. I didn't really like the taste of it, but my boyfriend did. He had ordered the Happy Soda, and we swapped. I liked his better, it was much sweeter and had a carbonated aspect to it with the soda. 

We are already talking about ordering again! This will definitely be a go to place of ours!

Omg, I've been meaning to try this place and today I finally did and am so glad. I got excited about everything on the menu and it was hard to narrow down my meal to order for one. So my big eyes ordered, with a plan for plenty of leftovers. 

Every dish can be ordered by a number off the menu...I started with appetizers #3 and #5. The fried shrimp, pork eggroll and also rice paper wrapped around shrimp and noodle, basil & bean sprouts. They were accompanied with fantastic flavored sweet and sour and peanut sauces! High recommend. The decision between Pho and Noodle soup was difficult-but I chose #26 wonton and egg, noodle soup with roasted pork. It came with bean sprouts, jalapeño and lime on the side-so flavorful. Most of mine will be tomorrow's lunch. My final course was #73, shrimp fried rice. It was a large portion and very flavorful. Half of that is also going home with me as well-I will be back another time to sample some other menu items. Bring your appetite when you come here. This is definitely authentic which you will realize when you see the restaurant full of Vietnamese people who shop the small store attached with fresh baked goods and foods.
This place has the best Pho in Tampa. I highly recommend getting the shrimp fresh rolls for an appetizer. They also have an amazing assortment of pastries and desserts if you got a sweet tooth.

I love everything about this place. The food is always fresh and delicious. The only thing I don't really like is the cafe sua da being served sealed in a plastic cup. I prefer the old fashioned drip method but it's still pretty tasty coffee.
Just had some tri-tip at pecan fest. Was cooked perfect, tender, tasty and i will look for you again and  get a whole tri-tip to take home. Thanks!

Rita's is so tasty, and not a bad price for someone on a strict budget. I love how most of their flavors are natural made, no dyes and additives, real fruit, and even though they are somewhat sweet, you can tell it's not as super sugary as many other things on the market today. The customer service has always been good here. I highly suggest if you live in the area, in the summer time, take a walk there in the evening or on a really scorching hot summer day. It really is worth it.

Great place for Pho. I ordered their #2 Beef broth, with rare beef and I added shrimp for an additional $3. I also ordered their chicken eggs rolls and Thai tea with boba. The broth was very good, with a great flavor. I added all the trimmings, mint, jalapeños, lime, siracha, chili paste, etc. The bowls are huge, so chose wisely (extra large available). 

The service was fast! The server was attentive and pleasant. The restaurant gets pretty busy during lunch time, so it's best to beat the crowds if your on a time crunch. They also have pre-made meals for take-out, and delicious Snow-Ice (type of ice cream). I ordered the mango with bananas and cherry boba. It was the best I've ever had. I recommend that you save room for it, you won't be disappointed.

This is my favorite and only place I'll go for Pho and sandwiches! Their prices are very affordable, and it's keep clean. Enjoy!

This place is heaven! ---BUT--- do not come here expecting to receive service like you would at a normal restaurant in America. It will just never happen and you'll learn to live with it. 

Best pho and ramen in town. Love the crab toast. The bakery is a staple in my home. I crave this place once a week and have grown to love things I would have never tried before. 

Service isn't great. The place is always packed. It's loud. There's usually a language barrier. Sometimes the server doesn't see you. It's life. Their food makes up for it. Is it a place where I leave a crazy tip? No. But I come often enough that I know what I'm getting into.
The best Pho in Tampa! Fast and fabulous. One of our must stops when we are in town! Delicious and reasonably priced!

There's a standard dish I always order: vermicelli with grilled pork and eggrolls. Sadly this place failed to deliver. My food came rather fast (and cold!) and it's almost as if it had already been prepared for somebody else. There was also a sliver of RAW meat that was on top of the eggroll which I brought to the server's attention. She was young, a bit inept but I give her credit for trying. I give it 3 stars despite my disappointment because my hubby's pho was actually tasty. The staff also tried to rectify my dish but they really didn't do anything else beyond heat up the meat and place it back exactly how it was prior. Barely ate it and I turned my attention to my hubby's pho instead.
Anyhoo I don't plan on coming back not when you have Saigon deli on the opposite side of waters avenue who is consistent and much better.

Very solid bahn mi sandwich and noodles soups. The "market" is small, but a very nice touch. I like to chow down on some eggrolls while waiting for my grub. 

Staff is hard to communicate with though, especially when having to order gluten free foods. 

There are like 70000 reviews already, so that's all I've gotta say.

A nice staff and extremely clean office. Been going here for a few years. I love how I receive a text message as a confirmation for my appointment, and I can also call at anytime and get the answering service ( LIVE person to discuss your needs). My teeth cleaning is always superb; my dental hygienist does a very good job. Dr. Yanez just seems extremely busy, and he gets in and out very quickly. It is much better to have fewer people, with more attention to that person, than more people with less attention. Overall, I gave it four stars because the place is immaculate, technology seems to be updated, staff is knowledgeable and service is pretty good.
Wow!  I just discovered  this place!  Love it.  Great Food and atmosphere plus the prices and the food market for quick take out is fantastic!

Nobody loves Wawa more than me.  But this Wawa has seen better days. It is only a matter of time before Pantry One takes over.
Within a 24 hour span I visited this Wawa twice. The first time the store was evacuated because a display case burst into flames. The second time a local crackhead reached behind the counter and stole a pack of newports.  Not to mention the fact that a few weeks prior I almost stepped on a hypodermic needle out front.
There are far better wawas around (Aramingo's ave and bridesburg) where you won't have to take your life in your hands. And...they probably have pretzels and more than one soup option.
Okay. If you want bomb ass food and bomb ass service go here. They are so nice so helpful and they literally go so fast.

Our go-to Vietnamese restaurant. So many options of food to choose from. The pho servings are very generous. This place is usually packed so I guess a lot of people find their food delicious. They also have a a bakery and to-go section in the store. 
I love that the outside seating is also now covered and airconditioned.

It's crazy how this is my third time coming back and the customer service from grand opening till now is still atrocious! The first time no one greeted me at the counter when I was trying to check out. Everyone was having conversations amongst themselves, acknowledges me while I was standing there, proceeded to talk, kept me waiting and then finally decided to ring me up. They continued their conversation, told me my total and did not have the decency to put the change in my hand. It was practically thrown at me; I had to collect all the coins that rolled off the table because of her. I just let it slide that time. But what do you know, just now the same thing happened again. This time the owner did this to me. No 'thank you' or 'come back again'..I'm truly appalled by their behavior. Concept of the restaurant is cool, but really needs to re-evaluate how they treat their customers, otherwise there isn't going to be any. Never coming here again.

Didn't even use this cab company but had a terrible interaction with their company. Regarding Cab number 429. We merged over on the freeway, with plenty of space between our vehicles and he proceeded to tailgate our vehicle. Then he sped past our car, cut us off and slammed on his brakes. He then pulled onto the shoulder of the freeway to get back behind the vehicle just to speed past our car making sure we noticed him flipping us off. We felt compelled to call the company to file a complaint and after telling them the cab number, the gentleman hung up immediately. Do not trust this company. They don't care about the quality of their drivers or the way they drive. You could not pay me to get in the vehicle with a person who would behave this way over a simple interaction on the freeway.

my 15 year old recently wanted to go there with 5 of her freinds, and i told her no, because it was near dark!!  i grew up with this wawa, and if you want to stop in the morning, have at it......but at night...forget it!!!  unless you want to practice dodge-a-bum with the pan handlers outside. no, i am not being insensative when they wear tommy hillfiger shirts and call you "dude" before trying to bum drug money from you. it would be a one star place for me, if not for the fact i met the famous harry kalas there. it was 3am, he was blind drunk, and told his wife to shut the "f' up,  but hey.......i met harry!!!!!!
The other one did. It have beer and wine. Parking above the store. 2hours free if spend 10$

Oh my Pho!  One of the best Viet restaurants I've been to in the bay area.  This is now my go to place when I want to get Pho'd!  Get Pho'd for less than $10! Friendly staff to make sure you have a happy ending!  Don't forget to get your Green Tea on and some baked goods for later! You will not be disappointed!

One of my favorite indonesian restaurant in town! Been there and order for shrimp rollade, chicken noodle mushroom and grilled chicken.. taste excellent and feels really authentic.. i waited for around 30-40minutes, but still worth the food.. will be back for sure!
We found this wonder spot by accident. Great food and service. Try the spring rolls. Super fresh and yummy. Great spot.

My new fav PHO place. It gets very crowded here! Come early!

Pho was very good. Some would say they Pho at Saigon Deli on Waters would taste better but I will tell you why this place rocks! 

Very clean, lots of variety on the menu, small bakery section, homemade tofu, friendly staff,  fun slushy drinks, kids menu!

I had tofu Pho it was very good. My daughter loved the chicken & rice off kids menu. She ate every bite. The sauce was delish. My husband got the special & I don't know what it was called. It was rice noodles fried on both sides like a pancake & had crunchy outside with chewy inside. Cut in wedges & they paired his stir-fry with it. It was the BombDotCom!

They have a slushy drink machine there so they can make any type of fruit or smoothie type slushy.

My current favorite Vietnamese place in Tampa.  It is a bit of a drive for me but I will drive to have a meal here.  The portions are big, menu is extensive with lots of pictures for people who don't know what they're ordering.  Their drink menu is great if you like flavored teas and boba.  They have a small market of prepared foods as well if you want to bring home some snacks or small meal options.  The seating is first come first serve and they try to accommodate every party.   But their parking is extremely small so try to get there earlier than later.

Worst company ever. Even if you have no place to go, you're looking at long wait times. God forbide you actually have someplace to be at a specific time. On multiple occasions I have called the company to schedule a pickup at a specific time. Every. Single. Time I have had to wait for 30 minutes or longer. Once, I waited an hour and a half before canceling the call. Keep in mind that I had scheduled a pickup time...

A company that prides itself on promptness? Please. Don't waste your time, or give these people your money.

Monday, May I was waiting for my wife to pick me up during a rain storm, in front of Menorah Manor in St. Pete today when this driver pulled up in front of the entrance and sat there waiting for someone to come out. I asked him to move from the front as my wife had just pulled up. At first he ignored me and then he rolled his window down just enough to say" A little rain won't hurt you" then he rolled it back up. I was holding a cane because of my bad ankle, but it apparently made no difference to this guy. So , yes I had to go in the pouring rain to my car. The driver did not care at all. He just had to backup for a minute to allow my wife to pull up under the cover to pick me up. But he wouldn't budge. That's really lousy manners.
I felt that your company should know what kind of driver you have.

Very trendy cool spot for some pho.. i had the crab rue (minus the blood patty).. it was flavorful and fresh. My friend had chicken pho and she said that it was good.. we had some boba tea to go with it and we both enjoyed it.. we will definitely be back to this cool spot

It's a supermarket. How great can it be? 

I come here a lot. I think it's a pretty good store. They have normal items and whatnot, but I think the best part is that the carry chopped vegetables (unlike their next door neighbor) and really cheap beer. 

I come here for decent/the "best" prices for regular brand name products (ex. Tostitos or whatever), although I've honestly never compared with corner stores. 

I mainly come here because they have chopped vegetables, which make it so much easier to cook after work (and for super cheap beer). 

I got the "Maryland style macaroni salad" once. It was $6 a pound. I think that was a pretty fair price because there was shrimp in it. 

I've never had a bad customer service experience here, nor have I had a wonderful one. You get help at the butcher. You checkout. That's it. I think it's a pretty decent place to shop when you want regular brand name items. 

Plus I can honestly say they have the cheapest beer in the area. My favorite is Victory Golden Monkey, and it's $12 compared to $18+ at delis closer to my apartment. While the selection might not be as expansive as your corner store, it's definitely the cheapest. The offer a mix-a-6 with a lot of craft beer options for only $12!

Such beautiful food! I took two of my 3 daughters to this sweet spot tonight and left more than satisfied. Truth is, I spent about 3 weeks in Indonesia when my now 21-year-old daughter was six- months-old. She accompanied me then and accompanied me tonight. This trip with her was a lot less stressful because I didn't have to continually nurse her on a twenty-three hour plane ride..but I digress.  Oh sweet delicious food of Indonesia, how you don't disappoint. The chicken satay was so delicious it would have been enough to stop there, but add the fried rice with salty fish, the coconut beef soup, the amazing mango smoothies...I mean, what are you waiting for? It's a cozy little spot too. Cash only so bring your bills and get to South Philly!

Absolutely delicious.

I came in with a friend last week and had a blast. I enjoyed an avocado boba smoothie, banh mi special combo, and an apple croissant for less than $10. The boba was made well and perfectly chewy - the smoothie itself had a good consistency and was way better than Green Island or other competing boba shops. 

The banh mi could compete with Saigon Deli - although they are both different animals - I like both. The noticeable difference was the bread - Thinh An makes their bread in-house (still have to say I love the crunch at Saigon though). The food was noticeably more healthy or fresher tasting than Saigon with similar pricing.

My favorite thing was definitely the Apple Croissant - it was one of the best baked goods I've had in Tampa and I could easily see myself stopping by all the time to try the different things on the menu. 

Overall, an excellent experience and it really shows with their huge lunch crowds. Thinh An is running at full capacity and it is a sight to see.

Finally another Vietnamese restaurant on this side of the bridge! I had lunch here today, and the place was packed! We were sat immediately though as another table just left. Service was excellent. The restaurant is gorgeous and decorated nicely. The menu is expansive! I walked over to the area where freshly baked bread, goods, and other delicious items were displayed and wanted to just eat off the selection over there. But after looking at the menu, I opted for a sandwich, iced coffee, and dessert. The bread is made fresh daily, and you can definitely tell upon first bite. I love, love fresh bread, and it is rare to find that at any Vietnamese restaurant. Kudos to that! I had a nem nuong (pork sausage) sandwich and that is also rare to find around here. Loved it! My coffee was delicious, and the waitress even let me add boba to it. I had the 3 bean dessert and was already so full I had to take half of it home. Also made fresh! I will definitely be back soon.
Awesome!  The best Vietnamese food in the area.  We drive from Channelside to come to Thnh An.  We always leave with goodies from the deli.

This restaurant is a must!!! Authentic, quick service, cheap and great prices, and flavor-filled dishes. 

I got banh mi dac biet sandwhich, pho tai chin XL, and the cafe sua dua/iced espresso with condensed milk. Great portions with amazing prices. I was surprised how big their XL pho bowl was for only $10. I was SO filled by the end of the meal that I didn't eat till 8PM that night haha. The banh mi dac biet was crunchy and filled with flavor too. 

I also noticed how they had a bakery, fried food, and boba/drinks counters. It reminded me of all the Vietnamese bakeries I went to Seattle, WA! 

Check this place out if you're in town for sure!
One of the good experience that I have with the food and the service it's a perfect match high recommend they are really deserve it

The best Vietnamese restaurant I've been to in a while! The service was quick and the food is high quality, great value, and very authentic. The bun bo hue that I ordered was delicious and exceed my expectations! I would definitely recommend this place to friends when I am in the area again.

My experience seems to be the opposite of most. In my case, the service was very attentive, although I felt very rushed every step. Here's your seat, what would you like to drink? what would you like to eat? Water? More water? Check? Thanks for coming. Wham bam! But they were very busy so I understand them wanting a fast turnaround time. I think it will be a better experience once business slows though. 

As far as the food, the banh mi thit nuong was just 3 stars. The flavor was a little off and not a whole lot of pork. The red bean boba tea was good albeit very sweet. 

They have a wide variety of options (though not much beef), both on the menu and grab and go. The space is nice. I put this on the same tier as Simply Pho - average Viet food (which is still good) with above average service in a modern atmosphere.

I love coming to this hidden gem! I am completely hooked on the delicious options for food here, from the yummy pho to the spring rolls and boba, I can't get enough! I always look forward to coming by and enjoying my food in a relaxing and clean environment. The staff members are always really nice too, and it's so inexpensive!

Food was delicious and our server was on top of it. Cool lunch atmosphere and the restaurant looked clean and super cute. I was so excited they had grilled chicken spring rolls and they did not disappoint.
Great Indonesian restaurant with many delightful,dishes that are very flavorful and well prepared. Fast take out service too.

‍ out of my words. The new younger employees are so slow and have no idea what to do with anything or how to solve a problem. I was stuck in line for 10 minutes because a young girl didn't know how to scan a coupon and wasn't sure if Wawa even takes any. I offered to just lay and not worry about it because I wasn't going to waste another minute of my life.

Currently with hurricane Irma clean up, I hesitated to post this review.  But after 24 hours of thinking about the situation we experienced at THINH AN, I feel that others need to be warned.

If I could give a negative rating I would!  Shame on this restaurant for serving us rancid noodles in our Beef Pho. When we told our waitress about it, her nice demeanor became a bad attitude and avoided us afterward!  To top it off, the owner, who sat at the cash register in the front glared at us when the waitress told him about the situation and when we left.

Noodles in any dish should NOT taste sour nor should it have a sticky & gritty taste.  

We DID NOT ask for a refund. Instead, we returned the rancid Beef Pho & ordered another noodle dish in replacement & asked for it to go.  We told the waitress we did NOT want to get sick over rancid noodles!  At first she told us we could NOT exchange nor return the rancid Beef Pho.  She never came back to our table until she brought us the check.  Another waitress came by our table, mumbled something, left a bag on our table and kept walking.  

We should mention, the waitress got our order wrong on the first bowl of Beef Pho as well.

They did not apologize, nor offer  to do anything to try to fix the situation, no service after our request, just the check with an abrupt & short attitude.  We DID leave her a 15% tip.  

Tampa lacks decent Vietnamese restaurants (my food standard is average) & we have waited for a long time to try this restaurant, waiting to make sure the restaurant became established, plus we live far away and had to drive quite a while to go there.  

After 4 days of no power, eating dried food, we decided to celebrate with a decent meal. We chose Thinh An.  We told our waitress this and she was happy to hear before the rancid noodles in the Beef Pho incident.

THINH AN, please learn some basic customer service skills. Learn to treat customers with respect and understand that if you treat a $10 mistake with grace, you will have a regular customer for a long time, we would have written a raving review & recommend your restaurant to all of our friends & family.  Instead you forced us to write a review showing your greed over $10- shame on you!

For those of you who have had great food & experiences at this place, I am happy & hope you never have to experience what we did.  As a paying customer, we deserve respect and not be served rancid food.    We will never return & we will let all of our friends/family know never to support Thinh An!

Update:

Thomas M- to comment on your statement.  
You have been misinformed & you need to train your staff to not lie about customers!

We DIDNOT ORDERED THE WRONG SIZE PHO!  Your waitress sent in the wrong size!  We DID NOT TOUCH THE FIRST BOWL, the waitress took the first bowl back as she admitted to us that she did not take the order correctly.

The second bowl had RANCID NOODLES AND WE TOLD THE WAITRESS ABOUT THE RANCID NOODLES!  We opted NOT TO ORDER ANOTHER BOWL OF PHO, instead trading it for another dish.

We ordered items to go BEFORE we even sat down to eat because we were were without electricity and  needed food.  

Your untrue comments & statements truly show the lack of customer service and the type of person you are.  If you are the manager or the owner, you truly need to look within yourself and your staff before you accuse customers of wrong doing.

Still no apologies!  

We are truly shocked & horrified at the additional  comments from Thomas M from Thinh An.  We hope that if you consider dining at Thin An, look carefully at the reviews where customers experienced issues, no apologies, very few comments from Thinh An's representatives.  Instead, this Thomas M insisted to make false comments of our review.  If he was present at the restaurant while we were dining there, we did not see him, he did not came to our table to speak with us.  Instead he continues to make false statements.  We were charged for every items we ordered!   Very sad.

I had been looking for a great place for pho and I have found it. The pho was exceptionally delicious and flavorful I had a small and it was plenty and the prices were very reasonable for the large portions that you get I will def be returning
Great value.  The prices are very reasonable.  Food is fresh, quick, and delicious with deep authentic flavors.  They have tons of great vegan options as well.
I gave it a second chance and I'm glad I did! I loved the pho, the bobba tea, the ice cream! The server was so nice and everything is nice and clean! Def will go back and often!!

Feb 24 in a hotel called at 4pm to be taken to Berns Steak House.
Called back at 4:25 to ask "where is he?"  "On his way.
NEVER SHOWED UP and no call.
I missed going to Berns and was very sorry I tried this cab company.

I really really liked this place, yummm! I had a bbq pork bahn-mi which was very fresh, perfect flavor and a generous portion for the price. I also got some chicken fresh rolls which were outstanding and a strawberry boba! All.so good! They have a market/bakery that you can purchase things to take home. My son liked going around and picking out what he wanted. I like that they offer so many different things to take home. This place is a must try! Even my husband who doesn't really care for Vietnamese food liked this place.
Love this place. Food is always fresh and very reasonably priced. Service is always super friendly as well. Management is always available and involved in operation

I think this place is good...only reason for me that it's not great is that the broth in the Pho is not hot (temp) is not hot enough.  Otherwise, I very much enjoy the portions and freshness.  Teas are also wonderful and blended perfectly.  I am going to ask next time if they can make it hotter and will adjust as necessary.  But, give this place a try...it's worth it.

I have had excellent service from Alex and Noel and appreciate their help. They're great, caring people and they're efficient drivers as well. 
Dorothy

This is the BEST Vietnamese restaurant for Pho that we have been to in Tampa. We are regulars. We brought our viet family here that was visiting from out of town and they also said it the Pho and food here was excellent. The Pho here is amazing. Broth is flavorful without giving you the MSG headache afterward and they don't skimp on the quantity of the meat and the bean sprouts, basil and culantro (Pho is not the same without the culantro) and the service is good.

We love the vanilla egg tarts (we used to love these in NYC and haven't been able to get them down here), fresh soy milk and fresh tofu (tofu compares to some small of the Chinese tofu eateries in Chinatown, NYC). They also make a variety of Vietnamese snacks, bread, fried foods, desserts and boba/bubble tea, etc drinks. Other soups/noodles, Bah mi, rice dishes are good as well.

If I had to compare this to Saigon Deli, Thinh Ah is slightly a step up. But Saigon is is very good as well.

It gets packed on the weekends and also prime lunch and dinner time. Expect a short wait or to sit in the outdoor area (which is just as nice) since they have AC and heat there as well. The parking lot gets packed as well but if you wait a little someone usually leaves.

I ordered number 71 from their menu but sadly I've eaten here since they have open but this time the chicken that was also served in this dish was very dry and old. You could taste a sour taste in the chicken. It's so dry that it crumbled up in my mouth making me take a big gulp of my drink. I've never been so disappointed with my meal at this place. I feel sick and I couldn't complete my food. The rice was dry and the Pork that was served with the food was very dry too. All around this dish is not good I had maybe 6 scoops with my spoon till I had both the chicken and pork inside my mouth that's when I couldn't think of anything but reach for my drink of water... now let's talk about the water. The water smells like pool water and you could taste that the water came from the sink.. I live in the Area and I know how the water taste. I'm very disappointed with the food. The table next to mine had some kid using his straw and shooting spit balls! For real what type of stuff is that? It's a restaurant not your damn home keep that shit there! Stay away from here! There's many other options in the area. Don't be fooled, just because it's new or whatever the food isn't worth your money or time.

They have such a good variety here and its one of the few places that offer crawfish. The bakery and sweet treats are on point too. Very cute and clean viet market/ restaurant vibe. The cream cheese tarts are not too sweet and are a perfect snack :) and Ive tried a lot on the menu and have not been disappointed yet

I have been here multiple times and every time I leave here so happy.  Even if you are the pickiest eater on Earth I don't see how you couldn't find something here that suits your fancy.

Do you like smoothies?  They have a plethora of fruit choices ranging from a common strawberry to exotic durian (never again).  They'll even include boba.

Are you a vegetarian?  They go through the meticulous process of making multiple flavors of tofu in house.

Do you like pastries?  They have delicious, soft croissants filled with strawberry, mango, apple, chocolate, cream cheese, etc.

Do you like a spotless, modern restaurant?  This is one of them!

Do you like Vietnamese food? They have delicious soups, sandwiches, etc.

Do you like to save money? Their prices are so low you'll think that they're an error.  A substantial  Bánh mì sandwich for $3.50??? Extra Bánh mì bread for $0.50???  How can they make a profit at these prices?

Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu you are the best.  Why did you have to pick a location all the way over here?
We ordered the large pho dac biet and grill pork with egg and rice. They were both delicious. The take out bakery, Boba bar and ready food are very convenient.  Definitely worth returing.
Great food with a big variety of dishes. Staff is attentive and friendly! Prices are very affordable.
Vietnamese fare at its finest. They even have side items you can take home. Price is nice too. The passion fruit slush with original Boba is spectacular.
I'm a huge Wawa fan because of their milk shakes. Every time I pass by one I have to stop in and get a cookies and cream milkshake and how can  you go wrong since they are only $2.59
I'm always satisfied but I'm Not Happy this location doesn't have Mac and Cheese on the menu yet

Advertise by littering their menus all over my neighborhood. Hired help doesn't use common sense and wind blows them all over. Should be fined. If your food is any good, word will get out. Quit it with the menus.

So many selections! The bubble tea options are wonderful and pho was pretty good (we got the chicken) ...will be more adventurous next time. Loved the little market and the made to order egg puff waffles were so yummy!

So its my first time here. I found about this place because of my mom which was recommended by my auntie. Thisplace is pretty packed. Its almosr 3pm during lunch on a sunday.
