They have drink/banh mi stations, cooked ready to eat food on the left and on the right is the resturant if yoy wanna dine in. So i was here with my family for the first time. My family picked up some stuff from the left side. While i wanted to try their drinks. I asked what they recommend its the normal thai tea milk tea and taro milk tea. So i ended up getting the lychee milk tea. They said 'thats what the american always like/get' so i gave it a try. Took them around 5 to 10mins for the drink. Took my first sip. Oh my god what the heck did i just drank? I thought to myself did i drink straight sweet sugar syrup? (Thats how they make their drinks). Imagine like a mouth full of sweet sugar in liquid form in your mouth. Tooooo sweeeett let me tell you. I asked if they can make me a new one. I stood there and watch them remake it. They took my drink add and mix it with water and gave it back. Thats their method i guess. I still gave it a try anyways. Man its still sweet as fu*k but its not as bad earlier. I ended up throwing away my drink because its not meant for me. If you like mouth full of liquid sugar then this drink is for you. If you guys are into that drink let me know. Let me know how sweet was your drink or maybe it was just mine and the person was new or made it wrong or something. I shouldve took a before picture nefore they mixed it but i have a after picture. Ill might give this place another try later if i feel like it or when they arnt busy to see if there is a difference.
Great bun and wonton soup! Tons of variety on the menu. Service is quick, helpful and polite. Prices are affordable. Very clean and efficient environment.

I waited months for this place to open and it was a major disappointment. I really was hoping for a quality restaurant close to home....it won't be this place. The pho was not good. The broth did not have a good flavor, very plain and lacking something. There was very little meat in the dish. The meatballs that were used did not include the tendons. We ordered the combo pho and had maybe two pieces of tendons in the soup. My bootleg-out-of-a-package homemade version is better than what I was served today. The only reason I gave them 2 stars is for the portion size. There were plenty of rice noodles in the dish. The service was pleasnt too. I really had high hopes. I guess will have to drive right by this place to keep going to the other Vietnamese place further down the street, the other place is worth the drive. Besides, this place has slightly higher prices than others.

With out a doubt, best bread in town. Will stop out of my way to get a loaf, seeded of course. Make sure you stop by early enough, because some days by three o'clock closing, they are all sold out. 

Always make sure to pick up a slice of the tomato pie, which is excellent. Try the delicious, and very cheap, biscotti's as well. You'll be surprised how good they are.
We have ordered take out about 10 times this is a genuine pho place. Service is prompt. Its a great place with many options especially for being in the South and not in and inner city

I've been here several times and I'm finally doing a review! This place definitely deserves 5 stars! I love everything about this place. We went last night and I mentioned to Jason that this might be my favorite restaurant in Tampa. This place is worth the hype! 

Service is excellent. I always get greeted right away and I usually don't have to wait long for a table. The servers and hosts and cashiers are all extremely friendly and are super willing to help explain anything on the menu. 

Food: so much variety and so fresh! They pretty much make everything in house and don't use MSG so you can truly taste the flavor of the food. 

Favorites: Thinh An Special Broken Rice is HUGE! 2 people can share this and still be full. The extra large plate has a huge grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, egg quiche, a whole strip of grilled short ribs (similar to galbi) and grilled shrimp, with broken rice, lettuce, and crunchy pickled radishes and carrots. They serve this with fish sauce and a bowl of clear onion soup. 

Banh Mi: Any of the banh mi sandwiches are delicious! I usually get the special banh mi with all the different meats (I especially like the pate), and the BBQ pork banh mi (banh mi thit nuong). They bake their own bread and the mayo is house-made and delicious! 

Noodle dishes: I've had the Thinh An Special Vermicelli which had grilled pork, grilled ground pork, fried eggroll, and grilled shrimp on top of vermicelli noddles with fish sauce. I love fish sauce! I've also had their Quang style yellow rice noodle soup (Sat & Sun only) which was also flavorful and homey. Surprisingly though I have not tried their pho yet at Thinh An. 

After you order and while you're waiting for your food, you can browse their expanded bakery section! All the delicious baked goods and prepared foods are made in-house. All of their bread items are a good choice especially the croissants. They also are a tofu house so all their tofu items are also made in-house. We like to grab a gallon of their fresh soybean milk each visit (it usually doesn't last long at our house!). Their tofu pudding, whether served hot there or cold to take home is the best! It's really hard to find this dessert in Tampa and we were ecstatic when we found it here! The ginger honey is amazing with it. The tofu pudding reminds me of my childhood. Try the crabmeat and shrimp toast! It is so decadent! You have to get one of their curry pork empanadas (Banh xep)! It has a different dough than a true empanada, it almost is like a doughnut. I can't wait to get more of these! 

Desserts:  You have so many choices here. I've had the eggpuff waffle which comes with your choice of ice creams and toppings. I had mine withwith coconut and mango ice cream, mochi, green beans, and strawberry syrup. I've also had the pandan regular waffle as well and it was delicious. These waffle desserts are huge as well, we've shared with 4 people and could not finish!  Rainbow dessert is always a solid choice and any of their boba drinks. Their cafe sua da (iced espresso with condensed milk) always hits the spot, whenever I allow myself coffee that is! They also serve shaved ice! 

The menu is expansive but not hard to navigate and there are pictures on the back if you need visuals. 

**They are also serving boiled crawfish now!**

The only downside is that I live a solid 45 minutes away so I can't come here as often as I would like but it is definitely worth the drive! Tip: weekends are extremely busy here especially on Sundays and parking can be hard to find/non-existent during these times. I suggest going during the week or non-peak hours.

We went to thinh an for dinner and it was super busy. We waited for 40 mins to get a table. I'm not sure the person in charge of taking down the waitlist is the owner or a manager. He was not friendly and had attitude toward customers. Our waiting beeper rang and he just stared at people, we then followed him to the table. He treated customers like prisoners lol. The food was decent, and not that flavorful. Fish sauce for vermicelli and rice dish was super sweet which lacking of some sour balance from lime or vinegar. The servers there are very nice and friendly. A lady was next to me waited for her Togo order for over an hour. When she asked the people there for her food, they were saying in Vietnamese and I heard that they only had a partial of her order. They totally forgot to pack the other part of the order.

Not one of my top picks for Vietnamese cuisine. I've heard a lot about this restaurant, and decided to give it a try. When we arrived, we were seated immediately - which was great since this was around the prime lunch time. Our waitress gave us complimentary water, and took our orders. I ordered the Pho Ga, which was mediocre - there was more slices of chicken then there was noodles. The soup lacked flavor and richness. The service here is quite confusing. We had to track down our waitress in order to pay for our meal. Honestly if you're desperately hungry and in a crunch for time - you can settle for this restaurant. But don't expect much authentic Vietnamese cuisine here.

There are so many options here, it's tough to know what to order... If it's your first time, definitely go for the banh mi. They are incredibly tasty and all very affordable at $3.50/each. I'm torn in my love for the egg and ham one versus the roasted pork, but I think I might have to try the headcheese one next.

The grilled fish here is truly something special. It's salty, sweet and crispy. It also comes with a side of sambal sauce and some sweet-soy-diced-onions concoction. Just thinking about it makes me salivate.
I always get excited when I see they are out and about in Tucson. Usually go to art street fair just for bbq4you but recently found them on Houghton on weekends once a month! Yay!

I cannot begin to describe to you how much I love this place. Thinh An was one of our places to go for our Asian Food Tour and I tell you, it was a great decision. It can get really busy and that can make parking a hassle so plan accordingly. Once we got there, we were seated and placed our orders. Once we placed our orders, we got up and looked around at their market side and they had a ton of great items. From bakery to produce to dairy, they had it all. It was a sight to see. 

Spring Rolls: (5/5) To die for, we got the grilled pork and every bit of it was deliciousness. I wish I ordered more!
Special Pho: (5/5) Didn't even have to add in condiments because the broth was so good.
Fried Rice: (4/5) It was very light but very tasty. I liked it. 
Banh Mi: (4/5) It was very good! 
Beef Vermicelli: (3/5) The lemongrass was strong that it made some bites bitter so I didn't like it too much but it was refreshing when it didn't taste bitter.
Strawberry Milk Tea: (3/5) I didn't like it, tasted like strawberry powder that I had at home. 

The servers each had an ear walkie talkie with one another and that made service 5/5! I love this place and I am definitely returning!
Stopped for a to go order. Ordered beef pho to go and they didnt put the sprouts etc condiments in the bag. It is not pho without these things. Oh well better luck next time
Been very happy with everything I've ordered.  Well not a fan of the basil in the shrimp rolls but otherwise everything is excellent.  Will keep going back...there are plenty more soups to try.

This is literally one of the greatest places to eat. The food was absolutely incredible. The staff was so pleasant. Also, the menu. Wow. So many options. The prices were very reasonable. 

My husband and I both had pho. And I dream about it to this day. We want to go back and try the rice bowls because they looked AHMAZING. Honestly there are not enough places like this. 

To top it off, it was soooo clean.

This place was absolutely amazing ! The servers were fast and very nice. The food was the best I've ever had in Tampa. I had the #13 without meatballs. The meat was delicious. I was very impressed by my overall experience. I will definitely be back !

Delicious broths, fresh ingredients and cheap. I highly recommend this place to anybody that likes pho or wants to try it.Their broths are delicious you can taste all the different ingredients from the bones to the spices, their veggies and toppings are fresh and flavorful. You leave feeling satisfy:) i one side of the building they have a bakery/ grocery with different types of pastries and other items. Try their fried tofu, you get 4 pieces for a 1 dollar and they have different flavors. Very good.

What a treat!!!!! I drive past this restaurant so much and finally decided to stop. It is sort of like a restaurant/market/prepared foods to go & cafe all in one. I was tempted to make a plate of prepared food and take it to go, but then I saw the menu. I ordered a vermicelli bowl w tofu and other delicious stuff on top and a boba tea for dessert. Super clean and nice inside, great staff, will go back!!

Authentic tasting Vietnamese good for dirt cheap.  I've spent some time in Vietnam and this place tastes like the real deal. Their Bahn Mi sandwiches are fantastic and the summer rolls are fresh. I will come back more often in the future!

I'm not going to lie, I'm a little upset my bf has been hiding this place from me for some time! He had always talked about "this Vietnamese place he goes to for lunch," but I did not realize what I was missing out on.  

Well, I am thoroughly impressed! Attentive, fast service, great variety of food (seriously, how can they serve all these things and do it with such finesse?) and it's all delicious. I had a mini panic attack about having to pick ONE thing off the menu but he reassured me we could come again. 

I decided on what seems to be the fave pho: pho dac biet. It's got all sorts of beefy deliciousness in there from meatballs to tendon and rare slices. We also tried the bbq pork spring rolls which were super tasty and fresh. 

What truly sets them apart is the bakery/grocery element. They've got a ton of uber traditional dishes from bakery to hardy to-go lunches and more that you can pick up if you're in a hurry or take home for the next day. I really wish I could name everything I saw, but I'd be here a loooonggg time and my Vietnamese isn't very good (and by that, I mean non-existent). 

I tried the lychee boba slush too, my standard, and it did not disappoint! You gotta get the jellies though! 

Next time I will have to go with one of the other 9 million items. Guess we'll be trekking across town a few times for this place, because it's worth it!

I love this restaurant :) I had the vermicelli with stir fried lemongrass beef, thai tea, and desserts the first time i visited. the thai tea was surprisingly perfect! normally my favorite thai tea is from thai restaurants, and boba shops put a twist on them that i tend not to favor. the lemongrass beef was marvelous! it really forced me into the present moment because i wanted to cherish the flavor for as long as i could... they put a coconut cream sauce on one of my desserts that reminded me of thai coconut custards that i loved from sunday thai market.... in any case, i recommend you try it !!!
today i tried the vermicelli with bbq pork and pork eggroll. i likes it, but i miss my lemongrass ... i knew id favor the lemongrass , but my leaning towards novelty today got the best of me. next time :)

Fast, delicious food. There's plenty to choose from which may be overwhelming to some people but this was great! Everything we wanted in one place; crawfish, traditional Vietnamese food, boba, and dessert! The workers are great and attentive. The pho was one of the best down here during our visit, that homemade taste and the rest was just as great. Can't say enough good things

I want to move back to Tampa just so I can eat here on a regular basis. My husband and I arrived 30 minutes before closing on a Saturday night, but they were still packed with more people coming through the door. We ordered so. much. food. Probably too much food, but it was totally worth it. We had the vegetarian crispy spring rolls, vegetarian bahn mi, spicy vegetarian noodle soup, and the tofu and spring rolls over rice noodles. Plus two fruit teas and boba, all for the price of $32. We stuffed ourselves silly but it was impossible not to. It was all absurdly delicious. The service was friendly and efficient. Because it was close to closing time I didn't get to check out the market area, but what I could see from my table looked great. We will certainly be back the next time we're in town.

Lots of traffic in this WAwa . Not enough cashiers on at any given time. No gas station. Always well stocked & the milk is always fresh(not like some of the corner stores. Parking can be an issue because  there not enough spaces to accommodate the traffic & pulling out into Richmond street with the bus depot right there tricky. Watch out for the panhandlers & addicts. Hold your purse tightly. Better yet if you can take the 5 minute drive up the the Bridesburg WaWa much safer. This review is more of a 2.5 than a 3

This is a great place for all your alteration and dry cleaning needs.  The owners are thorough, and all my clothes came back better than new.  I talked to the female owner and she is also skilled at making things like pillow covers, dresses, and other sewing things.  A great place and reasonably priced.

We called at 6 AM for a taxi and they told us 20 minutes. 25 minutes went by. We called again. They told us 10 more minutes as they "we're getting taxis on the road." 10 more minutes go by, we call again, and they say there are no taxis in our area. Well we were only on our way to the airport... Thanks United. I'll never forget that name when I need a ride. Skip right over it because, God forbid, you might have to get somewhere.

A true Jakartan food! Bubur ayam FTW and mie ayam jamur! 
It's a place for the x Jakartans to feel at home.

Nice place for lunch in downtown Philadelphia. Indonesian food. We had fried rice special (Nasi) dish and Noodle (Mei) dish. They are very tasty. We also had Satay which was chicken (you can also get it with lamp) on the bbq stick for appetizer with peanut sauce. Price overall was very good too. I would definitely return again if I am in Philly.

I've been coming to Thinh An for at least a year now and all of my experiences here have been nothing short of stellar! 

My most recent experience was when I went here with my boyfriend and my parents. Despite how packed it was on a Sunday around lunch time, we were still able to get a table inside Thinh An. We were able to easily pick what we wanted to order because the menu has a picture of each food item, making it much easier for my indecisive self to pick something! I ended up going with the Vietnamese steamed ground pork rice roll with Vietnamese ham on the side. 

Within 5 minutes, all 4 entrees arrived at our table. To this day, I'm still pleasantly surprised at both how large the entrees are and how quickly they come out to our table! Although I am used to having my rice roll cold, it was served to me warm/hot. Nonetheless, it still tasted wonderful! The Vietnamese ham was temperate, something I was more used to, and it tasted delicious and fresh as well. 

There are so many reasons to love Thinh An, from their customer friendly menus and clean atmosphere, to their quick/friendly service and large and delicious entrees, to the college-student-friendly bang-for-your-buck prices - this place is nothing short of amazing! Definitely give it a shot if you can.

We had a really good experience when we were here.  We would probably say this is our favorite vietnamese restaurant so far here in Tampa.  Being Atlanta Native and Vietnamese myself I would say that the food here was very good and it hits the spot for me when I miss the Vietnamese food from my mom or from Atlanta.  Compared to other Vietnamese restaurants I've been to in Tampa area, this so far is our #1.  If you know other places do recommend, but this so far to us is #1.  

The restaurant is new so my husband and I want to come by and try as we were still in the search for some good Vietnamese food. We think this is it for now. The food was fresh, service was fairly quick, and the taste of our entree met our expectations if not more.  They even have a section to take ready made items.  It reminded me of some of the Vietnamese places I've been to and miss in Atlanta.  So this gets a 5 from me.
My new favorite spot! So glad to have D'jkarta Cafe as a neighbor. Everything I've had here has been amazing and the service is excellent. Well worth the trip if you're not in the neighborhood.

This place gets super busy and for good reason.  I find it best to get here early.  The food is really really good.  My favorite Vietnamese place.  The pho is fantastic.  Everything I've gotten here has been great.   The employees generally run like a fine tunes piece of machinery.  They are friendly and efficient.

The atmosphere here really reminds me of home. I love the idea of incorporating a restaurant, bakery, and boba place together. While the pho is a bit too sweet for my taste, the shrimp spring rolls are pretty good. The workers here and friendly and they have a large drink menu and decent options for tradition asian pastries and sweets. I will be back to try the desserts!
First time here!   Good was flavorful and cooked to perfection.  Lam was our server and he was exceptional.  Offered recommendations and provided great advice on selections.  Will be back
Really great food, at a super affordable price. The service was really fast and friendly too.

Why does this acme have such bad reviews? I think it's great! Well stocked in general and prices are fair enough. People, this isn't Walmart so don't expect super low prices! The convenience in terms of location is great too. Pretty easy to find parking.

Tofu: delicious! Excellent variety and flavor combos. Well priced to be able to sample many kinds. 
Pho: beef pho is hearty and a bit oily and fatty. Delicious but needs lime to cut fattiness. Modest portioning. 
Banh mi: combination banh mi lacks flavor. We tried three kinds and sandwiches were small compared to other comparable restaurants and meat content was even less. Felt like eating bread sandwich with occasional meat surprise. Can improve. 
Thai green tea boba: tastes like an air freshener. Too artificial in taste. Would avoid this flavor. 
Similar restaurants have better bang for your buck.
Great food! I love their Pho and Beef Stew. They also have great fresh spring rolls. It's priced very well and is definitely delicious.

This is by far my favorite place to eat. I recently went there during lunch and was able to buy some of their pastries because they are always out by the time I go for dinner and they are just as amazing as the food and drinks. I will continue making this a weekly meal spot.

Vietnamese food heaven . They have almost every single Vietnamese dishes, desert and drinks here . We tried banh canh , nem nuong , tofu , cha , Che Thai and Banh cuon. Everything tasted good . Very impressed. Great customer service . Definitely will come back when we visit Tampa again .

Surprisingly the food was pretty decent. We ordered the Hue Spicy Noodles (Bun Bo Hue) and BBQ and eggrolls noddles. The other egg noodles soup and other pan fired were not good. The multi color dessert wasn't good. The rice and BBQ was decent. The service was good and fast. Given that this is not in the Vietnam town, this restaurant offers pretty decent food in Tampa. I would recommend it if you are here and want some decent Viet food and just know what to order that's all.

Dr. Barnetts office is extremely mismanaged. The employees are rude and never return a call. When it comes to billing I have always had to contact corporate to get any type of billing issue which is happened more then once resolved. Would not recommend this office to anyone.

We came from Orlando (while on vacation) for the day to check out the Florida Aquarium, and then sought out good Asian food using Yelp, which led us to this out-of-the-way but well worth it spot. I was happy to see the place busy, but we were seated right away by very friendly staff. Our server gave us several good recommendations based on our preferences. We found something for everyone here (including a very picky child) and loved all our food. We had pho, fried rice, egg rolls, and the chicken curry, and really enjoyed everything. The service was very good throughout the entire meal. I wish we lived closer -we would be regulars!

I got takeout from here when I was sick and I was extremely satisfied with my pho. The menu was extensive, my pho was amazing, the prices were very fair, and the serving size was huge! I will definitely be back!
Smaller group today.  Good food, fast service.  The grilled chicken dish was absolutely good.

Why five stars? Because Thinh An Kitchen is the best new restaurant in town, that's why! Sounds like one of Brett's (Tampa CM) reviews. 

Tried Thinh An multiple times now. The food has been consistent all around. The location couldn't be better. Love how clean and modern the place looks. In comparison to other viet restaurants, it's in a class by itself.

Thinh An Kitchen is fairly new so they'll be rough around the edges at times, especially in the service department, The Owners here are terrific people, so I'm confident things will improve. Every new restaurant has to crawl before they walk. 

The meatball pho is probably my favorite dish, it's earthy and hearty. Pastries and noodles are all made in house, get an almond croissant in your way to work and thank me later.
Awesome Colombian fast food very friendly a little expensive but good thing aren't cheap now Day

3 stars for the Bakery service, good customer service over the phone

I ordered a half sheet cake for a birthday. The coloring was great - a vibrant mix of blues, red and yellows. The size and pricing were great for a crowd of 30+ individuals (Half sheet cake ~$28)

The half chocolate and half vanilla with a vanilla buttercreme was not overly sweet, moist and well-received! Unfortunately they do not have any sort of bagging to carry such a large order and only have small grocery bags.

Tips/Takeaways:
-Can take same-day orders of large cakes with proper notice and it was exactly what I imagined I'd be getting for the price I paid and the nature of a sheet-cake for large groups from a Supermarket. Would recommend it again for those looking to feed a lot of people with a cheap cake option!
The pho is amazing, the broth is so flavorful! Staff is always friendly and it's a very clean environment! Love love this place!
Unbelievable! Quick service amazing food and super clean! And did I say cheap! New favorite place

I just completed my Invisalign treatment with Dr. Yanez and the rest of the staff at I.Dentical. I initially chose this practice out of convenience since they're in my neighborhood and a certified Invisalign provider. Over the many times I've visited in the last year, I've really been impressed with the cleanliness of the office, the efficiency of booking and confirming appointments, and how WONDERFUL the staff is. All of the hygienists are an absolute pleasure and make the sometimes stressful experience of going to the dentist much more bearable!

I was very pleased with how upfront the staff was on the details and cost of my Invisalign treatment. There weren't any surprises and I am so pleased with the results! If you are considering Invisalign, I'd highly recommend coming here!

There are only so many words one can use to describe a place they consider their second home. Community, togetherness, love and support - these are things that are never lacking at Crossfit Purgatory. As it is a gym, there is, of course, the overall feeling of 'badassness' and motivation. Walk into this gym during any given class and you will witness people from all backgrounds and all levels of fitness coming together to complete a workout for their respective best times/weights. Each member (and visitor) at CFP is a respected and valuable player and that is never forgotten. 
So, all in all, if you are looking for the PERFECT place to comfortably tackle your fitness goals head on, Crossfit Purgatory is for you! Seriously - as good as it gets!
place is ok i can taste MSG in the foods its ok once in a while but not often The thai tea tons of sugar yaiks

A big thank you to Paul Hinton. Driver Sevices Manager for United Cab!!! We had a little issue & Mr. Hinton took care of it with great professionalism ! We have used United Cab for many years & will continue to do so .

I was there today bought few things in the bakery. Guess WHAT! I bought only few things but my receipt was high. In the receipt had 21 items. But I got home and count only just 17 items:-( I called the this place immediately then a girl answered only said : sorry, do you remembered what did you buy? How the heck would I remember those. I trusted them :-( and they r not even honest to return my money or anything. So I hope anyone if have to go to eat or buy things at this place. Please watching carefully. If not they will take your money under your nose and you don't even realize. That is an very dishonest way to do business. I will never coming back.

Um. HELL YES. This place is dope. 

Came across this place on google and decided to try it out. We are from Chicago and didn't know many places in the area for dinner...DEFINITELY recommend this place. 

We LOVED our waiter. Can't remember his name, but he was super attentive. We ordered the Spring Stash Cheese board to start...holy shit. If you love charcuterie boards, you gotta get something off the cheese menu. One thing we noticed, was they prepare the board with thoughts of how many people there are to share it. We had four people and they prepared ours in a long slate board, while the couple next to ours had a square plate. I mean that's strategy!  

We also got a couple dishes to share because we couldn't decide what we wanted. My favorite was the goat cheese ravioli....omg. My mouth is watering just thinking about it!! I eat ravioli everywhere I go, and this is my new favorite. Definitely have to try along with the collard greens - they were the best I've ever had. 

ALSO- the salmon- idk what they did, but wow. If you like it crispy on the outside and juicy and flavorful on the inside; you gotta order it. 

Not only all this- but the chef also sent out buttered rolls (with some sort of cinnamon butter) and little desert squares out at the the end- free of charge!!

I love this place. Would highly recommend.
Wow. Just go there. I could have ordered dozens of things but I settled in the best meal I've had all year in this amazing place. I will return. Often.

Authentic delicious amazing! So glad to find this hidden gem! Even their table spice condiments are made fresh!! So excited that I'll have a new go-to spot in Philly. We ordered the fried chix with sweet and sour sauce (off the menu), grilled squid, beef randang, and stir fried flat noodle. The rice jelly drink brought back such good memories from my childhood! Will definitely come back again and again!

YUM YUM YUM!! First time visit here. The food was delicious and the service is excellent! 

We started with chicken egg rolls which were thin, crispy and tasty (though I was missing some sort of sauce for dipping). I ordered the Pork and Egg Roll Noodle bowl and my friend had the Chicken Pho. The vegetables and herbs in both our dishes were fresh and aromatic. Both our meals were fantastic. Our meal leftovers were even better the next day after soaking more of the flavor! 

This place is an eat in restaurant but also has a bakery and hot items available to grab and go. After our meals, we both wandered around taking in all the wonderful offerings trying to decide what to indulge in. We both grabbed a few more chicken egg rolls. I bought a chocolate croissant which I ate for breakfast the next day and it turned out to be more delicious than I had expected. My friend took home some of the seasoned tofu and said it was excellent when she reheated it with some sautéed spinach. 

If eating in, the only thing to get used to is the seating. The majority of the inside tables are lined up side by side so you could end up sitting right next to strangers.... I always found that type of seating somewhat awkward. After being sat awhile and ordering though, I no longer felt any awkwardness. My friend loved it!

Service was excellent. Friendly servers!

Overall, we are looking forward to going back here. Delicious!

The food was absolutely Review. Lots of options for vegans, vegetarians, and meat eaters. Everything was delicious. I got the coconut slushie boba, vegetarian spring rolls, and vegetarian pho. It was all so well made and tasty!

Love love love their food. A friend introduced me to this place. We shared the tostones which had shredded beef and chicken on it. Delicious!  Love the sauces; the garlic mayo, you could drink, spicy mayo and parsley mayo are also both delicious. We also shared the beef kabob. It was cooked perfectly; tender and flavorful. Both were too much for us to finish. But we did our best. They don't serve alcohol, but you can go to the little latin market next door and order a beer; just have them put it in a brown paper bag for you.

This place has a large variety of Vietnamese  goods and food as well as sweets such as snow ice and waffles. The atmosphere was nice and service was good as well. I recommend it and will be back soon.
I have to drop by this restaurant for lunch when we are in Tamba, love the variety of Vietnamese food in here !

I have been a member of this gym for a long time, mostly because of the convenience of the location. However, I found out that I've been charged extra fees for a "night owl" account I never signed up for. Apparently, when most people are sleeping, I would have to workout at the gym so not to be charged. Absurd! Not to mention, I was offered to be charged more a month to correct this problem. I will contact their corporate office because I really feel scammed. This gym really has nothing great to offer....don't waste your time or money.

GO HERE NOW! Place is full of Vietnamese goodies ranging from pho to bahn mi to boba, and everything is so delicious! Tried the egg rolls, pho sate, and passionfruit boba tea and scarfed it all down. Will definitely come here again for my Vietnamese fix!
Absolutely love the freshness and quality of the food here. My favorite go to is the Special Vermicelli. I actually eat here at least once every other week!
My husband and I go here once a week for our Pho fix and a pastry to take home.. Love it!!

Was at this restaurant last night. Hostess were sweet however our server was not so friendly. We ordered and I asked if it was to much food and she replied no. None of us had been here so we didn't know what was appropriate to order. Beef Tartare breAd was delicious. Crab bread was soggy and fishy tasting. Crudo was okay. Got sweet potatoes broccoli and cauliflower for side dishes all amazing. Octopus salad again tasted like the sea. Grilled Bronzino, bass and lamb chop all fair. I think this restaurant was fair and not all it is  talked up to be.

My husband and myself have been going to Thinh An Kitchen for sometime. We have always enjoyed the food. Didn't mind small wait times before being served our food and the occasion order mixups. 
However, last evening was the end . Went in, got a sit right away. We ordered right away off the specials menu. It was not long before we got our drinks. Then we waited....and waited....and waited. In the mean time 2 more tables were seated. Pho' I understand is a very quick item was served to the other tables. But when the ordered food came to the other table and we were still waiting. We left.
So if you don't mind the on sometimes / off sometimes food service enjoy. But for us ever again.

If you're looking for the vegetarian items on the menu just keep scrolling. I ordered the veggie meal w/ tofu and veggies. I was surprised that the tofu was fried however is was cooked very well. The rice was tasty however the veggies were odd. By odd I mean you don't get traditional veggies you get a salad. The salad had carrots and also in the box were a few tomatoes and cucumbers. It was strange! The sauce that accompanied the meal was very tasty. Overall I would order this again. They give you a very large portion for a reasonable price. 

4/12- The second time around was even better. I ordered the veggie noodle and an order of egg rolls. I had the order to go so everything was deconstructed. The broth was deliciously flavored. The veggies were broccoli, carrots, scallions, bean sprouts, jalapeños and the rice noodles were perfectly cooked. The tofu was also cooked well and went effortlessly with the soup. Avoid the egg rolls at all cost. The look greasy and tasted like salt, they're totally unpleasant to eat.

We just ate at this restaurant and the food was very good. The atmosphere was great and clean and modern. Prices are very fair for the quality. We immediately recognized waiters and staff from another well-known nearby Vietnamese restaurant (corner of Hillsborough and Sheldon Rd) eating a few tables away. We found that surprising at the time. Then we saw a few very detailed negative reviews of Thinh An pop up on Yelp a couple days later. Hmmm.....my recommendation is to try the place for yourself before believing all of the 2 and 1 star reviews below.

I went to this place with a big group for lunch. I ordered a taro milk slush with popping boba, and spicy beef soup (Bun Bo Hue). My milk slush looks so yummy, but it tastes like water. The beef soup was so spicy that I can barely taste anything. I can tell this place uses the same soup base for all the Pho, Banh Canh, etc. and they just use the powder for different soups. I have high hopes as they are very fancy and they have a section of Vietnamese food inside. Very disappointed.

I ordered take out from the first time here.  I ordered the stir fried flat rice noodles. It comes with fish balls, pork, shrimp and veggies.  When I went to pick it up the employee said I ordered the flat egg noodles but it was incorrect.  She quickly apologized and told me my correct order would be ready in about five minutes.   So I quickly paid and told her I'd be back.  I stepped out to buy myself some dessert from potito's which was half a block down.  I came back and it  we ready.  She apologized again and I was on my way.  I went back to work to eat and it smelled delicious.  It came with a spicy sauce similar to sriracha but not really.  It was like a homemade spicy sauce.   It also came with a little cup of pickled cucumbers.  Not really pickles.  But more so like slightly pickled cucumbers.  The noodles were still piping hot.  I was hungry so went right in.  The food was good.  At first I was a little disappointed that the box wasn't full as some places do.  But it was just enough for me to feel full.  The noodles had a tasty flavor.  The meat and vegetables were good as well.  It came with about two or three pieces of shrimp that were a pretty good size.  The shrimp was also deveined.   I'd like to try the other dishes on the menu next time.  I definitely will be back.  The price is right and the quantity was just right.  Entrees average about 7-8 dollars.

I'll continue going to them because they're the closest cleaners to my apartment, even though they consistently press wrinkles INTO the front of my shirts. They're nice, at least. And relatively cheap.

I found CrossFit Purgatory through a groupon promotion and out of the many businesses I have tried through groupon, they are the only one I have continued to visit. The staff is incredible friendly and helpful, the other gym patrons are welcoming and encouraging (plus everyone is SO FIT, which I find very motivating)!  After a few classes the staff already knew my name and made me feel at home. If you are not in the best shape or not familiar with lifting techniques, don't let that stop you. The staff will make an effort to teach you proper technique while still challenging you to push yourself. I would not have thought there was a gym worth paying so much for, but I have yet to regret it. 
*and if you are a woman I highly recommend Aly's 9:00 Woman's only class. She's awesome*
Fun, informative, and delicious tour of the brewing facilities with Bob (he's awesome - look for him on Saturdays). One of Tampa Bay's finest jewels - we'll definitely be back in the near future.

We arrived during business hours, with plenty of bagels & pastries behind the counter. Three employees were working and we were rudely told "sorry we're not serving anything right now".
What on earth?!
Never going back.

I have tried Vietnamese food for the first time, first of all I wondered if they will have vegeterian food available but when I checked their menu I am surprised to see quite a few vegeterian options no egg as well. I had veggie rolls and spicy vegetable noodle soup. Staff is really good, ambience is neat, reasonable prices for the quantity we get. Thanks to yelp good suggestions again. I am new to the area and I completely relay on yelp and Google reviews. I would definitely recommend this place.

We found ourselves in Tampa after evacuating our home due to Hurricane Matthew.  This was favorably reviewed on Yelp so we gave it a try.  I have eaten at many, many Vietnamese restaurants all over the country and this one is up there with the best!  The food was terrific as well as the service.  It was so good we went back the following day!  We had a variety of different things and loved it all.
Nice food, clean restaurant! We kept going back to this resto. for obviously this good review from us

One of my favorite restaurants in tampa! Huge portions for the price. The pho bowls are excellent and the milk teas are legit! I personally love to order the tofu bahn mi sandwich and the avocado smoothie with boba. I'm a vegetarian and there are many good options. I highly recommend!!

Love this place! My boyfriend and I both had done a bit of CrossFit  training before but definitely enjoy the "gym" atmosphere where you can vibe off everyone's energy. We decided to jump on a deal with CrossFit Purgatory and I'm so glad we did. 

The members are friendly and welcoming, the gym is huge so there's room to move, and the instructors are great. It's hard in some large classes to keep the class moving but to also help with beginners, but they're great with that. There's always beginners in the classes and the instructors take their time to work with you. 

It's always nerve-racking to try a new place, especially if you're a beginner. Don't let fear get in the way of changing your life! CrossFit will change you for the better. I have done the typical gym, the running, the eating right, but never ever have I seen the results that CrossFit will provide. THE FIRST STEP IS WALKING THROUGH THE DOOR. Now do it.

I used to come here for lunch all the time when I worked in Jenkintown. Great food and a chill environment. I hear that they are now mostly focusing on their catering business.

Excellent and healthy food!

The foods, the services, and the environment are good for me.
Since this is their first week to open business please be consider to wait little bit longer. I believe this matter will be resolve soon.

If you want to taste an Indonesian Cuisine please consider this place.

This place is ALWAYS busy- which is good sign that they really know what is going on. Polite and fast service, a clean hip setting, a market/to-go section, boba bar, outdoor seating and above, tasty food at a great price- Thinh An Kitchen is THE place for Vietnamese food in Tampa bay.

They recently redid their menu, my personal favorite- the Thinh An Special Rice Noodle Bowl increased by 50 cents to 10$. To be honest, I'd be willing to pay more for this bowl of rice noodles, fresh veg, grilled pork, fried tofu, and shrimp which is probably bigger than my head. If you're a first time visitor, you definitely can't go wrong. The old menus which were massive text walls have been improved with page/sections which even have pictures of each menu item, which can make it much easier to explore new menu items which you otherwise might not be curious enough to order. 

The classic Viet rice paper spring rolls can be a little over-priced, but are definitely worth a try first time. The relatively bang-for-buck of the various snacks, drinks and other items in the to-go area can vary- so do some research against other restaurants to figure out the best deal. Usually Thinh An comes out on top, so I don't usually hesitate as it's almost always a good deal. The hot food in the to-go bar features crispy mung bean sesame balls, house-made Vietnamese sausages, various pastries and toasts, and as the name implies- at least 5-6 varieties of tofu from traditional to lemongrass. Cold platters inspiried by main dishes on the menu can also be found to-go.

The noodle soup- classic Vietnamese beef broth noodles served with lime, beansprouts, basil, mint and chilis, seem to sometimes have some MSG and leave you drinking water for the rest of the night, but usually this isn't an issue. Since it's so hot outside, their best sellers are usually the dry rice noodle bowls, Banh Mi (amazing sandwiches for only $3.50!!!!), and other platters.

Parking out front is limited, especially since the neighboring pawn shop is unwilling to share any more. Try parking around the side or even the back if there aren't any spots left

I've brought some Vietnamese friends here, and they all gave the ok on decent restaurant authenticity and even took food back home with them. I can verify that their to-go food holds up even after a 5 hour bus ride!

This place has relatively early closing hours for such a popular place. Around lunch-time there is high traffic for to-go plates, and at meal times expect almost every table to be full. The food comes out quick as they have a good kitchen system, and waiters bring a payment machine directly to your table. 

Delicious and affordable food, a clean and efficient dining experience make this place a 5 star restaurant even on a bad day. Excited to see what Thinh An is going to bring us in the future!

I took my families at this restaurant here last Sunday. The waiter took our order, everything seem ok when the food arrived, but one thing it disappointed me is my food I order , the shrimps is uncook , the shrimp taste weird that when I notice something wrong so I asked my wife to check it out ,she notice rights away the shrimps is uncook. I told the waiter and he went and tell the owner but the owner didn't bother to come down and talk to me. Man I was pissed up but when I went and paid my bill and got a chance to talk to the owner. Him(owner) didn't seem to cared what I was complaining and said opposite what I told him. If him(owner) was nice enough to take the blame I wouldn't wasted my Damm time to write all the negative things about the place but he such an as-hole but they give me no choice but I have to write all this negative review for them. Once against if you or any one going here for eat in-out just check the food before you eat otherwise you will end up pissed up like me.

I've had nothing but positive experiences with United Cab.  I only have used them to get me to and from the airport and naturally we have no issues getting a cab after our flight lands.   But on the pick up to our home they are great about communicating the status via text just to give me confidence they have not forgotten the appointment.  And thus far they have always been on time give or take 1 or 2 minutes (usually early).   The drivers are open to us guiding them on our preferred routes which I like.  In other cities I've been lectured by cab drivers and while I respect that they often know better, that is not always the case.  So it is nice to have a short conversation on our preferred route.

Cost is pretty much the same each time (about $30 with tip) from South Tampa so we know going in what it will cost.   Overall, a solid recommendation.

Thinh an Kitchen is a great place for Vietnamese food. In my opinion, their pho is as delicious as other Viet restaurants in the city. I particularly enjoyed rice vermicelli, banh min, and of course they're different beef and chicken pho soup. Additionally, the place also includes a nice bakery where you can grab items in small or large quantities and it also has a boba bar! Now their boba selection is somewhat limited, but you gotta give props for having this and a bakery in one restaurant. As for the environment itself, the place has always been clean and presentable whenever I visited and they even updated their outside tabling last I went. I give Thinh An Kitchen a thumbs up. If you're in the area and enjoy Vietnamese food, try this place out.

Who are you trying to kid, Yelp?  The one review out of 13 that's positive, is the one that doesn't get filtered? Give me a break!

I took a United Cab from the Cruise port to Citrus Park, a trip that has always been $35, but this time it was $ 50.  The driver was confused (?) on the Veterans Expressway, and actually got off instead of staying on to the exit.  By getting off, he had to swing out to the west, and added miles and dollars to the trip. 

Add my voice to the other reviewers who have been ripped off by United Cab drivers.  If there is a lineup of drivers at the airport or cruise terminal, I won't be taking a United Cab. Maybe if enough people refuse to patronize this company, they will clean up their act.

So good! I got the mushroom noodle and there were so many ingredients. I was so hungry and it was so good, I forgot to take a picture :)

Great price too, it reminds me of Sky Cafe that had to move to Washington Ave after a fire, but now I've found another Indonesian spot close by with the same quality food, so excited!

Avoid this company if possible.  Took a United Cab taxi form the airport to downtown early last month, $26 plus $3 tip, total $29.  The vehicle has an electronic POS credit card reading machine, which was great.  A week later, I took another United Cab taxi from downtown to the airport, this time the vehicle didn't have an electronic POS machine, it is the decades old manual machine, $29 again, charged to credit card the next day, was fine.  

NOW a week later, my credit card was charged another $29 by a company called "ADDIS LIMOUSINE AND CAR".  On that day, I was in Phoenix, thousands miles away!!  Seems reviews from other sources mentioned same trick was done by this company.  They use another company's name to charge you the same amount of your last taxi amount a week later, and hope you do not check your bill or you do not notice that.  I understand maybe most people would just briefly look through your statements and do not pay attentoin for repeating/similar/small charges.  WOW, that's how they get your money!

This is actually a great spot to eat. They have a lot of options to choose from with many Viet dishes. While you're waiting, they have other to go foods that are available to purchase. We ordered some bo kho, pho, and one if their banh mis. Overall it was good. There was a situation where I found something in the food but the way they handle the situation was phenomenal. They try to accommodate in any means possible and took it off the bill. The pho wasn't bad and the portions were great. I also ordered some egg rolls. As a Viet person, I expected the nuoc mam sauce to be better and the flavor more enhance. Smoothies are great I loved the durian smoothie wasn't too strong but it was just right.

This is definitely one of the best Vietnamese restaurants I have been to even compared to those that I have tried in California. The short ribs (with rice) was really well marinated and full of the soya, savory and meaty flavor. The lotus salad with shrimp and pork was a huge delicious surprise. We loved the combination of the sweet and saltiness but highly refreshing salad. The only thing was that the salad was HUGE. We had to leave half uneaten so we could eat our short rib and rice. I wish there was a smaller version.

I was so excited at first to try this restaurant. My best friend bought me a giftcard to this restaurant for my birthday. Thinh An is not near by my house. There is not an expiration date on the giftcard. On September 9, 2018 around 8pm, I went there and the guy cashier tells me that my giftcard has been declined. I was like "what?" I was embarrassed and it didn't make things better when the other female cashiers and wait staff are making fun of me and laughing at me. I was like "How could that be? My best friend bought it for me for my birthday!" He seemed questionable. I said, "It was a year and a half ago!" He said, "Oh within a year, our giftcard expires!" I was like, "well, you guys should add that expiration date onto your giftcard because I highly doubt it that anyone bothered to tell my best friend!" I think that the guy cashier or someone should have honored my giftcard. So they didn't so I highly advise for any future customers to not buy their giftcard. The banh mi was okay. The taro slush was gross! Even with less sugar it isn't supposed to taste like that! The Vietnamese iced coffee needs to be without ice because I get it with a bit of condensed milk but that didn't taste right either. I had a very bad experience and I don't advise anyone to drink or buy their giftcard! It took me over a hour to get to that restaurant and I had to pay!

I went in during my lunch hour for a gel mani...  was asked my Cecelia to pick my color, I picked pretty quick because as I mentioned, I was on lunch. She stood in the corner of the room whispering with a coworker and reading a long stream of texts on her friends phone while I just stood there....waiting. Sat down and she talked to her coworker and her client pretty much the entire time. I was so not satisfied with how my nails turned out. She did not make nails the same shape, she painted all over my skin and seemed to miss the nails completly. She painted very blotchie and I left with what looked like an already 3 wk old manicure. Now, I never ever complain but I felt I had to since I was charged 40 bucks plus a tip for a manicure, I called and spoke with a "manager"  and with out giving names, I told her I was not happy with the result. She pretty much dismissed me and basically blamed the awful mani on me. This was the 1st and definitely last time I will go there for anything at all!!

One of my favorite places to go in Fairmount. It's casual but still nice. It's cozy, comfortable and always a relaxed setting. I love the boards that they have available and don't eat meat so there are always solid veggie options. Their wine on draft is my favorite but their beers are also great. They also have open air so when the weather is nice, it's perfect.

Wow!! Definitely one of the top Vietnamese restaurants in Tampa. We had the spring rolls, egg rolls,  Pho Tai (number 14) and it was all very good. Their service was very quick. Everyone was very friendly. Very affordable. Can't wait to come back and try a smoothie and dessert (big selections).

Hey - it's a Wawa and was there when we needed it.
Cigarettes, bottled water and wait - Girl Scout Cookies?  Sold out of somebody's trunk in the parking lot.
And the DO have a parking lot.

Yay Wawa.
Long wait even for the appetizers. I came again because the food taste good, but the wait is ridiculous especially it's not even that busy. I'm not sure if I will come back

I am so happy I made it to this place. Food is great, space is beautiful and price affordable. I told the server this was my time trying Indonesian food and she was very excited about that. To drink: I tried the Es Cendol (made out of green rice flour jelly); I feel that this is more of an acquired test still I'm glad I got to experience this interesting flavor. My entree was a noodle dish: Bakmi Ayam Jamur. The taste was delicious, great balance on flavors and very fresh. If you are familiar with Thai and Malaysian food, then you might agree with me that this is something in between. Therefore, a great opportunity. IMPORTANT: bring cash, they don't take cards. You can easily get a nice meal for less than 10 dollars.
This is my favorite spot for Vietnamese food in Tampa. The bakery and Boba Tea/smoothie bar is also top notch! Quick and friendly service. It can get pretty busy, but it's worth the wait.

It is one of the wort cab service I have ever had. There has been times when I have been waiting for 2 hrs after calling 3 times. The charges are crazy high. I went to the DMV which is around 7 miles and had to pay $30 on one trip.

I had lived in Tampa for a few months for work and always felt so homesick of the east coast because of my love for Asian food and culture. Pho is one of my favorite comfort foods, and it's something that makes my weekends feel complete. 

I found this restaurant off of yelp and it brought be a little piece of home. The restaurant itself looks a little skeptical from the outside but it on the inside it is a clean and well put together restaurant and ready-made foods venue. The ready made foods had some items from the menu like spring rolls, but also had a variety of different fried tofus. I love the lemongrass one. The ones here were amazing but they fit the bill ( they weren't juicy in the inside and had been sitting for a while). 

The restaurant however was pleasant. My friend and I sat down to eat and ordered 1 pho,  1 vermicelli bowl, and some summer rolls. Everything was honestly delicious. The vermicelli especially. I was so surprised that the meats were marinated so authentically and then grilled to perfection with the slightly charred taste. The shrimp I have to say has that perfect texture and we're not rubbery. 

The pho broth was a little on the light side for me but there was so much meat in the bowl that it filled our hearts and tummy's to the top!

The only slight disappointment was the iced coffee because we had to ask for it twice and it was served in a plastic boba like cup with a sealed top versus in a glass which I would have preferred. It was also a little bit sweet. 

Overall, would recommend and go again if I was in the area.

Great pho! Very extensive menu. Haven't had a bad 
meal in the three years we've been going. They also have on display a variety of small baked goods that can be purchased if you're on the road.

Love this place!!

Pros: my new favorite Vietnamese restaurant, clean, cute ambience, great variety of food selections to eat I or take out, good pricing, very tasty sandwiches ( and they are NOT stingy with their meats either), tech forward- even with Apple Pay, soup - even vegan was so good, appetizers-yum, friendly owner and staff.

Definitely a great place for Vietnamese food and we are coming back this upcoming weekend.

Cons: wish it was closer to where I live. 
Saigon deli was a go to place but it has nothing in comparison to this place.. this one hands down!!

I love going to places like this with good food but not having to pay a lot for it. 

I ordered Nasi ayam bakar - grilled chicken dish with a lot of extra sides that came with it, along with a soup.  The chicken flavors were good and it was nice and moist.  It had too many bones to my liking.  The sides were interesting, some which I couldn't identirfy... but included fried tofu (which i really liked), liver which was tasty but not my favorite texture, some veggies which helped to add some crunch
My friend ordered a noodles dish and i'm not really a noodles person but i think if i were to go back, that's what I would get.
Best noodle soup I have ever had.  I always get the #30 and I add Beef Tendon.  I have had Pho in so many cities but you guys are hands down the best!!!!!!

Discovered this place while staying in Tampa near the airport. I am a big fan of noodle soup or as the comment known is Pho for the Vietnamese version. Being raised on it and is a common staple in Southeast Asia with different variations in the region. This soup is amazing and probably the closest thing to what I grew up and mom used to make. I am not a big fan of the Vietnamese version as they have tend to put herbs that give it a different flavor and smell. I have grown accustomed to this now. I pretty much order the same thing here and it's been consistent each time. The herbs and the bean sprouts are fresh and crisp. Bean sprouts has tendency to get soggy if it's not fresh. The place is usually full when I arrive and the service has always been spot on. They have a smoothie bar for Asian drinks such as bobo tea and the like and it's made fresh. They do offer carryout and have a small buffet of Southeast Asia you can carryout. The food is fresh and maintained. It's not a traditional buffet you would take it to sit at your table but mainly to take home with you. Please check this place out it's clean and you won't be disappointed.

Solid grocery store that knows where it's positioned in the market. The food is reasonably priced and the packaged goods are always solid. If you're looking to buy staple foods and support a reasonable grocery budget this is a good place for you. The cashiers are typically pretty friendly and I'm a fan that they don't push for a rewards card at this supermarket and make their deals available to anyone shopping there.

Called at 430 in NYE to get a cab for 745 the operator told me they were not taking call aheads...called again at 7 the operator said that can would be here in 20/30 min called when the cab didn't show 30 min later and the phone rang busy. Finally I got an answer the operator said that no one responded to our call, operator then said she would call back. We missed our reservation and ended up driving ourselves. Would not use them in the future

One thing I love about this place is that they are very very fast. Our food came out with in minutes.  I had the combination broken rice and my wife had BBH both very good but not the best we've had. For the price it's worth a stop in.  The BBH was not as hot as we would like a soup. And the beef rib could have ad more flavor. That's the difference between a 4 and a 5 star in my book.  I also too Home two banh mi and they are out of this world and at 3.50 that's a steal.
Fast service, number 13 is always good. The sandwiches and bubble tea are always a good selection! Best pho place in Tampa hands down.

I wish I could give them negative stars! This company is horrible! I call for cabs quite a bit and unfortunately this is the cab company that's contracted, so we have to use them. People wait for HOURS!!!! Do yourself a favor and walk before calling them!

I go here only for really expensive items as I feel like they are a bit more professional than some other locations although their prices are really outrageous.  They charge so much for simple dry cleaning services and hemming the dress of a coton sundress.  They are not a regular vendor for me.

I was in search of a new dentist that was professional, had a nice and professional staff as well as up-to-date equipment and a clean office and I found Dr. Yanez. I called on Tuesday and was able to come in for a consultation on Thursday which is today. I was very comfortable with the staff and the cleanliness of the office. I consulted with Dr. Yanez and I told him all my concerns and a dental plan was made and I was able to get my first service today which was a cleaning. The hygienist was very professional and warned me ahead of time about the pressure and that she had to do some digging to remove some tartar, I didn't flinch at all as she cleaned my teeth. I felt a slight sensitivity but I was able to handle it. After all was done I scheduled my next appointment and a six month check-up and cleaning. I have several more services I need to get done and I look forward to it. I'll up date this review if anything changes during that time but if not I'll wait until all my major procedures are done and then give my over all opinion but for now Dr. Yanez and his staff get 5 stars.

I've always seen Wawa stores in NJ & PA, and I know people who love them. My first experience with them leads me to understand why some friends like this store so much. They have some great, cheap junk food--specifically their milk shakes.
They have a bunch of different ice cream flavors (cookies & cream, Reese's, mint chip, etc), and the two I tasted were both really good. I only wish I was able to mix a few flavors together. If I could do that I'd probably stop by every time I see one to make a different creation.

Please please do not ever use this company. There are plenty more cabs that are pleasent. I took a cab home, well attempted to. This cab driver tried to tell me i didnt know where i live and that it would be 40$ for my ride when it has never cost more thatn 11$, to make it worse the driver demanded i give him 20$ jsut until wie reach my house, wheni said no and i only had my debit card he made me exit the cab in the middel or 7tha nd nebraska. This is not the intersection you as a female alone woudl be dropped off at. I have tried to contact Paul who overseass the drivers but he hasnt responded to any of my calls fromt he past month

I wish this place was located in Orlando. It was beyond good! 

    As soon as you go in you see the pre-prepared food which look delicious and well priced. We were seated and received our drinks quickly.  We ordeted our food and went over to the other side to see the offerings.  I literally wanted to buy everything and take it to the hotel.  Just thinking about it makes me sad that I'm so far away. 

   Our food was brought out by such a nice man.  He explained to us how to eat some of the items which was very helpful.  I was surprised at the amount of food our plates brought and the price.  Wow!  Everything tasted amazing and fresh. The shrimp and meats were so well seasoned.  My sisters ribs were delicious and she loved ever aspect of her plate.  My noodles were superb. Craving this right now! We ended up eating everything in our plate. 

  For dessert we ordered the egg puff with green tea ice cream.  It was the best eggpuff I tasted. Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.  The sweetness complemented the green tea ice cream very well and the strawberries.  

  The service was great and everything in the menu seems to be less than $10. The food is fresh and doesn't fall to heavy on the stomach.

Fast service ! Very good food and reasonable price ! Friendly staff. This is the best pho I have so far on my vacation to Florida ! Parking was a little complicated but the wait for a table was super fast! Super clean restaurant!
Very good food and very decently priced. Happy mango is very refreshing. Pefect for shot American day. Or any day really. I'd highly recommend it.

Entering into Thinh An is like entering candyland. Except better, because in addition to sweets is all of your favorite Vietnamese food too!

My sister took me here while a friend of hers and I were visiting. He's Vietnamese and not gonna lie, Tampa is not what comes to mind first when either of us thought about diversity. So Thinh An was my sister's answer to our skepticism.

Dropping in on a Friday evening, there was a wait-- always a pain yet a good sign of the food to come. Plus, having a wait gives you an excuse to peruse the store section. My sister's friend was able to tell us all about the different foods for sale there and was super impressed by the authenticity. Meanwhile, I was impressed by the fried tofu (get the lemongrass one!), which I munched on as a pre-dinner snack.

When we were finally seated, we ordered A TON. We got the wings with fish sauce, the papaya salad, and the shrimp and pork crispy pancake to start. They were all delicious, with my favorite being the wings. For my main, I got two: the special banh mi and the udon soup. Yes, I am a little bit insane...

I didn't know before this evening that there is a special type of Vietnamese udon, but it was delicious. I feel like its not something I normally see at a lot of Vietnamese restaurants, so I would recommend trying it for something a little different. The banh mi was amazing as well-- the bread was perfect and the sandwich definitely rated in my top 3 of all time.

Service is a bit slow and it can be difficult to get the waiters attention. They also forgot to bring my hot tea and I had to remind them. However, for the price and authenticity, you can't beat it.

Never been this happy for having lunch in Philadelphia! This restaurant is amazing! I really like the Ayam Bakar. It's really Surabaya grill style, which I missed a lot  I also ordered Bakso Super. It is very tasty and also I really like the egg inside the meat. The soup is very tasty but I don't really agree to have cabbage to replace the lettuce (as in the original bakso). Nevertheless, I was just so happy with Ayam Bakar. The sambal is very East Java hot style! Sure thing to revisit this place in the next trip to PA!
Everything was absolutely delicious and fresh! The udon soup and fried rice were amazing! I live almost 12 miles away  but it doesn't matter; I would travel to go back again.
Excellent food. Large portions. Only thing negative was they wouldn't substitute spring roll for fried egg roll.

This was my first stop in Philly on a warm summer's day and it was a hit with us. The spring rolls and sweet & sour squid was incredible and fresh. Noodles, noodles, noodles! I loved the noodles. Service with a smile. This place is worth a checkout!

We've had this place twice and I LOVE IT. 

First time, we dined in. The interior is clean, bright and smells wonderful. There is a bakery/shop on the left side, with some amazing quick grab items. The dining room is bustling and our server was really great.

The second time, we ordered pick up and it was ready very quickly, all items accounted for and was a great option for us on a busy night.

We have had Pho, nooodle dishes, rolls, the waffle dessert, the Durian dessert. My absolute favorite item so far is the Quang Style Yellow Noodles. It is filled with Turmeric and the flavor is out of this world! Do yourself a favor and head over to this wonderful establishment.

This place gets compared to Saigon Deli a lot, which has nothing to be ashamed of...and amazing as their food is, Thinh An does everything a wee bit better in my opinion!

To start, the decor is modern and inviting. When you walk in, you are greeted by a server or host to seat you (both inside and covered patio options). The menu is fairly large and complex compared to most Vietnamese restaurants I have been to- something for everyone, surely. The pho is wonderful and more "involved" than that other place down the road. The banh mi has all the right things going on with it. Plus, there is a bakery inside the restaurant for little goodies to take home- if you wish.

Simply put, there is a lot to love about Thinh An. Personally, I've loved it 3 times in the month since discovering it existed!

Finally found my favorite pho in Tampa. Also the vermicelli noodles with lemon grass chicken is SOOO good. Got both with two order of spring rolls and two matcha teas with boba for $32. You really can't beat that! Also the pastries looked phenomenal. This will be a weekly spot for me

You want food?  You don't care about a parking impossible experience?  You don't want to have to pay something for nothing?  You don't really care about "nice" appearances?  You kind of prefer it if you're more or less the only European in the place? 

You love the taste of charred wok on your flat rice noodles? 

You sometimes fantasize about being in the world of blade runner?

Your not actually on Java.

You want to be here - D'Jakarta.  

You will not be disappointed.

Thank me later.

This is my second time here. I've had the kabobs, empanadas and tostones all the way and the food is delish! Portions and price are good. My boyfriend and I love coming here, especially those late night cravings. They are open late on weekends.

Super clean and cozy restaurant located in a pretty residential area of Philly. Street is a pain, but still worth the visit! 

The prices are fair for what they offer here. All the dishes are flavorful, homey and filling. Although their side dishes and starters are on the smaller side, the main rice/noodle dishes are just enough. 

I highly recommend the beef rendeng rice dish! Beef is soft and all the other components pair perfectly with rice as it's so packed with flavor and spices.

I went here recently to grab some pho. The pho was great as usual but the service was HORRIBLE. We got seated immediately but waited 15 minutes until someone came and took our order. We even had to ASK for a waiter since we didn't even get waters or was acknowledged until I said something. Most of the waitresses pass by you like they didn't see you and clean a table instead of waiting on you. I've never had a to write a review because most places I've been to had okay service. But this needed to be said. Upon ordering boba, they have many variations of "boba." I have had boba for years and know what a good boba tastes like and this was the WORST boba I've ever had. When I asked to exchange it for a different one, I was given an attitude and a long lesson on the difference between a smoothie and a milk slush. I didn't even want the boba afterwards because of the poor misunderstanding. Overall, if you want good service and good food... just order take-out.
Greta food, Greta flavor, great atmosphere! Love it here! Been here several times and it never disappoints. I enjoy Vietnamese food but this place is one of the best so far.

Great place for vietnamese food, everything is good!  Huge menu but also whole section of ready made, ready to eat pastries.  On our latest trip we got the Bun Bo Hue and Mi Quang.  Both are noodle soups.   Bun bo hue had better tasting broth and was actually less spicy.  Both with plenty of meat and veggies.  If you're not into soups, then you can't go wrong with any of the broken rice dishes, my go to is the #63, it's a good combo dish with a variety of meats, I've had this many times before and it's always good.  
The vietnamese sandwiches are what they absolutely should be, delicious, stuffed with meat and veggies, and incredibly cheap (only $3.50!, so much cheaper than most other places in Tampa) 
I also love getting snacks from the pastry side, my two favorites are the Banh Tieu and the Croissants.  Banh Tieu is slightly sweet, puffy, hallow donut that is deep fried but not a oily or sweet as a regular donut.  Croissants has meat inside and is awesome for breakfast the next day.

I purchased a car from them years ago, in 2009. After purchase I ended up getting my car serviced with another Nissan dealership because Chapman was messy and had no waits for service. I traded in the car in 2016, today I received a call from Chapman's service department wanting to know why the car was towed there. I explained to them that I traded the car in and explained when they wanted to know exact details when I refused to provide the information because I felt like they should have the contact information of the person that had the car towed there, the service person Mike was rude and began to talk down to me as if I couldn't comprehend. I explained to him that he would need to contact the company that towed the car in because the vehicle was no longer mine and he disconnected the call.

The setup of place is nice. Food is reasonably priced, seating is comfortable.  While sit down dining, you have view of the bubble tea/drink bar and the deli part of the store.  My only real complaint is not being able to access the restroom at times- it's because you need a key from the front. It's only one person per restroom at a time for a restaurant of this size. Thus, it becomes a bit chaotic when multiple people line up to use the restroom at any given moment, especially when they're busy up front, and kitchen staff also needs to use the restrooms along with the customers, that someone has the restroom key somewhere. But I'm sure they will figure out a solution for the restroom access to keep the customers happy.
 But overall, everything else is pretty good- food, pricing, atmosphere, service, location for a decent dining experience.
They have improved with their services ever since I made the last review. Their food is still pretty yummy!!! Try their veggie fried rice-you won't get disappointed!!

Wow food here is amazing! Place is nice, clean,  and well decorated.  I highly recommend this place for an authentic Indonesian dishes. Grilled chicken, stir fry noodles, meatball soup, satay, and happy mango are my go to meal here. Yummm

Best Vietnamese food in Tampa. Service is good. They also have a little market of fresh bakery products as well as a bunch of other homemade goodies. Can get a little crowded because the food is exceptional. They also have bobo tea, shakes, coffees and other custom fresh drinks.
They have a good selections and food was really good. They also have have fruit drink, love the coconut juice

The prices are great, the restaurant is contemporary, clean and the food is great. You can buy food in a buffet area, such as bread, chicken, spring rolls and more. They offer Bahn mi, boba, pho and other Vietnamese cuisine. The food and atmosphere are really great and everyone is really friendly there. The only downfall is that it is so good, sometimes it is hard to get a parking space if you are not early during the lunch rush.

So glad bf goes to school in Tampa Thinh An is on his way home and we get food from here often. Some things are better than others but all in all their pho and other noodle dishes are amazing. I'd recommend calling ahead your order, it's not uncommon to see the line out the door. Definitely check out all their baked goodies.

In the west side of Tampa, no restaurant has pho or Vietnamese dishes as good as Thinh An. Maybe Saigon Deli comes close but they're more central Tampa.

I work nearby, they have a ton of vegan/vegetarian options. There's an entire menu dedicated to Tofu centric dishes. Their boba tea and slushes are non-dairy (as long as you ask for the non-dairy versions).

I love spicy Asian food and they have great Bun Hoe (spicy pho) and lots of good options. If you want baked goods and pastries they have a large market - granted that I can't eat most of it since I eat veg foods, but I can see people who would enjoy it.

The grilled beef was Delicious. I actually went in with low expectations because food trucks tend to let me down sometimes, and wow, this place surprised me. The meat was very tender and flavorful, the plate came with roasted potatoes, a small arepa with cheese and a salad. Everything was very tasty. I definitely give this place 2 thumbs up.

This Vietnamese restaurant is beyond delicious with excellent service. The food always comes out fresh and very fast. Their tofu is some of the best tofu you can find and I think anyone would thoroughly enjoy it (even people who are usually not fans of tofu). Their boba is also incredible. Literally nothing I have tried here has been bad and everyone I've taken here has ever had any complaints!
Friendly service, convenient location , and a ton of equipment for whatever you need.

Great diner with a large menu. It is always crowded but the line moves quickly. Never had a bad meal and the bakery is also very good. Cash only is the only downside, ATM on location. Also has liquor!

Really nice area with super helpful staff! I went in here with my parents and sister whole visiting from Northern Virginia, and the staff were super friendly in assisting with my moms orders, and giving me recommendations on what bubble teas to get.

Be aware that this place does have a $5 credit card minimum!

I got the strawberry tea with lychee poppers and crystal boba... OMG so good!!!!!

This is a great Vietnamese restaurant! The prices are reasonable and the portions are great. They always seem to be busy.

I mainly come here for their tofu. The spicy lemongrass and mushroom ones are my favorite. The Banh Mi is amazing as well; the veggies are super fresh. I'm already looking forward to my next visit.

Best bahn mi in Tampa. MUST TRY YOUR BAHN MI WITH a FRIEd EGG**

Great prices. 
food comes out faster than a fat kid chasing an ice cream truck.
