One of the cleanest Vietnamese restaurants. You can eat your pho in peace with out swatting flies in between bites.

What is there not to like? Omg the Pho is phenomenal, I visited this place just for the phó but needed up eating a whole buffet. The food was extraordinary in taste and the textures were exquisite. 

Starting with rice sheet egg rolls, perfectly balanced with peanut sauce. Then we tried their tofu and I must say the mushroom was my favorite. Also, you get 4 tofu blocks for $1 can't beat that! Then the amazing phó with all the meats, the broth was perfect and so was the seasoning. The bowl size was pretty big and it may be much for one person, but I definitely devoured it.

The wait time to get into the restaurant was about 15 minutes after waiting 10 minutes to have someone assist us. Restaurant is pretty busy, and after we were seated it took 15 more minutes to have someone approach our table. Food was out fast but the waitress was nowhere to be found until check came by. Although, I thoroughly loved the food, this restaurant is a bit chaotic. Too much going on at once and no one to assist when you need to ask a question.

Awesome food and awesome service! Their menu is extensive and everything I've tried is delicious. My go to is pho tai or #30 and #31 when I'm in the mood for something spicy. Also love that they have egg noodle options!

Where do I start. I placed an order online and was provided a time when my food would be ready. I arrived and the parking lot was a disaster. There is not nearly enough parking for the number of table they have.  Inside was chaos.  People everywhere and barely a way to get to a counter and no distinguishable line. I finally work my way to the back counter and asked if I was in the right place for pick up and the girl said "You'll need to wait."  She didn't even answer my question. So I wait and wait and finally the other girl spoke to me. I gave them my order number and name, and low and behold it wasn't ready, so I got to wait even longer. 

As I stood there waiting I got to witness the completely unsanitary handling of the food.  The girls wore no gloves, and yet every container that came out they opened to check inside and if food was hanging out they used their bare hands to push it in the container better!  Of course they are touching all kinds of other surfaces in between and their computer.  

Fifteen minutes later my food was finally ready.  Took it home.  I order the chicken pho. The broth and sprouts were good but the shredded chicken managed to to be tough and dry, which seems impossible given it's in soup.  I also ordered a spicy vegetarian soup, and it was good.  The pork egg rolls were excellent.

But here is where things got really bad. Apparently their website is not fully secure, so within a few hours of placing my order online, my email got registered for nearly 75 websites and newsletter subscriptions! And my address and email was used to try and order building supplies.  This is no coincidence since that was literally the only thing I had used that card or email for in about a week.  

So, my advice.  If you dare brave the place to order the fairly good food, that is hand touched by various staff, do not order online for pickup, using your email or credit card.

Sensational and authentic Vietnamese food!!
This is a terrific Vietnamese restaurant, bakery and market.  The staff and a lot of the customers are Asian/Vietnamese which is always a good sign.  We ordered a bun rieu (tomato crab noodle soup) and a deluxe fried rice and they were were amazing and there was so much that we had to take half of the fried rice home.  As for the fried tofu, my husband is a white guy who doesn't eat tofu and he just loved it - it was so fresh, almost creamy and perfectly seasoned!!  The service is really good and fast and the prices are very reasonable.

This place caught me off guard. Their menu is enormous so you're bound to find something you'll like. The prices are extremely fair and I felt like I got my moneys worth. The food was very good. I ordered the banh xeo which is extremely hard to find and it was wonderful. I will definitely be a regular. My boyfriend ordered a noodle dish and he loved it.
Amazing food at absurdly affordable prices. One of the best values in town. Try this place, you won't be disappointed

Love love love the water ice and gelati here. The staff is usually friendly and are quick to get the lines down. It's a plus that they have a pretzel factory in the same strip mall so you can have pretzels too

Came here for the first time and it has become my No.1 pho place of all time. Delicious pho, yummy and fully stuffed spring rolls, clean place, lots of options on the menu, sweet staffs, and ready to eat food to bring home for later. Love love love love it!

Place is clean and the wait is short (reason for two stars). However, the staff was impolite as they went from doing my nails to taking care of someone else for 10 minutes then back to my nails again. They also rushed, which you can tell by looking at my nails, when there was no need to as there was no one waiting. They do not have a student discount like other places in the area, so not that convenient either. Forgot to add that when I got there the guy kept trying to pressure me into getting gel instead of regular polish, three times to be exact. Then, when I sat down with the lady she asked why I wasn't doing gel....

Definitely recommend people to eat here. The food is delicious, cheap, and large portions. There is also a large selection of food and desserts which is a plus. The crytal jelly boba with avocado smoothie was crazy good. Money well spent.
I love this place! It has good foods, variety of teas and drinks as well as bakery! They are friendly too.

We have had lunch here several times and enjoyed each visit. The service is friendly and quick. The decor is clean and modern, if a little spare. The Pho is always delicious. The pork bun is large, fresh and plentiful. I wish it was closer to South Tampa.

Love love love love love this place! I've been coming here since they opened and have never had any complaints! The food is always so delicious. No matter what I try on the menu I'm always blown away. The service is great! They have a little to-go area where you can buy authentic Vietnamese goodies to take home. Just love this place. I always recommend it to everyone!

Buyer beware! The taxi stand guy at the airport told me that the ride from TPA to the Doubletree Hotel would be $3. When the driver (cab 320) saw my $20, he told me the ride would cost $20. It's about a 4-mile ride.

My new favorite Vietnamese restaurant with my go to Spicy pho! The workers are a little rushed to get your order. So be ready to stay off your phone, read the menu, and make a hasty but solid decision. They have just about everything from soups, meals, desserts, Boba, and small quick stop of tasty snacks. Place I've heard is usually packed with people.

Great place for Vietnamese food!! The price and portion is amazing! The layout and decoration of the restaurant is beautiful. Even when they're busy, they're always knocking out all of the orders in a timely manner. The bakery area and drink making area is a great idea! Owner is also very friendly and nice!

The best pho at a restaurant I have ever had, its the closest thing to the real homemade stuff! It was really packed, and I can totally understand why. The restaurant is very inviting and clean. I love the little side market they have for to-go options! If you enjoy authentic vietnamese food, you need to go here. 

Parking is a little tough, but its worth it!

My new favorite Vietnamese restaurant!
We walked in at 545 on a Friday to a packed house. The layout is extremely clean and inviting, even though the tables are extremely close together. 

The menu is vast enough that anyone can find something that they'll like. We ordered our toddler a Belgian waffle and it was soooo good!

We ordered 2 egg rolls, a bun and a pho and it all was only $21!!!

Delish and generous portions are what will keep this place going for many years to come.
Love this place! Super affordable and delicious. I go there at least once a week. Highly recommend!
Fantastic.... fantastic!!  Did I mention fantastic!?!?  Enjoy this place way too much! Everything on the menu is great.  Never had a bad experience ... I go there at least once a week.

This food is amazing!! Fresh, authentic, and tasty- it will not disappoint you. We ordered the spring rolls with shrimp, fried chicken egg roll, beef pho, stir fried rice noodles with chicken and another chicken dish and all were really amazing and prices very reasonable . 
The ambiance of the restaurant is casual but comfortable. We will be back!

WOWZA this is authentic Vietnamese food in Tampa.  I've had a lot of things off of their menu and I have yet to be disappointed.  Last time I was there I also brought along my friend that is a very tough critic when it comes to food but he really enjoyed his rice dish and has been wanting to come back to eat it again. They are part restaurant and part bakery where you can buy desserts and savory goods at the shop after you eat.

Food is tasty. Pretty much my grubhub go to.
If you are interested in Indonesian food, try this place.
Perhaps, more items to choose from would be great. Maybe for the future.

I used to love this place, but now the quality of the food (taste and quantity wise) went down the hill. They increased the price, but decreased the quantity. The chicken noodle that they were famous for doesn't taste like it used to be anymore. Some of the dishes are lack of flavor. I'm quite disappointed.

I've been going to Sansom Cleaners now for 10 plus years and I wouldn't go anywhere else for getting my dresses fixed. The lady who does the alteration there is the very skilled and the best at what she does. 

I've been to many other places but no other places makes me come back to them because they always mess up my clothes.

Stoped in to grab my hubby a Pho bowl and wasn't sure what to expect. I have always heard good things about the bowls and this particular restaurant, so I knew it was worth the try. 

The restaurant is small, t that really isn't a factor. The staff was friendly, but not too helpful. It seemed to me that they would know to ask customers if it was their first time and if they needed any help deciphering the menu. But nope, didn't get that. Instead, the man, assuming he was the owner, hurriedly handed me the menu and asked what I wanted. This didn't turn me off, since I think he thought I knew what I wanted, but I didn't. I ordered a bowl and in about 10 minutes it was ready. 

So why 3 stars: the restaurant is small and there is a deli inside. But unless you know what you're looking at, it's not much help. The menu does a good job of explaining what you get, and other than the guy I dealt with, the rest of the staff was friendly. Hubby loved his bowl, and my son wants to go back to try a few different dishes. We will go back and just be sure to ask questions and make sure we are clear on what we want and are getting.
My Favorite Vietnamese restaurant! The Pho soups are outstanding, filling, and very reasonably priced! Try a Banh Mi Sandwich, at $3.50 each you won't be disappointed!

Went here yesterday for early dinner semi snacking
They just opened about a week now

Tried the ayam bakar/grilled chicken,ayam goreng/fried chicken,bakso/meatballs and the bakmi/noodles ramen kinda thing 

Jakarta itself is the Capital of Indonesia  
It has a lot of cuisines 
And this is reminding me of home

You know the resto is good if a lot of their people eat in

*Price
Very reasonable around 5-7 bucks 
Hole in the wall
*Decorations indonesian traditional semi modern,very cool!
*Cleanliness...well it's a brand new resto
*a little bit slow on the food coming altogether 
But this is very minor 
They only a week age
 *Food taste delicious  
 
I only spent $35 for party of 3 plus tips 
Full and satisfied 

Cash only for now
Sunday afternoon probably the most busy time 
Since the indo people always looking for food after Church 

I hope they put more menu on the future 
We loved it so far
This is gonna be our go to place after Sky cafe

Food is great (besides the spring rolls) but the service sucks. After being seated today we waited for 15 minutes and nobody came to our table. Finally, we just left. Same thing happened the first time I came here. I'm so conflicted about this place because they have s lot of food that is good but they have an ongoing customer service related issue (extremely slow as well) that other people have talked about which they fail to address
Yum so good!  I can't get enough of this place. The Pho is amazing and the market of fresh food that you can take home is well worth the trip
This place is amazing. Service is quick, everyone is trying to please customer, great authentic food and bubble tea! Definitely coming back for more!

Tip: cash only! 

Vibes: cafe-style, modern, familiar 

Tasting notes:
-hekeng udang: deep-fried shrimp cake slices with a side of sweet chili sauce. Slices were umami, a solid appetizer for 2-3 people. 
-bakmi djakarta kecil: generous helping of savory egg noodles with little chunks of bbq pork, mini fish balls, a halved salty-sweet tea egg, sprouts, scallions, crunchy fried shallots, crispy greens, and two fried wontons. Two small bakso accompanied the noodles in a light broth-perfect to mix in with the noodles. 

Will be back for the specials!
I ordered through door dash . The food came quickly and it is as good as it gets! Plenty of food for a cheap price and it is absolutely delicious and authentic. Can't wait to order again !

Waaaah?! Another new viet place? I'm game! Came here on a Friday night to grab some dinner and dessert, but unfortunately the experience was very lackluster and disappointing. 

The food was alright. Nothing too special. Ordered the pork vermicelli and spring rolls. Both tasted just how I would expect it to taste. Now let's move on to giant, painstaking thorn of this meal...

Unfortunately, they missed the target in regards to the service. Don't get me wrong, but I understand a place gets busy and things won't come out in a timely fashion. But when you order food and the table next to you, who arrived later, gets their food before you, that my friend is what we call a literal joke. Not only did we receive our food late, but some of the items we ordered were never even actually ordered. I'm not sure exactly where the slip up happened or who's to blame, but it was one of the worst dining experiences I've had in a while. If you're thinking about getting dessert, I would suggest ordering it with your actual meal because lord knows how long it'll take for that to come out. For us, it took 20+ minutes after we finished our meal. By the time I finish this meal, I'm pretty sure we would have cured cancer and started living on Mars...see you in 2050 when we finally pay for this painstaking meal.

I would recommend if anyone wants to eat their meal in a timely manner and not spend over two hours sitting around waiting, head over to Dale Mabry and find another viet joint. Similar food, but much faster service. 

tl;dr - Might want to bring a laptop and turn on some Netflix because you can probably finish an entire season of House of Cards before the appetizers come out.

Good Indonesian restaurant in South Philly. I had the Rendang which was very flavorful. About $8 for it. The soup was really small-would of liked a larger bowl. I'd pay a little more for that kale soup. Also had the shrimp rollade as a starter. It was also good. Will definitely come back to try something else. 

Street parking.

First time at this restaurant. Food was awesome!! They also have a little store to one side of the restaurant where you can purchase fried tofu varieties, and various prepped foods. In a nutshell great food, excellent portions, affordable prices, and exceptional service. I will go back often.
The spicy vegetarian soup was perfect for a cold, rainy day. It was our first time there and we will definitely be going back.

This is such a great restaurant if you're looking for pho, Bahn mi sandwiches, or Thai snacks! They have ample seating, even though they always seem to be busy during regular lunch and dinner hours. The food is super fresh and always delicious. I especially love the egg roll vermicelli bowl and the fruit smoothies! They have a little store area with both hot and ready to go snacks (like pork buns and egg rolls and bakery items) as well as frozen, Thai food that you can purchase to take home.

The staff still are fairly stupid and untrained in the way to manage the front of the store. Cashiers talk to each other instead of focusing on the customer and helping move the extra long lines. The young customer service girls just hang and talk when they needed to be aware of the major checkout line backup. But it's the GM's fault!!...he shows no leadership and doesn't train the staff well...so this is what happens. Have really limited my trips here. The ACME at 10th and Reed is the real deal...those folks are all on the same page and all about creating a positive experience for the customer....they all smile, are pleasant, are speedy, and say thank you. Hey ACME, how about you bring your folks from south Philly over to South St and to retrain staff and get the place in shape??

I usually hold off on reviews until an establishment has been opened for a little while, but I've been to Thinh An twice in 14 hours because the food is so good. Note that this review is for the food. The restaurant just had their soft opening yesterday and they are still working out the kinks, so I recommend giving the restaurant time or come it knowing that they are in training mode...if you are patient you'll get the best Vietnamese food in Tampa...in my opinion!

I have driven by this location anticipating the opening since last Summer. On opening day Friday, June 24, 2016 we met a few other Yelpers for dinner at 6pm. I was so excited all day because some other Yelp friends put up pics from lunch and the food looked amazing! 

First, I want to say that the overall decor in the restaurant and layout is fantastic. It's so unexpected to find such a fresh contemporary design in a Pho restaurant. This restaurant has it all: Outdoor & indoor seating; hot bar for tofu and egg rolls, a pastry bar, refrigerated items for sale, prepared foods for sale and a dessert, tea, coffee, waffle & boba drink station!

The food menu is extensive and features all the Viet cuisine you'd expect including Egg Rolls, Summer Rolls, Pho, Bun and Banh Mi! I had the Pho Tai and the broth was served nice and hot and was perfect. Very clean, but earthy and tasty! 

I came back in today to get pastries and ended up buying the warm soft tofu and soy milk to go as well. The pastries are to die for! I especially love the Almond Croissants, but there isn't one pastry I didn't love! The bear claw filled with strawberry, cheese turnover and plain croissant were all melt in your mouth delish. The warm soft tofu with ginger cane sugar was an unexpected treat that my whole family loves! I normally don't eat soy or drink soy milk because of GMO's, but I will eat tofu and soy NOT manufactured in the US or made fresh. Vietnamese soy milk is nothing like the nasty soy milk you get in a typical grocery store. Thinh An makes all the soy milk and tofu fresh in house and it's delicious! Everything is made in house! 

The tea water is the best I've had! So herbal and really tastes like cold jasmine tea. The only thing I didn't care for so far was my boba drink, but that was because my server wasn't familiar with what I asked for and kept bringing me taro milk tea instead of a taro smoothie. The milk tea was way too sweet, so I gave it away. I'm positive on a day that's not so chaotic I can get a good drink here. I am excited to have a tea bar close by because I drive pretty far for boba tea drinks. 

I will be going back for a late lunch in hopes it's not too busy today. Apparently I'm not the only person that has been waiting for the opening. It was full of customers at 10:30am! I'm tempted to pick up more pastries when I go back in.

I'll be trying everything on the menu sans pork, so I will be posting tips along the way and may give a review update in a few months. I'm in trouble...this is only a 5 min drive from me and I'm already craving another almond croissant!

This is the freshest, most traditionally prepared Vietnamese food I've ever eaten. Everything from the Pho to the delicious balls stuffed with some sort of delicious surprise I had tasted and loved. It really is great to have so many healthy options: I love eating everything in sight and not having regrets. 

The white pyramid things wrapped in banana leaves that are stuffed with...whatever are awesome!!!!! You can just walk in and on the left there is a pick up and go area. Genius really. 

I won't even get started on the drink selections!!! Yum.

The most amazing pho in town n country/Tampa. So many vegetarian options which is great since I've been to a couple pho places without even a vegetarian menu. I always get the spicy veg pho (sorry don't know the name but #95) and the vegetarian fried egg rolls which are incredible and the sauce they come with is so delicious. Their lemonade is also great. I do tend to take it to go as I'm always in a rush. I suggest calling in the order is possible since they are always busy, but if you have the time, the patio is covered and air conditioned!
We had the pho soup! It was amazing! I will definitely be back to try more dishes . They have lots of dishes to pick from

I went here for the first time Saturday and was pleasantly surprised.   It's only been here for three years I hope it stays.  The noodle bowl is perfect.  The fresh rolls were perfect the pastries inside were amazing. The sticky rice was good.  I will def be back and tell others about.  Not expensive and very delicious.  This place won the #1 spot so far in this area.
Great local place! Service is friendly and attentive. Boba is my favorite and it's the best there. I love the prepared food section for a special treat.

Sambal Pompano!

D'Jarkata is one of my new favorite restaurants in Philly.  I don't dig the secluded residential location nor the ridiculous lack of parking, but the food here is really delicious.

Over the course of several nights, I tried much of the menu here.  One thing that makes everything better here is the Sambal.  You could basically put this on anything here and it would jack up the flavor 10 fold.  Seriously, ask for a take home container, or bring a sandwich baggie with you, and take some of this sambal home.

That before mentioned Sambal on top of the Pompano is awesome!  There are two versions of the Pompano, grilled and fried, of which the grilled is really extraordinary.  The grilled has this extra smoky charcoal flavor that is missing from the fried version.  Both pompano options are fantastic accompanied with a sweet onion soy sauce.  Both pompano options are my favorites here and I've had it each time with little if any deviation in quality each time.

The Beef Rendang may not be the best I've had in Philly but it sure is super tender and moist.  Layered over a coconut rice, it's truly sublime.  The entree portion was a great size and perfect for sharing with 2 or 3 as it can be rich.  The platter option affords more variety but I'd forgo the variety for more of this Rendang.

Of the appetizers, the chicken satay skewers are served with a healthy ladle of satay sauce on top.  Beautiful juicy thigh meat perfectly cooked over charcoal served with a wedge of lime that isn't required.  Definitely Recommend!

The mixed egg noodles can be customized for example, for those that don't eat pork.  This was accommodated with little impact to flavor.  The egg noodles just add great texture and flavor.  Having tried both versions, I definitely dig the version with pork.  Definitely recommend.

The sweet and sour squid entree was super tender accompanied with a sauce that was tasty.  Similarly the Fried Shrimp Roulade was crispy but a little bland.  The sambal sauce helped to make it much better.

While the before mentioned were fantastic, there were some disappointments on the menu, namely the lamb skewers and the shrimp a la carte entrees.  Both of these items were over cooked and in the case of the lamb satay, the satay sauce was on the side and not slathered on top like the chicken version.  No amount of satay sauce or lime wedges could have saved the lamb from being edible.  It was dry and hard to chew.  The shrimp, while being overcooked, also suffered from the lack of proper deveining.  These were not little shrimp and that simple effort mistake took away from what could have a been a really great dish.  Hopefully they were one time issues that can be corrected in the future.

Finally the operating hours are rather tight for an early dinner and the tight parking situation doesn't help.  Even still D'Jarkata is definitely a must try.

We love Mary Jo's Performing Arts Academy! Our daughter began dancing here at age 2 and adores going to dance each week. The teachers are wonderful, patient, encouraging, inspiring and talented. Most of all, they take care of their dancers as if they were their own family. MJPAA has become a second family to our daughter. We can't say enough positive things about this Studio.

The Pho is photastic!
Every time we come here, we try something different and are never dissatisfied.

They have the BEST tofu I've ever tasted. The rest of their food and service is also amazing. They have tons of delicious vegan and vegetarian options but also a full menu of really great meat options, so it's my favorite place to go with my friends and family. I'd even go so far as to say it's my favorite restaurant in Tampa!

Food is absolutely delicious! My son and I are not big fans of Asian cuisine, but this is definitely ast the top of the list. The good is delicious,  fast service,  staff is not focused on entertaining but making sure your drinks are full and food is done well. We've already been back a few times.

After coming here, I haven't gone to any other Vietnamese restaurant. By far, my favorite! I gather I'm not the only one because whenever I come, it's packed with people.

The price plus the QUALITY and authenticity of the food is unparalleled. Of course, you have to try the pho. We get the pho dac biet (has brisket, tendon, meatballs, tripe). I have had pho all around Florida but this is by far the best. My mom comes from south Florida to Tampa mostly for the pho more than to see me 

I think another thing that sets it apart and makes this place super special is the bakery/hot food/dessert/supermarket area. Super unique and special. 

We've been coming here for almost 4 years and will keep coming as long as they're open!
Excellent, love their pho.  My boys had attended as well and they loved the entree/soup.  Very happy with service, timeliness and the staff

I honestly am in love with this place. The prices are beyond reasonable and the food is of good quality. There are about 15-20 parking spaces. Quarantine times, they have seating in their covered area and people sitting tables away from each other. They also have a nice market off to the side to get all great treats, tofu, bean curd, fresh rolls, etc. They also have the countertop to get Boba tea, bubble/puff waffles, and Bahn Mi.

This place has superb Indonesian food. We went with my brother family who were here before. We order few dishes and shared so i tasted little of each.I liked stir fried flat rice noodle the best which came with shrimp,fishball and fishcake,veggies on it. It was little different but very  delicious. The decor was good and staff were courteous and friendly. I would love to go back and eat here.

All the great reviews of this place are no accident. Thinh An is absolutely legit. Great pho is all about the broth and theirs is the best we've had in Tampa. It's really rich and flavorful where others we've had here tend to be thin and bland. Prices are great, too. I mean four bucks for a bun mi? Come on! Take note that your food is going to come out when it's ready, so you may get your bowl of pho before your baby momma gets her fried rice. It is what it is. But it's worth it!

The word is definitely out on this place. It gets super busy and parking can be a real headache. Show up a little early or a little later to avoid the crowds of happy patrons.

Alex responded promptly for my estimate request and I was able to quick schedule a visit.  Alex was prompt (he wore his mask) and knowledgeable.  He had to order a part and quickly scheduled a return visit.  His price as fair.  I would highly recommend Alex and hire him again for my appliance repair.  Thanks Alex!

Thank you for making the best Vietnamese food in Tampa!  

The menu offers a wide variety of dishes.   

The restaurant is clean and super comfortable for in-room dining.

All in all if you're in the mood good, definitely check this place out!

Wifey and I have been going to Saigon Deli for years.  A good friend recently told me he won't go there anymore because they're not keeping the place so clean.  So we decided to try and find someplace else.

We recently purchased a new car (LOVE you Lexus Wesley Chapel!!) and the young woman who did all the transaction documents was Vietnamese.  We asked her what her favorite restaurant was.  Without skipping a beat she said "Thinh An."

In the past 5 days we've been there 3 times.  First of all - it's not just clean.  It's SPOTLESS CLEAN!  The condiments are wiped clean - everything is CLEAN!  

I like that the servers speak and understand English, the menu is full of pictures so you can see what you're ordering, and everything we've had so far has been EXCELLENT!  AWESOME!  DELICIOUS!!

Yes, it's a drive for us, but Thinh An is worth going the extra distance.  We can't wait to share our new find with friends.

If you've read any of my reviews, I'm tough and I'm critical.  If I post 5-stars, the place has to be MORE THAN GREAT.  Thinh An deserves every star I posted.  We're super-impressed.

Lilly - thank you for turning us on to our new most favorite restaurant!
The food is incredible and very well prepared. The staff are just absolutely charming from start to finish. I'm super happy I discovered this place
Great food, lots of choices, quick service, and always busy! One of our family's favorite mid-week dinner choice.

This place is awesome! It has a fast casual vibe with all the traditional Vietnamese comfort foods like pho and banh mi but also have some modern additions like boba and the bubble waffles and snow ice cream! Basically, they have any Vietnamese dish that my heart could ever desire. Best of all, I'm a big fan of the deli section which has a variety of pastries which totally appeal my food porn desires. 

On the weekends they get really busy but must have a really good system in their kitchen because they brought our pho out so quickly it was reminiscent of the Jimmy John's motto "freaky fast."

In all, this is one of my favorite places to eat with my family. Would definitely recommend it for a quick bite or for some quality family time.

This a family favorite and go to. We love the food, atmosphere, variety in their menu (SO MANY OPTIONS from bakery, beverages and food). I'd recommend to literally anybody in Tampa for Vietnamese food!

On top of that, their service is fabulous paired with high quality food. Love them!

Nobody had mask at this store. Food is pretty good but during a pandemic I think that is best to stay away from here as they don't seem to concerned about cdc guidelines. When I stated this to the team they asked me did I want the food or not.
Great food! I never had anything I didn't liked here! So many different options to choose from and I love the little bakery/Togo shop they have.
I love this place, they have online ordering and a hot bar. It can get packed during lunch time. Food is always on time. Parking can be difficult at times also.

This Acme used to be a Super Fresh. Didn't know it was changed until I went for a walk today and decided to stop in for some home cleaning items that I couldn't get at Whole Foods.

The store is clean and well-stocked, but the cashier had an attitude bigger than the Titanic. I got no "hello," no nothing. I could have accepted that she was mute but the scowl on her face was ridiculous. What did I do to you? I bought two items and paid by card. You had another girl bagging my groceries. Minimal effort was required on your part for that transaction.

Hot mess! I'll only be back if I'm desperate.

I have to update my review so future Christina knows what she tried and loved.

We ordered a variety of stuff during the COVID-19 quarantine so we got to branch out and try new dishes (#supportlocal). I'm happy to report that everything was delicious. 

Fried Chicken Eggrolls - my husband loved these and said he'd get them again.
Shrimp Spring Rolls - these were very fresh and a great starter.
Seafood stir fried soft egg noodle - I liked the soft egg noodle better than the pan fried egg noodle (tried both). The good news is if you get the pan fried egg noodle dish to go they separate the dish so your noodles don't get soggy. My son ate more of the crispy noodle sans topping so I guess in the future we will have to keep getting both. For the crispy noodle dish I got the tofu/vegetarian topping. Both were delicious, but I'll probably stick with the seafood next time. I love fish cubes.
Beef fried rice - their fried rice is amazing. It was seriously addicting. You know it's good rice when you love it the same eating it cold, because rice rarely tastes good cold. This will be a repeat order.
Banh mi - we got both chicken and tofu banh mi sandwiches. When I bit into it I remembered why I love it so much. For $4, it's an absolute steal. I get it without jalapenos because I dislike spicy things.
Avocado smoothie with boba - It's sweet and delicious. A small hits the spot and it's only $3.50.

Unfortunately, it looks like Thinh anh is closed for the near future as we get this pandemic sorted out. From friends I found out they deliver on DoorDash, but I couldn't find them on UberEats. I really hope they weather this storm, because they are amazing.

We dined in at 7pm on the weekend. It was extremely busy. Their parking lot in the front is very small, they have parking on the side of the building, and in the back. The back is not lit, its dark and unpaved. The area is not that nice so take caution if you park in the back of the building. I am unsure if it is always super busy, but they appeared to be having a dinner rush so we had to take a buzzer and wait. We were told 20 minutes. After 40 minutes we checked ands were told one party was in front of us. Another 25 minutes later we asked again and they woman claims she called our names 3 times and went on to the next party. We were sitting in front of the woman the whole time- she never called our names. Almost an hour and ten minutes later we are finally seated. Our waiter was very helpful. He did tell me the beef pho and chicken pho were the only gluten free options.You can get an extra large for only 12.99 which is insanely cheap. The pho comes out fast and super hot. The flavor was rich, well developed, and a bit sweet. Overall, It was really tasty and they give you a lot of rice noodles. I can't say its the best pho in Tampa like many of these reviewers say, but it is very very good and maybe in the top three of places I have been to.

This place was recommended to me by a good friend and since I love vietnamese food, I quickly went the next day.  It was a 25-30 min drive but it was easy to get to and well worth the effort.   I am a big fan of Saigon Deli so the bar is set very high, but Thinh An (not sure how that is pronounced) is as good, and with super reasonable prices, better hours and huge portions is the new leader in the Tampa Vietnamese clubhouse.

I arrived at 6:40 on a Sunday night and the inside was crowded but I was seated quickly.  While the menu is huge, it was pretty easy to see that it was divided into the main categories (appetizers, pho bowls, vermicelli noodle bowls, rice bowls and bahn mi sandwiches).  I quickly and mistakenly ordered chicken summer rolls and the Special Vermicelli.  The summer rolls were excellent, but quickly made redundant five minutes later when the huge dinner bowl showed up.  It is easily twice the size of any other of my favorite places (I wish they had a small and a large option, but for $9.50 I probably would have just ordered the large anyway) and came with pork, shrimp, an egg roll and another roll that was delicious but I couldn't identify it on the menu.  

When I got half way through this monster I probably should have stopped, but it was so delicious I just kept going.  When I got to the 3/4 mark, I should have just asked for the check but soldiered on, finished it and now an hour later sort of regret it.  I'm sure this will all pass quickly and I can look forward to another road trip to try something different on the menu.

They apparently have good desserts, several beers and prepacked meals in the front, but that will have to be for another visit. 

The total bill with tip was like $16 and if I went again I wouldn't bother with the appetizer unless I had company to share it with.

The service was great, the restaurant is bright and everyone seems to be having a nice time.  Lots of regulars judging by the comments i heard.

The only negative was that it took about 15 minutes to get a check.  It took me two minutes to order and about 25 minutes to eat the meal.  I was ready to head out but it took a long time to pay.  I guess it was because they were really busy.

Overall, a great place.   Worth the drive, even from deep in South Tampa

Love...this...spot. It's part buffet, part prepared food, part sit down and all great! I sat down inside near the windows (the seating is tight and i could hear all of the conversation next to me - only minus) the menu focuses on mainly soups and noodles dishes...no complaints here. I ordered the Bun Bo Hue, the Banh mi dac biet and a Thai bobba tea to wash it all down. The service was quick...as it should be and i got my tea followed by the soup and then quickly behind that the banh mi. The soup came out with a sidecar of sprouts/cilantro/jalapeno and lettuce and it was excellent. It could use a bit more heat (I love heat) which was close by in the form of a spice tray. The flavor was so good with a very hearty offering of meats. Up next was the fully-loaded banh mi, which i added some chili sauce to and was equally excellent. The combination of savory with the spicy/bright tones is always one of my favorites. This pot reminds of a Saigon delil, which is a huge complement. Make sure it is on your list and make a stop, you will not be disappointed.
PS. The prices are legit!! $8 for a huge!!! bowl of soup and $3.5 for a banh mi....you can't beat that.

I finally had the chance to try this hottest and newest Indonesian restaurant in town. Definitely as good as it gets and I'm kind of obsessed with the decor and the Jakarta-themed murals on its walls. In case World Geography is not your forte, Jakarta is the capital of Indonesia which is located in Southeast Asia which makes Indonesian cuisine one of the most colorful and vibrant in the world with full intensity of flavors.

Enough of the intro lecture and let's get down to business. If you come here during a weekday, you'd probably have more chance of finding a nearby street parking spot. If not, fret not - drive around the neighborhood a little and you should find one a block or two away (the walk should build up your appetite). Once you get here and get that appetite built up, grab a seat and a menu. The menu spread consist of selections of dishes that you'd find in the streets of Jakarta. I highly recommend the satays as appetizer - they always bring me back to the memories of Jakarta's late night snacks/supper culture. Few other dishes that give me the same feelings are the Soto Betawi, Bakmi Djakarta, and Nasi Goreng Djakarta. D'Jakarta Cafe's version of these dishes are really on point and authentic. Some of the beverages can be quite sugary, but it's so worth it. Your Jakarta experience won't be complete without either the Ice Cendol or the Happy Soda :)

The service is very quick, friendly, and hospitable. Definitely a 5-star experience!

The best things here are tofus. Sit down meals are not worth it. 
The other dry street styles food are okay but not that good. The hot sit down meals I've tried 2 times are not authentic and just not good. My parents ordered some noodles it tasted like it was missing ingredients and lack not the right flavor. I had rice with beef and it was so dry I can't even swallow. The food is okay if you don't know how it is supposed to taste like. I got bad service my order took forever, they forgot I ordered additional egg rolls, no one really check on us, and cant follow what I requested for to-go order.

There's a good reason why Thinh An Kitchen is a 4.5 Star restaurant with over 900 reviews. Whether you're hungry for a good Bánh mì sandwich, a plate of Bánh cun, or a delicious bowl of Ph, you'll find it here (and do much more) at unbelievably low prices. To say we were impressed by our first visit is an understatement.

Stopped by last night due Yelp reviews but with our family experience, food and service were nothing like the reviews raved.  To start, our server (blue polo shirt) didn't know what's inside the Three color dessert and instead of going to ask the kitchen, he told me to look at the menu and walked away.  The menu did not list any ingredient! I had to grab another guy(grey T- shirt) and he told me to wait for our waiter and I had to tell him our waiter didn't know the ingredients in the 3-color dessert color for him to answer my question!!  That was horrible service-- unfriendly, rude and impolite!!!! Not sure which color of servers' shirts indicate what their position. 
 
Food portion was decent but quality is not there. We ordered broken rice dishes but they did not inform us that there was no more broken rice-- we figured this because they gave us regular rice and we're too hungry to question. The nem nuong roll meat was rubbery, tasteless and so pink which made us think the meat had so much food coloring.  The worst nem nuong rolls we ever ate!!!! 
Would never return!!!

I would consider myself to be a fried rice connoisseur, i have tried probably hundreds of fried rice dishes in my 18 years lol, but this place has the absolute BEST. I have no idea what it is but the pork just falls apart and melts in your mouth and there are just so many flavors. I also ordered the appetizer portion of the Wonton Soup and it was delicious, the cilantro really adds that extra bit of yumminess. I'm also obsessed with boba so I ordered a mango boba and it was super good. The place was packed yet the service was still quick and friendly. I really wanted to try to snow ice cream but I was just way too full but I will be back again! This place is AMAZING!
Horrible customer and the food isn't good at all pizza is horrible! Everything is just thrown together. Totos is much better in every aspect!

If you have not been, GO!  There is so much to try and you won't be disappointed.  I'm not a huge fan of Pho but love the lemongrass chicken vermicelli.  Teriyaki chicken with fried rice is great as well and don't forget to grab a croissant or two to go with your matcha milk tea.  It's all sooo good!

This is the second time I've been here and I tried different, yet equally fantastic dishes here.
This is superb for a vegan !!! And you always have left overs... there's no way to finish a whole bowl. 
The service is always above par and everyone is friendly :):) I cant wait to go back.
This is the best pho place I have ever been to! Hands down! Friendly and clean and the food is absolutely delicious :)  really you should try it

I can't believe I've never checked this place at before! The food was delicious and you can't beat the price! 
The service was great and the food came out very fast! We also got a few goodies in the market like sesame balls, cassava cake and some what we call "palitaw" in the Philippines. 

We will definitely be back!

I come to Thinh An weekly for vegetable spring rolls, veggie egg rolls, and tofu bahn mi. The food is always out quick, and it's super cheap. The staff is really nice except for the older man who seems to run the place, he's pretty rude and unprofessional. However, I think I new guy is running it now and he's the sweetest.

Vietnamese market and restaurant where every fkin thing tastes amazing. 

Visited on 9-7-19 at 6:30pm. $44.76 got us a milk slush, an appetizer, three entrees, a sandwich, a dessert, and two pastries. Service from Thong was quick and attentive and friendly.

We started out with the $2.50 fried pork egg rolls. They were crispy and hot and full of a delicious filling of pork and carrots and maybe rice? Very tasty. 

Kiddo had the $9 teriyaki chicken with broken rice and I tried a bite of his chicken and ended up stealing half of it. It was charred and smoky on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, and covered in a sweet bbq sauce. It was amazing. 

I had the $4 bbq chicken banh mi and it was hands down the best I've ever had. The bread is freshly baked and crusty, the chicken was sweet and tender, the veggies fresh and lightly pickled, and it tasted like they slathered it in garlic butter and grilled it a little. Heaven on a bun! 

For dessert we ordered a coconut bubble waffle and it was hot, crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and filled with real coconut.  My husband loved his pork fried rice so much he ordered a chicken curry to-go so he could eat it today. 

Before leaving we snagged an almond croissant and a strawberry pastry from the market and both were nothing short of exceptional...flaky, buttery, perfectly cooked, magnificent. 

I was highly impressed with the fantastic service, freshness of the food, and everything tasted so fkin good. I am equal parts happy and sad that this place is so far from my house. Sad for my belly but happy for my waistline. This place put so much love into this food....it's a bargain for the price!

Amazing service and food always! 

I recommend trying their frozen beverages as well as their coffee!
This is the best Cali burger that I have ever had it's always super fresh, the meat has a great taste, served on a sweet bun,  they never disappoint super consistent with flavor!

Place was great, staff was friendly. For only being open 2 weeks the place was packed at lunch time people waiting outside. Luckily we got there right before the rush and were able to get our food pretty quickly.  Looked around the restaurant and food portions were large and prices were reasonable. Overall, I could not complain. I hope they can consistently serve at this quality, I look forward to going back. Place is very clean and has a contemporary feel to it.

OHMYGOSH the Cajun crawfish is unreal! Perfectly cooked, absolutely delicious, and affordable! Everything else was awesome too: the fruit teas, the beef stew, the fresh bread, etc. OMG... just go already! Eat! Enjoy!
This office is very unprofessional. They had me come all the way there for services they didn't even submit to the insurance an than want me to pay out of pocket because they didn't do there job.

5/28/17 was my first time inside this store. I usually walk past this store a lot whenever I come to South Street in South Philly. Very clean inside and very well organized. Good prices in this store.

We came here last night thinking the food would be good but the service was awful and the food was pretty disappointing after reading some good and some bad reviews... giving it a chance. We are from out of town, and the person that was taking our order was quite rude and seemed like she didn't want to help us and gave us some weird facial expressions when my bf wanted to order a  burger. The burger was super greasy and tasted like greasy mushhh and my arepa looked so sloppy. This is more like number one sloppy fast food to fit the food name. We support small local businesses but this one is just poor customer service and poor tasting food.
Great food, great price. We love the egg rolls, the sandwiches, the pho and the fried rice.

Best place for blood work and labs! I have been here MANY times, i've come for myself, brought my mother and wife too.  Always fast to see, completely painless and on point! The girls here do excellent work.  They may not always smile, but are VERY good at what they do! Getting poked With needles is always nerve-racking and can be incredibly painful if the person drawing your blood is not good; choose wisely and be sure to come here!

In 2012, I had some rather extensive cosmetic dentistry and oral surgery done by Dr. Yanez and the process took several very involved visits - extractions, dentures, titanium implants, adjustments. The experience from consultation to final visit was nothing less than stellar. Two years out from this work, Dr. Yanez's handiwork remains true to the original goal - to give me my smile back.  

What might have been a really harrowing experience was actually seamless. Dr. Yanez and his staff were always professional, knowledgeable, and most importantly, supportive and helpful. As one might expect, the decision process and options available to me with such an extensive list of needs and concerns was almost overwhelming - NEVER, at any time, did I feel pressured or directed into any one direction by Dr.  Yanez or his staff. His chairside manner was very reassuring and confident - and  his staff was always at the ready to assist him (or me) and allay any concerns, pain or fears that I may have had as I underwent this long process.  

Finally, Dr. Yanez was certainly not the first dentist I consulted with about my issues, but he was definitely the last. I highly recommend him for anything related to the practice of dentistry, from something as simple and routine as a cleaning or filling to complex oral surgery.

Best pho near to Westshore. I love how quick they are but it's so fresh!!! They also have sandwiches and the Vietnamese frappuccino is so good. I always get the shrimp udon soup because I like to add stuff to the base. This is the only pho restaurant around that has udon noodles in a pho style soup. Udon is my favorite so I love coming here. Also their servers are very friendly and check up on you often.

This has been one of my favorite places for years. Just now getting around to posting a review. 

Their banh mi and boda teas are the best. Never get fatty meats and never feel like its under portioned for the price.
I agree with Cookie C...I'm not a dentist and we went there for help. I thought...that was the best place in Philadelphia.I got so disappointed.

Had pho here for the first time about 4 days ago. Impressed. Not a huge place but by no means small.
Menu has a lot to offer. Prices are good. I'll definitely be going back. Took my wife there for the first time about three days later and she was blown away.

I use your order from them weekly. Possibly $100 per week on average. I'm disabled and it is a welcoming event. I even have a great relationship with the receptionist in the morning. She knows my name every time I call. This recent experience sucked big time. The delivery was late way over an hour. I called at least 3 times wondering where my food was. The manager was very rude to me and blamed me for the problem. I asked for my money back and he said he "was busy" and he didn't care what I did. He finally said call your bank. I'm too busy. I called my bank and they could not believe how I was treated since I order from them so much.

I brought my husband here for the first time last night and he enjoyed himself beyond words and asked me why we haven't been here before. I've been here many times with friends and with other yelpers this is solid service great food always to pick up some homemade tofu. My son and I both opted for theBan mi sandwich the traditional with the head cheese and the pate on the crispiest softest and crunchiest bread with fresh pickled vegetables along side. We both of course opted for fruit slush- me pineapple and him passion fruit. You must try and order of spring rolls not all of them are cooked some of them are cold with the cellophane wrap and fresh tofu and shrimp. If anything needs a little extra space on the table are two containers one fairly spicy and the other volcanic spicy. Service always spot on quick efficient and clean. Do yourself a favor stop in they're open seven days a week.
Sit outside if you want the true Tampa experience Or inside in the air conditioning plenty of seating all around never had to wait more than a few minutes.

One of the best Vietnamese food I've had in the states so far. It was so good I wanted to move to Florida lol and I'm from New York. The taste was similar to what I had back in Vietnam. They also have twisted bagel, which is used to dip in the soup, that I don't see is available in a lot of Vietnames restaurant. The service is also good however the place is packed so somtimes you have to be patient a little bit. Overall great restaurant!

There's a reason this place is so busy. Friendly staff, great food. Got the hekeng udang appetizer, which was really tasty and fried super crisp. Had the nasi ayam goreng, which has a little bit of everything on it. Really enjoyed the various sauces, which had great flavor in addition to some heat.

I could tell by the crowded parking lot that this place was legit. Awesome pho and delicious chicken wings. The wings are an appetizer and come in orders of 4, but they're the whole jumbo wings, not the little wing ding pieces you get at most places. Definitely one of my new go to's

Seriously the food is so good - we came on a Saturday night and the place was popping. Didn't think we'd get our food that quickly but both our spring rolls and pho were served within 5. The spring rolls were so fresh and the outside skin wasn't dry at all! And the pho was soo good - the broth was rich but not salty. Definitely recommend checking it out!

We are regulars at this store and are usually greeted by friendly cashiers. Unfortunately today we had a cashiers with a bad attitude who kept giving smirks and dirt looks. This cashiers name was Elainia, a tall young male with curly hair and AA meeting tags on his key chain. Very unfriendly experience.

There are lots of Indonesian food in Philly and they serve foods from different region jn Indonesia. This restaurant is specifically serving foods from Java island. The food is on the sweeter side. The foods are mixed of Indonesian Chinese food. If you are craving for Indonesian Chinese food, you should try this restaurant. Today we tried the pompano grill fish. The fish is so fresh and the sauce sambal is delicious. We also tried the "ayam goreng mentega" - this dish is so close to the one in Indonesia. It is very delicious. Highly recommended if you are in Philly area and craving for Indo food

Came to Tampa to visit for a night and since it was raining we couldn't go out for dinner so we order via doordash.
OMG this place is amazing and the prices are soooo reasonable. I love Pho and my ex roommate who is Viet made the best pho ever. So I can only eat from authentic places. And so far this place is the closest I've gotten to my roommates food! So I ordered pho with tripe and meatball and the broth was soooo fresh and flavorful. They packed all the condiments for the soup separately and the veggies were also super fresh. 
In addition to my pho, I had a chicken banh mi. Exploding with flavor and freshness. The size of the banh mi was so generous for the prize. I also ordered oolong milk tea and the tea was so strong and flavorful. And some other places they make the tea super weak, but not here! 
I love this place so much and I can't imagine how amazing their other food are. Next time I come back to Tampa I'll make sure to pay them an inperson visit.
My favorite restaraunt in all of Tampa. I get the tofu bún everytime. I'm not even vegetarian but they make their own tofu in house and it is so good! Great portions and prices.
Best pho I have and the fresh roll is must get!!! Have been here numerous time never let me down !!!!

Thinh An Kitchen has some delicious Vietnamese cuisine that really hits the spot! The menu is massive and there's literally something for everyone. The hours are also much more optimal than Saigon Deli, another delicious Vietnamese option. 

The wait for a table isn't easy - so try coming during off hours to avoid longer than usual waits. Make sure to grab a Thai tea or a Vietnamese coffee because it hits the spot while waiting for food!

From banh mi to bun rieu, plenty of flavors to go around! Definitely recommend the bun rieu!
Back to business since last Wed. As good as always. Limited seating outside and inside.

Coming to thinh an is a drives away from the University area but it  is worthit. The broth is AMAZING. you truly taste the spices and beef flavor that was boiled into the soup. You really don't need to add sriracha or hoisin sauce to your soup- just enjoy it. 

When it comes to the boba, be prepared to pay a little extra for real fruit. An avocado smoothie with boba will come out to $4~ but if you want real fruit it's like an extra $1 and some change more. 

BUT THE BEST PART of this place is the bakery. Oof, that bakery is stocked pack with some many delicious goodies from traditional Vietnamese finger foods to every day pastries everyone can enjoy. 

Affordable, delicious, aesthetically designed, what's more to say?? Oh, parking is sometimes difficult because there's so many peoplen coming in but that should prove how good the food is.

Coming from Southern California we have AMAZING ASIAN FOOD. I have been so disappointed since I've moved to Tampa because most of the asian food is subpar at best. Thinh An is the ONLY place comparable to authentic Asian food. Their pho broth is delicious, good portions of noodles and protein, very affordable and they even have a take out prepackaged section that I purchase from to have snacks throughout the week.

Ohhh Acme. Outdated, overpriced, low quality.  Meat and fish is overpriced, very low quality and frequently near expiration. Low customer turnout means produce and meat just sits for days and spoils on the shelves.  This is bottom of the barrel in terms of grocery stores. I prefer Sprouts on Broad and Washington for fresh meat and produce.

Huge menu with tons of variety. Very inexpensive, they also have good boba tea. Everything we had was very fresh and delicious. 

They have pastries and other items buffet style for grab and go. 

Restaurant is very clean, staff was attentive with great service. 

I'm on a bahn mi quest right now and this may be tied for #1 with Saigon Deli on Waters. I like Saigon Deli's bread more but I overall liked this bahn mi more.

SAFETY ALERT!!!!!!!!! DO NOT USE UNITED TAXIS!!!!!!!!!!!!! When I pushed the buzzer at the Tampa international airport there was already a taxi in the waiting area. Taxi 426- with United Cab on the side. I went to get in after my luggage was already in and there was no door handle. The car smelled awful and the windshield was cracked in 3 places- I was told it would be a minimum of $25 I explained I only lives 7 miles away he said that didn't matter. He drove me to my drop off location and instead of using the monitor on the back of the seat to pay this man pulled out his phone and charged me on that. I see the receipt shows Yellow Cab- Not United Taxi- When I called the number to confirm the legitimacy the guy laughed and said yes that our driver I said "safety" and "inspections" were words used while I was on hold and this taxi was not up to par. He then asked if I was an inspector and then said "Well did you take it?" I said I was going to go ahead and call the attorney general and this man said I was a snitch. I am a very frequent traveler through Tampa international airport and I will NEVER take a taxi again but I also would never want our visitors to experience what I did. He also did not have any readily cleaning materials or a shield protecting passengers and himself. NO badge was displayed. Oh and 34 dollars for going 7 miles.

Really great restaurant. Very clean and up to date interior. Service was great, never had a whole page for just vegetarian options so that's a plus. The Tofu spring roles with the peanut sauce were phenomenal. The vegetarian pho was out of this world, best tasting broth ever. And let's not even get started with the Bobba options.....I can't wait to go back!

Delicious and fast service. Excellent choices for everyone. Wonderful vegetarian dishes and the tofu spring rolls are amazing. We love the boba tea and don't forget to try the egg puff waffle for dessert.
Excellent Vietnamese food served original style. Also has prepared groceries, fresh and tasty. Friendly staff and very efficient service. A winner!!!

Came hungry and ordered half the menu, and it was all good. I've had tons of pho in my short life so I'm a bit pickier than average, but it was super solid here. I really enjoyed the spring roll appetizer, and the banh mi was exceptional. Probably the crustiest bread I've ever eaten. Do yourself a favor and dip your banh mi in your pho, you won't be disappointed.

This is my go to Vietnamese place. I drive form Westshore just to get food here. Very nice and clean Vietnamese spot. Usually busy but the wait isn't long. Not only is the food great but the price is also very cheap! So if you're looking to pig out, I recommend this place.
Look. I walk in twice a week and there are never any baskets by the door. Ever. Ever! Get it together acme, hipsters are the only reason I stay out of whole foods.

In the spirit of #Thank You Thursday, I am thankful for this Vietnamese restaurant. It has been one of my favorite places in Tampa for a long time. I was so happy when they opened their doors again. When my kids (4) asked me what I want to eat for Mother's Day, I knew right away that I want to order my special meal from here.

I like the soups, the spring rolls, the drinks, the desserts, the tofu and more. Seriously you can't go wrong here. They make their own soy milk, tofu and breads. 

Thank you for serving us such yummy food!

One of the best Pho places I've been in a while! A lot of other places I've been to have had such watered down broths, I have to add so much lime to help add something to the soup. But not here, the broth was so flavorful and complex - it's was one of the best - 2nd to homemade. They also come in two size: large and extra large. All of us ordered extra large but no one was actually able to finish! We also ordered the fresh spring rolls (bbq pork) they were good, not as remarkable like their pho, but still pretty good. Avocado smoothie was great! I'm not sure if they used fresh avocado or powder, but it tasted like the fresh ones I get from another place! They have so many other menu items, vermicelli bowls, fried rice, grilled plates with rice, etc. Plus there is a little market / bakery inside with some traditional Vietnamese goodies. Definitely worth a try!

The only minor thing was our orders not getting taken correctly. A few of us didn't get what we ordered, or it wasn't correct. The server was mostly friendly but he did say a few times "you never ordered that" but we definitely did. I would still come back here again, just give the order more slow and have them read it back to me.

I used to shop here whenit was Super Fresh if I was in the nieghborhood. They have a good selection and sale prices where you don't need preferred customer card. They have to go food items, a deli, sushi and chicken as well. Prices are reasonable. I was on South Street getting my haircut.I like this Acme because it's fairly large and you can walk aroundwith shopping cart. Employees are friendly too.
My absolute favorite place! The service is always amazing and the food is wonderful. I love the Bun (#33) and the shrimp fresh rolls.

This is now the top of my Vietnamese dining list. Dishes were of high quality and tasty. Service was attentive and I feel I've made new friends. Even the people dining around us were helpful with suggestions and sharing.The added bakery and deli is a must no matter how full you feel. We had lots of leftovers after ordering too much and several bags of goodies from the bakery/deli when we finally left.

This is my first time eating Thinh An.  I'm not that familiar with Vietnamese and decided to Uber some to go.  Food arrived fresh and hot.  

I can see why people like this place: good portions for the price.  The food was not bland. 

Now, here's where things go bad for my own personal taste (experienced Vietnamese cuisine lovers, please don't come for me...LOL...I grew up with a basic American diet and wasn't introduced to foods of the world until about 10 years ago.  

I've only ever had a roast pork Banh Mi sandwich at Saigon Deli. Hands down- it's way better TO MY liking. Their meat has less fat marbling. Their sandwich is slightly smaller, and the bread is a little softer/chewier and the roast pork taste better.  The bread at Thinh An is lighter and crispier (crumbs all over the place), the meat is fattier and not as dry and it comes with a yellow sauce (Mayo?) that made the bread a little soggy during delivery. However, I liked the carrots better than Saigon.  (Picky? Dang. I guess so.). I've had the Saigon sandwiches for a couple of years - love them.  I will not try another Thinh An sandwich.  I threw mine out.  

Small Wonton soup. $3.50 with 4 wontons. Great broth. Simple. Good for kids, sick people and people that like a brothy classic soup ‍. I always pluck the meat out of the wontons. I would get this again.  Saigon's wonton broth is too sweet for me.  Both are worth trying. 

Pork and Shrimp egg roll:  I liked it and would get it again. 7/10 because there is only one shrimp in each roll. It has a savory ground pork filling. Hot and crisp. You get two in a serving. 

Cold fresh Shrimp rolls - classic, light, fresh. Peanut sauce is good.  Quite similar in taste to a few other places I've tried and I would order again. 

Spicy Bun bo hue beef soup.  If you eat it with all of the noodles and veggies, it's reasonably spicy.  If you are a "mild" spicy person - this one may be slightly too hot for you.  Great for winter. For me, the broth was too sweet.  I'm going to try to the beef carrot stew next.  This is a rich, flavorful broth with a thicker noodle than Pho.  The meat has some fat and tendons but I expected this.  It's tender enough to nibble around it and adds flavor to the soup.  There is a lot of meat in this.  I didn't care for it and put most of it to the side.  The blood ingredient kind of scared me (don't laugh) but just don't think about it - it's fine!   

I'm going to try again for the fried rice, veggie egg roll and the soup with the wide flat noodles.   It anyone knows which soups are the least sweet, message me!

Always amazing food and service. Every single time we have visited this restaurant despite being super busy the one thing never changes..the service and food. The prices are reasonable price for their Pho and not overpriced. Love this place

Take out was scheduled  for 8:00 pm and it wasn't fulfilled until well after 8:30. While I watched everyone in the restaurant receive there food within minutes of walking in. I won't be returning to eat here again.

Perhaps my favorite restaurant in Tampa metro.  The food is outstanding authentic Vietnamese. 
My favorite is the curry chicken with baguette. Its a dish that is not common at most Vietnamese restaurants. The price points are great and so many options.  This place gets packed especially on weekends so be prepared to wait. I only wish they opened a second location closer to Brandon/Riverview. They are located pretty far from most of Hillsborough County.

A good time with some good people and some good food, and some very strange fruit!  

My first Yelp event of any sort... and I was pleasantly surprised how friendly everyone was! I had my girlfriend with me, and even she commented on how nice it was that way. It was at one of our favorite Vietnamese restaurants, so we knew the food was going to be awesome too! And it was! 

I had the Special On Vermicelli, and OMG, it was HUGE! I could not eat it all, although I wanted to since it was so good! Also tried the Durian (strange fruit) smoothie with Boba, and it was delicious! And very different! Girlfriend had the BBQ Pork Bahn Mi, and those are always good.. as were my freshrolls!

After we had finished eating... DURIAN was brought to the table! It was placed in front of RJ, who smelled it, tasted it.. and announced it edible! And didn't think the smell was that bad, either. It was passed around for the enjoyment (or dismay) of all. Some liked it, some vehemently did not! 

Me? I thought the smell was a little odd... like old onions maybe, but the taste was pretty good... I would eat it again! Girlfriend was like.. nah, once is enough!  :)

It was a lot of fun, and I hope to do more of these in the future!

Thanks to TJ for putting this together, and thanks to Thinh an Restaurant and staff for being so helpful and friendly!

Food was ok, but service definitely ruined everything. We purchased their famous sugared tofu, planed to sit down at the table and enjoy the food. The lady server came and aggressively threw silverwares on the table. We chose to be careless about her attitude with the thinking probably that was just because she had a long and exhausted day at work. But the worst part was when my friend went to the restroom and overheard the server's convesation with her coworkers. She literally was saying unappropriated things about us, and also making fun of other customers. 

"Don't try to tell the customer what he wants. If you want to be smart, be smart in the shower. Then get out, go to work and serve the customer!" -

Nice busy place, with a lot of options to dine in, take out, eat outside. I chose to eat in, and the Pho and Spring Rolls were really good. Lots of meat in the Pho and nice to have that, as it is sometimes a rare thing, so much appreciated. A lot of nice and friendly people serving customers and working like a well-oiled machine.

Impressive first look when you enter the restaurant. A large area with to go snacks. However, I was totally disappointed with the dinning in food. The taste or total lack of taste for all the three dishes we ordered. Not the good authentic taste of true Vietnamese food. For this the rating is 1. 
The saving grace for this restaurant is the to go counter with variety of the tofu snacks, banh mi, spring rolls and a variety of bakery choices. The service is friendly. 
I may come back for the snack counter but definitely not dinning in
The BEST! Great restaurant and food market. I drive all the way from St Petersburg to buy the homemade tofu. Highly recommend!

Vietnamese food is in my top 3 for sure. Most, if not all of the Vietnamese don't mind the slurping of the noodle . Thinh An is my go to in Tampa because their food has the most flavor. The customer service here is fantastic and you have to stop by the bakery on your way out!!!

Seriously I felt like I was eating out of a dumpster. I ordered shrimp and pork udon noodles. 75% of pork was fat, soup base cold and 2 shrimp. Egg rolls cold and appeared to have been microwaved after frying.. Their take out process was nightmare. Worst Vietnamese food I've ever had. Over hyped and under delivered. Horrible. This spot is to be avoided!
Love the food!  Love the service!  The bakery is awesome!  If you like authentic Vietnamese food, this place does not disappoint.

This place is a very fast pace restaurant. We arrived at 7:30pm, ordered right away then received our food within 5 minutes, however we did order their pho and spicy soup. Both of our meals were delicious. Their Crabmeat Rangoon are just ok, didn't taste any sort of crabmeat. For only $10 you get a large bowl of soup you can also upgrade to a bigger bowl for $2 extra. Their bakery's almond croissant is a must try!!! So good!
One down side that we didn't like is that the place is jammed packed. Tables were so close to each other! I would suggest take out for those who are very cautious around this time.
Excellent Vietnamese cuisine. Selling one of best tofu I've had in America. All food are packaged well and clean. Great customer service.

Did this place get the Covid effect?  I don't know but, bland is what comes to mind!  I used to love their pho, however a whole new opinion today!  The chicken was pulverized!!!! I'm hoping this is just a fluke, considering the positive reviews!  I ordered Rangoon's that were all stuck together, and spring rolls fried to a crisp!  I recommend their competition on fletcher instead!!! Not all it's cracked up to be, sorry...just being honest!

Ok I'm giving three stars because it's always packed by people of similar decent that get serviced . The food is always good . But due to service or lack there of I give less stars . I go to many Vietnamese restaurants and only feel this way at this establishment. Was a little better when they had other ethnic backgrounds working there but that has not been the case for sometime . They also offer a "shrimp " egg roll but they don't tell you it's mixed with pork . I don't eat pork and they would not tk it off or apologize for the misleading menu . Food is good service is not .

Like: Everything but the Pho. They have some hard to find dishes here like Hu Tieu Kho and Bun Moc, Vietnamese Curry. They have clay pot fish that you can buy, it comes in the clay pot, you have to return the clay pot though. 

Dislikes: the pho. Not sure why but the pho tastes strange in Tampa, I think they use Beef Broth from a can or something. It tastes different from Pho anywhere else in the country or even when you cook it at home. 

It's better staffed than most Viet no Me's restaurants, so they're nicer and friendlier than most. Something must be right about this when you can't find a table. Loved it.

Btw this is something cool to try next time you eat here. When you leave and you're all done, take a second to smell your armpit. Just do it. I promise you'll be surprised.

I loveeeeeee this place!!! It's always amazing and great prices!!! Great staff, great service, super fast, fresh, I could go on and on, seriously. Just go and try it for yourself and you'll be hooked!

The hotel front desk called for a cab, and the driver was on time. That would earn him 5 stars. What takes away 2 stars is the inside of the cab that was dirty, with fare information that was torn and faded. Obviously the owners don't care about their fleet. 

The driver was courteous, but did not look very professional in his sweat pants, but he got the job done to get me from point A to B.

I have been coming here for quite some time and have ordered out several times.This is the first time I have ordered an extra large and when I got it I noticed it was in the same container as my large has been.I went back in and talked to one of the employees and she pointed out to me the the difference between a large and extra large.I ran into the owner and he confirmed what the employee said to me.The large and extra large come in the same size container,the difference is the large is below the line and the extra large is above the line.I have included pictures.The food is great but just don't order the extra large pho to go.

This is one of many places that serves authentic Indonesian dishes in Philadelphia.

The location is fairly new, overtaking the space previously occupied by Sky Cafe. Almost everywhere in Philly parking spot is scarce. The restaurant can be packed at times because of its popularity and delicious dishes. The business hour is rather short considering it's closed at 8pm still during dinner time.

The food is as authentic as you can get. One of their special dessert is "Ropang". It's a grilled texas toast topped with chocolate sprinkles and grated cheese. Now take a minute and drool! This is why I come to this place. Their main dishes easily compete with other Indonesian restaurants in the area, but I must admit they are no less delicious and flavorful. My only wish is they add more selection to the appetizer list as it lacks the basics found in other places (i.e., "Batagor", etc.). My last visit was quite unsatisfactory as, in addition to not finding the appetizers I crave, some of the items in their Daily Special were finished and that special dessert was also finished.

Other than that, the service has always been superb. Staff have always been kind and attentive to the patrons. Delivery did not take too long and I have found no errors in any of my orders.

I'll probably come back here but not anytime soon. There are other places to try. However, I do recommend friends to try the delicious food this place has to offer.
I've dined here twice now and it has been fabulous both times.  Quick, Hot, Delicious food.
The worst bike shop I've been to. Didn't fix anything, expensive, and terrible customer service.
Fantastic place! Great ambience and food. We were blown away by the pho. Can't wait to  come back!
Favorite pho in Tampa. Fast service, great food and price. They have a small market inside as well to get take home foods.

Love it here! Everything I have ever ate here has been delicious the make your own pho is my favorite and definitely go to the bakery and grab something sweet and also enjoy a boba tea. I will say the service can be hit or miss as far as friendly dynamic but the service for food is always quick even in a packed night.
Amazing! Everything is flavorful, staff is wonderful, not one complaint from us. May be our new weekly spot.

One of my favorite restaurants there pho soup is like best remedy on a rainy day or a good remedy when not feeling well also love there chai tea with boba and there cafe with condensed milk my kids love there egg puff waffle with ice cream the inside is beautiful and clean

WOW! I haven't had Mexican food like this since...I was in Mexico and even then it wasn't THIS good! 

The tortilla's are homemade and delicious! The tacos we had were so good and the tequila selection was amazing. Karol the owner was so knowledgeable about the tequilas and gave us a tasting sampler and taught us the different  types of tequila and how good tequila can be beyond the typical Cuervo stuff everyone knows. I was sipping tequila which I NEVER would have done before and I LOVED it!

They served us a 6 pound lobster that had spices and sauces that honestly might have been the best thing I have ever eaten in my life! It was tender and delicious and not reliant on butter to taste good. 

This place is the real deal and the prices are excellent!

Make sure you try the guacamole. it is the best I have ever had in my entire life. Seriously. It is outrageously good! 
Everything was perfect and I am already planning to return on Friday night!

There I was, 6:45 pm on a Wednesday. I'm new to Philly and just downloaded the app for points and coupons.
