I'm at the check out, I don't know how to use the machine and I've scanned something incorrectly and the coupons aren't taking. Then, out of what I can only assume is heaven, comes Melissa. She was the kindest clerk who helped me and was incredibly patient. She's the standard for great customer service and I want her to be in charge of all groceries from now on.

I wish I lived in Tampa.  I don't know anything about Tampa except that Thinh An is here, but that's enough.  We were only in Tampa for one day, but we loved this place so much that we ate here twice.

I've been a vegetarian for about 12 years now, so when I say this is the best tofu I've ever had, you should understand that I've had a lot of tofu.  I've also had really great vegetarian Vietnamese food in Southern California, and this place beats anything I've eaten there.

We shared the vegetarian fresh rolls, and I got a Thai milk tea and the lemongrass tofu broken rice dish.  My husband had a lychee boba tea and a beef stew dish with bread.  All of it was amazing.  I don't use my adjectives lightly (I do teach writing, after all); I really was amazed by this tofu.  I don't know how they got it to taste so good, other than the fact that it's made fresh in house.

I got several pastries and flavors of tofu from the hot bar, all of which were excellent.  For dinner, my husband had a banh mi, which was huge and cheap, and he really enjoyed it.  We tried the cream puffs, which were just okay.  I also tried the sweetened iced soy milk, which didn't taste anything like soy milk I'm used to getting from the grocery store.  It was a nuttier flavor than prepackaged soy milk.  

Y'all are lucky to have a gem like this.
I would like to Thank them for providing Mease Countryside Hospital with Delicious Food. By far the best vietnamese food i've had in a long time. Thank You Soo Much!!!!!

This is a very good place for lunch/dinner in Town and Country.
You can sit and dine in or look around at the buffet of take away items they offer.Pork buns,tofu,stew,green papaya salad and more
Must try the fresh baked croissants-yes-they bake many variety.The Ban -Mi roast pork-juicy and filling.The Beef tendon Pho is delightful .We also got the Rainbow drink-coconut cream with ice and sweet mung beans,green jelly and pinto beans.Plenty of seating inside and out.Priced reasonable,service quick with a smile.

Did a take out here for the first time. Not too crazy over majority of the food. We ordered yellow rice, rendang over rice, rojak was watery and not tasty at all, fried noodle was not bad, sweet soy sauce pork over rice which was not good - the picture looked so good but not in reality. Price are reasonable for Philly. I may not return since I prefer the other indo restaurant in Philly.

My hubby and I went here a few
Months ago with 2 other families and loved it! I had
The meatball Pho along with some spring rolls and both were amazing! I was very impressed with the service for a table of 8. Everything came out accurately and at the same time. I know they offer Bobo teas which many at our table love and said theirs were very good. I am not a fan so opted for just iced tea . My hubby ordered a giant bowl of
Soup. (He coined the phrase BABOS which means Big Ass Bowl of Soup) and loved it. We are actually planning on our 2nd visit tonight where I may try something new.. But the meatball soup was so good I may just order it again. Definitely a place
To try out here in Tampa!!

RJ liked it. 
Karen couldn't stand the smell.
Chris was okay with the shake but hated the fruit.

We all had a good laugh at Chris' reaction after eating the fruit. 

Thinh An is not a good place if you have a group larger than 6. There definitely will be a wait if you go on the weekend, especially Sunday.

Our server, whom I've had during other visits, is always so attentive and works really hard. Plus, it's always nice to see our Elite buddy, Melinda.

Good food as always. You have to try the tofu.

We had good time.
Ordered delivery a few times, burgers and chicken mostly. We always enjoyed the food, arrived when expected, but not always hot by the time we got it. We will continue to eat here, solid menu.

Just go, if you are reading this you are looking for great Vietnamese,  go.


IMO better than Saigon Deli

I've been here numerous times and finally putting a review together. This is a good place with an expansive menu. Whether it be their large Pho bowls or Chinese crossovers, you can't go wrong here. I usually gravitate towards one of the sandwiches they have at under $4 and throw an egg roll in for a buck or two more, or I do the spicy curry chicken / potato plate with bread at $8.00.
The Pho Bowls are all around that 7-10 range, and you'll be leaving with a take out bag. 
Wait times are ok, even at busy times. They run 13-18 minutes. It's a keeper, try them.

VIBE- 3
TASTE-4
VALUE- 3.5
SERVICE- 3.5
WAIT TIME- 3.5
CLEANLINESS- 3.5

Overall- 3.5 STARS

Excellent service. Food was delicious and cooked to perfection. Our server was very professional. I ordered the Mixed Vegetables w/ Seafood Rice, Stir Fried Flat Noodles, Colossal Shrimp, and Happy Mango to drink. Our food came out in a short amount of time. I love this place and will definitely be back

I try to come in here at least once a month over the last few years to treat myself. Their Arizona roll is just the right amount of spicy and it is one of my favorites. The fresh sushi almost always gets me though. It is fast, delicious, fresh, and inexpensive. Oh and do yourself a favor and try the boba green tea.
Love this place to pieces- my only wish was the dining area was updated- no complaints ever.. EVERYONE IS SO beautifully kind. Food is amazing!

Watch out for these scoundrels.  Read your receipt carefully.  When you have a bunch of things to be charged, they punched in the prices fast n furious. My bill was 19 plus some changes. Turned out they over charged me $5.15.

Very disappointed. The food and drinks were decent not great. The service was ok. Just disappointed how the cashier and the owner treat their own race customers. There was a different treatment between us and the Caucasian couple next to us. They were not friendly at all. Usually when I go to a restaurant, the first impression (the host) is the most important. There was no smile or greeting which made me felt as they did not welcome us to their restaurant. And before we left, there was still no smile or made us not want to come back. We had been here before since they were first open and not as busy as now. However, the service was much better. Often when I go to Florida to visit family, I want to support our vietnamese restaurants but this is definitely not the one.
The owner is very rude and my food wasn't great. Cold meat on my gyro and you can do better. Why settle for poor customer service with mediocre food.
OMG I'm in Heaven. There are lots of food here. Everything is great! Very busy at 2pm on Saturday afternoon

Went with a couple of friends that recommended this location, so glad we listened. I'm not an expert but I think this is as authentic as you're going to get. Everyone loved their choices and even though they were packed, the food and drinks came out pretty quickly. 

We don't live close enough to go more often, but if we did, we certainly would.

I just had a very discouraging shopping trip to my local ACME supermarket in the Chestnut Hill section of Philadelphia (Crittenden Ave Store).  I am a 69 year old man who pays attention to the way businesses I shop at adhere to (or not) the Covid protocols for Philadelphia.  The first two employees I encountered (in the produce dept.) were chatting together, one with mask only over his mouth and the other with mask over neither his mouth or nose.  I asked them politely whether their store manager instructs them on the proper way to wear protective equipment.  One said yes and pulled his mask up slightly in embarrassment.  The other said yes as well and made no effort to cover either his mouth or nose.  I went to the manager who was working on the floor, wearing his mask only over his mouth.  When I asked him about the protocols he requires for his employees, he pulled his mask up slightly and said he would speak with his employees.  Later when I circled back to produce to shop both men were again wearing mask incorrectly.  I asked if they had been approached by the manager and they said yes.  This time the most resistant employee pulled his mask up enough to cover only his mouth and said, "He told us to cover our mouth."  When I went back to see the manager, I found him again working on the floor this time with his own mask covering neither his mouth or his nose.  I cannot shop here any longer.  It is not a safe environment.

If you big on customer service this ain't the place to order from I was on the phone with a guy that was taking my order and he was talking to nasty and rude when I ask to speak with a manager he got real hype Like IM The Owner if you own the place & ya customer service like that I can just bet the employees are the same way... No Thanks

Started with Chicken Satay as appetizer, charred on the outside and juicy in the inside. Topped with peanut sauce and cucumber pickles.
Continue with entree, the GREEN noodle is superb!!! It's made from veggies 
I don't feel guilty with the carb I ate, because there is no carb, it's veggie noodle 
My second favorite entree is called Soto Betawi, broth made with mixed curry and coconut milk, filled with beef cube, beef tripe.. it's rich in flavor and super tasty.
Finish the meal with Ice shaved, sweet and refreshing.
This is a must place to visit when you are in the area.

My friends and I were coming from a festival and while we were looking for a bite to eat, this place popped up and I have to say that we are glad to have stopped because I have to say that this is the best truck food that I have ever tried! I had the Paisa Burger and it is phenomenal! It came out to $11 with fries and a drink, which I think is reasonable, because of the amount of flavor you are getting and quantity. It was so big i couldn't finish the other half. They give you pink, green, and pineapple sauces so you pour them into your burger and you get an amazing mix of flavors! You will not regret visiting this place!

I love D'Jakarta. I have tried several Indonesian restaurants in Philly and this one is the best one. The one dish that really stands out is the minced shrimp fritter( Hekeng). I was nicely surprised to find this dish here. It is a famous Chinese Indonesian dish from Pontianak and you won't find it anywhere outside of Pontianak except at a couple of Pontianak restaurants in Jakarta. 

The Soto Betawi, pork satays, fried broad noodle( kwe tiau goreng), Ketoprak (Jakarta version of gado gado), Grilled fish and Nasi goreng are also amazing. 

Having grown up in Indonesia, I can assure you this place is as authentic as it gets.

La comida es muy buena, los precios están bien pero la atención no es mala es pésima, hay una Barranquilla es que te contesta todo como si fueras a pedir regalada tu comida, fui dos veses pensando que la primera había sido ese día en particular pero decepcionante la atención, que lastima el sitio es limpio la comida muy rica pero no voy a pagar por un plato en el cual solo ordenando me voy a sentir regañado o atacado MUY MAL SERVICIO AL CLIENTE NO LO RECOMIENDO EN ABSOLUTO.

Thinh An undoubtedly serves up some of the best Vietnamese food in Tampa. However, they do not enforce social distancing, and I felt uncomfortable entering the restaurant to get my takeout.

I ordered a special combination banh mi and the chicken egg rolls go to. I was told to pick them up in 15 minutes. I showed up 5 minutes early, so I shopped in their small market and picked up some caramelized pork belly and a banh tet chuoi. You pay for the market food and also any take out food at the cash registers, then you bring the receipt to the pick up area, and they'll give you your food.

I thought the banh mi was excellent, nice thick cuts of meat, fresh veggies, and a nice amount of pate. The egg rolls were dry. The pork belly was okay, but there were definitely areas where the fat felt unrendered. The banh tet chuoi was huge and had large areas without banana.

I absolutely want to return for pho and other Vietnamese dishes, but the place was so packed that I'm not returning until a higher percentage of the population has been vaccinated. Even getting carryout was a problem as there's no place in the restaurant that isn't packed with diners (who obviously aren't wearing masks). You can order delivery through Door Dash and Uber Eats, although I usually try not to use those services as they take such a high percentage from businesses.

We heard about D'jakarta Cafe from JL Jupiter on YouTube. The place did not disappoint. We were sad to not be able to eat indoors, but they have great safety measures in place because of COVID. The food was amazing. Rich and flavorful. Tastes like we were invited into someone's home kitchen. We had the Nasi Rendang and Nasi Goreng Special. Both were phenomenal. Highly recommend seeking out this gem in Philly.

Acme is one of those stores you only visit when necessary.

This location is especially depressing in the setup and overall aesthetics. As another review mentions the store is dimly lit and it is nearly impossible to maneuver without walking into another shopper.

Shoppers in this location can be unique to say the least. 

At this point I see no purpose in shopping at Acme with Whole Foods next door. If your budget allows for alcohol, cigarettes, cable, or a cell phone yet you are concerned about paying 39cents more for higher quality groceries, you are living with outdated priorities.
This places makes fresh and very good tofu.  On the other hand, noodle soups were not good at all, too sweet and not authentic ingredients.
So many options and sooo good. The curry chicken is the best and sometimes I just go craving for it.
It's a smaller version of regular Acme supermarkets but it can meet your basic grocery needs. There's salad bar and they carry wine and beer too. It's a way better than Superfresh used to be.

Associates may not be all the most friendly, but I had a wonderful experience here.  Everyone was helpful, day or night, and this place was conveniently located for me when I visited Philly.  Walked to this location 3 times in 4 days.  The prices were reasonable and definitely were a good alternative to Whole Foods right across the street.
Phenomenal food, service took a little long however. The chicken pho is practically perfect and convenient for picky eaters who like to customize food.

At the end of the ride I swiped my credit card and the driver said it would not process my card. I paid the driver in cash and 3 days later there is a $17 charge from United Cab on my CC. Numerous attempts via email and phone calls and no one will respond to me. Lesson learned... if you pay a driver cash after he says your credit card did not go through make sure you get a sighed and time dated receipt from the driver.
Been coming here for years! My favorite is the Pho Beef noodle soup and the spring rolls and fried egg rolls! The also have traditional Vietnamese coffee and condensed milk! Yummy!!
Great food and quick service. I love that they have their ready made food section. Good selection of Vietnamese favorites and good flavors. Best Vietnamese place in the area.

All I have to say is WOW! The food was exceptional and the staff was excellent. This is easily the best Vietnamese  restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. We ordered the Krab Rangoon, Pho, Banh Mi, and BBQ Pork Spring Rolls. I would recommend all of these items. The portion sizes were way more than you would pay for anywhere else. I will definitely be coming back whenever I'm in the area

Fast, delicious food. There's plenty to choose from which may be overwhelming to some people but this was great! Everything we wanted in one place; crawfish, traditional Vietnamese food, boba, and dessert! The workers are great and attentive. The pho was one of the best down here during our visit, that homemade taste and the rest was just as great. Can't say enough good things

We were driving back home and was deciding what to eat.  It was a little late and there were only a handful of places still open.  We decided to come here as it was on the way back to the place. Ordered the Picada de la casa.  We brought it back home and it was delicious.  Its like a sampler platter with all the Colombian carvings.  I especially enjoyed the chicharron.  I would definitely come here again especially if I'm in the area.

I actually really enjoyed coming here! The service was a bit aloof but I honestly think it's cultural more than anything. I decided to jump out of my comfort zone and order the es cendol, which is a rice jelly drink with coconut milk, which reminds me of pandan if you've ever had it. Very Southeast Asian.

The stir-fried egg noodle dish (Bakmi Goreng Djakarta) was definitely the highlight for me of the things we ordered. I guess because it was familiar as far as Asian food goes. I also liked the Ketoprak, but I think because the flavor profile of that dish was more subtle, it kind of paled in comparison.

As a final dive, we tried the ropang, which is the most Asian thing I've ever eaten (and I ate a lot of strange combos in 5 months in Korea). It's literally shredded cheese on top of a Nutella grilled sandwich with sprinkles. It wasn't disgusting, but it's...definitely an acquired taste.

Look, I'm saying come here for good food and stepping out of your comfort zone because this isn't your neighborhood Chinese and Pho. We're in Philly!

Had pho here for the first time about 4 days ago. Impressed. Not a huge place but by no means small.
Menu has a lot to offer. Prices are good. I'll definitely be going back.

You won't get too Thinh off the food at Thinh An, but it'll be worth it.

Sadly, I'm not a fan. I got told to move while waiting for my sandwich (grr), and that never works out well (grr), I mean there were a dozen empty tables (although the place was kinda busy), and the table was helpful since I had bags with me, but no.

And said sandwich was mostly just average - good bread, okay meat, good veggies, but the pickled carrots were way sweet and overpowered the whole thing. 

Viet coffee wasn't good. Bit of a waste in the end.

Caught a couple of employees making fun of me too, and that's not working out so well for them rating wise.

Family business so I'll just about slide them a 3 but it could easily have been 2.
Love the huge variety of the menu. Huge menu of boba and I like that we can buy snacks on the other side of the restaurant. Would definitely recommend to a friend.

Excellent food, drinks, service, price and portions. The grilled pork rolls were meaty. The broken rice with pork chop and beef ribs were also good, though personally I prefer mine less saucy. The vermicelli was also really tasty. Overall everything we ordered were really delicious, and so many selections with foods, drinks and desserts we wish we had more room to try them all. The staff members were all very nice and efficient. My husband's beer was almost empty and they were there to ask if he needed another. The price was more reasonable for the quality and quantity of food.

I am so excited for this place to be so close to me!

Food- We got the BEEF PHO (kids size), HUE STYLE BEEF RICE NOODLE SOUP, and COMBO UDON NOODLE SOUP. Everything was SO good and all broths were soooo flavorful. Its so hard to find udon with a good flavro broth so I was very excited. Also the udon noodle was different that I've ever had and was very tasty. The beef pho was also very good, it was ALMOST as good as my favorite beef pho from Saigon Deli. The hue style beef was also very yummy but not spicy at all even though it was labeled spicy. Good thing they have ALL the hot sauces on the table (garlic pepper, pepper oil, and saracha)! Theres also so many choices of main entrees and desserts/drinks. SO MANY. 

Price- Prices were all very good! Everything I looked at was under $10. I mean $3 for a kids pho that was actually a normal sized bowl to me?!?! AWESOME!

ATMOSPHERE- So clean and new! Pretty good size and people kept coming in!

LOVE LOVE

What a wonderful meal I had at D'jakarta Café - a corner Indonesian restaurant deep in South Philly.  I really liked everything about it.  Totally!  The food was very tasty beginning with the meatball soup in a chicken broth.  That was followed by a generous serving of Pangsit Goreng accompanied by a sweet chili sauce.  Now the main course of Bakmi Kecil was everything I like about Indonesian cuisine .... full of robust flavors & spices with meats and nuts and eggs and veggies over a bed of thin noodles.  Their house-made sambal was a perfect blend-in with this dish and a thickened soy sauce added just the right touch.  Service was extremely friendly and watchful .... water glass refilled, serviette replaced etc. And all the art work on the walls is cool - interesting photos and a commissioned wall-sized drawing of D'jakarta.

Now get this .... all this cost about ten dollars!  Talk about value for money!!  Five stars is an easy assignment for D'jakarta Cafe!!
I am glad they carry Van Leuwen famous ice cream from Brooklyn. The ingredients are natural and very homemade. The peanut butter marshmallow crunch is amazing
Just ordered for take out. Love their nasi ayam bakar, and Soto betawi. Just the right amount of spice, and their samba sauce is amazing.

Don't use this company, even if it's more expensive, use Uber or Lyft. This company is full of sh**. I spent $40 to get from TPA to the corner of Dale Mabry and Kennedy, the driver made me pre-pay "in case there was no internet at the destination" and joked that he though I was going to Dale Mabry and Gandy when I arrived less than 6 miles from where I started. DONT USE THIS COMPANY.

I was invited to join some friends here for dinner. I was pleasantly surprised to see a modern clean restaurant with friendly staff.
The menu has so many options from fancy drinks to many types of dishes to choose from. Our group ordered various items including some of the sandwiches. The food was all served quickly and tasted great! The sandwich was huge and such a great value. All the food is really I had so much in my bowl that my left overs turned into 2 more meals.

The dessert was also amazing the coconut ice cream over a vanilla waffle...YUM!!

I look forward to coming back here and occasionally picking up to go food. They have an entire area where you can walk in and pick a few items that are ready there on the counter or in the fridge to take home to eat later.

A great new place in Town and Country!

Wonderful! First, bright, clean and cozy environment( remind me back home in Asia) *outdoor seatings for nice weather!!
And the friendly staff are always a plus(no more angry Vietnamese like those on Clark rd!)
Needless to say the food!! for $7 a bowl of Pho with loaded goodies, great flavors, I am happy!!
I also didnt miss our traditional Asian dessert: hot, sweet tofu with ginger. Yum. Its huge too.
Whats on my mind the entire time? Buy the bakery, soy milk, tofu,.....home! ^____^ What a trip!!!
I ordered a vegan bowl and it was so good!!! Full of flavor . Definitely recommend this place. They offer so many options and all of them are delicious.

Amazing service and amazing food! Normally I always get to go orders from here but I didn't want to deal with dishes or clean up at home so I decided to go in for dinner! Talk about quick service, ordered and got our food and ate within 30 mins! The wonton noodle soup is one of my favorites! Super filling and def big enough to share! We also ordered the crab Rangoon that is also pretty delicious! Big portions at a little price! Soup and crab rangoon both priced under $14 ! One of the best Vietnamese restaurants in my area for sure !

We arrived on a busy Saturday night, 30 min. before they closed. Our waitress seemed frazzled. To start, we asked for an extra large bowl of combination beef noodle soup. 

When it arrived, the portions were generous. The beef noodle soup came with slices of rare steak, well done flank, tendon, meat balls & tripe. I omitted the tendon. They forgot to put tripe in, so I had to ask for it. We asked for an extra large order of beef noodle soup, but when the owner stopped by our table, he said with an extra large order, there's typically two take out containers instead of one because the portions are huge. However, I was still amazed at how much meat was in our bowl. Also, it was sweet that the owner packed our leftover soup for us. He saw how my husband was struggling and jumped in. We got BBQ pork sandwich to share. For my half, it tasted fatty and I didn't think there was a lot of meat in it. I hope the next time we order a sandwich, it'll have more meat in it and not be fatty.

At the end of the night, at least 10 other people came in for dinner; I didn't feel rushed.
This will be my go to place because of the fast service, large portions, & clean atmosphere!

Although the office is clean and modern, this office should spend less time watering their plants and more time doing actual work! I had only been a patient for a year but every time I went there was a different issue. At my first visit, they didn't check my insurance before hand. The second time their computer system with the patient charts wasn't working and the hygienist was on the phone with IT the entire time she was cleaning my teeth. Also, when I asked them to send my chart to another dentist it took 3 phone calls.

My biggest complaint is that the hygienist seemingly knew more than the actual dentist! I'm assuming he knows his stuff but he was so impersonal that you wouldn't even know. He failed to discuss anything that the hygienist mentioned to me beforehand without me asking... and he was already half way out the door. Honestly, I don't even know his name because he never introduces himself. He literally poked around for a minute and said he was done.

Very disappointing and I do not recommend!!

I love this restaurant.  Among least expensive and best menu in Tampa area.  I come from Green Cove Springs FL 170 miles away and always stop by here.

My one complaint:  men's bathroom:  needs to have separate stall for toilet.  Every time I need to wash my hands , there is someone inside locking the door and I have to check back 1-2 more times.  This is unsatisfactory in the time of Corona virus.

Plus another complaint:  workers need to wear gloves when handling newly cleaned dining wares like chop sticks & spoons.  We need to minimize bacteria & virus transfer.

This restaurant is always busy, but the staff is very quick on turning tables. We were given a pager and was seated in 10-15 minutes. There is a buffet with various appetizers and their specialty items of tofu. I ordered their combination pho, Pho Dac Biet, and tried one of their tofus. They serve their food very quickly so the overall wait time is not too bad. The broth is very flavorful and not too heavy. There are so many ingredients in the noodle soup with side add-ins, such as lime, bean sprouts, basil, cilantro, jalapenos etc. I've tried their combination rice vermicelli dish before and it was amazing with the combination of pork, shrimp, egg roll, etc. They have a variety of choices and all the dishes were authentic. Definitely a place worth trying and returning.

My roomie had been raving about this spot for weeks so when I went to visit her new place we decided to give this Cafe a try. I was NOT disappointed. The food here is authentic Indonesian with reasonable prices. The fried fish was almost comparable to my mother's (Indian style dish). 

It's not the biggest place in the world, but the food is fresh and homemade that I'll definitely be open to going here again.

They're ok if you're in a pinch and cannot venture farther to ShopRite etc. Haven't been in awhile but the prices are still one of the highest of the local chains. Not sure if this store is competing with nearby Whole Foods... but the prices of the items I got weren't that spectacular. Couldn't seem to find anything under $10...

Tried the Meatball Pho today for lunch... and it was very good. Has some shrimp Eggrolls too... and they are excellent! (just don't eat the shrimp tail, like my girlfriend did! lol!) Staff is great... very friendly!

This is one of our staples for Vietnamese food. It's so good, so fast, and very reasonably priced. It's a great experience every time. I love all of their soups. Come hungry, because the portions are big, which we love.

Take your business elsewhere.  I really wish this store would just go out of business and be replaced with a nicer store that offers fair prices and treats customers with more class.

Some of the sale prices can be extremely good (e.g. boxes of pasta for under $1 quite often, bananas for $0.69 a pound) but regular-priced items are often a ripoff. Kellogg's Special K might be over $5 a box when it's not on sale, when it's widely offered for $2.50 or so at cvs, rite aid, and walgreens almost all the time. 

Don't even think about buying soda here, as they will always build the city's soda tax into the prices, even though other nearby retailers like the Walgreens at 11th and Locust can offer 12 packs of soda for 3 for $9 still. 

Beer is available - and the selection is quite diverse. Unfortunately, it is taxed at 10%, which is a higher tax rate than you'll pay at the Bella Vista beer distributor just a few blocks south (not to mention their prices beat Acme's too). Whole Paycheck across the street also charges the 10% tax, but their beer prices are often lower than those here.

Management is probably aware of their non-competitive pricing, as I was yelled at by a manager one time recently and asked to put my phone away, after taking photos of a few price tags to send to a friend.  He said it was a "corporate policy" that no photos whatsoever can be taken in the store for any reason.  If a manager wants to spend his time harassing one person over such a trivial matter such as this, instead of doing "real" management work like dealing with the vendors and cashiers and suppliers, it says a lot about the mentality of those who work at this establishment.

Probably my favorite Viet food in town. The restaurant itself is a bit crowded. Not very good for the whole
Covid situation, but i guess that's cuz the food is that good. I order from this place take out probably once a week.
Decent pho. Good, cheap food. Restaurant is not the cleanest, service is average.

This was a really great spot!  I just moved out to Tampa and have been exploring the area; decided to try out this food.  They had such a huge menu!  Including an extensive vegetarian menu, which was very helpful for me as a vegetarian!  The service was also extremely friendly, and the restaurant was kept very clean.  It was also very busy and you could tell it was a hot spot, popular for a reason!

I was excited about getting Colombian food and came here. I ordered 2 drinks blackberry and tamarindo, they were both good definitely made from frozen pulp not from the fruit.The empanadas were bomb, very tasty!The hamburger was really good too, the meat was different from what I'm used to but delicious. Now the salchipapa was so salty my dad and I both stopped eating it. 5 hours later food didn't go down so smoothly. I'm guessing the food wasn't too fresh because of the pandemic. Last time I ate here was a couple of years ago and I stopped coming bc of the price, which hasn't changed. They do have some good business hours considering the pandemic.

Dined in today for the first time after eyeballing this place from the previous Yelp Reviews... so happy I finally did! Scrumptious, interesting food and various flavors very modestly priced. I got the chicken liver as an app - two hefty skewers worth, nice and crispy and flavored on the outside, makes eating healthy easy! Additionally got the veggies and chicken w fried rice- veggies and chicken were served in a flavorful broth, and I added the sriracha and sweet& spicy red sauce on the table which made it perfect. Finally, the worker there was so sweet and welcoming. Definitely gonna come back again and try something new!

I am very disappointed in this establishment! Originally, I gave it a good rating, but after going there for over five years, I am more disappointed each year! The dentist does not engage with you much, and it seems as if they just want to "up sell" you for more expensive services. Furthermore, I had to go to another dentist to be evaluated; after going to this dentist. I wound up having over four cavities, and almost had a root canal done. Although, my teeth had X-rays done every six months there?? I called to inquire a few times about the other dentist's evaluation, but no one called me back. Horrible follow up with concerned patients. Go somewhere else, where people really care about your teeth, and don't look at you for only making money.

Cannot believe I never tried this restaurant until recently. Their Vietnamese food is the best in the area even in the Tampa bay region. It's always packed but they have very good customer service and you won't need to wait too long before your food comes to your desk. I love their vegetarian egg sandwiches and veggie vermicelli. Pho is good as well. I plan to try all vegetarian options on their menu in the near future.

Found this on Yelp when we were in the area and it did not disappoint. We ordered online for pickup and everything was ready as expected. We had pho, two different ban mi, bun with pork and egg roll and some fresh rolls with shrimp. Everything was delicious and reasonably priced. My daughter added a boba tea while we were there and loved it.

I can't get enough of this place, casual Vietnamese fresh dining. This restaurant has a small market/bakery where you can box and just take different items home, I love trying new foods I haven't had before. This restaurant is usually pretty packed and with good reason, the food is delicious, they offer a huge variety and prices very affordable. I've tried a lot off their menu but the #79 special bahn mi is probably my favorite with an order of the Vietnamese iced coffee, my kids love the vermicelli, boba teas and desserts.

Bad attitude and food is not consistent (Food good one day and the next you're wasting money).
I ordered bacon cheeseburger w/extra onions, (let them know I was willing to pay for extra onions) received a cheeseburger with little onions. Called back to let them know I didn't have bacon on my burger and was informed I ordered earlier. I explained I was aware of when it was ordered, was informed it could not be replaced if it was eaten I explained the sandwich was not touched. This is not the first time I've had this issue with this restaurant.
Đồ ăn thì khỏi phải bàn, tốt đến tờng sợi mì từng muỗng nớc. Phục vụ nhiệt tình và dễ thng. Có 1 thứ cần phải thay đổi là sự sạch sẽ của toilet. Còn về phần đồ ăn và phục vụ thì Chất Lợng!

I had high hopes for finding a new dentist after my old one stopped taking my insurance. Unfortunately this is not the place for me. They cancelled my appt without telling me and without any reason. I had confirmed the appointment the day before over the phone. I showed up and they were shocked I was there. They told me that it was okay because they still had that time available. Then they made me wait an hour and acted like it was my fault for showing up to an appt I had made but they had accidentally cancelled. After a long wait and a confusing amount of animosity I went back for my cleaning. The dental assistant told me to let her know if anything she did hurt, and at one point she stabbed into my gums and I told her that it hurt. She shrugged and kept going. When the dentist came in he was cold and didn't talk to me or introduce himself just started telling the assistant about all the cavities he was going to fill in my mouth. I haven't had cavities in over 8 years and at my last dental appointment I had no signs of any cavities forming. I left knowing I would never go back. Oh and they were pushy about Invisalign when I have no interest in anything like that. I've been to places like this before. The worst kind of dentist.
Pho and spring rolls were excellent. Definitely a go to restaurant for a long time to come!

BBQ4U has been selling the best Tri-Tip in Southern Arizona for years. Santa Maria Tri-Tip is a style of barbecue from the part of California Bill and Sue are from.  They sell sandwiches packed with beef, burritos and whole Tri-Tio to go.  They are often at the market at Broadway and Houghton.

I have a bit of a mixed experience at this place. We got in and the place was decently packed but quickly got seated. There was a lot of wait staff working and we got helped by at least 3-4 of them during this particular visit. 

I ordered the beef short rib rice plate, flavor was good but my issue is with the beef itself. It was more fat than beef. A bit disappointing.

The bf got the beef bo kho, and while he enjoyed it, I thought it tasted more like a beef rendang than a bo kho. Some flavor was overpowering a bit too much.

My biggest issue was that we ordered the Shrimp spring rolls. These came and were promptly filled with pork, and yes a shrimp. As someone who does not eat pork, not stating in the item description or anywhere that even though it says "shrimp spring roll" it also contains pork is incredibly misleading. Once I told them, they were very quick to fix and bring me fresh shrimp rolls with extra shrimp. They did a great job on that.

They have limited items containing beef. Also check the menus on the wall as the banh mis listed there are not also listed on the menu you receive (thinking about the grilled chicken banh mi here)

I do give them credit for having the side section with lots of pastries and goodies. 

I would come back and try them again, but for now my favorite vietnamese place remains in Pinellas Park.

My gas dryer was not providing heat.  I made an appointment with Appliance Express Repair within two days.  Alex arrived within the time frame given.  He wore a mask.   He was able to fix the problem:  replace the bad coils.  Price was fair.  This is the second time I had used their services.  I definitely recommend them and would hire them again.

I got the chicken noodle soup with Krab Rangoon's with milk boba and lychee boba, it was one of the best foods I've ever had. They have very fast service with fresh hot food. I would recommend it to anyone.
Delicious, bustling, surprisingly inexpensive. Vegetarian options! Can't believe we didn't know it existed until now. Went last week, and will go again soon.
I don't know what's going on at Takka on Chelten Ave but a small pizza and onion rings should not cost $22.00!   Tax, bogus prices on menus, tips for service not served...wtf??
Very good! Even has a supermarket inside. Good service but tables very close together crammed in.

Although far from home, we frequent this place whenever we are on that side of town.  Have not been disappointed with any dishes thus far.  Appetizers (fried spring rolls and fresh roll) are ok, I've had better.  Mostly enjoy the various drinks and sweet soft tofu.  Pastries remind me of those at French bakery, especially almond croissant, excellent!

I like coming here for mango drinks and the salchipapa and I will say I've had the burger before as well. The food is very good but I customize it a lot to my taste. Sometimes they get it right and sometimes my order comes out wrong. But late nights when I don't feel like driving far I come here.

just got take out and the food was amazing! i never had indonesian food, but grew up eating many other southeast asian cuisines and its great. Different than thai but still has similar flavors/ dishes. Can't wait to try more!

I really wish I lived closer to this place. Great pho if you're looking for it but the whole menu is worth your visit. I personally love the bun bo hue. It's so good I finish the broth too and I don't do well with spicey. I almost always take a banh mi to go. My only real criticism is that its kinda small but that's not even a big enough issue for me to notice it.

Short:

Busy place, great food, ok service.  Come here for the authentic Vietnamese food and they even have a small area to buy bakery good or deserts.  

Long:

This place gets packed.  Come here expecting to have a wait if you come during normal lunch/dinner hour.  Service is quick but also a mess.  Everyone is everywhere, honestly, I got confused who my server was.  We ordered from 3 different people. 

The menu here is amazing.  I know what each item is as I'm familiar with Vietnamese food, but for new comers, the menu helps a lot.  Each item is accompanied by a picture.  This give a good visual idea of what you're ordering, no surprises.  This helps me out when introducing people to new types of food.

From what I've had, all the food is good.  The pho comes out quick, since the broth is already made. The other dishes like the broken rice combos, those take a little more time. 

Service is odd, they are all friendly but unattentive.  When ordering appetizers, it always comes out the same time as the food.  I understand they want to get people in and out, but we also would like to enjoy our food.  There was a few times where I needed a steak knife to cut my meat.  I asked our server and then 3 other people, it took at least 15 minutes to get a simple steak knife.  We didn't see our server at all once we got our food and had to get a different person to get our check.

Overall, place is good, service needs work.

Finally a breakfast sandwich next to my office! ok enough about my needs lol Loved this place it offers breakfast and lunch.  I ordered an egg and cheese breakfast sandwich on cuban bread with a double expresso, it's was $6 and well worth it.  Sandwhich was a great size, the cuban bread was fresh and eggs cracked on the spot. I will be a regular here for breakfast and lunch.  they have salads , sandwiches and for bread they offer white, wheat, rye, cuban bread and croissant.  I'm posting pics of menu.  Must

A traditional Vietnamese restaurant. They have Banh Mi that are the best food on the menu. They have the usual favorites and if you have never tried the xui mai you're missing out. I just recently tried it and was mad I had never eaten it before.  It's pork meatballs that have jicama as an ingredient and it's a tomato based soup that is savory and sweet. They sell it in the fridge case to take home. I just learned to make it I loved it so much. 

They have a nice selection of Vietnamese hams also and traditional Banh mi bread that's 5 for $2. There is a lot to choose from.
So good. Their pho is the freshest I've ever had and they have a great bakery. Very clean inside and always full of people.
The tofu is awesome! However, the owner is not too nice but the food is great.

I'll be going to Whole Foods across the street from now on. This place should honestly be given negative points from my experience.

It's Super Bowl Sunday and we're hosting a party of about 15 people. I need to pick up a few last minute items and the place is packed. The wife said it was as if a huge blizzard was coming as many shelves were bare. I grab some chips, solo cups, water and need to grab some ice on my way out. I mention this to the cashier so she can ring me up and she says they're out of ice. That's fine. There were multiple options in the area to get ice. 

I walk by the cooler and see bags of ice in there. I go back to the cashier and tell her that there's ice in the cooler. She says "oh, sorry. I didn't know they refilled it." So I asked if I could just grab a bag now. She tells me I'll have to go to the back of the line that is now, no exaggeration, about 12 people deep after already waiting in the line that was about 12 people deep. 

Obviously, since we needed ice, we wait until about 30 minutes before the party to get it so it wouldn't melt. So i'm trying to figure out what my best options are now. I really didn't think there was enough time to get back in line again. Even if there was, I shouldn't have to since I had already waited in the ridiculously long Disney World like line. 

I asked her why I had to go back and wait in line when I already did that and it was her mistake to tell me they were out of ice. Honestly, I could've just grabbed the ice and walked out the door and no one would've known but I would never do that. She says again, "sorry, you have to go to the back of the line." 

Another Acme employee is at the register checking out at the time. They obviously know each other and look at each other and smirk. I stand there in rather stunned silence. The cashier says nothing else and just ignores me as of I'm not there. After about a minute, she finally says you can go to customer service if you really need help. She said it in the most rude way with her back turned to me. So I went to customer service and 10 minutes later, I got the help I needed but...

Wow.

We come in wait for a long time to get our drinks that we order. My husband noodles with grilled meats and shrimp extra shrimp patties,it come out meat. My shrimp soup never came out this I was happened last time same waiter same soup and the same thing he told me I didn't order it both times. And gotta watch your bill they add more items on the recipe that not belong to you not happy both time

One of the best Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa. This place is always packed whenever I come. I love the section where you can pick your own food including pastries, tofu, shrimp paste, etc. It is a plus when all of the servers can speak English well and understand what you need. I would strongly recommend this place to all of my American friends who want to try Vietnamese food.

I'm no expert on Indonesian food and I'm primarily a plant based gal, but I still really enjoy D'jakarta, a small friendly authentic corner spot deep in the heart of South Philly! 

So far we've tried the happy lychee and happy mango drinks and enjoyed them both, with the mango being a favorite. It's piled high with tons of fruit and had a waterice/smoothie consistency. Definitely go for one of their fruity drinks, even if just to split and taste! 

We're big fans of ketoprak, a traditional vegetarian dish from Jakarta, which consists of tofu, vegetables and rice cake, rice vermicelli served in peanut sauce! It's so flavorful! 
*They can and will sub the fried egg to make it vegan!

I love their tamarind soup! It's located on the back sheet of the menu and it's easy to miss. It comes in small or large with a sweet and sour base, cabbage, peanuts and potatoes! Most recently we added a side of their delicious coconut rice for just $2 to bulk it up! So good!!!

We've tried their spring rolls which are perfectly fried and crispy! They come with an insane tangy peanut dipping sauce I could eat an entire bowl of!! 

Hubs recently had the chicken wontons and said while they were tasty, they had too much dough. He prefers the satay. 

The menu can be a bit overwhelming to newbies and/or plant based folks, but it's definitely worth venturing out for! I have yet to be disappointed by anything! 

For those from Indonesia or who are experts in the cuisine, they all rave about it here! 

BYO! 
Street parking is typical South Philly and requires a bit of patience.
Imo their food is really good, great customer service. Too many options to choose. Definitely will coming back sometime in the future.

I have been wanting some Bahn Mi... so we headed over to Thinh An after reading all of the great reviews. 2:00 pm Saturday afternoon, and the place was packed. Parking required waiting a bit, until someone else left. But it was worth it!

We went in, got seated fairly quickly by some very friendly staff. Another staff member (Duy) showed up almost immediately to take our order... we ordered some hot tea, and told him we would order when he came back with that.  

Menu looks great, good selection of Vietnamese dishes, with some nice pictures on back.  I asked my girlfriend to let me order for both of us... and when Duy came back, I ordered the BBQ pork Bahn Mi (one for each of us) and an order each of the BBQ Pork SpringRolls, and the Pork and Shrimp SpringRolls.  The food arrived quickly, and was delicious. The Sandwich rolls are baked right there... and they are GOOD! Tender soft inside, and a bit of crunchy crust on the outside. The pork and other items on the sandwich were yummy, fresh, tangy, crunchy, sweet, sour... just so many wonderful flavors and textures all mixing together. Just needed a small shot of Sriracha to light it up a little bit.

This was my girlfriends first time for Bahn Mi... and she is in LOVE, lol! Now she wants to learn to make springrolls at home too!

One of the owners / managers dropped by to say hi... always a good sign that they are trying to ensure an excellent experience. Nice people all the way around! 

Food was awesome and service was terrific! We are talking about what we will order on our next trip!

Don't miss stopping by for a sandwich or two, or some of the fabulous looking Pho they serve. You will not regret it!
Thing An is our family's comfort food in the best possible sense. The menu is huge and it is always good. Tampa is lucky to have them!

Fantastic Vietnamese sandwiches.

I wasn't planning to go here, but when I saw the name I remembered I read great Yelp reviews about this place. First of all, parking is a total nightmare. It could have been that I went at noon on a Friday, but there is a small parking lot in the front (all spots were taken) and a small parking lot in the back (all spots were taken). I ended up making my own spot and hoping that take out would be super quick. 

Even though the lot was packed there were still plenty of seats if I wanted to eat there. (I didn't because I kept thinking with each passing second my car was about to be hit by a driver who couldn't get out). I did a mad dash around the pre made food section and grabbed a tofu spring roll package. I wanted to try more, but their favorite meat is pork (I can't eat pork). At the counter I ordered a vegetarian banh mi and then thought about it and changed it to two. Each banh mi is $3.50 which is on the lower side of what I've found in Tampa Bay. 

I was sad that they didn't have a beef option. I saw on the screen that they have a new chicken banh mi, but I thought tofu sounded better. 

It took about five minutes for my sandwiches and then I sprinted out of there. Note that if you spend less than $5 they don't accept card. 

Once I got home I tore open my sandwich and dove in. The bread was crispy.  The tofu was seasoned perfectly. I definitely made a mess around the table. The pickled vegetables complemented the tofu well. The spring rolls were also very good. I made it through one sandwich and half sping roll and I couldn't eat any more. Although writing this review is making me want to go back for more sandwich. 

I am a huge fan of this place and I'm sure I'll be stopping by for more banh mis...possibly weekly.

The fried pork egg rolls with the fish sauce are very appetizing. You have to try the PHÒ TÀI soup with rare beef... It's definitely the best by far....
Very friend, attentive and the price is reasonable. My go to place for Vietnamese food.

Love their pizza. They have great steaks and the service is always with a smile. They are very kind and friendly. They guys in the kitchen are great at food and make sure that it is all done right. From what I can tell the owners are there every time I order something. I had moved to the neighborhood for a few months while I looked for a place to buy and they were a weekly order out. I loved the food and I loved the service. 

They have 2 leter sodas and lots of choices to shooed from. The place is clean but small still have room to sit and eat.

This place was really packed but they offered great takeout service. We called in our order and had a chance to browse the bakery area before checking out. They have plenty of snacks and bakery treats, so check this area out before checking out. Don't forget to check out the refrigerators too, as they've got some really good desserts. 

We tried the bun bo hue and chicken curry, along with the spring rolls with shrimp and pork. The bun bo hue had a decent spice kick to it, but the noodles are so good. The chicken curry came with bread that goes so well for dunking. 

One of my fave viet spots in the area .

I called United Cab about an hour ahead to secure a cab.  I was scheduled for a medical procedure that prohibited me from driving afterward.  I called at 15 minutes after the appointed time and the dispatcher told me that the next available driver was mine.  At 30 minutes late, she said my driver was about five minutes from me.  At 45 minutes late, the driver called and said he had been waiting outside for a while.  I knew that he had not, because I would have seen him.  It turned out that he had the wrong address.  When he showed up 5 minutes later, he had his son with him and told me that he had taken his son to the doctor that morning: that was why he was late picking me up. I was nearly an hour late for check-in at the hospital.  I called a branded cab company on purpose because I have heard Uber doesn't always adequately check the backgrounds of their drivers.  Next time I may give them a try anyway.

Family and Friend Favorite! Fresh Delicious Vietnamese food along with an exceptionally organized staff especially when Dr.Tom the owner is around. Its run like a well oiled machine. Its my favorite Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa and we go almost twice a week and drive 45 min to get there from our home. There is a bakery and refrigerator full of take home goodies as well.

This place is pretty good for a standard vietnamese spot. The food all around is pretty decent and good. The one thing i like here is shaking beef and tofu. The tofu here is unique. The pho isnt the greatest to be honest with you guys. I love how their set up is like 1 side togo market type of feel then a boba/dessert spot then the rest of th area is the restaurant dine in area. They also have this semi outside patio like for outdoor seating if you like. My family goes here for majority of the time for the tofu

I finally got to come here on my last day in Tampa.  I got here around 11:30am on a Thursday and thank god that I was able to find parking because this place gradually got packed. 

    The place was 25% full but after I got done eating, it was at 90% capacity in seating.   After reading all the great reviews, I can see why this place was packed.

     Coming from Atlanta, the best way to describe this place is combination of a Sweet Hut put together with a wonderful Vietnamese Cuisine Restaurant with a bunch of to-go Vietnamese Street food.  

      This place has everything!!  It has a huge selection of Vietnamese restaurant food including: Noodles, Appetizers, Rice with Meat dishes, and etc.  It's the most complete Vietnamese menu I have ever seen in my life.  This place has every drink selections which include tons of bubble tea options.   It also has tons of to-go egg rolls, fried tofu, and other kinds of breads.  Waitress service is awesome and she was super attentive as it was super busy.  

       I got the the ground pork spring rolls with peanut sauce as my appetizer and # 63 which is pork chops, short ribs, shredded pork skin, broken rice, egg quiche, grilled shrimp, and fried egg on top of the rice. 

       Omg, the food was off the chain.  Customers kept piling in while I was seated here.  It got more packed as time grew.  I was able to even get some to go Vietnamese street food. 
        
        If you love Vietnamese food and your in the Clearwater/Tampa/St. Petersburg area.  This is a must go restaurant for you!  I can't wait to come back when I am back in town!!

Amazing! The place was slammed with diners and takeout orders non-stop (which is a testament to how good it is) but service was still quick and pleasant. Best pho I've had probably ever. Large menu with everything you'd expect and then some. Can't wait to go back.

Don't skip the  little area with baked goods, tofus, and grab n go items. Got fresh douhua with ginger syrup and it was heavenly. The croissant bread made for a nice breakfast the next day.

Thinh An is stunning. I was pleasantly pleased and loved everything about it the moment I walked in. The vibe, the expansive menu, the offerings...I couldn't have asked for more from this new restaurant on the block. I was happy to visit on their first day of business on their "soft opening" of sorts. 

I enjoyed taking in all the offerings of their take-away counter and was amazed by the selection. The fresh bread and pastry was picture perfect and I instantly was very impressed when I imagined all the hard work that went into creating it. Next, my eyes went to the refrigerator of tofu (both silken and spicy preparations I believe) and the soymilk that is made in house. Very cool! 

My love and I had the tea infused water that they serve and an avocado boba to split between us to drink. The tea had a really nice flavor (unsweetened) and I could taste that the boba actually incorporated real avocado unlike others I've had which I could tell had all been mix. I had been craving one of these bobas and this really hit the spot. We also sampled some mango green tea and passion fruit green tea I believe. Both were very excellent. 

Our main sever, Duy, was attentive, prompt, and aimed to make our experience the best it could be. Although at times the restaurant got loud, I found that pointing to or giving the number of the entree that corresponded on the menu was very helpful! The menu is quite varied and long and I appreciate that there is a side with pictures and a side with detailed descriptions on English. Beautiful menu!

We ended up ordering two types of banh mi sandwiches. Let me tell you, I have not seen a bigger French bread roll or fresher on these Bahn mis! The filling and veggies were ample as well. I ordered the #17 seafood soup and my love opted for an XL combination beef pho and we were not disappointed. 

The entrees, despite being hefty, were easily devoured by us. We left with plenty of leftovers to take home to enjoy the next day. 

We sampled the homemade warmed silken tofu which has a very thin, transparent ginger sauce and it was quite delicious! I had never had anything like that before. Then came the showstopper--the "Hong Kong style" egg waffle cone!!!! Let me tell you that this dessert delight was extremely delicious. We had ours with green tea ice cream with some mini m&ms and every bite was enjoyed. My mouth is salivating just thinking about  this ice cream and waffle goodness. Despite not ever indulging in waffles I know I had to try this. The "egg waffle" itself was supremely tasty and complimented the ice cream very well. I look forward to trying the shaved ice on future visits. 

The decor of the restaurant is lovely! I enjoy the visible workspace for the desserts,drinks, etc. in the main dining room area, the cool wall and lighting, and I thought the projector screen with the images of Vietnamese countryside and geography was a nice touch. All in all, a top notch experience. I look forward to dining here again soon. It's nice to have a new and great go-to Vietnamese restaurant, thanks Thinh An!!!

Best Pho and Boba! Every time I come here, I receive excellent service and even better food. I really enjoy the mango smoothie with the popping boba. The smoothies are delicious. The pho is some of the best I've had. The portions are very big for a good price.

Awesome spot for lunch; it literally has everything you could think of! From boba drinks, to snacks, to delicious authentic Vietnamese cuisine! So much options and the availability of foods from the side bar is just insane. 

Foods from the to-go side bar and fridge include: egg rolls, spring/summer rolls, fried tofu, rice cakes, assortment of breads, sticky rice, jelly, steamed savory rice cake, soy milk, flan, donuts, shrimp pancake, and so much more!

This restaurant is suitable for group event or any social gathering. There are indoor and outdoor seating and definitely kids friendly. 

What about the foods? 
It is pretty goods and the price is very reasonable! 
From all the times I have been here, I have tried their Bun Bo Hue (Spicy Beef Noodle soup), Combination Fried Rice, Pho, Mi Quang (Thick Egg Noodle with Seafood Soup-based), Bo Kho (Beef stew served with Vietnamese-style bread), and Porridge. 

Each of the dishes mentioned about is quite decent and flavorful. 
I was a bit disappointed with the Mi Quang, which is filled with egg noodle, shrimp, meat, quail egg, herbs, peanuts, and rice cracker served on the side, since the broth lacks a certain flavor. It is hard to explain but I had better at home and in Vietnam. Another reason for my dislike is because it is not Chicken Mi Quang, which I loved. 

The Bo Kho or Beef Stew is very rich and flavorful. I love the broth and could not stop eating it. The seasoning was perfect; taste just like the way my dad makes it at home. Unlike the conventional way of eating soup with a spoon, I personally like to break the bread up into pieces and dipped into the broth! It is much more fun and delicious eating this way. There were a lot of beef meat and carrot in the soup but I did not eat it since the pieces was way to big and I feel lazy cutting it down into smaller bite size. 

The reason of me giving Thinh An 4 stars is because when they are busy, especially during lunch hour, the staffs tends to overlooked our table. In addition, during my last visit they brought me the wrong order of porridge and during my most recent visit, I clearly asked the waitress if the "Nouc Cam" or OJ was freshly squeezed (I asked in both English and Vietnamese a couple of times) and she said "yes," but unfortunately, it tasted otherwise! More like from a container. I had a feeling that this was going to happened; thus, I asked repeatedly over and over just to be sure...

Despite the little fumble, I still like the restaurant and the foods options here. Without a doubt, I will come back whenever I drive to Clearwater or Tampa. But next time, I am looking forward to trying the mixed grilled noodle bowl and rice platter. I noticed a lot of people ordered it and it looks so appealing!

incredible tacos and tamales. i borderline have stopped cooking at home because im so hooked on the fish taco and pork tamale.  staff is friendly/helpful and food comes out super quick. the red sauce for the pork tamale is the best. good heat and flavor. i like how the cashier can split the orders up so the tacos go into the correct to-go containers for ease of divvying up later.

Always just the best food. The pastries are so tasty and fresh. The almond is my favorite, but literally love all the sweet flavors. The fresh rolls are to die for and the pho has the best flavor. 
Just don't go close to closing time or they'll kick you out by cleaning lol.

I ordered a cab for someone else around 2200 hours. Didn't get a text saying the cab was on the way until 0210 hours. Over 4 hours to get a cab. That is incredible. Needless to say, I wont be attempting United Cab again.

Used to be SuperFresh.  Same tired products and clueless clerks.  Is it any wonder why Whole Foods is kicking this store's ass?  When asked for a price check, clerks will just pull a number out of their hat!
I ordered 2 seafood noodles with more tép m, but no tép m at all. I was so disappointed with the service here. Maybe they don't understand what I'm ordering even though they're Vietnamese too.

Easily a match for DC's Eden Center. It was packed at 4pm on a post-lockdown Sunday.

Travelled from Brandon for a tofu banh-mi and taro smoothie with boba. Very fresh ingredients in perfect proportions. I'm full and very satiated.

The bakery has a nice selection of prepared foods.

We'll gladly drive over 40 minutes for this!
This is my favorite restaurant, here maybe twice a week, always awesome. Food is good, service is quick, and the atmosphere is great.

Good customer service. The food came out really fast. You can find all of the basic noodles soups in the store. 
Also, they serve porridge "chao long ", chao vit, ...yummm
Varieties of food to select.

I have been coming here for a year to buy fried tofu and Vietnamese ham (cha lua).  Tofu made from scratch there is top quality as well as the ham.  I would give those items 5 star.  The noodle soup broths are too sweet.  I give those items a 3 star.  The grilled meats are also too salty.  Overall.
it's a basic place to get decent Vietnamese food.

Drove 30 minutes to this place after a terrible FAKE experience at Bistro BT.  Whatever you do DO NOT go to Bistro BT.  Place is overpriced, pretentious, hipster garbage.  Thinh An is as legit as it gets.  From the summer rolls, vermicelli bowls, and rice platters, to the vast array of bahn mi, this place is as delicious as any of the multiple Viet places I've been to in NYC.  It really is a hidden gem in Tampa.  Everything was so good my friend and I ordered 5 Bahn Mi to go.  Ate the Bahn Mi for dinner and they were delicious.  Packed with meats and veggies and made with traditional french bread.  Plus, they were $3.50!

I need to speak up here. 

Yelp as we know are full of haters. These poor victims cry and cry and cry because well they like crying. My experience was completely the opposite.

The food is rock solid! I recently moved into the neighborhood and just found this gem. Service was amazing. Delivery was quick and friendly.

The cheese steak hoagie was perfect. Much better than the hallowed Max's up the street. Try it their way loaded, reasonably priced and delicious. I also got their buffalo wings. Fresh, crispy, and delicious.

Definitely try Two Brothers out!

Stay safe. Stay well.
Always amazing, food never disappoints. This time we just shared a bunch of appetizers and rolls. We were very satisfied and surprised at how low the check came to.
The sandwiches and sides were good and hearty. But man, those cakes. Just amazing - we couldn't put our forks down. This place has a legendary reputation for a reason. Truly awesome - we'll be back.

Ordered the Bun bo hue. I thought he asked if I wanted pork belly and I was confused so i said no, but he was asking about the pig blood which I did want... it clicked when I got my receipt.  It was delicious anyway. The noodles were perfect, thick and perfectly cooked with a bite instead of a soft starch. The flavor was tangy, savory and spicy, and the price was great. Quick service. Definitely worth going back.

Been here about a dozen times now, and continue to go back! The food is great, super affordable, huge portions, and a deep menu with a lot of variety. The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is for the service, as they really make an effort to turn tables and it makes you feel rushed.

When u order a pizza with mushrooms and the mushrooms aren't cook what you gonna do 
Better way it's to put the pizza on trash and let a bad review then and this happen to the takka  grill and pizza
Great food and service really enjoyed.  Very crowded but served quickly will return to try other things even took home snacks from the take out section

Very disappointed with the service in scheduling here. I scheduled an appointment for a cleaning, and they didn't have appointments until a month and a half out. I asked to be put on the call list for cancelations if sooner, and they put me on the list but never called. So, a month later, I called again to get an appointment. Again, a month and a half wait. Now, the day before my appointment, they call and tell me they must reschedule me. However, all their reschedule dates are over a month away. Total, I have been waiting 3 months already for a cleaning, now they are asking me to push to over 4 months for the cleaning - even though they requested the reschedule, not me. Absolutely absurd. Obviously, I am switching dentists.

Thinh An is a fabulous new Vietnamese restaurant and Vietnamese market which opened today along Waters Avenue in Town 'n Country. The family that owns Thinh An is well-known to many of the Tampa Bay Yelpers, and we have all been excitedly waiting as they went through the rebuilding, furnishing, and training process before today's grand opening.

I was there for lunch today, and after saying Hi to the owners, and touring this beautiful new restaurant, I sat at a table to review the massive menu. Before long, Karen F., TJ T., Nick S., and Tina K. had joined me, and this turned into an impromptu Yelper gathering to enjoy the food and compare our thoughts while slurping noodles.

The first thing you should know is that this restaurant is gorgeous. Even though they specialize in Vietnamese street food, everything is presented in a very classy and upscale restaurant setting. There are lots of servers and helpers circulating throughout the restaurant to say Hi, and answer questions. It's all very cozy and friendly, and Thinh An is bound to be a big success as they become better known in the NW Hillsborough County area.

To your left as you enter the front doors is their large "Market" section, and this is where you can select Spring and Summer rolls, sausage buns, fried eggrolls, homemade tofu, breads, pastries, all sorts of colorful desserts, soy milk, and more. It's all pre-packaged and ready to take home, or back to your office -- and it is all made in house.

The dining area is to your right, and there is a large "Beverage Bar" along one wall where you can get your fruit teas, milk teas, boba teas, slushies, and coffees to go, or to have with your meal. Once you sit down, they present you with two menus -- one is all of the different drink choices, and the other is the listing of food. If you flip the menu over, you'll find the ever-popular "Gringo picture menu", whereby you can look at the pretty pictures and point to whatever you want.

The food menu has a variety of fried eggrolls and fresh Summer rolls for appetizers. I tried a grilled ground pork roll with homemade peanut sauce, and was thrilled with the taste. Beyond the appetizers there are all sorts of noodle soups, stews, udon, vermicelli, congee, rice and broken rice platters, and banh mi sandwiches on homemade rolls. Thinh An also has a full section of vegetarian specials, so there is literally something for everyone.

I was originally planning to try an Udon soup, but the kitchen didn't yet have the Udon noodles ready to go, so I fell back on my usual Pho tai rice noodle soup with a grilled pork sausage banh mi sandwich. The pho soup was rice noodles cooked in an aromatic beef broth with sliced rare steak, and topped with scallions, onions, and diced cilantro. The soup comes with a side dish of Asian basil, flat-leaf culantro, sliced jalapeno peppers, bean sprouts, and a wedge of lime. I ordered a regular (Large) bowl of soup, and it was huge.

My banh mi sandwich was grilled pork sausage served on a freshly-baked homemade sandwich loaf, with light mayonnaise, pickled daikon radishes and carrots, cucumbers, cilantro, and jalapeno slices. I normally have the roast pork or pork meatball banh mi, so this was something new and very delicious for me.

The owner decided that we still looked hungry, and so he brought over a complimentary taste of their homemade sweet tofu which was soaking in a sweet syrup with ginger. The tofu was warm, and it absorbed the syrup, which made for a very light treat for dessert. I ordered a peach fruit tea with peach boba balls to sip on the way home, but ended up drinking it while wrapped up in conversations with my Yelp friends.

Thinh An Kitchen has been a long time in coming, but it was well worth the wait. If you are new to Vietnamese food, then you'll want to make this your first stop as you become familiar with the cuisine in a very friendly and cozy environment. If you are a long-time lover of this style of Asian food, then you'll be back time and again as you eat your way through their very expansive menu. This was an easy five star review -- they've done it right, and you will be very pleased with your decision to visit here.

My son and I went down to Tucson to check out the store and it was great. The staff was super friendly and welcoming.  Robby was at a sneaker event down the street so we got to meet him and get a picture!

Excellent food. I tried the seafood Pho based on a chicken broth and it was delicious. The best part of this dish was the delicate quail eggs. We also tried a mocked up "Asian quesadilla consisting of cheese, shrimp, and chicken. Excellent "pancake" as they call it.

This place is almost perfect! I seriously crave it and am always dying to go back every week to try another dish off the menu! The food is pretty darn good, some beat each other in flavor but overall I think it'a pretty good to bring my Vietnamese family to. I absolutely love the menu as they have dishes that you normally don't see at other places like Bun rieu (crabby noodle soup) chao long (rice porridge with different types of innards) mi quang (pork and shrimp yellow noodle soup) and so much more!

I no longer have to beg my mom to cook for me when I can just order it here at Thinh An and be satisfied! Of course, they can never beat mom's cooking though! 

I like the new cafe/market idea but find that with such little space it can be clutter some. It's always pretty pack whenever I go and there's never ever any room to move so it's pretty uncomfortable dining in. Service is alright, due to the fact that people are flying everywhere in such a tight place it just doesn't ease you to the food plus you don't know what's happening half the time. 

I do love that there's a small yet decently sized area dedicated to baked goods, tofu, small meals and desserts to pick up. They are pretty good too!! Some of these dishes are time consuming to make so this makes life easier and my tummy happier! 

I definitely highly recommend Thinh an if you're looking for good Vietnamese food with plenty of options. They also have special dishes going on so maybe you can grab yourself some garlic crawfish or any other speciality dish. 

Oh and!!!!! Their large bowls are really big! Worth the price too :D

This was my second visit to i.dentical and the same as the first, phenomenal.  

The staff is extremely courteous and professional, the office is very clean and well organized, and the dental hygienists are understanding and top-notch in their craft.  

Although this visit was only for a routine cleaning and my fear of the dentists chair was ever so apparent, they made me feel relaxed and comfortable.   

To compliment Dr. Yanez he is very genuine and honest in his post cleaning examination.  

I have had many experiences in the dentists chair where I felt like I was in a 'shake-down' to purchase whitening kits and other dental accessories.  Although made known they are available, there was no pressure at all and for that I am truly grateful.  Keep up the great work!

New go to! Taco bus level.

The steak is amazing and you can clarify rare, medium rare, etc

Visiting family in Tampa and ended up having dinner here it was really good and worth i had the pho and it was good there Vietnamese iced coffee is really good but I couldn't finish it, it was too strong for me but if you like strong coffee definitely have it. I did try their avocado smoothie and it was AMAZING

This Steak N Shake is for the birds. The customer service is disgusting, they allow you to order online but you not check the online orders, and the food wasn't made properly! I will say that I had a milkshake with those holiday jingles cookies mixed in and it was amazing! 
In closing I will say that I will return to Steak N Shake (for milkshakes only), but at another location, because this one blows!

Stopped here before my flight back home and man is it such an overwhelming place. Their menu is so BIG and they have so many bakery items to choose from. You better bet your behind I spent a long time reading through yelp reviews to finally decide on what I wanted to order. 

I ordered #37 Sate Beef rice noodle soup (spicy). It was DELICIOUS! The aroma itself smelled amazing! It had the smell and taste of fried shallots. I love fried shallots. You could say its kind of similar to pho but with a burst of flavor already in the broth. 

The boyfriend ordered the Bun Bo Hue. It was good but after reading some yelp reviews about it not being spicy at all, they were right. It was still flavorful though. 

My nephew ordered the deluxe special pho. He loves pho so everywhere we go that has pho, he has to order pho. When we visit Tampa, we always go to Pho Kien Giang. In his words about the pho here, "I like Thinh An's pho without any condiments but I like KG's after I put in all the condiments," so to me that sounds like he likes this broth better since it tastes better without condiments. 

My sister ordered the seafood rice noodle soup. She really enjoyed it. She also stated that they were very generous on the amount of seafood they put in. 

My brother in law ordered the special vermicelli. Good gracious that bowl is huge! Its twice the size and portion of normal bowls. At least that's how it looked like to me. The only complaint he has with this dish is that the sauce wasn't as great as he had hoped. The flavoring of everything else from eggrolls, shrimp, meat was perfect though. 

Now on to the bakery selection. They have everything from steamed buns to fried steamed buns, all types of croissants, pastry pies, bread, etc.. I would like to go back and try other things on the menu.

My review is not for the food here, which is fantastic, but for the effort the staff is making to keep their customers safe during the Covid-19 pandemic. I have had to stop going to several of my favorite restaurants recently, even for take out orders, because the employees are violating the county ordinance requiring face masks. But on half a dozen visits to Thinh An in the past two weeks for take out, this restaurant has consistently followed the pandemic safeguards - all staff were wearing their face masks correctly, the few customers eating in the restaurant were kept a very generous distance apart, and I was even given a hand held pager / buzzer thing to let me know when my order was ready so I could wait outside. I still don't feel comfortable getting anything from the self-service area like I used to, but I do trust the kitchen staff to make my take out order safely. Thank you Thinh An.

The 3 stars are for the deli counter with great choices for nack food. This place certainly know how to make tofu.
As for the food in the restaurant, it is a hot and miss depends on what you want to eat. Service is good. The food comes out SUPER FAST. Wait staff is also niceSorry but I give and F for the eggroll. Too greasy and mushy inside. For the soups, I find them BLAND. MY husband loves the grilled pork bu'n. I come to this place for the tofu pudding and the fried tofu selection.

This place is terrible and I wouldn't eat here even if I was starving. The customer service is absolutely disgusting and their food just isn't worth the drama. Just another greasy joint with bad attitudes.
