The Tucson roll is amazing but the green tea smoothie tastes like heaven! It's a hidden gem of the east side and although I like short lines, I don't like keeping secrets! Every time i come in i get fat service and deliciously fresh food. Do not let this business die!

My son and I are in town on business and have been hitting many of the local restaurants. We found this restaurant on yelp and decided to give it a shot based on the pictures I've never eaten at an Indonesian restaurant before. The place was phenomenal the tastes were delicious the food was clearly very fresh and the restaurant was very clean. It appears to be a family run operation and clearly they take amazing pride of ownership in not only the way the restaurant appears but especially in the food they put on the table. If I lived in the area I would eat at this place three times a week. This is by far one of the best restaurants I've eaten at in South Philly.

Our go to Pho place when we're in the Tampa area. The Pho is delicious and the portions quite generous! The place is always packed so wait times are around 10-15 minutes but well worth the short wait. They have a lot of other food items on the menu and there is a store that has plenty of pastry offerings and other desserts.

Don't go here. Horrible
customer service. I brought in a pair of Uggs to be cleaned which cost $45. It took 3 weeks to get them back. When I picked them up they had shrunk and I could not even fit them on my feet. Also, the fur lining had gone from soft to coarse and frizzy. They refused to give my money back. Terrible!!!!!

Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu donated food to our entire hospital during a very stressful time. The chicken was so perfectly seasoned and the egg rolls were delicious. Thank you for making delicious food and sharing it with our healthcare team!! Your kindness was so well appreciated & I cannot wait to visit your establishment when it reopens after social distancing is but a memory. Great food & great people, what more could you ask for!

I hidden treasure of exotic Asian food that is expertly prepared with quality ingredients and delivered to my doorstep piping hot and packaged with no mishaps.  I loved their products and I will order from them in the future.  I highly recommend you give them a try.

So I am 50 and I go to buy beer and cigarettes and cough syrup at Weis. They carded me for everything. Happening at Acme too and the Mgr responded "we're not keeping records on you" WAKE UP AMERICA. Of COURSE they are keeping records. Of course They Are!  There's no reason to swipe an old persons license unless they were watching you.  They think we are stupid, OF Course They are Watching YOU! WAKE UP, AMERICA! It's unbelievable to me that anyone would believe they aren't keeping files on you. Of Course they are, if they weren't, why do they need ID? WAKE UP AMERICA!

I retract my previous ravings about Saigon Deli being the #1 Vietnamese restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu IS THE NEW #1!! Thinh An is the perfect place to meet all your Vietnamese food cravings. There's a huge dessert section with a dessert bar to accommodate as well as a bakery attached to the restaurant. At some point, it's almost necessary to peruse the bakery and take home one, two, or a dozen items. The pho and bun are the best in the area. The banh mi baguette could be better.

Nearly everything I've tried at Thinh An's is simply fantastic with no obvious hints of MSG, nor is it oversaturated with salt. It also does not skimp on their portions. The prices are also reasonable, so I have no complaints. Despite the 30+ minute drive from my home, I am still always excited to go to Thin An, because I know the food will always be delicious and the familiar faces will always be friendly. So, if you're conflicted between the two Vietnamese restaurants on the same road, drive the extra 5 minutes for more superior food and service.

Been here a couple times now and I really enjoy the attmosphere and friendliness of the staff. I always order a different Banh mi to try out the menu and it never disappoints, espcially since it is only 3.50 for the sandwhich.

I love looking through the bakery with all the unique and homemade items. I even tried their boba and waffles which I have not seen done before in this area. 

I recommend this place if you are in the town and country area. If you enjoy causal Vietnamese food, boba and of course the ice cream waffles this js the place to be. Will be back!
I had my husband pick up take out. We ordered an extra large spicy, vegan pho, vietnamese coffee and some vegan fresh rolls. The vegan pho is amazing. One of my favorite places.

The best place in tampa for Vietnamese food especially pho. It's about 30-45 mins away from where I live and I drive that far for my hangover cure at least twice a month. The pho is the best I've ever had. Highly recommend starting with one of the egg rolls or spring rolls, they are SO good. Can't forget about their banh mi too!! Its always packed any time of day but the food will always come out very quick. They also have a section with prepared foods and deli items which is awesome; i always pick up a few things before I leave.

I love this place! Best food and service. Anything you order off their menu is really good and the atmosphere is always nice. I've been taking my family here for about a year or more and have enjoyed every meal we've had here. Their boba is taste fresh and not artificial like other places do and their pho broth is amazing. 
The only thing is that it's usually always busy and parking can be a pain sometimes but other than that I think the food is worth it.

They move around! We caught up with them by chance at Broadway and Houghton. Bottom line: WOW!!! The tri-tip was unbelievably tender and the portion was ample for the price. 

My Saturday routine will include a tri-tip from BBQ4U whenever thy are at Broadway and Houghton!

I went there with a friend for dinner. My soup came out first, his came out 20 minutes later. I ate alone.

The food was great so I decided to give them another chance.
I took two friends with me this time. I explained to the waiter what happened last time and that the three of us would like to all eat together and not watch the others eat.
This time, I had to sit and watch my two friends eat. My soup came out 15 minutes after my two friends were served.

I want to give them 5 stars because the food is truly awesome. But whoever is running the kitchen needs Gordon Ramsay to come in and teach them about serving a table all at one time so each guest that came together can actually eat at the same time together.
I am a fan of this place ! - Food is pretty good, service is fast and prices are good. They have a large menu.
It is priced very well.  The atmosphere is very clean and new.  Love how you can pick from the already prepared food.  I can't wait to try the pho.

I've been a fan of this place for quite some time and they never fail me!  Haven't had Pho in a bit of time here since COVID and now that I'm back to the office, this place is right up the road.  So had to make my way in today for some tofu and veggie pho and it was amazing as always.  They do require masks and the seating is limited.  If you recall in the past, this place was quite busy; now not so much -- alot of folks are getting take out and they've taken out some of their table so that the restaurant is less crowded and allow for distancing between tables.  Staff is always very friendly and food is out super fast.  If you haven't tried the boba tea, I highly recommend their Thai Green tea w/boba.  I didn't get it today as I am doing Keto and that sort of KILLED me....but was at least happy to have my pho (w/no noodles of course).
Food is tasty and nice portions. It can get crazy busy but it always good to order ahead.
Delicious, fresh selections. Wonderful Boba teas. The most amazing Pho, spring rolls, and soups. Super fast and great quality. You won't regret it.

All the staff here are wearing masks and enforcing COVID protocol. Staff are always accommodating, friendly, and willing to help you find items! Easy self checkout and the lines with cashiers always go quickly! Great open layout and there are always awesome deals. Be sure to download the ACME app for lots of weekly coupons! :)
Super fast service- excellent food. The pho is amazing, my favorite is the won ton soup.

UNSAFE FOOD PREPARATION. When I went to the bathroom, which was way into the workers' area of the store, I looked into the window of the food prep area which was near it. As I was standing there, a man without a mask walked by me and went into this room and up to a table where food was being prepared by another man with his mask pulled down below his nose.  Later, when I discovered my husband was getting food from the deli, I mentioned it to the person there and how upset I was and that I wanted to put the food back. She called the department manager for me to speak to and low and behold it was the man that walked by me without a mask into the food processing area. Next, she called the store manager. He said he would handle the situation, however, it was obvious he could care less. I feel that going there 
is PUTTING MY LIFE AT RISK. I will never go back and if I could, I'd give them no stars.

I am soooo thankful Thinh An is on Door Dash during the pandemic. It is so fast and easy to get the best Vietnamese food in Tampa. I love the classic pork bahn mi and can't get enough of the fried shrimp and pork egg rolls. I'd been missing pho and ordered it to-go when I knew it would be close to impossible for it to taste perfect not right out of the pot. But the restaurant packaged it to perfection!!  Providing a separate container with all of the add-ins (basil, noodles, sprouts, meat,etc.). After ordering I realized I didn't have hoisin sauce at home and was pleasantly surprised to find packets in my delivery bag. The pho broth was still pretty hot out of the container too! I also didn't realize the pho meat would not be cooked, and I left it out while I finished putting the kids to sleep. I decided to skip it this time because I wasn't sure how long it had been sitting from transit to my home with the extra time on my counter. This was a reasonably priced meal and helped me have my pho/bahn mi fix without going out to eat. I will be ordering again from this amazing restaurant! Thank you for opening back up and providing tasty food to the community!

The biggest portions I've ever seen in my life !! 

Got their vermicelli special and it could've feed three people. 

Bun bo hua was a hit w my husband and the pho was good too! Also got the catfish in claypot. Good but a little too salty.

First, the food here is outstanding! 
This is my 3rd visit here. The last 2 times my guests and I were served at different times and did not eat together. Even after my 2nd visit, I explained to the waiter what happened the first time. Sad.
This third time again I asked the waiter to please bring our food out at the same time so my friend and I could eat together. They did it. My friend and I were served at the same time on this 3rd visit. 
Thank you.

Now I NEVER write negative reviews. But i am Extremely disappointed. Meat is like Beef Jerky or Pork Jerky or Chicken Jerky. Chewy tough meat, freezer dried potatoes. Even being the dog i am i had trouble chewing it and i cant believe i paid over 20 dollars of my hard earned money for the food i got. I picked it up to go. Got it home and couldn't believe how freezer dried it all was. Really??? Never again. Its Freezer dried deep fry. Yuck.
Best Vietnamese in Tampa! So happy to find this great spot. If familiar with Atlanta, Ga--Similar to Lee's Bakery quality
Unexpected gem!! You can get variety of Vietnamese food! Coming from TN, I was mesmerized by Pho selections!!! So many to choose from and they also have a boba tea/ deserts inside.

D'Jakarta, came highly recommended by friend for their memorable grilled fish! I would have to say this is definitely a super delicious spot to enjoy some really good Indonesian food! We orders fired tofu for our appetizer rounds which was quite yummy, the sauces that accompanied the tofu were delicious one spicy and one sweet. For our entree's we ordered Nasi goreng, shrimp in butter sauce and an order of the fried and grilled whole fish! The grilled fish surpassed expectations! I was perfectly seasoned and crispy. I do have to say a fork and knife won't cut it, be ready to get your fingers dirty, worth every bite! The nasi goreng was just as delicious and authentic! This place comes highly recommended and we can't wait to return!

Monday, May I was waiting for my wife to pick me up during a rain storm, in front of Menorah Manor in St. Pete today when this driver pulled up in front of the entrance and sat there waiting for someone to come out. I asked him to move from the front as my wife had just pulled up. At first he ignored me and then he rolled his window down just enough to say" A little rain won't hurt you" then he rolled it back up. I was holding a cane because of my bad ankle, but it apparently made no difference to this guy. So , yes I had to go in the pouring rain to my car. The driver did not care at all. He just had to backup for a minute to allow my wife to pull up under the cover to pick me up. But he wouldn't budge. That's really lousy manners.
I felt that your company should know what kind of driver you have. 
Monday, May 13

Image
Took my order then told me I couldn't get it after 5pm waisted my time and was rude about it.

I have been coming here for a long time. It's my favorite Vietnamese in town. Pretty consistent with the food here. Fresh and tasty and I can find good options without meat. I just wish they offered more options like ones you can find in Vietnam.

This place has a great happy hour upstairs that is 100% worth the wait. We love the edamame dumplings - eat it with a a spoon and make sure to get the broth! We usually also get the Kobe Sliders, Kimchee Fried rice, & Short Rib. Been here a few times and everything new we try has been great. 

I would recommend 2-3 (small) plates per person.

Fantastic Indonesian food which is very hard to find in the northeast and is a often overlooked cuisine in Philadelphia. All of their soup noodle and and fried rice dishes are done perfectly. Wonderful meal and great prices. Try the chicken liver skewers; the thick soy and chili dipping sauces really highlight the dish.

These guys get such bad reviews because their drivers are hopelessly unprofessional.  The only reason I've used them up to now is because of convenience at the airport (they have the monopoly for airport service at the terminal baggage claim).  Tonight the driver had no money for tolls so he stopped in the median at the offramp to memorial drive.  Literally in the middle of the highway as cars pass by so that I can get toll money out of my bag in the trunk.  That and they give customers a hassle about using credit cards.  Two weeks ago a driver, after asking me if it was cash or credit, got off the Veterans so he could take me to an ATM.  When I complained that he was taking a longer route he said "I thought you needed to get cash so I'm getting off to go to the nearest Bank."  Trust me you don't want to use these clowns.  Use Cabs Plus and save the headache.  Its the same cost, professional drivers, and you don't have to get out in the middle of the highway to get the guy $1.25 for tolls.

Upon entering at me I made eye contact with the security guy. Once I make my way to the seafood section I was really greeted and a very polite manner by jessica in the seafood section. I was treated and taken care of with the upmost respect. And I really appreciate it. I simply asked where the bathroom was and she pointed the way for me. On my way to the bathroom I've noticed that the security guard made one round passed me On my way to the bathroom. Once in the bathroom I've noticed that the bathroom was very clean and very taken care of. And they had good smelling hand soap for your hands which is definitely a plus for me. Once we turn into the seafood section after returning from the bathroom, I've noticed the security guard making a second round despite the first two initial sightings of him once I entered in the market. He then stopped me and asked me about my body tattoos on my neck. I felt really uncomfortable by being approached. After that, I calmly made my way to the register and cashed out all of my girls that I purchased. I have numerous family members that work in multiple Acme markets along with a frat brother of mine who also works in the corporate office. I am truly upset that I was profiled and followed annndd approached as if i was stealing or something. My experience and the market was really well despite feeling watched and followed by the security guard. And I highly think that it is unprofessional to wear a Du-rag in a business setting; when it's not a part of your religion.

Bought a pair of Warby Parkers 2 months ago at a different location.  Unfortunately my friend accidentally flattened them.  I came to this store and they were able to fix them back to new with no issue.  10/10 recommend

We went on Memorial Day. The wait was long but it was worth it. Lots of options on the menu. Food was very fairly priced. Also a ton of dessert options. There is an attached bakery/deli area where you can pick out stuff to take home. So many different things, gotta come back a second time.

not vegetarian/vegan friendly. ordered spicy vegetarian rice noodle soup through uber eats and my "vegetarian" rice noodle soup had beef in it
 
oh oops:( i already threw it away:( thanks for clarifying though!
I hate you guys except for the cute girl in the morning she so nice always gets nervous around me love her

Ordered the rare beef pho and Thai tea! This place is amazing! Came back another time and ordered the bbq vermicelli bun bowl with egg rolls- this was to die for. Easily the best Vietnamese food in Tampa and very inexpensive!

Poor service and it was took almost 40 min for an order ( beef noodle) . Not sure why there was few people ordered after me but they got foods before me 
No explain from them 
Foods are not good taste as I had before

It's been a year since I started eating here, & one must still beg for a little tiny, sample of something I want to buy, but, have never tasted & still don't get it. Peter, the young man who knew there was a potential sale brewing, sent a staff member into the kitchen & brought me a sampling of a ground pork meat ball. SURPRISE! I loved it & bought some. That was easy & they treat it like its gold. You have so many varieties of flavors, Americans need a little 101.  I would purchase so much more if they would take this procedure up a notch
Even Trader Joe's opens a fresh can or pkg for you to taste.
Come on Mr Thomas, step it up please. Isn't customer service what it's all about?
Thank you Peter at check-out.

1st visit/lunch @ 11:30. It's a Vietnamese restaurant. Very noisy, so conversations between more than 4 people are difficult. App: #7. GRILLED CHICKEN FRESHROLLS.(Spicy)/2pcs - not spicy, room temp.  Entree: #62g. Chicken stir-fried soft rice noodle w/broccoli, carrot, beansprout & celery - bland, not hot enough (temp.).
Friends love this restaurant, so I'll try it again.

Thinh An is everything you want in a Vietnamese restaurant and bakery. Ambience is clean and crowded, but customer service in the dining area manages it all well. Food is tasty as well. 

Tip: Even though they have signs about wearing masks, they don't really social distance. So if you're trying to get in and out, get take out. 

My friends and I got seated right away, tucked in the back booth for me and my kid, which was nice. We all got different things and they were all delicious. They increased the prices on some of their popular items like their soups. 

I ordered a Bun Bo Hue with everything, large fresh sugar cane drink, and large durian smoothie (fresh fruit +$1.50). Later, I went to the bakery side and got 2 baos, and 1/2 gallon pandan soy milk ($3). Before tip, I paid about $30 for everything. Not bad for good Vietnamese food and drinks that is hard to find in Tampa. 

Overall, love this place for its simplified and easy to read menu (includes pics, descriptions, and prices), open buffet style bakery (not covid safe bc most items aren't individually wrapped like the baos), and fridge full of sweets and fresh drinks.

Just had dinner here tonight and it was so so amazing!!  Great staff!  Super friendly and helpful.   Food was out quickly and was delicious!!  I had a spicy Pho soup vegetarian and my husband had chicken teriyaki.   They also have amazing Boba milk tea and a little deli like area that you can get all kinds of different things to take home and eat.  We live an hour away but will certainly make the trip again!

We've been trying to find a CLEAN Vietnamese restaurant and we finally found it.  

The staff was very friendly and the food was as expected.  It's great that they also have a boba tea bar right there too. 

If you are in the area and in the mood for Vietnamese food. Stop by this place!
Super authentic food. Market inside to buy other things as well! So cool!!!! Love this place. Really busy most of the time!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Most whole fish in casual restaurant menu's around Philadelphia are usually tilapia. It's kind of a flavorless fish without much nutritional value. However, D'jakarta's whole fish is pompano. This was my first time having this type of fish, and after seeing how flavorful it is, it definitely won't be the last!  It was grilled crispy on the outside and juicy inside. The sambal it came with had some nice heat to it. 

The prices are a little higher than some of the other Indonesian places in South Philly. However, the atmosphere is really nice, and the staff are willing to adjust dishes for you. I don't eat pork, but I wanted a noodle dish that came with pork. No problem! It rings up as Halal on the receipt. 

The stir fried egg noodles were tasty, but I thought the portion was small for the price compared to other places. The spring rolls filled with vegetables and dried shrimp with a tofu sauce were delicious! The peanut sauce had some heat to it and there was a lot more flavor in the filling than your standard spring roll. Rice is so simple, but at the same time, it's so easy to screw it up. The coconut rice was perfectly cooked and seasoned. It's by far the best coconut rice in town! 

On my way out, I got a sweet drink to go with coconut milk and some jelly. It was pretty good, but not a must have. I'll be back for the fish, coconut rice, and the spring rolls for sure!
i've been here more time than I can count; hands down the best thing is their palomilla steak with rice and beans! They also make excellent breakfast sandwiches!

This is my go-to for Vietnamese. They're special pho is delicious. Good amount of meat and the tripe and tendon is perfect. They have a variety of delicious teas and other drinks. I recommend getting their sugarcane juice!
Desserts are also a big thing. Personally my favorite is the taro snow ice!
Hands down besr Vietnamese Pho and vermecelli in Tampa Bay. Fast friendly service and the deli and preoackaged traditional Vietnamese food is enticing.

If you are in the Tampa area and you are looking for some tasty Vietnamese eats, then look no further because this restaurant is the place for you.  Now this is not your normal restaurant , it is actually half restaurant and half bakery.  You can literally find any type of Vietnamese snacks you can ever dream of in this place.  From fried goods, to sticky rice, to jellos, this place has a little something for everyone.  Now price wise for the bakery it could definitely get a little dangerous if you walk in hungry.  Each item ranges between $1-$10 but when you eat with your eyes it could definitely add up lol.  Now for the restaurant they offer almost every traditional Vietnamese dish you can think of which include a wide variety of pho, broken rice dishes, banh canh (udon noodles), and etc. the menu is HUGE!! Now each time I go I always stick to my favorite which is the bun bo hue (spicy beef noodle soup) which always hits the spot.  But honestly everything I have tried there has been delicious and the restaurant prices are not bad either (definitely $-$$ signs). Beware this place does get packed and parking is a little scarce but it is definitely well worth the wait.  Next time you are in the Tampa area definitely check this place out! Even if you don't have time to sit down and eat then at least pass by to grab a few snacks!
Best egg rolls I've ever had. Also the top pho I've found in Tampa. Meat is tender and broth is incredibly flavorful. My top hangover cure, for sure... regardless, highly recommend.

D'Jakarta, came highly recommended by friend for their memorable grilled fish! I would have to say this is definitely a super delicious spot to enjoy some really good Indonesian food! We orders fired tofu for our appetizer rounds which was quite yummy, the sauces that accompanied the tofu were delicious one spicy and one sweet. For our entree's we ordered Nasi goreng, shrimp in butter sauce and an order of the fried and grilled whole fish! The grilled fish surpassed expectations! I was perfectly seasoned and crispy. I do have to say a fork and knife won't cut it, be ready to get your fingers dirty, worth every bite! The nasi goreng was just as delicious and authentic! This place comes highly recommended and we can't wait to return!

I ordered delivery from there for the first time last week. Yuck. I don't know what was in my sandwich, but it looked like some type of white gravy that completely overwhelmed the taste of the shrimp. I tried wiping it off the shrimp, but you could still taste it. It was disgusting.

And the fact that they charge you $2.24 for delivery..then an extra dollar for using a debit card...

I'm not planning on ordering from them ever again. Done.

I've been coming to this place since it opened! The quality and taste of the food has not wavered since I can remember! The restaurant itself is always clean and well presented! The staff are always so friendly and very helpful. Yes it can take a bit for them to attend to you sometimes, but again we all have to take into consideration that they are trying their best to juggle so many people and orders. I very much would recommend this place to anyone seeking great quality Vietnamese food! Much love to this place, great way to satisfy those pho or bo luc lac cravings!

This cab service makes regular pickups and drop offs at a dialysis center in Sun City.  When trying to enter the building, I requested the driver not block the handicap ramp to the front of the building.  His first response was that he would be quick.  I explained that other patients could still be impacted, including me who was pushing a wheelchair.  I told him by moving over a couple of feet he would allow others access to the building.  Clearly he did not appreciate the feedback or suggestion.  He was rude and nasty.  I will not repeat his choice words with racial and sexist connotations.  And he dared me to call the police on him.  Wow!  All because of a simple request in which he was clearly in the wrong.  A call to there office assured me the manager would be notified, but I don't know if it was actually done.

This is one of the best Vietnamese restaurants to go to in the Tampa Bay area! From the selection on their menu to every platter being good. I love those Pho and Hu Tieu. The wait staff is very attentive and everyone of them do a good job since I've been eating here. I must've ate here 20+ times over the years. Even the little deli area has some delectable Vietnamese treats that I always seem to leave with. This is just a good place to eat Vietnamese food.

One of my favorite restaurants of all time. I've probably been a dozen times at this point and anytime I have Vietnamese food elsewhere, I compare it to Thinh An. So far I've not been able to find somewhere else as good. My go to items are the pho, banh mi and avocado smoothie. Absolutely delicious and the food is consistently good every single time I eat here. Highly recommend trying it!
5 stars for the fried rice. 3 stars for everything else. We had the beef rendang and the beef soup. The prices were also kind of high. We won't be back.
The best Tri tips in Southern Arizona!!! Bill and sue are great people with great food!!!

The service was great with a friendly staff catering to your every needs. So many selections on the menu. Pho was very good as was the pork and shrimp egg rolls. The grilled chicken and fried rice was great too. The prices are reasonable.

Came here to grab some take out. Between the two of us, we ordered the chicken satay, braised pork with sweet soy sauce, and turmeric rice. The chicken satay was good but the lemon grass was too strong. The braised pork was absolute delicious, it was braised perfectly. Soft, and moist and comes with stewed mushrooms and egg. Highly recommended. The turmeric rice tasted very turmericky. The chicken that came with it was very tasty but be warned, the hot sauce is hot as hell. You may not be able to handle it. Take a spoon and just dip it and taste it first. It was spicy and bitter at the same time, my mouth immediately caught on fire and was still on fire and numb after my meal. Definitely approach with caution. Other than that, D'jarkarta Cafe was a good experience and we look forward to coming back for future meals.
Hand down to their tofu. My husband didn't like his chicken pho as the chicken tasted bad. My kids loved their beef pho. I enjoyed my spring rolls.
The food is so fresh and taste amazing. It's is hard to choose from their menu bc brushing we eat there is so good. We order at least once a week.

Why 5 stars? Because this is my favorite banh mi in Tampa Bay!

   ---   ---   ---

I could eat banh mi every day of my life, and this is probably the place I'd prefer it from, above all others.

Thinh An Kitchen is bright and modern. There's a counter for to-go orders, a dine-in area with tables, and a bakery section with plenty of pre-prepped goodies to take home. Although I've only been twice, and gotten the banh mi each time, this is my new go-to Vietnamese restaurant in the 813. The boba smoothie section is as good as anywhere, as well.

I haven't had the courage to try the durian during either of my visits, but maybe one day I'll work up the strength. After Chris W's experience, I might just keep putting it off until I forget durian exists :) For those of you who don't know, durian is a fruit with a very strong odor and taste. Some love it, and some... do not.

Bad foods, bad customer service, bad experience, sell old food , try to get us buy the food was old and  naughty, even they have the fresh foods front of you but they don't what to sell for you they want you to buy the old foods, that is discussing! Yuck
Best Vietnamese food I've ever tried in Florida. Fair prices, authentic food, wide selection, and top-notch service.

Finally tried this highly regarded yelper favorite with a pickup order. Restaurant was surprisingly busy for a Monday evening. Order was ready when I walked in and service was friendly. I was immediately taken back by the flavorful broth in my chicken pho. I hadn't experienced that since my days in the northeast. The size choice was large or extra large. I went with large because I can't even handle medium. The quantity of fresh bean sprouts, basil and cilantro was overly generous. My only reason for four stars instead of five was that the chicken was dry, even in the broth. The fresh shrimp rolls with peanut sauce were amazing. I'll be sure to add them to every future order since it's only $3 for two large rolls. I'm looking forward to trying new and different menu items from here.
Great food.. low prices and service was good!!! They had every dish that I usually order and more. Food to go... all the drinks and even desserts.

I have been coming here for quite some time and have ordered out several times.This is the first time I have ordered an extra large and when I got it I noticed it was in the same container as my large has been.I went back in and talked to one of the employees and she pointed out to me the the difference between a large and extra large.I ran into the owner and he confirmed what the employee said to me.I have included pictures.The food is great but just don't order the extra large pho for $2.00 more.

We have now stayed at the Rittenhouse Hotel twice, one 4-night stay, and a second 2-night stay.  During both stays we were on the "R" floor, newly renovated, and technically the "unlucky" 13th floor of the building.  (we are not superstitious!)  On our first stay, we dined in Lacroix Restaurant for dinner, and on the second stay we had brunch on Father's Day.  Both meals were top notch, and we had two friends with us for the brunch.  They commented that "this is the flashiest hotel we've ever been in."  We really like it here, and the people are very attentive to the needs and wishes of guests.  My other half used the spa every day.  The hotel gets a score of 95/100 from us, and I'll leave it at that, plus a good collections of photos I shot on the afternoon of Father's Day, 19 June 2016.

One DEFINITE negative is that nearly every electrical outlet is taken up by hotel stuff.  There were two free in the bathroom and two in the bedroom; NONE at the desk.  Where would you prefer to set up your laptop and iPhone and such??
Love their food but the highlight for me is definitely the market side with amazing tofu choices and other Vietnamese foods that are hard to find elsewhere!
My husband surprised me and sent me food. He ordered cheesesteak hoagie n fries.  The meat tasted good but where was it. Wheres the "hoagie "? I don't want anymore surprise food from here.

Since this place opened I have passed by like a billion times (I live 3 mins away). Not bad ,decent food,good salchipapas (with Chicharones extra topping). They also have natural juices . Nice place to stop for a quick bite.
This place is amazing. Everything I've tried is great. I love the spring rolls and Banh mi but we've tried a lot of things, there are a ton of options. The pho is also wonderful. Highly recommend.

I haven't had Indonesian food for quiet some time and this place got the taste perfect! It definitely reminded me a bit of home and the customer service was amazing. I ordered the chicken satay which was cooked perfectly and paired it with their homemade peanut sauce and it tasted amazing! I'm a big fan of salty fish fried rice and the taste of the dish was great too! I definitely am coming back here sometime soon and would highly recommend this place to others!

Not as good as others raving about it. 

The pho and frankly everything else is sub par. I think people appreciate it being a more american style restaurant to feel like it's cleaner than a small Vienamese store like Saigon Deli but honestly the small stores are what the real gem is at. Good thing about Thinh An though is that it opens for dinner too and it has a food section where you can get some ready to eat/to-go Vienamese food.
Amazing fried pork egg rolls! Their spicy beef pho is fantastic! And so is there crab bread! We eat here almost once a week. They are always super busy but we order to go!

We came here to pick up some munchies and food to eat at the beach. They had so many different bakery, desserts, and food items to go. You can grab and ask them to heat it up to go. It can get crowed, so try to get what you want and leave. All food are wrapped in saran wrap or covered.

Of the half-dozen or so Indonesian restaurants in South Philly, D'Jakarta is the safest bet for novices. Chances are, you'll be served by a native who knows the dishes, but also speaks perfect English. While others in the area specialize in a few regional dishes (and some don't have printed menus), D'Jakarta Cafe offers an extensive menu with stylish ambiance. They have the traditional Indonesian staples like satay, beef rendang, nasi goreng, and meatball soup, but the desserts and drinks are what really stand out. Ropang and rujak are two of the most eclectic desserts you are likely to find in Southeast Asian cuisine and if you've never had a happy drink, D'Jakarta is an ideal place to try your first. Despite the name, they are non-alcoholic. 

Nearest subway station: Oregon or Snyder
Yummy food! Very large portions! Definitely get a drink when you go such as a boba tea. Sat outside and it was nice

A seemingly never ending menu of wonderful (and photographed) Vietnamese food and drinks. The wonton soup and grilled pork sammy were an excellent combination.  The flavored teas with boba berries were an awesome treat and a rare find.  Adjoined bakery and deli also had some enticing prepared foods like coconut jelly and vinegared pig ears.
Been coming here for four years and they have the best pho soup and fastest service and clean

The food is quite good, but the restaurant does not enforce social distancing. It is quite packed inside. I only ever get takeout, but I haven't been disappointed as of yet with the vegetarian pho (my regular order). I usually order online; the process of getting the takeout in person is speedy, which is nice.

Came here with my Mom and ny Cousin's family earlier this year. Food was very authentic and flavorful as all Indonesian food should be. Very satisfying and hit the spot for us! All meal was cooked perfectly per Indonesian standard and it satisfied my craving. We ordered a bunch of dishes: Gado-gado (Indo salad with peanut dressing), fried chicken with green chillies, grilled fish, and toasted bread for dessert. They were all very delicious! If only this place is close by, would definitely become a regular customer!

I love this place just as much, if not more than when I wrote my original review! They are always consistent when it comes to their food. 
The grilled pork banh mi is amazing! The crusty French bread is the best anywhere. I also really enjoy their grilled pork and egg roll vermicelli bun. It's so hard to pick between the sandwich or vermicelli. Must try boba tea flavor - avocado! I'm so obsessed and get it every time now. 
Hubby and I have ordered take out from here a few times since the COVID pandemic began. I'm so glad to see they survived and were able to reopen.

This is all in one shop for Vietnam food.  It is divided into a restaurant and take out area.  If you want to use their tables, you need to wait to be seated.  The selling point here is the tofu, it should be good. As for other items, they are decent to average.  The snow flake is disappointment, the ice itself is ok at best, but the mochi was hard as a rock and  red beans is far from generous.  It is not cheap, I do expect better quality.

The food here is so tasty! The prices are good, the restaurant itself is clean and decorated with photos and a mural depicting Jakarta, and service is polite and fast.

I really love salted fish fried rice, and D'jakarta Cafe has one of the best versions I've had on this side of the globe. The chicken satay skewers were also delicious, as was the beef rendang, which was intensely coconut-y and had a much stronger lemongrass flavor than other versions I've had. I especially appreciated that the sauce for the beef rendang was not overly creamy, as it is at more mainstream Indonesian-Malaysian restaurants. The D'jakarta noodles (thin) were delicious as well - we originally thought it came in a meatball soup, but it turned out the meatball soup was served on the side. The table's favorite dish was the fried chicken in sweet sour sauce - the exterior was lightly crunchy, the meat was incredibly tender, and the sauce had that mouthwatering savory-sour balance of flavors.

We also ordered a few drinks - the mango one was basically dessert in a cup and worth ordering, but the other drinks (e.g. Milo and teh kotak) are generally served in cartons/cans with an up-charge - if you've never tried them before, they're worth trying out, but if not, you can find them at any Southeast Asian grocery in Philly.

A few large shared plates came out to ~$30 for three (with plenty of leftovers to spare), which is a pretty solid lunch deal in my book. D'jakarta Cafe is definitely worth the hike down to South Philly, and makes me wish I still lived in this city!

Thier thia green boba milk tea was Soooo good!! My sister had the sugar cane she loved it!! We both had banh mi sandwich it is the best I had in Tampa! We had thier coconutb egg puff sooooo good!! Can't wait to go back!!!!

I really love this place. They have such a wide selection of different boba and Vietnamese food! I love their little self-serve market as well. The grilled pork sandwich is my favorite thing on the menu #80. I also always get shrimp and pork eggrolls with extra peanut sauce!

Took this company out to Amalie arena with no issues.  When I called for the ride home I waited over 30 minutes and called to ask how much longer.  Got told my ride was cancelled since I was unreachable.  I had perfect signal and was never called or texted as told to say my cab was on the way.  I had been sitting at the pickup. Congratulations, you just lost a customer to your competitor, Lyft.

I was absolutely shocked when I ate at Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu. It has not only restaurant but a tiny market inside. Very inexpensive. 
Food was fresh and taste better then I had in a while in some Vietnamese places in South Tampa! 
We had Pho soup and some fresh shrimp rolls, lemonade , and crab ragooons. I would recommend it in heart beat. Choose which bouillon ( chicken or beef) you want , type of meat or not, add fresh basil leaves.... enjoy ... yummy. 
The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is PARKING. We came around 2 pm and it was packed . I had to wait till someone else leaves. There is also no street parking... 
 If you are in this area , don't forget to visit it.
Pretty good pho place with great prices. They're egg rolls and krab rangoon are the best I've ever had. Massive portions, friendly staff
Great portions and fresh flavors!  You can see the patrons are happy and well cared for by the staff but not overly hawkish. I had the bùn with beef and shared a shrimp roll. Very good. Will be back.

I just returned from a major procedure with Dr. Yanez and the excellent team at i.dentical. After years of no dental care, my teeth were in very bad shape, and the doctor recommended full extraction of all teeth, a few implants, and fitting with dentures. Of course I was terrified, especially since it was done all at once in one appointment.

It went so well, and I'm just thrilled. Setting up financing was easy, and they offered what I know was a very reasonable price for a lot of work. All that work only took a little more than two hours, and was almost entirely painless. And I can finally smile again!

Dr. Yanez and Amy were careful and gentle and made me feel totally at ease. The office space is very clean, bright, and comfortable, and everyone working there is friendly, helpful, and compassionate. I will definitely recommend I.Dentical to anyone looking for a great dental health experience.

I am very disappointed in this establishment! Originally, I gave it a good rating, but after going there for over five years, I am more disappointed each year! The dentist does not engage with you much, and it seems as if they just want to "up sell" you for more expensive services. Furthermore, I had to go to another dentist to be evaluated; after going to this dentist. I wound up having over four cavities, and almost had a root canal done. Although, my teeth had X-rays done every six months there?? I called to inquire a few times about the other dentist's evaluation, but no one called me back. Horrible follow up with concerned patients. Go somewhere else, where people really care about your teeth, and don't look at you for only making money!
This was so flavorful, the food came out quick, tasted fresh, great atmosphere, affordable prices and big portions!

These vehicles , these drivers are a nightmare!!! They drive like lunatics , extremely rude, personal hygiene is non-existent... How does this company stay in business??? Watch these clowns at the airport ... How anyone gets into these cars is beyond me!! Call Uber, Lyft, buy a car, walk, crawl... Please do not get into any of their vehicles pleaseeee

Ok, Takka. 
This is my second time ordering from you and you're playing .500 ball.
The first time I ordered your TakkaSalad, it was perfection. I wasn't sure what to expect, but you exceeded my expectations. I even recommended you to friends who were looking for a new place after being disappointed by the changes at Rose Petal.
Great first date. 
Second date.....
This time, not so much. 
First off: How do you overcook a SALAD??
Salmon, shrimp, and hard boiled egg (which I specifically asked you NOT to put on) were all seriously overdone. 
The salmon was dry, the shrimp was tough and very dark (burnt) and, I don't eat eggs, but I know that green yolks mean you boiled the eggs too long. 
Also, your garlic bread is soggy. I noticed it the last time but let it go because I have YET to find a place that can make decent garlic bread. Its not as noticeable when the rest of the meal is great, but this time, it kind of capped your failure.
Dude. That salad is $18. Y'all gotta do better.
Huge bowls of pho happiness for cheap. Never leave hungry. Desserts are good and some of the grocery items are fun and interesting. Coffee flan ?!?
Authentic!!!!! Delicious food and an awesome bakery. I LOVE this place. Very affordable prices and the atmosphere is fun. I love their bun bowl and the bubble tea selection is extensive.
Best Pho in town! I've been going to Saigon Deli for the longest but recently tried Thinh An and so glad I did. The meat is a lot softer and broth is more flavorful. Two thumbs up!

A wonderful place for a casual dinner with family or friends. Extensive menu choices and very tasty. Good service. We missed a glass of wine to go with the meal and had to settle for a beer (not a huge issue). As this was our first time, we plan to explore other menu items in near future. If you like Vietnamese food, you will not be disappointed, I am pretty sure!

The best Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa, Clearwater and St. Pete. This rating based on food quality, price, service and their efficiency is beyond any other Vietnamese restaurant I visited. Make sure to order Bun Bo Hue, Hu tieu bo kho, Hieu tieu va Banh Canh Dac Biet. Vegetarian option is available but dont have much food in the bowl. Make sure to buy the to-go food. The owner is a doctor and seems to have great experience in owning restaurants. I love how they placed order directly from their phones and the food come out bet 5-10 min. The quality is omg. Cant wait for it to open in Orl. This is our 3rd times visit and tried diff food each time.

We have gotten food to go from here twice. We have tried the beef plate, the burger, and the quesadilla. Portions are generous and the food tastes good. It is a favorite for us when we need to pick up some food. Service is friendly and there is some nice outdoor seating. One day I'll actually eat there instead of rushing home. Their food comes with a variety of sauces, all yummy.

The food here is amazing, this place is such a gem! 

I came here with a rather large group and the staff was super friendly and accommodating about our reservation which I really appreciated. 

We ordered a mix of rice, noodles, curry, soup, and other things. I wish I took a picture, but you're just going to have to take my word for it that everything was delicious. The chicken satay skewer was full of flavor and tender, it slid right off the stick. The fried rice was very tasty and even though it was such a simple dish, it was very memorable. The curries and noodles we tried were also incredible, you truly can't go wrong with anything on the menu. The Happy Soda was less sweet than I thought it would be but I really liked the jelly in it. 

Everything so good, we were all still talking about it the next day and making plans to come back. You need to come here!

Wow, what a restaurant! Where to even begin? For starters, we arrived on a busy Friday night when the restaurant was at full capacity and we were seated, handed our beverages, and served our meals within ten minutes time, talk about exceptional service.  

We ordered the pho which was deep and robust in flavor and generous in portion size . Bun bo hue was delicious especially with the addition of the homemade chili paste that was offered in the condiment tray. Seafood fried rice was a bargain, you can't beat the price to portion ratio here! Additionally, they serve crawfish at market price and man do not miss out on it! At $8 a pound, the crawfish in a garlicky Cajun broth was the icing on the cake for us.    
Finally, the service was friendly and welcoming, even though the restaurant was completely packed, our server was attentive and efficient. The restaurant had an overall familial ambience to it, everyone greeted us with smiles all around.

I took one star away for the fact there were no boba pearls for bubble tea by the time we got there and the sugar cane drink at $8 was not worth it and didn't taste fresh. Due to how pack it was when we got there we were also seated right next to another patron which made for an awkward meal initially. However, the pros definitely outweighs the cons. Needless to say, this is a place that we will miss and venture back to if the opportunity presents itself.

This review is specifically about their takeout pho. Unfortunately, the pho wasn't good. I had high expectations here because I've heard many wonderful reviews but the pho here was one of my least favorite pho dishes I've ever had. The noodles were severely under cooked to the point where it was hard and crunchy. The cartilage which is usually my favorite part, tasted fishy. The one good thing about the dish was that the broth was great but it didn't make up for the fact the noodles were raw and the cartilage tasted like raw fish. I don't like wasting food but I couldn't finish the pho. 

I know takeout pho doesn't hit the spot the same way as pho in the restaurant. But I've had takeout pho from other places before and other restaurants had much better takeout pho than this place. 

Although the takeout pho was not worth. Price wise, I thought it was a very good bang for your buck. $10-11 for a bowl of pho is decent compared to the other pho spots in Tampa. 

Based on other amazing reviews, I will probably come back eventually and try the pho in person and hopefully it'll be better than the takeout pho.

I arrive to the establishment at 5:05 and the worker is nowhere to be found. Myself and others are waiting and she isn't there. She walks out of the bathroom around 5:08 and doesn't acknowledge anyone and just starts doing her opening procedures. At 5:11 she takes her headphones out and barely utters good morning. Just such a nasty vibe and awful representation of the city of Philadelphia. I've been to many jamba juices and everyone is friendly and efficient. Not here. I travel a lot and will NEVER return to this location.

Best place in town for pho. The flavors, the service, the variety. Also, grab a cup of the Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk, and stop at the bakery for the sesame donuts! Sooo good! Been going here for a couple years now and I've never been disappointed.  and If I ever try pho anywhere else, it literally never compares to this place. The best!

Best Vietnamese food in Tampa. This place is packed all the time now and I see why. They fixed their service issue a long time ago. The phó is the best in town, and 2nd place doesn't even come close. I talk to the owner all the time and he's always working, making sure everything is running smooth. Love this place and I come here at least 3x per week.

This is one of the best restaurants in Tampa, not just for Vietnamese food. Every dish is delicious and very reasonably priced. They are closed on Tuesdays so remember that if you are hungry and in the mood for delicious food. I have had the Banh Mi sandwiches there several times with super fresh baguette bread, pork slices and greens. You  can't go wrong with the Pho there. The shrimp spring rolls are a meal in and of themselves. They have a take-out bar, but not sure that is open during COVID-19. They have delicious drinks and ice cream. Staff are super friendly. In a strip mall on Waters Avenue but definitely worth the drive to the western part of the county.

I've been to this place 4 times. Every time it's busy but the process is so precise, we are seated within 5 minutes. The food is authentic, fresh, hot, large servings and presented beautifully. The pho is amazing and perfect (I've had the beef and chicken flavor broths). We always buy extra deli items in the bakery and dessert area (croissants, nam va, pork buns, fried tofu). Nothing disappoints! A must is their boba drinks. They have all flavors and make sure you get the "smoothie" not the milk if you want thicker ice. The mangonade is pretty good too! Always plenty to try on their menu and you know it'll be good.

Me and some friends were looking for a food adventure for lunch and found this AMAZING Jamaican hole-in-the-wall! The food was incredible. The chicken was marinated and flavor was awesome. The sweet plantains were puffy, toasted on the outside and soft throughout. Delicious!! Their 'festival' greens with lettuce, peas, cabbage and carrots was steamed perfectly. They offer unique and traditional Jamaican dishes every day so I will definitely be back to try them all!!
First time, had the beef rendang, the app fried potato with corned beef and the vegetable and shrimp rice platter. Food was great, byob is great, service was great. Would visit again!

How is it possible that I haven't already reviewed Thinh An? I feel like I've always assumed I already reviewed them considering we've probably ordered on average once a month for the past 3+ years. 

We used to love a different Vietnamese restaurant somewhat nearby, but the moment we tried Thinh An - I couldn't eat from the other restaurant anymore. The bar was suddenly and drastically raised.

We have been incredibly happy with the speed of service. The parking is not great - let's be honest now. It's a pretty poor parking situation, but not too much they can do about it. 

The food though. So, so good. And consistently good. My typical order is chicken pho and sometimes grilled pork spring rolls. 

Their veggies always tastes super fresh and crisp, and all the broth is so, so good. 

We typically pick up or order delivery often, but have eaten in a few times. They have indoor seating that is a little more on the snug side, but there is seating that's kind of half in/half out. It's like it was a porch area that was converted. It's enclosed like a sunroom with screened windows. Definitely my favorite area to eat.

Inside, they have a little area where you can find grab and go items, which are super convenient. There is one bun they have that has an egg in it that is excellent.

The chicken pho is delicious - the broth is flavorful but the chicken can be on the dry/tough side. It's typically much better when it's shredded more finely. 

Other favorites are the grilled pork spring rolls (their peanut sauce is delish!) and the grilled pork vermicelli. We've also had their banh mis, which are super good and at $4 a fantastic yet budget-friendly meal. I've also had the crab Rangoon, which was fine. A bit better than the typical Chinese restaurant, but not much different going on here. 

The kids menu is only available for dine in and has some options for those picky eaters (chicken nuggets and fries). I wouldn't know, my girl loves to down a bowl of pho. 

In all this time, I haven't ventured out much outside of those options, but they are excellent and consistent. We will be loyal customers as long as we're in the area.

Everything I've tried here is delicious.

It's about time to update my review. I read my last one and couldn't believe that all I had tried at the time was the banh mi sandwiches. Since then, I've tried a ton more. 

At my most recent visit, there was a 20 minute wait on a Friday night at about 7:30 p.m. so we did what any normal person would do, we ransacked the already prepared foods section and noshed on that while we waited for a table. I forgot how much I love that ready prepared food section. The fried tofu is seriously the best. I heard they make their own tofu and if this isn't true then I'm part of the problem since I've been telling everyone that. I also tried their bean curd stuffed with tofu which was superb. I finally tried their chocolate croissant and man they are not stingy with that chocolate. It was so sweet and delicious. You can make a whole meal out of that section. 

After stuffing our faces, we were seated and proceeded to stuff our faces some more. We tried the chicken wings, Vietnamese lotus salad with just shrimp, Vietnamese pancakes with just shrimp, and pho. Everything was delicious. I went with someone who is Vietnamese and he said the food is legit. If you don't like fish sauce, you don't want to eat here, because everything was doused in fish sauce. I loved it. 

If you do have a request to change a dish, make sure you confirm when the dish comes out. I don't eat pork for religious reasons and my friend ordered everything without pork, in Vietnamese. When the lotus salad came out, it had pork in it. They made us another one, but just be cautious. 

This is one of my favorite restaurants close to me. It never disappoints.

I have been coming here for quite some time and have ordered out several times.This is the first time I have ordered an extra large and when I got it I noticed it was in the same container as my large has been.I went back in and talked to one of the employees and she pointed out to me the the difference between a large and extra large.I ran into the owner and he confirmed what the employee said to me.I have included pictures.The food is great but just don't order the extra large pho for $2.00 more.

Highlight of our trip out to Tampa/SRQ area! 

Food was fresh! The place is so clean! 
The people for so nice! 
Service was quick! 

The taste though....  the best tasting pho I have ever had! 

I would drive an hr for just their food!!!

I love the food and casual feel of this cafe. Sometimes I want a meal that satisfies with a bite with a flavor I can't replicate. Other times, I want something that fills me up, and honestly feels like a proper meal that energizes me. "Home cooking" is the term I want to use, but this was my first time eating Indonesian food! 

I had the beef rendang rice platter and I really enjoyed having a bite of so many different things to try on one platter. It was delicious, and I expect to come back soon!

It's my first time here and it's really nice! The atmosphere and everything. Food is good and average priced, a large variety of desserts too! From tofu pudding to boba tea to shaved ice and waffles! It's part restaurant and part store shopping area. It's not big BUT it's the only place that sells good soymilk and croissants! It's a drive for me but I want to say it's worth it. If you're in the area and in the mood for Vietnamese cuisine, i Highly recommend you going there!
Best pho ever my favorite place to go always busy but they are quick they also have like a lil market and fresh teas and desserts

I have been wanting to try this place and we finally got the chance!  We went in during lunch on a Saturday and it was not busy so we were seated right away. We ordered the spring rolls, beef rendang and braised pork belly. All dishes were great!...truly felt like I was eating a home cook meal. There is also a side dish tray of spices and cucumber which is definitely a good addition to our meal. I think it is also BYOB. We would definitely go back to try other dishes!

I didn't think it would happen. I honesty didn't think I would find a pho place that I loved more than my one back here in Virginia, BUT THIS PLACE IS IT. Soooooo good! I wish I could drink a gallon of their pho broth. My mouth is watering right now as I type this review. I got the Pho Tai (as usual) and was not disappointed. The only thing I wish was different was that I had two stomachs to be able to finish it all. By the way, they only have "large or extra large" portions here which I thought was funny...Oh, Florida. 

The staff was quick and friendly, and I really liked their pay at the table check out system. It made our quick lunch even quicker because we had to catch a movie. 

I will definitely be frequenting this place as much as I can once I move!

My favorite place for pho. It's always so crowded in there. Boba and waffles are great too. I'm not really a fan of their shaved ice or their pastries. I don't recommend them. They got a really extensive menu and all of it it's amazing, not so much on dessert. I'm really giving it 4 stars because I don't enjoy how crowded it is. But food is worth the five stars.

Unfortunately I've been meaning to share a totally disgusting experience I had in middle of December 2019. It should be valuable now because health and hygiene is essential especially during these times. Hopefully this never happens again. 

You could see from my previous review I loved this place. On this occasion, maybe my 10th visit, I ordered my usual Curry Chicken. It's delicious and not common in other Vietnamese restaurants.  I enjoyed it better than Thai curries. A few bites in I found a very small hair on my spoon. I took it off quick before my dining companion would notice. I didn't want to make a fuss. Several bites later, I discover a massive thick hair. Not sure human or rodent (see photo). I called the waiter. We were grossed and lost our appetite. Obviously we weren't paying for this dish.  Wrapped up other barely eaten one to go and paid. The waiter who was not Vietnamese should have notified the manager and comped other dish. This is a huge blunder. He apologized but didn't recognize seriousness.  We just wanted to get out of there and I was heading to airport to catch flight. 

This business is by far the most successful Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa Bay, out of dozens of options.  I don't know if I could go back. I certainly would never order curry there again.

Very delicious and scrumptious Vietnamese restaurant! The tofu taste mouthwatering and fresh. The beef broth is so tasteful and their pastry area always pleases me! If its busy , which they normally are everday, I highly suggest to go there and is worth the wait!

This is the best local place to get Vietnamese food. The service is amazing, the place is always buzzing, and the fruit smoothies are incredible. The price is right, and the food is GOOD. We go every week, and I always get the same thing; number 31 extra large with a number 1 and a mango strawberry smoothie with popping boba. So good. I also love the Pho and I swear it has medicinal properties; every time I get a cold I go there for pho and I'm like a new person the next day. My husband always has the Bun, and he loves it even though he's not big on Asian food (doesn't like sushi or Chinese). I recommend the crap out of this place. Only annoying thing is; it's closed on Tuesday, so you have to plan your trip around that. I always crave it on a Tuesday too, and I remember it's closed. So I'm usually there every Wednesday.
Variety of choices and the mini grocery/bakery next door is great too. The drink option they have is second to none!

Wonderful, friendly & always fun to join this very busy restaurant.

Tom and his staff welcome you in and serve great traditional foods with a smile.

The foods delicious & as an added  bonus they have a bakery, plenty of choices of prepared foods that are ready to go!

The pho is one of my favorites.  They have many other unique items.

Enjoy but get there early!

Wow this place is really good. My wife suggested sushi I was in the mood for Pho, and then I remembered my son and his wife recommended a restaurant a mile or so from my house that had great Pho and food. When I mentioned this to her she agreed that we should try the Pho place. 

Boy I was in the mood for Pho, and this place delivered.

My wife had only compliments for the place and the food.  

We'll definitely return. Highly recommend

Been wanting to try Thin An for some time and finally got the chance.  As others have stated, the parking lot is tiny so getting a parking spot may be tough.  The food was fairly good, but the seating arrangements are why I gave only 3 stars.  The tables are lined up so you are shoulder to shoulder with your neighbor.  That doesn't make for a relaxing dinner, but rather creates more of a fast food environment.  Glad I tried, but maybe take out next time, if I choose to return.  Too many good, comfortable choices in the neighborhood to deal with crowded uncomfortable seating.

I'm always craving some good ole Pho and when I realized Tampa was full of Vietnamese joints, I got really excited! Decided to check out Thing An Kitchen and was not disappointed.

The menu was HUGE so it was difficult to chose just 1 item, so I ordered 3 things to sample. I chose the fresh shrimp and pork spring rolls, meatball Pho and the Vietnamese crepe.

The soup was my favorite! Loved the flavor and I really enjoyed the delicious fresh veggies on the side.

The crepe was a lot larger than expected and had the perfect crunchy exterior. Lastly, The spring rolls were very fresh.

Overall, it was a nice experience with great food.

Great inexpensive place to try your way through the menu. Im a soupy and pho kind of gal where as my fiancée can appreciate the vermicelli.
Passion fruit tea is my favorite drink
Absolutely best Pho and boba tea in Tampa hands down. I've even went to other states and I still can't find better pho.

Hands down best Vietnamese around! If you're looking for Pho, pastries, teas, coffee, and boba tea come here. Very clean restaurant and staff is very friendly. The pho is the best I've had in a while. So fragrant and full of flavor. Not to mention that the portions are huge!! I prefer tofu pho and it was perfect! My daughter ordered the chicken fried rice and even that was good. After eating, visit their breads and pastries market ... you won't be disappointed. No time to sit and eat, there are hot pork buns, egg rolls, spring rolls, and more on a small buffet area that's in the market. We also purchased a few pastries--strawberry and chocolate filled croissants which were absolutely delicious!! The bread was so soft and fresh and the filling was not overly sweet. We will definitely be coming back here. 

Glad to know that there is a good place where I can get my pho and pastries. Highly recommend this place!!!

D'jakarta Cafe is a tasty Indonesian restaurant in south Philly. I only got delivery so can't comment on the dine-in experience. The food was great, though. The beef rendang and the shrimp rollade were delicious - tender and flavorful. The djakarta noodle had a lot of fun variety, though nothing was quite as excellent as those other items. Overall made for a good couple of meals, and I'd consider ordering again.

I ordered a large pizza ( half beef and half beef pepperoni ) FREAKN bomb ! Pizza was amazing. I always got 10 Buffalo wings hot ! Omg you guys these are like made in ghost pepper sauce. It is so hot my lips were burning for 25 mins after eating them. But they TASTED AMAZIN! So if you like spicy spicy get the HOT wings if not GET MILD!
Their fresh bread sandwiches is to die for everything I've had has been absolutely wonderful!!

3/27/21 Update:

    I haven't been here for 2 years and decided to come here for an early dinner.  Nothing has changed with the parking as it's very limited.  There is more parking spaces in the rear of the building and we were lucky to find some. 

    There is sign saying to wear a mask but nobody is checking or taking temperatures.  I didn't see a sanatizer stand coming in either.  As my other reviews of the FL restaurants recently,  get your Coviad Vaccine prior to coming here as well.  I can see why FL has the most COVIAD cases as it's just really packed in here. No social distancing or anything here.  They seat you right next to somebody.  

       The staff is wearing some masks but that's about it.  One staff member wasn't even wearing it properly and slid it off at one point.

        I ordered some beef spring rolls as appetizers which I loved the peanut sauce it comes with.  I then ordered their shaken beef plate that came with rice, lettuce, tomatoes, egg meat cake, and some shredded pork thin noodles.  The beef was a tad too salty for my taste and I had eat a lot of rice with it.

         My better half got the beef vermicelli with shrimp.  Not too bad.  

          I looked around their deli side and I didn't see anything appealing as I could get most of the stuff back at home in ATL.  Enjoy the new attached photos!!!

United Taxi meanwell but they have to practice bettor customer service they apparently I'm not used to dealing with pan customers that's why they're so rough that rude and unprofessional. I refuse to ride with the United Taxi because of his unkempt look and where his car reflect his personality. But I'm unforgiving I used to drive a taxi in Atlanta so that's why because I used to be it's hard to be happy when you're not making the money that you need so I understand but I won't get in the car with a driver just not happy that makes for a bad Atmosphere bad vibe.

1 of my local favorites and always felt good about supporting them until a recent experience in which the manager, perhaps owner, insisted we purchase a $8 bottle of sauce rather than provide us with an extra small container of such.  We bought 6 sandwiches and only asked for a 3rd sauce and if u insist on charging, how bout .25-.50 for the tiny serving size?  It'd be similar to a restaurant wanting you to purchase an entire bottle of ketchup rather than provide a small packet.  Not cool.

Apparently they don't accept out of state cards . The f I have my card and state issues ID what does it matter?  Add that I also have a military ID which is why I'm out of state...  just don't go here.

The staff here is very welcoming, order of bun bo hue took longer then expected, it was fine though but the restaurant made up for it for a free boba, chicken curry tastes very good as well. The deserts are are very cute and delicious As well, most definitely coming back

My Service Person today, Daniel gets 5 Stars.  My original install took several hours longer than anticipated, and I have had to have technicians come out 3 times in the past 8 months- so I just couldn't give the company 5 stars....  Daniel is awesome- he knows what he is doing and hopefully I won't have to call again except for my twice a year maintenance.
Teriyaki chicken is a must!! I love this place. So many options and they give BIG portions for an amazing price!!

Very cheap and good viet. 

Probably the way to go if you're on a budget or want some more obscure authentic viet food. They have a little market in there where you can buy a mix of grocery and ready to eat things.

This place offers decent Indonesian food. I don't find it wowing but it is also not bad. I ordered 4 items as delivery: fried chicken platter, shrimp rollade, ice cendol and ropang. Price wise, I think it's pretty normal for the portion.

The fried chicken lack to me lacks flavor, the fried tofu looked like it was fried in old oil (it had a dark tint and a weird taste) but the soup that came with it was good and is a nice touch. 

I'm not positive on what the soup is in English, in Indonesian is sayur asem, which in direct translation is veggie sour soup? It has the right amount of sour to me and it was refreshing.

Shrimp rollade is alright. It was a bit salty for my taste bud. Something that I would pass if I ever order from them again. 

Ice cendol overall was refreshing but there is a graininess with the drink that was slightly odd to me. If you're a texture type of person, this might not be for you.

My favorite of them all is the ro-pang. It's simple but complicated. It's thick toast with cheese, chocolate and coconut egg spread, that all may sound weird but it's really good. It is a combination or sweet and salty with a hint of custardy (I know this is not a word). I would suggest trying it out because out of the 4 dishes I ordered, the only one I would reorder is the ro-pang.

But overall, it's alright. A middle ground for me. It's not a definite 'no' going to the restaurant or reordering from them but it won't be a go to place either.

We LOVE Thinh An! I am a college student and I make a visit to Thinh An every time I return home.

FOOD: HUGE portions. For the price, it's almost unfair. Very affordable. Pho is decent; I'd recommend their bun thit nuong (grilled pork noodle salad) instead.

The bun rieu (tomato crab noodle soup) is my favorite there. It is delicate but filling. 

My mom always gets the chicken skewers. They're unassuming on the menu but are perfectly juicy, tender, and seasoned.

The pickled carrot and daikon is to die for. You can buy some to take home in the little take-away part of the restaurant.

SERVICE: It's always busy, but we always get sat relatively quick. However, the service isn't very attentive. It can be hard to get drink refills. Also, every time I've gone, the dishes have come out staggered. I've had to wait 10-15 minutes for my food while everyone else at my table has gotten theirs already. Pretty awkward.

TL;DR: Service can be disappointing BUT for food quantity and quality, it's a family favorite.

This place never disappoints.  The food is so tasty and amazing.  I haven't had anything bad.  The EGG ROLLS with meat are sooo good. The prices are reasonable, great service and the place is always very clean.  

They have a little mini market / store.  I've never purchased anything from there but it all looks so good.  

Parking can sometimes be challenging but that's a good sign I think.  

I highly recommend.

Everything I have tried here is delicious. Very friendly and fast service even when they are busy. Tried the sandwiches today and they are awesome. The crab Rangoons are to die for. I also really live the wonton soup broth and yellow curry. Amazing prices as well. So happy to have found this place
I love the customer service! My favorite pizza & cheese steaks! Also a great environment to sit in & eat. Highly recommended.

Since my first review I've tried several pho joints in Tampa, and have concluded Thinh An Kitchen is my favorite. 

The perfect destination for pho enthusiasts because of all the choices. There are at least ten different pho's, including a create-your-own option!

Their best attribute is consistency. Whether dining in, picking up, or receiving deliveries from Uber eats, the food is always perfect. Pho is always hot, flavorful and packed with plenty of fresh herbs and sprouts. I add a few drops of my own Sriracha when the mood strikes. 

This restaurant and store combination offers freshly packed groceries, indoor dining, and has a cafe featuring Vietnamese teas, shakes, and boba.

Large portions for under $20 per person. Great place to eat well on the cheap. Pho is gluten free!

Pho is okay, broth is bland and have had better elsewhere.  Service is pretty bad when they are busy.  Today I was berated because they wrote down the wrong order over the phone even though I repeated it 3 times, then the guy had the audacity to blame me.  Used to order from here once a week but I will be trying other places going forward.  Just because you are busy doesn't mean you can be rude to your customers.

Love this place! Boba drinks are delicious. Thai tea and taro are the best. My favorite dish is #33 BBQ pork bun. My husband and I try to visit every few months. He loves the BBQ pork bahn mi. Good selection of pastries and to-go items. Don't forget they are closed on Tuesday!

This place is so good and so reasonably priced! I haven't tried the more adventurous items but their Pho and mixed grill plates that come with noodles are delicious! They also have prawn crackers. It's always busy and seating is close to your neighbors but I feel that makes it more authentic. Definitely a must try if you haven't been.
Yes yes absolutely 100% yes love the food! I stay gettin the boba, Bahn mi, pho, and the spring rolls. They could get my order completely wrong and id still go there to eat Bc the food is so good

I've used these guys for over a year, 2x a week and can emphatically tell you to use somebody else.

First was the issue last week, where I ordered a cab around 9am for pickup at 2:55pm.  I went downstairs at 2:50 and the cab never showed.  I called at 2:55 and asked for a status and she said "well, we're really busy."  When I explained that I ordered ahead, she got annoyed and said, with a tone, "well, we're really busy."

To continue this, I then asked for a supervisor and she said "really?!" like a 14 year old child crying.  After putting me on hold, she then came back on the line and hung up on me.  Meanwhile, still no cab.  At 3pm I checked the status on the app, at which time it said, "trip cancelled."

After investigating the incident, I learned that the cab arrived at 2:42 and left at 2:47 and marked it as a no-show.  I received no call or text because, as I learned, the system that automatically calls doesn't tell you until 5 minutes or less.  So he arrived 13 minutes early, didn't call me directly, and the automated system also did not call.

So to sum that up, their system is awful and problematic, customer service is even worse, and I still have not received a follow-up call to discuss.  I tried to call this morning, but got an attitude from the supposed supervisor about speaking to somebody.

To add to this, their drivers repeatedly overcharge for my trip, figuring I do not know the difference.  I called several times to express my displeasure, but it never changes.  The variance in cost is a couple of dollars, so it's not huge, but it speaks to the manner in which their drivers operate - to screw customers.

One of my new favorite Vietnamese spots! Ordered through Ubereats for lunch with some coworkers and it was a hit! We tried the special vermicelli, the special rice noodle soup, shrimp and port fresh rolls, fried pork egg rolls, ham sandwich, salted lemonade. All of it was fresh and delicious! Would recommend and order again

| Number One...or Number Three |

I like the fusion of Spanish and American traditional fast food items. There are a few basic menu choices that mix typical food truck options with Spanish flair. I ordered the Hamberguesa and it was pretty good. I like the multiple textures and flavors that that were included on the sandwich. My one qualm is the price is a bit high and everything is a la carte. For just my sandwich it was about $9 and to add french fries would have been over $3.

Great Vietnamese food, and for the price it's UNBEATABLE!  Always have to come here when I'm back in Tampa.  Also, try the coconut smoothie with rainbow jelly.  If you have a sweet tooth, you'll love it.
The food is the best, and at a great price! Everyone is so friendly and staff is very attentive. Love this place!
