Our entrees were great!! delicious Pad Thai came to the table as well as some awesome fried fish and a bowl of vermicelli with grilled chicken. Everything was fantastic and the price was great as well. 

This is a great place for a quick meal with some friends, great Viet thai comfort foods abound!!

3 Stars  - Because the food was awesome in every way. I had issue with the pungent smell that permeated the building as soon as you walk in. I made me so nauseous that I didn't even eat my main course meal when I got it. It's like a sour fermented alcohol smell and it's in the carpet everywhere you walk. I gave three stars because Fritz is a nice kid but his attention was focused primarily on the couple that was seated after us. They got their complete meal and was leaving while we were still working on our appetizers and waiting on our main course. 

I like the fact that he was social but when you work in this industry you have to be like a bee  going from flower to flower to ensure that all your guests feel appreciated and welcomed. We didn't get that feeling. I wish I could chalk it up to a busy lunch crowd as it would be understandable, perhaps he's a fairly new kid and he's still learning his craft in this industry.

The food was exceptional, the drinks amazing but when you represent a brand as it's face so to speak, remember that a measure of pride had to be worn just like the name tag or the uniform. 

We've visited this Olive Garden before so the expectation was higher... not sure what happened since our last visit but when the manager walks past without even greeting you at your table or making eye contact and giving a silent nod... something is lacking...

Do better Olive Garden
Their voice message says they are closed for vacation,will be open August 8th. There is a sign on the inside door,says same thing

We were looking for vietnamese food and my wife stumbled into thia store front. We didnt know the food or area, so based on fellow yelper reviews we figure  this was safe bet for dinner. We were seated in the round table in the back near the kitchen.  We order the classic "pho", summer rolls and i have to tell you by far the peanut sauce is probably the best sauce i've ever had. I have been to quite a few chinatown and this sauce rocks. The freshness of the summer roll, the shrimp al dente and the rice noodles were just perfect.
The soup, excellent quality broth, very tasty and well seasoned. Although generous slices of beef, i could have benefit from more noodles
We also order pan fried noodles with seafood. Honestly, the noodles were very tasty and the seafood very fresh and well seasoned.
Lots of garlic flavor all over the seafood and sauce. We had a blast, price ans service left us wanting to come back. We now know the next time we have a big party and we are in Philadelphia with family, we will take advantage of the 2nd floor seating area. As while we had dinner, we noticed several groups of people going in and out of the dinning room.

Great place, especially for a cold day. My husband and I got an order of the spring rolls, #105 beef and brisket pho, and #307 BBQ pork and shrimp vermicilli. Both really good! Total was $25 - very reasonable! They had incredible service - a staff that's always on the lookout to see who needs what and gets right to it. We'd definitely come back.

There's a lot of great things to say about this place. First, breakfast all day?! Yes, please! Aside from that, it's a restaurant that will have something for everyone. Some interesting dishes hardcore foodies will love as well as your classics if you're more meat and potatoes.

I'm gluten free with some other food allergies (fun times!) and they're able and willing to accommodate (with zero eye rolls or condescending tones like I get at half the places I dine) with substitutions and GF bread.  It seems, however, they may not keep GF bread and GF buns in stock at the same time or they run out of one frequently. My turkey club came on a GF hamburger bun last time which was better than nothing, but not as good as when it comes on GF toast. This wasn't the first time there was a swap, so that's why I'm mentioning.

I'm hesitant to tell you to ask for Nicole for table service because if I go and can't get her as my server, I'll regret this post! She's on top of her game, hustles, and is personable to boot.

Mike at the bar makes a good drink and is always attentive. As a bartender in a past life, a pet peeve of mine is having to ask for a second round; you should be asked as your drink is getting low and he always does.

Sandler's is a great place to grab a quick bite with a small group but can also handle larger parties in the space they have which can be tough to find in Center City.

Keep up the good work guys!

This place has a nice assortment of healthy fresh pressed juices and meal options. I really do like it. The only down side is that it seems a tad pricier than it should be. A small juice for example is nearly 7 dollars with tax. I also ordered a beet salad with tofu and it was over 11 dollars. Just a little too expensive in my view. If they could cut down their prices slightly, I would be a much bigger fan. The juice and food are phenomenal, it's just not very affordable on a consistent basis.

Had a delicious meal here for dinner. I have food allergies and the kitchen was not only accommodating by creating new sides for me but made the food flavorful which doesn't happen when you tell a kitchen no garlic onions or leeks. Great experience - salmon, chicken roasted potatoes all a ten.

Goodness is seriously my obsession! It's definitely one of Tucson's hidden gems. As a UofA student, I come here way too often, but it's a much-needed break from campus food. I love all of their healthy, fresh options. My favorites are the housemade granola with almond milk, breakfast burrito, and the Solar Power smoothie! They also offer a 10% off discount for students.

I just had breakfast here, and it is amazing!!! I had the Greek yogurt parfait which has seasonal fruit, granola and a honey drizzle. This is a perfect start to breakfast. I then had a build your own omelette with turkey bacon, cheddar cheese and spinach. I will say this omelette was cooked perfectly. The omelette comes with a delicious heap of home-fries. I was surprised, but not surprised that the omelette included toast. I had the 7 grain with butter and their in house blackberry jam. 

The staff is super friendly and nice.  My server Jordayn is amazing!! She is very engaging with her guests and stays on top of their needs during the entire experience.

After reading these Yelp reviews, my boyfriend and I couldn't wait to try this place (we anxiously waited a week until it reopened after renovations). The food lived up to the hype...we each got Pad Thai and it was fresh, flavorful and a HUGE portion. I got the vegetarian ($8) and he got the chicken ($9) and after trying both, I'd opt for the chicken next time. Shrimp rolls (aka summer rolls) are delicious! BBQ chicken vermicelli is awesome! Service is quick, prices are great and food is excellent quality.
Loved our brunch here! Nicole our server was amazing. We had a group of 8 - the food was terrific and Nicole's upbeat spirit helped turn our meal into a party! Will be back!

This place is such a nice little gem in the city. It's warm and welcoming with excellent service. They remember who you are and treat you like family. The regular menu is spectacular - with a very impressive happy hour menu as well. The ambiance is great (sometimes live music). The bartenders have always been very friendly- (Gina was very sweet today!). As far as management, Ally is very attentive, present, and wonderful. Tonight we tried the lobster poutine, brisket poutine, and Chesapeake poutine- HIGHLY recommended. There is not a bad thing to say about this place. Please go try it out and see for yourself :)

We randomly stopped here for happy hour. They have a great happy hour menu with decent food and drinks for a reasonable price. The bar seemed a bit under staffed during happy hour. It took about 5-10 minutes before we were greeted at the bar. We only ordered drinks but the food that came out near us looked appetizing. I wasn't impressed with the bartenders service. The restaurant had slowed down and we still received slow service. We had to ask for our check three times before it was brought over. But other than the service, the prices and drinks were decent.
Had a great time! Relaxed atmosphere downstairs, upbeat club atmosphere upstairs and then tiki bar on the rooftop! Lots of room to roam...

I live in centre city with no cars and no desire to take the bus anywhere to get pho. So in my area, this is my go to place for pho. Sure, i've had better pho at other places, but the best one in chinatown and in the area is hands down this place.  

I usually get some variation of pho or the spring rolls and vermicelli with pork.  And we usually get the shrimp rolls to share.  It's weird they put mint in the shrimp rolls i don't like the taste necessarily, but i usually just take it out as i'm eating it...

sometimes the pho has great texture noodles, perfecty chewy and just the right amount of stickiness.  but sometimes, its just OK.  

The vermicelli tastes good but someimtes the spring rolls are a little too hard.  The pork is always on point though.

Service is great! They are always attentive and fast.  So I never get annoyed dining here.  Not always the most pleasant place to eat especially during busy hours and downstairs, but i always left here content and satisfied!

Their Chicken and Waffles are fire.

Side Note: Visit their website for updated Menu/Prices. The menu on Yelp is outdated.

I have now been in here twice in two weeks. The second you walk in they make you feel like family. Ally is one of the sweetest people ever and truly cares about her guests. The poutines are all delicious and the happy hour  is great as well. They also serve breakfast all day!
One of my favorite spots to get pho when in Chinatown. It's inexpensive and quick service.

Stopped by Sandler's for a quick bite to eat with my husband and sister tonight. Great crowd but they were able to seat us without a reservation. First time eating here and what a delicious surprise!  Comfortable atmosphere, very clean and warm greeting from the manager Lisa.  Great selection of wine, beers on tap and cocktail specials. We started with the poutine with brisket to enjoy with our drinks. Our entrees were very well prepared - Lisa came by during our dinner to see if all was well- she was so nice - we told her what a lovely dinner we were enjoying.  We will definitely be back.

The Cuban restaurant. 
Giraldilla on Hanley Tampa FL
Service was horrible 
Food raw chicken pork 
Plantains horrible 
I feel sick to my stomach 
No manager on duty to complain. The worst restaurant I have ever been in my life. They should closed the place 
Dirty place 
Uncooked food
I feel poison
I want to sue this place.
I was one of a party of six who came in for the tasting menu dinner last night and every dish was a work of art.  I do wish we had a chance to meet the chef.  We will be back!

Welcome addition to our little city. 

The menu while small, still manages to have a great variety to choose from. Gordon Ramsay would be proud. They've beautifully melded the Spaghetti to the Western on the menu. We all had a hard time deciding on one dish on our first visit, so of course we had to go back to sample more. 

Entrees at our table for our first visit included the Ribeye and spaghetti and meatballs with broccollinni in cheese sauce x 2 and  the Prime rib entrée with baked potato and balsamic green beans. We also shared the calamari appetizer. Finished off with the Tiramisu to share. 

Growing up in Montana, there wasn't a shortage of good beef. That being said, I felt these cuts were great, just like home. Well prepared. Our waiter explained the meat is brought in from Colorado. Our meat was tender and cooked as ordered. Seasoned so well, we didn't notice it was seasoned. My other half said he thinks it's the best Ribeye he's ever had. He saved the last few bites with bone to take home and gnaw on in privacy..ha. 

The creamy horseradish and au jus served with my prime rib were delicious. The broccollinni with cheese sauce, very decadent, but so tasty. Bolognese sauce was light and just the right amount of sweet. Meatballs fell apart and just really good. The tiramisu, light and fluffy, perfect notes of espresso. 

For our second visit we went on a Meatball Monday. My other half ordered the spaghetti and meatballs and I ordered the meatball app, the creamed spinach side, and the onion rings. I wasn't in love with the onion rings and the creamed spinach side is rich and definitely comes with plenty to share! The meatball apps were still delicious. 

Happy to hear they have a hostess now! If you're going for dinner, it is pricey, but you get quality and a lot of food. Dinner will be saved for special occasions for us since we are on a student budget, but can't wait to make it in for a lunch and more of their weekdays specials.

Goodness is one of those places that successfully delivers healthy food that tastes great. I haven't had one item yet that has disappointed me. 

My favorite thing to get here is The Goods smoothie. It has the perfect amount of sweetness to it, and the avocado lends a creaminess that just makes it sooo good. Other great things I've had here are the tuna salad sandwich (very fresh tasting) the og burrito (just a damn good burrito). My partner loves the Azteca bowl. As you can see, the menu is quite diverse. There is something for everyone here!

Service has always been decent here. I'm not sure why but every time I come I take long to order and the cashiers have always been very patient and helpful, answering any and all questions I have an even giving suggestions for things (I wouldn't have tried the smoothie without the cashier's input, so thank you for that!). Food and drinks are a little pricey though, which is a deterrent for me.

If you are looking for a healthy meal that will satisfy, check out Goodness.

This is my favorite fro yo place! The owner is super nice and helpful. I love their waffle cones and variety of flavors that changes. My dog loves their puppy cups! Great price for a yummy treat! I appreciate their punch card loyalty system too.
Respectable breakfast and not super crowded.  Good atmosphere. Waitress was friendly. I'll come again!

The only real name for this place is "ChooChoos" -- in reference to the neon sign of a choochoo train on the front window -- and I fell in love with this place. Super cheap, super tasty, super fast Vietnamese pho in Chinatown. I try to make a pitstop here whenever I'm in the area. There's better somewhere in the nether-regions of Philly, but if you don't have the luxury to travel out to Little Saigon / Viettown, totally hit this place up if you need a nice warm bowl of noodles and soup!

This is our neighborhood take-out favorite.  I can't even tell you how many times we've ordered from this place, but we have always been very happy with our food.

It's a little dingy and greasy inside, but the food is prepared to order and I've never had any concerns about their standards.  The service is friendly (although slightly limited in their English skills) and super fast.

Our favorite is the sweet & sour shrimp - this is a guilty pleasure kind of place, not somewhere to veer away from the standards.  Their vegetable delight is also quite good and my husband is a big fan of their General Tso's Chicken.

And still cash only!
I got the clean it up juice and a tofu taco and both were delicious and fast. The taco is a good size also. It's not a small street taco. So definitely worth the money
This is the place everyone affectionately refers to as 'Choo choo' bc there's a train on the restaurant sign outside. You don't go here for the ambience; it's all about the food and it's amazing.

So I had the chance to visit Sandler's on 9th and  I was too excited. The family owned restaurant is just what my appetite ordered. Located in Center City, the super chic restaurant is serving up belly filling classics with an ultimate twist.  Like have you ever had Bacon Infused Belgian Waffle?!?

Not only is the decor super awesome, but they staff matches the cool vibe that bounces from the walls to the bar. If you ever visit you must request Jordan (I hope I spelled her name right) but she was freaking amazing.

So let's get into this super amazing meal that I had the pleasure of devouring. Now I stopped in for brunch, but you must know that this is probably one of the only restaurant in Center City besides diners serving breakfast all day. 

The restaurant is the perfect spot for brunch with the ladies, dinner date with bae or just a quick vibe for happy hour.

Greedy Bonus Points: Breakfast All Day!!!!! ( Like where they do that at in Center City)... Like I can get a Cosmo and French Toast at 9pm. Please keep em coming!

Greedy Bonus Points: Weekly Specials including Happy Hour. ( love a restaurant that is constantly introducing my palette to new eats).

Greedy Bonus Points: Morning Happy Hour... ( my type of morning wake up call)

Greedy Bonus Points: Price Points are Amazing ( enough for food a few drinks and some cash left over  to catch a Uber back home lol).

Goodness gracious....how did I not find this place earlier. 
5 Star Juice place all day long 

The juice menu here is a delight to find. One of the few places that you can find green juice that isn't tainted by the addition of sherbet or yogurt in order to make it taste sugary. A great selection of juices that will keep you healthily for years to come. 

Certainly juice is not all they have.  That was all that I had today but the menu had a few items that caught my eye. Specifically the grilled cheese with tomato soup mad me think of my childhood and a blustery day. Now, there are not that many blustery days here in Tucson but this dish will definitely be calling my name soon. 

I was impressed with the clean feel and the friendly staff. I have to admit I didn't exactly give the easiest order with my juice and I had several modifications. However, the staff not only handled it with ease but also with a respectful, friendly, no problem, attitude. They made me feel good about my order and executed it flawlessly. 

I will definitely be back and we recommend you do not hesitate to stop in.

Mike the bartender is the best :) Performer !
Get the berry spice, sugar rimmed,high ball . That shit is high and tight. Danielle was the sweetest :) !!

So good! And fresh! I recommend the smoothies and juices. I didn't care much for the sandwiches, but that's not what I came there for after all!  We were in Tucson for 5 days...and went there 4 times.  Definitely check this place out!

Great place walked in on a Saturday night immediately greeted at the bar by Shannon.  Drinks excellent the tuna was perfect and the soft shell crab sandwich amazing.  Great staff great and great place.  Nice job Paul!!!'

I absolutely love the food at this place! The granola and cacao warrior are great and I come here for breakfast often. I love the vegan options and appreciate that they've added more to their menu. HOWEVER, on their menu the Kale Caesar salad is marked as vegan despite the description saying it has Parmesan and caesar dressing. My sister and I asked about this and learned that the dressing contains dairy and is not vegan. I'm assuming this was just a mistake and it was meant to be marked vegetarian instead, but I really hope they will fix this now that it's been brought to their attention. Some people might not think to ask since it is labeled vegan, which could affect lactose intolerant people as well. (This would be a 5-Star review if it weren't for that error.)

This is a pretty cool place. Just walking in I felt healthy. It smelled so light and fresh as soon as you walked in the door. The staff was friendly and very helpful. I had never had an açaí bowl before, but now I absolutely love them. It was pretty crowded when I went, but that just spoke to how loved the place is which is amazing. Thanks for a wonderful experience Goodness!
The bun bo hue was pretty good.  Decent portion of meat and noodles.  The broth wasn't quite what I was hoping for, but we're spoiled in California and it wasn't bad.

The food is amazing always! I had the best sever ever! Jesse was amazing she was fantastic and had an amazing attitude. I've been here several times and had other severs that could care less and forgot that I was even there. I have a tendency to come dressed in regular Florida just came from the beach look so I guess they think I'm not going to tip well, BIG TIME MISTAKE treat me right and I treat you better

I really enjoy Sandler's for breakfast (love anything with lox), week-end brunch (avocado toast) lunch (salads are wonderful and can be ordered half sized) happy hour (house wine is great) and dinner (always an interesting special)

The staff is always friendly and very competent.  The management is superlative.  The bar scene at happy hour is comfortable whether I am alone or with friends.  I appreciate that the full menu is always available.

All in all, my favorite restaurant.
This place is good with friendly staff.  But not the best.  There menu is limited and I feel the store space isn't utilized well.

We had a 40th party here with about 20-25 people. We had a fabulous time. Food was delicious the staff that took care of us was awesome. We can't wait to go back. Definitely having our Christmas party here.

They were busy when I arrived and I overheard that there was a glitch with technology affecting reservations and seating accommodations, but they seemed very active in trying to deliver great customer service. I had the BLTA which was fabulous. It came out from the kitchen in a reasonable time frame. A great stop on the blocks.

Oh my, I truly adore this place! The vibe is modern, yet natural. And there offering of tasty and healthy foods is perfect for a pick-me-up at any time of day. from fresh pressed juice blends to power bowls, you can't go wrong. I got the Maine Root (bottled brand) maple lemonade and the Sonoma Chicken Salad Sandwich. The wheat bread it was on was soft and tender, like a prairie wheat and the chicken salad tasted fresh, not like nasty canned chicken. After, my boss and I shared 'The Professional' which is a smoothie that is either vanilla or chocolate (your choice) with strawberries, banana, Greek yogurt and pea protein. It was delicious and filling, even for the 16 oz size.

Needless to say, if you like delicious healthy food, try Goodness!
I love this restaurant! The food is amazing! I has a breakfast bowl it was so fresh and so good! The staff are so nice also!

WHAT AN AWESOME RESTAURANT!!! My friends & I did dinner & theater !!! What a welcome from Ally & Paul himself!!! We felt like VIPS !!! 
 The brisket poutine was yummy along with the duck quesadilla & nachos
 We all tried salmon AHMAZING with perfect root vegtables !!! Salads & Burgers where a HIT as well!!! Our server Nicole was just so accommodating 
 Oh and the ambiance just so rite in downtown center city. WE will be back!!! Beth B

Food was fine. Way more expensive than what it was worth, though. I had the turkey burger. The meat wasn't seasoned and was rubbery. Poutine with cheese and bacon was delicious! 

The service was not great. They only do happy hour for certain tables, so we payed extra for a cocktail because they put us at neighboring table. We waited 25 minutes to get one bottle of beer. The place wasn't even busy.

If I could rate my experience with them zero stars I would.  I sent them this email after being there on June 2:
I attended Diva Royale Drag Show this past Saturday night for a friends bachelorette party with a group of 20 people.  We all purchased the general admission with the prepaid 3 course dinner ticket in advance.  Within our group 5 of us ordered the eggplant parmesian. Everyone at our tables received their meals and ours were never brought out.  When our server came to check to see if we wanted anything else, we let him know that 5 of us never received our food.  He went to check in the kitchen and came back and said they ran out but were getting more.  At this point the show upstairs was about to begin.  I went to speak to the manager, who basically would not accept any responsibility for the error.  They then stated that they would set a table up for us upstairs and would then bring up our food.  That was unacceptable because none of us wanted to be sitting down eating dinner during the show.  We wanted and should have gotten our dinners at the same time as the rest of our party.
There were so many fails in this situation:
Our servers not even being aware that 5 people never even got their meals.
The kitchen being so unprepared and running out of one the four items on the menu.  Your club was not packed and we all pre-purchased our tickets well in advance.
Your management (both restaurant and Diva Royale) all refusing to accept any and all responsibility for this mishap.  We should have been reimbursed right then and there the cost of the dinner.  
Our dinners were finally brought up and plopped on the bar.  That is not what we paid for.
My goal that night was to make sure my friend had an awesome time and she did.  I was not going to make a big deal about the major fail on your part.  The five of us were comped two drinks apiece, which certainly does not make up for not having any food in our stomachs and what we paid for our tickets.  I spent $62.00 for dinner and show and only received the show.  

I, along with the other four of my party who were shorted, should all be reimbursed for your failures.  You did not deliver what was promised and what was paid for. I expect a response from you.

After I sent this email I received an email back from Scott on June 5th, who said he was horrified and would check with manager on duty that night.  I have never heard back.  I have left repeated voicemails (no one ever answers their phone) and emailed Scott along with the owner and other managers and have had no response.  
Those who ate said the food was mediocre and only one of the queens was worth seeing (Maya).

I got the pho tai sach where the beef slices should be thin and slightly cooked from the hot broth. Well, the pho tai sach that I got was with beef slices that looked like elephant skin, dark brown and gray. The beef slices were cut thicker than most places so it was very tough. At first, I thought it was just a mistake and that the broth was just really hot. However, when I saw other tables being served, I noticed that their beef slices were slightly cooked and still had some pink to them like they should be. So what happened?

Next is my brother's dish. He got com suon bi cha. Nothing was right with this plate. The pork chop was chewy and undercooked while the bi was old. So the waiter offered to bring out another dish in which my brother order the bun bo hue. When that dish came out you could automatically tell the broth was weird. Turns out that the broth tasted like bo kho (beef stew) and not the usual bun bo hue broth. By then we were just tired and wanted to leave so he just sucked it up. 

I don't know what happened and how so much changed within a month. We both ordered the exact same thing last month and the pho was one of the best I ever had. I hope it was just an off day for them.
I love açaí bowls! Reminds me of my trip to Hawaii! I ordered a medium Cloud 9 bowl. Perfect mix of ingredients and flavor. Loved the color!

I've been coming to this place for years.  My Vietnamese college roommate introduced me to pho at this place circa 1996.  And while the friendship has come and gone, my love of pho has only gotten stronger.  

This place is almost like a cafeteria.  It's always packed, there's always a flow of people in and out, and the food comes out fast and hot.  It's a little divey--but then again you're in Chinatown.  If I walked into a swanky pho place in Chinatown, I would immediately walk out because that's not normal.  The goi cuon is very good.  The pho is above average (you can taste lots of star anise) but a touch on the too-salty side.  The vermicelli dishes are average.

Back when I was a Vietnamese food newbie, I would have unhesitatingly given this place 5 stars.  But now that my Vietnamese palate has become a bit more sophisticated (thanks to the Denver, CO Vietnamese food scene--what UP Federal Boulevard woot woot!) this place gets 3 stars.

Tried this place tonight as I was in the mood for pho. I prefer vegetable pho, altho I am not strictly a vegetarian. It was not on the menu but when I requested it they said it was available. It was very good, a nice tasty broth and crock full of lovely veggies, with a nice big bowl of sprouts, basil, hot peppers and limes to top it off. My husband got the flank steak pho and enjoyed it  

We got summer rolls as an appetizer. They were very fresh and served with a peanut dipping sauce. 

I also ordered stir fried vegetables with lemon grass. They were tasty but somewhat oily so not really all that healthy. 

It was unbelievably cheap. $26 for all that food. Great service, very friendly staff.

Respectable breakfast and not super crowded.  Good atmosphere. Waitress was friendly. I'll come again!

Still gonna keep the 4 stars. But went back for Dinner and  it was complete chaos.  John the waiter who was there for 2 whole weeks was fantastic but had no help at all from any other leadership.  When sh*t such as call outs or whatnot happens a manager needs to step in and clean a few tables or make sure every guest is being helped.  2 weeks in the business John can't do everything.

When I want to start my day with a good cuppa coffee I head to my local Wawa's. When I pour my cuppa coffee and it comes out looking like tea, that's not a great start to my day. When I asked the young lady behind the counter why my coffee looks like tea. And she gives me sarcastic answer like well you'll just have to wait till the next pot. Makes me really not want to do business with you anymore.

My friend and local food blogger (Juice w/ Jae) invited me to brunch at Sandler's on 9th this past weekend! It was nothing short of amazing and for sure the best experience I have had all year! From the food to the drinks and service I was blown away. This place has comfort food on another level! We went Saturday and I dragged another friend there on Sunday for another round of brunch! My weekend was nothing short of amazing thanks to the amazing service!! 

+ my server Jordyn was so sweet!!! Even the managers are super hands on with the service!!! The energy is incredible!!! I'm sending everyone I know here!!!

Nice place that offered excellent service right off the start, decor is pleasant but low budget for sure!

I had the 16 oz ribeye with spaghetti and meatballs $33.00, the steak was very tasty and tender, a bit to much grizzle at times!

The pasta was cooked just perfect doneness and the sauce was outstanding!

A soup or salad came with my plate which I choose the Greek lemon and noodle soup that may have been the best item of all?

Garlic bread we ordered was very nice too!

We finish with a fresh baked peach cobbler that was delish!

My friend had the spaghetti and meatballs that he seemed to be making love love too?

I would definitely recommend this place/ the staff was friendly as well!!

Yum yum

Stopped here because of the Yelp reviews. It's worthy!

I had the Hulk smoothie and the Chicken & Brie sandwich. The Hulk was green and tasted like bananas plus many other subtitle flavors. So good!
The sandwich- hold crap that's good! Chicken, Brie, caramelized onion, garlic heaven! The tomato soup - not sure what's in it but also excellent!

My friends had the Açaí Cacao Warrior bowls and they said it was excellent. 

Ya, it's that good!

Ambiance:  Not much to speak of.  The renovations might have more of a positive effect if the place was not always packed with people and noisy.  Clean and typical.

Food:  The food is always priced well and you know that you are going to be more than full walking out of here.  The types of dishes have a huge range (just look at the enormous menu).  I personally do not like Pho as much as Chinese Hand Drawn Noodles, but my friends love the Pho here.  Popular dishes like green curry chicken, lemon grass chicken, beef ho fun, papaya salad, and raw beef never disappoint.  This is not a gourmet foodie place - this is a comfort/classic food place for people who grew up on this stuff (or at least wish they did).

Service:  The service is good and very typical of an Asian restaurant.  The servers are not going to fawn all over you or constantly check in.  But when you do flag them down for something, they will always follow up on your request fully and quickly.

Overall:  I definitely like this place for its consistency, the food , and the price.  I often crave food from here and it always coincidentally happens on a Wednesday (the day that they are closed).

I wanted to like this place so badly! I love healthy food and this seemed like a convenient option. The menu has lots of vegetarian and vegan options, which I was super excited about. Unfortunately, we didn't even get a chance to eat there and had to take our food to go. Why you might ask? Because they don't have a single high chair! It's a real bummer because I have two small boys and there was no way any of us were going to get a chance to eat without at least one high chair. I don't have enough hands for that. So if you have young kiddos, this is definitely something you need to know. We took our food to go and just ate at home. Pretty disappointing since the restaurant itself was stylish and I would like to have hung out there a bit. As for the food, we ordered the Azteca bowl and the teriyaki vegetable bowl with tofu. The Azteca bowl was good but there were was not much meat in there. Boo! I really liked the flavor of the teriyaki bowl but the tofu was sad and mushy. I love tofu but the way it was prepared was barely edible.

CHEAP CHEAP FAST FOOD !! didn't actually eat pho but my friend did. I got the minced shrimp on sugarcane, pork balls, and spring roll on vermicelli and it was pretty good. the pork balls were balling af. portions are pretty good but if you want the largest portion you should probably get the pho because the bowls are HUGE

This restaurante has the tastiest food, great music and wonderful, friendly staff. 
FYI try the short ribs are to die for.
BBQ chicken nachos-amazing!!! Great to cure a hangover. Our server Nicole was very attentive and pointed us in the right direction. So glad we finally made it there!!!!

I was so excited to try this place out after seeing pics of the food and the gleaming reviews. We went in for breakfast before an appointment and before we ordered, we let the server know we were in a bit of a hurry. She said no problem. Twenty minutes go by after ordering and nothing. No one walked by to ask the status of our order and the only sound we heard were the loud, drunk people getting wasted at 8 am at the bar. I got up to look for someone but couldn't find the bartender or our server but when I did, I asked for our food to be made to go. I waited another 10 minutes and still nothing. When we finally got our order, we paid and ran down the street to make our appointment and only had 5 minutes to eat. French toast burnt on one side and raw on the other. The fried chicken was burnt on the outside and soggy pink on the inside. We were starving and stuck I wrote an email to the owner months ago but did not get a response.
By far one of the best restaurants I have been to in Philadelphia. If you like craft food and great service this is the place to go. I travel for work and this is my new favorite place in Philly.

Ok- we sat down to eat in this restaurant and had to get up to leave. I have never seen such a dirty floor in my life. It really creeped me out and I could not make myself give them the benefit of the doubt and order. I feel bad for leaving such a poor review but "Eek! Methinks not" describes my thoughts exactly when looking around this restaurant.

Went here, because the Yelp reviews mentioned brunch all day. Teayana recommended the Braised-n-Confused (brisket cheesesteak with a fried egg on top) for a unique experience and the Salted Caramel French Toast. I ended up getting the Braised-n-Confused and a kids-sized French toast. Both were excellent! Would definitely eat here again, if I'm in downtown again. It's a short walk from the Liberty Bell and Independence Hall.
I am from out of town and needed to get my labradoodle in to get checked.  This office was wonderful.  Got me in right away, Sadie was very well taken care of and I would go back to them any time!!

We had a brunch here for my graduation (about 30 people).  All the food was amazing! The staff is so friendly and management was very flexible and accommodating.  My friends and family had a great time.

Our family came here for delicious foods and pho
Sometimes our family cane from other states or city we always brought them here to try over years. 
We recommended try Pho Xe Lua

This was honestly the most disappointing meal during my week in Philly.

I came in after seeing all the reviews about their "phenomenal" lobster roll and traveled all the way from UPenn just to try them out. I was greeted after a few minutes of just standing near the hostess table and was taken to my table. The hostess sat me down and then I waited again for a waiter, and this place was completely empty when I walked in. I watched the hostess, bartender, and other waiters loiter around the bar while I was sitting down waiting for someone to help me for around 5-10 minutes. Also as I was waiting, I saw around 2 pairs of people walk in and wait to be serviced, but never were so they just walked out. 

My waitress was extremely nice, but she seemed like she was in a rush the whole time. I asked about the Lobster roll after seeing it on the pictures in Yelp, and she told me that they had gotten rid of it and replaced it with the Lobster & Shrimp Salad Roll so I got that naturally. 

When it had come out, I was so excited, it looked mouth watering. But taste-wise, it was below average. It had no taste to it. I felt like I was chewing on old gum. But I finished it because I had just finished my tour of Independence Hall during the heat wave. My fries were perfect though. 

I gave this place 2 stars because of my waiter and my fries. Nothing else. Water is a ridiculous price here, $5. I could've gone over to Wawa and gotten the same bottle for $2.

Sandler's on 9th stood out to my boyfriend and I as all open restaurants on Christmas Day to. We'd never heard of it, but it looked like a nice place from what we could tell glancing through the windows. We were pleasantly surprised upon walking in and I recall one of us said to the other "this is going to be a new place for us". 

The atmosphere was my favorite thing about this place. We felt relaxed and comfortable as soon as we walked in. The decor is well thought out but it's not in-your-face and overly designed. The restaurant itself is pretty large and it also had a family vibe to it. It's the kind of place I'd probably bring my family when they visit for a nice breakfast/brunch. 

As for the food, there weren't many vegan options and the menu could use some help as far as labeling goes to help those with allergies/dietary restrictions. That aside, I had the quinoa bowl and my boyfriend had the two eggs any style. We also had some mimosas. All of it was delicious, the portions were big, and it was very reasonably priced in my opinion.

I wrote a good review many months ago. Since then, I have been back a few times and I hate to admit but I was thoroughly disappointed in my meals and service. I live close by so I kept wanting to give it another chance. Now, I really would recommend going elsewhere. The salad toppings were sparse and the lettuce was part brown. The chicken wings were bland. The eggs were too buttery. Overall, I don't think I'll go back unless I'm with other people who want to go.
Aware of scam Vitnamese food. Photo is not what they have. So  mad about it. Is this another fake or scam to show what you cannot do. Photo of sample for what???

Great wawa for how busy 301 is, always in and out fast. The only complaint I have is the people that beg for money outside, there is always someone that asks me and I'm there almost everyday because it's close to my job and it's a quick run in. But just today I went there on lunch and their was 1 person that asked me then I walk out and someone else is asking me. That's the only complaint I have about it but it's a great location and the people that work there are always nice.
Ultra clean and delicious food, I visit regularly whenever I'm in Tucson... usually awful music playing a notch too loud, lol, but their food makes up for it, and great customer service...

Where do I begin?

The protein bowls, especially the Thai one with chicken are incredible.  My mouth was engorged in a sea of spicy Thai peanut sauce 

The beach bod smoothie is delicate and beautiful.  It makes being a bro who lifts that much tastier.

The pick up orders are very speedy.  

They have a nice little patio and inside dining area.  Parking is a bit strange but not an issue.

Overall, I love coming to this spot.  I'm here probably once a week.  My only negative feedback concerns the counter staff, who more often than not are impersonal and dry.
The Mediterranean Tofu Bowl is my favorite! It's so flavorful and crave it all the time! Sooooo good!

How does this place not have reviews yet!? This has been the most FIRE meal I have had in a long time, and I am Cuban myself! I eat it all the time but this place is crazy. I've never been the type to put the energy into a review but this is just so amazing. I had the masitas fritas (fried pork chunks) with extra of the mojo on top with white rice and red beans. Fire. I also had a side of the tostones (twice fried plantains) and they were huge and the perfect thickness. Don't lose your cook! Lol

Wide selection of high quality fine patisseries, the type that you'd find on a street in Paris without costing you an arm and a leg. Owned by La Colombe, but definitely with more of a messy, homey European feel.

[ desserts ]
Amazing selection: basic homestyle desserts like cookies and croissants; fine pastries such as chocolate cakes, tiramisu, coffee cakes, strawberry shortcake, carrot, and panna cotta; and a wide chocolate selection as well.

Portioning is convenient: cakes come in tiny bite-sized pieces, slightly larger ones for sharing between two people, and large group-sized ones.

They also have sugar-free versions of their popular desserts!

Only complaint is that I wish they had signs and labels for prices and what each item is, so that you don't have to ask the servers about each individual item.

[ macarons ]
Towards the back of the shop is a large selection of small macarons. I think they are more nuanced in flavour and more well-made than Sugar Philly, which is the more well-known macaron source in Philadelphia.

All macarons that I ever eat get compared against the gold standard, Ladurée in Paris. These are less fine and heavier in flavour and texture, but still quite good (7.5/10):

-Green tea: strong and well-flavoured, small flecks of tea leaves in the cookie
-Earl grey chocolate: sounded great in theory, but not so good in execution. Earl grey flavour just didn't marry well with the chocolate.
-Fleur (d'oranger et rose): my personal favourite. Heavier and not as subtle as the Ladurée version, but quite good nonetheless.

Quality coffee and drink menu too.

[ vibe ]
Definitely hints of Paris café culture, without the snobbery. French music on an iPod dangling from a cable next to the milk and sugar stand, which was cute in a disheveled kind of way.

Servers wear cute black fedoras and are quite attentive and friendly.

There's about 6 tables inside, a bar facing the window (great for work or people-watching), and a table outside as well.

[ conclusion ]
Worth a stop for high-quality desserts at a great price in a nice European environment.

The only reason I didn't give five stars is because it seems like the portions vary in size depending on who is making them.   I ordered a salad yesterday which seemed larger than the exact same salad I ordered today.  

That aside, the food is amazingly fresh and better quality than you will find anywhere.  Everything is well made.
This is by far the best laundromat I've ever been in. Very clean, very friendly, and exceptional service. Everything is done through an app so the hassle of carrying coins is over!
I loved their food. I wish they could come up with a system to diminish the smell of cheese but it's understandable... besides that, they are excellent

I wish to give them a 5 star but the server is kinda not in the very welcoming mood and cashier guy is rude in someway from beginning to the end. He maybe is the owner or at least a part of that manager. Lack of smile most of staff 
I surprised that they have such a full menu of Vietnamese food, basically all is Southern Vietnamese cuisines, maybe the chef is from Old Saigon. I found my Soda Sua Hot Ga after 20 years, kinda my childhood drink which is made by Condensed Milk and Egg Yolk then add Club soda. It's yummy drink and they did it good. You should try if you're not afraid of fat and sugar. Not that terrible bad or too sweet tho
I ordered Pho xe lua dac biet XL cause I always want to eat a lot of meat. Pho Broth is tasteful and smell so good, maybe one of the best smells ever since I moved to US and eat all place from California to many place in NewYork, Washington. However The decorations of food is such a big problem. Very 1 star look. And they gave me a big bowl with so much Pho( i mean white rice noodles) and not that much Meat or others as I expected when ordered an extra size. That's not cool. 
The same with my friend's Bun thit nuong, taste good but so lack of decoration for a nicer look. 
My disappointment is on the Shrimp and Pork Papaya salad. They bring it totally separated ingredients, is that because American like that way??, but in Vietnamese restaurants I haven't ever seen such a plank and weird way like that. 
If the owner can read that, please notice that we go to the restaurant to eat and pay for you guys. Make it with respect and some good attention. Food is an art thing and southern Vietnamese is very soulful lovable people who always made food with happy and fruitfulness. Don't just throw it to customer. 
I barely write a long message but cause Your chef did a good job on the Pho broth so I hope that you guys can change and pay a little more attention to the look of the food. Then You guys will rock the world.

It's a great space with ambiance, lighting, and good music playlist.  Food was fine, but agree with the other reviewer that it's more expensive than it should be.  The service was not great. It wasn't even busy and yet it took far too long to to order, and zero follow up after food was dropped to check in or refill drink glasses.  With slightly lower prices and more attentive service, it would be a winner.

This place is horrible. The older Mexican lady, the "manager" in the office would always try and sell me drugs when I would come to drop off the rent. Place has no security.  Crack heads walk around the pools at night and wonder and try to walk into apartments. Whenever you report things to the front office they always brush it off. We had a roach problem and they said "it's just a Tucson thing". This place sucks!!!! We tried to move out within the first  5 days but they refused to let us break the lease.

This is how the discussion on what to eat went. Are you Hungry? Yes. Want to go see Rose? Yes!!
We enjoy the food at Olive Garden, but nothing beats the service we receive from the Wonderful Rose.
Six years later, still fabulous and still a regular! Wendy and Peter know what customer service is all about. Great quality yogurt with Mom and Pop service. How about six stars

We went at almost noon on Black Friday, and got right in. The service was phenomenal and the food was delicious and fresh! We even opted for the extra $5 take home meals and ended up with lunch and dinner all for $40 (that includes a very generous tip)
The creamiest frozen yogurt in town. Delish!  Wendy the owner is super nice and friendly. We love this place.  I recommend the peanut butter and chocolate frozen yogurt.  Smoothies are also great.

Cool space and fast drinks but they should really rethink their djs and music options. When you are looking to drunk dance and have a good time, you don't wanna dance to Adele's depressing remix of Skyfall. Dance floor fail.

3 Stars  - Because the food was awesome in every way. I had issue with the pungent smell that permeated the building as soon as you walk in. I made me so nauseous that I didn't even eat my main course meal when I got it. It's like a sour fermented alcohol smell and it's in the carpet everywhere you walk. I gave three stars because Fritz is a nice kid but his attention was focused primarily on the couple that was seated after us. They got their complete meal and was leaving while we were still working on our appetizers and waiting on our main course. 

I like the fact that he was social but when you work in this industry you have to be like a bee  going from flower to flower to ensure that all your guests feel appreciated and welcomed. We didn't get that feeling. I wish I could chalk it up to a busy lunch crowd as it would be understandable, perhaps he's a fairly new kid and he's still learning his craft in this industry.

The food was exceptional, the drinks amazing but when you represent a brand as it's face so to speak, remember that a measure of pride had to be worn just like the name tag or the uniform. 

We've visited this Olive Garden before so the expectation was higher... not sure what happened since our last visit but when the manager walks past without even greeting you at your table or making eye contact and giving a silent nod... something is lacking...

Do better Olive Garden

10/4/19

Well, they clearly listened when I reviewed them last and steps were obviously made to address issues and deficiencies. Great job! Our server, Mariah, is very friendly and attentive even though this is a busy night and she has other guests.  We're up to 4  stars, Olive Garden... keep it up! I'll be  ing!

Nice place, pretty empty on a weeknight. The wait staff was great and kept entertaining my 4 yr old daughter, who loved their thin crust pizza. I got the tuna poke tacos, which were delicious, and the Brussel sprouts. They were out of some items off the beer tap list, but otherwise a nice selection of bottle beers.

Day 1 was great. Maybe cause I went super early.  

Unfortunately it's gone downhill. The last time I immediately noticed a bad odor. No other way to put it except it smelled like sh"t. Very strong odor. I held my breath and proceeded to go laundry. 

It's a shame because their machines are pretty good.
So upset this place closed :( terrible area though, so not exactly surprised. However I rarely fall in love with a restaurant. I hope y'all will reopen somewhere one day!
Friendly staff and amazing food. The crab cakes were amazing. My friend tried the lobster poutine and she loved it.

Came into town for the night. And am staying down the street. It was lunchtime and to early to check in
But hey, I'm in Philadelphia chinatown, with Vietnamese Pho on the mind. So, here I am. Boy, what an experience. So much delicious food for such a great price. Cannot wait till my next trip to Philadelphia.

Sudaze has been around for 10 years and for very good reasons. Wendy and Peter have kept up the tradition of the former owner, Carol. The quality of the yogurt and the best service ever keep my husband and I coming back multiple times a week. What other Yogurt store keeps a file of your favorites and then phones you when the flavor is in? I call in an order and receive a bag with my name, spelled correctly, in bright markers. The yogurt is  creamy and the flavors are not just vanilla and chocolate , although they have them too. I love cake batter, red velvet cake, peanut butter and original tart ( to mention a few). Sudaze is a MOM and POP store! It is very very Special. Can you tell I am a true Fan!!?

This was my first time here based on my Vietnamese friends' recommendation. It is in Chinatown. The restuarant sign is clearly visible but the entrance is a little confusing. You have to climb up the stairs and the door is immediately on the left. It is a cozy yet clean place and packed with people. 

I ordered the beef pho which was $8.75 for a large bowl (versus an extra large bowl). The broth was flavorful and not too salty. I wish they had an option for well done beef, tripe and meatballs but I didn't see that on the menu. The fried chicken wings were meh....I would pass next time. It didn't taste like fried wings from a Viet or Korean place. There was minimal breading and didn't have any flavor to it; not spicy nor salty. Just very bland.

Service was fast and friendly. Although when I asked for my pho to be packed as leftovers, the waitress put the broth and noodles in the same container which is a no no for me because the noodles will suck the broth out. 

Overall a good place to stop by especially on a cold, rainy day like today.
Staff was delightful, but the food was bland and average.  Very disappointed because I was looking so forward to dining here. I won't return.

The food at Sandler's on 9th is incredible. They have so many unique flavors of American comfort food that you can't get anywhere else. In addition, their chef is constantly innovating new items and specials that are all so good. 

I definitely recommend stopping by to try one of their burgers and poutines! You will be treated well by the kind and attentive staff that do their best to accommodate any need you may have including dietary restrictions! Check them out!

As of January 2018 it has come to my attention that there is a BED BUG infestation there .... Iam posting this because it's so horrible for anybody and so hard to eliminate ...Some one I know lives there and although not brought by this person is expected to pay for the 500  fee for the exterminator.. How ever it was shared with this individual that there might need to be several extermination that need to be done ... I am goin through this with this person and it's HORRIBLE.. PLEASE INQUIRE if you decide to rent here.. RENTERS BEWARE....

Excellent dinner. We sat at the bar and "amazing mike" was our bartender/server. He gave us his top 5 choices on the dinner menu to pick from. He was spot on, as the nachos were the best we've had and my burger guy absolutely loved his burger with short ribs. It was so big and not able to  finish all of it. It was cooked perfectly. Drinks were great and the brownie sundae Mike brought out for Scott's bday was super nice and delicious. Aly the owner's daughter was very sweet and welcoming. We will definitely be back soon to try other things. This was a great recommendation from a friend who is foodie himself. You must give this place a try. Check out their menu you won't be disappointed. 

ENJOY!

My new favorite place!!

My wife contends that I don't do a great job eating a healthy lunch--and she's probably right.  Working in the Campbell corridor, we have Brushfire, Frankies, El Pueblito, Rubios, Five Guys, etc.

She gave me a gift card to Goodness.  So off I went to get a turkey feta wrap for lunch.  This might be the best, freshest, tastiest wrap I've ever had in my whole life.  I was blown away with the yumminess and yet it was healthy.  The freshness even after the weekend was stupendous and the flavors were superb!!  I could eat there 3-4x a week!!  Sorry Frankie, I'll still come get my turkey salad!!

Anyway, more to come--but take out was painless, food was terrific and I can't wait to go back--probably tomorrow!!

We came here for the first time due to all the awesome yelp reviews, and that we wanted to introduce our 13 yr old neice to some vietnamese/thai grub. Upon walking in, we were greeted by a tank of crustaceans. Seeing the tank of lobsters and crab actually  made me feel like the food was absolutely going to be good. We were sat promptly, despite it being lunch time and the place being very busy.

Our waiter looked semi annoyed that were were taking a bit long to read over the lengthy menu and decided to give us a minute by hoovering right over my shoulder until I was ready.I ordered the Vermicelli noodles with shrimp on sugar cane, pork balls and a spring roll. I would say that my dish was by far the best, mostly because it had so many different components and each very different from the next. The least appealing part of my dish was between the lackingluster egg roll and just overly oily fish on a stick. The pork balls were the best part, and the funnest to say outloud. 

My husband ordered the bbq pork on white rice which was pretty standard, he was not trying to be too adventurous and really enjoyed it. Our niece ordered the shrimp pad thai, and sadly that was a huge disappointment. The dish took forever to make, and although it came looking gorgeous on the plate, it was clearly cooked on a burnt pot. There was this odd smokey flavor to the pasta, and sadly she was so hungry that she just ate all the shrimp off of the plate and didn't bother with the rest.

The trek to this sidestreet itself is worthwhile simply because of the really cheap prices and abundant helpings they serve. I would love to go back and try some more things on the menu and get a fun cocktail from their list.

After dinner, we walked over to this small yogurt shop in the shopping center on the NE corner of Swan/Sunrise. Very small shop - we sat outside at the small group of tables facing Sunrise. They had just a few flavors that change from time to time - we went with the chocolate with sprinkles. Smooth, creamy, and very light - great dessert after a big Italian meal. You can have just the yogurt or have any number of mixins. Friendly staff and great prices at this great neighborhood spot!

Wow - first time here and had a great experience! Was meeting an old friend for a couple drinks - I was met by the bartender Mike who is super friendly and welcoming. I instantly felt like I was hanging with an old friend. He made us great drinks and steered me to the duck quesadillas, which are AMAZING! Bar was a little quiet but Mike made me and my friend feel super welcome and comfortable. Will definitely come back again! Thanks Mike and Sandler's for a great night!!

First and not last time customer. Had bacon fried rice & tuna poke tacos Both were yummy. The bacon fried rice was AMAZING! Service was great as well. Cant wait to return!

P.s. A clean restaurant is a plus!

I work right by this new place so while I watched it being built I knew it was definitely going to be a must try.  I went here for lunch and will definitely be back for more lunches and dinner. 

When we walked in we were asked if we had a reservation, it wasn't needed, but definitely good to know it's an option.  I chose to try the tuna tacos on their appetizer menu with a side of fries, while my fiance got one of their burgers.  Their fries were amazing, super crunchy and salty.  The tuna tacos had a lot of flavor and the tuna was very fresh.  My fiance enjoyed his burger, he said that it was cooked to his liking and it also came with the delicious fries. 

I'm excited they will also have a to-go window on days when I don't have time to sit but feel like having a hearty lunch.

Today I ordered the Turkey Pesto sandwich with the slaw side of the day and it was scrumptious; it had a generous amount of turkey, pesto, goat cheese and sun-dried tomatoes on perfectly toasted multigrain bread. The ingredients were fresh, flavorful and very complementary to each other. Possibly the best sandwich I've had thus far. I'd order it again and recommend! My pickup order was also ready in just a few minutes and the staff was friendly and upbeat.

New management has ruined this establishment. Old management was around for over 15 years and was amazing. With new management, pho broth is way too sweet, service is slow, summer rolls are loose. Also, they installed cameras. This is the only restaurant in Chinatown with cameras pointing at you while you eat. With old management, food was delivered within 4-8 minutes even at peak hours. We went at 5:30pm and waited almost 15-20 minutes for our pho.

We went here for a holiday brunch with about eight of us. They sat us in a private room. The service and all of the food was excellent. This was the second time we went to this restaurant and we will definitely be back for more!

Came here on a Friday night and it wasn't crowded at all, which shocks me. Our waiter joe was absolutely amazing! He helped ya with every question and request. We started with the Chesapeake poutine and it was the best, I could have had that as a meal. I got the duck quesadilla and it was awesome, the bbq sauce in it was so good! Other people at the table got the ahi tuna sandwich and delirium tremor burger and finished it before I could get a picture. This place was so good and I can't wait to try the brunch menu!

This is currently one of my favorite places in Philly. I love the variety of food you can get here. From duck quesadillas to lobster rolls, you can't go wrong! The service is amazing. They are always so friendly and welcoming. Here is what I recommend:

Lobster roll
Short rib burger
Cheddar burger
Duck quesadillas 

I've just had the lunch here, but am excited to try breakfast!

Being  cautious of places that the look too healthy 
I might not gone in but it was 106 degrees and I really need liquids.
I had a delicious and healthy smoothie and checked out all the dishes
Tried one curry That was excellent.  Will be going back to sample more

Me and the husband were carving some authentic tacos and this little place showed up in our search. We ordered the Quesadilla de Camaron and the tacos pescadores, it was delicious. Ordered take out, the owner was very nice. Everything tasted fresh, very pleased. The quesadillas were amazing, the fish tacos were a little on the bland side, could use something tangy, but I was satisfied nonetheless. Definitely will be coming back.

I mean, what can you say? It's an Olive Garden. Food tastes the same as any other location. Large, hearty portions. Creamy alfredo. Zesty unlimited salad. I find the hostesses here to be friendly, and never any issues with the service at this location.

Last night my girlfriend and I decided to visit I candy. What a mistake that was. The bar is completely boring and plays the same setlist but we figured it'll do for a quick drink. Yet Another mistake. As we were sitting at the bar this white woman decides to bogart the tiny space between my gfs chair and the bar. Anyone with good etiquette knows you stand behind someone's chair when ordering a drink when the bar is full. But no. She stood there, pushing my gf several times. After my gf confronted her and asked her to please move over and be respectful the fake Pam Anderson decides to call her a "bitch." Now this is my issue, don't ask for trouble if you aren't looking for any. We proceeded to argue and lo and behold WE were kicked out of the bar. The security guards were completely ignorant to the fact that the woman continuously antagonized the situation and was belligerent. Yet their excuse was she was drunk. And even had the nerve to say that their manager is black. I'm sure he/she wouldn't appreciate that and I wish I would've gotten his name. I've already contacted BBB about this business and will never be visiting this racist establishment again. If I could give them zero stars I would.

I found this place from one of Yelp's suggestive collections (like, you enjoyed these places so maybe you might like this one too). We had a burger hankering and winnings from betting on Country House in Kentucky Derby #145 (who only won as the result of a Derby first-ever DQ) and we decided to try this place out in recognition of such a historic moment.

Sandler's unfortunately was anything but historic for dinner. When we first walked in around 8pm I could see dinner tables already set with coffee mugs for the brunch crowd the next day. This place closes at 11pm per the internet - y'all ain't expecting a dinner rush? Should have been our first sign. Minor red flag went up in our mind, so we sat at the bar.

Bartender was nice. Don't remember her name. There were a decent number of TV's to watch the Phillies, Stanley Cup playoffs, or whatever else you're into.

$8 for a Blue Moon draft! You've got to be out of your mind. We determined bottled Heinekens to be the most economical beer choice ($5.95 at 5%). 

Looking at the rest of the menu, we liked how all the kid meals were named after kid complaints like "I'm not hungry" and "I don't know." Nice touch.

We ordered burgers, as we intended. I got the bacon cheddar burger with sweet potato fries (the bartender presented that option without mentioning the upcharge, not that mentioning it would have deterred me but don't present it like a freebie if it's not) and boyfriend ordered the Hog with regular fries. They came out quickly. Mine was medium well and I always get nervous when they come out 5 minutes later with a medium well burger, but surprisingly it was cooked okay.

My sweet potato fries were PERFECT. The perfect crunch, perfect flavor, perfect salting... I've never had better sweet potato fries in my life. I hope they were house made. Even if they were frozen I wouldn't really care. They were great. Burger was meh. I got a ton of black pepper flavor in the mouth feels and I wasn't into that. Could have used more cheese in my opinion - I've been to Vermont and eaten a ton of Vermont Cheddar in my life and I could barely get a hit of that yumminess. I couldn't determine what Sandler's sauce was, or if I liked it. The bun was flaky and I didn't enjoy it.I like nice, dense, potato buns personally. The branding on the bun was cute, but mine was upside down and for how slow it was in there, that was disappointing. Bacon seemed like it had been dried out into jerky after sitting in the window too long in the kitchen waiting for people to order things with bacon on them.

Boyfriend, however, received the wrong burger. He had a bacon cheddar burger on his plate just like I did. He actually didn't even notice until I asked where the pork was haha. It took a while to get the attention of someone to send it back. Bartender was fetching a beer for someone from the back. I made eye contact with a couple servers who found themselves behind the bar and none of them tried to check on us - maybe they aren't allowed. The host (manager?) was walking around and avoided eye contact only until the bartender had a chance to talk to us first. Finally we got the bartender's attention and her response of "that's definitely not a Hog" gave us the impression that it was the kitchen's fault. She took his burger back (let him keep pickles and fries to munch on). This is when the host (manager?) asked if the burger was okay, now that obviously something was wrong asy boyfriend previously had a burger in front of him and now had no burger. *eyeroll*

Here's the kicker. When the burger came back out - again, way too quickly - we were pretty sure it was the same burger, but with some pork slapped on. It still had the lettuce and tomato from the original burger (which is not mentioned in the Hog description) and didn't have the fancy onion (which is mentioned in the Hog description). Uhhhh, what? Boyfriend said it was okay.

We ate them both because by this point we were hungry and just wanted to eat and get out of there. Also I wanted to savor every last bite of the sweet potato fries. Those fries and the bartender's friendly demeanor (when she was present) are the sole reason for the 2 star rating. This meal was so disappointing after the shocking moment that we witnessed in watching the Derby. We went home and binge watched a Biggie/Tupac series on Netflix to make ourselves feel better.

We won't be back. If I get a hankering for their sweet potato fries, I'll order via Sandler's To Go which we noticed on our way out.

It was my first time to Sandler's and it was, ok. I was really hoping that it would be as great as the menu appeared but I was a little underwhelmed. The menu was simple which often times can communicate that they specialize in the few things they sold. Interestingly, the pancakes were small and lacked flavor, the potatoes were recommended but were overcooked and under seasoned. The service was good, the place is very nice, but again the food is a little on the simpler side. If your looking for a larger selection and a menu that has a few unique specialties this is not your place. It just didn't believe it was worth the money.

We tried this Corner Bistro last night and I was very impressed our waiter did a good job considering he was the only one on the floor and had a party of 15 in a private room very nice house made cocktails interesting menu from chicken waffles which my wife said were amazing the classic soups like tomato an onion an amazing Burgers & Wings a must-try for a group or the after-work crowd or catching a bite

I recently visited Sandler's because of a recommendation from a friend & immediately came back the next weekend! Sandler's On 9th has extremely delicious brunch (try the avocado toast!) and the most incredible service. Nicole is one of the best waitresses I've had in a long time - so nice & friendly and full of great energy! She recommended her favorites to us and let my friends and I know what was the best for us to order. I will definitely be making Sandler's On 9th a go-to spot for my Sunday brunches!

This is always a great place to replenish your energy after a workout. They have amazing smoothies and breakfast bowls for you to choose from. Recently I saw that they have the Rib Eye Banh Mi which is a type of Vietnamese sandwich. I can say they did a good job with the banh mi considering this not a Vietnamese restaurant. Goodness is a great find if you'd like some healthy and delicious food.

I went into this place excited because of all the 5 star reviews, but my experience was quite the opposite.  Perhaps it was just an off-day, but service was terrible.  We had a 2:00 reservation on a Sunday afternoon, so maybe it was just the post-brunch rush that screwed things up, but I'm not sure.

For starters, the place is massive but was practically empty when we got there for our reservation, except for maybe 4 other tables.  After we were seated and given menus, the hostess immediately wanted to take our drink orders to get things moving I guess, but we didn't even get a chance to look at the menu.  She seemed miffed, but we needed a chance to settle in.  Plus, between 4 people we had 2 different brunch menus that were slightly varied, some with more or less dishes in certain categories, so we had no clue which one stood.

It then took a 20-30 minutes before anyone even acknowledged we were sitting there in a brightly lit corner table by the window.  We saw several servers and bussers amble about, but no one made their way towards us.  After realizing no one was coming to see us, we finally flagged down a server who was clearing glasses nearby and she sort of just said "okay" without any sense of urgency and went in the back to grab somebody.  They finally sent someone over who told us that our actual server would be out shortly but that she could take our drink orders at least.  This girl was friendly and fast, I wish I could remember her name.  She did the best she could with the clearly short-staffed/confused situation.  Our actual server never did end up being our server, so props to the new girl for picking up quick.

We ordered a pitcher of the raspberry mimosa, which was just okay. It wasn't cold at all and had bits of raspberry seeds in it, so not super refreshing.  Food was decent, but nothing great.  My favorite part was my app, which was the potato pancakes with apple sauce and sour cream (although I've had better).  Friends ordered the avocado toast with eggs, the french dip sandwich and the chicken and waffles, which they all seemed to like.  My pancakes came out straight up burnt (charred black) on the bottom (which they clearly plated that way to hide it, thinking I wouldn't notice).  I never send food back, but I sent those back and they took just a little too long to come back for being screwed up and presumably made "on the fly."  I ordered a side of bacon in the interim, and that was crispy and delicious, so that's good.

Two other tables in the vicinity also seemed to be having the same issues with service as we did, cause they all looked a bit impatient and I heard their servers say "sorry" often, so maybe it was just one of those days.

Again took an eternity for some reason to receive and pay the check and at that point we just wanted to leave after waiting for so long prior to the meal.  I can't remember the total price with tip, but based on the menu prices I imagine it was what's to be expected for that area of the city, but not worth it in my opinion.  If the food was stellar despite the service, maybe I'd return, but there's just so many other options in the city.

Their pho: I defy you to find better. The place itself is clean and uplifting. Very light and welcoming. Usually filled with ethnic folk who know what's good. I have never had a bad dish here. And that extends over many years of patronizing. Go----you won't be disappointed. And did I mention the value: super!!

This place kind of stinks... We needed a quickish dinner before the Walnut Street Theatre & thought we'd try something new.  I'll start with the atmosphere, it was a bit uncomfortable...we were seated against a glass door with a booth on one side and a hard chair on the other. It would be acceptable until another table was seated right next to us and there was pretty much no way to go to the bathroom without my husband moving the table so I could get out. (Why not stagger seating? Plenty of other empty tables).  Then our waiter seemed like he could care less about waiting on us (and his other tables). We weren't super hungry, so after drink ordering we settled on the Philly cheesesteak Scotch egg for an app & each of us ordered a salad for a meal. I know, I didn't think this food would be a fair assessment of this place, but just wait. The Scotch egg was one tiny egg covered in extremely dry ground beef (or ground turkey? Tasteless crumbs, either way)...I don't know in what world it was reminiscent of a cheesesteak. There was the tiniest schmear of a sauce and a couple slices of raw jalapeños. This miserable and tiny offering was like $12. Then the salads were just as bad; my husband hated the Cobb salad & my wedge salad was tasteless (the worst ever croutons but I guess it was the only bread we were going to receive...) the only flavor came from bland ranch & burnt bacon.  We wanted to order dessert but our waiter took SO long to ever return to us. We ran out of time before we had to leave for the show so we just paid and left. Now, when I said that usually don't review a place until I feel like I gave it a fair assessment? Well the table next to us was having a dismal experience with our same waiter and their food. They ordered medium well steaks and the server said, "ok here's the RARE" to which they expressed their shock (no one ordered rare) and they had to wait eternities for the correct temps to come back out.  They were also going to a show and were panicking about the time it was taking.  I think it's safe to say that this place kind of stinks all around.

Sky Deck - YES!
Restrooms - YES!
Music - most of the time, YES! 
Decor - Mehhhh, pretty gaudy, but tolerable - good effort.

I miss the olden days of clubs. When clubs just happened to have bars, and weren't bars that happen t have clubs.
*sigh*

Two and a half stars. Tolerant bouncers, strong but not particularly tasty drinks. Bartender pushed the fireball cocktail that tasted like a glass of Big Red gum, and the subsequent drinks were not much better. At least shirtless "Channing Tatum Jr" was prompt with water bottles for the drunkies. Overall not a superfan of the relatively covered rooftop tiki bar. I'm hoping the absence of dancing was because it was a Sunday night. Second level wasn't open during our visit, and the single occupancy women's bathroom was treated like a private alternative to the multi-unit men's room. I've had way more fun at Woody's, but as far as gay bars go, I'll admit that the window shopping options are decent here for the gents.

New management has ruined this establishment. Old management was around for over 15 years and was amazing. With new management, pho broth is way too sweet, service is slow, summer rolls are loose. Also, they installed cameras. This is the only restaurant in Chinatown with cameras pointing at you while you eat. With old management, food was delivered within 4-8 minutes even at peak hours. We went at 5:30pm and waited almost 15-20 minutes for our pho.
Great ambience and a great meal. Service is excellent. Good variety of meat and appetizers. Everything that I have eaten here, has always been excellent.

Villa Bugs! I'm not kidding that's their new name! The owners are from Miami and are COLUMBIANS! They don't own any properties in Florida! What does Tony Montana say about the COLUMBIANS? Well this place used to be an MCLife property and they were ten times better.  I am moving the hell out.  They aren't even honoring my lease.  I'm getting an attorney!

Vibes: casual, classic American all day every day, kept simple without tablecloths; good for dates or long table gatherings

Tasting notes:
-Braised and Confused: cut in half with a beautifully fried, sunny-side up  egg on each half; bread is fluffy and thick to hold in the molten, sharp provolone and tender brisket; couple spoonfuls of home-fried potatoes with brown onions on the side to make the dish a solid brunch choice (especially as a hangover cure) 

Other thoughts:
-Server was super nice and welcoming, took the time to talk about the bar that just started up
-Love the range of dishes that run all-day, so there's bound to be something for whatever time of day  

Will be back for: the rest of the all-day menu, paired with a cocktail or two!

Nicole was a fun and friendly waitress. She was warm and welcoming!This was our first time here and she recommended the tuna tacos and bbq chicken nachos that were out of this world! Best nachos ive ever had. The beer selection is pretty extensive and delicious. My boyfriend and i love beers and they definitely satisfied our taste buds!! Will be back here again!!!

Talk about a wasted lunch time. I went in as soon as the Olive Garden opened. One table in another part of the restaurant had two people seated. I was enjoying my quiet lunch, but the restaurant seated a very loud family of kids in the table right next to mine, with entire place empty. Ruined my peaceful lunch and I left without leaving a tip. Waitress you list out because your front counter person doesn't know how to seat loud people away from quiet diners. Ron
