Once everyone arrived and took their seats, the food started coming out and everyone was amazed by the deliciousness of everything. The hummus and babaganoush came out first with homemade, hot and fresh pita bread. Then came the stuffed grape leaves and cabbage rolls, fried kibbeh balls, and lentils with rice. Then, when everyone thought we were done, they brought out chicken and lamb kabobs. Everything was divine! 

I swear if I got to redo this party 100 times, I wouldn't change a thing. Everything was perfect. There is not another place in the city that I would recommend more than this place, whether it be for a party of 40 or a dinner for two. Best byo in Philly.

Super disappointed with this place, mostly because I went in not knowing it was a fast style dining place and also a chain. They had no vegetarian or vegan lunch options outside of a very simple salad. I tried the fruit tart and it was pretty average. I got a drink, a salad, and a pastry and it came out to $15. Definitely not going back here, not a good value for my money.

This Cosi has gone downhill in recent months. It seems they put less chicken in the buffalo bleu than they used to and it can be cold instead of room temperature. They put less dressing on it too. What was one of my favorite lunch sandwiches is now just... average.  The chips are stale half the time. I'm going to have to cut this location out of my lunch rotation.
The doctor is great but the scheduling is terrible and patients had to wait long time to get seen

I used to live at the University City Cosi when I was in college. Well, I wanted to anyway. So many happy memories of squagels and mocha...

MANY years later, I can't even remember the last time I went to a Cosi, but it probably would have been in New York. I got lured into this one by their one-month promotion of their pizza flatbreads, a whole flatbread for $5 (they're usually over $8). I called up a friend one evening last week and we met at this location, which is much larger than I remember the University City one being, and also appropriately styled for being in the middle of the business district - lots of tables and very spacious between the food and beverage bars. It was pretty empty (my friend and I were the only people there), so I figure they're slow most evenings and super busy for mornings and afternoons. The service was quick and courteous, and the line cook who made our pizza margherita whipped up a fresh pie for us, which I thought was a nice touch. The woman at the beverage bar humored my preference to get my mojito lemonade in my own tumbler that I'd brought instead of using a disposable plastic cup. (That lemonade is SO sweet, seriously had to keep diluting it with water.)

So pretty much everything was looking good, and then we got to the pizza. For a fast casual chain, I'd say they do a pretty good job. The crust was the best part, obviously, but the fresh mozzarella and generously adorned basil were better than I expected too. The one downside was the tomato sauce. Too sweet. A little too much like ketchup. But I hate ketchup and sweet tomato sauces, so that's probably just a personal quibble. Overall, for the $5 deal, I'll try to make it back this week, but maybe not for full price. 

Those squagels though...I'll probably come back for one of those again.

Seriously my new favorite place in Tucson. The interior is gorgeous, the prices are good, the deals are absolutely awesome, and best of all - the food was killer. I got their "all you can eat French toast" deal with a side of bacon, eggs, and sausage - and it was the best dining out experience I'd had in months. Tasted better than any other breakfast experience I can remember in Tucson - especially for the price. 10/10, would highly recommend. I'll be bringing all my friends and family!
The French toast here is AMAZING! And the customer service is top of the line. Highly recommend this place!
so i went to kneaders for the first time. I ordered a salad with tomatoes .I didnt get tomatoes and im not happy .I will spend my money whee people make me happy
I dream about their french toast. I think it changed my life.

Honestly, I wasn't really impressed by our recent lunch at Kneaders.  We've been waiting to give them a try, and expected this place would be awesome because of how busy it always seems to be.  I'm not sure why it's so busy after having eaten here.

I had a turkey sandwich.  The turkey was dry.  The bread was dry.  The lettuce was partially brown.  They put the tiniest amount of whatever their "Kneaders Sauce" spread is.  I'm still not sure what it is, as I couldn't find a description of it on the menu, and there wasn't enough on the sandwich to taste it or to break up the dryness of the bread and meat.  And for a place to call themselves "Kneaders" and have such pitifully dry and tasteless bread is beyond my comprehension.  There was nothing to it.  It didn't taste fresh.  Maybe I hit up the place at the wrong time (11:30AM on a Saturday), but it didn't live up to the expectation.

My husband had the big grilled cheese sandwich.  It was very generic.

The pastries were ok, nothing to rush back for, though.  The chocolate croissant was a little dry, but the middle where they had a good enough chocolate-to-dough ratio was good.  The chocolate chip cookie is nothing to write home about (Beyond Bread, Eegees, etc all make better cookies).  

I also tried their caramel apple.  This was probably the best thing I ate here, even though part of the apple was totally rotten inside.  They coat a green apple very generously with caramel (and some have chocolate or candy, too).  It was tasty, but the rotten bit wasn't cool.

The service was slow and confused.  They kept running food to the wrong tables.

Anyway, the food is edible, but nothing outrageously good.  I've tried it, and don't feel a need to go back anytime soon.

Stopped in today after a hike. Our server was so friendly and helpful with the 9 month old with us (brought out a banana while we waited for our food and brought his eggs out first). The huevos rancheros were AMAZING. La colombe coffee was a nice treat . Would love to go back

I absolutely love Split Endz!!! Leanna is amazing and always makes my hair look gorgeous!! Everyone there makes you feel welcome and I won't go anywhere else!  The best salon I have ever been to and I can't wait to go back! I highly recommend them :)

My father's estate paid 1843 Memorials $905 in October 2018 to clean his grave stone and engrave death year.  As of September 2020 (more than 2 years later), WORK NOT STARTED.  

DO NOT give your money or business to this company.  We've demanded a refund so that we can get the poor man's gravestone engraved.  Our BBB complaint will simply add to their "F" rating - wish our estate attorney would have done research first.

Before I went to this restaurant I wish  had read one of these reviews. This restaurant is one of the WORST places I have ever eaten in Tampa. The food was cold, bland and disgusting looking. The salad was brown, the craw fish was bland and cold, the rice was cold, to say the least and those were the good features. The restaurant looks pleasant from the outside, but the lack of customers should have been my first clue to immediately walk out. I complained to the manager(half women/half man) about the food, & rather then say or do anything that could made my visit and review pleasant, she basically told me too bad & stomped off, but was quick to hand me the bill along with a nasty attitude.  Having a meal at Taco Bell or McDonald's would have been more tasty, filling and not as expensive.

I will NEVER go back to this restaurant and the best thing that can be done is that it gets shut down!!!!!  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!

A Kneaders bakery opened up about a year ago right down the street.  We were so excited/worried.  We knew this could cause significant weight gain!  I've been there over a dozen times and some of their pastries are pretty darn great. Brownies are good/great and the muffin tops are very nice as well.  I realize it's mostly (if not all) frozen and pre-made but that's fine.  It's fairly inexpensive and it's so close by it doesn't matter that the quality isn't top notch.  The inside is nice and would be a great place to do homework for a student or for me to get some work done. That is it WOULD be .....if they had WiFy....which for some reason they don't.  We went in, ordered some food and a couple cups of coffee. I asked the young lady behind the counter for the WiFy password.  She RUDELY replied "no! We don't have wify and nowhere around here does.  The closest place would probably be the mall!"  I want a little taken aback by her aggressive and disrespectful tone.  I asked her to cancel my order.  She looked at me like I had wasted her time.  There weren't many people in the Place but she was acting overwhelmed as if she were working at a high volume motor vehicle office.  The girl was even dull enough to give me her name ...Kelsey. 
Now I realize it isn't Kelsey's fail they don't have the internet at the freaking bakery/ coffee shop where she works.  But next time she ought to be a little (a lot) more respectful about the way she breaks the bad news.  
Come on Kneaders...spend the 40 bucks a month and start acting like a business.  Maybe some more people would spend time and eat some of your half decent food.  And please train your young staff a little manners.
High quality brick oven pizzas. Really enjoyed the classic margherita and verdura (white) offerings. We'll be back.

I brought my car in because I had a low pressure light going off even after filling my tires twice with air. They didn't find any leaks after checking and spraying. The mechanic went so far as to show me my tires and put extra air in so I felt safe for an upcoming road trip- and no more tire light. Great service! :)

Used to love this place but sadly it has gone downhill! Bad service, poor quality food and poor quality coffee. Perhaps the baked goods are made well but we ordered the breakfast sandwich which was delicious in the past but this time the egg was overcooked and sandwich arrived to table looking like a mess. Also we ordered cappuccino which they brought looking like coffee and milk. No foam. When asked they explained machine was broken . But still charged us. What??!!! Very disappointing. Not good customer service at all.

Absolutely the best Frappes in Tucson. Yes even better then Starbucks!!!! WAY cheaper too... I took my friend by there today to try the white chocolate and berries frappe. She says she will NEVER go to Starbucks again!!! The Frappes are $3.29 and really big! And they have a convenient drivethru. Try a FRAPPE you will not be disappointed. As for the pastries I was impressed with those too.They're as good as Beyond Bread desserts. I bought the muffin tops and my family was so happy with them.They were  so big we cut each one in half... I HOPE MORE AND MORE PEOPLE WILL GIVE THIS BAKERY A TRY BECAUSE THEY SURE ARE WORTH IT

Yummy soup!  Their bread bowls are amazing!  They have many different soups everyday and always have the bread bowl option.  Their sandwiches are good as well as their salads.  I didn't love the brownies I had from there though!  But if I'm in the mood for some homecooking soup and bread... This is my place!

I love this place! I was a little skeptical at first but so glad I tried it! I usually get the pastrami sandwich on sourdough and the mango tango. Quality over quantity in my opinion. Ya the portion sizes I can see being "small" but if you get the full I would say it's as big a 6in at subway .

After years of suffering from terrible customer service, juice that leaks out of the container and extremely annoying policies at Freedom Smoke USA it is so refreshing to finally find a company that is the exact opposite. 
At Club Vapor, the staff is friendly, helpful and very knowledgeable. They have a wide selection of mods to choose from, a vast array of juices made to order, daily deals & discounts, and a way more enticing customer rewards program. 
Their ejuice is top notch. It hits well, does not leave a weird aftertaste AND IT LASTS! I do not blow through juice half as quickly as I used to. Most likely because club vapors juice containers do not leak AT ALL. (This was a huge problem at freedom smoke.) 
Club Vapor is doing it right and has earned its 5 star review.

Food was somewhat disappointing...was on a school trip and had to stay for dinner. I had to wait with several of my friends at the table for a good 15 minutes AFTER the teacher with us went and told them they forgot about us. When I finally got my food...I took one bite before getting rid of it...I understand that the service was lacking simply because of the large crowd. But still....

My husband and I finally found a salon and stylist we can call our own! Tricia's technique is thorough-she cut my hair wet, then after she dried it, cut it again making sure the layers were perfect. Overall a terrific experience. I highly recommend the salon and Tricia
I went there with crocs and wasn't let in unless I paid up more than your average joe... Um f*ck no.
Always great tasting everything! Manager always has a smile and treats you like she wants you to come back! Love it!

This is not a review - merely a statement that I will never eat in this restaurant.  I don't care if it's the last restaurant standing.  I purchased a coupon on Travel zoo and from what I understand, merchants use this type of marketing to introduce their product to people that may otherwise have not used their services.  I thought the coupon expired 9/15 (I know - my oversight) but when I pulled it out this morning, it actually expired three days ago.  I called the restaurant to ask about using it today (or whatever worked for them) and the man that answered the phone was extremely rude and said it expired and there was nothing he could do (really?) and to take it up with travelzoo.   What kind of owner of a business would treat a potential customer like this? This was an opportunity for them to build their business.  I don't understand.  I would be hesitant in future to purchase something with an expiration date since it was prepaid.

I ordered the turtle cheesecake to go (my first time going) and this is what I got for $5. I've had better and more substantial amount of cheesecake for the same price from other places. Not sure what to make of this experience. I'm looking for great dessert in Tucson and I can't say this place made the list.
Was able to easily get a convenient appointment.  Ample parking out front.  Jenn was very nice and did a great job with the haircut.  I used a Living Social, but would definitely pay full price.

My wife and I were looking for a good shop we could trust, with reasonable prices, and an educated staff; as we both knew with all this new vaping tech coming out we'd want some support to get us educated without emptying our pockets.  As soon as we entered, we were warmly greeted and after a bit of small talk about vapes, Gabe gave us some solid advice.  We ended up getting a Kangertech Subox mini starter kit, an Efest 18650 battery and a couple 10ml bottles of juice.
     We now consistently shop here and have made this our main source of juice and batteries.  You just can't beat top notch customer support with a quality product to back it up.  Having tried a handful of brands juices now, I have to say Club Vapors is both better tasting and smoother hitting than the rest.(to note I'm running 70/30 3 nic)  You can tell they use quality nicotine and flavors, nothing about this place is cut rate.


My wife and I make it a point to stop at either the Ina location or South Side location when we're in Tucson.

Came for the dinner buffet. Maybe it wasn't the best time to come???

The sushi had been sitting for some time (the tuna rolls were turning dark brown), and the food on the hot tables seemed like it had been there for some time as well.

This was surprising, as it had come highly recommended by some close friends.

Maybe just not their night, as the best thing I had was the jello... to remove the taste of the teriyaki chicken from my mouth.
amazing salad, friendly employees, nice and clean... just feels like home. 10/10 would recommend.

Great place, I was near here and was craving a sandwich. Holyshit this sandwich was delicious!!! 

Great sandwich and cookies  mmm . 

Sourdough , turkey, bacon sandwich 
Omelet with cheese and sausage 
Croissant with cheese and sausage 
French toast 
Chocolate chip, peanut butter & oatmeal cookies 

I would recommend this place

Ordered a slice to go. Wasn't satisfied. 
I mean who charges $5 for a wallet sized paper thin slice of cheesecake. I know I'm asking for a lot coming from NYC but the taste doesn't compare. 
For the price and quality, can't say I'd recommend this.

The only reason for 2 stars is for the service. Unlike the food the service was pretty good. Wish there was another selection to rate that.
This is the coolest tea lounge I've ever been to. They have so many different choices. It's a great place to take friends to hang out and enjoy a great cup of tea! The staff is also super friendly.

I've never had to endure dealing with such a terrible post office.  
   
1.  This post office will not redeliver your packages.  You can submit the redelivery form online, mail your pink slip (assuming they actually leave you one) or call the main post office line to schedule redelivery, but ultimately this post office will keep your package until you pick it up.  They even admitted to me that they don't check redelivery forms.  
2.  They deliberately keep the phone off the hook.  Even the post office main helpline can't get through. 
3.  I've received my neighbors mail on a weekly basis and vice versa.  
4.  They've lost a package of mine more than once

On the plus side, the two at the front desk on weekends are very nice...but clearly this post office needs new management and a code of ethics...or should just shut down.

Stopped in today around 3:00 pm. No one at the counter. Finally, after a few minutes, an employee came out & said they were "Having a little meeting in the back" & that someone would be w/us shortly. 5 mins later, she came up & said "I'm sorry. We just had two employees get into a fight; our general manager is supposed to be coming in; but I'm not trained on the register so there's no one to serve customers right now."  There were no police or ambulances or anything, but I guess they just decided to shut the whole store down? Insane.
$20 a piece for a couple on a Sunday night. Lol no thanks. They just lost out on the $100 we would have spent on expensive liquor and more on dances....

I wish I could put zero stars. I schedules an appointment for a nail in my tire. I arrive 10 minutes before my appointment and the told me it would be 4 hours. I said what was the point of making an appointment then. I arrive 5 hours later to be told they hadn't started my truck yet. Another 1.5 hours and I was able to leave with an invoice for another $1900.00 for "additional" repairs they said were critical and could cause me to loose control and cause an accident if I didn't get them fixed. I am mechanically educated as my father owned a shop for over 20 years to which I spent many summers under cars with him. I questioned their assessment of "critical" and was told they had to inform me of issues, how I choose to handle them is on me. 

The specific issue they are indicating as concerning was the upper control arms and ball joints which I had them replace 3 years earlier with over 250,000 miles on the factor set. Every time I went for my tire rotation I requested they grease the grease points. I was told they did each time. When I was replacing my brakes they ball joints were flat because they hadn't been greased in some time. Hmm...  So now at just over 300,000 miles they ask me if I do a lot of "heavy" towing and hard driving because the ball joints are in bad shape. The worst part is, if they had actually looked at the truck they would have noticed I don't even have a trailer hitch. How could I be towing anything?? Are the parts they sell crap? Or their failure to simply provide service the customer is requesting? I went to my trusted shop for an oil change and did a thorough inspection of the "critical" issue they indicated and yes the joints are worn but still completely safe for another 50,000+ miles. 

This is not an isolated incident at this location but was one of the more notable ones. I fear for those that don't have a basic mechanical knowledge because they work harder to take advantage of people then actually repairing cars brought to the shop for minor repairs.

Pulled up to the drive thru at 7:24.  Ordered a ham and egg croissant with no cheese and an orange juice.  Got the order repeated to me exactly.  Pulled up to the window at 7:26, there was one car in front of me.  At 7:30, I pulled up to the window where I waited for 4 minutes before anyone opened the window.  I was handed my order, made the payment and drove off.  When I took a bite of my sandwich, there was cheese melted between 2 eggs.  That went in the trash.  This place will need to step up its game, especially with the new bakery about to open next door to it.

I was looking for a 30 min or less place to stop in for lunch. I chose Kneaders thinking it would be a sure thing to get a bowl of soup and slice of bread  in under 30 min.  I was wrong on my choice as it took 25 min standing in a line with 3 people in front of me.  As I stood there I started to notice that the staff was unorganized.  The person who worked the window would leave window to gather food for a table, and the register attendant would leave to attend to window.  The cook would only make sandwiches and never leave his area to help the inside line orders.  I believe at lunchtime they needed one person dedicated to soup, bread, and dessert area.   The soup was good when I finally received it but my slice of bread with my order turned out to be a whole loaf of bread.  My suggestion is to avoid eating in and go through drive through for lunch.   I will return when I crave soup again.

Came in as I had a nail in my tire. I did not have an appointment but they said it would be ready in 2 hours. Luis is very personable and professional. The store is clean and has a nice waiting area. There is coffee and vending if needed. There is also a Culver's across the parking lot so you can get a snack if needed. The bathroom is clean and they even have a changing table. They finished my car earlier than promised.

I sent my boyfriend and my brother to this wack ass gentleman's club and they didn't even see titties. What type of trash ass gentleman's club is this? Truly disappointed. My boyfriend really wanted to see some titties.

They offered free cinnamon rolls and other samplers at the counter. A famished me grabbed a few and gorged on them until my order was ready. 

Chunky cinnamon bread french toast with caramel syrup, whipped cream and strawberries. Perfect filling and yet a simple, breakfast. Crunchy on the outside , soft on the inside and just add all the toppings and it is delightful.

If you're going in as a dancer, beware of the pocket watching woman that sits in the dressing room. She calls her self a manager (along with the rest of the staff) and demands a $10 tip for doing absolutely nothing. And when you had a bad night and made all your money at once, and you don't feel like you'll be able to afford her random tip out, she will demand "her money" aggressively and threaten that you will never be allowed back unless you offer it up. This is all after you already paid your $40 house fee.
Well I dont have much to say about this place except that they dont not honor the free drink coupon. Other than that it's a great place to hang out at.

Just had another great meal here. The pita is made to order and comes out looking like fluffy fresh pillows. They are so good we always order more. All of the grilled meats are great, especially the lamb. The appetizers are great too. We really like the Greek salad, tabouli, cabbage salad, and of course the hummus. The staff is also incredibly warm and friendly. We've been here over a dozen times and never had a bad meal. This is a real neighborhood gem. 

Just had a party for 35 here. The staff could not have been more accommodating. The food was great. This is a neighborhood gem.
great New York style pizza great service and great buffalo wings, the best in the area.  Charlie is a great guy!  Be sure you let him know that you heard about him on yelp!

I haven't had Cosi since my college days 10 years ago. I remember liking their flatbread sandwiches but it being a bit pricey for my college pockets. I went to the Cosi near my job yesterday to reminisce about good times..let me tell you. The food was not great. I got a bowl of turkey chili and a sparkling water and paid nearly $10. The chili was weird and green. It was thick and just odd tasting. Worst chili I've had. Such a shame that they're so expensive but the quality is just not there.

I agree wholeheartedly with all the other reviews. The receptionists here seem to reside on an entirely different plane of existence than the rest of us lowly earth-dwellers.  When they actually do worldly things like answer phones, schedule appointments, send medical records, etc, it's akin to a miracle and woe to those who don't treat them with the proper amount of awe and fear.  This makes emergency visits, such as an upper respiratory infection like Sergio A. had, and like I had as well, particularly excruciating because it's not only my time the malicious office staff waste, it's my health that's at risk too. 

Aside from the incredibly inept office staff, I really didn't have a problem with the doctors that I usually see here. 

P.S. Oh, the cherry on the poorly built sundae: they sent my medical records and recent tests to some address that was completely different than the one I had on file.  It wasn't even in Philly!  Those mental giants probably think HIPAA is a water-dwelling animal in sub-Saharan Africa, but I'm still considering filing a complaint with the Office of Civil Rights.

We had THE best mattress buying experience ever. We walked in, were pleasantly greeted, the salesman asked us what type of mattress we liked, he showed us some models that might fit our needs, told us about some specials and then left us alone while we tried the mattresses. Once he saw that we were discussing the one we liked, he came over and gave us the bottom-line price. 
We are now sleeping soundly on our new super-comfortable BB mattress that was hundreds of dollars less than anywhere else.

I have given this place many chances to impress me but they haven't taken one yet. The staff is very friendly and will no doubt make you feel welcome, however, the problem lies with a limited understanding of their own products and inconsistency in juice. I have been helped at least once by every employee here and can tell a difference in the consistency of the juice made  by each person. Twice I have had to go back in the store to have a juice remade because it was thinner than what I asked for and flooding my tank. It has also happened a few times where I have been given the incorrect coil even when I describe the name of the coil I need in full length. They write down your order but I have still been asked for clarification on my order several times in one visit. The most recent and last time I visited this location was today. I was given the wrong coil and went back into the store to exchange it for the one I needed. I ended up speaking with the manager who said they have never carried the coil I needed (even though I have bought it from them multiple times) and tried to offer me other coils that weren't at all similar to what I was asking for. I began to question his and his staff's understanding of their own products and vaping in general. Their juices all have great flavors but I can never trust that they will give me the correct ratio which, in my opinion, is more important. I have begun traveling a further distance to visit a shop where I can trust the quality of the products I purchase.
This cafe has delicious food, good service, a cozy atmosphere, and a nice patio. I was happy with the breakfast that I ordered here.

I want to give this place 10 stars! My absolute favorite is the French toast. It is divine! Soft bread, delicious syrup, and fresh strawberries and whipped cream to top it. Their sandwiches and various breads are amazing! Right I'm loving their pumpkin bread for the fall. I love the decor and cute small town feel you get in this restaurant. Great service and delicious food, totally worth the visit.

Hmmmm where to start? Kneaders is alright, I always feel super ripped off after going here. Today I ordered a turkey cranberry croissant, a cup of broccoli salad and a cup of Greek salad (ALL of it was really small) and my total was like 16 something. The turkey croissant was tiny in general and there was hardly any turkey on it, it was like something you get at a gas station. I usually have all right luck with their salads but they are also overpriced. I really need to remember not to come here. They used to have a really good potato salad and pasta salad and they did away with both of those items the broccoli salad was not good at all in my opinion.

I'm not going to go jumping for joy over this post office or anything, but its parking lot alone makes me very happy that its our default location. How many other post offices in the city have a parking lot? Maybe they all do, I actually have no idea, but I'm thinking probably not. 

The counter closes at noon on Saturdays but during the week it's open until at least 5. There's rarely a line of more than one or two people, and the woman who typically works the counter is efficient, if a little brusque. But hey, as long as I can get my stamps and packages in a timely manner, that's just fine with me.

I can't help it....i keep coming back here to discover something else on the menu that I didn't see the last time! I will always finish off my adventure with The Napoleon. Oh my heavens....it IS that good!

Four words - best bread in Tucson. 
Every sandwich we had, regardless of the bread type, had the perfect bread - soft when needed or crunchy when appropriate. 
The soups were also tasty and I didn't meet a dessert I didn't like.
At first, the price seems high for a drive-thru, but the quality of food is more than adequate.

Good, honest local business owners. 
I went to Mike's on a recommendation from a good friend that has taken her cars to Mike for the past 20 years. I can't say enough good things about Mike and his very knowledgeable and kind daughter, Liz. They always explain everything, don't make me feel like dummy for not knowing certain things, and if there's a recall and I can get things done somewhere else, they are kind enough to tell me!

They're understaffed. There is always a line throughout the day that moves as slow as a slug since they don't have enough employees to help you.  Friendliness wise, they're ok, not the worst but not the best either. I only go to this one bc it's so close to my home otherwise I'd never go there.

Very disappointed with our return trip here... We stopped by for lunch and were excited after our initial experience during their opening, however it was a let down compared to last time for several reasons.

First of all, there was a line out the door, which we took as a good sign since it seemed to be a popular spot for the day. Unfortunately, we soon found out that it was just crowded because the service was slow. On our last visit, the cashiers were very personable and were happy to give recommendations about the various pastries and sandwiches. Now, it was evident that they had hired new people who didn't seem to care as much- they were just trying to get customers through the line and didn't offer any samples.

The worst part was that there was a fly in their pastry case. We mentioned to the cashier that it was there (on top of the pie), but she made no move to take it out after we told her. To me, that was just unsanitary and unacceptable. Overall, we have no plans for a repeat visit.

They took my car in as soon as I got there. I got an alignment and tire rotation in 1.5 hours. That's the fastest anyones ever done it for me. The guy up front was the nicest guy I've met in a car shop. He said he really cares about serving his community. The waiting room was nice. You can watch them do everything through the window. They have coffee and cold water available.

This post office stinks. The friendly staff is the only thing it has going for it.

They're only open M-F 9a to 5p. Not helpful when a package gets sent here when you weren't home because you're working M-F 9a to 5p. Saturdays they're only open until noon.

The clerk flat out told me that they often don't check the website for redelivery requests. He gave me the phone number for the desk in the office. But by time someone answers the phone after 9a, the trucks will already be out for the day, so you have to wait another day.

The lobby is dirty, and everything is dilapidated. The sign with the prices even hangs lopsided.

At 9a the line will easily be 20+ deep.

We needed a new range.  We did some research and settled upon a Samsung range.  We found it on sale at Home Depot and ordered it.  It was going to take a bit to have it delivered, so we settled on a date.  The first time that it was to be delivered, Home Depot reported that the delivery folks said we were not home, though in fact, we were.  Then we rescheduled and again were told that we were not home, when in fact we were.  Delivery was then scheduled for December 28.  On December 27 we received a text and a call assuring delivery on the 28th.  The 28th came and we waited and waited.  Then when we inquired we learned that the date had been moved to January 4, without any notice or explanation to us.  Exasperated on December 30 we called a local appliance store and had the range delivered on December 31 with awesome service.  I doubt that we will ever order a major appliance from Home Depot again.  We had to pay an additional $100 to get the new range, as sales were over, but bringing this frustration to an end is worth it.  Oh, each time we called Home Depot to try to find out the problem, someone promised to call us back.  No one ever called back.  Moreover, Home Depot does not provide any clear avenue to speak to someone knowledgeable about delivery. Getting to  human beings is a challenge.
This store is awesome!  Even though they were short handed they got me in and took care of my car.  Store is very clean and service was solid.  I will definitely return!

Such a good night's sleep!  I stopped in store just looking, was greeted and taken on a great tour.  Very informed salesman.  Mattress delivered and set up quickly, old one taken away.  It did take 3 weeks for my back to quit hurting, but quit it did, after years of hurting.  I'm so happy with my purchase.

Oh, my, gosh. I have been looking for a bakery in Tucson that makes beautiful desserts... I found them! Not only are they beautiful, they are delicious. I would take a picture, but I ate the subject of the photo, oops. I had the croissant and the fruit tart. Good Lord, I'm a happy girl. Also, they are on door dash so I could get it while quarantined!!!

Uh. How has nobody mentioned the $5.59 All-you-can-eat French Toast? Probably because when we went for the event there was nobody there.  So, I will reiterate here: all you can eat french toast all day, every day. Killer deal. 

The toast itself was okay, but I'm finding it hard to complain due to the price. The place brings forth a country breakfast kind of vibe with oldies playing in the background. The place doesn't seem to be attracting much attention, but that could be because of the newer cafe that opened up right next to it. 

Good place to get a good deal.

5/5 tastes exactly like the kneaders back home. Very large building and very nice. Dave's BLT on focaccia bread is a mouth watering 10000/5.  WHY IS THERE NO CLAM CHOWDER?! also the staff was SUPER kind. 10/10 would definitely go here anytime I'm randomly in Tucson

Got mom and dad there first new matters in 30 years. It was easy. Just lay down on a bed and have it delivered with a guarantee that you can exchange if you're not satisfied. I'm very happy with how easy it was for my elderly folks. I appreciate that very much.
The most disgusting omelette ever.  I am not one for reviews however I am at a loss.  This food was horrific. (French dip was good,  but the rest is in the trash).  What a waste of money.

SWINDLERS!!! 

They told me there was no charge to diagnose my "check engine light" as long as I fixed the issue with them. Turned out the issue was an old gas cap, which I then had them replace. I was shocked when they charged me $89.95 for 1 hours worth of labor; their charge for plugging my car into their computer. All in all it took them less than 10 minutes to "diagnose" and sell me a gas cap off the rack. 

They refused to release the car without me paying and I had no choice as I need it for work. 

Save yourself from these scam artists and go ANYWHERE else.

Such a cool bakery, I love that you can see all of the behind the scenes baking. I had the guava pastry, it was very yummy. My husband literally did a dance when he tried the garlic bread. He also really like the cheese pastry. The staff was also super sweet! Highly recommend!
The hot dogs are amazing but the burgers are like heaven! Seriously the best burgers in Tucson. I am drooling just thinking about them! I can't wait to go back.

My bf, his mom, and I came here on a weekday for lunch. Since Kneaders had just recently opened up in Tucson, we were excited to see how the food was here!

Inside the restaurant, there is plenty of seating, and the bread and pastry displays are bright and decorative. They even have a cute gift wrapping station where you can wrap up bread that is purchased for someone as a present! We were treated to some free samples, which were delicious: sour dough bread with artichoke spread and brownie bites. Yum. Since we weren't very hungry, my bf and I shared the french dip baguette and his mom ordered the club sandwich. I am happy to report that the meats on both sandwiches were very fresh and tasty! Moreover, the bread was high-quality and tasted out of this world. It was a delicious lunch, and at only around $15 for both orders, also affordable. 

The service here is great, and they bring your food right to your table. We also got to chat with the manager, who was very nice.

Tip: Ask for a loyalty card! We asked them for one and unfortunately they were out (but the manager assured us that they would be receiving more next week). We will definitely be back!

Didn't actually by our mattress at Brooklyn but the staff-Emerson, was fabulous.  Great information and not too pushy. The company just needs to formalize information more to be taken seriously in Tucson.

I can't really imagine this post office being worse, with the sole exception that the employees have been nice in our interactions with them.

We lived in Philly for a spell a couple of years ago and needed to send packages abroad. They were repeatedly returned to us for a problem with filing customs papers, et al. The employee helping us simply didn't know what forms needed to be filled out. This is outrageous.

Deliveries were no better. All the time we'd get UPS reliably delivering to our door, but the postal service would often "forget" or not even ring our bell (if they actually came...I'm a little skeptical) before we'd get an email saying a delivery was attempted. Often no note, and when it came no information besides this POs address.

POS is actually a pretty good name for this office, come to think of it...

This is by far the worst primary care physicians office I have EVER DEALT WITH. First they were in Rittenhouse square and my PCP left the practice and I was not notified. Then they scheduled my new appointment with new PCP and a pipe burst that day (they called to cancel) then they moved to this broad street location and scheduled another appt. and that appoints was cancelled because of a pipe bursting in new building. Finally I made an appointment and left work an hour early and there's no parking that is patient parking so you HAVE TO PAY!!!!!!! I called to inform them because this was my first time since I was canceled on I may be running late due to broad street traffic and PARKING ISSUES, they said I cannot be late because the nurse leaves at 4:30!!!! I walk in at 4:32pm "nurse left for the day" IM SICK TO MY STOMACH! Missed work, rushed here, no appointment. Grrrrrr....maybe consider having hours once in a blue for this kind of thing. I'm switching PCP. And soooooo

I ordered four large which that packed two by two.  The weight of the containers cracked the the lids and soup leaked everywhere.  I noticed while I was holding that the plastic bag got very warm all of a sudden.  I turned around and went to go back.  They replaced one soup that had cracked but not the other... The second soup cracked and also leaked all over the place but that one just got a new lid. On top of that when the repackaged, they stacked the damn bowls again as if they didn't learn anything the first time!! They did insist on replacing the 4 bread- which was the least of my concerns.  I went there for soup, not for the bread that comes with it. I had to go out of my way because of the breakage.  I got my crap and got back to the office to find that NOW, the BOTTOM of the bowls are starting to rip and tear... probably because from soaking in the old soup that had leaked and cheapo quality. I did not feel they appropriately compensated... but I guess word is that they declared bankruptcy.

Wow, this is one of those times that I wish I had paid attention to the Yelp reviews before stepping foot into this AYCE American Chinese buffet.  China Pearl SUPER Buffet is located along N. Dale Mabry Highway right before the bridge carrying you over the railroad tracks and Busch Boulevard, and then before the traffic light at Linebaugh Avenue.

From the outside the restaurant is modeled to look like a cheery Asian temple with lots of blues, reds, and golds, and there is a large parking lot to handle the swarms of walking dead Wal-Creatures who decide to stop here. 

My first clue that this was destined to be a forgettable meal was the fact there were only 5 tables of people inside of the restaurant, and that none of these people were Asian. After surveying the crowd I realized that there were some important differentiators between me and the rest of these people:

#1  I have a pulse. 

#2  I was not wearing pajama bottoms and flip flops.

#3  I was not shoveling the food into my mouth without chewing.

There are three food stations set up to one side of the restaurant. The first, closest to the wall, had wilted salad fixings, fruit, pudding, Jell-O, and sheet cakes. At the far end of this table was the sushi -- primarily California rolls, and pieces of nigiri that had been sitting out so long that the fish had actually turned a gray color. YUM!!!!

The second and third stations were set up as steam tables. This was the usual collection of soup pots, fried rice, Asian noodles, crab Rangoon, greasy egg rolls, fried chicken fingers, and deep-fried mystery meals.

One small problem -- there were no heated water baths under the buffet pans to keep the food steaming warm. Instead, everything sat under heat lamps until it was devoid of any moisture.....or flavor. Everything looked as though it had been fried in oil. The food tasted greasy, and salty, and was just a notch above room temperature.

I will say that the servers were very pleasant, and quick to refill my Diet Coke, and for that this restaurant has earned one star. Next time I'll avoid going here and therefore no longer need the the post-meal bottle of Kaopectate. I'll just visit the drive-thru at KFC instead.
The advertisement for the breakfast sandwiches are out of alignment with reality. Quality of ingredients were cheap (i.e. imitation cheese, low budget ham, etc.). You'd be better off at Panera Bread.

This is the worst food I have ever eaten.  we were absolutely starving and against our better judgment we ate here. I would say about 75% of the trays were down to scraps or have been sitting long enough to be dried out. We grabbed a plate of stuff and started trying it... I almost puked! Awful flavor and cold! We had a couple bites off of our plates and couldn't stomach anymore. We told Aaron at the register that it was gross and not fresh and he just kept saying "fresh,fresh,fresh"...we asked for a discount since we only had a few bites and he said no... I'm not a picky eater either, I'll eat pretty much everything and you couldn't pay me to eat here again! Also, I still have a weird feeling in my throat from something!

We needed a mattress for our new RV and decided to try Brooklyn bedding. We were so happy with their offerings and service! We tried several models and selected the one that best fit our needs. The salesperson was wonderful- he was informative and helpful while allowing us to make our decision. We definitely will return when we need a new bed. I highly recommend this store and their beds.

every vegetarian should be RUNNING to this restaurant for their vegetarian meat.  seriously, I'm shocked that so many people are afraid of veggie meats....hello!...it's the real meat that you should be afraid of!  aside from my overt personal beliefs, this restaurant is truly a mecca for vegetarians.  overall, the buffet sometimes disappoints me and sometimes impresses me, i find that it's very hit or miss.

although it's not as cheap (yet still reasonable), ordering off of the menu is the way to go!   veggie dishes, "meat" dishes, and desserts are fantastic! 

my favorites: lamb masala and a mango lassi!

Only focused on up-selling you. Highest pricing of tires in all of Tampa. Poor communication to the customer. Worst tire place in the area by far. Place down the road does 2 plugs gets me in and out + says "yep we hear that about them a lot". Obviously I'm not the first they've tried to take advantage of.

I have always had a decent sandwich here. But do not get the Reuben unless you like sauerkraut as there was minimal meat. So disappointing. Assuming they were short staffed also as I had a long wait. I don't think I'll go back. To many other options in town for a great sandwich.

Updated review. The food is good. The service is good. The staff is friendly and the desserts are mostly outstanding. I haven't tried them all yet,  but the chocolate mousse dome is miles better than the chocolate mousse cake. The cake has almost rubbery frosting on top and nowhere near enough of the delicious mousse filling. The cake part is good, just not enough to overcome the other shortcomings of the cake. The eclairs are heavenly. I tried the house made parmesan chips last time and they were surprisingly good.
Friendly service! Clean and cute! Good prices and portions! The French toast is delicious! Love the cream and strawberries along w the Carmel syrup. Nice treat for breakfast.

Poor Cedars, I can't help but feel a little bad reviewing you. I originally meant to review Cedars at least 500 reviews ago. But sometimes I slack off, forget, and things totally get lost in the shuffle. And unfortunately had I have reviewed Cedars 500 or so reviews ago I would have given Cedars a stronger review. But alas and hello to fortune, since that time I've come across several places that do Middle Eastern and slightly exotic on a budget worlds better than Cedars does it.

Cedars is still an awesome place to go for a good sized plate of Middle Eastern treats on a budget. and they make some pretty sweet seafood dishes, and a tantalizing plate of stuffed grape leaves. And last I remember the bar was pretty inexpensive. But with places like Alyan's, Sahara Grill, and even Ethiopian spots like Dahlak offering up a similar menu at a better quality while on the same price line, I can't give Cedars a solid review.

I enjoy this place especially for their bread puddings! It's hard to get a quality bread pudding here in Tucson. However. Kneaders has me covered with their delectible raspberry bread pudding with sauce! OH YES!!! Bakery & Lobby areas are clean well stocked and neatly presented. Product displays are always stocked with a good selection to grab & go. Staff are nice and helpful. I stop here at least 4 times a week for my sinister sweet secret! Bakery items are always moist, melt in your mouth wonderful. Try the chunky cinnamon bread! It's to die for!

okay...... i was just there for the first time at the "new samosa" if you like the old samosa this will only be a dissapointment. Indian cooking is supposed to be very rich in flavor, well here its not some how. Most of the foods I ate were spicy but thats all you could taste was hotness no other flavors the hottness overpowered the flavors of the food. My favorite indian dessert is Gulab Jaman it should be soft and fluffy in a lite syrup, but these were rock hard in a thick disgusting syrup. that was a dissapointment. But im not saying all the food there was bad it was just boring with no flavor ive had better indian food.

I have been to this Kneaders many times. Smoothies great, breakfast delicious, sandwich large and tasty, breads soft and fresh, treats and pies sweet and worth the calories. If you pick something off the menu... you have already made the right choice.

I used to love New Samosa, until it broke my heart. Last year, I had a habit of popping by for lunch once a week. It provided a whole buffet and menu full of options, which as a vegetarian, came as a rare treat. Also, the salad bar was always fresh.  In recent months I'd found myself too busy to keep up with my New Samosa weekly ritual. When I found myself in the neighborhood yesterday, I had to stop by. What a shocker! They now serve meat and half of the buffet items I had previously enjoyed had been nixed in favor of meat dishes - which were NOT clearly labeled. There was not even any veggie pakora. The lettuce on the salad bar was starting to wilt and brown and the tomatoes were also beginning to go bad. The raita didn't look too hot either. To top it all off, they raised the price of the lunch buffet by $1. I don't know if they are under new management, but this wasn't the same restaurant I made my weekly lunch spot last year. Unfortunately, I don't think I'll be going back. I need to find a new Indian spot with decent veg options and a fresh salad bar.

vegetarians be warned - samosa is no longer all veg!

i was in here in the fall and found the food to be OK. it wasn't knocking my socks off the way indian cuisine typically does, but i enjoyed having the faux meat dishes which i've yet to experience elsewhere. while options always abound for me at indian restaurants, i could literally eat every item on this buffet, plus, it included my much sought after protein! 

as much as that excited me, i was bored by the lack of intense spice and flavor. combine that with the terrible service - it was not crowded, yet it took FOREVER for our server to open our bottle of white and bring us some glasses & a bucket, as well as to bring us our check when we had finished our meal - and i wasn't exactly raring to go back. 

now i have even less reason: samosa serves real meat!

my boyfriend dined there yesterday and was informed that they started offering meat 3 days ago. perhaps because former neighbor passage to india recently closed shop? who knows. either way...he said there was no faux meat on the buffet, and the real meat was marked with a tiny hand scribbled sign. not sure if that will change day to day or if it is still available when you order a la carte or what. not sure i feel like going back to find out.

This is my favorite Cosi.  I know they all serve the same food and beverages,  but this location does it much,  much better.
The staff here is so young and enthusiastic,  they get you in & out quickly with a smile and a decently prepared meal.
I noticed they have a lot of negative reviews,  and maybe it's because I get Big Guy preferable treatment (even though I'm a little smaller) and even though I really don't care for their coffee, the food and the fast,  friendly service gets me everytime.

I'm not a big fan of some of the strong flavors in Lebanese food, but I did really enjoy my experience at Cedars. I went with a large group and we decided to order a bunch of appetizers to share. For me, this was a great way to taste a lot of different dishes.

We ordered hummus, labni (strong, plain yogurt), arnabeet (cauliflower dish), fried calamari, tabbouli, and spanakopita. They bring out a round of complimentary pita bread and you can ask for the basket to be refilled. All in all it was plenty of food for a party of 5! You could tell the food was fresh and homemade - a very authentic experience! 

The restaurant is located right off of South Street by the Head House district. The place is relatively small, but seemed to have a lot of tables. Our server was very attentive and provided great service. This was a new experience for me, but I would definitely be up for trying it again!

I stopped at the Drive-Thru to pick up lunch with my son.  I got the chicken salad croissant and was disappointed. The chicken salad tasted great but there was hardly any on the bread. Thin and not even to the edge.  Not worth the money I paid for it at all. My son ate his club sandwich even though it had dressing on it which I had asked not to be included.  It was really unfortunate because with everything going on in the world we do not get out much and he was looking forward to it.  A treat after having to go and get his vaccinations and then neither of us enjoyed it. Oh well.
Sometimes you just want an option where ...you aren't in the city and there are many free parking spots available! I'm so glad for this post office because it makes my life easier! Gets the job done!

Simple and tasty middle eastern cuisine. Great service, friendly servers. This is probably the only sit down (date night type) Lebanese cuisine in Philly! Not very big inside but it's nice with dim lighting and background arabic music. Make sure to leave the car home and Uber it. This area is impossible to find parking. Impossible!
I always hit this place when I come into Philly!  I love the butter truffle burger with chipotle fries.  If you love burgers try this spot! its small and has a great vibe!
Still on of the best places on girard.    Consistent and high quality.   Great neighborhood place ...... probably the best place to get a burger in Philadelphia

Found a BONE in my Yellowtail roll and scallion roll. When I called to complain, the person on the phone started to giggle and responded with "um ok... I guess next time you order we can give you an extra roll or something." I obviously will NOT be returning. 

The sushi that I did manage to consume before finding the bone was not great. The fish did not have flavor and there was too much vinegar in the rice. Also, the rolls were not completely rolled and were falling apart.

The cooking class with Chef Craig was so great. Everyone got to cook all of the dishes and Craig gave good tips and tricks throughout the class. I was hesitant to take the class at a store but it was so much fun. I will definitely do that again! You can bring a bottle of wine and you get a discount towards store purchases. Bonus!!!!

We stopped by Martins after the Philly Flower Show this past weekend. Very friendly and we kept adding on to our order. Tonight we had the Romano & Parsley Sausage with peppers and onions...better than any sandwich you would buy out there. Cant wait to try the rest of the meat we bought. Next time we will pass on all the other stores and just purchase a large order from Martins.

Love.

That's really all there is to say. 3 meat combo: ribs that fall right off the bone, katsu chicken that is so moist and flavorful (I usually don't care for it from other places) and teriyaki chicken grilled perfectly every time. White sticky rice and macaroni salad. After a meal from here you just sit around being happy all day and want more... 

My kid is picky, changes her mind on what she likes daily... But I can always count on her destroying her plate... 2 years old and eating the rib like a beast. 

And downfall, like most food trucks, they sell out, and sometimes it's way too fast :/

Just don't...don't go, don't order food, don't go.  We've been going to the Macayos at 19th Ave and Thunderbird in Phoenix for 40 years.  Has it's ups and downs but lately mostly downs.  This weekend we tried the Tucson location and it was very disappointing.  The new shorter menu eliminated the combo appetizer I always order.  I asked for a chimi a la carte and was told they couldn't do that.  3 moderate meals, 1 water, 1 Pepsi and 1 Margarita (tasted like a mix) with tip total over $60.  Just don't go.

The food was really good but service was terrible. The table was sticky and dirty. The waitress spilt sodas on the table and me. Our service was exceptionally poor even while the restaurant was near empty. This restaurant is a hit or miss, while you get good food, the service is next to worst.

It is 8:01on 12/17/2014, and I just got off the phone with the rudest woman EVER. I simply called to see if Grubhub's 1 hour and 45 min delivery estimate was right for my food.  She went into a tirade acting like I was the biggest inconvenience ever, about how they use a 3rd party delivery service and all they do is make the food so she can't tell me.  I say ok, thinking to myself why is this lady being so hostile? She offers to see if they made my order and I said that would be nice.  She confirms it went out and then says, "Bye," hanging up on me while I'm trying to thank her.

Honestly, if you don't want to deliver, than don't.  Or at least tell your employees that it's part of the business model, and they need to treat ALL customers the same - respectfully.  Because guess what, if I don't get delivery from you guys, you won't get my business because I never go in to the restaurant.  There are plenty of other places to get delicious burgers from in NoLibs now.

Soooo much food!! Really easy to accidentally over order... Get the Mac and cheese! It was fabulous. The vegan burger was really heavy but tasty especially with the horseradish cheese! Make sure you bring your a game to draw your most creative burger... As for mine, fail.

Absolute joke of an establishment. I order a burger w/ fries, and when I get home and open up my food I see that neither the fries or top bun of my burger are there! Like seriously, how idiotic are you that you forget these things!?!? Plus the food itself was like $16 which is a complete ripoff. I guess when you're selling to delusional hipsters in Fishtown you can justify charging that but to us normal people that's absurd. 

Bottom line: don't waste your money at this piece of s**t restaurant. 

Make America Great Again.

I didn't even cook it yet, but I was so impressed with the customer service, I had to write a review! They were so friendly, and he even starts telling me a recipe he used what I bought in. It sounded delicious, and I wish I wrote it down.

I just ordered from here because up until tonight this was my favorite place to order from a lot. Drivers have always been nice so I tip nice...I think that's the right thing to do.  Anyway tonight I ordered a fairly large order for my family and went to my car. When I returned I opened the pizza and saw it had about 3/4 of meat over my veggie pizza. It was supposed to be half veggie with one side for meat. I don't eat meat. Other errors included leaving out paid for chicken for the salad ordered. I called to report errors and I was first accused of eating all the pizza..I said no only 2 slices gone...she said she can't take a pizza back that's been eaten. I'm like it's only 2 slices gone and I can't eat meat so the pizza still here..she said she need to see the pizza when they deliver I'm like ok that's cool...plus she said she will bring chicken they left out. I'm like ok cool. I then get a call back saying that the driver took a picture of the pizza and it didn't have meat on 3/4 of it...I'm like lady I just spent freaking $60 here like I usually do and you accusing me of trying to swindle you out of a free pizza...really!!! I asked for a manager and she said none was available. Really!! So of course they are not bringing me my pizza out and no chicken for the salad. Got to go spend more money tonight to get some food I can eat.  They have horrible customer service and don't care if good paying customers come back.

Owners of Chestnut Hill store are unwelcoming, rude & do not provide good service. Bread is to die for good...best in the US.. I give the owners 1 STAR, 5 STARS for the bread. Will now be driving into town to buy my Metropolitan bread!!!!!!!

Had a chirashi - I'm a big fan of sushi and chirashi, and since my favorite sushi place in town, Vic Sushi, doesn't have chirashi on the menu, I've been looking for a nice place for one. After the reviews and referrals of my friends, I decided to try this place.

Well, the chirashi here is definitely not bad. The sushi cuts are think and many, the rice bed is seasoned well and just enough to make one full. While I can't complain too much of the quality, I was rather disappointed with their maguro sushi; it lacked flavor. Too bad that only if the tuna was good enough, this place could have easily been one of my favorite chirashi place in the town. (Sushi weren't bad on the average, but yet to beat Vic Sushi)

I can't say much about the service here since I came a bit early (5:00pm) to avoid any crowd and enjoy quiet dinner alone at the sushi bar. However, the service was just right for me, and the décor also is none of my complaints.

Overall, although I didn't try much of their menus, I'm pretty satisfied by this place.
Just the tuna was on the bland side, so maybe I won't come here too often, but other than that, no real complaints so far. 

However, thus my search for the quality chirashi in Philly continues :(

Absolutely the best burgers ever. We tried the Kobe burger with wasabi, the smashed onion burger and the truffle burger. The fries are amazing. Maybe the best we've ever eaten. The Macaroni and cheese is awesome. And the desserts . . . well you get the picture. The biggest problem was that we all ate too much.

THE SUBS THAT DREAMS ARE MADE OF.  Yes, this was literally the best sub I've ever eaten, EVER.  I typically find one thing I like at a restaurant and stick with it, however The Experience (sandwich name- doesn't seem to be on the online menu, but available in the store) was so damn AMAZEBALLS that I am inspired to try every single sub on the menu. Seriously, do not miss this!  And while you are there, make sure to try a solo pickle!  I don't know how they made a pickle so good, but it would turn a pickle hater into a pickle lover!  See you soon Planet Sub!

Planet Sub, Round 2: THE CUBAN EXPLOSION!! 
On our second trip, we ordered the limited time Cuban and also a Creamy Club, and of course added a solo pickle!  Both were toasted to perfection, which may not sound like a big deal, but no one wants a hard, blackened sub roll, or an overly soft, squishy one.  The toast on these had just the right softness with lightly crisped edges. Each sub was hot and oozy and wonderful. 
The bacon on the Creamy Club tastes nice, unlike some other SUBpar places that use cheap bacon that overwhelmingly taste like fake liquid smoke. No sir, not this bacon!
The Cuban was filled with all the standards you would expect from a Cuban, but each tasted... elevated. Hot and juicy pulled pork, the perfect amount of sliced ham, oozy Swiss and yes, you guessed it, those amazing pickles! 
So glad we got to try the Cuban before it was gone, but I also can't wait to try one of everything else! 
 the sub!

Sketch is one of my favorite spots in Fishtown! I've been here with my partner 3 times and we've never been let down. The atmosphere is cool and low key, and the people are super friendly. The burgers are incredible!! I haven't explored most of the menu because i'm hooked on the burger. They are tasty and big. Most of the sauces are good too, and the bun is outstanding. My girlfriend gets the black bean burger, and loves it. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone interested in some local, non-pretensious eats.

The chipotle and aioli sauces are our favorites.

This is some of the best Hawaiian food that I've had. Visited the truck on DM and the restaurant is just all good. I would stick with the the teriyaki chicken with mac and rice can't go wrong. I wish they would give you more sauce (teriyaki, sriracha, etc...)at the table since I like lots of it. Other then that they are great.

SO GOOD! I love this place!!!! Everything I have ever ordered has been delicious...cheese enchiladas, green corn tamale, chile relleno.  Yum!  I love the chips and salsa - very light, crisp chips and the salsa is not too spicy!  I think this place is great....although there have been times when I got a little too much cheese on my plate...nothing to complain about really!  YUM!

Woah, who knew the burgers would be so gigantic! Well I had a good idea, but seriously...

I think next time I will split a burger because it was a challenge to eat it all. It was just too delicious to waste, so I forced myself to enjoy the whole thing. I had a regular burger with the horseradish cheddar, bacon, and sauteed onions. I was very pleased that I could actually taste the cheese, because sometimes cheese can get lost in the mix of flavors. The roll was fresh, and the burger was cooked just right. I also had a milkshake, which the girl at the counter made "extra thick" so it would survive the 5 minute car ride home (how sweet is that?!). Oh and the fries were awesome! I think that their pricing is pretty good. Maybe the extra toppings are a little pricey, but the quality is there so we didn't mind too much.

My boyfriend said that he heard some talk of an ostrich burger and an antelope burger while he was waiting for the food... Not really sure what is going on with that! Maybe there is a new special in the works.

I've been here a few times, and for the most part the food has been great! It is a tad expensive, but my food has always been spot on. The California burrito , enchilada style is quite good. Tonight I tried the steak cortez and it was to die for. I'm not a big fan of their rice, so I usually mix it in with the beans. Their dessert is really good...however I was disappointed when I ordered the fried ice cream. It was $5.29 for one small scoop. Seemed a little overpriced for me. Our server was great! We sat in the cantina for happy hour, and he was very consistent with checking up on us and refilling our drinks.

So glad my wife found this place.  We travel to philly regularly and this is now easily the best meal I've ever had there.  Far superior to the cheese steaks.  We had the Mac & Cheese, fries, and I had a burger with grilled onions and mushrooms.  May have been the best burger I've ever had in my life. Chipotle mayo was fantastic.  The service is unbelievable.  You order at the counter but they visit your table more then a five star restaurant.
Macaroni salad is the best I've ever had, the rice is perfectly cooked, and the ribs are outta this world.

I thought the sushi was good. I would come back.
But, they really need to clean up their orange awning outside. It is filthy. And that's not the first thing I want to see when I go to a sushi place.
Been there many times and didn't like the quality of the meat.  I grill all the time and this stuff was just bad!!  The meat smelled foul!

Herradura Margarita started the lunch out wrong and it was mostly downhill from there. If you must eat there then have the cheese crisp. 

The herradura margarita was on special for $8 so I looked the server straight in the eyes and said I hate overly sweet margaritas. He said the margarita would not be sweet so I got it. When it arrived it looked like it had way too much chambourd and yes it was way too sweet and the server smartly hide until the food came. 

The food was generally bland except for the hot salsa that came with the lunch burrito.  Prices are amazing high and the quality is amazing low for Tucson. What gives???

Good food, good service! The server was very helpful when our party asked questions about the menu. We will definitely eat there again when we visit family in AZ. 
Aloha!
Delicious food, comfortable atmosphere very chill spot I loved my Dr. Pepper pork sandwich, sides are extremely good definitely a good spot in Philly on a chill night.

Just a scooter ride down Girard to this new place. Sketch is super cute inside, I was staring at the colorful walls and bright colored paintings while we waited for our food. The prices are great and the portions are huge, my daughter and I could have shared a  single burger.... Service a was delightful as we talked our servers ear off. There are a few booths and bar seating a a table outside. There are also vegan options and a grilled chicken sandwich if burgers are not your thing. They have a variety of sauces and toppings to add if you choose while they come with tomato and lettuce and their token cheese balls. While some might not like this, their burgers are big and juicy and filling and really the fries aren't even necessary- I will say it again- another reason not to leave fishtown.

Love this place. Seriously the best Hawaiian Food I've had outside of Hawaii. Hell I think it's just as good if not better. Staff is always friendly even when there's an issue they work to make it right and make you feel valued. Will continue to eat here and tell all my friends and family about it. Spam Masubi is a must!!!

I recently moved to Philadelphia and someone told me about the Reading Terminal so I went and accidentally came accross Martin's  so I decided to get some sausages. Everyone is friendly here I didn't know what I wanted and they were super patient with me. When I got home I could believe how good the sausages were. the spices italian and garlic was awesome! Everything I ordered that day was great. My husbands and friends were pretty happy. I often have his sausages in my fridge when I know the boys are coming over because I could put then on the grill in second notice and I don't have to worry about cleaning up. 

I have been going here ever since and have not bothered to try any other meat vendors because i'm always satisfied and I even plan on ordering my turkey here for Thanksgiving.

We LOVE this place! From Seattle and have tried several other Japanese restaurants and find this the best in Philly. Nice quiet atmosphere, you can hear yourself and friends talk, food great and service excellent. Even the way the food is plated shows that they care. Will keep coming back.

This place was very good! Went over the Memorial Day weekend. They got us seated right away! They had a nice menu not to large and not to small. I was most impressed with the kids menu. The kids taco plate is amazing value for all the food you get! My husband ordered a margarita and said I was a little weak for the $8 they ask for it! But we would return and possibly order a beer. Our server was Vanessa and she was very nice and knowledgable about the menu items.

I wish I could be positive about Macayo's, so let me at least try. 1. The service is ok. The waitresses are pleasant. 2. The little "Mexican pizza" (??) they offer is pretty good at lunch, though overpriced. Now for the bad news. The food in general is not good, and my wife and I have tried the place (which is convenient to home) many times. Usually, it is just adequate. Recently, with visiting relatives from the East, we were six adults and two small children.  Our relatives, eager for real Mexican food, were surprised that this bland, goopy stuff was billed as "Mexican" -- in a town like Tucson, which knows from Mexican. All of the entrees were barely ok, except mine. I'd made the big mistake of ordering chicken tacos. They were overpriced and atrocious -- two little shells filled with lettuce, a gob of some melted cheese and maybe a tablespoon each of some godawful chicken-like mush substance -- not actual chicken, not even chicken salad. Chicken paste, maybe. The French fries that the kids had were a handful of stale little fries, and I mean a handful. Desserts were ok. The place was WAY too expensive for the quality of the food. This was our final visit.

After a long, beautiful sunset run on the river, I was starving for sushi. I was visiting the area and saw the great Yelp reviews so I thought this was the spot for me. The staff was very polite and the restaurant was quaint and well kept. I ordered the Sushi Heaven Plate and thought it was OK. The sushi was fresh, but there was nothing extraordinary. No unique flavors, no incredible textures. Just straightforward, average sushi.   For dessert I tried the fried ice cream and was pretty disappointing. The ice cream itself was still rock hard when it came to the table and the dough was still spongy textured on the inside, which I have never experienced before.   

Not really a place I would go back to again.

This place had literally one of the best burgers I've eaten in Philly. 

To be honest, the place is a little hard to find at night and it's kind of a hole-in-the-wall restaurant. There doesn't seem to be much seating for large groups, but I came with a group of 5 so a booth was good enough. 

First, the service was pretty great! Our server was helpful in giving us suggestions on what to order and telling us her personal favorites. But note, it's cash only! I ended up shelling out $20 for the whole thing, but it was WORTH. 

I ordered the Cyclops burger and a Salted Caramel and Pretzel milkshake (can't remember the exact name). WOW. That milkshake was SO good. It was the best milkshake I've had in such a long time and I would get the same one again. The cool thing is that you can mix and match flavors that you like. The server was telling us about a Peanut Butter and Jelly one (Peanut Butter + Strawberry). It all sounded delicious, forget mixing... I'm ordering that shake. 

The burger was cooked exactly how I wanted it (I asked for medium), the bacon was crispy, and the fried egg just took the whole burger over the top. I asked for the garlic aioli sauce and provolone, and I had to give myself props for making good decisions. I also tried the sweet potato fries and the Green Chili Fries. Both of them were really solid, but I think I'd go back for the Green Chili Fries. I think the sweet potato fries would've been better with a different choice of sauce (we got the Green Goddess). 

Lastly, one of the coolest parts of the restaurant was being able to "sketch" on a piece of construction paper with some markers and crayons. Not gonna lie, some people hacked and busted out their professional cartoon drawing skills, making the wall art seem pretty intimidatingly good. I spent a good amount of the meal (neglecting both friends and food) trying to draw something worthy of being put on the wall. I ended up with something I was pretty proud of, but was sure it wasn't quite good enough. To my surprise, all we had to do was ask and they gave us scotch tape to put up our drawings. Lesson learned... just ask and you shall receive.
Awesome food. Great service. Went in with a last minute catering order and was taken care of. The cooks even helped load my truck. You guys are awesome. Your new location is great.

I stopped by Sketch this week with a friend when we were looking for a quick bite in Fishtown. I ordered a burger with bacon and she ordered the chicken sandwich. There is a large variety for people looking to pick and choose how to build their burgers or sandwiches. It should be noted that the fries are AMAZING (and Belgian style). And they come with a free dipping sauce of your choice (the sandwiches come with free sauce as well). You can also order cheese with the fries. 

The burger was tasty but not the best burger that I've had in Philadelphia. It was good though. I would definitely stop back in here again if I was in the neighborhood. The service was fast and the burgers were big (so big that I had to take most of it home).

There is nothing vegan friendly about a place that charges you $8 for a not-anything-special vegan burger in a cheap baguette (because the hamburger buns are coded in eggs), iceberg lettuce and one slice of tomato. Not to mention you will be charged $1.50 to add a pinch of avocado. Other than this pathetic veggie burger this place does not have anything else for vegans. They simply took off the vegan menu... You might as well go to Chillies and find more vegan options. Their tables are sticky, they don't accept cash and you are surrounded by sketches of people advertising the killing of cows for their God given right to eat a burger.
Best Japanese food I have ever had! Traveling for a week and plan to eat here every night!!
Best freshest sushi in Philadelphia!!!!  The sashimi pieces are very large.  The prices are reasonable.  The staff is very friendly.
Wonderful service. Spectacular and delicious food! I got the katsu chicken and kalbi ribs combo plate. This is the real deal! Craving some real authentic island food? This is your place to go!

I really like Planet Sub so it makes me sad, but I have to dock them a star based on my last visit. I was thrilled to see they were on Groupon and bought three vouchers. The first time I tried using one, the cashier didn't know how it worked, but they took it without question.

On my most recent visit, I was grabbing dinner to go for my boyfriend and myself. I ordered a Big Dipper for him and a half Green Turkey for myself and specified the order was to go. The cashier was a really young kid who seemed very clueless. He asked a female worker how to do everything. When I presented my phone to use the Groupon, the kid once again asked her what to do and she said "We don't take those." I was confused; I know how Groupon works and they kinda have to take them. She said, "I'm sorry but an employee put us on Groupon and he wasn't authorized to do so. You'll have to contact Groupon." I was annoyed. My order was $18 and change, which is pricey for two sandwiches. I might not have come without a Groupon or special deal.

I had already ordered so I sucked it up and paid full price. I got a drink while I was waiting. A lot of options in the Coke Freestyle machine were out. When the young cashier brought my sandwiches out, he had only packed one to go. I admit by this point I was perturbed and short with the kid. I said "This is to go." And he said, "Oh. You wanted both sandwiches to go?" and slipped my Green Turkey in with the Big Dipper. I suppose I could've wanted to eat in and take my other sandwich to go, but that was weird. The lady was nice and apologetic for the apparent Groupon mixup.

When I got home, I discovered my Green Turkey wasn't what I ordered. There was no guacamole, no onions, no sprouts, and no salsa. It appeared to be a Turkey Club instead. I was super disappointed.
