I could just as well have ordered one of their many other selections such as american kobe, turkey, vegan, chicken breast or smashed onion burger.  They all sounded great and I think this wide range of offerings for meat and non-meat eaters is going to bring in a lot of people.  Very smart ;-)

My order was to-go, so for about ten minutes I patiently sat in the dining area which I would estimate to seat at least 30 people.  Sure enough, as described on the menu, lovely owner lady spilled some cheesy poofs right in the to-go container with my burger in place of french fries.  I chuckled on the way home imagining that the chef at Sketch sounded like Isaac Hayes and was singing about his chocolate salty balls.  Remember that one when you see him!

Dear Yelpers, this was a mighty fine burger.  Just the perfect size for my tummy and it went down so easily.  I probably could have eaten two just because it tasted so good I wanted to reward myself for getting off my ass to go to Sketch in the first place!  The bun was grilled and buttery, the bacon was well crispy and lean, the burger was a perfect medium-well and had some crunchy brown grill marks on the outside.  Even done at medium-well, there was plenty of juice dribbling from my chin.  I can say that I am in burger withdraw already.  I have only an empty container with remnants of some lettuce and aioli sauce and it saddens me.  

So how does Sketch burger compare to the others?  I would have to say they compare most directly to Five Guys because of the minimal menu, ability to build your own sandwich and their walk-in-and-order approach.  To put Sketch in the same category as Five Guys is a severe insult though.  Do we then compare Sketch to Royal Tavern or Johnny Brenda's (my number 1 and number 2 respectively)?  My philosophy is you need not to compare, you need only to enjoy.  This works great for dating too!  So my suggestion is that you run on over to Girard with your ipod and have a seat while the chef's making your burger and you listen to Chef singing No Substitute.

4 out of 5 Sketch.  I just can not reward a five star review for a frieless burger no matter how good.  I just feel that's part of the burger and has a great impact on the overall work of art.  Your cheese puffs do get a Rerun Break Dance for retro coolness!

Points of interest; Feel free to write on the chalk boards in the dining area.  No credit cards but they have an ATM directly in front of the register.  Would be a great place for a small group. They will take your order on the phone if you want to call ahead - recommended.  Safe assumption that there's no delivery.

Overall pretty cool place to grab a burger. The random sketches all over the wall was possibly more fun than I would have imagined it. The Nashville Hot burger is consistently on the menu according to the server, but since I'm from the south that's the one I decided to try. The burger was seasoned well even though a little over cooked. My advice request medium temperature. Topping were very good and the burger was fresh off the grill along with extremely hot fries that two friends can easily share. All in all I'd recommend this place. They have burgers of the month featured so there plenty to explore for locals and tourists.

I've ordered from here before and never had a problem until today. We ordered two 18 inch pizzas and 24 pieces of boneless wings, but wait this location has a boneless wing special! A very rare kind of chicken! The fabulous Golden Arches have joined forces with our local chain and are now supplying  westshore pizza with chicken nuggets. Fine take my fucking money! But if you want to bullshit me into thinking that you didn't just place a bunch of McDonald's chicken nuggets into a container and sell them to me as wings you are flipping nuts! So nope! Never ordering from here again and will be leaving reviews in various platforms and even getting into contact with the franchise owner because it's just not honest business.

I'll take this burger joint over the more well known one that shall remain nameless any day. Fries are on point (sweet potato is a fav), vegan milkshakes are actually pretty good (vanilla tastes like the real thing), and the black bean burger didn't make me want my money back like most places. It was flavorful and well seasoned. Hubby really enjoyed the Mac and cheese, said it was one of the best he's ever had.Service is also really good and prices are reasonable. The crayons and construction paper are also a nice touch. Keeps me busy until the food gets to the table.

Shame on me for not singing Shiroi Hana's praises earlier. The one day I stopped by here, it was for lunch, after a stressful national standardized exam. I was depressed, and the only thing that could console me was sushi. I stopped by Shiroi Hana, eager to munch down on some raw fish and rice.

I wasn't let down. 

Their ala carte sushi is reasonably priced. The rice is seasoned and well-portioned per nigiri (that is, you get a high fish-to-rice ratio). Lunch specials are a steal for the sushi lover, and a great deal compared to dinner. The fish itself? Fresh and flavorful.

For my second trip, I did end up stopping for dinner. As I saw a bus full of tourists enter the Applebee's across the street, I silently scoffed to myself. "Come all the way to Philly to eat at a chain restaurant?

"But wait... I haven't even written about Shiroi Hana myself! Despite its deliciousness and authenticity!"

Well, that all changed tonight. I was shocked that at 8pm on a Sunday night, the place was dead. Our servers, from the sushi chefs at the counter to the waitresses in kimono we ordered sake from, were all extremely helpful, though.

Seriously, come to Shiroi Hana for a great sushi experience. The fish is fresh and well cut. The sake is well-poured.

A highly recommended experience for excellent Japanese food in a comfortable environment.

Awesome food with creativity not only on the walls.  The staff is super nice and ALL their food is awesome, not just their burgers.  They change up their menu slightly here and there but you can always count on a few different type of awesome burgers, great fries with different sauces as well as filling dishes I would consider an "entree" like the mac n cheese which must have like 10 cheeses in it and is so good!  It's on the smaller size with "about" 8 maybe 10 booths but its very pleasant, clean, friendly staff, and fun to see all the creativity on the walls!  Definitely a place worth trying.

Being from out of town we always like to try new places.  This place is fantastic!!!!  Super friendly staff and excellent service.  Very clean too.  Recommend it to everyone wanting a different sub menu.

Really nice vegan entree - tofu sukiyaki.  With Sake and salad.  One of the best dishes I've ever had here in Philly.  Of course, everyone has different tastes.

Also, nice romantic atmosphere.  Beautifully warm inside.  I love it here, and always end up seeing people I know.  Nice and clean.   Fun and Hip waitresses.  Food, a bit pricey, but drinks are normal.  

They are literally a hop from the Kimmel Center, and know how to get you to your concert on time!

second time, this time eating in! we actually were able to get a seat.  although it was table service, it didn't really feel like it.  of course the food was still amazing, but the atmosphere and service left something to be desired. 

this time, ordered a milkshake. yes please!  i don't care how much it costs, every ingredient at this place is top-notch.  you will also be pleasantly surprised at the variety on the menu, although it is small, it packs a lot of goodness. 

the people at sketch know how to do it, and do it right. definitely take the trip, and go early so you can get a seat.  and maybe you will make it in time to get one of the baked goods/treats they seem to always be out of. they look delicious.

I LOVE dinner done. It has absolutely changed my life. I am a full time working mom with a toddler. Before dinner done my weekends were consumed of finding new recipes and planning my grocery list. During the week after a long day of work I used to spend hours preparing dinner for my family. I have been using dinner done consistently for two months and they have healthy, fresh, and scrumptious meals. I spend less money feeding my family on their meals then grocery shopping and I can now come home, relax, and spend time with my family. Dinner done is a win win. You won't be disappointed!
Greek salad was good, but the sub was disappointing.  Not much to it.  It was all bread and no flavor.

Best Hawaiian food ever.  Visited the islands many times and this is as authentic as it gets. The combo 3 meat plate is incredible.  The teriyaki chicken was tender and juicy, the Bang Bang shrimp was delicious and the Kalbi ribs were cooked perfectly.  The meal came with two sides and I tried the rice and Mac salad.  The taste on the Mac was slightly sweet and surprisingly good.  The service staff was friendly and welcoming.  I also liked the cleanliness of the dinning area.  Now is one of my favorite Tucson eateries.

Love this place and the food but I am so sad today. My boyfriend was craving their truffle fries so we braved the 100 degree weather to walk there. Got there and there was a paper sign on the door saying they were closed for summer break? With no notice on their website. BRB gonna take a cold shower with no burger in my belly :(

Once and a while and now I see why... staff is very nice and friendly. Okay so now to the food and one why they use the same gloves to handle money and meat. The plastic barriers use that to grab meat and place another sheet on the scale on top of parchment paper.  Need to train for personal hygiene better food safety practices.  Secondly the sausage I bought was  terrible breakfast not the links. The casing was nice and thin but didn't hold the meat filling properly. It spilled out because there was no twist. I've had apple sausages before and these were disgusting. Texture, taste etc. They have gone down in quality the last few years.

This place is priced extremely fairly, especially considering the large portions and quality of the food. These guys don't cheap out by giving you fatty pieces of meat. The flavor of everything we ordered was on point. It was worth driving from the airport directly to grab a bite to eat. Solid Grindz deserves a solid fan following!

Passing through Tucson from Texas and the family decided to try something new. The staff was very nice and answered all of our annoying tourist questions with a smile about the food. The food came fairly quickly for our table of 6 and was absolutely delicious! My kids ate all their food which is a miracle in itself. Definitely worth trying.

I'd say they are average mexican food. They're Margarita was great and they're chips and salsa make it worth coming back. 
My wife and I shared the pork carnitas and they were very good, salty but good. My son's mac-n-cheese came cold and my daughters quesadilla was greasy. My in-laws love the place though and I didn't have a problem with the service except when it was time for us to leave, our waiter was no where to be found. They had a great kids menu and even had strawberry and chocolate milk. We ended everything with the flan which was super sweet. We'll go back again, but only because it is close by.

Me and The Hubs were in the area a few months ago visiting family and made a trip to Reading Terminal Market.  While there, we bought some Italian sausages from Martin's to take back to my folk's house for dinner the next night.  AMAZING sausages!  I wish we'd bought more.  I wish these people shipped!

I miss the Cyclops!! I was transferred about a year ago to the Boston area and I can't find a burger joint as good as Sketch. Nobody will put an over easy egg on a burger here. Damn Board of Health!  I can't wait to come back to Philly and visit so I can get a Cyclops and the wife can get the decadent Truffle Butter Burger. Best burger anywhere.

I had the special Seitan Burger, just to be a little healthy and just wasn't craving the red meat that night. Very sweet and tangy and filling. But I had a sweet tooth and also got a vanilla shake which really hit the spot. I also had a pina colado Sobe Iced tea. Damn.

This place is quaint, filled with colorful walls and chalkboards for doodling and making your mark. A great place to have a quick burger-based dinner with some cheese-puffs, which come with your burger...You can opt to have your burger on a salad instead of a bun if you're on the Atkins...or just hate buns. But who can resist good buns?

I don't recall any signage out front at all, but maybe I just missed it. Not sure about that one. It's across from Canvas, so look for that if you're lost.

The green chili cheese fries were the highlight of the evening. Based on that would be five stars probably. They are thick cut steak fries slathered in cheese and green chili, but there is no spice to spite the chili. The cheese sauce is a nice liquid that doesn't solidify overtime, which may be good or bad depending on your outlook.

The Banh Mi Burger was a total fail. It's the Burger of the month, pork burger with some type of sauce that makes it Vietnamese, maybe the mayo or something. There are also pickled carrots and maybe radishes I don't recall. No, but they were both cut way too thick. there are also jalapenos on top with no spice either. None of this would be that bad by themselves, or maybe it would be, but the pork burger itself was super dry and flavorless.

The truffle Burger was all right. It smelled like truffle, but I really did not taste anything besides a strong smell oh, I think it was truffle oil? The mushrooms were not bad and I added some pepper jack cheese which was also pretty good. The beef patty itself was thick and cook perfectly at medium, unfortunately the burger had no real flavor or seasoning. It seems to have been just a big patty of ground beef? And that might be good for some people I guess.

All-in-all I guess the average score would be a 4 with a high score for the fries, a low score for their burger of the month, and an average score for the truffle mushroom burger whatever it was called

Tom embodies the definition of a consummate professional.  He is professional, knowledgeable, extremely efficient, flexible, and responsible. He made me feel like I was his only client. He is very clear and straightforward in his explanations and great at following through with requests.  This is not my first loan and I am quite amazed at how he is able to do everything so perfectly from beginning to end.  As a workaholic myself, I would say he is on another level -  great for his clients!  Highly recommended A+

How did I just discover this place??  Apparently it's been here for 12-years and I've been in Carrollwood for 10-years and never knew about it.  Dinner Done offers quick and easy solutions to dinner.  How many times have you worked late?  Picked the kids up for a late soccer game and are just too tired to start cooking?  Sure fast food is an option.. but just not healthy.  With Dinner Done, you prepare 4 meals for $94.50.  Since it is just my hubby and myself, I split each of those meals in half for 8 meals!  We tried the Walnut Rosemary chicken on Sunday night and it was delicious!  There were 5 chicken cutlets that I prepared earlier in the week.  My hubby had 3 and I had 2 and I served it with a veggie on the side that I provided.  My hubby is out of town tonight so I will be preparing the Curry Chicken dish I put together since he is not a fan of curry.  If you don't want to prepare your meals you can pay a little extra and have them prepare the food for you.  And for another additional fee, you can add delivery service.  I actually found the preparation fun.  If you bring a friend it can be a fun 2-hours.  They serve wine for while you cook or water.  I was there in the afternoon and had brought my own water but it's good to know for next time.  There are about 12-13 recipes to choose from every month.  And if you go 3 times within 16-weeks, you get $30 your 4th visit.  That essentially brings your price down to just $84.50 for the 4 meals!  I will be back at the end of August for sure!  :)

Chill Asian ambience, fresh seafood with generous portions. I'm a fan of the exboyfriend and white tiger roll. The chefs selection of sushi and sashimi was solid as well. If you want good sushi here is a great choice.
Just drove by and the place is closed and boarded up as a result of Irma. I hope they reopen. The food is fantastic

I've been here twice and I have to say that the experiences were night and day. My advice to you would be to only come here during a very down time, not a lunch or dinner rush time and not on a weekend.

The place is extremely small, with I think perhaps four tables that seat around four people each. There is a very small kitchen with one chef working, and one person working the register/phone/tables.

The last time I came it was me and a friend, just after they opened up and on a weekday. This was around a year ago. The burgers and fries were pretty good, and everything was done in a reasonable about of time.

I came in on 1-26-19, a Saturday, at about 12 PM - lunch time. Only one table was free so I was seated there. Then it took my server over 15 minutes to actually take my order. She was so caught up with getting other orders out, phoned-in take-out orders and such. Once she finally took my order, it was literally another 30 minutes before my food came to me. My food being one hamburger.

Meanwhile numerous other people showed up, hoping to be seated but having nowhere to sit, putting in to-go orders and so forth. Once I did get my burger - the "cyclops" (basically a burger with a friend egg and garlic mayo) - it was nothing to write home about. Certainly it wasn't even close to being worth $9.25, especially with the unreasonable wait.

Add to that an underwhelming bottled tea by Joe's Teas (they ONLY offer bottled beverages) brought my total to $12.96 plus tip. For an underwhelming burger that took a total of 45 minutes to get from the kitchen to me, that's just not excusable.

I hear that the place has changed ownership since my first visit to my recent visit, and that may be the culprit for the downslide, but I also think they are just simply not equipped with the space or staff necessary to handle the volume in a timely fashion. Coupled with the overpricing, I can't suggest you bother trying this place.

Love it,,veggie burger and all them burgers taste on point!
I always go back for more!

I've been to a few burger joints around the city and I'd have to say this place is the BEST place so far. 

I had my friend pick up a reg burger with large fries and brought it to me at my job.
I asked for Medium Rare, it WAS medium rare! Juicy and delicious. Cant wait for her to pick it up for me again!

Dr. Kaylee and Dr. Kace have changed the way I think about chiropractors and the field itself. Through their knowledge and expertise I have learned the role chiropractics can have in your overall health and well-being, and the importance of routine maintenance that will help with more than just temporary pain! I highly recommend scheduling a consultation with them, the doctors are super friendly and will make it worth your while.

This Fresh Meat Market is the bomb I love going there. The best time to go is early in the morning because it's always a line. Thank God they have the tickets machine they call the number but you have to lesson for the number because some of the people walked away they call the number so they missed a spot in line. It's always crowded there but they have a lot of workers to assist the customers. And the workers are very pleasant. They have a wide selection of meats.  The prices are reasonable and take a reusable bag because they give you a bag but it's a plastic bag and if you want to do other shopping your reusable bags will hold up better while you're walking around. I found out about this place from my girlfriend she always shop here. She had brunch over her house and I asked her where she got these delicious sauces from and she told me. I went down there and brought brought some of the sausage and other things from Martin's Market. Their sausage have different things in them like mozzarella cheese and broccoli rabe so can you  imagine what the taste is like I'm telling you absolutely delicious. And me and my husband don't eat beef so I get all the turkey items that we like. I even buy other people things like someone on his job likes the turkey bacon so we usually buy him 3 lb of turkey bacon and my husband takes it to work and give it to him and one day I surprise my mom and brought her a couple of different sizes and she loves her pork especially the slab bacon. But all I can say that you need to take a visit and you'll see what I'm talkin about o and I forgot the Italian sausage and green peppers and onions and you know what you could do with those fry em up put them on a grill with a long roll oh my God you'll be in seven heaven.

If you are in the fishtown area and you just want a burger, you cannot go wrong here.  Burgers are their specialty and they do them quite well!  Plus, this burger is very reasonably priced.  They offer a nice variety of toppings and their fries are quite good.  I cannot comment on any other items, as I have just had the burger and fries, but I hear the milkshakes are good as well.  This place has more of the atmosphere of a coffee shop than a restaurant, as you order your food from a counter.  Because of this I would recommend it more for lunch than dinner.  Having a dairy allergy, I also appreciate their vegan-friendliness.

Always great service and a fun experience. Staff is professional but personable. Prices are average, but the quality of the food is always great. Size of portions is also amazing. They know my order when I walk in the door.
We enjoyed lunch here - bento boxes and sushi are both delicious. Good size portions. Service is very good. No loud music. An excellent choice for lunch and quiet conversation.

It's ok the food was ok but I expected more and it's their specialty. The place was empty the staff seemed uninterested in us spending the bulk of their time chatting with each other.  I'll try it again to see if it was an off day.

Holy Cow! Blessed Bovine! What else can I say to express to you how absolutely awesome the cooked cattle is at this restaurant?  

I was looking for a wonderful burger that was low on hype and big on taste and Sketch appeared to fit the bill.  I arrived with my 9 year old and my 4 year old, not expecting much.  What I got was a small, laid-back burger spot, that far exceeded my expectations.

I chose to get a medium burger topped with jack and BBQ sauce.  My two children split a well done burger with ketchup, American, and veggies.   I decided a large order of fries would be sufficient for the entire table. While our food was being prepared they took great interest in sketching out a drawing to place on the walls.  

The fries arrived before the burger, I'm still undecided if they are meant to be appetizer-ish (yeah, that's a word) or if Sketch just knows the fries are so good that you'll eat them all before your burger is done and beg for more.  In any event, the latter is what occurred. As soon as the fries arrived we dug right in, ignoring the fact that they were scorching hot.  What can I say, the mouth wants what the mouth wants.  The harissa aioli was the perfect accompaniment.   

When the burgers finally arrived we were ready to dig in.  I split the burger for the kids and dug into my personal burger.  My kids, who usually eat more than me, were more than satisfied with half a burger.  I couldn't even finish mine.  

Honestly, sketch was the best burger I've ever eaten.  Quality meat, fresh toppings, and an awesome roll made for an unforgettable experience.  Add to that the AMAZING fries and you'll understand why this place has been dancing in my mind every since.

Ok. Whoever decided to mix vegan food and wonderfully delicious hamburgers is either insane or amazing, but probably both

It is one of the few places that I can go with my vegan friend and we can both leave satisfied.

I don't touch vegan food. So I can't really say if that part is good or not. But my friend eats it so it must at the very least be as tolerable as any other vegan food.

The hamburgers on the other hand are fantastic. They are a little too big for a person my size but they split in half nicely.

The fries are good and the aoli sauce they come with is enough to keep people coming back.

If you are in the mood for a good burger definitely check it out.

My husband and I stopped here for the first time ever. We shared the
THE PLANET SUB (697) Premium Roast Beef, Oven Roasted Turkey, Smoked Ham, Bacon, Swiss, Lettuce, Tomatoes, Dijon, Mayonnaise. It was AWESOME!!!  Loaded with delicious meats, crispy bacon, melted Swiss cheese etc.  It was made quickly, heated without being burnt and absolutely delicious. Wish we had one in Goodyear AZ. Staff was friendly and efficient. Great place for a great sandwich.

Well, well, well I must say that my burger experience here was spectacular. I took my mom and daughter here. Mom and I both had the Truffle Butter burger and we both could pretty much say it was one of the best we ever had. The meat combined with the truffle butter leaves a very flavorful taste in your mouth. The fries are delicious, somewhat of a barbecue or smoked flavor, very good. Milkshakes way too pricey! Very small dining area, but it's all worth it! Lol

Interesting concept and fun for families to participate in the family meals. I have been to their in kitchen sessions with my granddaughter several times and always a fun experience for both of us. With in kitchen sessions you can also adjust the amounts and ingredients as you see fit for the dish. Also have ordered prepared meals that are put together by the staff. Most meals are very good. All in my family enjoy the food. I would opted for more than the represented servings to assure plenty for the family. Well worth the exp

Juicy Burgery Deliciousness!!! Best Burgers I have had. I ordered the truffle butter burger and the Kobe burger today, both of which were phenomenal and out of this world with flavor! I would highly recommend this place to my friends and everyone! If you haven't tried it you need to. The service was excellent, I was able to talk with the owner Dan and you could tell he has a passion for what he does and for the area and shows it big time! Look at the picture, you can see the juice!!! Mmmm mmmm delicious!
Great subs :-). I had the tuna and it was very good. Great customer service too! Very clean and TVs yay!

Now THIS is what Tucson has been waiting for.... REAL AUTHENTIC ISLAND STYLE FOOD!!!!! These owners are born and raised Islander and has the know how and the secret family recipes that are true island style plate lunch. The Kalua Pork is smoked first, not added liquid fake smoke, and is cooked to perfection. It's as good as the best plate lunch in MAUI where I come from. His katsu is moist, the banger shrimp is delicious, teriyaki beef is tender and exactly the flavor. Now he has Poke, real, fresh POKE! Unlike anyone else!! Each item is as close and as authentic as you can get to what real Hawaiian and Island food is like! Wow! A real winner. The restaurant is spacious, clean and the decor sets the island mood. One of the best things is the extra teriyaki sauce that you can pour on yourself. The food is delicious, atmosphere is relaxed, restaurant and bathroom are clean. I highly recommend this awesome place that's like being in the islands. Glad they brought the islands to us. Can't wait to tell my friends and co-workers about this place.

I am always looking for something new to try for lunch.  The guys that I work with visit Solid Grindz at least twice a week. I now know why! I plan on being a regular. I ordered the Teriyaki Chicken. For $8.00, I received a decent amount of teriyaki chicken, 2 scoops of sticky white rice and a scoop of tuna mac salad.  Well worth the money spent.  I was able to make two meals out if it. For those with a larger appetite you can upgrade your combo to include another scoop of rice.  They do have bottles of teriyaki and hot sauce for those who want more. The rice is served plain so I added teriyaki sauce to it and it made it better. The Tuna Mac salad is somewhat plain in flavor but is eatable.  Those raised on a miracle whip based Mac salad may not like it since it is mayo based. There is an option to add rolls to your meals as well.

The Solid Bang Shrimp is phenomenal!!! It has the right amount of flavoring that also blends nicely with the Tuna mac. For $9.00, I got 10 large shrimp, 2 scoops rice and a scoop of tuna mac with my order. I was able to make two meals from it.

 Service was quick and friendly. I waited approximately 8 minutes for my order to be ready.  Will definitely be back.

I have finally found "a neighborhood butcher." Their prices are good. $3 and north to $4 for a lb of ground beef. I asked if it was sirloin and they said "sirloin and chuck." Perfect! They gave me pound of dogs, got about 8. Total came out to $8.90

30 mins later I made some burgers- no seasoning (besides a little kosher salt) - and they had a bassier milk taste with a very soft and tender consistency, that indicates more sirloin than chuck. 

The meat comes in a regular plastic bag. Which means it is not pumped full of carbon monoxide like Shoprite meat is- that's why it's in the air tight package. It artificially keeps the meat pink. Not here at Martin's. Nice gentleman gave me a calendar too!

We had been hearing a lot of good things about Solid Grindz and finally got to eat here today. All the reviews are true, it's really good! We tried many different dishes on the menu and everyone agreed it was the best in Tucson! Definitely try the Spam Musubi too, they are awesome!
Good food, just didn't give me my utensils and napkin in my bag when I ordered to go.

My boyfriend and I went to Dave and Busters for lunch on Saturday August 31st, we were highly dissapointed waiting 30 minutes and no server stopped by to ask us for drinks or anything. My boyfriend looked at places near by and we found planet sub and decided to give them a try. We walked in and were greeted by Ceci, we told her it was our first time at Planet Sub and were not sure of what to order, Ceci told us all about their bread they make in house and gave us opinions on popular sandwiches, our experience was wonderful! Friendly staff, clean tables and amazing food! We live in Vail Az and decided to come back again the next day to dine in again! Greeted again by Ceci and her customer service was above a 10/10!! Love Planet Sub! Would love if they could expand their location to vail on maryann cleveland!!

Our recent home buying experience was made so much better because of Tom Vosburgh.  We are so glad that we chose to put our trust in Tom; he not only answered our questions, he took the time guide us through every step of the home buying process.  Tom is very knowledgeable about every aspect of his job and he is also a very nice guy!

you get what you pay for. if you remember that, then you'll be pretty pleased with the sushi here. the prices may seem steep at face value, but their cuts of fish are VERY generous and the rolls are ginormous. is there cheaper and better elsewhere? yes, but not in philly. 

sashimi is the name of my game, and the sashimi pieces in our chirashi and sashimi roll were the largest i've ever seen since moving here. the fish is not SUPER fresh, but it's fairly good. the agedofu (why don't they call it agedashi tofu?!) is so good, but the house sake was terrible, even when warmed. still, alcohol is alcohol, and i love that they have hot sake in-house.

as a stand-alone restaurant, i would probably rate shiroi hana 3 stars. but in comparison to the paucity of good sushi restaurants in philly, i'd give it 4 stars. so i'll split the difference and bump it up for excellent service and hospitality in letting us overstay our welcome way past closing time.

as a separate note, do they ever open up the top floor for service? maybe for large parties..

5 STARZ for very friendly and accommodating staff. Theyre the best staff. But Katsu doesnt have taste which was kinda sad. On the other hand Chicken Teri is very tasteful like very soy saucy which i think is normal for a chicken teriyaki.

I don't normally indulge in cheeseburgers, but it was finally time, so I began searching for the best joint in Philadelphia to break the fast.  Every article I found, every person I asked, they all pointed to Sketch Burger.  Understandably so.  As soon as I bit into the medium-rare Kobe beef patty (topped with melted American cheese and grilled onions), I knew I had chosen well.  It got a bit messy, with greasy fat juices dripping all over, but it felt like a religious experience.  I am very particular about buns, and it was soft and toasted.  I opted out of the sauce and lettuce-and-tomato dressings, which I recommend omitting to truly taste the beef.  The crisp French fries are thick and seasoned--the wasabi sauce kicks them up to a different gear.  The burger shop is lit with poor fluorescent lighting and decorated with amusing doodles, which may appeal to some, but I found it a bit cold and kitschy.  The entrance is guarded by a shelf of rotating sweet cookies and desserts--the hazelnut chocolate truffle blew open the roof of my brain.  All in all, the burgers are greasy goodness and the menu is filled with many surprising delights, including savory entrees and sides and thick milkshakes.  Sketch Burger is not my M.O., but I know it is very appreciated by the locals and those searching for a filling and tasty burger.

My coworker took me here for lunch for my birthday. I feel kind of bad because even though I got a feel meal, I wouldn't say this is the best sushi I've had. The prices here are outrageous compared to other sushi joints around town (near rittenhouse or old city). Even basic rolls cost like $7, $1-3 dollars more compared to other places. Special rolls cost about the same but smaller with more rice. I guess compared to the other high end restaurants in this part of town, the prices are reasonable. 

I got a nigiri/sashimi special and got to try some of their fish. The fish seemed fresh and the plate arrangement was very nice. I did not like how they cut their fish though. The fish was cut very long and skinny, not easily eaten in one bite like sushi is supposed to be eaten. They also put cuts through each piece of salmon and tuna for my sashimi, maybe to improve the texture of the fish but it didn't really do anything. The raw fish was strangely hard and reminded me of the texture of jello. This could be that their fish might actually be fresh (not previously frozen) but I actually prefer the softer/mushier, previously frozen fish from Vic's. If you have had Vic's, there's definitely a difference. 

The worst part and the reason why I would not come back here is their sushi rice is messed up! It was all HARD and it NOT STICKY at all. When I tried to dip my nigiri in the soy sauce, the rice fell apart and crumble all over. This is not proper sushi.

Update: Unfortunately the last two times I've been here their bang shrimp has come out, at most, warm. Usually it comes out hot like it was just made but now it feels like it's been pre made and waiting under a hot light for someone to come along. :/

The pizza tastes good but two bad things... Its dirty... There was hair in my pizza slice once... There is no management or customer service... I ordered a pie and it came in 8 slices and one of the slices was one inch wide it was so small....I ordered peporoniand it was all cheese... I called to re order and they re charged me and charged me to deliver after they screwed up my pizza... For the lack of customer service I would not go back.

Ordered the traditional poke. Friend got the burger with rice. He enjoyed his. My poke kinda sucked and way overpriced for what it was. The atmosphere inside didn't give me confidence in the food either. The blaring country music didn't add to the experience.

Oh man, the Paesano nearly put me in a coma with delicious kilo-calorie goodness. 

Forget n-thousand variations on cheese and steak all over the city, the Paesano is the sandwich you must have before you die. 

A bit pricey at $8 for a fancy hoagie / sub, but ... did I mention delicious? Oh yes.

Also, how do the guys who work here stay so buff? After one sandwich, I was nearly inert for the next 24 hours.

Yes. This place is really good. For some reason it's not renown in Philly as a great burger spot, but it's succulent. The burgers are so moist (and fortified with butter from what I can tell) that the fact that they are not cooked to the right temperature is OK.

The green chili fries were delicious and spicy. My bulls-eye burger (bacon, egg, cheddar, topped with BBQ) was outstanding. Recommended.

OK food with horrible service. The server acted as if she had better places to be, was not attentive to our order and, thus, royally screwed it up. 

There were two errors with the order before third time, when I had to get up from my seat to request lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle on the side (as ordered) because the waitress was starting at her phone behind the counter paying no mind to her customers. 

No compensation was offered when I went to pay the bill. Again, I had to wait a few minutes before the waitress acknowledged me waiting at the counter. I tipped 20% but felt compelled to write this review.

I have to mention this place is cash only. I loathe cash-only. No one gets paid in cash so passing the buck to the customer to the store-owned ATM is just egregious at this point to me. 

Another note, and this goes for all businesses, step it up and stop serving fructose based ketchup. It bastardizes the food (if they even get your order right), is super unhealthy and tastes like chemicals.

I can't wait until a better burger place opens up. This restaurant will definitely have to try a little harder in this ever growing, competitive neighborhood.

We stopped here for burgers before going to Evil Genius Beer Company. We ordered three burgers an order of fries and two drinks. The fries came out way before the burgers and when we finally got the burgers they were raw inside. The owner was very apologetic and only charged us for two burgers, which we thought was unnecessary as we assumed that he was going to remake the burgers.  But all he did was throw the burgers back on the grill, which would've been fine if they were just plain burgers but since they had cheese, toppings and sauce on them they were mediocre at best.
Do not be fooled by the location/exterior. Very good habachi and sushi at a great price. BYOB, rarely a wait time and a wide variety of meals. The meal is always very consistent and delicious.
Great spot to get afford trendy clothes. Love that I can sell my clothes for cash too! Staff is nice!

You know when you're really craving something specific... for me it was a juicy burger. I have slowly been making my way through philly's best burgers list (a few different lists) and was in the area so I came to sketch. 

Unfortunately I was pretty disappointed. After careful contemplating, I chose the truffle butter burger because who can resist truffle?! I asked for medium rare, some parts came out really pink and some parts were weirdly tough. I couldn't taste the truffle at all. I mentioned this to the woman working there and she brought me a cup of truffle butter which was nice of her. Overall the burger was not seasoned well and a bit dry. The fries were thick cut and too potatoey in my opinion.. kinda dry and lacking flavor. The dipping sauces (aolis) tasted okay but seemed really watered down. On top of this... anytime I spoke to the woman working there, she seemed highly irritated with me. 

Lastly, I was surprised when my check came out. I felt like the menu was a bit deceptive because I was charged for every topping separately even though the menu lists the truffle butter burger as coming with mushrooms.  That should be made clearer... most places don't charge for separate toppings unless it's a build-your-own burger. 

The most impressive thing about this place was the "sketches" of really unique burgers hanging up all over the place. But that's from the customers anyway so...
I haven't had a better burger, ANYWHERE!!! So dope. Kid friendly. Cash only. Bank of America a few doors down or use the ATM in restaurant.

While dining in or ordering out is probably an entirely different experience, I would advise against placing group orders with Planet Sub. The office that I work in placed a group order and it was completely disappointing. 

The first issue was that the online ordering system allowed group members to edit or remove other members' meals, and the layout of the website was confusing, making it easy to accidentally modify someone else's order. The second issue is that the morning of the date we were going to get this group order, we received a call saying ALL of the soups were sold out, so anyone who ordered a half sandwich and a soup were now just getting a full sandwich. There were many different kinds of soups on our order, and I find it both disappointing and surprising that every single soup they offer was sold out. How does that happen? The one plus (or maybe a red flag) is they mentioned they could deliver to us when they called. 

Once our order arrived, the delivery person was kind enough to help sort out all of the food and distribute it to those who ordered items. Each item was bagged individually with the recipient's name on it. However, the delivery person noted that some people's items may have gotten mixed up and are in the wrong bags. Additionally, because of the bug on the website allowing people to edit each others' items in the group order, some items were flat out wrong or missing, including the sandwich I had ordered. Luckily the restaurant brought some "extras" and after some people traded sandwiches I ended up with a BLT.

I read other reviews saying that they claim to make the bread in-house, but honestly I felt that it was really bland and cheap tasting bread. It had a really thin crust and was really reminiscent of cheap school lunch sub bread. Also, it was wheat, which is not my first choice for a BLT. Additionally, the bacon was definitely the super paper-thin microwavable kind -- come on, even Eegee's serves better bacon. I'm not necessarily going to speak for my whole office, but this was a really bad experience for me and several others and we probably won't be ordering again. I also am going to pass on ever visiting the store for an individual order, either.

This place is INCREDIBLE! I saw that one lady saying something about it be racist, and I genuinely laughed at it. The most insane thing I've seen all day. 
The entire staff is some of the nicest people I've ever met. They went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and to accommodate whatever needs I had. I've been to a lot of Chiropractors, but this one is by FAR my favorite.

Food is bomb! ESP the loco moco and shrimp!! And the girls that work here are the greatest! Answered any questions we had and even recommended a platter and even came to check up on us to make sure everything was tasting good!
This place is the worst for online orders! Waited over an hour for my order and I had to canceled since it was taking it so long. Is you offer a service make it work!

On December 31st 2019, my boyfriend and I walked in to planet sub with our 1 month old baby and were told that we had to leave Because they were closed at 1, this was at 12:55. People were still in there eating. We went outside waited a few minutes to decide where we wanted to eat, no body left planet sub, we went to popeyes and came back and a few people that were there before were still there and people were going in to get served but we were told they were closed I was so furious, I went in and threw a fit to the lady who said she was the owner. She said the employees nor herself knew if they were going to close. First of all if you are the owner you should know wether your going to close for the day, she explained they were closed for 30 minutes. Like I explained to her, you NEVER tell customers your closed if you arent sure if your going to close for the day or have customers coming in still if your closed and serving them! I was so angry because NO ONE ELSE was turned away. Idk if it was because we walked in with the baby but either way you dont turn your customers who are bringing your business in money 5 minutes before you say your closed you still serve them. I will NOT be returning and I will be sure to let others know the terrible service and the incompetence of the "owner". The owner said I was being nasty and aggressive and I was because it was so shitty to tell us we had to leave your closed but continued serving people after, we watched several people walk in after us. She didnt seem in the slightest bit apologetic.

Don't order their sandwiches. The American Grinder had two slivers of meat, and was missing their sliver of salami. And they tried to mask the lack of cold cuts with a mountain of lettuce and tomatoes. Same goes for the Sausage Parm; very thin sausage with an avalanche of mozzarella cheese covering the narrow piece of pork. And the pork didn't taste good. I'll stick with their pizzas, wings and salads!

Food was great, a bit sad that they ran out of Spam Musubi by the time we got there at 6, otherwise it would be 5 stars. I had the 2 Combo with Teri Beef and Katsu Chicken. They were both super flavorful and cooked right. Service was nice, polite and while it took a few minutes longer for our orders than our friends, it wasn't so long that it was an inconvenience. The island music provided just the right happy mood. Hope to be able to try the Spam Musubi next time!

Delicious classic Japanese lunch, steps from Broad Street in the heart of Center City. The atmosphere is calm with dim lights and a cozy feeling, not too crowded or loud, perfect place for conversation.

Hope I give this review and it stick's cause YELP keeps filtering reviews to great companies and hard working people that are making  a living...
SKETCH burger is a great place to relax and eat a great burger and  can't never forget them french fries...Too yummy.
I recommend it in any occasion....Taste  great and friendly staff.

Here again the other night. Was very busy since it was a Friday night but we were able to find yo seats at the bar. They have a dj on Friday and Saturday which is pretty loud but ok. I didn't have food this time just drinks but I recommend the wings or the shrimp platter.

What a hidden gem. We stumbled upon Shiroi Hana while aimlessly walking around trying to find dinner on a rainy night. I did a quick Yelp search to make sure they served alcohol, and was also pleasantly surprised at all the good reviews! And this place lives up to it, trust me. The atmosphere was warm, with simple Japanese decor & an impressive space upstairs for private parties. It was our server's first night working and he was friendly and attentive. 

We started off with Wasabi Shumai and spicy garlic edamame. We were blown away by both dishes and the addition of garlic and spice really elevated the edamame. For our meals, we had the Rock and Roll (basically shrimp tempura), a Philly roll, and the Negimayaki. The sushi was  fresh and delicious, and the Negimayaki was tender and very filling. Overall, it was a 5 star experience and I cannot wait to visit again!

Everyone told me this was the best burger in Philly, and they weren't wrong. This small hole in the wall joint really delivers. The meat is the best I've ever had in a burger--super juicy and tender, and the grease oozes down your arms. You can make your burger as decadent as you like (truffle, egg, bacon, etc.) or just go simple with it. I find it doesn't need much because the meat itself is so well-seasoned. A close second to the burger, though, are the fries. The portion is generous and they come with a "flight" of condiments which make all the difference.

TIP: this place is CASH ONLY! Also, if you're artistic or funny at all please leave a drawing on the wall for the rest of us untalented people to laugh at and admire as we eat!

Had a great experience last week at Dinner Done. Friendly and experienced staff. Owners were present and engaged. Overall a great, fun experience. Ate the first meal tonight, pepperoni parmesan chicken, and it was great! Whole
family liked it! Will be going back for sure, this was a great time saver for my busy life!

First timer and here! Let me say As soon as I walked into the restaurant I was greeted by friendly employees. The rumor from the kitchen was making me drool before I even ordered. They have a great variety on the menu and authentic Hawaiian dishes some I haven't seen in the states except back in Hawaii. Let me tell you prices are as great as the food. I had the Kalbi beef with their specialty bang shrimp and after having my first bite of that shrimp my God I wanted to get some on the side as well. Great stop for lunch and in my case if you're in town for business eat in or take out it's as easy as that. Definitely coming back for dinner LOL.

So I got on yelp looking for a good sandwich place. After looking at their menu it sounded really good so I went. I drove in from Sahuarita and was excited to try it. I ordered a half turkey club and a whole Planet Sub and added cheddar cheese and black olives. I also asked for no mayonnaise and mustard. When I finally got home I opened my sandwich up and it was covered with mustard and mayonnaise. For me just the smell of mustard makes me want to throw up. Unfortunately, I cannot give a good review because I did not get to try my sandwich. Also, I did not know this but both subs were served hot. Maybe I missed it but I don't remember the menu saying they were all hot.

Tom and his team are very nice to work with - professional, friendly and they do what they say they will do.  Communication through-out the process was very good, and we are quite happy with the end result.  Highly recommend.

Amazing bang shrimp. BRING THE FRENCH FRIES BACK lol. They were so good with the teriyaki sauce. Or maybe I'm just weird. But great service. Great food. I wish they sent coupons out but that's just the Mr.Krabs in me talking.

This is definitely my favorite burger joint in Philadelphia. The creative sketches on the wall are always fun to look at, and it's enjoyable drawing one yourself. The burgers are AMAZING. First of all they are big and very affordable. They are cooked to perfection and the sauces provided are soooo delicious. The service is fast and I never had a bad experience with a waiter! I would definitely recommend to anyone!
So much one use plastic. So much waste. Plastic and Styrofoam like it's 1985.  for everyone even eat in customer. No recycling either. Just a sad situation this day and age

Twice I have been here within listed business hours and they are closed. I am here now..guess what? closed! Absolutely ridiculous. Food is great, but not worth driving and looking for parking only for them to be closed. You gotta do better Sketch management!

This store makes me wonder why I ever bought meat from Trader Joe's when this is not much further from my office. Delicious meat at extremely reasonable prices. The meat associates are super patient with my indecisive self. Haha.

I have been a customer for a while.  I got discouraged when I thought that they had gone out of business.  I finally saw that they just moved down the street.  It is a better establishment.

Of course I love all of the different things I have tried there.  The food is always fresh and relatively quick.  I usually pick it up on the way home and they are always very accommodating.  The ladies at the front are very friendly and very helpful.  I know I always take too long to order because when everything is so good, how do you decide.

Maybe it is just me, but it seems like they are getting more business at the new place, and even the food is better.
Definitely better than subway. Also their daily specials are bomb. The bread is pretty good as well! Also the staff here is really friendly and always good with their recommendations!

This is my favorite sushi spot in Philly.  And I have been to Morimoto (twice), Raw, Fuji Mountain, Mizu and many, many others.  Shiroi is not a "show place" but it serves very fresh product with a wide variety of fish.  The kitchen entrees are well prepared and there are some great values to be had.  The Tuna Lover's platter and Vegetarian Special (a bento box) never disappoint.  I enjoy eating here and have many times and intend to come back many more times.
Charging for toppings? GFY That's scamtacular. For what they charge, lettuce and onions should be included.

I wish there were a zero star option because that's what I would give Sketch.  I came here last Friday with my boyfriend when it was downpouring.  All we wanted to do was get out of the rain, get a quick bite to eat and move on with our lives.  Coming from somone who has worked in the restaurant biz, I know what the worst complaint about a restaurant can be.  It's not that the food sucks, that the decor is tacky, that the location is bad, it's HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE, like Sketch.

So we walk in and nobody greets us, offers us a table or anything!  Ummm, if you don't have a hostess, get a sign that says, "Please seat yourselves."  So, after five minutes of awkwardness and confusion, we decided to just seat ourselves.  By the way, the tables and chairs were really sticky, like there was a layer of grease all over them.  The place looked really dirty overall, probably as clean as a McDonald's.  ANYWAY, despite the fact that half the restaurant was empty (i.e. not busy at all) no one came to our table with water or menus.  This place was the most inefficient, embarrassing, unprofessional restaurant I have ever been to. Without a question, we decided to walk out (which I have never done before) and went to PUB AND KITCHEN instead--our favorite go-to burger spot, where we were greeted immediately, seated immediately and given excellent customer service. 

Who gives a SHIT how good your burgers are when you don't even know how to take care of your customers?  What kind of business strategy is that?  Obviously a bad one because I got a really big mouth and I made sure to tell every single person in my office this morning to never come here.  Honestly, places like this don't even deserve to be in business.  

GET A CLUE!
I live nearby and go often, sometimes with my husband or friends and sometimes alone. Food is always delicious, staff is warm and friendly, atmosphere is quiet and comfortable.

had my Moms Celebration of life at Macayos Estes. Service and Food were over the top!
Manager, Marissa worked with me to make sure this event was perfect.
Servers Tony and Richard were exceptional!!
The day was perfect...Thank you Macayos Staff!!!
Went on Saturday night at 7:30 & it was closed. Phone number is disconnected. Since I can't give it a negative or zero stars, it gets one just so I can post this.

Looking for a juicy burger that'll hit the spot to satisfy your comfort food craving? Sketch is definitely the joint to pop in to try. It's small, but cozy and community friendly since you'll notice their walls embellished with drawings from local customers (hence the name "Sketch" burgers - relax, sketch while you wait for your burger, and have some fun!) 

*CASH ONLY. ATM out front

Recommend: 
- Truffle Burger (my fav if you love mushroom/truffle)
- Cyclops (for all you egg lovers out there)
- Don't forget to check out their fresh baked goods at the front either; cheap and tasty.

I've been a customer for years, but have to sadly report the quality of their meat has changed in my opinion. There has been consistency, times where I had to say good-bye to the savory and satisfying umami taste. Because of this, I will have to say they are a 3.5 star.
Food was very very good. Way better than subway. The quality is above par and priced reasonably.

Love this place! The kitchen is always clean, staff helpful, food fresh & setup is very efficient. It is wonderful to leave there after 1 hour with enough meals (with leftovers) to feed my family for 1-2 weeks!

I wanted to love this place after a mall the reviews, however the food was just not good. We ordered two burgers, cyclops and Nashville, and they both were very disappointing. The patties were very thick and not flavored. The Nashville burger was a special which sounded like it would be so bomb, however it did not taste good: jalapeños, pepper jack cheese and a spicy crunchy chip. The cyclops was pretty much the same thick cut and flavorless party with an aioli and a fried egg.   We also had an order of cheese fries and the cheese was also terrible! I didn't really think you could screw up cheese fries but the cheese was gritty and lumpy (wish I took a picture). 

Pros: cute shop with creative concept of having different sketches on the wall from customers, short wait time for food. 

Cons: food wasn't good, parking was hard to find (street parking). 


Despite wanting to really like this place, I don't think I will be trying again.

I've been around the block and few times, and this in one exceptional Mortgage Broker.  Tom is extremely well informed and is able to communicate his knowledge to his clients.  Mr. Vosburgh is honest, reliable and pleasant to work with. 

Thank you for your assistance.  I found your name on YELP and following the recommendation that preceded me.

This place is amazing! The people are generally super nice, except when it gets busy. The staff seems to get a bit flustered when it's a busy Saturday night but the food never falters as a result. The burgers are amazing.. my personal fav is the Kobe beef. The sauces are different and can get spicy so choose wisely! I love going here and will be more than happy to go every weekend just for the fries alone! I would recommend grabbing a burger and fries and drawing a picture to hang on their walls as a momento!
Bang bang shrimp here is to die for, so is their teriyaki sauce. It's no wonder some people try and steal it.

This used to be my favorite burger spot but since the new owners took over it has gone down hill. I recently made an order on Uber Eats and requested a turkey burger with aioli, pickles, onions, bacon, and American cheese and the truffle parmesan fries with extra shaved parmesan. My burger was cold, the aioli was missing and the onions were old and sloppy and the extra shaved parmesan was missing from my fries. It's a shame what has happened to this place.

[ summary ]
Smaller and slightly less of an intellectual "I-read-the-New-Yorker-and-am-holier-than-thou-on-my-high-fucking-horse" vibe than Franklin Mortgage. Dark enough to make the person across from you look sufficiently attractive to make the conversation enjoyable (just make sure you keep the lights off later when things get serious). Another spot to add to your repertoire of places to bring a chick when she's got a little too much intellectual horsepower for your local dive bar and 3.50 beer specials, but is still a sucker for wine and costume parties at the age of 30.

[ finding the door and getting in ]
Upon entering Ranstead Street (quite generous - more accurately described as an alley, perpetually under construction) you will be 100% certain that your friend has brought you here to murder you and throw your limbs into one of many restaurant dumpsters. You'll know you've found the place when you see two Rs (one artistically drawn backwards, J.R.R. Tolkein-style) on the door. Someone will then inform you of the wait time, which will hopefully not be too atrocious.

I once put my name and number on the waitlist, sat in Capogiro for an hour, gave up, and went to Franklin Mortgage instead. Minus one star for leading me on. That woman had zero intention of calling me back. Gents, you know my pain.

[ vibe ]
The walls are touchably velvety. Dark, chandelier-y, gold tiles, wood tables, pretty ladies with feathers in their hair. A tasteful collection of nude pinup paintings on the back wall is the perfect finishing touch. Splendid.

[ dranks ]
What a psychologically conscientious place: to reduce financial anxiety and simplify tab splitting among stingy friends without causing bad will, all cocktails are $13.

The "Bartender's Choice" option is fantastic: I asked for something "apple-y" and was given a scrumptious apple ginger cocktail with a slice of tart granny smith and a piece of crystalized ginger. Well done.

My friend got the monkey gland, which was sufficiently absinthe-y.

My other friend got a Yuengling (some people are just beyond help). We let her sit at the table anyway.

[ overall ]
Worthy experience.

The food is so tasty. I haven't had this good Hawaiian food since since I was last in Hawaii. It tastes just like any mixed plate you would find in Hawaii. The Mac salad was the best I've ever had. My takeout was ready within ten minutes which was also nice. Pricing is reasonable. 
The parking lot is a little weird so beware.

I don't think I appreciated how good the food was until a couple of weeks later.  Since eating at Green Eggs Cafe I have had brunch at two other restaurants.  Neither were as good as this restaurant.  The roasted potatoes seasoned with salt and rosemary are  AMAZING!  My omelet was uncommonly good.  They pride themselves on catering to dietary restrictions which is good for me because I can't eat dairy or gluten.  By chance, my server has family who are lactose intolerant so she understood my needs.  The only drawback to this restaurant are the long waits.  If we were seated sooner I would have given them 5 stars.

Our original destination was Nick's Sari-Sari store at 2001 Craycroft to sample some Filipino fare.  However, by the time we arrived later in the day, most of the food was gone.  Luckily for us, we espied Solid Grindz Hawaiian BBQ in the adjacent strip mall, just a walk of a few yards away in the next parking lot on the East side of Craycroft.

Other than a few meals at Mama's Hawaiian BBQ on Tanque Verde, we have not had many Hawaiian dinners since Lani's Luau, one of our favourite restaurants in town, at Harrison and Golf Links closed.  That establishment was like a small family restaurant on the islands, and it had the nicest couple as owner-chefs.

We were very glad that we stopped into Solid Grindz.  One orders at the counter with the menu items' being posted behind it.  A number is provided to take to the table so that the meal can be carried out and cups are given for self-serve sodas.  There is a station set up with plastic flatware and napkins.

Mom opted for the Kalua Pulled Pork, always a favourite, Island Beans and Island Salad.  My choice was the double-meat Kalbi Ribs, Bang Shrimp, Tuna Mac Salad and Island Beans.  One of the staff brought out our order, and both plates were ample, plenty of food for each of us.  In fact, we each brought some home, and our Chihuahua, too, had Hawaiian for dinner that night.

Everything was flavourful and tasty.  The Kalua Pulled Pork was moist and tender; the Kalbi Ribs were seasoned well and devoured to the bone; and the Bang Shrimp in its creamy sauce was, well, bang-on!  The Tuna Mac Salad was cold and creamy, and the Island Salad was a simple green salad with a fresh, light dressing.  Frankly, I am not a fan of sweet baked beans, but the Islands Beans changed my mind.  They were absolutely delicious!

Mom announced that we were definitely coming back to Solid Grindz, and we certainly shall.
Best pizza I've found here in Tampa. Bring I'm from Jersey I searched a long time till I found this place. It a very casual place with great food.

The place is small, with sketches all over the walls (hence the name). That makes for an interesting ambiance, but If you love burgers then this place is like heaven! Choose from a sirloin beef, American Kobe, turkey, or vegan burger. Then choose your toppings, state your preferred temperature, order a side of hand cut fries with a shake, and you are all set. You will receive a perfectly cooked to order juicy burger that will put a smile on your face. The American Kobe cooked medium rare with cheddar cheese is my personal favorite. If I lived in Fishtown I would be a regular here.

I had been toying with trying their services for a while. I compared their prices to what I spend on groceries. Considering that a lot of what I buy goes bad before I get around to preparing it their prices are comparable. I use their To Go services where I pick the entrees and they prepare it for pick up later in the week. I've only used them for one month so far but everything I've tried so far has been delicious. Because of my eating habits I actually take the entrees to work for lunch. It has cut back what I spend on wasted groceries and fast food. Well, I'm off to pick up this months entrees.

Food, service and fun. I love having a Macayo's close to me. Sometimes we just go for their signature margaritas but we mostly go for the authentic Mexican flair. The chips are fresh and crispy, plus you get the perfect medium salsa with unlimited refills. My favorite is the chicken street tacos and my husband always gets the chimi dinner (macayo's invented the chimi). I love that their staff is quick to serve you, check back frequently and it's cool to see the regulars. Oh wait does that make us regulars, maybe :)

Saved my vacuum cleaner from the garbage numerous times for a small fee.  My vacuum cleaner had a funny smell that wouldn't go away even after changing the bag consistently. Scott figured it out immediately! He cleaned a small filter located at the bottom of the unit for no charge. This took care of the smell immediately! On several occasions my cord severed due to my cleaning lady running over it. Again, Scott came through, swapping the cord for a new one and extending the life of my vacuum once again. I highly recommend this place for repairs and new vacuum purchases. The owner and staff are experts in the field and are super helpful!

THIS PLACE SUCKS! Here's why....

You walk in hungry. You pay around $10 for a freshly made burger and fries swimming in a cheese sauce and after you're done, you want more!

So, you walk back up to the counter, mouth glistening with awesome burger grease and order another. You sit down and you enjoy that scrumptious made to order burger with egg, bacon, and fried onions on top. All done.

You go home and you're fat. You're fat and your wife leaves you because you've been out all night eating these awesome burgers. 

Don't go here unless you want burgers so good your wife leaves you.

It was my husband's 40th birthday and I threw him a huge bash with camping, games and even a bagpiper. While planning for our shenanigans I was thinking that no one was going to want to wake up the next morning to cook breakfast and that's when it dawned on me, Macayo's. I ordered 20 chorizo, egg, cheese and potato breakfast burritos with their awesome mild salsa. It even came with plates and forks. I can't tell you how delicious these burritos were, big, hot and fresh. Our guests were full and happy, thank you so much Macayo's !

I walked in here at about 8:20 something and someone was sitting in the restaurant so I tried to place a order for dine in and the hostess told me they were closing soon so we couldn't sit and eat. Understandable. I placed my order, paid and sat to wait for my food. The person sitting got there food literally a min before I did so I felt some kind of way and was like hey ppl have families to go home to whatever. Come home and COMPLETELY MESSED UP ORDER. I ordered a onion burger medium and pulled pork burger and we got two REGULAR Burgers none that were cooked the way we wanted. I called the store before they closed and no answer. WILL DEFINITELY not return. The messed up part is the burgers looked like they would be good and I wouldn't be able to tell you because my medium burger looked like the picture attached. Absolutely not what i ordered

This is probably my new favorite Japanese place in Philly after having searched for so long for an authentic one in Center City! We got there at 8pm on a Friday and were seated right away. We ordered a tempura sampler, a sushi regular set, and Japanese steak. The tempura came out warm and crisp. The hilight of the night was sushi -- thick fresh slice of fish on a small bed of perfectly cooked rice (reminds me of Sushi Yasaka in NYC). Pardon me, my mouth is watering as I'm writing this. The steak was also yum. Plus, the ambience is great and service is also on point! 

We forgot to take pictures of food, but attached is a photo of banana tempura, which deserves honorable mention.

This is kind of a weird place. The interior is very strange with table drawn artwork plastered over every square inch of the walls. It definitely has that vibe you would expect from a fishtown / northern liberties type place. They also have tons of brownie and dessert jars everywhere. I had the Cyclops burger ($8.95) which includes an egg on top of the burger. Overall the taste of the burger was good, but I prefer Good Dog, or the Shake Shack in Center City. And speaking of dogs, a lady who worked there brought 3 dogs into the restaurant. Upon entry, one proceeded to sniff my leg and then the lady brought them into the kitchen area for a while. It seemed like a health code violation to me, and so they get a point deduction for this. I dunno, maybe that is the kind of thing that you sort of expect when you go to a business with the name "sketch" and get something sketchy. I will attach a picture. Also had sweet potato fries ($4.5) which came out about 10 minutes before the burgers did. They were pretty good, but they were a little salty. 

Food Quality/Taste =  4 Stars
Portion Size Given Price = 3
Price = 2 Stars
Service = 2 Stars (We were not offered glasses of water, and were told to get something out of the fridge towards the back...)
Experience with Staff = 3 Stars
Decor = 2 Stars (I thought it looked weird, but this just might be a fishtown thing)

Returned to this place again this year after a stellar initial visit on my birthday last year and a fair experience getting some food to go a few months ago.  
I decided to give it another shot for three reasons, I'm all about giving restaurants second chances (last time was no where near as good as the first), I was in the mood for some pho and some pok pok wings at a new spot and also I was craving their Bang Shrimp!   
Since my last visit they've changed locations.  Only a few blocks down the way and across the street.  It's not its own building anymore and it a bit smaller.  They had maybe 20 people inside dining and it was between meal rushes....like 2 pm. 
This is where it went down hill.  First of all, they no Longer serve pho.  Pretty big let down but I get it.  Real pho takes a long time to prep the broth and if you aren't selling it every day...I could see removing it from your Menu.  They did have a soup, but it wasn't clear what it was exactly and I don't think it was even on the menu.  There was a sign on the register..."Try our Island soup". I didn't. Then I ordered some pok pok wings which are my favorite and they were on the on line menu so I at least I knew they still served them.  NOPE.  Don't have those anymore either.  So I went with the honey sriracha wings instead.  So I ended up with the Bang Shrimp,  an Order Of ribs, a pulled pork sandwich, their tuna Mac salad and the wings.  
The shrimp was as it was before.  Large shrimp flash fried with a light cream sauce drizzled Oder the top.  Still better than good!   But all else was a huge bust.  The previously tasty macaroni salad was bland and basically just mayonnaise and noodles.  The wings were really bad.  Tiny little pieces of chicken cooked to death in a sauce that may as well have been ketchup.  The ribs were discarded after everyone had tried a bite and the sandwich didn't get eaten after my good friend tried a piece of the pork.  It was one of Those meals that actually kinda ruins your day.  I had bragged to my friends about the quality of this restaurant and based on my review of it a year ago they were finally convinced to give its a try.  I'm thankful that I bought lunch that day cuz I woulda felt really badly had I convinced them to spend their own money on a lunch we really didn't eat.  We all shared he shrimp which were still great.... but after not having some of the thinks we'd wanted (even though the pok pok Wings we're still advertised) and what they did have was so bad...I won't be going back.  I never say that.  
Like I said before, there were a lot of people there so I think they'll be ok.  Just not for me.  The folks running the place were always really nice and offered pretty efficient service and I wish them the best.  I just felt it necessary to change my review of this place.  I have an image of someone reading my initial review and making their dinner choice based on my recommendation (ok it would probably never happen) but I thought i ought to update the review jus Incase.  After all, what's a review worth of it isn't up to date.  I can't count on all my fingers and toes how many fantastic places I've found by reading a positive review of it here on Yelp.

We have been coming to Shiroi Hana for over 15 years and this was our first time back since before Covid. Taking into consideration the challenges restaurants have faced, the meal was still disappointing. The waitstaff no longer greet you with a warm towel at your table. This may be due to Covid measures. Cloth napkins are gone. The menu was new. Gone were old favorites like the bento boxes. The my meal started off fine with miso soup, seaweed salad and tempura. The sushi was inedible, however. We had mostly tuna, eel and salmon and the  quality of the fish is poor. Even the water tasted like it came from the bathroom sink. The issues are too numerous and we will not be back.

Were visiting and found this Hawaiian place. The food was good but not super authentic. Their Mac salad was real deal but their kalbi and some of their other dishes were super sweet. A lot of Hawaiian food on the mainland is too sweet. We also tried their Bang Bang Shrimp. It was breaded, fried with a mayo chili sauce. Not really spicy enough for me. The portions were really big and the service was great.

What a disappointment. The last time I ate at Sketch was 2009 and  it seems to have gone downhill rapidly.

The staff seemed to be slammed the day I came and didn't really seem to care. I watched as two different tables left after not even being seen by the server.

Having a server doesn't make any sense since they just turn in a checkbox list into the cook. The service (when they did anything) was rude, short and not understanding.

On the plus side the fries were good. So was the burger. For the money and time it's not worth it, unfortunately.

Interesting concept and fun for families to participate in the family meals. I have been to their in kitchen sessions with my granddaughter several times and always a fun experience for both of us. With in kitchen sessions you can also adjustment the amounts and ingredients as you see fit for the dish. Also have ordered prepared meals that are put together by the stall. Most meals are very good. All in my family enjoy the food. I would opted for more than the represented servings to assure plenty for the family. Well worth the experience.

One thing I always miss from home (New York) is a good old diner where you get a nice burger and kick back. Sketch is worth the hype and reminds me of that relaxed atmosphere.

First, we started off with the burgers-he got the Cyclops and I got the vegan burger, and both of us were super happy with the large portion of deliciousness. My friend is a big burger fan and this was a win for him (even despite some busting of his chops by the owner!) There was a large portion of the fries, which I liked but I probably wouldn't get again. The green goddess sauce is super spicy and much tastier than the chipotle.

The best part of Sketch, though, is its milkshakes. After giving up dairy ~month ago, I had been looking longingly at regular milkshakes, spiked milkshakes, even McFlurries and Wawa milkshakes (I know). It's a thick, thick shake that's probably double the amount any normal person would intake of milkshake-you can definitely share with a friend. I had the vanilla cherry, which was basically a vanilla shake with cut up cherry. It probably was the best or near best of the milkshakes I've had in the past 5 years: that good. I'm so happy that Sketch is right off the MFL so I no longer can complain about the lack of milkshake in my life. 

If it's your first time, sit down and you'll get waited on (we and two groups after us made the mistake of going straight up to the counter). Also, if you're a bit put off by the somewhat 'hipster' vibe some reviews are talking about, don't be. The owner is super nice and the patrons ages ran from 20-75 when we went, so you won't feel out of place.

Makhani is a wonderful addition to the Old City restaurant scene.  It occupies a space that has turned over with different restaurants several times in the last year alone.  I hope Makhani enjoys wonderful success and occupies its space for years to come.

The food is all fresh and made on site.  Service was generally attentive and certainly welcoming.  I had Muglai, lamb in a thick nut based sauce. It was accompanied by rice, presented with a bit of creativity, and we ordered Nam the bread made on site, which arrived at the table warm.  

The owner welcomed us as we completed our meal.  The space is small enough that he may be able to greet all guests over the course of an evening.

I am a Luddite when it comes to Indian cuisine, but the menu looked pretty extensive to me.  Several dishes allow the guest to choose between lamb and chicken as the meat for a dish.

My wife and I really enjoyed Makani and we will return.  The reason for rating the restaurant a 4 rather than a 5, is that many Indian dishes are hot--we were asked whether we wanted our dish mild, medium or very hot.  We were served water, although our glasses were not refilled as much as I would have liked.  It would be wonderful, I think, if a bottle of water sat on every table.  This is a BYOB restaurant--we recommend beer over wine to accompany the meal.  The restaurant might also consider putting bottled water, carbonated preferably, on the menu.  Having a beverage always ready to address the wonderful "heat" of the dish would be a low cost, wonderful addition
It is a pleasure to recommend Makhni.

I usually go to Mama's BUT if I don't feel like driving the extra 3-4 miles, I'll go here from now on. I just went here a few days ago, and since teriyaki chicken is my favorite, I will order it. I get extra rice, but since I am hearing that the tuna macaroni salad is actually pretty good, I may have to include that next time I visit. 

I read in a previous review, yes, they have moved. They're next door to the carneceria next to the what used to be the driftwood, on 29th and Craycroft across the street from the Super 8 motel.
