Anywayyyys, you order your food at the counter, and then they will bring it to you at your table once it's ready. I get teriyaki chicken with extra steamed rice, any my boo thang gets the kahlua pork. It's the shredded pork, and I love how there is pieces of the onion and cabbage that's cooked with it, and I honestly don't remember what sides he got with it, but oh boyyyy it was all delicious.  They don't have the same chili at mama's but put a sriracha on it, and it is super tasty! 

I hate that I forgot to take photos, but I will update this once I go back which will happen soon.

Right down the road from the military base where I was visiting with my son. It is located right on the side of the road and I noticed the restaurant sign while driving by earlier in the week. I was hungry for hawaiian style food so I googled and this place popped up. Although the menu is small, their food is delicious.

Sorry yeeps, I'm gonna have to give this toss up to Mama's Hawaiian BBQ. The kalbi here was very lean and gritty, the kind of meat that makes you want to floss your teeth after eating. The portions were smaller in comparison. Also, they only serve one underwhelming dessert, pineapple ice cream. Spicy sauce available on command but it's only spicy for a teeny baby.

Now for the pros. My fiance had the chicken katsu and liked the texture of the thick panko batter. The musubi is delicious- fried spam on a bed of rectangular white-vinegar sushi rice wrapped in seaweed. The staff is very friendly, the manager even came by our table to ask if everything was going well. The parking lot is spacious, not gravel, and very accessible from Craycroft.

Sketch Burger is just that a little sketchy but serves good burgers. The burgers are a good size and fills me up for sure. I believe they have about ten to choose from. The service is usually great but did have an issue once when I walked in and had to leave even though it was an hour before they close. The lady informed me that it was too busy and they were sorry. I drove about twenty minutes to get there so was a bit frustrated but out of my control.

It's a cash only place where you get your own drinks. They had some sort of art concept there and can draw pictures on the paper they provide you and try and put it on the wall or take it home with you. They burgers range from $7.00-$-$9.00 but not including toppings and extra items. The drinks are around $2.00. They also have dessert there and thought it was pretty good. I believe they have a fair amount of milkshakes. The parking can be an issue in the area.
Best food I've had in the area in awhile!! Crabs were out of this world. Prices were affordable and service was great. The bar is kept clean and the crowd was fun.
Amazing food work close and food is always on point !!! Very friendly  staff !!! Been going here for years and always get that teriyaki chicken fix that I need lol !!

Came here for my first (and last) time today and ordered a Buffalo chicken wrap. I wanted it in a tortilla, it came in a lettuce wrap. Really not a big deal. Quick and easy fix to throw it in a tortilla which the female employee kindly did. When she brought it to the back though to switch, the maskless male employee literally yelled "what's wrong with it?!" then looked up at me. When she told him I didn't know it came in a lettuce wrap instead of tortilla it appeared he said bulls*** and went back to his phone. The place was completely empty so not sure why something so minuscule warranted that sort of reaction. Food was ok, nothing special.
Probably the best traditional Japanese food in town. Quiet with calming music. I love the black miso cod. I have been here many times and will return and recommend it to friends.

Finally got around to trying Sketch. I have to say, I was a little bit disappointed, mostly because I think my expectations were set very high from all these great reviews. Don't get me wrong, everything we had was alright, but I wasn't blown away by anything, especially for the cost ($30.00 for two burgers and one order of fries?).

Anyway, I ordered a ground beef burger with mushrooms, grilled onions, pepper jack cheese, avocado, and chipotle sauce. My husband got a ground beef burger with grilled onions, cheddar, and green goddess. Both of our burgers were overcooked. There was no pink in them at all, not even in the very center. I also couldn't taste the sauce on either burger. That being said, the roll was fantastic. Definitely the best part of the burger itself.

As for the green chili cheese fries, which I only ordered because everyone was raving about them... they were ok. I asked for the cheese sauce on the side, and even though the woman taking our order wrote that down, somehow when we got home the sauce was all over the fries, which made some of them very soggy. Ignoring that issue, I didn't really find the cheese sauce to be too special. I actually thought the fries themselves were really delicious, and if I could do it over, I would get a small order of fries (for half the cost) and some other dipping sauce on the side.

At the end of the day, it was an OK burger. (If you want a delicious burger, try Union Jack's in Manayunk.) I probably won't be going back, simply because the cost was ridiculous for what you actually get.

My brother and his wife had their rehearsal dinner here and it was the first I had ever heard of this place.  It's a really cute and cozy sushi restaurant and they have a pretty diverse menu. We were able to satisfy everyone from the die-hard sashimi eaters to the vegetarians and the "I don't eat raw fish"-ers.  All in all the food is good, fish is fresh and service was really on point. If parking wasn't such an issue for me, I think I would be back more often.

I love the service here. The owner happened to help me. Today's special is foot long for $6.99. I was happily surprised that they have gluten free option here.  And even happier that she threw it in so I could try it out. It's delicious for it to be gluten free!   And very generous portions. I believe that it's longer than a foot long!  They even have a few wraps available. Veggie and seafood options. I'm definitely returning. they make their bread daily there.

I was also told that those people who have tried gluten free from there, feel better afterwards compared to the normal breads. They only have limited supply of it daily. Once they are out of it, that's it. 

Would be an awesome place to cater from.
I ordered a14" pizza crunchy I got a soggy crust(bottom). Really changed the definition of a pizza. I ordered thru Uber so no refund at the store.

One of the best Japanese Sushi bar restaurant in Philly that did not break the bank account!

We were completely surprise with this restaurant, we were expecting that this place is just another Americanized Japanese restaurant. But lo, from appetizers to main entrée the dishes are simply epicurean.

We started of with traditional miso soup to warm our stomachs, we then served with Hamachi Kama a delicious Yellowtail and Salmon collar and Salmon blossom salad with crawfish and seaweed paired with hot bottle of house Sake. For main entrée I decided to have Chirashi served with sushi rice.

All in all, it was a lovely dinner while visiting Philadelphia. Dishes are fresh, flavorful and as I've said, it was reasonably priced.

Im too full to type.

Stopped by Sketch in Fishtown and figured I'd find out what all the burger buzz is about.  Love Canvas, -sure gotta say that the way rap singers thank Jesus on awards shows right? it's true though.

Figured, ok, might as well go for the gold.  I ordered a Kobe beef burger for $9.60 and a bottle of water to wash it down = just over $11.  

But that's not all!
no.  There's more!

I was considering the sauces to choose from and went with the first, the Harissa Aoili, which the nice girl at the register recommended and when I went looking at the cheeses, she admitted it really doesn't need it.  Im glad she was honest because she was dead on right.   So I grab my bottle of wooder and sit down for my 20 min wait.  (made fresh, whatta ya want, fast foood? well golly, no.)  Ok, so it arrives with a smile to my table and oh yeah it's surrounded by a mote of cheese balls.  Oh, I didn't need them, I ate em though.  

VERDICT: best damn burger I ever had.  Really.  I heard people say such silly things before but I knew it was just BS.  Now this damn burger turned me into one of these over dramatic exaggerators!  

The rumors of the ecstasy shake piqued my interest but my gut is happy I went with the bottle of wooder.  Next time perhaps.

I wanna go back and see what the Smashed Onion Burger is about, but doubt the Kobe will allow me to cheat on it.

I didn't know that a mortgage broker could be such a positive part of buying a house.
Tom was:
-unreasonably fast in replying to questions. I don't think he sleeps.
-thorough. All conversations were followed-up with an email. Emails were followed-up with a phone call.
-knowledgeable. Tom knew more about renovation loans than the people who handled them professionally. I'm not joking.
-involved. He came to my official signing just to be there to answer any questions that I might have. Mortgage brokers don't do that.
In short, if you call Tom, your house-buying experience will be better.
went there for an Italian style pork roast as per their website. Was treated like crap. Ps-they do not carry it. Never again.

Best vegan/veggie burger in the city! I eat mine with the bbq sauce and avocado but they have an assortment of excellent toppings and sauces to choose from. 

The service here is always great, staff are friendly and helpful. I love the variety and the specials board that changes often. 

Supplying diners with construction paper, crayons and markers always gets extra points in my book. 

Overall, Sketch is delicious comfort food that you can feel good about eating.

I've been here about four times so far and every time I go I have a great time. The food is really good, prices are reasonable, people there are friendly and they have a pool table as well. I def recommend you try them out. They are one of the better bars around.

Checked their website yesterday and saw they were open until 9. Took the 20 minute walk over around 6, and when we arrived, there was a handwritten sign on the door noting they were closed. Anecdotally, a passerby let us know they had been closed for the last month - so something "sketch" is definitely going on (funny? no? maybe? k...). Don't bother stopping by until they confirm they've reopened.

How did I not find this place sooner??! All of the dishes I have had are amazing! Not to mention the pricing and the portions are perfect. All of the menu items come with detailed descriptions and cooking methods. I literally can not say one bad thing about any of the dishes and sides I have gotten. Dinner Done makes dinner easy but still super tasty!

The Best Burger Ever!!  If anyone thinks they can top this burger, send name and location.  Epitome of bomb!!  The ayatollah of burgers!!  Milkshake was on point!  This just blew my mind it was so good!  Friendliest service!  Gave water to tired dog on sidewalk, really sweet!  Con: parking, that it's also the only place to get this burger!  They need to expand!

Ordered several times and each time was missing something and today was the worst.  Ordered 2 K e cheeseburgers and received one plain burger, no fries.  When calling and asked what happened, their response was we were busy and it fell through the cracks.  Waited an hour for delivery only to be left hungry and frustrated.

I forgot to write a review. I should have a long time ago. A few of us were on a work related trip a few months ago. We were not familiar with the area, but happened to be close enough to drop in for a quick bite to go. Without going into too much detail, I was pretty blown away with how good the sandwiches were. And whoever was there that day was super nice to us. We came back the next day and did it all over again. Altogether, I had the turkey club and the Experience. Both were really good. However, the Experience is probably one of the best tasting sub style sandwiches I have had. I would definitely recommend this place. And if you don't mind a little spice, I would definitely recommend the Experience.

This is the best place for hot dogs and sausages. The prices can't be beat. Their hot dogs are the best I've found anywhere. They usually have good deals on sausages. I've had their kielbasa, linguica, and andouille sausages. All were delicious. The staff is a great help to picking out the meats. They also have steaks, pork, chicken, etc... 
You can also get those meats from the Amish in Reading Terminal and it will be just as good. But you must get your hot dogs and sausages here! It won't be as good anywhere else in Reading Terminal.

Wow, Westshore Pizza was definitely remarkable. The ambience is lovely. Pretty much every item that we have ordered was very fresh and tasty. Staff is really helpful and will help you with anything. I'll definitely be returning in the near future.

Amazing food and amazing atmosphere. Such a helpful and friendly staff too! I have been here multiple times and have always been impressed by their food. The fish is so fresh! The Sushi Heaven is a great assortment that I will definitely be back for.

Hands down the best sandwiches in Tucson! The homemade bread is delicious and there is such a great variety of yummy fillings and options. The owners are so friendly and hardworking, they deserve all the success they can get. We'll definitely be back!
Awesome selection of quality meats, and great sausages of ALL kinds!!! Friendly "philly-style" service and fair prices.

Where have you been all my life dinner done where have you been all my life?

I'm telling you this is a wonderful business. I just stocked my entire freezer for meals for the next week and a half for my family of six. I spent less than I normally would and it save me hours of time and time is not something that you can get back. I wish I would've thought about this business myself the food is amazing it's simple and easy the directions are clear and concise thank you dinner done for making our family less chaotic and much happier.

Hearty hearty Asian food... It's all meat and rice! The protein portion (pork chicken, shrimp, beef) is always super tasty and flavorful, and it mixed well with rice (choice of white or brown). The Kulua pork Is a bit fatty which is tasty. The bang shrimp is my favorite... Deep fried and covered in a semi sweet sauce.
You can get vegetables, salads, or beans as your sides too. I suggest calling ahead before driving down to the restaurant. Food is made to order so can take up to 20 minutes.

Everything so far has exceeded my expectation. I have bought two dinners so far in the last two weeks. They both were fantastic. The first was for a small dinner the second because it was so good we returned. I will definitely tell everyone I know.

Stopped in while getting tires at Wal-Mart, easy walk across parking lot.  Warm Welcome as soon as we entered, followed by some baseball talk which is always welcomed (I had on NATS WS Shirt). 
Ordered the "Experience" (1/2) and Wife ordered "Superhero" 1/2 Combo. I did a water & was given a full size cup which is always nice. 
My Sandwich was delicious, never had anything like it so it was an Experience, a good one !!! Bread  was toasted just right and the sandwich flavor was different in a good way. Definitely enjoyed it. 
Between the sandwich & sharing my wife's chips was full, and still capable of moving-LOL. I had a couple bites of my wife and hers was also delicious. 
Bathrooms were immaculate, and the seating area was spacious and also very clean
We were asked several times how was everything, and our trash was even removed as we sat & talked. 
While sitting there listened to the banter between customers & staff which was nice to see the relationship, seemed like Cheers. Will be back !!!
its a nice little neighborhood bar with pretty good food too.
Some of the best Hawaiian I've had in a long time. Teriyaki chicken and pulled pork was delicious. Amazing macaroni salad! Would recommend

Love this place.  I started using this food source to market with my clients and special events.  You will not be disappointed with service and quality.  The super hero is one of my favs.  Clean, friendly, delicious and best of it all so reasonable priced.  Keep it up !

If you don't take your Vac here for repair and routine maintenance, either you're Bill Gates's love child, or your're just insane. My old purple pet hair Dyson is still chugging along after 13 years and counting, thanks to these guys. Wish they were still in Dresher. 

Vacuums are expensive to replace, and smart to fix. You wouldn't throw away your car just because it needs a tune up or a single part replaced. Go here. They really know their stuff.

Cheap. Great Quality. The cheeseburger I had was very juicy and cooked perfectly. The lady who I think owns/runs the joint is a doll. Shakes are delicious and I'm wishing I didn't finish off the chocolate chunk cookie just now because having no more of that cookie has left a hole in my heart this |        | big. 

Another charming aspect is the decor. At your table is some construction paper, markers and crayons. Have at it. Decorate the wall. show me your feelings.

This place is a reminder that awesome food doesn't have to cost $20+ per person.

Went in last Thursday evening. Most of the place was reserved! Found a spot at the counter watching the sushi masters work. It was great! Dinner and a show! Had a green salad first then the vegetable tempura (oops, no photo)then finished with an entree of Bagel roll (cream cheese and salmon) and the tuna club (exactly what it sound like. Plenty of hot sake to wash everything down. The food comes fast so we were out of there in an hour on a busy evening. The place ended up being packed but not noisy. Everything is chill and orderly here. No loud talkers either. Score! Have been here three times in the last month and a half. Worth it every time. And you don't feel like crap afterwards!

I bought the Holiday cookies kit and It was amazing. Instructions on point and all the ingredients in there. The lady who helped me there was friendly with impeccable customer service skills. Love. Can't wait to try other other selections.
They did a great job, showed up on time and were very competitive with pricing.  I will call them again next time I need something done.
We used Cardinal for a patio and gravel work. Jorge was efficient, productive and professional. Very reasonably priced. I would not hesitate to use them again.
The food is phenomenal! It's a very popular place so being patient counts for double, but the wait is worth every single bite!

First of all the service is amazing, fast and friendly, they greet you right at the door! I had the Experience sub which was fantastic due to the fact that it's filled with hot chicken and jalapeños! Looking for a spicy sandwich, look no more. The menu is filled with so many healthy choices as well, and they have hot soup served all day! Try the clam chowder if you have a chance. Delicious. I'll be coming back again soon! Thanks Planet Sub.

this place may not look very big from the outside, but it does have quite a bit of space. I've never sat upstairs (might be reserved for private parties) but  gotta say it looks pretty cool there. get a table up there if you can!

There's a minimum charge of $7 per person but do not fear. It is of no challenge at all to meet that minimum. even if you share.

The entrees are served with soup/salad but I've also ordered the large house salad here. It is a lot bigger than the complimentary one they give so I'm happy. the Sukiyaki's delicious too! Definitely share it. The teriyaki chicken's pretty average and the i also like the bento  box which comes with ice cream at the end.

Come here for food all the time! I feel like a home chef whenever I make a meal from here! As a bachelorette living on my own, it's hard grocery shopping for one, and I'm not into meal planning. Everything just goes to waste. I can get a few entrees and sides for the next two weeks or so, and eat it over days without wasting food and produce rotting. 

The meals are delicious and flavorful! And made fresh. The recipes are unique. Like the pumpkin chicken lasagna they had last month. Divine

Just ordered from Cappy's. Best wings i have ever had. Crispy and meaty. We got hot and garlic parm wings. They were phenomenal! We also ordered broccoli bites, cheese fries, chicken tenders and fried pickles which were amazing as well. Offically my go-to place for wings!

Mr. Kace and Dr. Kaylee have truly created a gem of a service needed by everyone. They take their time to develop unique treatment plans based on one's physical situation and desired outcomes. In two short weeks into my treatment plan, Dr. Kace has developed outcomes that I didn't think was possible. I can now walk free from foot pain for the first time in years. Not what I was expecting, but it most assuredly delivered a much desired result! I am looking forward to continuing my personal treatment plan and would highly recommend anyone with pain to visit Navigate Chiropractic to see how the body can be healed through the spine and mind!

I should have known this would be a mediocre experience from the get-go. My husband was craving burgers and we decided to give Sketch Burger a try. We ordered take out and the person on the phone was pretty rude. He kept asking in an annoyed tone of voice if we were done ordering after each item (literally we had 2 burgers and 2 orders of fries). 

When we got there about 15 minutes after we called, we still had to wait another 30 minutes for the order. I had a turkey burger with green goddess sauce and hand-cut fries, and he had the truffle butter burger (second choice as kobe burger was sold out) with curry ketchup and cheese fries. The burgers were huge and greasy, as expected, but the turkey burger tasted dry and under-seasoned. (It really needed the sauce.) They skimped on my toppings which kind of stinks if you are charged per topping (lettuce, tomato, bacon and avocado).

My new favorite place to eat in Philadelphia! Everything is tasty! The cheese fries are my favorite. I really enjoy the variety of toppings and homemade sauces you can choose from to add to your burger.

Can no longer do this.

Years ago the quality was spot on, perfectly cooked and mouth watering delicious. 

You'd think Chicken Katsu wouldn't be a hard thing to make but again, this alongside most other offerings are getting continuously worse. Stringy meat, dry, overcooked. Can't do this anymore; expectations of a quality meal no longer exist. Not sure why, but the quality is clearly failing and the food being overcooked. The cold macaroni used to be to die for...

Sure hope the owner revisits the passion that once was established as a growing staple here across from the Base and would really like to see this place wake up and get back to the quality it used to provide.

The meal? Half of it went to the garbage can. Enough said.
Best sub place in Tucson! People are super friendly and nice all the time! Too top it off the buffalo chicken sub and chicken BBQ Subs are the best.

Came here on a recent Friday night. The place is classic and intimate. I liked how they don't try to be "trendy," the interior is just a typical nice sushi place. It's quiet and felt like we weren't actually in the city. 

Now on to the food - we got the wasabi shumai which was delicious and spicy. We also got a few rolls and some individual sushi pieces. Everything was really tasty and fresh with really good attention to detail - they topped the rolls with some kind of delicious spice and sauce mix. 

I would definitely come back here, but my only complaint is the size of the rolls. They were noticeably smaller than rolls at most other places. Definitely a little expensive for the small size. Still, good enough food that I'd return.
Chicken parmesan sandwich was on point 10/10 would recommend friendly staff and love the location design

Above average (by an inch) Japanese food in CC. It's close to my office so it's convenient at the moment. Special rolls are great, everything is pretty authentic. Atmosphere is cozy and the service is pretty prompt and efficient.

Bottom line: efficiency + consistency + convenience = 4 stars.

Dinner, 5:15, Wednesday, 15 June 2016
Here's what we ate together:

THE VEDGE BAR
A - Fancy Radishes - smoked tamari, avocado, pickled tofu, shishito - 90/100
B - Stuffed Avocado - romesco, pickled cauliflower, "fried rice," black salt - 90/100
Shared: Rutabaga Fondue - today's soft pretzel, yesterday's pickle, charred onion - 100/100

GRILL
A - Eggplant Braciole - smoked eggplant, Italian salsa verde, cured olive - 90/100
B - Grilled Seitan - horseradish, pickled celery, charred kohlrabi slaw - 100/100

THE DIRT LIST
A - Broccoli Rabe - black garlic tahini, pickled turnip - 90/100
B - Fingerling Potatoes - crispy, creamy Worcestershire (we ended up sharing these, they were really very tasty, but not unusual enough or wonderful enough to merit a 100 score) - 90/100

We were really busy this night, and not able to budget the time the restaurant deserved, for a more detailed write-up on our meal.  Also, it was a hot night, and a bumpy cab ride getting there.  But the food was exquisite, and neither of us, both dedicated omnivores, felt in any way deprived by the lack of meat or other animal products as a part of the meal.

Desserts were a chocolate bar and cherry cheesecake, 90 and 90 for both.  Our waitress was very friendly, smiling, and attentive - 100/100.

We also enjoyed a bottle of De Moor Vin de France Caravan Viognier, and shared some Tokaji of 6 puttonyos.  Nice accompaniments to our meal and dessert.

So averaging out the scores, 93/100 - great restaurant, great food, we highly recommend it to you!  The "tab" before tipping was $237.72 and we felt it was well worth the price.

Of the several sushi places I've been to in Philly, this one is solidly meh. It was fine, but not great. The fish seemed like it was watery, not very flavorful. I finished my food but wasn't particularly excited about doing so. The bathrooms were grody, there was water staining on the curtains upstairs.

Nothing quite annoys me like false advertising. Let's be clear. If your sign says you close at 7:30 then that should be the last service time you take. Post the last walk in somewhere so your not being misleading and untruthful. I can't walk into the Acme at 8:45 and they say we have customers in the store but we all have to be done by 9. You don't expect it with other retail shops so a nail customer shouldn't have to expect it either. My first time walking in and also my last.

This place is a life saver. To start, the fact that i can feed 3 of us a dinner entree for $12.95 is pretty incredible. It would cost at least that, probably more for the ingredients alone. We opt for the pre prepped pickup and go option, we haven't done the kitchen sessions yet. We sometimes take advantage of the monthly delivery to our door. 

Pre-prepped meals that are delicious & come with simple instructions give us back the time for shopping, prep, diversifies our meals and stops us from being bored with the same entrees all the time makes Dinner Done a five star in my book.
Been going for years. Best burger I've ever had! Massive variety of food and everything is great. Fresh ingredient, great environment, awesome service!

Cappy's has not only the best, but the most original menus in the city! Their wings are the best I ever had, and the prices are great. Recently had a steak, and it was cooked exactly the way I like it-- medium rare and flavorful. Their Mexican burger was also cooked to my liking, and I will definitely go back for more. I hope Cappy's keeps their new cook around for a long long time. Great food to go with cold beer and football!!
Great place for lunch! Lots of choices of Hawaiian food with plenty of side options. Only problem was that we couldn't try everything. Highly recommend!

Not a great place to watch movies. But when you live in Center City there are not great options within a close distance. The seats are not too bad. The crowd is young, dirty and loud. They do have many screens which play many different options at many different times.

Some of the freshest, most delicious sushi I've ever had. My boyfriend and I got only a few items, but they were all amazing:

Rock n' Roll roll
Snow crab California roll
Miso soup
Fried gyoza

I can't wait to go back!

We love their teriyaki chicken and bang bang shrimp. Sadly they no longer serve the island salad but it was to die for. 
Decent priced and fresh food.

Probably the best subs I've ever had, the bread is amazing, the chicken and meat are both delicious, the sauce, from Marinara to Chipotle, all good. Please give this a try, the owner Ceaser, is a great cook and even better with people, happy to have tried his art in subs. 
Also if you want to see what all of this is about, you need to get The Experience.
This place is great! I often go here when I don't want to wait in line. The staff is very knowledgeable and super helpful!

Just received this from Uber Eats and am beyond disappointed. Burnt  pizza and the garlic cheese bread is literally a hoagie with sliced cheese melted on it. I go to the one in south Tampa all the time and just disgusted with the product. Do better guys .

Great fries and burger. No heat and some crap rap station on. I felt like I was in north philly with power 99 playing some bad music.

I was the only person in there and ordered fries and a burger.  The fries came out first, way first, I finished them before my burger came out.  I knew this was going to be a problem since I ordered it rare.  When I got my burger it was MW, not rare.  It was still good and I was hungry, so I ate it.  I did show it to them and they apologized, offered to make another etc...  They handled it OK, it was a mistake.  But the rap and cold, blaaa.
Burgers have so much flavor and I love that it's mostly a la carte. Well done! I will certainly eat here again!

The subs here are amazing! The best grinder I've had in Tucson to be sure. The staff is amazingly nice and very friendly. I love coming here to get lunch, chat, and just an overall great experience. Speaking of The Experience, this sub on their menu is the best thing I have ever gotten from a sandwich. The sub is very well balanced and they definitely don't skimp on any ingredient on any of their sub, I've had about 6 different ones from their menue and everyone is bursting at the seams with deliciousness! I highly recommend anyone go here.

This is a really great burger place and something I am glad is in the neighborhood.  The burgers are huge so don't expect a small meal.  It is not just a flavorless mass of meat though, for that you will have to go up the road to Applebee's.  This burger tastes very good and will make you stuff yourself finishing it. The toppings and sauces for the burgers are all unique and tasty, you can also keep it plain if you like.  The milkshakes are awesome.  I haven't tried any of the vegetarian options or any of the non-burger sandwiches even.  They finally added a fry cooker so you can have a complete unhealthy trifecta of burger fries and shake.  There is also a vegan shake but at $7 it is a bit pricey.

Great food! I couldn't expect more from the food, or the service. We had Belgian fries with the garlicky aoili mayo which was spectacular. The only downside is the shortage on seating, if it's a busy night. We went on a Wednesday around 8 and seating wasn't an issue.

The food is ok - not great or mind blowing.  The convenience factor is huge, but I stopped using them because despite numerous requests they do not offer any entrees that use organic ingredients or even just antibiotic free meats. Yes, this would cost more, but myself and others would be willing to pay a little more for higher quality. Have you priced cancer lately? Numerous studies have touted the health benefits of eating organic produce and antibiotic free meats. I may not be able to do it all the time, but I'll do my best, so that means no more dinner done if they offer no clean foods. Food has changed greatly in the 15 years dinner done has been in business, but they have changed little. It's time to think of ingredients and the heath of the children and families we are feeding.
GREAT FOOD! Give them a try and you won't regret it. Everything was delicious, from the tuna mac, to the katsu chicken and the kalua pork. The "big" combos were definitely worth every penny as well.
the best pizza i ever ate i recommend this pizza for every one now known as big g you should eat this pizza it's bettter than other pizza

Great toasted subs and even better service. Super fast. We had the creamy turkey and the experience and both were excellent with fresh baked bread. Even the croutons for the Greek salad we had were fresh made.  They have fresh baked cookies too. Did not disappoint! Will be back!

Omg super delicious. My favorites are the teriyaki chicken, French fries and their ice cream is amazing. Not only is the food great but the management and employees are awesome. A great place for families for sure.
Better than Giunta's for meat. They give me the cuts I need in the amount I want. Support them. Very friendly staff, too.
First time to this restaurant. Food product was great as was the service. Owners are very personable and friendly. Wish we had one in CO.

I have had nothing but amazing food and experience here ! The food is amazing ! The meat is tender and juicy . The portion sizes are huge ! I usually get the pulled pork , teriyaki chicken , or the shrimp . So worth it ! Hours have changed due to Covid and they prefer you call in the order .

I discovered this place on social media and decided to give it a try. The office was very warm and inviting. Both Doctors are awesome and on point with their ability to locate and realign your spine through subluxation. It's totally amazing as my wife And I are skeptics. These doctor's are definitely on to something !! Believe, because it is very real the healing process !

Absolutely love this place.  We no longer live in Tampa, but when we did Dinner Done was a monthly stop.  My husband and I always made enough picks off the menu, split them in two, and had enough for a months worth of meals M-F.   We always found the portions to be sufficient and served them with a side of veggies and a starch.  I have even gifted certificates to friends still residing there.  And no we are not millennials.   As far as the organic goes, that might be a plus, but certainly not required.  Their model is pre-prepared food not specialty foods.  That would have to impact the price.  Since I've only seen one complaint in this area, I think it would probably impact traffic to the negative.

As usual, I'm always one of the last to try really good places to eat... Even though I was given a heads up possibly a year ago that this was the best burger made in the city, I didn't exactly rush over. 
I stopped in for a late lunch one day. I took it to go, and was more than happy with what I eventually sat down to eat. This burger is not only massive, but it was perfectly cooked the way that I asked...
I went with just a burger with cheddar, bacon, and lto... I don't think I've ever had a burger that large turn out as moist as this one did. Cooked medium well, and I have to say that wherever these guys get their bacon, I wish the rest of the cooking world would use their supplier... Thick cut, and wasn't undercooked. 
The fries are hand cut and about as fresh as can be gotten... These are worth just stopping in and only ordering fries. 
There's also plenty of fresh baked cookies, cakes, and other items near the register...
This burger joint has easily made an impression for serving a great meal that is worth more than the money spent on it..
I used to live on Hawaii, and this place is as good as it gets! Can't believe it's in Tucson
I eat solid grains at least four times a week always consistent always delicious will keep coming back as long as I can see keep up all the good work guys Tony from Audi!
Pizza Hut buffet still. Pizza taste horrible . Other locations better.  These pizzas literally catch flies

No idea why people go here. The dudes heating up the slices are so rude, the pizza sucks and the Cheese steak was a nasty. Onion rings oozed of oil. 

Seriously this place is a dump. Only thing good is the TVs with sports the rest sucks.

If I were to grade the pizza on a scale of 1 ton10 I would give it a 2. Simply because it's not the pizzas fault it sucks so bad. Save your time and money and go somewhere else.

Hard pass

My wife brought home to Seattle a 6 lb collection of Martin's Italian sausages and I have to say, it is some of the tastiest and juiciest Italian sausages I've ever experienced.  Great work folks, we'll be back again soon. 
P.s. My wife also said the service was excellent and the counter man was very helpful and knowledgeable.

Added: 12 Jun 2017 dug out a pack of Martin's sausage from the fridge today to use for breakfast. It was labeled with only Jalapeno in cursive, OMG it was killer good, it was actually Chicken Sausage with Apricots & Jalapeno Peppers. I don't think I would have bought it normally without trying it out first but as a surprise, it was incredibly delicious. We'll be back for more on our next trip. Great stuff guys!!

I love my neighborhood bar. They have great food for cheap including buy one get one crab legs on Tuesdays! Daily specials. Pool table, outdoor tables, and megatouch game which I love. Nice people and I can walk home if needed.
Passing through Tucson and decided to grab something different. Stopped by Planet Sub. Great idea! Subs were awesome!! Staff was super nice and friendly!! Definitely will come back here.

Love this place so much! Not sure where to start. Dr. Kaylee and Dr. Kace have transformed my body through their amazing care of my back. I have always been hesitant to go to a chiropractor because I wasn't sure if it could help me and was afraid of being pressured into treatments that would be costly and ineffective. Immediately, Dr. Kaylee, Dr. Kace and their staff put my mind at ease. I could tell that they were super compassionate, kind and extremely knowledgeable. They were patient in explaining chiropractic care in a comprehensive way while also offering prices that are super reasonable and lower than what I have found. I originally came in with neck and back pain and frequent headaches and now I have been living pain free with only the occasional headache whereas my pain in the pst had me taking ibuprofen like candy. But that's not even the biggest part of my healing although I am SO HAPPY to be rid of my pain. I have always had a hard time being able to breathe deeply--since I was a kid. It has been my normal for most of my life and so I didn't even list it as a concern but literally within two weeks, I could breathe deeply! It blew my mind and made me cry happy tears that I could actually breathe like a normal person. I also have been able to get rid of my plantar fascitis from their care and my mobility has made running and working out so much better!!!!! I cannot recommend Navigate highly enough. I have such respect and love for each one of the Navigate Team members. They have changed my life!!!

Consummate professional. He is thorough, reliable, personable, and very helpful. He was with me every step of the way and explained everything. I highly recommend him as I've called around for lenders in Tucson and I am so glad that I stuck with Tom. Will definitely use him again and again...

Probably my favorite sub place! Their bread is made in-store and it's soooo good. I get "The Experience", perfect sub for pepperoni lovers who also like an extra kick with jalapeños. Subs always come out hot and made with care. The owners are so nice and make time for conversation.
My Kalua pork was soupy and a bit bland... and no poi?? Ugh, I was so disappointed. The spam musubi was decent, so that was good. Still searching for authentic, excellent Hawaiian food in Tucson!

I love this place. I had never gotten a spray tan before but I got the membership and was so impressed with how easy it was and how well the tan ended up turning out. It was a great color and looked nice all week. I love the membership and all of the staff at this location have been so friendly and sweet! I highly recommend.

The wings were flavorless and with a half cup of butter in the container. The pizza was decent at best but only had enough cheese for a medium, to bad i had a large I guess. I called to ask if this was normal for the wings and the actually told me yes!! This is the best they can do? It would probably help if anyone there cared enough about their food to try a new recipe or maybe taste wings from somewhere else. Try New York New York.

Nice laid-back little burger place.  Lots of options for burgers and for toppings.  Pretty impressive vegan burger, although not outstanding.  Fries are gooooooooooooood, and you get so many,

I love ordering off a checklist.  And drawing.

I'm Polynesian so my family and I really appreciate island-style restaurants in Tucson. This place has all the staples like kalbi ribs, katsu, mac salad, rice, and even spam musubi. So far we've tried the pulled pork, ribs, katsu, shrimp and siracha and bbq wings.. The pulled pork is pretty good (I'd say Mama's is a little better) but the wings, katsu and shrimp are AMAZING! These are what keep us coming back.The tamarind bbq was especially a hit. 

They also have pad thai on their menu (have not tried this yet) and it looks like they are adding pho soon. 

This place is a regular dinner spot for us and is great for dine-in or take-out. We are always satisfied with the food quality and taste.

We arrived today and we met the owner on our way in, who was super nice. They were actually already closed, cleaned up and ready to go, then owner let us come in anyways and order and eat inside. We got the experience sub and it was really good, prices are very good as well. All the employees we interacted with even though they were closed, showed great hospitality. My family and I Will definitely come back.

I ordered the 2 meat large plate with the barbecue chicken and kalbi beef. Normally in Hawaiian restaurants that I've been to, the chicken is usually cut in large pieces, maybe 3 pieces and served. In this restaurant, they dice the chicken into many different sized pieces. The result is that a quarter of the chicken was overcooked and tough. My fork couldn't pierce some of the pieces! The rest of the pieces were decent. The Kalbi short ribs were decent as well. Not too tough nor too overcooked. Good flavor. The Macaroni and rice sides were tasty, with good portions. 3/5 because of dry chicken

Shiroi - how I've missed you.
The sushi chef who knows me "by face".
The older waitress who brings me genmaicha.

The incredibly fresh sashimi.

I miss it here so much!  I stop in whenever I can - which is about once a year now.

Best Sausage in Philly! 

I have never had sausage taste so good. This is worth the trip, and the variety is impressive. I have also tried and really like their Kielbasa. I highly recommend any of their products. The employees are very helpful also!

One of my favorite Japanese places in Philly.  Shiroi Hana has been around for a long time, and in the 20 years I've been going here, I've never been disappointed.  The food is great, especially the katsu, and I enjoy the house sake.  Prices are about on par with other Japanese restaurants in the city.  Service is curteous and responsive.  They do sometimes have a problem with seating, however, and stopping by without a reservation might lead to you waiting for a bit for a table at peak times, but the wait usually isn't too long. I've never had to wait more than 10 minutes at most.

Over priced, small portions. $30 for chicken Katsu (fried chicken over rice). I ordered veggie tempura and got a the brown outside piece of the onion. $9 of tempura, some of it not edible. Not worth it, never again!

A once a week staple. 

Martins...where do I even start! The meats and sausage are fresh, the service is quick, and the friendly staff are quick to explain their favorite preparation methods.

Top sausages:
Buffalo chicken
Broccoli rabe and sharp provolone 
White wine and garlic

Easily freeze and thaw for a great meal!

Tucson is lucky to have this gem, right outside of Davis Monthan AFB. It has a cult following, you cannot find a better classic Hawaiian plate lunch in this state. I'm convinced of that because we went to Maui recently and some of the most hyped up plate lunch restaurants there weren't as good as Solid Grindz. The staff is awesome and prices are great. The Kalua Pork and Teri chicken with the Mac salad are my fav!

I uber eats wings from here at least 3-4 times a week. Amazing! Every flavor! But my favorite is the Cajun. Lots of seasoning. Not breaded. Well done to my liking. Truly a diamond in the rough. How have I lived in Mayfair for so long and not discovered them sooner??? If you like reales wings but hate the crowd, order from here, down the street.  (Never been inside here though.)
Top notch burger from a cool hole-in-the-wall joint. The truffle burger was one of the best burgers I have ever had. 5/5 would inhale again

Seriously. 
Sooo good! 
and juicy! 
and huge! 
and the belgium fries too? 
oh mannn don't even get me started on the milkshakes. 
basically get whatever you want,, everything is good,, 
from the vegan to the Kobe,, it's all under $10 and bigger than your face and tastes good as a leftover at 5am when you can't find anything else in your fridge you'd rather eat. 
there's other stuff too. like those awesome sauces, hotdogs, cheese puffs, homemade sides and pastries...
nuff said
Wonderful food. Not fancy, it's simple and done perfectly.
Excellent Mexican food. Our waiter, Henry was outstanding, quick, and polite. I recommend the chicken poblano and the watermelon jalapeño margarita. One of my favorite restaurants in town.

Macayo's was pretty middle of the road as far as Mexican places go. Interestingly enough I've had a hard time finding genuine, tasty Mexican food in Tucson. Anyway, this place is a solid "acceptable."

The food was all right. On the food alone, I probably would have gone with two stars, but the service was good. I liked the guy. God, there is very little to say here. One of us got a shrimp dish, which contained all of three shrimp. That's about all I remember.

Very fresh and delicious subs! They make the bread fresh daily and you can see it being made in the background. Very nice dine in sports themed place.
The subs are huge for a good price. They los the ingredients and meat. I wasn't expecting much but was really surprised on my first bite. 
If you're in the mood for a good quality sub, i recommend to come here for a taste above.
Ordered delivery from this place, was not impressed. I got a rainbow roll which is mediocre. My friend's chicken teriyaki is over cooked and way too sweet.

Amazing burgers! First we got giant onion rings with delicious aioli and chipotle sauces on the side. We also ordered fresh cut fries with a side of chipotle and wasabi sauces. For our main meal, I ordered a regular burger with aioli sauce and cheddar cheese. My boyfriend got the Nashville burger (it was a special) and it had jalapeños, pepper jack cheese, and chipotle "crispies." Delicious, made exactly to our order, and did not have to wait long for any of the food. Also we both ordered milkshakes (super yummy!). He got moose tracks (special) and I got chocolate. Both thick, but we were given wide straws and spoons. Great waiters and cool atmosphere. Loved drawing as we waited for our food  We will be coming back soon!

Nothing pisses me off more then when you order the sushi plate and they put a GD EGG as one of the pieces.  Also, I happen to hate mackerel, so if I ever want to substitute, I GET AN EGG.  gahhh!
This is another one of those "meh, it's close to the office" restaurants, but for the money and non-awesomeness, I'd rather go hit the Bellevue food court for a pre-made roll for $4.99.  Seriously.
On several occasions, I have actually spit a piece out - you know when you just KNOW something isn't as fresh as it should be?  Their sashimi portions are Raw sized, as well.

It was a lazy Monday and I wanted something cheap and filling. I wasn't disappointed. The sub was amazing and fresh as well as the salad. It wasn't too greasy and the salad was perfectly tossed and seasoned. Whenever you want something that fills you up and spurns your guilt, this is a good place so start!

Ordered some items from their website that were "Guaranteed delivery by Christmas". As of 12/29 and after several phone calls prior to Christmas, was told today that the order is scheduled to ship mid January. No adjustment offered or authorized except to cancel order for refund. Horrible customer service and false advertising! Do not recommend!!

Love the variety of sausages. All the ones I've had have been so delicious. Usually comes out to about $1.50 per sausage depending on the per lb price. Highly recommend the Pork Sausage with Soy Sauce and Green Onions and the Cheddar Brats! I've still got dozens of other sausages to try and can't wait to try em all.

Excellent doctors & super professional. 
They offer chiropractic services for children & adults.

WOW---this place is GREAT.

I keep "light kosher," so I will eat the right foods at many restaurants. I avoid pork, Shellfish and non-Kosher meats. .I also do NOT mix milk and meat. I was there3fore limited at SketchBurger, ,but I had MANY choices---veggie, vegan and Kosher (e.g their jumbo kosher dogs . This place is a HOME RUN. I do wish that they took credit cards, but I can accommodate.

Delicious foods and nice surroundings. Near I-95. Stinking Philly does charge an 8% sales tax and a 1.5 cent per ounce tax on sweetened drinks---SCREW THOSE CORRUPT SAVAGE Demoncrap pols!!

WIth those limitations, this place is a HOME RUN!!  MAYBE THEY COULD OPEN OUTSIDE THE CITY---less taxes and a MUCH better government.

Go to Sketch burger. I am a great chef, but I couldn't make a better product at home---my test!!

Fun Fact: I used to work at the original Westshore Pizza location on Westshore Blvd. If anyone knows anything about Westshore Pizza, and what to expect, it's me. Westshore Pizza founder, Bob Vasaturo, was known as "Big Bob" and I was called "Little Bob", even though we weren't related. Bob did quite well for himself and franchised the Westshore Pizza brand all over the Tampa Bay Area. If I recall, the location on Lambright was the 4th one to open. 

Even after my unheralded career at Westshore Pizza was over, I remained a true fan. After all, they do offer the best pizza slice and drink deal in town that includes two enormous slices of "Philly Style" pizza, with or without toppings, and a fountain drink for only $7. What is a Philly Style pizza, you ask? It's pretty much the same as a NY style pizza. A regular crust pizza, cooked crisp, in a stone oven.

Speaking of Philly, as long as you don't ask for wit Wiz, Westshore Pizza offers a pretty legit steak and cheese sandwich. Whoever I order one, I'll always add mushroom and onion. Sooo good! It is always more than enough to eat. 

Final fun fact. Don't ever go to Philadelphia and order a "Philly Sandwich". There is no such thing. Trust me, I learned this the hard way.

I received an estimate and scheduled an appointment to take care of these weeds. Jorge and his team were on time and did a great job. He sprayed for future weed prevention, said it would work for at least 4-5 month  Thanks Cardinal Landscsping
The food is really good and they have a great variety. The staff is very friendly. The bang bang shrimp is delicious!

We had Jorge and his crew here today to take care of our front yard. It was an all day job and they charged a fair price and did very good quality work. We will be having them back soon to help us with our backyard. They are great!

what a RIP-OFF...recently had dinner there with friends....watery salsa, stale taco shells, rusted lettuce, tasteless so-called margaritas  (I think they forgot to add tequila &TRIPLE SEC while shamelessly charging $6-10)further insult... rice-a-roni mexican rice like side dish...ugh...on EVERYTHING
Even taco bell has better mex food than this hole in the wall...
tell all your friends DO NOT ever eat/drink there

Cappy's seems like a chilled spot to be. Although when we walked in no one was wearing a mask, still it was super chilled. Good food and nice environment but I wouldn't visit the inside during covid season. Ordered crabs to go and they were pretty good. Can't lie, I enjoy more butter with my crabs but the broth was doable.

Located within a shopping center I have to admit I was a little weary lol but they offer specials that drew me in and parking is soo accessible.  Monday- Wednesday they offer mani and pedi for $30! and I believe gel mani and pedi for $40!  On a bustling Saturday a mani and pedi is $33 and they take card! You can make an appointment or walk in. They sterilize the tools and the pedicure sink was clean. They have a large, organized choice of nail polish to choose from including OPI. They seemed to have build a rapport with their customers and they create a comfortable and clean environment to keep you coming back.

This Hawaiian food is so so. Idk maybe  it's cuz I'm from Cali but I wasn't impressed . The macaroni salad had way too much garlic and not enough tuna. It also wasn't very cold . The meat was good but I wasn't expecting it not to be . I'm gunna look for other places and see if there's something better out there

I came to this place because I've been doing Doordash for the past few days because I just moved here & I have no friends. I got the steak n cheese sub on a recommendation & it was fantastic. It had everything you want a steak sub to have & was so big I could only eat half. What impressed me the most was the entire staff was friendly - knowledgeable -- gave everyone who walked in recommendations & they were all professional.. I would go in and ask Ceasar for his recommendation or the nice lady who works w/ him.  If I lived next to a planet subs, I would drive 20 minutes out of my way 2 goto this location because I felt like they truly cared about my happiness & its rare to see that the entire staff seems more like a family then some work place. I strongly recommend this location & from now on this is the only place I will buy my subs & maybe I'll see you there. Thank you.
I had the oat honey latte. I like stronger, sweeter coffee drinks, and I thought this latte was absolutely perfect. It's a really cool place with a lot of seating. The staff was very nice, too :)

GOOD LORD!!!! I could write all day about my first time here! Just got back like ten mins ago and it was very very good!  
Today was my birthday.  And my favorite thing in the world is trying new restaurants.  Even better when they are ....well...SOLID! 
My dining partner, best friend and girlfriend was on board.  I've written before how she is not into new food.  She likes to go to the same place and get the same thing she liked last time.  Well it MY  day so she agreed to try something new.
She had the Kalua Pork and I had the Bang Bang Shrimp. In the first bite she apologized for resisting the opportunity to try something new and absolutely loved everything. !!!!  It was way better than your average pulled pork!  Lil bots of cabbage and a tasty, but not too salty flavor.  They serve it w a hot sauce which I thought was excellent.  But every table has Soy and a house Teriyaki sauce. The teriyaki was also much better than average.  Not as sweet!   Well...onto the Bang Bang!
The shrimp were deep fried and served tossed in a creamy sauce but very little of it.  Slightly spicy and full of flavor.  Sides were good but the thing that stood out were the Beans!  Typical baked beans but just done better!  For one, they've achieved the appropriate level of creaminess.  They've got a nice, not too sweet flavor not usually found in BBQ baked beans.  But the real winner here....the little slivers of red bell pepper mixed right in.  The creamy texture is usually only attained by low and slow cooking, this often disintegrates any diced veggies added to the beans.  They must've added the peppers late in the game because there's still a nice crunch to them that sets this side dish off!  I can tell I've thoroughly enjoyed a restaurant when I can't wait to try something else I noticed on the menu.  Next time it's gonna be the ribs!  
The food was so good I've little ink left in my pen to pay tribute to the excellent staff.  It consisted of only two young ladies up front, and a few cooks in back.  You only need s few people when every one of them know what they're doing.  These people....knew exactly what was up. Everyone was so nice and fast and clean and just on point.  You could tell these kids were proud of their restaurant.  And they deserve to be. 
We will see y'all soon.  And everyone else in Tucson should too!

Decided on delivery with GrubHub when pizza finally arrived after an hour past time it was to arrive.   Pizza was ice cold, tough and hard to chew. They couldn't even cut it all way through.   Funny thing our dog spit it out and wouldn't even eat it.  Worst pizza ever had
All about Vacuums did it for a quarter of the price and did it faster.

Typical neighborhood bar with a pool table, food, and a dart board. Seems to always be a good crowd there no matter what day of the week it was.  I went there on a Monday (Don't judge!)  and there was no more seats!  They get a good crowd in there for sure.   
I found the drinks to be more expensive than their competitors.  Frankford Ave is full of bars so your prices have to be competitive.  
On Mondays,  they have a $1 miller high life special though which definitely draws in the crowd.  
I'll be back , I'm sure but if I never stepped foot in here again, I wouldn't be heart broken.

Authentic Hawaiian food that you will keep you coming back for more. They also have a food truck on base as well as catering. It is a family run business & we are good friends with the owners, Tap & Toni. Super sweet couple & they love what they do and getting to know their customers.

Simply the best butcher shop in the city! It's located in the Reading Terminal. 
The meat here is fresh. The ground sirloin is lean and flavorful. The breakfast sausage is the best. It's perfect with eggs and pancakes. The sausage, steaks and chicken are all excellent. 
The people are pleasant and helpful. They can help you pick a cut of meat and give instructions for how to cook it. It's reminiscent of the old time butcher shops.

Location: On Craycroft close to Golf Links. Was the old Modern Peas building. Can't miss it, the building is green!
The Skinny: Definitely go. Great Hawaiian Food that was fresh, tasty and moderately priced. 
The Restaurant: The restaurant used to be an Asian-style restaurant so remnants of its past were still present but don't let that fool you from the food. This is a fast-casual style where you order first at a counter then sit down and they bring your food. There is fountain drink control on the inside. I did not get to check out the restrooms to observe their cleanliness. 
Food: The food was excellent. We ordered a myriad of food including the Katsu, the pork, the chicken teriyaki and the wings. All was extremely fresh. I do wish the scoops of rice were slightly bigger but other than that, everything was excellent. 
Overall: It is a good place to eat, easy to find, prices were moderate and was visually clean. 
Should you go: Yes I would give it a shot. This place is nice to have as it competes with one of the well known Hawaiian places in town. 
Cost: For the Teriyaki chicken, pork, katsu, wings and three drinks, it came out to about $36. 
Tip: Get the Katsu, that one was my favorite
Kids: We loved the Chicken Teriyaki!

Some of the best toasted subs around! I love this place and cannot get enough of the Smokey Southwest Chicken sub. I have had the Philly, and Turkey, but when I try to work the menu and order different subs my stomach always lands on the Smokey Southwest Chicken.
Very very happy with these guys. Top notch service from start to finish.
Great outdoor coffee place. Lots of shade and fans. In between a great bakery and vintage furniture store. I tried the Florida man latte, it was great. The staff was so nice
Jorge had some problems with his trailer this week, but agreed to return next week at a reduced rate. I will update this review once the work is done.

5 star burger!  Came here on a week night, I heard this was an awesome burger spot, I personally liked the concept, and couldn't wait to draw something. Walking in, it was not what I was expecting, totally no frills. It was a little tight, you walk in seat yourself, the booths are a little cramped, we started out in a church pew booth, but ended up moving to a table with chairs.  It was cold inside, so we probably should have sat outside, it was a nice evening, but I rarely eat outside due to fear of bugs.  
The waitress, came over gave us the run down of how things worked, self serve drinks, board with specials, and another with desserts and milkshakes.  Mmmmm milkshakes, I originally had no plans on getting one but just her saying the word mad me instantly want one.  I mulled over the menu.. I decided to keep it simple, best way to see how good the burger actually is.. I went for the Kobe with cheddar, small fries w/ Aioli on the side and a strawberry milkshake.  
Ok now that my order was out of the way time to work on my masterpiece... Sorry to say, that after looking at all the cool art on the wall I entered a mental block, the intimidation was real, I would have enjoyed a coloring book but I guess it's not, coloring burger, sigh.. alas, my milkshake came.. it was decent, a little less strawberry tasting than I would like.  I grabbed a can of Dr. Pepper and started thinking about the burger.. My muse burger man! I started drawing... and out came the fries shortly followed by the burgers.  
I ordered a small fries but I guess they use the same container for both sizes, not a great idea, kind of looks like someone just wanted to cheat me out of fries.. might be a marketing tactic to get you to order a large next time, eh idk.. On to the kobe burger.. I got my extras (lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles, mayo) on the side, I just wanted to try the burger itself.. took the first bite Success! It was delicious! I fixed my burger with the right amount of extras and the aioli sauce which is truly amazing and enjoyed my meal! The fries were good I used the aioli sauce which I will say again was amazing.  I'll be back, I have another masterpiece idea brewing, the burger and aioli inspired me, lol.

FRIENDLY, VERY clean. Stopped by here for the first time while waiting for Walmart to finish my tires. If you're used to Subway/Jersey mikes etc, this is a whole different level of goodness that the others dont compare! I'll definitely be back. I had "The Experience" with my own twist of Black olives, mayo and mustard. The bread is Amazing. They really do care and have passion. I'll be back for sure

If you're working mom like me, can't cook, just busy or don't have time to food prep this is the place to be. A quick healthy meal for the fam is all I could ask for most evenings. Some of the entrées are even freezer to oven.

I give Dinner Done my highest personal endorsement. The meals have the directions and suggested sides and alcohol pairings, it's so simple my husband and teenager can even prepare delicious meals. 

They even offer delivery service in Tampa!

I ordered a large pepperoni pizza to go. The pizza was ready on time, and the lady assisting me (both on the phone & in person) was friendly and helpful. The pizza was hot when I got it home, with a good amount of cheese & pepperoni. 
I do wish they let me know of any specials they had. Once I walked in, I did see some signs, as I paid around $18.50 (after taxes) for my 1 large, one topping pizza... and I saw a deal for $26.99 for a large 1 topping pizza, wings & garlic knots - which I would have opted for if I had known. They also have some really good lunch deals! 
I'll be back.

BURGER ARE INCREDIBLE.  Potatoe fries are good and really everything I ate here is good.  The place isn't fancy but warm, the owner is very nice and been in the food industry for a while 
I recommend for a quick lunch.

This was the best burger that ever existed PERIOD.

BIG, FAT, CHEAP, FLAVORFUL, UNIQUE, VARIETY, you name it, it had it. The best burger ever.

I love Shiroi Hana. This two-floor Japanese restaurant is usually crowded to some degree, yet they manage to maintain fast service. They're not cheap, but they're worth a visit.

Their kitchen turns out some fabulous creations: I've had their Beef Teriyaki ($19; #24), broiled choice rib eye seasoned and served with teriyaki sauce. Mmmm. A special I've tried of theirs is the "exciting" Japanese tray (their words, not mine - it's a bento box) served with shrimp shumai, miso soup, a ginger salad, rice, and a scoop of ice cream for dessert. I've also experienced their Ume ($25), an assortment of four fresh pieces of sushi (tuna, white fish, salmon, and shrimp), a California roll, aromatic chicken teriyaki, and shrimp tempura. Tempura was blah, but everything else is tasty.

We are visiting from out of town and was excited to find the food court at The Bourse during our walking tour today.  The experience was less than stellar to say the least.  The two people working were both sitting at the bar on their phones when we walked up.  I ordered the biscuits and gravy with hash browns and scrambled eggs. The biscuits were hard, the gravy was okay but not that warm, and I ordered scrambled eggs but received an omelet instead.  The person with me ordered the baconcakes which sounded amazing and was extremely underwhelmed with the end product.  This is definitely not somewhere I would frequent if I lived here and it is definitely somewhere I would not recommend to others.

Jorge and his team of landscaping ninjas blew us away with their professionalism and the sheer volume of amazing work performed over the course of two days. They completely transformed our multi-acre property that was looking pretty shabby after the record monsoon rains of 2021.

The place looks amazing. Highly-highly recommended, and I cannot imagine hiring anyone else for landscaping services!

I have been back to Sketch several times since my first review over 2 years ago. It is one of my go to places for a burger or just to bring guests from out of town because it is such a unique and cool little restaurant. Sketch is easily my favorite spot for a burger right now as the quality, taste, bun and price top my list. 

After my first couple of visits I started exploring the menu more:
- The Lamb burger is excellent and Sketch changes their specials pretty frequently. They are usually changing up some of the sauces or ingredients on the lamb burger.
-The Belgian fries are outstanding, possibly the best fries I have ever had. My niece from Paris agrees and she knows her French Fries. Get the large fries and try the dipping sauces.
- I am not a big fan of the Green Chili fries. They get heavy and soggy.
- The grilled Chicken sandwiches are also very, very good. So is the pulled pork sandwich with Sketch's homemade buttermilk biscuit! Wow.
- The milkshakes are worth every penny.
- The warm brownie dessert with ice cream is big, delicious, and reasonable. Easily can be shared. We currently top it with the Green Tea or Cinnamon ice cream.
- All their baked goods are very good also.

We try to come during off hours and we have been lucky with not waiting for a table or finding parking on Girard. The staff has been friendly and attentive. I love this place!

Cash only.
Waited 40mins for onions rings that came out to me like this. Not sure what is going on but it's definitely not how it used to be

Dinner Done! is absolutely amazing! This is our second month purchasing meals from them. I work full time, have a horrible commute, a family, and also working on a Master's degree so preparing dinner is really the last thing on my mind. I've used the delivery option and ToGo, both are convenient for me. The meals are prepared with fresh ingredients and are delicious! The menus change each month so you won't ever get tired of eating the same things. I love that my time in the grocery store has decreased too. Worth.every.penny.

Solid Grindz cooks up some really delicious Hawaiian BBQ. Ive tried most everything on the menu from their incredible pulled pork to their dynamite ribs and I gotta say, it's all great. A couple of my favorites include the Chicken Katsu and the Pork ribs. Each entree is served with white rice and some creamy delicious mac salad. The prices are very fair and you can get out with a 2 entree plate for just around $10. 

I will say though, the 3 entree plate isnt the best value. They use the same size container for the 1, 2, and 3 entree plates so you get less of each entree the higher up you go. 

Regardless, this is a happening spot for sure. The lines can be really long on weekdays during prime lunch hours (11-1) but worth the wait. Highly recommend!!!
Small business, big flavor. Popped in for a Sammy and had "the experience". Solid Sammy threat lived up to the name. Fast, clean, friendly service.

Best miso soup and unagi I've ever had. 

Their miso soup was NOT bland, meh, or salty. It had that lip-smacking/comforting chicken soup vibe. Hmmmmmm. Never thought I'd be impressed by miso soup. They MUST be using some pork neckbones alongside the bonito flakes ;)

The unagi was simply delicious perfection. Honestly, it's the only unagi I've had that tasted fresh vs like it was pre-seasoned and defrosted (OLD!!!!) teriyaki eel


The lean whitefish sashimi wasn't great, the plating was barebones and I didn't love the texture on the tuna. That said... the dining experience was pleasant, the sashimi servings were fairly generous and the price was modest/way reasonable for downtown. 

FYI bathroom is out the front door and upstairs=DON'T almost walk into the kitchen like I did!

This is a place that offers an interesting experience - each table is equipped with a set of crayola markers and construction paper. Prepare to draw!...hence the name. The walls are lined with diners' doodles. 

Sketch has good food. So-so service/holistic experience. I would come back again for a burger, now knowing what to expect. The food was a 4 and the experience/service a 2. I really want to give them a 4, but if I'm a guest of theirs and not my living room's, there are standards I expect...even for a casual burger joint.

During my visit, I ordered the truffle butter burger, cheese fries and a chocolate milkshake. The truffle butter definitely came through. It's a dish you have to be in the mood for and once you're not, it's over. The burger came out medium rare, as ordered, and was tender. I would not do the truffle butter again...I like the taste of truffle, but it was confusing to shake up flavors I'm used to on a burger with flavors I expect on pasta. I recommend ONLY if you have a palette that doesn't mind mixing associations. Overall, I was glad I tried it and I'm glad they offer something different. The fries were good while hot. Milkshake was also good.

I didn't like that no one welcomed me when I came in and I had to figure out their procedure - seat yourself. Maybe I missed the sign, but a few others after me were wondering around, too. It's unclear from the get-go if they are going for fast food, or service environment.

Drinks at Sketch are in a fridge and you help yourself, also have to ask for water...which comes out in a small plastic cup. Don't like that they encourage buying from the fridge and don't provide water without asking. Don't like that the experience is half service/half help yourself. One way or the other, but not both!

Bathroom is crammed and dirty. It was locked out while I was there and it took 30 minutes of various customers going up and walking away for an employee to take care of it. Parking is on the street.

L.O.V.E. Dinner Done! The meals are so convenient (easier than the dinner boxes you can subscribe to now) and they taste delicious. The chicken ones are my favorite and seem to keep the best in my opinion, but I've gotten fish/beef/pork and it was all good. The side dishes are also good. It ends up being cheaper and healthier than eating out too. They should put out a cookbook sometime, the recipes are that good.
The Raquel is the best Margherita Pizza I've ever had. The food is so good and the service is great

A crooked business run by a young couple. Quite racist place as well. I was offered to pay $1200 upfront for 3 months treatment. An option of paying per visit was "not convenient" to process a transaction for this establishment.

The food here was fairly mediocre, not bad but nothing extraordinary. I had the pork katsu, which was slightly pricier than other places in Philly and I couldn't really taste the difference. The service overall was fine but I left feeling still hungry and thought the food was just fairly average.

Very nice staff and speedy service.   The Teriyaki chicken and Katsu chicken are both excellent!  Solid Grindz has been a regular stop for me to pick up dinner to take home.  We have also tried the Kalua Pig and the wings and everything has been great.

Saved my hide when we had a tree fall, taking out my sewer line and falling into the road. Showed up immediately, brought all the crew and power tools and got the job done beautifully. Cleanup was included. I hired him again to fix the hole and rocks and he did another great job. Highly recommended.

My favorite neighborhood sushi spot! This is perfect for takeout, as well as eating in. All of the staff members are fabulous and so sweet. The sashimi is always fresh and so good. My favorite roll is the naked tuna roll and the rainbow roll. The rock shrimp tempura salad is another favorite.

I am extremely disappointed in this place. My 18 year  old is looking for his first job we happened to pass by after he submitted an application so he thought it'd be good to go in and inquire about his application. The manager apparently was on the phone when he walked up to ask if he could speak to her since it's always best to talk to the management. She stated she was busy and pointed to someone else to speak to so he did and the other employee told him that since he had no baking experience that they'd have to pass. Well I always thought that at any fastfood place they would train, so I took it upon myself to call and ask their requirements. During the conversation the manager asked if I was speaking about the young man who had just came in and I said yes, she than commented that since my son waited to speak with her she felt it was invasive and rude. I am soooooo upset at that, this is my son's first job hunting experience and I taught him to always speak with management so that's what he thought he was doing. First off my son is extremely well mannered and has the upmost respect for anyone he comes across. So for her criticize my son that way is unacceptable, my son listened in on the call and felt disappointed and now is feeling upset with trying for new jobs. If this is the type of people that run your business then you have to rethink your hiring process

Been here twice: Two and half stars. I know it's hip to say "Sketch has the best burger in the city," but it's untrue. The burger, fries and milkshake were good the first time around. The second time, my burger tasted like somebody poured a quarter cup of salt into it. Never returned.
Pricey as all get out, also. $1.50 for cheese?! Then it goes up another $1.50 for bacon. No thanks ... The 'cool' kids can keep getting suckered by this joint.

Communication was great from the get-go, and Jorge fully discussed the job with me and even took a look at another tree after I mentioned it. Work was done very well and very quickly, for a reasonable price, and the clean-up left the yard looking like new. I will be using Cardinal Landscaping again and highly recommend them.

Wow! So this was the old Snow Peas combined with the new Solid Grindz...guess they kept either part of the old menu or a chef. Either way, the food is amazing!! Have had the teri chicken, the katsu chicken, the tuna mac, the island beans, and the bang shrimp..I can't decide which is best!  They've done wonders with some spectacular flavors, you have to get the bang shrimp, it's unbelievable!  Place is clean, staff is friendly, and it's usually packed at lunch, which is a good sign!  Can't wait to go back!

Friendly service, great green chilies cheese fries, and mediocre burgers.
Sketch is very casual with cool drawings on the wall from customers and friends. Small space with only about 7 tables.
Servers are super nice, quirky, and friendly. Tables are equipped with plastic utensils and napkins and drinks are self serve (bill you later).
Green chilies fries are amazing! So good. Tangy green chilies mixed into the cheese sauce. Bit of old bay on the fries. YUM
Burgers were underwhelming. First, they are very dense. Second, overcooked.
The beef burger was okay. Asked for medium, got well done. Patty is made of short rib, beef brisket, and beef, but honestly it may have well been a normal beef burger. There is a lot of meat though. Also forgot the aioli sauce.
The mushroom truffle burger was just okay too. I thought it had a solid truffle taste. Asked for medium, got well done. Not sure, but thought all burgers come with lettuce and tomato, which was missing.
Overall, Decent place but I wouldn't go out of my way.

This gem was my saving grace while we were on a road trip from Texas to Cali. Excellent service. Great suggestions for a first timer. We got a Greek salad, the veggie sub and built a sub of our own. Everything was delicious. The bread was fluffy and the ingredients were super fresh.
Solid Grindz is a solid spot to grab a bite. I always go with the chicken teriyaki and bang shrimp combo. Perfect for family or a quick business lunch.  You can't go wrong with Solid Grindz.

Skip it. The sandwiches are mediocre. The bread is soooo yeasty, it's almost bitter. It feels like a hole-in-the-wall place trying to look legit. The service is super friendly, almost too friendly as to be oppressive.

The meat is low-quality and the sandwich is mostly bread. I wish I had something positive to say, but I won't be coming here again.

Jorge and his team of landscaping ninjas blew us away with their professionalism and the sheer volume of amazing work performed over the course of two days. They completely transformed our multi-acre property that was looking pretty shabby after the record monsoon rains of 2021.

The place looks amazing. Highly-highly recommended, and I cannot imagine hiring anyone else for landscaping services!
