Omg! Came back to Shiroi after nearly 7 years and they treated us like celebrities.  The tuna lovers plate ($42, includes 2 pieces of chu-toro), naked tuna on crispy rice, oshi-tashi with bonito and succulent salmon tartar were all sheer perfection.

Swimmingly fresh.

Fabulous service, nothing "shi-shi" or hipster or fancy, just amazingly good sashimi, nigiri and maki.

We love you and sister-restaurant Doma, too.

Run, don't walk, to Shiroi Hana today!

Best decision I've made. I was suffering for 2 years with numbness in my arm and lower back pain. Within a few visit I had total relief without surgery or medication. So grateful for Dr. Kace & Dr. Kaylee. I look forward to my adjustments very week.
My go to butcher, located right in reading terminal markets.  Quality choices of meats, friendly and helpful staff.  They even cut meats to order.

Solid Grindz totally has awesome Hawaiian food. My fave is their bang shrimp and kalua pork combo with a side of mac and rice...the kalbi is def worth the try as well! Pre-covid they had a food truck and brick and mortar location but currently the actual restaurant does only pick up...they were pretty good about social distancing with clear markings on the ground or if it's more convenient/safe you can wait in your car as well. Another thing worth a try is the spam musubi, which you can get 3 for $10... the food may seem a little pricey here but if you're super hungry and craving some well-prepared Hawaiian comfort food, Solid Grindz is the spot!

A & J were the first to respond for an estimate for replacing my 18 year old noisy drip timer that was keeping me awake at night. I could hear it through my bedroom wall and it was driving me insane. Jorge showed up promptly, assessed the job and bid a fair price. He then selected an excellent replacement and installed it in a quick and professional manner. Jorge made a great impression and I am very satisfied with the job that he did. Thanks Jorge!

This is the nicest Salvation Army I've ever been in. Tons of furniture available. Nicely organized home goods and neat finds. The clothes are organized by style and color. I just wish they were organized by size, too (maybe I just missed a sign). The staff was really friendly. The place was clean, too.

Best Hawaiian food on Tucson? Probably! 
I'm not an expert but this place is pretty darn good. 
We arrived just before the lunch rush so I ended up ordering the 2 meat special. I ordered the chicken katsu as well as the teriyaki beef, along white rice and the salad. The food arrived quickly, we were grateful because we were starving! 
The chicken katsu was hot and fresh, the outer exterior crunch and the chicken nice and juicy. The teriyaki beef had a good flavor, others may have wanted more teriyaki sauce but it was perfect for me as I don't like it too sweet. The rice was hot and perfectly sticky. The salad was also unexpectedly good! Not sure what the green sauce/salsa was to put on top of it but it was yummy! A bit tangy, not too sweet, it was good, and a good refresher to the heavier chicken katsu. 

Highly recommend this place, just get there early if you are going for lunch because they can get busy!
Absolutely fantastic.  The Bread is phenomenal and the staff is Great  still one of my favorites

The BEST warm sandwiches and the homemade potato salad is to die for!!! I could eat it all day! The vibe is very calm with gentle music in the background and the owner and employees are kind with excellent customer service! I have been here 2x now and absolutely will be a regular customer!! 
They also have a wide drink variety and a nice kids menu! 
The price is the same as subway but 1000x better quality- I had the chipotle chicken sandwich today and the chicken was so juicy-so good!
Highly highly recommend!!
Fire bang shrimp (not spicy)! The sauce on the shrimp is sweet and sooo good, I got mine with some amazing cold pasta mac and a Hawaiian bun. The Guava drink is absolute nirvana! A must try!!

What I Love about sketch burger is that they actually follow through with their price promises. If a burgur costs $10 here, it's because theres $10 of material on it. This ain't no ripoff burger place (we're all familiar with that). Owner is passionate about her craft-a real food lover and very knowledgable. Definite 5 stars. Cash only.

My roommate and I love sketch burgers. We live nearby and think they're great. However, we will never eat there again. The waitress is so horribly obnoxious and has been every time we come (which is usually Sunday nights) She's loud, abrasive, and has that horribly fake server voice which I can't stand. She also doesn't do the menu any justice. Everytime I order a turkey burger or a veggie burger (or anything that doesn't contain red meat) she makes a snarky comment like what I ordered wasn't a good choice. She did the same thing to my roommate when he tried to order a vegan milkshake, saying (and I quote) that he "shouldn't even bother. Get a real man's milkshake." I couldn't believe it.

I do love the burgers and I'm sure I'll be tempted to order from there again but only for takeout. I won't risk having to be served by that obnoxious loud woman ever again.

Words cannot describe how much I love Dinner Done.

So, you know Hell Fresh and Blue Apron? This is similar but way better. How is it better? You don't have to cut or prep anything. Here's how it goes at my house:

- Night before, we take out a meal to thaw in the fridge (unless it has now thawed cook option)
- The day of, we Turn on the oven
- Pop in the meal
- Set an Alexa timer
- Ten minutes before that's supposed to finish, I prep a veg or make a salad
- One and a half minutes before the timer goes, I microwave a pouch of rice

BAM. Dinner is DONE. There is more than enough in the package for two people. You could definitely serve three people if you had heavy sides.

We've ordered probably thirty different entrees from Dinner Done, and loved all but maybe three of them. Our favorites are Beef Burrito, Caprese Chicken and  Catalina chicken. The selection changes monthly I think, with some favorites that are nearly always available. You can order online and they offer Curbside pickup as well. There is also a discount automatically applied if you order enough, don't ask how I know that. I think Dinner Done saves me money, because I can go to Publix for ingredients for one meal and spend $25-way more than this costs.

If you like yummy, fresh food that saves you a ton of time and money, give them a try!
Missing items from order, not enough food for the price, chicken is good but everything seems basic and rushed

Great neighborhood bar with amazing food. The bar food is great quality wings are cooked crispy with a unique flavors. The chef has daily personal dishes that our phenomenal but the crabs are the best in the neighborhood. Do no waste your time at expensive crab spots this place hands down beats the taste and price. also a great place for to watch a game or play on the top quality "Diamond" pool tables. The bartenders are friendly and personable.
I really enjoyed my meal! Must try the Medusa Roll! Everything was so fresh! I will definitely be back.

Fast, reliable, excellent work. Jorge gave me an estimate the same day and began work the next day. The estimate was reasonable and he even threw in a few extras. 
Looks great. Great customer service. 
I will absolutely use them again.

One of my favorite New York style pizzas in Tampa. We also love their wings  I do have to say, we stopped ordering it through DoorDash and Uber because every time it would be cold....and maybe it's just me but the freshness isn't the same. We now order for pickup, and it's nice and hot every time.

This food truck is AWESOME!!!  I don't have another experience to compare this to but I'm very impressed and borderline addicted to this Hawaiian food.  Specifically that Bang Shrimp omg!  I first tried Solid Grindz during Tucson Meet Yourself a couple of years ago and I have to seek it out anytime they are close to me.  I love that they still have the truck to set up downtown and for other festivals.  If you ever see them around or are on the eastide of town in their neighborhood you should definitely try them.  So far I cannot bring myself to get away from the shrimp, it is crispy and comes with the perfect sauce.  I like to add sriracha to it for extra spice.  Some day I will try something new, and will visit their actual restaurant :)

The taste is OK but not memorable. There was nothing wow about it. In fact, we took the Supreme pizza home, fresh right out of their over. 10 minutes later, I tried the pizza and it was soggy and cold. It's definitely not NY style to me. Save your money and go elsewhere, even Pizza Hut or Dominoes.

We stopped in because Planet Sub had great reviews!!
We ordered subs and they were delicious! The owner was very nice!
We give 10 stars!!

Went here for lunch with my dad and had amazing service. They have a large variety of lunch special combos to choose from. I ended up getting 1 slice pizza, wings, and drink for $11... not bad at all. There are cheaper lunch options available if you only want pizza though.

Service was great, everyone seemed friendly and I appreciate the fact that they have outdoor seating as well as indoor seating spaced out due to covid still being prevalent. 

Is it the BEST pizza and wings, honestly no, BUT it's definitely a great casual place to stop in for a quick lunch :)
Terrible! They use poor quality cheese on their sandwiches which taste awful! It smells like the nail place right next door and cleaning suppLies! and they are always out of product!!Don't go there!!

Great hidden little gem. Best Cheesesteak egg rolls, hands down! Ask for Paige, such an outgoing and professional bartender. I'll be coming back frequently for sure! Also fun spot to watch Eagles game!

In honor of May being National Egg Month, and National Burger Month; its fair time that that I give it up to an amazing burger that combines the flavors of both with endless amount of fortitude. The Cyclops Burger is easily one of the most amazing burgers out there; combining a massive sirloin burger, with an egg cooked any way you want, bacon, the toppings of your choice, and mouth watering sauce. Describing how I chowed down on this burger is sort of like summarizing food porn (sort of SFW - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zdfDXFvi8eY) so i'll spare you the lurid details.

But I seriously have to give mad respect to Sketch because it by far provides the best burgers in all of Philadelphia! whether it's the Cyclops I mentioned above, truffle butter, turkey, veggie, kobe beef, smashed onion, and then some; you might find your brain start to drool out your ear when deciding what to order. especially when you factor in all of those toppings, and homemade sauces that are constructed with love. add in fantastic milkshakes, and Belgian cut fries, and we're seriously talking the stuff of legends.

True waiting for such excellence may take awhile (although more so at others, one day I will might defeat your Geno's sized line to decide if you're worth it - http://www.yelp.com/biz/bobbys-burger-palace-philadelphia). But where else to they give you chalk and crayons to unleash your creative being while you wait. When the rest of The Deli crew and I stopped in before a show we put together, they even let us put up a flier and draw happy chalk stars around it. And for reasons like that, Sketch deserves nothing but love!

OK Am I the only one or has anybody else noticed that the service offered by on of the newer employees is just flat out awful. It could be that he is a relative of the owners or whatever and maybe he doesn't want o be there, but I definitely get the feeling I am interrupting something whenever he is the one that helps me. If he is the future of Martin's that is sad. The other day he was eating his lunch and seemed very upset to put it down and help 4 people who  wished to purchase something. I chalked it up to his having a bad day, but when my wife returned from the market today she commented on the same individual without any prompting from me. Relative or not he needs a lesson in customer service. It even more unusual because we are used to good service here

Jorge and his team did a great job laying pavers at the front of my house. I wanted to widen my driveway out by about (20'x10') for more space to park my car. There were also some small cactuses (4) that had to be moved for the pavers and gravel to be relocated as well. Jorge came by the next day and provided a competitive quote that I accepted via email/website. He scheduled me in the next week and the project took about a day and half to complete. He is friendly to work with and he quickly understands what needs to be done.

In addition, as a side job, Jorge was able to program my water controller (I could not figure it out, it was set up by the previous owner and had no manual) and he repaired the system that had two major breaks in the lines.

Overall, I am very satisfied with his team's work and would highly recommend them for anyone who needs landscaping work done in the Tucson area.

AVOID THIS PLACE if you want to be treated with respect. Having come here a few times with my boyfriend we experienced nice dinner dates, enjoying the sushi, decor and what USED to be polite service. But I ask who can enjoy any of those positive things if you are being booted out of the restaurant the moment you walk in. After highly recommending the restaurant to friends and insisting we try the place after a night at the opera I was mortified when we were treated so miserably. 

Coming from a family of small business owners in LA I know all too well the troubles and hard work it takes to run a restaurant. You NEVER disrespect a customer. 

The waitress'S (plural) were extremely rude turned the lights off on us and set the check on the table well before we had finished our meal. My friends being gentleman left tips, I for principles sake could not ( being a waitress for many years this was hard to do but the tip was not EARNED) 

Good Sushi is everywhere, being treated respectfully is crucial. I hope this review helps yelp users find a place they could really enjoy their time in, this place is not it.

I recently met friends for dinner at Shiroi Hana. They picked the spot and despite having walked past it a million times, I had never been there before. 

Of course I needed to look at the menu and read the Yelp reviews prior to my visit. So as it turns out, the website had been hacked. I couldn't menu stalk and I'm hoping it didn't infect my computer with a virus. Yikes. I mentioned this to someone who worked there and they had only noticed the issue the night before. I had been on the website approximately one week prior to our dinner. Yikes again. 

To my surprise, since I hadn't seen a menu, the sushi was a little pricy.  The specialty roles were a little above standard, but the basic rolls were high. Typically in situations like this, I'll go with a maki combo to maximize my sushi and my dollar...but they didn't have one. 

So I went with a glass of house merlot, a tuna roll and an eel avocado roll. The group split an edamame as an appetizer. 

Everything was fine, but generally unimpressive. The edamame had zero flavor and no salt or seasoning was added. We ordered the basic edamame, but a little something would have been nice. I dipped it in my soy sauce and it was just ok. Similarly with my rolls, they were fine but just standard. 

The service was fine as well. They were as attentive as we needed them to be. 

I left a little hungry and with a little less money in my wallet than I would have liked. I'll be passing on Shiroi Hana in the future.

We had a sweet young lady take our order. We explained it was our first time here and she welcomed us and explained the menu. I got the Experience and my boyfriend got the Super Hero. Both sandwiches AMAZING.  The Super Hero has a ton of meat! The EXPERIENCE was an EXPERIENCE, an excellent experience. The chicken was cold, however the put it in the toaster to fix it. The owner actually came to apologize and gave me a gift card to come back. Even with this very small error it was a fantastic experience and I'm definitely coming back. Quality ingredients and great staff!! Definitely get a 6 inch unless you are starving. It's a ton of food.
They never did give me the estimate that they promised. It is a waste of time to call a guy, meet him at the house, and then wait for nothing.

well, my intentions today were to hit a somewhat local burger joint for lunch but apparently they decided to take the day off so i drove a bit farther to sketch to give them a shot. man, what a tasty burger. i ordered the truffle butter burger with mushrooms, onions, lettuce, tomatoes, swiss cheese and aioli sauce along with an order of belgian fries. man, oh man was this thing good. not sure if it was a 1/3 pound or 1/2 pound burger but it def seemed like 1/2. takeout orders come in the cool little boxes which definitely make eating on the go A LOT easier for people like me. the fries were absolutely some of the best ive ever had as well. fried to perfection. a lil crispy on the outside and perfectly moist inside. 

my only gripe was wait time. 30-35 minutes for a burger is a bit of a push, especially if youre on the go or on a short lunch break etc. call early and allow time for the commute and possible wait when u get there. aside from that, these guys obviously take pride in their product .. from presentation to flavor. i will def be back.

Jorge and his crew did an amazing job turning our backyard into a comfortable, inviting, Oasis. They were fast, friendly, and did fantastic work. We would use them again and recommend them to anyone looking for a landscaper!

Sketch is a good burger joint.

The burgers are gigantic and very reasonably priced for the quality. I had the truffle butter mushroom burger with grilled onions. It was a tender, jucy, flavorful mess of a burger.

The cookies n' cream milkshake is OK.

Where I think this place really shines is the dips offered with the Belgian fries. I tried the chipotle, wasabi, and green goddess. All of them were very good but the chipotle outshined the other two by a small margin.

Protip: use the sauces for the fries on the burger.

The space is covered with crayon drawings that have been done by past patrons. It is an extremely casual place.

On the action-movie-parallel-satisfaction-scale, this place is Planet Terror.

Great eats with great flavored meats!! Bring a friend or bring the entire family, just bring your appetite! Eat in or take it to go, just stop in and order the combo plate so that you can try two of there delicious meats!!

Just so that everyone knows before you go in this store: you cannot return any items for a refund. You cannot return items for store credit. You can only return items for an exchange of another item in the store. 
They don't tell you that when you're buying anything, but the receipt has the return policy on it. Interestingly the return policy on the receipt is not the return policy on their website: "Incorrect orders, opened and/or not resalable as new, cannot be returned {no exception} and the final decision rests with us. $10 minimum!"
I'll admit that I was the perfect mark, and got talked into a much more expensive vacuum that what I needed. As I was walking to my car with my expensive vacuum I had a bad feeling that I'd just been conned. Unfortunately, even if I had turned around and tried to return everything five minutes after paying for it all, they would not have refunded my purchase.
So - just know that once you put your credit card in the machine, you own what you bought. No exceptions, no refunds, no negotiation.

I heard a lot of good things about this place. I must say I was not disappointed. I believe I had the cyclops burger and a order of bulgarian cut fries. The burger was huge, juices and flavorful. When it comes to burgers you can't ask for to much more. The fries were some of the best if not the best  I've had. The staff was friendly which was great since it was my first visit to Sketch burger. The place is a little pricey but I think it's worth a try for any burger lover. The customer made drawings are very entertaining. If I could draw I would definetly draw a picture so I could leave my mark on the wall.

Ok, I live in Cape May County NJ and drive to this place with a cooler full of ice packs to get sausage. I told my friend that we were going to stop by Reading Terminal whilst in Philly. He said, "You and that sausage!". We don't eat red meat. This leaves us limited as to sausage options. Martin's has an epic variety for those of us who decline the swine. There are countless turkey and chicken options. We get LOTS of sausage as we only go to Reading Terminal about four times a year. Everyone is always so nice and helpful! Martin's sausage makes any meal more delicious. Throw some of these bad boys on the grill, cook up some pasta, make a salad, and you have the perfect summer supper! I have recommended Martin's to all my friends and family. They love their sausage as well! Martin's is the absolute best!
Absolutely fantastic.  The Bread is phenomenal and the staff is Great Five stars here

My husband and I have been here twice now and we love it. We look forward to going each month now. Since there are only two of us we have a hard time finding good recipes for just the two of us. We usually end up wasting a lot of food. Dinner Done is awesome because we can split each meal into portions for just the two of us. They're a little pricey but you're paying for the convenience and not having to clean up after yourself. The first time we had no idea what to expect, so here's a little bit about how it goes. When you get there they give you a sheet with the recipes you picked and paid for in advance. The sheet also tells you your shelf number (and they will tell you verbally too). The shelf is in their freezer and it's where you put your meals as you complete them. There are various prep stations around, each counter has 2 recipes listed. You can go in any order you want, we usually just go to whichever station doesn't have anyone first and then figure it out from there. Each station has prep directions, such as mix 1/4 cup of oil and one egg in the mixing bowl...you prep your meal as stated or you can divide it into two containers to get two meals out of it. They have a wrapping station where you wrap each finished meal in plastic wrap and then you put it on your shelf and move onto the next meal. Everything is raw. You don't actually cook anything. Everything is kept in plastic containers with spoons to correlate with the measurement you need. We love this idea because we both hate tomatoes but love onions and garlic. So if a recipe calls for tomatoes we just don't put them on. Likewise, if a recipe calls for onions or garlic we add a bit more. You can personalize it as much as you want. They also have a freezer filled with some premade meals and sides. We love the quiche lorraine, roasted red pepper mashed potatoes, and twice baked mashed potatoes. If you're a family of two you will love this place because you don't end up wasting so much food. The last time that we went a few stations started running out of stuff but anytime you ask staff for something they are very quick and accommodating.

I REALLY like this place.  I've only been once, but I love the concept, the people and the end product.  High quality ingredients at working stations with recipes YOU follow and make yourself.  Then, you take the food home, freeze it and cook it later.  All you need to do is go to the grocery store and buy some side dishes, and BOOM!  Dinner is done.

When I went, there were about 30 of us, and there was plenty of elbow room for us all to whip up our meals.  The prep tables are big and the work stations are sanitary as well as orderly.  The staff did an exceptional job directing traffic considering most of the 30 had never worked in a restaurant environment before.  Hats off!  Can't wait to return.

This restaurant is now open for pickup and delivery with a more limited menu than before Covid. I have ordered dinner several times. My favorite is the black cod which is very delicious. I don't eat raw fish so can't comment on the sushi. The cooked food has been very good overall.

This is the Baskin Robbins of sausage with over 31 styles and flavors of sausage. The spicy lamb Merguez is my favorite. Try the chicken sausage that tastes like the inside of a fantastic Chinese dumpling as well as the chicken with feta and spinach. Martin's brats taste like those served in München. The Italian style ones shine You won't go wrong with anything you select.

My new favorite place to get burgers!  I don't even want to cook burgers at home now because they can't compare. I stumble upon this place trying to find food for my staff meeting, needless to say we ended up having half a staff meeting because everyone raves over the burgers. My assistant recently became a full time vegetarian and let me taste her veggie burger and it was amazing! I have the truffle butter burger with a fried egg on top and I still dream of this burger. One of my fav places to go, I love being able to color as an adult :)
Excellent subs. They make their bread fresh in house. Very kind owners. Close enough to airport so easy stop after flying into Tucson.

Sometimes you just have to eat something different, and that's when I go to Martin's Quality Meats in the Reading Terminal Market. Their sausage selection alone is impressive enough.
I love their sausages they make, with so many varieties available here. My favorite is the spiced lamb merquez and the Italian chicken sausage. The lamb sausage is juicy, not too heavily spiced and goes well with pasta or rice. Sometime I get the Portuguese sausage when I make my own Portuguese bean soup.
All natural and preservitive free, which makes the eating experience all the better. The beef is grade A choice, which is way above supermarket standards. On occasion, I purchase a fat, juicy pork chop or a meaty veal chop. All fresh all the time. And if you ask some of the older butchers, they'll share recipes with you.

Had just finished work and figured "gotta go get dinner".  Had to much fast food so far this trip and I saw local kind grinds on yelp.  Stopped  by and got takeout ..... Everyone was super cool with great service.  
When I got back to my room .... this killa plate was ono. Great flavor and cooked to order.
Most definitely be stopping by again before I go back to hawaii

A friendly little burger joint with a laid back atmosphere and delicious food. The place is fairly small though, so it's not a place to hit up with more than 4-5 people.

The menu is reasonably priced -- around $8-12 depending on your preferences -- and the selection is short and simple. (This is definitely a burger place. Although there are a couple other menu items, I wouldn't recommend coming here if you weren't in the mood for some permutation of patty (beef, turkey, veggie), toppings, and buns)

I ordered a kobe burger with pepperjack cheese, bacon, and chipotle -- not necessarily an exciting order, but a classic nonetheless -- and was very satisfied. The fries are thick, too. 

Overall, I had a nice experience here. I think I'll stop by again in a couple weeks.

I brought my sewing machine in for repairs and sadly the repairs cost more than what I paid for my cheap machine. I chose to use my estimate deposit and put it to a nicer newer machine that would last me longer than the three tiny years that I got from my broken one. The gentleman there helped me out with picking the right one and even explained some good tips that I didn't know already. It was nice to deal with someone who knows what they're doing.

Let me start by saying I had a bad valve and my drip system would not turn off and of course it happened on Father's Day! I called a few companies hoping on Father's Day (Sunday) someone would pick up because my irrigation system would not turn off! Jorge at Cardinal picked up and I heard his family in the background, naturally being a father myself I felt bad, he walked me through turning off the valve and said he would come out on Monday, he came out and gave me a great quote, he was back the next day to replace the valve, reset my timer, and trim my tree in the front yard and the rest of my bushes & landscape. If you're looking for a professional family owned local company, please call Jorge he is excellent and very very talented! You will not be sorry!!! Our yard looks amazing!!

If any body gives this place a good review this guy must be their friend.   It's sleazy operation.  I took my Shark vacuum to have cleaned and unclogged.  There was a pencil and a sock stuck in the hose.  Yes I have children.  The guy charged me over $80.  I had to call 3 times they took over 2 weeks for a simple issue that an experienced vacuum cleaners repair person would have handled within 3 days.   By the 3rd phone call they told me to they would have it ready after 12 noon,  Apparently they just fixed my vacuum that day.  It was cleaned but that was all.  It was not picking up dirt as it should for it was still clogged . My husband got the pencil out that was still there.  We took the bottom piece off and pulled all the dirt that had gathered over time adding to it's lack of performance.  Something this rip off place should have done.   GO SOMEWHERE ELSE.  I noticed he dressed like a pimp, now I know why.

1. Vegan burger
2. fries
Tasty burgers and found myself wetting my finger to get the last of the fries crumbs out of the wrapper. Friend had the Truffle Butter Burger and said it was delicious. Decor kept us amused looking at the pics drawn by customers lining the walls. Went early in the day and relatively quiet, although looking forward to going back on weekend when it's supposed to be jumping

Picked up to-go sushi from this spot my first night in Philly. I was exhausted, but hungry, and stumbled upon Shiroi Hana. I placed an order on the spot and in about 5 minutes it was ready! Yay! 

I ordered the Chirashi, which was delicious. All the fish was super fresh and tasty, as was the accompanying miso soup. The prices are a little high for what I'm used to (who says Philly is cheaper than DC, nonsense!), but the quality was high, and I'll definitely head back.
Great spot for subs! Their subs are one of the best ones I've had. Very flavorful, great price, great selection and the best customer service I've had. Must try!
Jorge and crew were great to deal with. The  estimate was spot on, and reasonable. From first walk thru to plants in the ground, Cardinal Landscaping did a outstanding job!

Add Sketch to the growing list of amazing Philly restaurants that serve terribly unhealthy fare.  Be you a carnivore or an herbivore, Sketch will have something right up your alley.  I tried the bbq chicken burger special... YUM.  My friend and I couldn't even finish the large fries between the two of us.  And, all of the tasty sauces that you can choose from are the cherry on top of your, uh, burger.  Because I really needed something else to be addicted to, like dipping french fries in aioli.


ps. Don't go here if you are indecisive.

This is the Chiropractic practice I was looking for.  There is individual care by very well trained and clearly advanced practitioners.  They run on schedule but there is never a rush.  They invest in the patients they see and will even do extra research when needed to enhance specific or unique challenges. This is what good Chiropractic care is all about.

Popped in here for BLT to go... also got a side of potato salad & a choco chip cookie. Everything was delicious!  The BLT was toasty & well made, crispy bacon & fresh toppings.  The potato salad was tasty.... And the cookie was the perfect dessert... it's a big cookie though so there's some left for later.  I'll definitely be back!

I randomly stopped in here the other day and got a Greek salad. One of the best, if not thee best, Greek salads that I've ever had! I added chicken and it was perfect. The dressing: just enough. The lettuce: crispy. The veggies: fresh. Can't wait to try more!

Was able to get a fair estimate and scheduled service pretty quickly. Jorge was nice enough to take a look at my irrigation system and answer some questions I had concerning my yard. The tree looks great!

Delicious food! Definitely come here for brunch. They have bottomless mimosas and sangria for just $18 and I'd definitely recommend the paella. It was delicious. They also have an outdoor patio section that is dog friendly. Sam at the bar were amazing!! Attentive and caring each time she checked on us. Definitely plan on going back

i probably shouldnt write reviews with a bloated food coma...but WOW!

5 different rolls.  three of them were ginormous.  huge.  like the size of a cupcake or a muffin top (the food).

the sashimi practically melted in my mouth.  like it was frappe'd.

dense rice packed in.  some rolls wrapped in cucumber were tasty.

monday at 545 and we opened the place for dinner.  very attentive server.

reasonably priced for so much food.

best sushi in center city as far as i know.  much better than fat salmon.

i will not be eating for the next three days.

Before I moved to the Tucson area I was the Duchess of Leo's Island BBQ in Peoria, AZ.
I really LOVE me some Hawaiian BBQ...seriously. 
I moved from Phoenix in 2013 and had given up on finding a good Island inspired restaurant in this area.

Until tonight!

Solid Grindz completely won my heart, and my patronage at around 6:45 pm this evening. As soon as myself and my Rocker Boy entered this quirky, eccentric looking establishment we were greeted in a genuinely friendly and enthusiastic manner. The two beautiful young ladies manning the counter were eager to describe our dining fare, and we felt at ease and welcomed from the get go.

I ordered the 2 meat plate of Teriyaki Chicken and Bang Shrimp (not Bangkok like my photo says...stupid auto correct!) and Rocker Boy ordered the 2 meat combo with Teriyaki Chicken and Kalua Pork. We both chose the white rice, but my guy went with the beans I chose the macaroni salad for our sides. For good measure I also ordered a side of the Spam Misubi...because SPAM!!

When our food arrived we were immediately struck by the large portions of food for the price  (around  $10.00/ $11.00) My partners Kalua Pork was perfectly smokey and moist interspersed with shreds of tender cabbage. My Bang Shrimp was succulent on the inside, crispy and lightly spicy on the outside...wonderful! Both of our orders of Teriyaki Chicken was flavorful, lightly charred, and fork tender. It couldn't have been any more perfect!

But wait!

Our sides of white rice was glutinous and sticky...just right for holding onto the Teriyaki Sauce that sits in a bottle on every table. Rocker Boy's beans were equally vinagary and sweet with pineapple chunks, and my macaroni salad was THE BEST Hawaiian style I've ever had! And I don't think I can adequately describe how much I enjoyed my Spam Misubi. Even if you don't like Spam, give one of these a try. The Spam is grilled to crispy perfection, then layed on a sushi inspired slab of sticky rice, then all wrapped up in nori!

I see myself gaining a lot of weight...

One of the owners (Toni) came to our table to ask how we were enjoying our meal halfway through. What a lovely lady...she really takes pride in the food her restaurant serves and it shows! She explained to us how they'd only recently upgraded to a sit down restaurant after having done business out of a food truck on the Air Force Base for the last 3+ years.

We will definitely be returning. We've decided that every Wednesday evening will now be known as 'Hawaiian BBQ Wednesday'!

Jorge was great on the walkthru and quote and his team did an amazing job at the first cutback/servicing at our new home. Looking forward to the future work at cleaning up and growing a beautiful landscape here!

I was very pleased with my experience with Jorge and Cardinal Landscaping. Although our initial appointment time was missed he quickly reached out to explain and was able to reschedule very promptly. He offered a fair price and did excellent work removing bushes and shrubs in the front and back of my house and making it look very neat afterwards. Recommend!

I love Martin's!  Did I say Love..yes it's true!
I have been coming back for years because of the quality of products they have!  Not only does Martin's serve up quality beef; sausages and pork products...but this is also the place where you can get antelope; alligator; rabbit and other 'game' meat that other butchers don't carry!

When you come to Martin's..get your number (there is usually a wait) and then begin to look at what you wanna buy!  

Martin's is a local favorite at The Reading Terminal!

You wouldn't expect an authentic Hawaiian plate lunch place in Tucson, but this place nails it. Had the chicken Terri plate with Mac salad, the large portion was more than I could handle, lol.  If you're in the area don't miss it.

I've been here twice now and I give it 5 stars! 

I've only had "the experience" and it is so so good. If you are in the Tucson Marketplace area I encourage you to go!!! 

Apparently they make their dough from scratch!

They have one of those Coke Machines where you can choose from like 100 different drinks!

It's a nice little place and the cashiers have only ever been professional when I've gone!

I used to love this place. It's really gone downhill. The service is horrible!  We waited for 15 min for our check. Our waitress was just hanging out in the back,  we could see her. The food has also gotten bad. Our beloved green corn tamale with Baja sauce was dry and sooooo small. It was overwhelmed with rubbery cheese. It was horrible. I  don't think we'll go back. It used to be my favorite Mexican place.  :(

Lively college town type atmosphere, creative spectrum of sammies, reasonable prices, and friendly staff make for this place to remind you why small businesses are the best. 
Not to mention the in house made bread is deliciously soft and pull apart on the inside while toasty crisp in the outside. 
Fresh ingredients, savory meats, and man-hand sized portions make this a hidden gem for simple cravings deliciously met. Yummy. I'd come back!
Amazing, recommended it already to everyone I talk to on a regular basis. Have had it multiple times since the first time I tried it and never disappoints.
Food is okay. Do they just leave the phone unhinged so it seems busy during lunch? Get call waiting wtf

Solid grindz is a solid 10/10 would HIGHLY recommend! They are a military, local, family owned spot with amazing authentic island cooking from their amazing tender juicy pork, teriyakis, to simple comfort snacks like their spam musubi. Have I told you about their mac salad yet? OH MY GOD, their mac salad is unlike anything I've ever had. (None of that fusion junk here) They also give you HUGE portions of food for a fair price. I'm never hungry after eating here. They work quickly to get your order to you. Amid covid they have not allowed dine in- rest assured the restaurant is extremely clean and inviting. They serve many families and men in uniform because they have a great reputation for serving local, authentic just homemade food filled with love and flavor. Never once have I been sick after eating here unlike some other local chains. They care about their customers and their love for the community shows through their amazing food! I'm excited to visit them again soon as my friend has highly recommended I try their bang shrimp. Apparently it's so bangin, she claims it's "addictive!" Make sure you stop into this little east side gem near davis monthan air force base. It's literally walking distance from base- if you don't have a car it's worth the short trek to get some delicious food! It shares a parking lot with a carniceria, parking isn't abundant but somehow there is always room. I'm happy to show this establishment some local love today and any day! If you can, stop in, donate, keep them running! We need to support our local business owners now more than ever! Wear a mask, call ahead and be courteous! #ThankYouThursday

Was visiting base and saw the food truck, lived in Ewa Beach for years & miss our Hawaiian Barbecue Spots. Glad we tried this one as it took us back to some of our best stomach memories of Hawaii Life. The food was delicious, hot and plenty of it for the $$$. Both me & my wife enjoyed our plates and left the BX full & satisfied. All the meats were cooked just right with the flavor we was hoping for & miss.  I especially loved the Mac Salad which is hard to find here in the Mainland. 
Definitely want to check out the Brick & Mortar Restaurant - Mahalo !!!

First I need to make it clear that I have spent a lot of time in New Orleans, eating real Creole food not crappy tourist stuff people think is true New Orleans cuisine. I have had meals at Kermits in the 9th ward and fried chicken at Willie Mae's and many meals at Commander's Palace.

Roux is the real deal. Authentic yet still Nouvelle so it's creative and bursting with flavors. 

Everything I had was so good. The service is outstanding and you will not find a better meal in Tampa

I called Cardinal Landscaping because of the good reviews. Unfortunately, we made and appointment and were stood up two times. The first time George texted and apologized, and rescheduled for the following day at the same time. No problem, I get it things happen. The next day, again no show. And, no text. So, now I'm just frustrated and have wasted a week. So, back to the drawing board trying to find a reliable landscaper in Tucson.

Very good authentic island food. You won't find food like this really in Tucson unless you know someone who can cook it themselves. If you're from Hawaii and you need your fix from anything back home here is your place. The menu isn't huge but has all the favors from Chicken katsu to kalbi short ribs, and of course spam musabi. Pricing here is very reasonable especially for the portions you get which are pretty big. Service is great here as well which makes the experience even better
The staff is wonderful the food is out of this world and great prices you have to try the pizza

Jorge and his team are fantastic. They showed up on time and did everything they said they were going to do. The price was fair and I would recommend them to anyone looking to have work done. 

They trimmed trees, bushes, pulled weeds, and sprayed for future weeds. My yards looked amazing when they were finished.

Going to ask them back for some gravel work and to plant a couple of trees.

We decided to try this place out so I got the chicken katsu with a side of white rice and beans. I asked for the side sauce of katsu and teriyaki so the chicken wouldn't get soggy on the drive back. I really enjoy the chicken, it was made perfectly in terms of consistency. I recommend checking this place out if you're on this side of town.

I'm always iffy about trying new spots, especially when it comes to sushi. Worried if it's not authentic enough or if the fish wont be fresh... But this was AMAZING.. It hit the spot! The sushi was delicious and very fresh. The waitress was super friendly, even offered to change our table cuz we were orginally seated at two person table, but we ordered so much, that she asked if we would be more comfortable in a bigger table, an extra plus that she noticed! We went about 530pm on a weekday, and by 630, there were already ppl waiting. 

Atmosphere was nice, service was great, food was superb, why wouldn't i be back? =)

Solid sushi here with good service. I'd be curious to see how their bento boxes are during lunch hours since they're slightly discounted - otherwise, the prices are pretty much in line with a Center City location.  

Bar offerings a bit lacking, but very few sushi places seem to have great beer options. I would absolutely go back, rolling 10 friends deep to use the reserved chabudai seating upstairs!
Yummy sandwiches! The owner is a wonderful person and we love to support a great small business. Skip the chain sandwich places and give planet sub a chance. You wont be disappointed.

Love Sketch!  It doesn't hurt that I can see it from my apartment, but even if it were across town I would make the trek.  The food is out of this world at reasonable prices (considering what you're getting).  The portions are generous.  The vibe is perfect for it's Fishtown location: funky, artsy, fun and a little dingy.

The standout here would have to be the service though.  Energetic, fun and really, really nice.

My boyfriend and I were looking for a place to eat dinner after the Christmas village. This was next to our parking garage so we decided to give it a go. Who doesn't love sushi. It was 5/6pm on a Friday. There wasn't anyone in the place. 

The sushi was drastically overpriced. I got two rolls and it was almost 30$. It was fresh but there were not many salmon dishes which are my favorite. My boyfriend got a bento box which came with so much more. If I could of re ordered I would have gotten that. It was unclear if there was a liquor license at the place. There was no drink menu and I saw some people have beer and a drink but I didn't see a bar. 

I don't think I would come here again. It was kind of weird and crazy over priced.

BarkSuds is GREAT! I love their business model-- truly unlimited grooming sessions (everything excluding haircuts) for a fixed monthly price (haircuts extra, price varies depending on size of your dog). 

I've been taking my giant schnauzer here for over a month now and the staff is always friendly. If I don't see an appointment available online, I just call and the staff has always been able to squeeze me in where it is convenient for me. They have even stayed later than their posted closing time to finish up my dog. Such an incredible staff. 

It is a great, affordable deal for those dog breeds that require much more attention or frequent grooming sessions. Both times my dog got his haircut, the staff has been very attentive and accommodating. For the price, they do NOT do custom/stylish cuts (one single length around the whole body, but they clean up my schnauzer's beard and eyebrows) but that is completely fine with me! 

I can't recommend Richard and his staff enough! Check them out if you are looking for a quick wash or a haircut!

Horrible business etiquette!!! These technicians are really rude to some customers and not others. Every time I come in the staff doesn't speak or say anything, which is beyond rude. Went today and waited for over an hour for a gel pedicure had 3 people ahead of me and 2 people who came in after me. The lady Tran sat me in the pedicure to soak finally after about two hours and started to do the person's nails who came in after me and was waiting for 5 mins! Then she had the other nail tech start another lady's nails who arrived after I did. I had to walk out. The worst part is that Tran tried to make it seem like I was getting my service done by asking me what color I wanted and having me soak my feet, but then left to do someone else's nails. I Went to spa nails across the street in the other plaza and the customer service was 10x better and I was in and out. Would rate 0 stars but I have to put at least one. :(

It was my first time and as soon as I entered, was greeted by the friendly staff. They were patient as they took our order. Once we received the food it exceeded our expectation and was very delicious. The atmosphere is very casual and comfortable i would definitely recommend eating here to anybody!

Trust me -  this comes from a dyed-in-the-wool-my-nana-can-cook-better-than-yours-with-one-mano-tied-behind-her-back Mexican food snob - some things at Macayo's are not THAT bad.

You would be perfectly justified in saying:

It's not truly authentic  Mexican food.
Service is hit or miss.
Sometimes your food is not perfectly hot.
It's a chain - this explains all three of the above.

You could also say:

The chips are thin, crispy and always served warm. They are freshly fried each day. I know this because I worked in a Macayo's in my younger days and one of my tasks was to make what seemed like a tanker truck full of these each day.
The mild salsa is actually quite good.
They don't skimp on portions.

Things I recommend:

The shredded beef - it's consistently good.
Happy hour - all appetizers are half price. Try the supreme nachos with shredded beef. I think they are the best nachos in town. My daughter, who recently turned 21, says the frozen house margarita is, I quote, DA BOMB.
They used to have a dish called Steak Cortez. Imagine - a steak stuffed with a whole green chile and covered in spinach con queso. Of course it's not on the menu anymore - it was probably illegal.

If you want to hate on Macayo's, it's your Yelp-given right. With places like these, it's all about your last experience. On our last visit, the food was consistent as always, but the service was stellar. It may be a different story next time.

First time here. I got the spicy south west chicken and it was  Really good !!!!! Beats Jimmy Johns and subway. My husband got the buffalo chicken signature and his was better then mine. I got my daughter the torpedo it's like the spicy Italian but really good my daughter enjoyed. Super family friendly. Will be back soon. Highly recommend!!!

I wish this was a place that I could just drive to, and not have to worry about parking, getting in from Delco, etc.  

Because if this place was around the corner from me, I'd be here every day.  They've never let me down, the prices are reasonable, and the guys behind the counter have a sense of humor.  

My go to dish here... grab some of the ground turkey, mix it with the turkey sausage of your choice (be sure to remove the casings first), and make a kick ass turkey meatloaf at home.  

Bring home some meat from this place, and you won't have to be Bobby Flay to put out a damn good meal at home.

I am so pleased with his work! Super professional, kept me informed about issues with scheduling and just a really friendly guy. Even my neighbors told me how nice the yard looks now! Definitely going to schedule more frequent landscaping with him so it's not so much work all at once. Check out the before/after pictures!

First time here...looks like they might be understaffed today, but hostess/chef didn't mention anything (she was actually pretty rude). Belgian Fries came out pretty quickly - yummy!  Still waiting for the sandwiches (I'm doing the chicken, no sauce, bleu cheese). Others in my party are doing the Dr. Pepper Pork and the Kobe sandwich. One couple is apparently tired of waiting - walked out.

This is my favorite sushi restaurant in the city for lunchtime sushi. I find that the 'mix 3 special' is a steal of a deal given the excellent quality of the fish. I have converted countless coworkers into Shiroi Hana regulars, and highly recommend it. I have had most of the appetizers as well as the sushi and sashimi. Colleagues have had some of the cooked dishes if they didn't like raw fish, and always said they liked the food.

The service is also attentive and very quick, and the fish is presented nicely on the plate. Even at noon I can get in and out under an hour, which is not my experience at some other restaurants at that time.

You want to give me a giant, awesome burger, tasty, crispy fries AND you're going to let me draw pictures while I'm waiting? Oh wait, and you're going to let me hang my creation on the wall? WELL DAMN, I'M ON BOARD.

This hole in the wall restaurant must have a loyal following of regulars from the way the waitress interacted with all of the people that joined us on the Wednesday night we were there. She was just a bundle of energy and friendliness, even to us, whom she'd never met before. 

She recommended the green chile cheese fries while we were waiting for our friends. We ended up trying both those and the standard cheese fries before the night was over and I don't know how they get the melted cheese that CREAMY, but again...damn, I'm on board. For all of it.

I got the Truffle Butter Burger, which had mushrooms and truffle oil. And, I'm assuming, butter in there somewhere. Delectable. I think the buns are Le Bus brioche rolls, which I've come to see as the ultimate standard in burger buns in Philly, so props there.

We finished up our meal with an awesome brownie sundae. I swear the brownie was made out of the chocolate that comes from angel poop. It's REAL, I PROMISE.

This is kind of out of our normal stomping grounds, but I'd definitely be up for coming back. I want to try the Kobe burger!
We came because our GPS was supposed to be taking us to Subway.  This was much better.

Stopped by because of a good buy on Groupon. 

1. Had the lemon pepper wings which were very good.
Served in a 70's Era wood laminated bowl that my mom bought at j c penny's back in '73. No biggie but what the heck. Wings were a bit over overdone but still good. A 7 on my personal scale.

2. Had a couple of Yuengling's. But really did not have a great selection on tap. The "lights" are well represented. The beer fridge has an ok selection of local and regional brews. Plus some of the new style hard sodas. Nice!

3. Atmosphere. This a corner neighborhood sports/pool bar. The locals take their pool seriously. There are a ton of trophies on the wall. Bring your stick! 

4. Parking is good. The bank across the street has a lot that is open after 5pm. If you are earlier...good luck on the street.

Conclusion I will stop by this summer to watch the Phillies and have a brew or two. Plus I want to check out the seafood. 

I would put Cappys as a high end dive bar. A place to hang with your buddies or grab a quick one before heading home. Either way I am putting Cappys on my list of places to hang.
The food and service was spot on. The crab leg sauce is better then Chickie and Pete's.

I want to keep this simple:  Sandwich was Mega Roast Beef (they usually don't make them)... it had thick slices of tasty roast beef with big piles.  Since this was my first time here I didn't know what to expect but worth what i paid.  The women who made my sandwich was impressive as she actually came out to ask me what I wanted on it and when i was done she took my tray.  What sandwich place has that kind of customer service?  The bread comes toasted which was okay; it was an Italian style roast beef and was pretty good.  If you get the roast beef I recommend lettuce and provolone.  I didn't think about it but it would have made the sandwich even better.  Place was nice inside for being close to the VA.  No complaints really definitely better than subway and Jimmy johns and jersey mikes.  I might try a different sandwich next time.
Best subs in town no question my favorite Sonoran cheesesteak out of this world. Only if you like spicy .If not they have a Lotta subs for your liking God bless

I am very impressed with this company. I requested an estimate for tree trimming. Jorge, the owner, responded right away. We set up an appointment and he arrived on time and was both professional and friendly. The estimate was very reasonable and Jorge was very quick to respond to emails and set up appointments.

I wish I could give this place a zero. Came in and ordered appetizer food, which I had to pay for in advance, it took over hour because the cook was down the street playing lottery (at least that's what the bar tender said). When the cook did get back, he had all sorts of shading looking people running in and out of the kitchen and not wearing a mask despite a sign on the door saying it's required. Seemed very unsanitary, who knows if he even washed his hands, as he looked filthy. I asked for a refund after seeing all this, but the bartender couldn't help and I paid for it in advance. When I finally got the food, it was not what  I ordered. The bartender that I ordered from just made excuses for him because she's obviously scared of the cook because we runs the place apparently and mistreats everyone. I have a masters in business and this is not a well run establishment, it's run like a restaurant in a third world country. Not to mention that the price is that you're charged dont match the menu. I would definitely avoid this place, they are such better options around.
Would definitely recommend! They trimmed our palm trees and did a great job. We will be going to them for future services.

I love most things Hawaiian and was very excited to learn about Solid Grindz when I moved here two years ago.

I tried the big kalbi and bang shrimp plate. The kalbi was overcooked, but that shrimp was delicious - crispy, creamy, a little sweet. The mac salad was spot on with the creaminess and seasonings - not soupy or anything! I didn't know what to expect with the beans, but they had the standard bacon/smoked flavor; I paired this with my kalbi and rice and it was almost the perfect bite, maybe I could have used a little bit of kimchi, but it's not like I didn't enjoy my lunch.

SG is located very close to the Air Force base and it gets packed fast. The parking lot is a complete cluster, and small, so be careful when you pull in, there's just a bit of wiggle room. The dining room is small/medium sized due to its location in a tiny strip mall. Orders get cooked fast, so you're not waiting too long whether you're dining in or take-out.

I have made many mortgage loans in my life and have always dreaded the mortgage broker interaction.  Not being from Tucson, and having two other brokers tell me how complicated it was going to be to finance a second home, I was losing interest in the whole deal.

By chance I stumbled across Tom's Yelp review and decided to give him a call.  From our first interaction I could tell he knew what he was doing and seemed to be giving me straight answers.  He and his entire team ALWAYS returned phone calls in a timely manner and kept us informed about our loan process at all times.

This guy and this office is as good as I've ever worked with  and I've worked with many.

Pleasantly surprised that Yelp worked for more than just restaurants.
Great place delicious food. They had an online order option. Aside from the fact they forgot the teriyaki sauce for my chicken, it was excellent

Sometimes at restaurants you may receive bad service, but at the Dennys on Hillsborough I received no service. My son and I were completely ignored. The waiter passed our table serval timed before even acknowledging us. He never once apologized for taking twenty minutes to take our drink order. Completely unprofessional. Not to mention how hot it is in here. Worst experience I've had in a long time.

Jorge and his team spent the day at our home today, weeding, pruning, cutting the high grass, etc. He was also able to check out our irrigation system during his initial visit and was knowledgable and thorough. Highly recommend, we will definitely use A&J Landscaping again!!

If I could give it 0 stars I would. The bartenders are great but the cook is an a$$hole!!! Treats the bartenders like $hit never gives you what you ask for and if you have any changes to your order he comes out and screams!!! I will never go back there

It doesn't look like much from the outside on 15th Street, but step inside and it's got a simple, modern, yet warm decor. This was my first visit, so not knowing what to expect, we tried the teriyaki salmon - something I could make at home, but it's interesting to test a new place on something very basic. It was perfectly cooked, and they do have brown rice, which was also perfect. A very nice touch. Other diners in my party praised the sashimi and sushi plates. Our waitperson was very helpful and attentive. Will be back!

This is one of my favorite 'mom and pop' stores in our area! The owner, Scott, is always on hand offering assistance in picking out the right vacuum cleaner for your needs, or answering questions, and so on.  What impressed me is that he really listened to me and heard what I said. Telling him I needed a second vacuum cleaner for my upstairs level, I told him how we have very limited storage space, so a large unit was not right for us. He immediately went to a model that was light, small, and yet very powerful - and best of all, bagless - which fit my needs perfectly! I love my new stick-vac, and my champ, the Simplicity Freedom upright, remains downstairs and my back remains pain-free. No more carrying heavy cleaners up and down the stairs for me! Also, he fixed my upright vacuum, which really needed some attention. It turned out it was very clogged because I accidentally picked up some water from the dog's dish. He fixed it literally overnight and I picked it up the next day. A couple of my friends think his pricing is a bit high, but in all reality, it isn't. You get what you pay for, and he sells quality merchandise. I have thrown away much, much more in lesser quality vacuums over the years - but the one I bought from him is like a little vacuum 'battle tank'! Made of metal, and not cheap, easy to break plastic, my Simpicity Freedom vacuum is super reliable. As far as quality vacuums go, it is light in weight, so there is very little arm and shoulder strain for the user. I repeat: I have wasted many, many dollars on cheap vacuums (sorry, Shark!) over the years at huge department stores. When there was a problem, it was just too bad for me. But, with Sew and Vac of Andorra, there is Scott to the rescue! Thank you, Scott. I am one very well pleased customer!

I was missing a good Hawaiian BBQ place once I moved to Tucson. However, shortly I was introduced to Solid Grindz. Now I've never felt anything but happy and full every time I've visited here. 

The food is quite exceptional. From their Bang shrimp, beef ribs, chicken Katsu to their Mac salad, rice and musubi, you can't go wrong! I will say the bang shrimp is my favorite. I can't get enough of the bang sauce, and now that I've gone pescatarian, it's probably my best choice. But previously I've had almost everything on the menu. It's all high quality and made fresh to order. Large portions for the price as well. You'll sure be satisfied and full when you visit. 

The food comes out quick for being fresh made buuut that's never stopped me from snacking on a spam musubi while I waited. The staff is quite pleasant and friendly. Always smiling and helpful with the menu. The location has changed not to long ago. From a stand alone building across the street a block or so down, now to a connected plaza. But they still have plenty of seating and the food has only gotten better. 

I still miss the good memories from my home town Hawaiian BBQ but this place will surely make more. Enjoy!
I'm so thankful for Dinner Done!  As a working mother, this service has been a life saver!!
Great Group of Chiropractors, both Dr Kace and Kaye, they  have a great touch.

Sketch creates a three napkin burger.  So juicy you could use wrist sweat bands.  Not interested in just plain beef?  Sketch has other options!  How about a kobe, smashed onion, turkey or vegan burger.  There is also an endless list of cheeses, toppings and sauces to top it all off.

As delicious as the burgers are, the real standout is the handcut Belgian fries - thick cuts of perfectly fried fresh potatoes.  These are some of the best fries I have ever had. You can have them plain or with green chili cheese sauce.  As tempting as the latter sounds, the fries don't need anything beyond a little salt.  

Not in the mood for a burger?  Sketch offers other dishes as well.  The night we were there they had a few other dishes including pulled pork cooked in root beer, mac and cheese with mushrooms and vegan burritos.  They also offer milkshakes and Stewart's sodas including root beer, cream, orange and grape flavors.

The only downside to this cool spot is the uber annoying, too cool for school hipsters who patronize the place for their vegan specialties.  But I can manage to ignore them if it means getting a burger and fries from this joint.

If you haven't recently been to this place, you need to give it another shot.  And if you've never been, go there PRONTO!

I love coming here.  In fact, this is one of the only reasons I come to the Reading Terminal Market.  Their sausages are insanely good and there are so many.  I usually leave with about twelve pounds of rolled up beauties of sausage.  I don't discriminate, the hot pork sausage, the chorizo, the Jamaican jerk chicken sausage and the lamb merguez!  

I feel bad for the tourists because they are honestly missing out on one of the best parts of the RTM.  But, they could always cook it on the street or in their hotel room.  Nope, this is a place that I'm glad is still somewhat for the locals.

Awesome food... You can really eat around the menu because all the subs are really good... I just tried another new one today, the super hero.... Might be my new fav.   The place is super clean and the staff is extremely friendly and don't forget to try the cookies! Freshly made every day!!

Finally a place in Tucson to get REAL island food. We had the combo plate with shrimp, teriyaki chicken and katsu chicken. SO good. The chicken was cooked to perfection - no fat on the meat either. The macaroni side is also great. Next time I'll try the veggie side. We are definitely going to be returning. Now we don't have to drive to think about picking up Hawaiian food on our way out of Phoenix back to Tucson. This is a must try!!

I don't even know what to say anymore about this practice. They're putting me through the ringer with my CD of my X-rays. All they want is money and apparently take it out on you as revenge (wrote a bad review on Google a few weeks ago). Also I found their Facebooks today just out of curiosity ... I know see why they don't wear masks at their practice. They are devout MAGA supporters and believe in pretty much all the conspiracy theories there are. 
To the Groffs, 
 Give me a new CD with an actual X-ray without having me pay yet another $10 or you'll be hearing from me again. 
This is all absurd. Give me my Xray and I'll be on my way.

Possibly the best burgers in Philly! Cannot beat Sketch for the amazing burgers and fries at the price point!

They also have great therapeutic sketching at every table, and if good your sketch will be on the wall!

Recommend: Kobe Beef Burger with the sweet potato fries and the curry ketchup!

*NOTE: Cash only.

Solid! I've eaten here a couple of times: one time was at their truck and the other time was at their establishment. They really bring out the island flavor in their ribs and their Loco Moco. The ribs were alright, I thought they were a tad too sweet on the sauce. The redeemer for me for Solid Grindz is the Loco Moco. A beef patty that was about 2 inches or more at its thickest point on rice topped with gravy and a egg, garnished with garlic bits. You want a meal, they'll give you one. I thoroughly enjoyed the Loco Moco,  but if there was a little less gravy, it would be a perfect meal in my eyes, but overall, Solid!  I needed either a hard labor day at work or simply a nap after this meal, it was hearty! I've heard a lot of good things about their Pad Thai which will keep me coming back more, as well as trying their pho. Get a meal at Solid Grindz!

Contacted the company for an evaluation of work I wanted done in my courtyard.  Jorge, the owner, said he could come the next day between 10-11.  No show, no call.  Really too bad because I chose this business based on other reviews.

This spot is sooo amazing!!! The staff is the most friendliest ever and the food is always a 10/10. Today I had a buffalo chicken Romaine wrap and it was so delicious! The Caesar salad here is probably one of the best in town. Seriously delicious.

We hired Jorge and Cardinal Landscaping to do a couple of projects in our backyard--a tree removal, some flagstone patio repair, and paver path from the front driveway to a paver patio in the backyard.  Jorge was great, even when we made some last minute changes to the original plan.  Everything came out beautifully!  The paver path/patio is awesome--it came out so much better than we had even imagined--and gives us significantly more useable space in the backyard.  Before they even left, I was coming up with more projects that I'd like to hire them for again.
Walked in, no hello. Got my order wrong. Food subpar. The smell of acetone from the neighboring business (which they can't control) was very off putting.

We had a tree we have been having problems with for the past couple of years.  And then the HOA noticed.  I asked for an estimate for removal of the tree and the job was completed with in hours, the same day.  Would never know a tree had been there.  Thank you very much for the prompt, efficient and professional service.

We stopped here for dinner and I think this is a pretty good spot. It's a standard sushi restaurant located in the city tucked away in the corner. It's really easy to walk past this place and never notice it at all.

My family and I have been coming here since Planet Sub moved to this new location! Their food is amaaaazing and you can tell it's from scratch!! The most important thing for me and the reason why we keep coming back is because of their customer service! Very very personable people. Today I went i had to call in my order, pay over the phone and even had one of the workers take my food to the car because I had a sleeping baby. There was no question about it or push back. All the workers are just genuine hard working people! I would recommend them to people off the street! :-)

Cappys has very friendly bartenders that are sociable and respectful. The food is high quality restaurant meals for tavern prices, and the food is great! The bar itself has many seats around the bar and a dining area that's great to bring the family in for a lunch or dinner. The patrons of the bar are friendly and love playing pool, stop in and shoot some 8ball.
Fancy beer and shot bar. Blah. Stick to just pretzels on the bar. Owner trying real hard to get rich off of you.

Interesting visit yesterday.  The place was empty and I walk in and there's a server standing there but not acknowledging me.  Confused, I ask if it's table service or do I order at the counter.  She mumbles something I can't dicipher so I go up to the counter and encounter a stoner who tells me in a voice barely above a whisper that she'll come to my table to take my order.  We're making progress...

I order a truffle butter burger medium rare and fries with chipotle and garlic aioli.  The fries are amazing and were way too much even for me.  The burger was unfortunately overcooked and dry.  

The stoner drops my check and I notice she charged me regular price for the fries (they're a buck off during happy hour).  I politely let her know and she then tries in vain to recalculate and tells me the total was actually a dollar more.  I just look at her.  It's like The Chinese Restaurant episode of Seinfeld as this point.  She must've realized she was wrong and finally gives me the correct total, again in a voice barely above a whisper.  I pay and that was that.  No apology.  No "thank you."
Jorge was quick to respond, come out, and email an estimate. They do amazingly detailed work. Very happy with our paver project. Will hands down call Jorge and his team again for future needs.

These guys did an awesome job! They responded quickly to my estimate request and came out the next morning. My front and back yards were weeded and blown free of goat heads. They trimmed back overgrown shrubs and sprayed to deter the weeds from growing back. They were super nice, so professional and asked a fair price. I would definitely recommend them to anyone. Thanks, guys!!

Great butcher and the best sausage selection i've found in the city. I ordered around $30 in random sausages from sweet italian to jamaican jerk to broccoli rabe and provolone, all awesome sausages. I also picked up a killer ribeye. Great butcher in the terminal market

So excited to have good Hawaiian food nearby!! 

Logistics: Called in our order and it was ready within 15 minutes. Menu is available on their website. You can also walk in to order. There are separate lines for walk-in vs. call-in orders. Masks required to enter and social distancing is encouraged. No dine-in currently. Also closed on Mondays right now. 

Food: Small plates were VERY generous portions. Definitely enough to feed a hungry adult! 

I had the small specialty plate with white rice, mixed veggies, kalua pork and bang shrimp. For anyone else like me who didn't know what bang shrimp is, it's breaded, fried shrimp in a creamy sauce. All of it was delicious. I appreciated that the mixed veggies were simply steamed, a nice healthy touch for an otherwise not very healthy meal! 

My husband had the small plate with white rice, Hawaiian roll, chicken katsu and chicken teriyaki. They gave a generous amount of sauce on the side so I was able to sprinkle some on my rice too. 

And of course we got spam musubi on the side!

All in all, we plan to return soon and often. Gotta support small business.

First time here. Just wanting something a bit different. Saw a deal bought the voucher and so glad I did.  

This is the restaurant from the people that run the food truck by the same name. 

The place is large casual. 2 TVs   You order at the counter and your food is brought to you. 

We had the kahlua pulled pork, teriyaki chicken, bang shrimp with tuna Mac, rice and island beans. 

The meats were so tender and flavorful. The shrimp panko breaded and very tasty.  The island beans are sweet baked beans. I don't usually like macaroni salad. But the tuna mac was surprisingly good. A hint of tuna, savory. Good. 

The staff was friendly. The redemption of the voucher flawless. 

Only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is tables weren't cleaned and the music is way loud.  Otherwise not bad. 

I'd try this place again. 

Mid range pricing. Regular cost for both of us $27.   Could get away with small plate meals at about $20.

First timer for Hawaiian food! I got the bang bang shrimp with white rice and steam veggies. I wasn't sure if I would like the bang bang shrimp because I don't like sweet things for my foods unless it's dessert but it wasn't too bad! There's a little bit of a sweet chili creaminess to it and the crunch of the shrimp was fab! The white rice was super good and made just perfect as well as the veggies. Make sure to have your mask on and don't forget to social distance. I called them in advance to order and it took about 10 minutes for the food to be done! Super quick. Will come back again and try the pulled pork!
Best subs in Tucson! The bread is always so fresh. Meatball grinder is so good!! Such friendly staff as well(:

This Place seriously has the Best wings. All of the food is Fantastic. The Chef has skills here and it shows. The atmosphere is relaxing and the staff is very Friendly. I will not hesitate to come back for a return visit.

When it comes to meat, Martin's in Reading Terminal Market does NOT mess around. Fresh and reasonably priced, Martin's really does have quality meats. I was impressed with the multitude of cuts available at this well-known butcher from beautiful roasts, classic cuts of steak, to chops and osso bucco galore. Even more impressive were their selections of freshly made sausages. If only I was able to take some home with me on the plane!

I hired Jorge and his crew to uproot and remove a tree and landscape my entire property. They did a fantastic job. All trimmings and such were cleaned up. I went with this company because of the good reviews. All of the men are hard workers. Excellent job fellas. Gracia.
Frank L.

Usually when a place ends in "burger" I discount any appeal it might have to my vegan tastes. So when Tom M. said we'd go here for vegan milkshakes, I was quite intrigued.

They have a bunch of vegan flavors (not just one or two) which is fantastic. When I came the first time, we got a "small" fries (for research, obvs) and it was fantastic. Coming in at $2, it was massively tasty, and they have a bunch of sauces to choose from, in addition to having ketchup and malt vinegar on the table (love!). 

So I came back the next day, to try out their seitan sandwich, which apparently rotates on the chalk board. It was delicious, if extremely filling (seitan will do that), and of course we had fries. 4 stars, will eat again (and again ...).

Other deets: Cash only, art supplies at your table (to make your "sketches" of course), and you sit down at will and wait to be served, even though it kind of looks like an order at the counter place. Menus on the table by the wall.

This place has yet to disappoint me. There have been burgers that I have constructed that I didn't like as much as others, but overall I am always satisfied when leaving this establishment. There are plenty of great burger establishments throughout the city. The overall quality and preparation of the food at Sketch Burger undeniably puts them on that list. When I think of a good burger joint three elements come to mind, burgers, fries, and milkshakes and Sketch Burger exceeds at all three. 
Are their milkshakes the best? That is certainly debatable but they are good, and one should treat themselves to one when dining here. They serve the standard Chocolate, Vanilla, Strawberry but check the board or ask about their specialty shakes. 
 
The fries are thick cut and lightly seasoned. The key to eating these is ordering a dipping sauce to your choice to dunk them in although the crispy goodness is good without any condiments. 

Some establishments try to extend themselves at times with an abundance of menu items and it usually doesn't work out... so when I saw pierogis on the board one day, I refrained but my dining companions didn't. No, they are not the best pierogis but they didn't taste like some menu item that clearly an afterthought or experiment. I probably should have ordered my own. 

Now we come to the meat of it all; the burgers. I stand by my opinion when I Sketch has some of the best burgers in Philadelphia. The meat patty itself is a generous size portion of meat. I like how they are able to cook it to my liking (well), while retaining the juiciness of the meat. Add a topping or two, or more and enjoy prepare yourself for a memorable burger experience.

Why 5 stars? Because the food tastes great and we only have to do the easy part!

   ---   ---   ---

My wife and I have been visiting Fitlife Foods just about every week for years. We do our best to eat healthy during the week and don't enjoy cooking, so it's been a Godsend. But with that many Fitlife meals in our rearview, we've gotten a bit tired of the options and felt like we needed a little break. I'd been wanting to try Dinner Done for a while now, so it seemed like the opportune time.

We've now eaten a handful of items and they have all ranged from good to great. We've tried bourbon chicken, loaded mashed potatoes, shrimp milano, meatballs, schnitzel, spaghetti and meatballs, pina colada cake and a few other things that I'm forgetting. I suppose the shrimp milano was my least favorite out of the group, but it was still a very solid meal. The bbq meatballs and loaded mashed potatoes was probably my favorite concoction.
